title: Fee Discrimination in Platform Competition: Free Access vs. Consumer Charges
affiliations: and Shandong University

detail.title: Fee Discrimination in Platform Competition: Free Access vs. Consumer Charges
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the profit and welfare effects of merchant fee discrimination by competing platforms, considering two business models-offering consumers free access versus charging them for platform use. When platforms charge consumers for access, fee discrimination lowers platform profits, aggregate merchant profits, and overall welfare compared to uniform fees, in contrast to outcomes in monopoly settings and one-sided markets. However, when consumer access is free, the effect of fee discrimination on platform and merchant profits depends on the intensity of competition. Specifically, if competition is weak (intense), platform profits increase (decrease) while merchant profits decrease (increase). Consumers continue to benefit—in this case due to expanded higher merchant participation—and total social welfare increases if and only if the degree of competition is in an intermediate range. These findings demonstrate the significance of market competition and pricing models in determining the implications of platform fee discrimination.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了竞争性平台的商户费用歧视对利润和福利的影响，发现在不同商业模式（向消费者收费vs免费）下，费用歧视的效果存在显著差异。当平台向消费者收费时，费用歧视会降低平台利润、商户总利润和整体福利；当消费者免费时，效果取决于竞争强度。
AI.research_question: 竞争性平台的商户费用歧视如何影响平台利润、商户利润和整体社会福利？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注垄断平台或单边市场的费用歧视效果，但缺乏对竞争性平台和不同商业模式下费用歧视影响的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于双边市场理论和平台竞争理论，分析不同定价模式下的费用歧视效应。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，比较不同商业模式（消费者付费vs免费）和竞争强度下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: 1）消费者付费时：费用歧视降低平台利润、商户总利润和整体福利；2）消费者免费时：平台利润随竞争强度变化（弱竞争时增加，强竞争时减少），商户利润相反，消费者总是受益，社会福利仅在中等竞争程度时增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了双边市场理论，揭示了竞争强度和商业模式对费用歧视效果的调节作用，填补了现有理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台企业制定费用策略提供指导，帮助监管机构理解不同市场条件下的费用歧视影响，促进更有效的市场规制。

detail.abstract: The Clash of Titans When the Westerners talk about Maoism, they detail the Great Leap Forward and Cultural Revolution by focusing on their dark sides-famine, chaos, and millions dead. They act like they are the ultimate way of everything. Then why only Maoism? When the West sneers at Maoism, it tallies the Great Leap's famine and the Cultural Revolution's chaos-millions dead, a grim ledger. Fair enough. But why stop there? No system delivers universal prosperity without scars. I acknowledge those failures, but no system can flawlessly ensure economic well-being for everyone. My argument is that Maoism's risks and losses pale next to capitalism's carnage, which I'd say competes with God himself in sheer killing power, as you'd expect from a divine rival racking up bodies across centuries. Maoism's crucible burned hot and bloody, forging China's freedom from centuries of rot and foreign boots. Capitalism's scythe, though, cuts deeper and wider-a divine reaper cloaked as progress while chaining nations to its will. Mao offered something differentdangerous, yes, but a path that broke China free from that slaughter and built a legacy that is still thriving today. Without him, China could've ended up another pawn of America, like so many nations enslaved by its dominance now. The CPC's survival and its lifting of over 800 million people from poverty prove Mao's policies, flawed as they were, where capitalism keeps failing. Mao's gamble, for all its mess, birthed a sovereign power; capitalism's machine keeps killing, quietly stacking bodies across centuries. Let's lay out the grim tally and see who's preaching from a glass house.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比毛泽东主义和资本主义的历史代价，认为虽然毛泽东时代存在失误，但资本主义造成的死亡和破坏更为严重，毛泽东主义成功使中国摆脱外国控制并实现主权独立。
AI.research_question: 毛泽东主义与资本主义在历史代价和发展成果方面的比较分析
AI.motivation: 回应西方对毛泽东主义的片面批评，通过系统性比较揭示资本主义的历史破坏性，为毛泽东主义的历史地位提供辩护
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史比较分析框架，代价-收益分析理论，后殖民主义理论
AI.method: 历史文献分析，数据对比分析，辩证批判方法
AI.findings: 毛泽东主义虽然存在失误（大跃进饥荒、文革混乱），但成功使中国获得主权独立并摆脱贫困；资本主义在几个世纪中造成了更大规模的人口死亡和经济剥削
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了毛泽东主义与资本主义系统性比较的理论框架，挑战了西方中心主义的历史叙事
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国发展道路提供历史辩护，为发展中国家选择发展模式提供参考，促进对资本主义破坏性的认识

title: An optimal algorithm for order picking in a multi-parallel-aisle warehouse
affiliations: University of Maribor and

detail.title: An optimal algorithm for order picking in a multi-parallel-aisle warehouse
detail.abstract: Order picking constitutes the largest cost in running a warehouse, hence optimizing the picking routes may lead to significant savings. We study the problem of optimizing a single pick route in a warehouse with (vertical) aisles and a fixed number of cross aisles, usually referred to as a multiparallel-aisle warehouse. The problem can be seen as a variant of the rectilinear Traveling Salesman Problem. In this paper we show that an optimal picking route can be found in linear time (in the number of aisles) for any fixed number of cross aisles. Moreover, we show that if the number of cross aisles is unlimited, the problem is strongly NP-hard. The presented algorithm is based on dynamic programming, where transitions between states depend only on the number of cross aisles. Therefore they can be calculated a-priori for each number of cross aisles and saved for later use, such that the actual running time for finding a picking route is linear in the number of aisles. Computational results show that the exact algorithm obtains average savings of up to 11, 5% in comparison to the best heuristics used in the literature, and that actual picking routes can be calculated in a few seconds, even for large instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个线性时间算法来解决多平行通道仓库中的拣货路径优化问题，该问题可视为直线型旅行商问题的变体。算法基于动态规划，对于固定数量的横向通道，能在通道数量的线性时间内找到最优拣货路径。计算结果显示该精确算法比现有最佳启发式算法平均节省11.5%的成本，且能在几秒内计算大型实例。
AI.research_question: 如何在多平行通道仓库中高效找到最优的单拣货路径？
AI.motivation: 拣货作业占仓库运营成本的最大比重，优化拣货路径可以带来显著的成本节约。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将仓库拣货路径问题建模为直线型旅行商问题（rectilinear TSP）的变体，采用动态规划理论框架。
AI.method: 基于动态规划的精确算法，通过预计算状态转移来实现在通道数量上的线性时间复杂度。
AI.findings: 对于固定数量的横向通道，存在线性时间复杂度的最优算法；但当横向通道数量无限制时，问题是强NP难的。算法比现有最佳启发式平均节省11.5%成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了问题在固定横向通道数时的线性时间可解性，以及在无限制情况下的强NP难性，为仓库路径优化问题提供了重要的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实际可用的精确算法，能在几秒内计算大型仓库实例的最优拣货路径，为仓库管理提供了有效的决策支持工具。

title: Moral philosophy and archetypes in the symbolic cohesion of the tale of the walking tadpole
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS and Independent

detail.title: Moral philosophy and archetypes in the symbolic cohesion of the tale of the walking tadpole
detail.abstract:
The analysis of Rafael Pombo’s tale The walking tadpole, reveals its moralizing role within Colombian culture. Through the story of the reckless young frog, the narrative illustrates the consequences of disobedience, lack of prudence, and unrestrained rebellion. Drawing on Aristotelian virtue ethics, Kantian deontology, and Durkheim’s moral pedagogy, the fable becomes a tool of socialization that conveys norms about responsibility, self-control, and respect for social order. Its tragic ending functions as a symbolic warning aimed at guiding collective behavior and preserving community cohesion through the teaching of good versus evil.

Keywords: Rafael Pombo, virtue, duty, morality, cohesion

AI.tldr: 本文分析拉斐尔·庞博的童话《行走的蝌蚪》在哥伦比亚文化中的道德教化作用，通过小青蛙的故事展示不服从、缺乏谨慎和无节制叛逆的后果，运用亚里士多德美德伦理、康德义务论和涂尔干道德教育学理论，探讨该寓言作为社会化工具传递责任、自控和尊重社会秩序的规范。
AI.research_question: 拉斐尔·庞博的童话《行走的蝌蚪》如何在哥伦比亚文化中发挥道德教化作用？
AI.motivation: 探讨文学作品作为道德教育工具的社会功能，分析寓言故事如何通过叙事传递社会规范和价值观。
AI.theoretical_framework: 亚里士多德美德伦理学、康德义务论、涂尔干道德教育学
AI.method: 文本分析，结合道德哲学理论框架对寓言故事进行解读
AI.findings: 该寓言通过小青蛙的悲剧结局作为象征性警告，教导责任、自我控制和尊重社会秩序，起到引导集体行为和维持社区凝聚力的作用
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了文学作品的道德教育功能研究，提供了跨学科的理论分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为道德教育和文化传播提供了具体的文学案例，展示了寓言故事在社会化过程中的实际应用价值

title: Online Allocation of Throughput-Constrained Resources Using Proxy Assignments
affiliations: University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business, Cornell University - School of Operations Research and Information Engineering and Amazon

detail.title: Online Allocation of Throughput-Constrained Resources Using Proxy Assignments
detail.abstract: Problem definition: We study a variation of the canonical online resource allocation problem in which resources are throughput, rather than budget, constrained. As in the classical setting, the decision-maker must assign sequentially arriving jobs to one of multiple available resources. However, in addition to the assignment costs incurred from these decisions, the decision-maker is also penalized for deviating from exogenous, time-varying target assignment rates for each resource, which represent the resources' respective throughput capacities throughout the horizon. The goal is to minimize the total expected assignment and deviation penalty costs incurred throughout the horizon when the distribution of assignment costs is unknown. Methodology/results: We first show that naive extensions of state-of-the-art algorithms for classical budget-constrained resource allocation problems can fail dramatically when applied to throughput-constrained resource allocation. We then propose a novel ``proxy assignment" primal-dual algorithm that uses current arrivals to simulate the effect of future arrivals. We prove that our algorithm achieves the optimal $O(\sqrt{T})$ regret bound when the assignment costs of the arriving jobs are drawn i.i.d. from a fixed distribution. We demonstrate the practical performance of our approach by conducting numerical experiments on synthetic datasets, as well as real-world datasets from retail fulfillment operations. Managerial implications: Our framework applies to many practical settings where resource capacity is throughput-based and potentially time-varying, such as assigning jobs to a pool of workers where staffing levels change over time, or assigning shipments to trucks whose departure times are scheduled throughout the day. In contrast to traditional online resource allocation, the financial costs of assignments must be balanced against the cost of deviating from target consumption rates. Our work provides decision-makers with the tools to efficiently manage this trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种新的在线资源分配问题变体，其中资源受吞吐量而非预算约束。提出了一个基于代理分配的原对偶算法，在未知成本分布情况下实现最优O(√T)遗憾界，适用于工人分配、物流调度等实际场景。
AI.research_question: 如何在吞吐量约束而非预算约束的在线资源分配问题中，最小化总期望分配成本和偏离目标分配率的惩罚成本？
AI.motivation: 传统在线资源分配算法主要关注预算约束，但许多实际场景（如工人调度、物流配送）中资源容量是基于吞吐量且随时间变化的，需要新的算法框架来处理这种约束类型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于在线优化理论和原对偶算法框架，结合吞吐量约束的特殊性，通过当前到达任务模拟未来到达任务的影响。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的"代理分配"原对偶算法，使用当前到达的任务来模拟未来到达任务的效果，并在合成数据集和零售履约操作的真实数据集上进行数值实验验证。
AI.findings: 算法在分配成本从固定分布i.i.d.抽取时达到最优O(√T)遗憾界，数值实验表明该方法在实际应用中表现良好。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统研究吞吐量约束的在线资源分配问题，提出了理论保证的最优算法，扩展了在线资源分配理论的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了在吞吐量约束环境下平衡分配成本与偏离目标消耗率成本的实用工具，适用于工人分配、卡车调度等多种实际运营场景。

title: When Lenders Meet Venture Capitalists: Relationship in Venture Debt
affiliations: and Yale School of Management

detail.title: When Lenders Meet Venture Capitalists: Relationship in Venture Debt
detail.abstract: We study how the lender relationship with venture capital (VC) investors shapes the life cycle of venture debt. We develop a model that highlights two competing mechanisms of the relationship, an information channel capturing certification benefits and a market power channel reflecting rent extraction. Using a comprehensive dataset on global venture debt, we test these channels across the life cycle of venture debt. At entry, the relationship mitigates asymmetric information and increases the likelihood of obtaining venture debt. In the investment stage, lenders with a relationship reduce hard restrictions while charging higher spreads. Post deal, relationship-backed startups are more likely to secure subsequent VC and successful exits by reallocating innovation toward commercially salient and safer projects. Our findings highlight that VC-lender relationships reduce information frictions and enable rent extraction while facilitating value creation in high-growth ventures.

AI.tldr: VC与贷款机构的关系通过信息认证和市场权力两个机制影响风险债务生命周期：关系初期缓解信息不对称，投资阶段减少硬性限制但提高利差，后期促进后续融资和成功退出。
AI.research_question: 风险投资机构与贷款机构的关系如何影响风险债务的生命周期？
AI.motivation: 研究VC与贷款机构关系在风险债务市场中的作用机制，理解信息渠道和市场权力渠道的竞争性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息渠道（认证效益）和市场权力渠道（租金提取）的竞争机制理论框架
AI.method: 使用全球风险债务的全面数据集，在整个风险债务生命周期中测试这两个渠道
AI.findings: 1) 进入阶段：关系缓解信息不对称，提高获得风险债务的可能性；2) 投资阶段：关系贷款机构减少硬性限制但收取更高利差；3) 交易后：关系支持的初创企业更可能获得后续VC融资和成功退出，通过将创新重新分配到商业显著和更安全的项目
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了VC-贷款机构关系的双重机制理论框架，揭示了信息认证和市场权力在风险债务生命周期中的竞争性作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为初创企业融资决策提供指导，帮助贷款机构优化风险债务定价和条款设计，为VC投资者提供关系网络价值评估依据

title: FRC Quality Inspections and Materiality Judgment
affiliations: CUNEF Universidad, CUNEF Universidad and

detail.title: FRC Quality Inspections and Materiality Judgment
detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of Financial Reporting Council (FRC) inspections on audit materiality decisions. Using data from listed UK companies between 2017 and 2022following the adoption of ISA 700-we investigate whether FRC inspections influence materiality thresholds in both inspected and non-inspected audit engagements. Our results indicate that auditors reduce materiality following an inspection. However, this adjustment is not accompanied by improvements in audit quality, suggesting symbolic compliance. We also find spillover effects: non-inspected engagements within inspected offices similarly reduce materiality level, indicating that the informational impact of FRC inspections extends beyond the engagements directly subject to review. Our findings contribute to the literature on regulatory oversight, audit quality, and materiality, highlighting the dual role of inspections as both a signaling and disciplinary mechanism. Policy implications suggest that while auditors respond to regulatory scrutiny through materiality adjustments, these changes may not result in substantive quality enhancements.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨英国财务报告委员会(FRC)检查对审计重要性决策的影响。研究发现检查后审计师会降低重要性水平，但未伴随审计质量提升，表明存在象征性合规。同时还发现溢出效应，即未受检查的业务也会调整重要性水平。
AI.research_question: FRC检查是否影响审计重要性决策？检查是否产生溢出效应？这些调整是否带来审计质量提升？
AI.motivation: 监管检查对审计实务的影响机制尚不明确，特别是重要性决策这一关键审计判断如何受监管影响需要深入研究
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管监督理论、信号理论、审计质量理论、重要性判断理论
AI.method: 使用2017-2022年英国上市公司数据，采用双重差分等实证方法分析FRC检查前后重要性水平变化
AI.findings: 1) 检查后审计师降低重要性水平但未改善审计质量；2) 存在溢出效应，未受检查业务也调整重要性；3) 检查具有信号和纪律双重作用
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对监管检查影响机制的理解，揭示象征性合规现象，拓展溢出效应理论在审计监管中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构优化检查机制提供依据，提示需要关注实质性质量改进而非表面合规

title: Right on cue? Category-switching in online marketplaces
affiliations: The University of Manchester - Alliance Manchester Business School, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Alberta - Department of Strategic Management and Organization

detail.title: Right on cue? Category-switching in online marketplaces
detail.abstract: When and why do producers change the categorization of their offerings? Prior categorization research assumes that producers engage in ongoing efforts to proactively optimize their categorical positioning, but this assumption may not hold for many producers due to their limited attentional capacity. Our theoretical account instead highlights the role of expectation violation cues—salient pieces of information indicating a violation of audience expectations—as triggers that can lead producers to revise their category choice. Our longitudinal study of 84,667 Airbnb hosts'categorization choices finds that negative customerreviews—an important form of expectation violationcue—significantly increase the likelihood of category-switching, particularly in categories with heterogeneousexpectations. Our study suggests that many producers might be less proactive about their category choices than previous research assumed

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，Airbnb房东并非主动优化分类定位，而是通过负面评论等期望违背线索触发分类变更，特别是在期望异质性高的类别中
AI.research_question: 生产者在何时以及为何会改变其产品的分类？
AI.motivation: 现有分类研究假设生产者会主动优化分类定位，但许多生产者由于注意力有限可能并非如此主动
AI.theoretical_framework: 期望违背线索理论 - 突出显示违反受众期望的显著信息作为触发生产者修订分类选择的因素
AI.method: 对84,667个Airbnb房东的分类选择进行纵向研究
AI.findings: 负面客户评论（重要的期望违背线索形式）显著增加了类别转换的可能性，特别是在期望异质性高的类别中
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了生产者主动优化分类定位的传统假设，提出了期望违背线索触发分类变更的新理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台企业和生产者提供了关于如何通过用户反馈信号来调整产品分类的实践指导

title: Dematerialization and the Future of Services: Baumol Inversion and Environmental Sustainability. Artificial Intelligence and the Shift Toward Low-Footprint Prosperity
affiliations: Anglia Ruskin University

detail.title: Dematerialization and the Future of Services: Baumol Inversion and Environmental Sustainability. Artificial Intelligence and the Shift Toward Low-Footprint Prosperity
detail.abstract: Manufacturing has long been considered the primary driver of economic growth, with its scale economies and productivity gains forming the backbone of national industrial strategies. Renewed interest in re-industrialization underscores the continuing importance of manufacturing for competitiveness, employment, and technological leadership. Yet this emphasis may need to incorporate a parallel transition made possible by artificial intelligence (AI), the dematerialization of services. This paper revisits Baumol's "cost disease" in light of AI's capacity to collapse the cost of ideation and enable services to scale virtually, often at near-zero marginal cost and with far lower material intensity. Under these conditions, services such as healthcare, education, and professional and creative industries can become central to a sustainability transition, contributing to prosperity without proportional increases in resource use. We term this dynamic Baumol Inversion, in which services once considered stagnant emerge as contingent pathways of low-footprint productivity. Rather than framing services as a replacement for manufacturing, the argument emphasizes complementarity. Manufacturing remains vital, but dematerialized services offer an additional, conditional route to resilience, inclusion, and environmental sustainability. Recognizing this potential reframes policy debates, shifting the focus from a singular industrial engine to a diversified landscape where services can, under the right institutional choices, contribute directly to sustainable futures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"鲍莫尔逆论"，认为AI驱动的服务非物质化可以改变传统制造业主导的经济增长模式，使服务业成为可持续发展的新路径。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何通过服务非物质化改变传统制造业主导的经济增长模式，并促进可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 制造业长期被视为经济增长主要驱动力，但AI技术使服务业能够以近乎零边际成本和低物质强度实现规模化，这为可持续发展提供了新机遇。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于鲍莫尔成本病理论，提出"鲍莫尔逆论"概念，探讨AI如何颠覆传统服务业生产力停滞的认知。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，结合AI技术特征和服务业转型潜力进行概念性论证。
AI.findings: AI使医疗、教育、专业和创意产业等服务行业能够以低资源消耗实现规模化生产，成为可持续发展的新路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"鲍莫尔逆论"理论框架，重新定义服务业在可持续发展中的作用，挑战制造业单一主导的传统观念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供新视角，强调制造业与服务业的互补性，推动多元化可持续发展策略的制定。

title: How to encourage pro-environmental behavior: Make it fun!
affiliations: , Vienna University of Economics and Business and WU Vienna University of Economics and Business

detail.title: How to encourage pro-environmental behavior: Make it fun!
detail.abstract: Climate change is a significant challenge for our society. Although individuals can help by engaging in pro-environmental actions (e.g., choosing a plant-based meal), motivating them to follow through has proven difficult. Here we ask whether a serious problem like climate change can be tackled by utilizing a less serious intervention: Play. Specifically, we conjecture that embedding pro-environmental decisions within a playful task (i.e., a challenge to win with your team or break a record) may increase individuals' likelihood to adopt the focal behavior. Put differently, whereas pro-environmental actions-and the preceding decision-making processes-are not typically associated with fun, adding elements of play may increase immediate intrinsic benefits for the self. Two large-scale field experiments (n = 306,493), a longitudinal field study (n = 4,184), and three behavioral experiments (n = 2,970) support our theorizing. The evidence further suggests that such interventions might produce long-lasting behavior change if implemented over a longer period.

AI.tldr: 通过游戏化干预（如团队挑战或破纪录）将环保行为嵌入有趣任务中，可以增加个体采取环保行为的可能性，研究发现这种干预能产生长期行为改变
AI.research_question: 是否可以通过游戏化干预（playful intervention）来激励个体采取环保行为以应对气候变化？
AI.motivation: 气候变化是重大社会挑战，虽然个人可以通过环保行为做出贡献，但激励他们持续行动很困难
AI.theoretical_framework: 游戏化理论、内在动机理论、行为改变理论
AI.method: 两个大规模田野实验（n=306,493）、一个纵向田野研究（n=4,184）、三个行为实验（n=2,970）
AI.findings: 将环保决策嵌入游戏化任务（如团队挑战或破纪录）能显著增加个体采取目标行为的可能性，且长期实施可能产生持久行为改变
AI.theory_contributions: 为环保行为干预提供了游戏化理论框架，拓展了内在动机理论在环境行为领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了有效的游戏化干预策略，可用于设计激励公众参与环保行动的实际方案

title: Organisational Entity, Personhood and Identity: A Critical Enquiry
affiliations: and Presidency University

detail.title: Organisational Entity, Personhood and Identity: A Critical Enquiry

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We have no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations.

detail.abstract: Organisation is a social entity with different forms having basic elements with an authority structure to fulfil the purpose for which it exists through the collective efforts of organisational members. The paper attempts to enquire critically different characteristics of an organisation from different dimensions like personhood, identity, culture, image etc. Organisational Identity is like a biological identity of a person. But unlike a biological entity, an organisation is a social entity whose identity has to be developed by the stakeholders of the organisation. Then arises the issue of conditionalities of organisational identity. Here the conditionalities have been structured in a pyramidal model. Thus organisation with its characteristics has been critically analysed.

detail.abstract: Understanding human behavior in the workplace has become a central pillar of contemporary organizational management. Individual differences, often studied through the lens of personality traits, decisively shape how employees communicate, resolve conflicts, and contribute to collective goals. In this context, leadership plays a crucial role in amplifying (or inhibiting) the manifestation of such traits, directly influencing productivity, innovation, and team cohesion.

title: Robustness and Regret Tolerance
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Industrial & Systems Engineering and National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Industrial & Systems Engineering

detail.title: Robustness and Regret Tolerance
detail.abstract: This paper shifts focus from the typical approach of maximizing expected reward to minimizing expected regret, aiming to find a solution whose expected reward is close to that of an oracle. While the two approaches are equivalent when the uncertainty distribution is known, they diverge once distributional ambiguity, characterized here by the Wasserstein distance, is introduced for robustness. This can be achieved by requiring the decision maker to specify a threshold for expected regret under the nominal distribution and then minimizing the excess regret beyond this threshold across all other distributions. By exploring the full range of this threshold parameter, our regret-based decision model encompasses both empirical optimization and worst-case regret minimization, the latter of which is NP-hard. When the reward function is represented by a linear optimization problem (possibly involving recourse decisions, a random technology matrix, and a random right-hand side), we propose a safe approximation that preserves feasibility and consistency with empirical optimization. Our approximation takes the form of robust linear optimization with convex uncertainty sets and is readily implementable using off-the-shelf modeling interfaces, such as RSOME. Finally, we show that our tolerance-oriented regret-based model consistently outperforms both target-oriented reward based model and empirical optimization in multi-item and multi-option procurement problems, using demand data derived from real-world scenarios in Singapore. In particular, we demonstrate that adopting a tolerance level slightly above the baseline allows our regret-based objective to avoid overly conservative procurement plans while simultaneously delivering superior out-of-sample performance and hence achieving robustness as intended.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于遗憾最小化的鲁棒决策模型，通过设定期望遗憾阈值并在Wasserstein模糊集下最小化超额遗憾，避免了传统期望奖励最大化和最坏情况优化的局限性。
AI.research_question: 如何在分布模糊性存在的情况下，通过遗憾最小化方法实现鲁棒决策，避免过度保守的解决方案？
AI.motivation: 传统期望奖励最大化方法在分布不确定性下可能不够鲁棒，而最坏情况优化又过于保守，需要一种平衡的方法来获得既稳健又实用的决策方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Wasserstein距离的分布模糊性建模，遗憾最小化理论，鲁棒优化框架
AI.method: 提出容忍度导向的遗憾最小化模型，通过设定期望遗憾阈值并最小化超额遗憾，采用鲁棒线性优化近似方法
AI.findings: 在采购问题中，该模型优于传统目标导向的奖励模型和经验优化，能够在避免过度保守的同时获得更好的样本外性能
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了遗憾最小化与鲁棒优化的理论联系，提出了可处理的近似方法，扩展了分布鲁棒优化的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了易于实现的建模方法（如RSOME接口），在真实采购场景中验证了方法的有效性，为实际决策提供了新的工具

title: Goals of the AfCFTA Competition Protocol Digital Market Competition Regulations: Lessons from South Africa's Online Intermediation Platform Market Inquiry (OIPMI), the EU's DMA and the US Experiences with Digital Platform Giants
affiliations: Technische Universität München (TUM) and

detail.title: Goals of the AfCFTA Competition Protocol Digital Market Competition Regulations: Lessons from South Africa's Online Intermediation Platform Market Inquiry (OIPMI), the EU's DMA and the US Experiences with Digital Platform Giants

declarations.funderStatement: The authors would like to acknowledge the kind support of the Economic Security Project’s Antimonopoly Grant.

contentType.other: Working paper, accepted for publication in the Illinois Journal of Law, Technology and Policy

detail.abstract:
The European Union (EU) has continued to be a worldwide leader in setting international norms, particularly in competition law policy, data protection and platform governance. In digital market regulation, after the EU Digital Markets Act (DMA), several countries have adopted or are considering the adoption of digital markets competition regulations (DMCR) similar to the DMA. While some have challenged the notion that the DMA and its goals of ensuring contestability and fairness in the market should not be the blueprint for adopting DMCRs in other countries, at this juncture, it is impossible to overstate the influence of the EU DMA on future DMCRs. We contribute towards this scholarly debate on the influence of DMA beyond the EU by focusing on a region that, despite competition agencies' regulatory enforcement in digital markets, has not received adequate scholarly attention: Africa. Although no African country has considered adopting a DMCR, at the continental level, African countries seek to adopt a DMCR under the AfCFTA Competition Protocol (CP). In formulating the appropriate goals of the AfCFTA DMCR, we build on African experiences in enforcing competition law, the African market structure, the debate on the goals of competition law in Africa, intellectual thinking on regulation of digital markets and the EU DMA. More specifically, for the African context, we draw on the 2023 Competition Commission South Africa, Online Intermediation Platforms Market Inquiry (OIPMI) findings on business user treatment to further inform the appropriate goals of the AfCFTA DMCR. An analysis of the OIPMI Final Report shows that African markets have high barriers to entry, and digital platforms impose unfair trading conditions on African businesses compared to international businesses. Consequently, like the EU DMA, fairness and contestability are critical for the success of African businesses in the digital markets. While public interest will continue to shape African competition law enforcement in digital markets, African countries can draw from the insights of the EU ordoliberal thinking and the US Neo-Brandeisian movement, which seek to enhance the participation of small businesses in a market characterized by few firms with concentrated economic power. We conclude by recommending that, unlike the DMA, which goals are distinct from competition law, the AfCFTA DMCR should incorporate multiple goals merging regulatory goals with these of competition law enforcement, while prioritizing innovation, inclusivity, fairness, and contestability.

* This paper is forthcoming in the Illinois Journal of Law, Technology and Policy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨欧盟《数字市场法案》(DMA)对非洲数字市场竞争法规(DMCR)制定的影响，分析非洲在AfCFTA竞争协议框架下制定DMCR的适当目标，建议非洲应结合监管目标和竞争法执行的多重目标，优先考虑创新、包容性、公平性和可竞争性。
AI.research_question: 非洲国家在AfCFTA竞争协议框架下制定数字市场竞争法规(DMCR)时，应该确立什么样的适当目标？
AI.motivation: 尽管欧盟DMA对全球数字市场监管产生重大影响，但非洲地区在数字市场竞争监管方面的学术研究不足，需要为非洲制定适合其市场特点的DMCR目标提供理论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合欧盟秩序自由主义思想、美国新布兰代斯运动、非洲竞争法执行经验以及数字市场监管知识体系
AI.method: 文献分析和案例研究，重点分析南非竞争委员会2023年在线中介平台市场调查(OIPMI)最终报告
AI.findings: 非洲市场存在高进入壁垒，数字平台对非洲企业施加不公平交易条件，公平性和可竞争性对非洲企业在数字市场成功至关重要
AI.theory_contributions: 为非洲数字市场竞争法规制定提供理论框架，填补非洲地区在该领域学术研究的空白
AI.practical_contributions: 为AfCFTA竞争协议下的DMCR制定提供具体建议，帮助非洲国家设计适合本土市场特点的数字监管政策

title: Futures methods for environmental law research
affiliations: University of Technology Sydney, Faculty of Law, University of New England and Singapore Management University - Yong Pung How School of Law

detail.title: Futures methods for environmental law research
detail.abstract: Rapid environmental change and geopolitical upheaval mean that there are many possible futures for environmental laws and policies. Given the difficulty of reliably predicting the possible future contexts within which law will operate, and the challenges to which it will have to respond, environmental law researchers will require methods to anticipate various futures. This chapter explores a range of ‘futuring’ methods for non-doctrinal legal research. There are many possible qualitative and quantitative methods. Reflecting the aims of this book to provide access to experience-based advice from environmental law scholars about their methods, our focus is on methods we have used. We consider five examples of combinations of three types of methods to design laws and policies to cope with various futures: scenarios, Delphi surveys and imaginative storytelling. The examples provided show the use of combinations of these methods to tackle different types of law and governance issues.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨了环境法研究中用于预测未来的多种方法，包括情景分析、德尔菲调查和想象性叙事，通过五个案例展示了这些方法的组合应用。
AI.research_question: 环境法研究者需要哪些方法来预测和应对未来环境法律政策的各种可能情景？
AI.motivation: 环境快速变化和地缘政治动荡使得环境法律政策面临多种未来可能性，传统预测方法难以应对这种不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未来研究方法论，包括情景规划、德尔菲法和叙事分析等非教义法学研究框架。
AI.method: 定性定量混合方法，重点介绍了情景分析、德尔菲调查和想象性叙事三种方法的组合应用。
AI.findings: 通过五个具体案例展示了不同方法组合如何有效应对各类法律治理问题，证明了这些未来研究方法的实用价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为环境法研究提供了系统化的未来研究方法论框架，拓展了非教义法学研究的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为环境法律政策制定者提供了可操作的工具方法，帮助设计更具韧性和适应性的法律制度来应对不确定的未来。

title: Generative AIs and the Hidden Cost of Intelligence: A Multidisciplinary Review of LLMs Progress, Resource Consumption and Path to a Sustainable Future
affiliations: Virtual University of Pakistan, Virtual University of Pakistan - Department of Management Sciences and Virtual University of Pakistan - Department of Management Sciences

detail.title: Generative AIs and the Hidden Cost of Intelligence: A Multidisciplinary Review of LLMs Progress, Resource Consumption and Path to a Sustainable Future
detail.abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) has reshaped technological, business and social environments. Though the models-GPT-4, GPT-5, Claude and others-have shown unparalleled abilities in automation, creative work and decision-making, they have placed enormous burdens on natural resources such as energy, water and computational infrastructure raw materials. This paper offers a multidisciplinary analysis with integrated views from environmental science, computer engineering, economics and business information systems perspective. The research analyzes the environmental externalities of LLMs training and deployment, and measures resource usage patterns and places them in context of global sustainability objectives. Methodologically, the study utilizes a mixed review framework by incorporating systematic literature review and secondary data analysis from peer reviewed journals in ScienceDirect, Taylor & Francis, Wiley Online, IEEE, MDPI, SpringerLink, SAGE, Emerald and other trustworthy databases. The findings show that the growth of GenAI is happening at an unsustainable level unless checked by strategic interventions on infrastructure efficiency, policy regulation and corporate environment responsibility. It is suggested to imperatively reconcile AI innovation with the circular economy and carbon-neutral computing principles to guarantee that intelligence augmentation is not at the cost of planetary well-being.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多学科视角分析了大语言模型和生成式AI的环境外部性，发现其资源消耗已达到不可持续水平，需要基础设施效率提升、政策监管和企业环境责任等战略干预来实现AI创新与可持续发展的平衡。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型和生成式人工智能的训练和部署对环境产生了哪些外部性影响？如何衡量其资源使用模式并与全球可持续发展目标相协调？
AI.motivation: 随着GPT-4、GPT-5、Claude等大语言模型的快速发展，虽然展现了在自动化、创意工作和决策方面的卓越能力，但对能源、水资源和计算基础设施原材料等自然资源造成了巨大负担，需要从多学科角度分析其环境影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合环境科学、计算机工程、经济学和商业信息系统的多学科分析框架，运用循环经济和碳中和计算原则的理论基础。
AI.method: 采用混合综述框架，包括系统性文献综述和来自ScienceDirect、Taylor & Francis、Wiley Online、IEEE、MDPI、SpringerLink、SAGE、Emerald等可信数据库的二手数据分析。
AI.findings: 生成式AI的增长处于不可持续水平，除非通过基础设施效率提升、政策监管和企业环境责任等战略干预措施加以控制。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了分析AI环境外部性的多学科理论框架，为理解技术创新与可持续发展的关系提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了协调AI创新与循环经济原则的具体建议，为政策制定者、企业和研究人员提供了实现碳中和计算和可持续AI发展的实践指导。

title: Why Banks Struggle to Detect Money Laundering, and How AI Can Help
affiliations: Georgia State University

detail.title: Why Banks Struggle to Detect Money Laundering, and How AI Can Help

keywords: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Financial Crime FinTech Artificial Intelligence (AI) Machine Learning (ML) Explainable AI (XAI) Compliance Banking Regulation Risk Management Financial Technology

detail.abstract: Money laundering is a pervasive global issue that undermines financial stability and facilitates criminal activity. Traditional rule-based anti-money laundering (AML) systems generate excessive false positives and are increasingly ineffective as criminals adapt their methods. This paper discusses the limitations of current AML practices and explores the potential of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) to enhance detection. It emphasizes the importance of explainable AI (XAI) techniques such as SHAP and LIME, which provide transparency and regulatory compliance by explaining model predictions. Drawing on the author's prior research in fintech, blockchain, and AI, this note highlights how financial institutions can move beyond rigid rule systems and adopt adaptive, trustworthy AI solutions to strengthen the fight against money laundering.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了传统反洗钱系统的局限性，探索了人工智能和机器学习在增强检测方面的潜力，特别强调可解释AI技术的重要性，为金融机构提供了从刚性规则系统转向自适应可信AI解决方案的路径。
AI.research_question: 人工智能和机器学习如何能够增强反洗钱检测效果，同时解决传统规则系统的局限性？
AI.motivation: 传统基于规则的反洗钱系统产生过多误报且日益失效，犯罪分子不断调整方法，需要更有效的检测技术来维护金融稳定和打击犯罪活动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融科技、区块链和人工智能领域的理论基础，结合可解释AI（XAI）技术框架，包括SHAP和LIME等解释性方法。
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析，结合作者在金融科技、区块链和AI领域的先前研究，探讨AI/ML在反洗钱中的应用潜力。
AI.findings: AI和ML技术能够显著提高反洗钱检测的准确性和效率，可解释AI技术提供了模型预测的透明度，确保监管合规性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将可解释AI技术整合到反洗钱系统中的理论框架，为传统规则系统向自适应AI解决方案转型提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了具体的实施路径，帮助其采用可信赖的AI解决方案来加强反洗钱斗争，超越刚性规则系统的限制。

title: Assessing Career Attainment via a Non-Wage Measure
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Harvard Business School - Finance Unit, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Duke University, Georgetown University - McDonough School of Business and

detail.title: Assessing Career Attainment via a Non-Wage Measure
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a non-pecuniary measure of career achievement, seniority. Based on a database of over 150 million resumes, this metric exploits the variation in how long it takes workers to attain job titles. A person's seniority is defined as the number of years it takes the median individual-within the same industry and firm size category-to achieve that person's job title. Seniority aligns with standard markers of success-it is positively correlated with both wages and educational attainment. To demonstrate its value as a measure of career progression, we show that individuals with higher seniority levels in the public sector are more likely to transition to higher-paying positions in the private sector. When non-monetary factors influence career choice, evaluating labor market outcomes using non-wage measures, such as seniority, offers significant advantages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个非货币性的职业成就衡量指标——资历，基于1.5亿份简历数据，通过分析获得特定职位所需时间的变化来定义个人资历水平。研究发现资历与工资和教育程度正相关，高资历的公共部门员工更可能转向高薪私营职位。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个有效的非货币性职业成就衡量指标，以及该指标在劳动力市场分析中的价值？
AI.motivation: 传统劳动力市场分析过度依赖工资指标，忽视了非货币因素对职业选择的影响，需要开发更全面的职业成就衡量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于职业发展理论和人力资本理论，强调非货币因素在职业决策中的重要性。
AI.method: 利用超过1.5亿份简历的大数据分析，通过计算同一行业和公司规模类别中获得特定职位所需的平均时间来定义资历指标。
AI.findings: 资历与工资和教育程度呈正相关；公共部门中资历较高的个体更可能转向私营部门的高薪职位。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新的非货币性职业成就衡量框架，丰富了劳动力市场分析的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供了评估职业发展和人才流动的新工具，有助于更全面地理解劳动力市场动态。

title: Understanding the Effects of ChatGPT in Higher Education: A Media Ecology Analysis
affiliations: University of Oklahoma - Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication

detail.title: Understanding the Effects of ChatGPT in Higher Education: A Media Ecology Analysis
detail.abstract: Newly emerging technologies became an integral part of higher education as students are being exposed to more and more technologies in their education journey. This paper aims to understand the impact of ChatGPT on students. This paper resorted to the Media Ecology Theory to accomplish the aim of this paper. Development of critical thinking is considered one of the major objectives of higher education. And, with the development of critical thinking ability, students subsequently contribute to knowledge development and creation. In this process of developing a critical mindset and knowledge creation, students are supposed to receive unbiased and accurate knowledge from trustworthy sources. This paper argues that ChatGPT as a source of information is not unbiased and the information it generates is not always accurate in nature. Despite this fact, students resort to ChatGPT as a means of assistance in accomplishing their class assignments. Subsequently, the biased and inaccurate information may or will eventually hamper their capacity to think critically. The content it generates revolves around the existing information and knowledge. Besides, it is also highly unlikely that it will generate new knowledge unless the information is being used by critical minds.

AI.tldr: 本文基于媒介生态学理论，探讨ChatGPT对学生批判性思维发展的负面影响，指出其信息存在偏见和不准确性，可能阻碍学生的知识创造能力。
AI.research_question: ChatGPT如何影响学生的批判性思维能力发展？
AI.motivation: 新兴技术已成为高等教育的重要组成部分，学生在其教育过程中接触到的技术越来越多，需要理解ChatGPT这类技术对学生的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 媒介生态学理论
AI.method: 理论分析框架
AI.findings: ChatGPT作为信息来源存在偏见且信息不准确，学生依赖其完成作业会影响批判性思维发展，该工具主要围绕现有知识生成内容，难以创造新知识。
AI.theory_contributions: 将媒介生态学理论应用于AI教育技术影响研究，提供了理解技术如何塑造学习环境的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育机构提供警示，需要在技术整合过程中重视培养学生的批判性思维，避免过度依赖AI工具导致思维能力退化。

title: The Ragsdale Framework for Autonomous Organizations: The Decision Model
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Ragsdale Framework for Autonomous Organizations: The Decision Model

declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted without external funding or institutional sponsorship. It represents the independent scholarly work of Marc Ragsdale and is not commissioned, financed, or owned by Kaamfu Inc. or any affiliated organization. While Kaamfu applies elements of the Framework in practice, the Framework itself is authored and maintained independently, and all rights to its theoretical development remain with the author .

keywords: Behavioral & Social Methods in Information Systems

detail.abstract:
Decision-making is the fundamental mechanism of organizational progress, yet most frameworks treat it implicitly, embedding it within processes, structures, or resource flows. This paper introduces the Decision Model, a formal structure that defines decisions as the primitive unit of analysis and traces their flow through the Opportunity–Goal–Action–Outcome (OGAO) loop, with Insight as the catalytic layer.

The model reframes decisions not as isolated events but as continuous, nested loops operating across all organizational levels. Each juncture—opportunity recognition, goal-setting, action commitment, and outcome evaluation—becomes a measurable point of diagnostic clarity, enabling assessment of decision quality, velocity, alignment, and accountability.

Acknowledging but departing from prior cycles such as Deming’s PDCA, Boyd’s OODA, and the intelligence cycle, the Decision Model makes decision flow itself the analyzable substrate. It also situates decision analysis within a staged path toward AI-enabled autonomization, highlighting how software systems can capture, evaluate, and ultimately optimize decision flow.

By operationalizing decisions as structured and measurable, the Decision Model contributes a new lens for organizational theory and provides scholars, managers, and technologists with a practical foundation for diagnosing organizational health and deliberately accelerating progress toward autonomy. This paper is part of the broader RFAO research program, which is introduced in the Overview paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了决策模型，将决策作为基本分析单元，通过机会-目标-行动-结果（OGAO）循环追踪决策流程，为组织理论和实践提供了新的分析框架。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一种将决策作为原始分析单元的形式化结构，以更好地理解和优化组织决策流程？
AI.motivation: 现有框架大多将决策隐含在流程、结构或资源流中处理，缺乏对决策本身作为基本单元的明确分析和测量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策模型（Decision Model），基于机会-目标-行动-结果（OGAO）循环，以洞察力作为催化层，将决策视为连续嵌套的循环而非孤立事件。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，通过构建形式化结构来定义决策流程，并与现有循环模型（如Deming的PDCA、Boyd的OODA）进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 决策模型能够将决策流程本身作为可分析的基础，提供决策质量、速度、一致性和责任的可测量诊断点。
AI.theory_contributions: 为组织理论贡献了新的分析视角，将决策操作化为结构化和可测量的单元，丰富了决策理论的研究范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学者、管理者和技术人员提供了诊断组织健康和加速自主化进程的实践基础，支持AI驱动的决策流程优化。

title: Overview of UNCITRAL Regulation of E-commerce

detail.title: Overview of UNCITRAL Regulation of E-commerce
detail.abstract: Based on the information officially published on UNCITRAL web-site, the author gives a general overview of e-commerce regulation that has been developed by UNCITRAL since the last century. The emphasis is put on main concepts, aims and effects of major documents. With electronic means of communication actively progressing, states tend to face new challenges over and over again, having to find compromises between data security and interests of individuals and legal entities. The UNCITRAL work is, i.a., aimed at helping national regulators to find possible solutions for this situation.

AI.tldr: 本文概述了联合国国际贸易法委员会（UNCITRAL）自上世纪以来制定的电子商务监管框架，重点分析了主要文件的核心概念、目标和影响，旨在帮助各国监管机构在数据安全与个人及法律实体利益之间找到平衡解决方案。
AI.research_question: UNCITRAL制定的电子商务监管框架如何帮助各国应对电子通信手段快速发展带来的新挑战？
AI.motivation: 随着电子通信手段的积极发展，各国不断面临新的监管挑战，需要在数据安全与个人及法律实体利益之间寻找妥协方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于联合国国际贸易法委员会（UNCITRAL）官方发布的电子商务监管文件和相关国际法规框架。
AI.method: 文献分析法，基于UNCITRAL官方网站发布的官方信息进行系统性梳理和分析。
AI.findings: UNCITRAL制定的电子商务监管文件提供了重要的概念框架和指导原则，帮助各国监管机构在数据安全保护与利益平衡方面找到可行的解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了UNCITRAL电子商务监管体系的理论基础和发展脉络，为国际电子商务法律研究提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国立法者和监管机构提供了实用的参考框架，帮助其制定符合国际标准的电子商务监管政策，促进跨境电子商务的健康发展。

title: Dreams as a Code Language
affiliations: Jungian Clinical Institute

detail.title: Dreams as a Code Language

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The clinical vignette is fully anonymized; written informed consent for publication was obtained from the participant. No institutional review was required for single-case reports under applicable guidelines.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Since Freud, psychologists have sought to decipher the language of dreams, but no universal interpretive manual exists. Advances in dream neuroscience and the emergence of Code Biology have brought us closer to understanding the rules and functions underlying dream formation. Code Biology, which studies coding processes in living systems, offers a revolutionary framework for how neural and symbolic patterns generate dream narratives. Dreams are not epiphenomena; they serve crucial adaptive functions-emotional regulation, memory consolidation, and ego development. Despite energetic costs, their evolutionary conservation across species highlights their biological necessity. Cartwright's studies confirm dreams' essential regulatory role in survival. This article argues that dreams are coded artifacts produced by multiple organic codes-biological, neuronal, symbolic, and cultural-mediated by archetypes. Drawing on Barbieri's, Major's and Goodwyn work, archetypes are reframed as artifacts of embodied organic codes regulating dream formation and symbolic imagery. Integrating affective neuroscience findings and Jung's theory, this perspective proposes emotional affects as archetypal neurodynamic patterns. A key methodological gap remains: the separation of neuroscience and clinical practice. Through clinical dream analysis, the article shows therapists act as "adaptors," translating dream codes into meaningful narratives-a process termed psychic codepoiesis. Finally, it discusses how Large Language Models, trained on life-coding principles, may support but not replace embodied human adaptors, offering a new paradigm for understanding dreams as the foundational language of subjective life.

AI.tldr: 本文提出梦是多种有机编码（生物、神经、符号、文化编码）通过原型介导产生的编码产物，原型被重新定义为调节梦形成和象征意象的具身有机编码产物。情感被概念化为原型神经动力学模式，治疗师作为"适配器"将梦代码转化为有意义叙事（心理编码生成）。大型语言模型可支持但无法替代具身人类适配器。
AI.research_question: 梦是如何通过多种有机编码系统形成的？原型在梦的编码过程中扮演什么角色？如何弥合梦神经科学与临床实践之间的方法论鸿沟？
AI.motivation: 自弗洛伊德以来心理学家一直试图解读梦的语言，但缺乏普遍的解释手册。梦神经科学的进展和代码生物学的出现使我们更接近理解梦形成的规则和功能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代码生物学（研究生命系统中编码过程）、荣格原型理论、情感神经科学、Cartwright的梦调节理论、Barbieri和Major的有机编码理论
AI.method: 理论整合与临床梦分析，通过治疗师作为"适配器"的实践来展示梦代码的翻译过程
AI.findings: 梦不是副现象，而是具有关键适应功能（情绪调节、记忆巩固、自我发展）；原型是具身有机编码的产物；情感影响是原型神经动力学模式；治疗师通过心理编码生成过程翻译梦代码
AI.theory_contributions: 将原型重新概念化为有机编码产物；提出情感作为原型神经动力学模式的新视角；建立梦形成的多编码系统理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床梦分析提供新的理论指导；提出治疗师作为"适配器"的角色模型；探讨大型语言模型在梦分析中的辅助应用潜力

title: Pregeometry of Semantics: From Fold-Space to Geometry

detail.title: Pregeometry of Semantics: From Fold-Space to Geometry
detail.abstract:
Pregeometry of Semantics (PGS) posits that meaning originates in a pre-metric field
P\mathcal{P} of semantic tension τ\tau and causal pre-order ⪯\preceq, from which discourse
geometry is derived rather than assumed. A folding operator
Fold σ\operatorname{Fold}_{\sigma} condenses recurrent tensions into a weighted graph
GG; the spectral onset (Δλ2>0\Delta\lambda_{2}>0) licenses an emergent metric gVg_{V}
(instantiated as a Fisher information metric on the spectral embedding), enabling
∇gVS\nabla_{g_V}S and transport on the resulting manifold. In the macroscopic limit, the
unique linear constitutive closure consistent with the axioms yields the flux law
B=σ ∇gVSB=\sigma\,\nabla_{g_V}S. Claims: PGS unifies variational, categorical, spectral,
optimal-transport, and information-geometric views in a minimal pipeline
P → G → gV → ∇ S → B\mathcal{P}\!\rightarrow\!G\!\rightarrow\!g_V\!\right
arrow\!\nabla S\!\rightarrow\!B, providing measurable preconditions for reliable generation and
a principled origin for geometry in language. Falsifiability: (i) pre-geometric invariants
IPGS,R,TI_{\text{PGS}},R,T under positional permutations and micro-perturbations; (ii) a
zigzag-persistence transition aligned with the Δλ2\Delta\lambda_{2} knee; (iii) Hodge-triad
shifts (gradient/rotational/harmonic) across sections; and (iv) a manifold-stability gate (S⁵OS)
that reduces errors iff IPGS ≥pI_{\text{PGS}}\!\ge p and Δλ2 ≥ϵ\Delta\lambda_{2}\!\ge
\epsilon hold. This establishes PGS as a theory-first route from fold to flux—with an explicit
experimental program and stop-conditions that discriminate ontic emergence from embedding
artifacts.

AI.tldr: PGS理论提出语义起源于预度量场，通过折叠操作生成加权图，当谱间隙出现时产生度量结构，最终推导出通量定律，为语言几何提供了原则性起源和可验证的实验方案。
AI.research_question: 语义的几何结构是如何从预度量场中涌现出来的？
AI.motivation: 统一变分、范畴、谱、最优传输和信息几何等多种视角，为语言中的几何结构提供最小化的生成管道和可测量的前提条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预几何语义学（PGS）框架，包含语义张力场、因果预序关系、折叠操作、谱间隙条件、Fisher信息度量等核心理论要素。
AI.method: 构建从预度量场到加权图再到度量流形的生成管道，使用谱分析、信息几何和微分几何方法推导通量定律。
AI.findings: 提出了从折叠到通量的完整理论路径，建立了可验证的预几何不变量和流形稳定性门控机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 统一了多种几何视角，为语言中的几何结构提供了原则性起源理论，建立了从预几何到几何的涌现机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可测量的实验验证方案和停止条件，能够区分本体涌现和嵌入伪影，为可靠的文本生成提供了理论基础。

title: Investigating the determinations of accounting users' continuance intention toward AI chatbots: The moderating role of privacy risk
affiliations: Hefei University, Hefei University and Renmin University of China

detail.title: Investigating the determinations of accounting users' continuance intention toward AI chatbots: The moderating role of privacy risk
detail.abstract: AI chatbots now offer professional services integrated into professional routines such as accounting activities, however, it’s unclear how to encourage continued use by professional users. Using the S-O-R framework, this study explores how the dynamic conversational qualities drive continuance usage of AI chatbots by accounting users, mediated by their cognitive and affective states. It also examines the moderating role of privacy risk on cognition-behavior and affect-behavior. Based on an online survey regarding the use of GPT by 312 accounting users, the results from PLS-SEM analysis showed that the proposed research model can explain 62.6% of continuance intention. Conversational quality at the input, process, and output stages impacts continuance intention through cognitive confirmation (p < 0.01). Conversational quality in the input and output phase also influenced continuance intention via affective commitment (p < 0.01), but conversation quality in the process phase did not significantly affect affective commitment (p = 0.367). Privacy risk moderated the relationship between cognitive confirmation and continuance intention (p = 0.004), but not between affective commitment and continuance intention (p = 0.242). This study is among the first to investigate a chatbot’s dynamic conversational quality within an accounting context, offering theoretical and practical contributions to effective chatbot design.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于S-O-R框架，探讨AI聊天机器人在会计场景中的动态对话质量如何通过认知确认和情感承诺影响持续使用意愿，并检验隐私风险的调节作用。研究发现对话质量通过认知路径显著影响持续使用，隐私风险调节认知-行为关系。
AI.research_question: AI聊天机器人的动态对话质量如何通过认知和情感状态驱动会计专业用户的持续使用行为？隐私风险在其中起什么调节作用？
AI.motivation: AI聊天机器人已集成到会计等专业服务中，但如何促进专业用户的持续使用尚不明确，需要研究对话质量和隐私风险对使用行为的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于S-O-R（刺激-有机体-反应）理论框架，将对话质量作为刺激，认知确认和情感承诺作为有机体状态，持续使用意愿作为反应。
AI.method: 采用在线问卷调查法，收集312名会计用户使用GPT的数据，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 研究模型能解释62.6%的持续使用意愿变异。输入、处理和输出阶段的对话质量通过认知确认影响持续使用（p<0.01）；输入和输出阶段对话质量通过情感承诺影响持续使用（p<0.01），但处理阶段对话质量对情感承诺影响不显著（p=0.367）；隐私风险调节认知确认与持续使用的关系（p=0.004），但不调节情感承诺与持续使用的关系（p=0.242）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在会计情境下研究聊天机器人动态对话质量，扩展了S-O-R理论在AI服务持续使用中的应用，揭示了对话质量不同阶段的影响差异和隐私风险的调节机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计有效的会计AI聊天机器人提供实践指导，建议重点关注输入和输出阶段的对话质量设计，并加强隐私保护措施以降低认知路径的风险影响。

title: Too Trustworthy to Fund: The Rise and Fall of Founder CEO's Facial Trustworthiness in Initial Coin Offering Success
affiliations: University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Science and Technology Beijing, Santa Clara University - Leavey School of Business and University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration

detail.title: Too Trustworthy to Fund: The Rise and Fall of Founder CEO's Facial Trustworthiness in Initial Coin Offering Success
detail.abstract: Blockchain technology has enabled startups to raise capital through initial coin offerings (ICOs), yet these markets epitomize extreme information asymmetry, where investors must make decisions with little reliable information. In such settings, visual cues from the founder CEO can disproportionately shape investor judgments. Building on research showing that facial trustworthiness affects decisions in online lending and auditing, we investigate how founder CEO’s facial trustworthiness affects ICO outcomes. Using a dataset of over 1,000 ICOs launched between 2021 and 2024, we algorithmically measure facial trustworthiness from stable structural features of the face. Our analysis uncovers a surprising inverted U-shaped relationship: trustworthiness initially boosts fundraising performance, but beyond a threshold, higher levels are associated with reduced success. To unpack this paradox, we conduct an online experiment and find that investors extrapolate CEO-level signals to organizational-level evaluations. Specifically, higher facial trustworthiness enhances perceptions of project legitimacy: investors see the venture as more credible, but simultaneously undermines perceptions of project viability, with investors interpreting the venture as less bold, competitive, or capable of achieving market success. These dual effects jointly generate the observed curvilinear relationship. We further show that social media engagement moderates this dynamic: higher engagement shifts the inflection point. By revealing both the benefits and hidden costs of facial trustworthiness, this study advances theories of soft signals in ICOs and entrepreneurial finance, illuminates how leader traits shape organizational evaluations under high uncertainty, and offers practical guidance for entrepreneurs and investors navigating digital capital markets.

AI.tldr: 研究发现CEO面部可信度与ICO融资效果呈倒U型关系：适度可信度提升融资表现，但过高可信度反而降低成功率。投资者会将CEO个人特质外推至组织层面评估，可信度既增强项目合法性感知，又削弱项目可行性感知。社交媒体参与度调节这一关系。
AI.research_question: 创始人CEO的面部可信度如何影响初始代币发行(ICO)的融资结果？
AI.motivation: ICO市场存在极端信息不对称，投资者缺乏可靠信息，视觉线索可能过度影响投资决策。基于面部可信度在在线借贷和审计中的影响研究，探讨其在ICO场景中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于软信号理论和组织评估理论，探讨个体层面特征（面部可信度）如何影响组织层面评估（项目合法性和可行性）。
AI.method: 混合方法：1）使用2021-2024年1000+个ICO数据集，算法测量面部可信度；2）在线实验验证因果关系和心理机制。
AI.findings: 发现倒U型关系：面部可信度最初提升融资表现，但超过阈值后反而降低成功率。可信度增强项目合法性感知但削弱可行性感知。社交媒体参与度调节拐点位置。

keywords: MIMIC-III (Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care) dataset

detail.abstract: Diagnosis prediction involves using past patient visit information to Figure out what their future health might look like which is tough but key in healthcare informatics. This work sets up a machine learning (ML) framework that can be used for clinical prognosis by learning from a database of over 40,000 anonymized MIMIC-III ICU patients. The approach requires thorough handling of the data such as missing data treatment, excluding outliers, turning categories into numbers and standardizing all the features by Z-score normalization. Highlighted features are included and the data is separated into learning and testing groups. For classification problems involving huge data sets, KNN excels which is why it is used the model reaches an accuracy of 90%, precision and recall of 92%, and an F1-score of 92%. Comparative analysis with Restreet and ULM Fit models highlights the superior performance of the proposed approach, making it a reliable and efficient tool for clinical diagnosis and prognosis in intensive care settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于机器学习框架的诊断预测方法，使用MIMIC-III ICU患者数据，通过KNN算法实现了90%的准确率和92%的F1分数，在重症监护环境中表现出优越性能。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习方法基于患者历史就诊信息准确预测未来健康状况？
AI.motivation: 诊断预测在医疗信息学中至关重要但具有挑战性，需要开发可靠高效的临床预后工具来改善重症监护环境中的诊断准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习理论框架，特别是K最近邻(KNN)算法在处理大规模医疗数据集分类问题中的优势。
AI.method: 使用MIMIC-III数据库中40,000多名匿名ICU患者数据，进行数据预处理（缺失值处理、异常值排除、类别编码、Z-score标准化）、特征选择，并将数据分为训练集和测试集，采用KNN分类算法。
AI.findings: 模型达到90%的准确率，精确率和召回率均为92%，F1分数为92%，相比Restreet和ULM Fit模型表现出更优越的性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了KNN算法在医疗大数据诊断预测中的有效性，为机器学习在临床预后中的应用提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个可靠高效的临床诊断和预后工具，可用于重症监护环境的实际临床决策支持，提高诊断准确性。

title: The Role of Information Asymmetry in Propagating Idiosyncratic Shocks to Firm Value: Theory and Evidence

detail.title: The Role of Information Asymmetry in Propagating Idiosyncratic Shocks to Firm Value: Theory and Evidence
detail.abstract: I propose a novel theory that relates a firm's idiosyncratic shock to a stakeholder firm's value. Specifically, I show that stakeholder opacity - the information asymmetry surrounding the non-shocked firm - influences how value changes around a shock that does not directly involve the stakeholder. Using data breaches as an experimental setting to test my theory, I show that nontargeted, opaque partners suffer larger reductions in firm value than their transparent counterparts after a shock. Furthermore, I find that it is only these same opaque firms that experience reductions in their market value, increases in their likelihood of becoming financially constrained, and increases in their cyber risk after their partner's data breach. Altogether, my model and empirical results show that information asymmetry accentuates idiosyncratic shocks in networks and heightens opaque firms' market, contract, and operational risks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的理论，认为企业的特异性冲击会通过利益相关者不透明度影响到利益相关企业的价值。使用数据泄露作为实验设置，发现不透明的合作伙伴在合作伙伴发生数据泄露后会承受更大的价值减损、资金约束增加和网络安全风险提高。

AI.motivation: 理解信息不对称如何增强网络中的特异性冲击，以及这种影响如何体现在不透明企业的市场、合约和运营风险上
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者不透明度理论，信息不对称理论，网络效应理论
AI.method: 使用数据泄露事件作为实验设置，进行实证分析，比较不透明企业和透明企业在合作伙伴数据泄露后的价值变化、资金约束情况和网络安全风险
AI.findings: 不透明的合作伙伴在合作伙伴发生数据泄露后承受更大的价值减损，更高的资金约束概率，以及更高的网络安全风险
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了利益相关者不透明度理论，扩展了信息不对称理论在网络环境中的应用，揭示了特异性冲击通过信息通道在网络中的传导机制

title: Aligning Large Language Model Agents with Rational and Moral Preferences: A Supervised Fine-Tuning Approach
affiliations: Zicklin School of Business, Baruch College - The City University of New York, Directeur de Recherche, Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique, Toulouse School of Economics, Institute for Advanced Study in Toulouse, University of Toulouse Capitole, Toulouse, France and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business - Econometrics and Statistics

detail.title: Aligning Large Language Model Agents with Rational and Moral Preferences: A Supervised Fine-Tuning Approach
detail.abstract: Understanding how large language model (LLM) agents behave in strategic interactions is essential as these systems increasingly participate autonomously in economically and morally consequential decisions. We evaluate LLM preferences using canonical economic games, finding substantial deviations from human behavior. Models like GPT-4o show excessive cooperation and limited incentive sensitivity, while reasoning models, such as o3-mini, align more consistently with payoff-maximizing strategies. We propose a supervised finetuning pipeline that uses synthetic datasets derived from economic reasoning to align LLM agents with economic preferences, focusing on two stylized preference structures. In the first, utility depends only on individual payoffs (homo economicus), while utility also depends on a notion of Kantian universalizability in the second preference structure (homo moralis). We find that fine-tuning based on small datasets shifts the behavior of the LLM agent toward that of the corresponding economic agent. We further assess the behavior of fine-tuned agents in two applications: moral dilemmas involving autonomous vehicles and algorithmic pricing in competitive markets. These examples illustrate how different normative objectives embedded via realizations from structured preference structures can influence market and moral outcomes. This work contributes a replicable, cost-efficient, and economically grounded pipeline to align AI preferences using moral-economic principles.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过经济博弈实验发现LLM代理在战略互动中存在显著行为偏差，提出基于经济推理的监督微调管道，成功将LLM行为与经济偏好对齐，并在道德困境和算法定价应用中验证了效果。
AI.research_question: 如何通过监督微调方法使大型语言模型代理在战略互动中表现出符合经济偏好的行为？
AI.motivation: 随着LLM系统越来越多地自主参与经济和道德决策，理解其在战略互动中的行为特征至关重要，但现有模型存在与人类行为偏差的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经典经济博弈理论，采用两种偏好结构：纯粹个体收益最大化的经济人(homo economicus)和包含康德普遍化道德原则的道德人(homo moralis)偏好结构。
AI.method: 使用经济博弈实验评估LLM行为偏差，设计监督微调管道，利用经济推理生成的合成数据集对LLM进行微调，并在道德困境和算法定价场景中进行应用验证。
AI.findings: GPT-4o等模型表现出过度合作和有限激励敏感性，而推理模型如o3-mini更符合收益最大化策略；基于小数据集的微调能有效将LLM行为转向对应的经济代理行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于道德经济原则的可复制、成本效益高的AI偏好对齐管道，为LLM在战略决策中的行为校准提供了理论框架和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的微调方法，可应用于自动驾驶道德决策和竞争市场算法定价等实际场景，帮助嵌入不同的规范性目标以影响市场和道德结果。

title: Leveraging Cross-Industry Data for Building Multi-Dimensional Machine Learning Models in Anti-Money Laundering Detection Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Leveraging Cross-Industry Data for Building Multi-Dimensional Machine Learning Models in Anti-Money Laundering Detection Systems
detail.abstract: This study explores the integration of cross-industry data for building multi-dimensional machine learning models in anti-money laundering (AML) detection systems. By combining data from diverse sectors such as finance, retail, telecommunications, healthcare, and e-commerce, the research aims to enhance the detection of suspicious activities that traditional AML systems, reliant solely on financial data, often overlook. The primary purpose is to evaluate how cross-industry data can improve the accuracy and adaptability of AML systems by providing a more comprehensive view of customer behavior and financial activities. The methodology involves the development and testing of machine learning models that integrate multi-source data, utilizing both supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, as well as network-based approaches. Key findings reveal that multi-dimensional models can uncover hidden relationships and behavioral anomalies that single-industry models fail to detect, significantly improving early detection of money laundering activities. The conclusion emphasizes the potential of cross-industry data integration to revolutionize AML systems, while also addressing challenges related to data privacy, quality, and regulatory compliance. This study provides valuable insights for financial institutions and regulatory bodies seeking to strengthen AML frameworks through innovative, data-driven approaches.

title: LLM Grooming: A New Cognitive Threat to Generative AI
affiliations: University Paris 8

detail.title: LLM Grooming: A New Cognitive Threat to Generative AI
detail.abstract: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has given rise to a new form of informational and cognitive manipulation: LLM Grooming. This emerging threat refers to the large-scale contamination of training data with biased or deceptive content, thereby transforming generative AI systems into powerful vectors of disinformation. Unlike classical data poisoning-which corrupts developer-curated datasets-LLM Grooming operates through the systematic flooding of publicly accessible data sources, such as web archives, with fabricated narratives. Once incorporated during training or through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), these narratives are statistically assimilated by the model and reproduced as seemingly factual knowledge. This article conceptualises LLM Grooming as a distinct category of cognitive threat, beyond traditional information warfare. It explores its dual manifestation: in the restricted sense, as the contamination of training corpora prior to model deployment, and in the broader sense, through malicious prompts and RAG exploitation post-deployment. The paper examines emblematic cases such as the Pravda network, which generated over 3.6 million articles in a single year, measurably contaminating major Western LLMs. It further analyses the structural vulnerabilities of different architectures, with particular emphasis on the heightened risks faced by RAGbased systems. The findings highlight the inadequacy of conventional counter-disinformation measures, which are largely reactive and ill-suited to systemic contamination. The paper calls for proactive strategies, including dataset auditing, continuous monitoring, robust human-in-the-loop mechanisms, and international cooperation. By framing LLM Grooming as both an informational and a cognitive threat, the article argues for a paradigm shift in AI security to preserve the integrity of decision-making processes in digital societies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LLM Grooming这一新型认知威胁概念，指通过大规模污染训练数据将生成式AI系统转变为虚假信息传播载体的攻击方式，分析了其双重表现形式和架构脆弱性，并呼吁采取主动防御策略。
AI.research_question: LLM Grooming作为一种新型认知威胁的本质特征是什么？其对AI系统的具体影响机制和防御策略如何？
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的快速发展催生了新的信息和认知操纵形式，传统反虚假信息措施对此类系统性数据污染攻击无效，需要重新思考AI安全范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知威胁理论、信息战理论、AI安全框架、数据污染攻击分类理论
AI.method: 概念分析框架构建、典型案例研究（如Pravda网络）、系统架构脆弱性分析、对策策略探讨
AI.findings: LLM Grooming具有双重表现形态（训练前数据污染和部署后恶意提示/RAG利用），RAG系统风险更高，传统反制措施不适用于系统性污染问题
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了LLM Grooming作为独立认知威胁类别的新概念框架，超越了传统信息战范畴，为AI安全理论提供了新的分析维度
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了包括数据集审计、持续监控、人机协同机制和国际合作在内的主动防御策略，为保护数字社会决策过程完整性提供了实践指导

detail.abstract: Technological advancements have dramatically transformed the tourism landscape, enhancing the convenience, accessibility, and personalization of travel experiences. The intersection of tourism and technology has revolutionized the travel industry, enhancing how people plan, experience, and share their journeys. This article explores the transformative impact of technology on the tourism sector, highlighting how innovations such as online booking platforms, smart devices, AI, VR/AR, and social media have enhanced convenience, accessibility, and personalization in travel experiences. While these advancements have made travel more flexible and engaging, challenges such as data privacy, over-tourism, and the digital divide remain critical issues to address for sustainable growth. The future of tourism is expected to be shaped by emerging technologies like sustainable travel platforms, autonomous transportation, and blockchain, which have the potential to further redefine the travel experience. Drawing on practical examples from both India and the global community, the article examines the current technological trends in tourism and explores the future possibilities and challenges that will continue to shape the industry.

title: A Money View of Offline Payment Functionality
affiliations: Giesecke+Devrient

detail.title: A Money View of Offline Payment Functionality
detail.abstract: Central banks' work on CBDC often includes offline payment functionality, where individuals and merchants can conduct transactions without online connectivity. This is comparable to cash: a bearer instrument that is a liability of the central bank. Therefore, the impact of offline CBDC on balance sheets is well-understood. Lately, there have been proposals to equip other types of payment systems with offline functionality, for example IPS. This would involve commercial banks and private money. Now, the situation is not as clear any more: Would each bank issue their own offline "digital cash"? Would the resulting liabilities be fungible? Here, we look at different possible models and take an opinionated view how a practical offline-capable IPS should look like.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了为私人支付系统（如IPS）增加离线功能时涉及的银行负债可互换性和发行模式问题，提出了实用的离线支付系统设计方案。
AI.research_question: 当商业银行为私人支付系统增加离线功能时，应如何设计发行模式和确保负债的可互换性？
AI.motivation: 随着央行数字货币（CBDC）离线支付功能的发展，私人支付系统也开始探索离线功能，但私人货币的离线支付涉及商业银行负债的可互换性和发行模式等新问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于央行货币与私人货币的区别理论，以及支付系统设计和银行负债管理理论。
AI.method: 分析不同可能的离线支付系统模型，进行比较研究并提出观点性设计建议。

title: Woke AI Vs. Maga: Scalable Ethical AI in Action

detail.title: Woke AI Vs. Maga: Scalable Ethical AI in Action
detail.abstract: In an era of polarized technology ethics, Woke AI vs. MAGA encapsulates the defining clash between artificial intelligence committed to truth and justice versus reactionary efforts to preserve systemic bias. This paper examines how white supremacist ideology infiltrates mainstream AI systems and demonstrates how a counter-racist framework can overcome these limitations. We present the Keisha News Network (KNN)-a production-grade, counter-racist AI stack powered by the soWS Newsletter data engine and expressed through The MAGA Files, FNS (Fragile News Source), and the Fragile News Decoder-as a concrete, scalable alternative to so-called "neutral" AI, which habitually obscures racism through omission. Our analysis reveals that conventional large language models (LLMs) routinely exhibit white fragility: an avoidance of explicit discussions of white supremacy that inadvertently upholds oppressive narratives. In the Trump (2025-) era-marked by day-one pardons for January 6 rioters, federal dismantling of DEI programs, and presidential misinformation about the Epstein files-the urgency of systems capable of naming power and decoding propaganda in real time cannot be overstated. This research advances both academic discourse and applied AI design by operationalizing African-centered theory into live systems. It also offers a case for investment: scalable, truth-aligned AI tools that not only meet ethical imperatives but open new markets for transparency, bias auditing, and information integrity. KNN demonstrates that ethical AI at scale is not only possible but necessary, and that real innovation begins where neutrality ends.

detail.title: The Power of Digital Influencers in Fashion Marketing
detail.abstract: This book explores the transformative role of digital influencers in contemporary fashion marketing, offering a comprehensive analysis grounded in academic research and industry practice. As social media platforms redefine consumer-brand interactions, digital influencers have emerged as powerful intermediaries who shape trends, drive engagement, and influence purchasing decisions across diverse audience segments. The book provides an in-depth examination of influencer typologies, platform-specific strategies, psychological mechanisms of persuasion, and the dynamics of brand partnerships. It also critically addresses ethical considerations, influencer credibility, and evolving consumer behaviours in the digital age. By combining theoretical frameworks with real-world examples, this work equips scholars, practitioners, and students with a nuanced understanding of how digital influence operates within the fashion industry and what it implies for future marketing strategies. The final chapter offers forward-looking insights into emerging technologies, measurement metrics, and the evolving landscape of fashion influencer marketing.

title: Thought Experiment: The Third Paradigm -An Evidence-Based Path for Financial Planning's Next Paradigm
affiliations: Academy of Financial Services

detail.title: Thought Experiment: The Third Paradigm -An Evidence-Based Path for Financial Planning's Next Paradigm
detail.abstract:
This article proposes a paradigm shift for the financial planning profession, moving it from a static, heuristic-based approach to a dynamic, evidence-based one. The current model, which often relies on simplistic rules and single-period calculations, is compared to past outdated scientific theories in fields like physics and medicine that were eventually overturned by new evidence. The author argues that financial planning is "stuck in the past" because it fails to properly apply the scientific method to retirement income research.
A central issue is the profession's neglect of the aging process. This ageism leads to an oversimplified view of retirement as a fixed, 30-year period, rather than a dynamic journey with constantly changing needs and statistical probabilities. The article advocates for a "Third Paradigm" that treats retirement income planning as a three-dimensional (3-D) problem, considering the interplay between age, portfolio allocation, and spending/income.
Key Shortcomings and a Path Forward
The author identifies several key shortcomings of the current paradigm:
Over-reliance on heuristics: Simple rules of thumb are used instead of comprehensive statistical data.
Incorrect data arrangement: Research often models "years since retirement" (shorter to longer),which is the opposite of the reality of aging (longer to shorter remaining time frames).
Static calculations: The use of single-period calculations fails to capture the dynamic nature of a retiree's life.
The article presents research supporting a new methodology that models the entire projected lifetime of a retiree. This approach considers how a person's remaining longevity, a concept called the "Longevity Bow Wave," changes with age and how that change should influence asset allocation and spending decisions. For example, less volatile portfolios are shown to be more favorable for older retirees with shorter time frames.
In conclusion, the article calls for a call to action to update the profession's research and software. It suggests that by adopting a dynamic, multi-period modeling approach and embracing advanced technology like AI, the profession can move beyond its current limitations, elevate its standards, and provide more insightful, evidence-based advice that truly reflects the complexities of a retiree's life.

title: When Accuracy Loses Its Price: AI and the Declining Willingness to Pay for Verified Information

detail.title: When Accuracy Loses Its Price: AI and the Declining Willingness to Pay for Verified Information

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: Generative AI tools provide rapid, low-cost forecasts, raising the question of how AI availability affects demand for accurate information. Across six studies, we show that AI access reduces willingness to pay (WTP) for accurate data. Priming AI's predictive ability (Study 1) and offering free AI forecasts (Study 2) both lowered WTP. In settings either AI results were not shown (Studies 3a and 3b) or shown (Study 4), participants valued AI forecasts but miscalibrated their use: although they were willing to pay substantially for AI estimates, they failed to adjust for accuracy differences across contexts. Interactive chatbot use (Studies 5a-5b) boosted users' confidence, reduced estimation errors, and decreased WTP. In Study 6, participants interacted with purpose-built forecasting tools, where we found that design features shape users' confidence in AI but did not prevent reduced WTP. These suggested a paradox: AI may democratize access to forecasts while undermining investment in vetted accuracy.

AI.tldr: AI工具降低了人们对准确信息的付费意愿，虽然提升了预测便利性但削弱了对验证准确性的投资

title: Photonic Integrated Neural Networks: A Review

detail.title: Photonic Integrated Neural Networks: A Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no conflicts of interest

detail.abstract: Neural networks (NNs), inspired by the biological visual cortex, have been widely applied in computer vision, natural language processing, and beyond. As Moore's Law approaches its physical limits, photonic neural networks (PNNs), which leverage photons rather than electrons as information carriers, have emerged as a promising technological advancement. With ultrafast speeds and ultralow energy consumption in ultra-high throughput, PNNs usher in a new generation of intelligent computing. Moreover, the advent of photonic integrated circuits (PICs) provides a compact and reliable hardware platform for computing, further advancing the development of PNNs. In this paper, we review recent advances in linear and nonlinear computation and integrated optical devices serving as fan-in and fan-out. We also summarize large-scale on-chip PNN and discuss the future challenges associated with their monolithic integration.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了光子神经网络(PNNs)的最新进展，包括线性非线性计算、集成光学器件、大规模片上PNN以及单片集成面临的挑战。PNNs利用光子作为信息载体，具有超高速、超低能耗和超高吞吐量的优势，是后摩尔定律时代的重要计算技术。

title: AI Feynman: A Powerful New Approach to Discover Marketing Laws
affiliations: Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School and Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School

detail.title: AI Feynman: A Powerful New Approach to Discover Marketing Laws
detail.abstract: In a recent paper, physicists Udrescu and Tegmark (2020) developed a recursive multidimensional symbolic regression algorithm called AI Feynman, that combines neural network fitting with a suite of physics-inspired techniques, which they use to successfully recover 100 famous laws of physics using synthetic data. AI Feynman presents a remarkably novel approach to marketing researchers, not to mention social scientists in general, who aim to discover, for example, generalizable algebraic laws characterizing consumer response behavior. In this paper, we introduce this powerful algorithm to marketing scientists. We test the ability of AI Feynman to recover five famous marketing laws-(1) Bass Model (BM), (2) Generalized Bass Model (GBM), (3) Multinomial Logit (MNL) Model, (4) Multiplicative Competitive Interactions (MCI) Model, (5) AdBudg Model-using synthetic data. Using AI Feynman, we successfully recover all five famous marketing laws across arbitrarily chosen ranges of model parameter values. We quantify the degree of measurement error in the outcome variable within which AI Feynman is robust in terms of yielding the correct algebraic equation characterizing each marketing law. We show that empirical applications of the five famous marketing laws in the literature satisfy our quantified measurement error bounds. We believe that AI Feynman will be invaluable in terms of its potential usefulness to discover as yet unknown algebraic laws of marketing in emerging domains such as information diffusion in social networks, consumer adoption of digital products etc.
