title: Our Beliefs About Work Will Determine the Future of Work
affiliations: Complex Systems Research Group

detail.title: Our Beliefs About Work Will Determine the Future of Work
detail.abstract:
In this essay, we address the tangle of beliefs concerning the nature and necessity of work in modernity, and the implications of those beliefs for the future of work. We consider work generally, in all its manifest forms. While those manifestations have changed over time depending on the institutional characteristics of any given social structure, the toil to procure a living has been consistently required of humanity, whether through enclosure, hunting, farming, scavenging or its current predominant form of waged labour.

Labour and wages are typically the purview of economists; however, \emph{homo economicus} with its perfect optimising within the context of perfect information fails to capture the complexities of modern work. Social actors behave according to nuanced and often contradictory belief structures. To begin to untangle the knotted skein that are our beliefs about work, we will divide these beliefs into two overarching yet contradictory teleological perspectives, and explore the different strands within each. These opposing beliefs produce tensions in the fabric of our society, and we believe they need to be explicitly addressed before that fabric is irreparably torn.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨现代社会中关于工作本质和必要性的复杂信念体系，分析这些信念对未来工作的影响。作者将工作信念分为两种相互矛盾的终极目的论视角，并认为需要明确解决这些对立信念产生的社会张力。
AI.research_question: 现代社会中关于工作本质和必要性的信念体系是什么？这些信念如何影响未来工作的走向？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学中的理性人模型无法捕捉现代工作的复杂性，社会行为者基于微妙且常常矛盾的信念结构行事，需要解构这些关于工作的复杂信念体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用社会学和哲学视角，超越经济学的理性人假设，关注社会行动者的信念结构和终极目的论视角。
AI.method: 理论分析和概念框架构建，将工作信念分为两种相互矛盾的终极目的论视角进行分析。
AI.findings: 工作信念可以划分为两种对立的终极目的论视角，这些对立信念在社会中产生张力，需要被明确认识和解决。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了超越经济学视角的工作信念分析框架，揭示了工作信念的社会建构性质和内在矛盾。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现代工作困境提供新视角，帮助政策制定者和组织管理者更好地应对工作领域的挑战和变革。

title: Illusion and Consciousness: Disentangling Human Existence from Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Illusion and Consciousness: Disentangling Human Existence from Artificial Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. The research was conducted independently, without any personal or financial relationship that could have influenced the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is theoretical in nature and does not involve human participants, patients, or sensitive data. Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was self-initiated and self-funded by the author.

keywords: Computational Epistemology science and technology studies (STS)

detail.abstract: This paper examines the persistent confusion between artificial intelligence (AI) and human consciousness. Drawing on philosophy of mind, theology, and ethics, it argues that conflating computational artifacts with conscious experience constitutes a category mistake. The paper introduces the Qatrani Epistemic Distinction Model (Q-EDM), which establishes three propositions: (1) ontological non-equivalence between AI and human beings, (2) the epistemic scope constraint that AI simulations lack semantics or qualia, and (3) an ethical-policy imperative to focus on governance, bias, and accountability rather than attributing metaphysical agency to machines. By clarifying these distinctions, the paper provides a conceptual framework to guide researchers and policymakers, ensuring that AI remains a powerful tool but never a substitute for human existence.

AI.tldr: 本文通过哲学、神学和伦理学视角，分析了AI与人类意识的混淆问题，提出了Q-EDM模型来区分AI模拟与人类意识，强调AI缺乏语义和感受质，并呼吁关注AI治理而非赋予机器形而上学能动性。
AI.research_question: 人工智能与人类意识之间的混淆问题及其概念区分
AI.motivation: 当前存在将计算产物与意识体验混为一谈的范畴错误，需要澄清AI与人类在本质上的区别
AI.theoretical_framework: 心灵哲学、神学、伦理学，特别是Qatrani认识论区分模型(Q-EDM)
AI.method: 理论分析和概念框架构建，基于哲学和伦理学理论
AI.findings: 建立了三个核心命题：本体论非等价性、认识论范围约束、伦理政策必要性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Q-EDM模型，为AI与人类意识的区分提供了系统的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者和政策制定者提供概念指导，确保AI作为工具而非人类存在的替代品

title: The Role of Negative Peer Events in Leverage Manipulation: Evidence from Bond Defaults in China
affiliations: Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University, University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), University of Canterbury, University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) and

detail.title: The Role of Negative Peer Events in Leverage Manipulation: Evidence from Bond Defaults in China

keywords: Implicit government guarantee GEL classification: G32

detail.abstract: This study examines the role of negative peer events, specifically initial bond defaults, in driving leverage manipulation of non-defaulting firms within the same region. Controlling for firm-specific time-varying characteristics, we find that initial bond defaults within a province are associated with an increase in leverage manipulation among non-defaulting firms. Two potential mechanisms underlying this relationship include increased financial constraints for these firms and elevated investor risk perception of the local bond market. The positive impact of bond defaults on leverage manipulation is more pronounced for financially constrained firms, firms with severe information asymmetry, and those affected by high-rated bond and principal defaults. We further show that companies that manipulate their debt ratios experience higher default risk. Our findings have important implications for transparent disclosure and highlight the negative effect of regional bond defaults on corporate financial reporting practices.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了区域内首次债券违约事件对非违约企业杠杆操纵行为的影响，发现债券违约会通过加剧融资约束和提升投资者风险感知，导致非违约企业增加杠杆操纵，且这种效应在融资约束严重、信息不对称程度高以及受高评级债券和本金违约影响的企业中更为明显。

AI.motivation: 债券违约事件可能通过改变地区金融环境和投资者预期，影响非违约企业的财务报告行为，但这一机制尚未得到充分研究。

AI.findings: 省内首次债券违约与非违约企业的杠杆操纵增加相关；融资约束和投资者风险感知是主要机制；效应在融资约束严重、信息不对称程度高、受高评级债券和本金违约影响的企业中更强；杠杆操纵企业面临更高违约风险。

title: Cooperation Under Uncertainty: The Interplay of Communication and Noise in the Indefinitely Repeated Prisoners' Dilemma
affiliations: University of Bremen

detail.title: Cooperation Under Uncertainty: The Interplay of Communication and Noise in the Indefinitely Repeated Prisoners' Dilemma
detail.abstract: In many repeated economic interactions, players cannot perfectly observe others' past actions but instead receive noisy feedback. Communication has been identified as a key factor in sustaining cooperation under such conditions. However, it remains unclear how its effectiveness depends on the level of noise in monitoring. This study presents a laboratory experiment using an indefinitely repeated Prisoners' Dilemma. Treatments vary along two dimensions: the possibility of communication and the level of monitoring noise. I elicit participants' subjective beliefs about their partner's cooperation as a measure of perceived strategic uncertainty. The results show that communication is more effective under low noise, as participants form higher and more stable beliefs. Further analysis finds differences in communication content across noise levels, which may shape the variation in beliefs.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验室实验发现，在重复囚徒困境中，沟通在低噪音监测环境下更有效，因为参与者形成更高且更稳定的合作信念，沟通内容也因噪音水平而异。
AI.research_question: 沟通在维持合作中的有效性如何依赖于监测噪音水平？
AI.motivation: 在重复经济互动中，参与者往往无法完美观察他人过去行为而只能获得噪音反馈，沟通被认为是维持合作的关键因素，但其效果与监测噪音水平的关系尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于重复囚徒困境理论，探讨噪音监测环境下沟通对合作行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 实验室实验，采用无限重复囚徒困境，通过两个维度设计处理：沟通可能性和监测噪音水平，并收集参与者对合作伙伴合作行为的主观信念数据。
AI.findings: 沟通在低噪音环境下更有效，参与者形成更高且更稳定的合作信念；不同噪音水平下的沟通内容存在差异，这可能影响信念的变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了沟通效果对监测噪音水平的依赖性，深化了对噪音环境下合作维持机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为现实世界中噪音监测环境下的合作策略设计提供了实证依据，特别是在需要依靠沟通维持合作的场景中。

detail.abstract: Plastic waste has become one of the most pressing environmental challenges of the 21st century, threatening ecosystems, human health, and sustainable development. This paper explores innovative solutions and circular economy strategies to transform plastic waste from an environmental burden into an economic resource. Through an extensive review of literature, case studies, and global practices, it identifies sustainable models such as closed-loop recycling, bioplastics, waste-to-energy conversion, and extended producer responsibility (EPR). The research emphasizes the importance of technological innovation, public-private partnerships, and community engagement in addressing plastic pollution. By integrating circular economy principles, society can shift towards reducing plastic production, maximizing reuse, and creating value from waste, ultimately fostering a sustainable future.

detail.title: The finance-growth relationship and the level of country development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The contribution is free from any conflicts of interest, including all financial and non-financial interests and relationships

detail.abstract: We examine whether dynamic impacts of banks and stock markets on economic growth are related to the level of country development. Using annual data from 15 industrial and 15 emerging countries over the period from 1976 to 2005, we find that banking development and stock market development may have distinct short-and long-run impacts on economic growth at various stages of country development. Financial development is not always a panacea for economic growth. Most importantly, our findings suggest that the fully functional tools to render stable growth for a country may depend on the level of the country's development.

AI.tldr: 银行和股票市场对经济增长的动态影响与国家发展水平相关，研究发现金融发展并非总是经济增长的灵丹妙药，有效的金融工具选择取决于国家发展阶段
AI.research_question: 银行和股票市场对经济增长的动态影响是否与国家发展水平相关？

title: Digital Skills for the Accounting and Finance Profession: Evidence from Online Job Advertisements in Hong Kong and Singapore
affiliations: Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Hong Kong Polytechnic University, School of Accounting and Finance, Students and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Digital Skills for the Accounting and Finance Profession: Evidence from Online Job Advertisements in Hong Kong and Singapore
detail.abstract: Lack of digital skills among job applicants has been a significant factor that prevents them from taking advantage of many career opportunities in an increasingly digitalized economy. Knowing what digital skills are currently required by employers would be important for addressing the skill shortage. In this study, we apply the natural language processing techniques to analyze digital skill requirements in online job advertisements from three data sources. All three sources provide the full text of job advertisements in which employers describe the required skills or qualifications for the advertised positions. We observe consistent evidence on the demand for digital skills in all three samples in recent years: the percentage of jobs requiring digital skills typically ranges between 20% and 30%. A few digital skills are consistently in high demand through the study period. There are substantial overlaps but also clear differences in the digital skills that are required for accounting and finance professionals. We also find strong similarity and some differences in digital skill requirements between Singapore and Hong Kong. The findings from our study can provide valuable evidence to inform curriculum planning and career preparation for college education and professional training in accounting and finance disciplines in both economies.

title: A New Axis of Influence in Afghanistan: Analysing China and Russia's Political Engagement with the Taliban Roshni
affiliations: Independent, Independent and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A New Axis of Influence in Afghanistan: Analysing China and Russia's Political Engagement with the Taliban Roshni

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors do not have any personal or financial relationship with other people or organisations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced their study.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this report

detail.abstract: Russia's formal recognition of the Taliban in 2025 and China's expanding political and economic engagement in Afghanistan illustrate a shifting regional dynamic that has been interpreted as the emergence of a China-Russia axis. While both powers converge on the goal of limiting Western influence and ensuring regional stability, their underlying motivations diverge: Russia seeks strategic depth and security assurances, whereas China prioritises connectivity, investment, and access to resources. This convergence produces a pragmatic alignment rather than a consolidated strategic partnership, raising questions about its durability. For the Taliban, such engagement provides external legitimacy and opportunities for economic relief, yet it simultaneously risks deepening Afghanistan's dependence on a narrow set of external actors, with significant implications for regional governance and international policy responses.

AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"目标趋同-动机分化"的分析框架，丰富了实用主义国际合作理论

title: Weighing the Scales: The Balancing Test of the Foreign Subsidies Regulation
affiliations: University of Vienna and University of Antwerp - Faculty of Law, Business & Law Research Group

detail.title: Weighing the Scales: The Balancing Test of the Foreign Subsidies Regulation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Both authors declare that they have no conflict of interest. The paper was written in July 2025, subsequent developments had to be disregarded.
declarations.funderStatement: Mattiolo acknowledges the financial support of the FWO (Research Foundation – Flanders, funding file No. K202925N) for supporting his doctoral research on the Foreign Subsidies Regulation.

detail.abstract: The balancing test under the Foreign Subsidies Regulation (FSR) has emerged as one of its most debated features, reflecting tensions between competition enforcement and broader EU policy goals. Initially conceived as the 'EU interest test' in the White Paper, its contours remained rather vague until the recent publication of the Draft Guidelines, in July 2025. These Draft Guidelines finally allow a glimpse into better understanding of the balancing test. This paper explores more broadly how the balancing test works and the policy objectives it may pursue. After mapping the legal sources and the FSR's relationship with broader EU law, a theoretical framework of the balancing test is developed, rooted in FSR broader assessment and in the general principles of EU law. The test's process and assessment, particularly the order of positive eRects, are examined. Some procedural points, i.e. the burden of proof and variations across FSR procedures, are discussed as well. Ultimately, the paper assesses how the Commission will use its discretion in conducting the balancing test and its policy implications.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟《外国补贴条例》中的平衡测试机制，探讨其运作方式、政策目标、法律框架和程序要点，重点研究委员会在实施平衡测试时的自由裁量权及其政策影响。
AI.research_question: 欧盟《外国补贴条例》中的平衡测试如何运作？它追求哪些政策目标？委员会如何行使自由裁量权进行平衡测试？
AI.motivation: 平衡测试作为《外国补贴条例》中最具争议的特征之一，反映了竞争执法与更广泛欧盟政策目标之间的紧张关系，且其具体轮廓直到2025年7月草案指南发布才变得清晰。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于《外国补贴条例》的广泛评估和欧盟法律的一般原则，构建平衡测试的理论框架。
AI.method: 通过法律渊源映射、与欧盟法律关系的分析、理论框架构建、测试过程和评估（特别是积极效应的顺序）的检验，以及程序要点的讨论。
AI.findings: 草案指南首次提供了对平衡测试更好理解的机会，揭示了测试的具体运作机制、证明责任分配以及不同程序间的差异。

title: THE IMPACT OF INTERNAL AND MACROECONOMIC FACTORS ON THE PROFITABILITY OF THE BANKING SECTOR. A CASE STUDY OF THE WESTERN BALKAN COUNTRIES

detail.title: THE IMPACT OF INTERNAL AND MACROECONOMIC FACTORS ON THE PROFITABILITY OF THE BANKING SECTOR. A CASE STUDY OF THE WESTERN BALKAN COUNTRIES
detail.abstract: The banking sector in the Western Balkan countries has changed dramatically in recent years. A variety of factors have contributed to these changes, such as economic growth, increased competition, and the implementation of new regulations. As a result, the profitability of the banking sector varies greatly between countries. The purpose of this research is to look into the impact of internal and macroeconomic factors on the profitability of the banking sector in the Western Balkan countries. The research used 85 observations from unbalanced panel data from five countries from 2005 to 2021. Data were gathered from the International Monetary Fund's World Economic Outlook Database, which contains information on the trend and progress of banking in the Western Balkans. The variables used included macroeconomic variables, internal bank variables, and industry variables, with return on assets and return on equity used to measure bank profitability. Panel regression with pooled least squares, fixed effects, and random effects was used to analyze these variables. Internal factors such as bank Z-score, 3-bank asset concentration, bank net interest margin, bank overhead costs to total assets, bank credit to deposits, and bank capital to total assets have a positive impact on profitability, according to the findings. GDP and inflation, for example, have a mixed impact on profitability. The impact of industry factors such as liquid assets, deposits, and short-term funding, as well as bank Z-score, on profitability is mixed. The study's findings have significant implications for policy experts and bank managers in Western Balkan countries. The findings can be used by policymakers to create policies that promote the profitability of the banking sector. The findings can be used by bank managers to improve their banks' profitability by making strategic decisions about asset allocation, capital structure, and risk management.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了西巴尔干国家银行业内部因素和宏观经济因素对盈利能力的影响，发现内部因素如银行Z值、资产集中度等对盈利能力有正向影响，而GDP和通胀等因素影响不一。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行业盈利能力影响因素理论框架，包括内部银行因素、宏观经济因素和行业因素对银行盈利能力的理论影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2005-2021年西巴尔干五国85个非平衡面板数据观测值，采用面板回归分析（混合最小二乘法、固定效应和随机效应模型），以资产回报率和股本回报率衡量银行盈利能力。
AI.findings: 内部因素（银行Z值、3家银行资产集中度、净息差、管理费用占比、存贷比、资本充足率）对盈利能力有正向影响；GDP和通胀影响不一；行业因素（流动资产、存款和短期融资）影响混合。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了银行业盈利能力影响因素的理论研究，特别是在西巴尔干地区这一特定经济背景下的实证证据，验证了不同因素对银行盈利能力的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者制定促进银行业盈利能力的政策提供依据，为银行管理者在资产配置、资本结构和风险管理方面的战略决策提供指导，有助于提升西巴尔干国家银行业的整体盈利能力。

title: Whom You Know Does Not Matter but What You Know Matters: Interlocking Directorates and Firms' Performance in Shariah and Non-Shariah Systems
affiliations: Sunway University

detail.title: Whom You Know Does Not Matter but What You Know Matters: Interlocking Directorates and Firms' Performance in Shariah and Non-Shariah Systems
detail.abstract: This study explores the intricate relationship between interlocking director networks and firm performance across two different governance structure of Shariah and non-Shariah firms. The study covers 1362 firms listed on Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange and 6382 board of directors using social network analysis and random effect panel data regression. The average shortest path distance and Watts-Strogatz statistics show evidence of a small-world network or six degrees separation with the firms and board of directors for both Shariah and non-Shariah firms. In the context of Shariah-compliant firms, closeness centrality is identified as having 34.42% statistically positive impact on ROE, while betweenness centrality has 54.42% statistically negative impact on ROE. For non-Shariah firms, the closeness centrality has 27.36% , while betweenness centrality has-14.02% statistical impact on profit margin. It implies that the swiftness with which information traverses the intricate web of directors positively shapes firm performance, suggesting a departure from the conventional wisdom that asserts the importance of connections over the critical factor of shared information. Furthremore, serving as an intermediary between nodes within the network may not necessarily contribute favorably to overall firm performance.The study also uncovers a negative significant impact of degree centrality on ROE and ROA, underscoring the possibility that directors may pursue their interests, potentially to the detriment of shareholders.

title: Dry-roasted NUTS: early estimates of the regional impact of 2025 extreme weather
affiliations: , European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Dry-roasted NUTS: early estimates of the regional impact of 2025 extreme weather

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The views expressed here are those of the authors and do not necessarily represent those of the European Central Bank nor its Governing Council.

detail.abstract: We estimate the economic impact of three types of extreme weather events-floods, droughts and heatwaves-that occurred in Europe during the summer of 2025. Using weather data and estimates of average historical impact from Usman et al. (2025), we conservatively calculate that these events will lower gross value added (GVA) in the affected NUTS3 regions by a combined euro 43 billion in 2025, equivalent to 0.26 percent of total European Union output. Beyond these short-term losses, the regional impact of extreme events historically increases over time, with substantial impact in the following years. Based on the average historical experience, we estimate that the annual GVA in the affected regions will be euro 126 billion lower by 2029 than had these events not occurred.

AI.tldr: 本研究估计了2025年夏季欧洲洪水、干旱和热浪三种极端天气事件的经济影响，保守计算显示这些事件将使受影响地区的总增加值减少430亿欧元，相当于欧盟总产出的0.26%。长期影响更为显著，到2029年受影响地区的年总增加值将比未发生这些事件时减少1260亿欧元。
AI.research_question: 2025年夏季欧洲极端天气事件（洪水、干旱和热浪）对经济的短期和长期影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 极端天气事件频率和强度增加，需要量化其对经济的实际影响，为政策制定提供依据

AI.method: 使用天气数据和Usman等人(2025)的平均历史影响估计方法，保守计算总增加值(GVA)损失
AI.findings: 短期损失430亿欧元(占欧盟产出0.26%)，长期到2029年累计损失1260亿欧元，区域影响随时间增加
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了极端天气事件经济影响的量化分析框架，验证了历史影响估计方法的适用性

title: Housing Valued Beyond Consumption Value: Evidence from the Korean Jeonse System
affiliations: Sogang University - Department of Economics and Sogang University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Housing Valued Beyond Consumption Value: Evidence from the Korean Jeonse System
detail.abstract: The objective of this paper is to identify the main sources of housing values beyond their consumption value, which reflects the current state of housing attributes. To isolate consumption value as a component of total housing value, we leverage the Korean jeonse rental system. In this system, tenants pay a lump-sum jeonse deposit--typically 50-100% of the property value--that is fully refunded at the end of the lease, with no capital gain or interest income over a 2-4 year tenancy. We construct the price-to-jeonse ratio at a granular, property-level scale using repeated transactions and rental contracts for effectively identical units, and examine its relationship with housing and neighborhood attributes. Our results show strong explanatory power from variables capturing redevelopment potential, such as building age and capital intensity. When combined, these variables explain more than half of the variation in housing prices beyond their consumption value. In addition, variance decomposition analysis indicates that over 80% of the variation in housing prices is explained by variation in consumption value (as measured by the jeonse deposit). These findings suggest that, in Seoul, speculation plays only a limited role in explaining cross-sectional variation in housing prices.

AI.tldr: 通过韩国全留租金制度分离房屋消费价值，发现重建潜力等因素解释了超过50%的房价超出消费价值的变异，投机因素在首尔房价中作用有限
AI.research_question: 房屋价值中除消费价值外的主要来源是什么？投机因素在房价中负责了多大程度的变异？
AI.motivation: 理论上房屋价值包含消费价值和投资价值，但实证研究难以分离这两者，韩国全留租金制度为这种分离提供了独特机会
AI.theoretical_framework: 房屋价值理论（消费价值 + 投资价值），重建潜力理论，投机理论
AI.method: 利用韩国全留租金制度构建房价-全留租金比率，通过重复交易和租赁合同数据进行粒度化分析，采用方差分解方法
AI.findings: 重建潜力变量（建筑年龄、资本密集度）解释了超过50%的房价超出消费价值的变异；80%以上的房价变异由消费价值解释，投机因素作用有限
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一种新的房屋价值分离方法，实证验证了重建潜力在房价形成中的重要作用，对投机理论提出了挑战
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府房地产政策提供了实证基础，指出重建潜力管理比投机阻断更有效，对房地产市场监管具有重要意义

title: Banking Sector Development and FDI in Emerging Markets: Evidence from the SCO using a CCE-PMG Approach

detail.title: Banking Sector Development and FDI in Emerging Markets: Evidence from the SCO using a CCE-PMG Approach
detail.abstract: This study investigates the relationship between domestic banking development and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in nine Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) economies, including Pakistan, India, Iran, China, Russia, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, and Uzbekistan, from 2000 to 2023. Using a panel econometric framework that combines the Pooled Mean Group (PMG) estimator with Pesaran’s Common Correlated Effects (CCE) approach, the results show a positive long-run association between banking sector development and FDI. Granger causality analysis provides evidence of a unidirectional relationship, indicating that the development of the banking sector statistically precedes and is strongly associated with foreign investment. The positive long-run association highlights the crucial role of robust banking systems as domestic anchors for investment and as key components of regional economic resilience. The results yield two principal policy implications. First, strengthening domestic banking institutions is an important national strategy for enhancing attractiveness to foreign capital. Second, coordinated efforts among SCO countries are necessary to manage shared economic vulnerabilities and to improve the bloc’s collective investment appeal.

title: How to select the best candidate when judges can have multiple friends and enemies
affiliations: Universidad de Malaga

detail.title: How to select the best candidate when judges can have multiple friends and enemies

declarations.funderStatement: Financial assistance received under project PID2023-147391NB-I00, funded by MCIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033/FEDER UE, is gratefully acknowledged.

keywords: backward induction. J.E.L. Classi…cation Numbers: C72

detail.abstract: This paper studies a collective decision problem in which a group of judges must select a socially deserving winner from a set of candidates, despite each judge having multiple friends and enemies among them. Such relational biases arise in many real-world settings, including academic hiring, editorial boards, prize juries, international committees, and papal elections. We show how these conflicts of interest can be overcome by designing simple sequential voting mechanisms that implement the socially optimal choice via backward induction. We first propose a mechanism for the case of three candidates, where each judge can be associated with one candidate who is either a friend or an enemy. We then develop a new mechanism for four candidates, which, under a mild structural diversity condition, ensures correct implementation and extends recursively to any number of candidates. Our results provide the first general framework in which judges may simultaneously have multiple friends and multiple enemies, while still guaranteeing selection of the socially deserving winner through mechanisms that are both natural and practically applicable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个集体决策问题，其中评委需要在候选人存在朋友和敌人关系的情况下选出社会最优的获胜者。作者设计了简单的顺序投票机制，通过逆向归纳法实现社会最优选择，并提出了适用于3人和4人候选人的机制，可递归扩展到任意数量的候选人。
AI.research_question: 如何在评委对候选人存在多重朋友和敌人关系的情况下，设计投票机制来确保选出社会最优的获胜者？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中许多决策场景（如学术招聘、编辑委员会、评奖委员会、国际委员会和教皇选举）都存在评委与候选人之间的朋友和敌人关系，这些关系偏见会影响决策的公正性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集体决策理论、机制设计理论、博弈论中的逆向归纳法
AI.method: 设计顺序投票机制，首先针对3个候选人的情况提出机制，然后为4个候选人开发新机制，并在温和的结构多样性条件下确保正确实施，可递归扩展到任意数量的候选人。
AI.findings: 提出了能够处理评委同时存在多个朋友和多个敌人关系的通用框架，通过自然且实用的机制保证社会最优获胜者的选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了评委可同时拥有多个朋友和多个敌人的通用理论框架，扩展了集体决策理论在处理复杂社会关系方面的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际决策场景（如学术招聘、奖项评选等）提供了可操作的投票机制设计，有助于减少关系偏见对决策质量的影响。

title: Do social preference games predict behavior in the long-run? A lab-in-the-field experiment with crowdfunding contributors
affiliations: CATÓLICA-LISBON School of Business & Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Do social preference games predict behavior in the long-run? A lab-in-the-field experiment with crowdfunding contributors

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This experiment was funded by Paris School of Economics (11th call for funding PSE, 2014).

detail.abstract: We explore the long-run external validity of social preference games by linking behavior from a lab-in-the-field experiment to longitudinal data on crowdfunding contributions. In 2015, contributors of a crowdfunding platform participated in incentivized versions of the Dictator Game, the Trust Game (in both roles), and the Public Goods Game. We tracked their subsequent activity on the platform over a ten-year period, focusing on the number of distinct projects they funded. Cooperation in the Public Goods Game and positive reciprocity in the Trust Game are significantly associated with long-term crowdfunding behavior, and these correlations remain stable over time. The first-mover decision in the Trust Game also shows a positive, though weaker, association, while the Dictator Game is a poor predictor. Importantly, where predictive relationships are observed, they are concentrated among participants who reported supporting projects outside their personal networks. In addition, individuals who contributed to social projects exhibit higher levels of prosociality in the lab. Taken together, our findings suggest that certain standard laboratory games effectively capture stable and generalized prosocial preferences.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过将实验室实地实验中的社会偏好游戏行为与长达十年的众筹捐款纵向数据关联，验证了社会偏好游戏的长期外部效度。研究发现公共物品游戏中的合作行为和信任游戏中的正向互惠行为能显著预测长期众筹行为，且这些关联随时间保持稳定。
AI.research_question: 标准实验室社会偏好游戏是否具有长期外部效度，能否有效预测现实世界中的长期亲社会行为？
AI.motivation: 尽管实验室实验被广泛用于测量社会偏好，但其外部效度（特别是长期外部效度）一直存在争议，需要验证这些实验能否真实预测人们在现实世界中的长期亲社会行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学中的社会偏好理论，包括利他主义、互惠偏好和合作行为等理论框架。
AI.method: 采用实验室实地实验与纵向数据追踪相结合的方法：2015年在众筹平台进行激励性的独裁者游戏、信任游戏（双角色）和公共物品游戏实验，随后追踪参与者10年内在该平台上的众筹行为。
AI.findings: 1）公共物品游戏中的合作行为和信任游戏中的正向互惠行为与长期众筹行为显著相关；2）这些相关性随时间保持稳定；3）信任游戏中先动者的决策也有正向但较弱的关联；4）独裁者游戏预测能力较差；5）预测关系主要集中在支持非个人网络项目的参与者中；6）支持社会项目的个体在实验室中表现出更高亲社会性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为实验室社会偏好游戏的外部效度提供了强有力的实证证据，证实某些标准游戏能有效捕捉稳定且普遍化的亲社会偏好，推动了实验经济学方法的验证和发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为众筹平台和其他依赖亲社会行为的组织提供了识别和预测长期亲社会贡献者的有效工具，具有重要的实践应用价值。

title: Household Portfolio and Deposit Insurance: Implications for the Supply of Safe Assets
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management (IIMB), Bangalore, Bocconi University and Washington University in Saint Louis, John M. Olin Business School

detail.title: Household Portfolio and Deposit Insurance: Implications for the Supply of Safe Assets
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the effect of deposit insurance (DI) on household portfolio allocation between bank deposits and risky assets. Theoretically, limited DI creates a kink in the capital allocation line, causing depositor bunching at the DI threshold and increased equity holdings. Using a natural experiment in India and individual holdings on stocks, deposits, and mutual funds, we confirm depositor bunching at the DI threshold. Leveraging a bunching-in-differences design, we show that DI expansion shifts portfolios from equities and mutual funds to deposits, driven by unmet demand for safe assets. Bunchers increase their deposits between 3.6% and 5.1% by liquidating their stock holdings, which were more exposed to safer state-owned enterprises, transiently affecting the asset prices of these stocks. We show that the share of bunchers is a sufficient statistic to measure the depositor-implied risk of bank default. Our estimates of the welfare effect of changes in DI show that depositors gain at least 4% as DI increases, even after accounting for the resulting moral hazard by banks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究存款保险对家庭投资组合配置的影响。理论表明有限存款保险在资本配置线上产生拐点，导致储户在保险门槛处聚集并增加股票持有。通过印度自然实验和个体持有数据，证实了储户在保险门槛处的聚集现象。研究发现存款保险扩张促使投资组合从股票和基金转向存款，主要由对安全资产的未满足需求驱动。聚集者通过变现股票将存款增加3.6%-5.1%，这些股票更多是较安全的国有企业股票，暂时影响了这些股票的价格。聚集者比例可作为衡量银行违约风险的充分统计量。福利分析显示即使考虑银行道德风险，储户仍能从存款保险增加中获得至少4%的收益。
AI.research_question: 存款保险如何影响家庭在银行存款和风险资产之间的投资组合配置？
AI.motivation: 理解存款保险制度对家庭投资决策的影响，以及这种影响如何通过资产配置行为体现，对于评估存款保险政策的效果和设计最优保险机制具有重要意义
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限存款保险理论，资本配置线拐点理论，储户聚集行为理论
AI.method: 自然实验方法（印度政策变化），个体持有数据分析（股票、存款、基金），聚集差异设计（bunching-in-differences）
AI.findings: 确认储户在存款保险门槛处聚集；存款保险扩张导致投资组合从股票和基金转向存款；聚集者通过变现较安全的国有企业股票增加存款3.6%-5.1%；聚集者比例可作为银行违约风险的充分统计量
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了存款保险影响家庭投资组合配置的理论框架，提出了聚集行为作为风险测量指标的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估存款保险政策效果的实证依据，提出了衡量银行违约风险的新方法，为家庭投资决策提供了参考

title: Remittance Analysis and their Economic Aspect, Kosovo Case

detail.title: Remittance Analysis and their Economic Aspect, Kosovo Case
detail.abstract: The role of remittances as an external source of funding is considered to be extremely beneficial for many countries, especially for those facing with large number of unemployed and a slow pace of economic development. As Kosovo faces an unfavourable economic situation, remittances from abroad have been a great support, contributing to the well-being of Kosovar families. Kosovo's economy heavily relies on the remittances of immigrants living in Diaspora, but the data and analysis regarding the extent of the remittances in Kosovo have been scarce. In this paper, an analysis will be conducted on the remittances received so far in Kosovo, focusing on their effects on the economy, and especially their impact on GDP and exports and FDI. As a conclusion, this study is expected to yield results that will reflect more in detail and more precisely as to what is the real impact of remittances in emerging economies and which have a high percentage of remittances received in general in these countries, and in particular more insights will be provided as to where Kosovo stands at this level of remittance impact on the economy.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了科索沃侨汇对经济的影响，特别是对GDP、出口和外国直接投资的影响，旨在揭示侨汇在新兴经济体中的真实作用。
AI.research_question: 侨汇对科索沃经济的具体影响是什么？特别是对GDP、出口和外国直接投资的影响程度如何？
AI.motivation: 科索沃面临不利的经济状况，失业率高，经济发展缓慢，而来自国外的侨汇对科索沃家庭福祉起到了重要支持作用，但相关数据和分析较为缺乏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 侨汇经济学理论，外部资金流动对新兴经济体发展的影响理论
AI.method: 对科索沃迄今收到的侨汇数据进行实证分析
AI.findings: 预计研究将详细反映侨汇在新兴经济体中的真实影响，特别是对科索沃经济的具体影响程度
AI.theory_contributions: 为侨汇经济学理论提供新兴经济体的实证证据，丰富外部资金流动对发展中国家影响的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃政策制定者提供侨汇经济影响的精确数据，帮助制定更有效的经济发展政策，对其他高侨汇比例的新兴经济体具有参考价值

title: The Dynamic Effects of Banking, Life Insurance, and Stock Markets on Economic Growth
affiliations: Shih Chien University and Shih Hsin University

detail.title: The Dynamic Effects of Banking, Life Insurance, and Stock Markets on Economic Growth

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The contribution is free from any conflicts of interest, including all financial and non-financial interests and relationships
declarations.funderStatement: Financial support from the National Science Council of Taiwan (Grant No. NSC 101-2410-H-262-006- and NSC 102-2410-H-262-002-) is gratefully acknowledged.

detail.abstract: This study provides new evidence on the long-and short-term effects of life insurance, banking, and stock markets on economic growth using the pooled mean group (PMG) technique. The sample consists of 31 countries and covers the period from 1981 to 2008. We contribute to the existing literature in three ways. First, we examine whether variations in time series averaging methods, used for a generalized method of moments estimator (GMM), affect the robustness of the effect of financial activities on growth. Second, we study the long-and short-term effects as well as the nonlinear effect of the finance-growth nexus. The results of the entire sample analyzed using three estimators provide robust evidence that private credit impedes economic growth while the effects of life insurance and stock market on growth are not robust. Our findings suggest that the effects of financial activities on growth vary with the period, income level, and financial development. That is, countries at different levels of development should engage in different financial activities to ensure sustainable growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用PMG技术分析寿险、银行和股票市场对经济增长的长短期影响，发现私人信贷阻碍经济增长，而寿险和股市的影响不稳健，金融活动的影响因时期、收入水平和金融发展水平而异。
AI.research_question: 寿险、银行和股票市场对经济增长的长短期影响是什么？这些影响是否因时间序列平均方法、国家发展水平和金融发展阶段的不同而变化？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对金融活动与经济增长关系的研究结果不一致，需要更深入分析不同金融部门的影响以及这种关系在不同条件下的变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融发展理论、经济增长理论、金融中介理论
AI.method: 使用混合均值组（PMG）技术，样本包括31个国家1981-2008年的数据，采用三种估计器进行分析
AI.findings: 私人信贷阻碍经济增长，寿险和股票市场的影响不稳健；金融活动对增长的影响因时期、收入水平和金融发展水平而异
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了金融活动与经济增长关系的稳健证据，揭示了这种关系的非线性特征和条件依赖性
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同发展水平的国家制定差异化的金融政策提供依据，帮助确保可持续经济增长

title: Separation of Powers in Crisis: Constitutional Limits on Executive Dismantling of Federal Education Infrastructure
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Separation of Powers in Crisis: Constitutional Limits on Executive Dismantling of Federal Education Infrastructure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author thanks Claude, an AI assistant, for its assistance with research organization, source identification, and text synthesis under the author's direct supervision and guidance
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract:
This paper explores the constitutional limits on executive power, specifically in the context
16 of federal education infrastructure, arguing that the dismantling of such a system would
17 constitute a dangerous overreach of the executive branch. The work is a critical analysis of
18 the constitutional limits on executive power, particularly considering recent judicial
19 criticism and political polarization. It provides a unique interdisciplinary perspective on the
20 intersection of constitutional law, education policy, and democratic governance. The
21 paper uses a combination of legal, historical, and sociological frameworks to demonstrate
22 that the executive's authority is not absolute. The work examines landmark legal
23 precedents, including the "General Welfare Clause" and the "Commerce Clause" to build
24 an argument for constitutional limitations. The paper further argues that such executive
25 actions would not only subvert the will of Congress but also threaten the fundamental
26 principles of equality and access that are central to a functioning democracy. This analysis
27 demonstrates that the implications of such actions extend beyond mere constitutional
28 mechanics; they touch upon the very health of our democratic institutions. In a climate of
29 profound political polarization, the separation of powers stands as the bulwark against the
30 use of executive authority for partisan ends. The judicial branch, therefore, remains the
31 final and critical safeguard against executive actions that stray from constitutional
32 precedent, ensuring that the federal government's role in education continues to serve the
33 general welfare.
