AI.tldr: 本文探讨了行政权力在联邦教育基础设施背景下的宪法限制，认为拆除此类系统构成行政部门的危险越权行为。通过法律、历史和社会学框架分析，论证行政权力不是绝对的，并强调司法部门作为防止行政行动偏离宪法先例的关键保障。
AI.research_question: 行政权力在联邦教育基础设施方面的宪法限制是什么？拆除联邦教育系统是否构成行政部门的违宪越权？
AI.motivation: 基于近期司法批评和政治两极化的背景，探讨行政权力的宪法限制，特别是在教育政策领域，以防止行政部门为党派目的滥用权力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合宪法法律、历史分析和社会学视角的跨学科理论框架，重点关注"普遍福利条款"和"商业条款"等宪法原则。
AI.method: 采用法律、历史和社会学框架相结合的分析方法，考察具有里程碑意义的法律先例和宪法条款。
AI.findings: 行政权力受到宪法限制，拆除联邦教育系统不仅会颠覆国会意志，还会威胁平等和获取机会的基本原则，损害民主制度的健康。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了宪法法律、教育政策和民主治理交叉领域的独特跨学科视角，深化了对行政权力宪法限制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了司法部门作为防止行政越权的关键保障作用，为维护联邦政府在教育中服务普遍福利的角色提供了实践指导。

title: Foreign Ownership and the Welfare Responses to the US-China Trade War: Evidence from Manufacturers in Vietnam

detail.title: Foreign Ownership and the Welfare Responses to the US-China Trade War: Evidence from Manufacturers in Vietnam

declarations.funderStatement: This paper was supported by the Centre for Inclusive Trade Policy, ESRC [grant number ES/W002434/1].

detail.abstract: This paper studies the welfare implications of the US-China trade war in Vietnam. Utilizing an enterprise survey in Vietnam that covers the universe of registered firms with information on their capital ownership, I provide novel evidence that Vietnam's positive responses in employment and exports in 2017-2019 are driven mainly by foreign-owned manufacturers. To further understand the welfare gains of the trade war episode, I develop and estimate a quantitative model of trade participation with foreign ownership, where foreign-owned and domestic manufacturers differ in their distributions of productivity and fixed costs to participate in sourcing and exporting activities. A foreign demand shock to Vietnam of a magnitude similar to that of the trade war raises the real expenditure in the model by 5 percent, predominantly from an increase in labor income.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美中贸易战对越南的福利影响，发现2017-2019年越南就业和出口的积极反应主要由外资制造商驱动，贸易战带来的需求冲击使实际支出增长5%
AI.research_question: 美中贸易战对越南的福利影响是什么？越南就业和出口增长的驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究美中贸易战对第三方国家越南的经济影响，特别是福利收益的来源和分配
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易参与定量模型，考虑外资和国内制造商在生产率分布和参与采购出口活动的固定成本差异
AI.method: 利用越南企业调查数据（涵盖所有注册企业），构建和估计包含外资所有权的贸易参与定量模型
AI.findings: 越南2017-2019年就业和出口的积极反应主要由外资制造商驱动；类似贸易战规模的外国需求冲击使实际支出增长5%，主要来自劳动收入增加
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了包含外资所有权的贸易参与模型，区分外资和国内制造商在生产和贸易成本方面的差异
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解贸易战对第三方国家的影响提供实证依据，帮助评估贸易转移效应的福利收益

title: The Impact of Social Media on the Development of Women Especially in Transition States
affiliations: and AAB College

detail.title: The Impact of Social Media on the Development of Women Especially in Transition States
detail.abstract: The main goal of this paper was to highlight the importance of social media in the development of women entrepreneurs in the state of Kosovo, where the number of women entrepreneurs is increasing every day. In this research, two objectives are presented: to analyze the influence of social media on women's entrepreneurship in the case of Kosovo and to measure the impact of social media usage on sales of women's entrepreneurship in the case of Kosovo. To realize this empirical research, a questionnaire containing 25 questions was used, and 750 women entrepreneurs answered this questionnaire over a period of 5 months. The results of the analysis are presented through descriptive analysis, Pearson correlation, and the OLS model. The results of this research show that social media has a positive effect on increasing sales in women-led businesses; they have easier access to communication. Also, the results indicate that these media have a positive impact on increasing the audience as well as reducing expenses during the marketing campaign. Based on the presented results, it is stated that social media is the primary influencer in the development of women's entrepreneurship, and these findings are nearly similar to the results of research conducted by authors from various countries.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实证分析发现社交媒体对科索沃女性创业发展具有重要积极影响，特别是在增加销售额、扩大受众范围和降低营销成本方面。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体如何影响科索沃女性创业发展？社交媒体使用对女性创业销售额有何影响？
AI.motivation: 科索沃女性创业者数量日益增长，需要了解社交媒体在女性创业发展中的重要作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社交媒体营销理论和创业发展理论，探讨社交媒体对女性创业的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用问卷调查法，对750名女性创业者进行为期5个月的调查，使用描述性分析、Pearson相关分析和OLS模型进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 社交媒体对女性创业销售额有正向影响；提供更便捷的沟通渠道；有助于扩大受众群体；降低营销活动成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了社交媒体在女性创业领域的研究，验证了社交媒体对创业发展的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃女性创业者提供了使用社交媒体提升业务的实际指导，为政策制定者支持女性创业发展提供依据。

title: AI Governance: A Necessity and Imperative
affiliations: Alpha Sol LLC

detail.title: AI Governance: A Necessity and Imperative
detail.abstract:
This is an excerpt from Alex Wodi’s book, AI GOVERNANCE: A NECESSITY AND IMPERATIVE (AMZ, and BN 2025). The book discusses salient issues arising from the explosion of interest and the proliferation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and services post the release of ChatGPT in November 2022.

Leveraging a quarter-century of working in the private and public sector, Wodi explores the field of AI Governance from a legal, historical and technical perspective. He examines the history of AI, the human and environmental cost of AI and related technologies, public concerns about AI risks and harms like copyright and privacy rights violations, Algorithmic bias, job displacement, the international, national and organizational approaches to AI Governance. He looks at the legal and regulatory frameworks, principles, and standards related to AI, viz: the OECD AI Principles; UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI; NIST AI RMF; ISO/IEC 42001; ISO 23894; and the EU AI Act. He deftly navigates and compares the AI Readiness ranking, AI Laws, Policies and AI Strategies of the US, UK, China, Canada, Singapore, South Korea, Japan, India, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Egypt, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, Brazil, Colombia, Chile, Australia, and New Zealand.

In this excerpt, Wodi explores the meaning and importance of AI Governance, AI in Antiquity; The Dartmouth AI Workshop and the Turing Test; What Exactly is AI; Algorithm Bias and Discrimination; and the Eliza Effect.

In view of the potentially transformative impact of AI on humans and society and its attendant risks and benefits, Wodi submits that AI Governance is not just a necessity but an imperative to ensure the design, development and deployment of ethical, innovative, responsible, safe and trustworthy AI.

AI.tldr: 本书探讨了ChatGPT发布后AI治理的必要性和紧迫性，从法律、历史和技术角度分析AI治理框架，比较各国AI治理策略，强调需要建立道德、创新、负责任、安全和可信的AI系统。
AI.research_question: 如何建立有效的AI治理框架来应对AI技术快速发展带来的风险和挑战？
AI.motivation: ChatGPT发布后AI技术爆炸式发展，引发了版权侵权、隐私侵犯、算法偏见、就业替代等一系列社会问题，迫切需要建立全面的AI治理体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于法律、历史和技术三个维度构建AI治理理论框架，参考OECD AI原则、UNESCO AI伦理建议、NIST AI RMF、ISO/IEC标准等国际规范。
AI.method: 采用比较分析法，研究美国、英国、中国、加拿大、新加坡、韩国、日本、印度、沙特、阿联酋、埃及、肯尼亚、尼日利亚、南非、巴西、哥伦比亚、智利、澳大利亚和新西兰等国家的AI准备度排名、法律政策和战略。
AI.findings: AI治理不仅是必要选择，更是当务之急，需要确保AI的设计、开发和部署符合道德、创新、负责任、安全和可信的标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了多维度的AI治理理论框架，整合了法律规制、历史演进和技术标准，为AI治理研究提供了系统的理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业和组织提供了具体的AI治理实践指南，比较分析了各国治理模式的优劣，具有重要的实践指导价值。

title: Memory and the cross-section of stock returns
affiliations: Sabanci University

detail.title: Memory and the cross-section of stock returns
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of associative recall on the cross-section of stock returns in the US equity market. Utilizing a novel measure of return expectations rooted in memory, we show that stock-level cues such as monthly returns, return volatility and abnormal trading volume prompt investors to recall past experiences. Investors then allocate memory weights to these past experiences depending on how closely they resemble current cue values. Consequently, returns following those past experiences more similar to current cues strongly influence the future return expectations formed today. Investors overvalue those stocks with higher (lower) memory-based return expectations so that they earn lower (higher) future returns. We show that this memory effect is more pronounced for small-cap stocks and has a unique explanatory power which cannot be subsumed by recency or salience effects. The memory effect is stronger in portfolios that contain stocks associated with higher arbitrage costs and a higher likelihood to be mispriced. These findings remain robust after controlling for established asset pricing factors, risk proxies and firm-specific attributes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了记忆联想回忆对美国股市横截面收益的影响，发现投资者基于当前股票线索（如月度收益、波动率和异常交易量）回忆过去类似经历，并形成未来收益预期，导致高记忆预期股票未来收益较低，低记忆预期股票未来收益较高。
AI.research_question: 记忆联想回忆如何影响美国股市横截面收益？
AI.motivation: 传统资产定价模型未能充分考虑投资者基于记忆形成预期对股票收益的影响，需要探索记忆机制在股市定价中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于记忆联想理论，投资者通过当前股票线索（收益、波动率、交易量）回忆过去类似经历，并根据相似度分配记忆权重来形成未来收益预期。
AI.method: 使用基于记忆的新颖收益预期度量方法，分析股票层面的线索对投资者回忆过去经历的影响，并检验记忆效应对未来收益的预测能力。
AI.findings: 1）投资者高估记忆预期高的股票，导致其未来收益较低；2）记忆效应对小盘股更显著；3）记忆效应不能被近期性或显著性效应解释；4）在套利成本高和错误定价可能性大的组合中记忆效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于记忆联想理论的资产定价新视角，揭示了记忆机制在股票定价中的重要作用，丰富了行为金融学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了识别错误定价股票的新方法，帮助理解市场非有效性来源，对投资策略制定具有实践指导意义。

title: FINANCIAL INCLUSION IN EMERGING ECONOMIES: AN INDEPTH STUDY OF INDIA
affiliations: R.D.National college and Mukesh Patel School of Technology Management and Engineering

detail.title: FINANCIAL INCLUSION IN EMERGING ECONOMIES: AN INDEPTH STUDY OF INDIA
detail.abstract: Financial inclusion is a key driver of economic growth, serving as a bridge to ensure the participation of marginalized groups in the economic process. This paper presents a yearwise ranking of Indian States/Union Territories over a selected study period, as well as of selected Asian countries, based on their degree of financial inclusion. The study constructs two separate indices: the Financial Inclusion Index, which incorporates both demandside and supply-side indicators. The objective of this paper is to develop a comprehensive Financial Inclusion Index for Asian countries, with a specific focus on India and its States, using these indices as a basis for ranking the countries and regions in terms of the direction, degree, and intensity of financial inclusion.

title: Revisiting national, economic, and monetary sovereignty
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB) and Swiss National Bank - Financial Stability

detail.title: Revisiting national, economic, and monetary sovereignty
detail.abstract: We revisit the concepts of national, economic and monetary sovereignty by providing a critical survey of the literature. We propose definitions across these three, building on the idea of popular sovereignty. Today, the core of sovereignty should be understood as the ability of a community to take collective decisions which are in its interest and to effectvely implement them. While we structure the three sovereignties such that monetary sovereignty is understood as a subset of economic sovereignty, which itself we consider a subset of general national sovereignty, we develop the various specificities of each with an ultimate focus on monetary sovereignty. Sovereignty in the traditional sense, understood as the ability of the state to legislate and to exert control in its territory, remains a key factor shaping reality despite that it is challenged by the growing role of international organizations, globalization and digitalization. In the absence of enforcement, sovereign nations continue to behave opportunistically towards commitments made to international organizations. Globalization and digitalization do not change the fact that law remains national, and that for example financial claims including fiduciary money are deeply legal concepts anchored in national laws. Nation states can decide either to be lenient towards e.g. the abuse of market power in payments, dollarization, illicit payments-or to forcefully legislate against them. If they choose not to act against practices that appear damaging for society, their sovereignty must have suffered either from a lack of capacity, or from an impairment of democratic, governmental or legislative processes. This would confirm the relevance of sovereignty as a normative concept.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了国家主权、经济主权和货币主权的概念，通过文献批判性综述提出了基于人民主权思想的定义。主权核心应理解为社区为自身利益做出集体决策并有效实施的能力。尽管传统主权受到国际组织、全球化和数字化的挑战，但法律仍然是国家性的，国家仍能选择是否立法监管有害实践。
AI.research_question: 如何重新定义和理解国家主权、经济主权和货币主权在当代背景下的内涵和关系？
AI.motivation: 随着国际组织角色增强、全球化和数字化发展，传统主权概念面临挑战，需要重新审视和定义这些主权概念的现实意义和规范性价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人民主权思想，构建国家主权、经济主权和货币主权的层次框架，其中货币主权是经济主权的子集，经济主权是国家主权的子集。
AI.method: 文献批判性综述方法，对现有关于主权概念的文献进行系统性分析和重新阐释。
AI.findings: 传统主权作为国家立法和领土控制能力仍然是塑造现实的关键因素；法律本质上是国家性的；国家可以选择是否立法反对有害社会 practices；主权受损反映在能力缺失或民主进程受损。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于人民主权的主权新定义；建立了三层主权概念的层次框架；确认了主权作为规范性概念的相关性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国家在全球化背景下制定经济货币政策提供理论指导；帮助理解国家在国际承诺和国内立法之间的权衡选择。

title: The Mechanism of Vertical Fiscal Imbalance Affecting High-Quality Economic Development: A 3SLS Estimation Based on Local Government Tax Effort and Expenditure Structure
affiliations: Anhui University of Finance & Economics and Universiti Malaysia Sarawak

detail.title: The Mechanism of Vertical Fiscal Imbalance Affecting High-Quality Economic Development: A 3SLS Estimation Based on Local Government Tax Effort and Expenditure Structure

declarations.funderStatement: Talent Project of Anhui Provincial Department of Education (Grant No. gxgnfx2023002) and the Major Teaching Research Project under the Anhui Provincial Higher Education Quality Engineering Program (Grant No. 2023jyxm1544). Additional support was provided by the Information-Based Teaching Steering Committee for Vocational Colleges under the Ministry of Education of China (Grant No. KTSJ2024028). The authors acknowledge the AFC and UNIMAS for the research facilities provided.

detail.abstract: Against the backdrop of China's transition toward high-quality economic development, it is imperative to explore the mechanisms through which the fiscal system influences development quality. This study employs panel data from 30 Chinese provinces spanning 2008 to 2022 and applies a Three-Stage Least Squares (3SLS) estimation to examine the impacts of vertical fiscal imbalance, local government tax effort, and expenditure structure on high-quality economic development. The results reveal that vertical fiscal imbalance not only directly constrains development quality but also exerts indirect effects by weakening tax effort and increasing the proportion of livelihood-related public expenditures. The decomposition of effects shows that the direct effect dominates in the tax effort pathway, whereas the indirect effect is more pronounced in the expenditure structure pathway. The findings suggest that regionspecific policies and optimized fiscal decentralization are essential to promoting sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三阶段最小二乘法分析中国财政体制对高质量发展影响机制，发现纵向财政失衡通过税收努力和支出结构间接制约发展质量，需差异化政策和优化财政分权
AI.research_question: 财政体制如何影响中国经济高质量发展？具体而言，纵向财政失衡、地方政府税收努力和支出结构对发展质量的作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 在中国经济向高质量发展转型背景下，探索财政体制对发展质量的影响机制具有重要现实意义和理论价值
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政分权理论、公共财政理论、地方政府行为理论
AI.method: 使用2008-2022年中国30个省份面板数据，采用三阶段最小二乘法（3SLS）进行估计
AI.findings: 纵向财政失衡不仅直接制约发展质量，还通过削弱税收努力和增加民生类公共支出比例产生间接影响；直接效应在税收努力路径中占主导，间接效应在支出结构路径中更显著
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了财政体制影响高质量发展的多重作用机制，深化了财政分权与发展质量关系的理论认识
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定差异化区域政策和优化财政分权体制提供实证依据，促进可持续发展

title: Tariffs and Timing: Thailand's Daily Export Response to the 2025 U.S. "Liberation Day" Tariffs
affiliations: Bank of Thailand and Middle Tennessee State University - Department of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Tariffs and Timing: Thailand's Daily Export Response to the 2025 U.S. "Liberation Day" Tariffs
detail.abstract: On April 2, 2025-the so-called "Liberation Day"-the United States announced reciprocal tariffs on its trading partners, with Thailand facing a 36 percent tariff on most export categories, effective April 9. This paper provides the first empirical evidence of how these tariffs affected Thailand's exports to the U.S., using confidential transaction-level customs data. We begin by documenting high-frequency patterns in Thailand's monthly and daily exports around the announcement. Using a difference-indifferences framework with daily HS2-level data, we find a sharp anticipatory response: exports to the U.S. between April 4-9 surged by 50.7 percent, driven by a 63.0 percent increase in manufacturing exports. These findings highlight exporters' capacity to intertemporally adjust in response to trade policy uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 美国对2025年4月2日宣布的对泰国出口加征关36%关税，使得泰国在4月4-9日期间对美出口爆增50.7%，制造业出口增长63.0%，显示了出口商在贸易政策不确定性下的时间调整能力
AI.research_question: 美国对泰国宣布的关税政策如何影响泰国对美出口行为
AI.motivation: 探索贸易政策不确性下出口商的行为反应和时间调整能力
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易政策不确性理论、预期敏感性分析
AI.method: 差异中差异法（DID）框架，使用秘密的海关交易数据，包括月度和日度HS2级别数据
AI.findings: 在关税生效前的4月4-9日，泰国对美出口爆增50.7%，其中制造业出口增长63.0%，显示明显的预期性反应
AI.theory_contributions: 为贸易政策不确性下企业行为提供了新的实证证据，丰富了贸易预期敏感性理论
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者和企业理解贸易政策变化的影响机制，为贸易风险管理提供参考

title: The Variance of Revenue in Uniform and Discriminatory Auctions
affiliations: Fuqua School of Business, Duke University and

detail.title: The Variance of Revenue in Uniform and Discriminatory Auctions
detail.abstract: We study the stochastic properties of revenues in uniform and discriminatory auctions. The revenue equivalence theorem establishes that the two formats yield the same expected revenue for unit-demand, risk-neutral bidders with independent private values. We establish that there is no equivalence in terms of the second moment: the variance of revenues is lower in the discriminatory auction than in the uniform auction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了统一价格拍卖和歧视性拍卖中收入的随机特性，发现在收入方差方面不存在等价性，歧视性拍卖的收入方差低于统一价格拍卖。
AI.research_question: 统一价格拍卖和歧视性拍卖在收入方差方面是否存在等价性？
AI.motivation: 尽管收入等价定理表明两种拍卖形式在期望收入上等价，但其随机特性（特别是方差）的差异尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拍卖理论、收入等价定理、风险中性投标人、独立私有价值模型
AI.method: 理论分析，比较统一价格拍卖和歧视性拍卖的收入二阶矩（方差）
AI.findings: 歧视性拍卖的收入方差显著低于统一价格拍卖，打破了收入等价定理在二阶矩层面的适用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了拍卖理论，揭示了收入等价定理的局限性，为拍卖形式选择提供了新的理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为拍卖设计者提供了风险管理的理论指导，当关注收入稳定性时，歧视性拍卖可能是更好的选择。

title: Decoding AI Diffusion: Mapping the Path of Transformative AI Across Industries
affiliations: Unaffiliated Author, Independent and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Decoding AI Diffusion: Mapping the Path of Transformative AI Across Industries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research was coordinated and supervised by Convergence Analysis as part of its Spring 2025 AI Economic Policy Fellowship.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A; this research does not include patients or participants.
declarations.funderStatement: N/A (unfunded).

contentType.other: Final research report published by a think tank (Convergence Analysis).

detail.abstract: In this report, we develop an organizing framework to assess the diffusion potential of transformative AI (TAI) across different sectors of the economy. We argue that many existing methodologies for assessing TAI's potential to augment and automate cognitive labor oversimplify the structural, cultural, and technological differences between industries which will impact their susceptibility to disruption from AI. Drawing upon TAI literature and historical general purpose technology diffusion patters, we identify the sectoral factors most likely to impact the breadth and speed of TAI diffusion. We propose a five-category framework to organize these factors: technological readiness, workforce and human capital, investment, markets and competition, and regulation and oversight. This structure can be applied sectorally, leveraging qualitative and quantitative indicators for a given sector to determine the likely path and speed of TAI diffusion within that sector, or to compare TAI's potential impact across different sectors. We aim to provide policymakers, business leaders, and researchers with a tool to assist more nuanced foresight, enabling stakeholders to better anticipate labor market shifts from AI.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个评估变革性AI（TAI）在各经济部门扩散潜力的五维度框架，包括技术准备度、人力资本、投资、市场竞争和监管，用于预测AI对劳动力市场的影响。
AI.research_question: 如何评估变革性AI在不同经济部门的扩散潜力？
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法过于简化行业间的结构性、文化性和技术性差异，无法准确预测AI对各行业的影响程度和速度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于变革性AI文献和历史通用技术扩散模式，识别影响AI扩散广度和速度的部门因素。
AI.method: 提出五维度分析框架：技术准备度、人力资本、投资、市场竞争、监管监督，结合定性和定量指标进行部门分析。
AI.findings: 建立了可应用于具体部门或跨部门比较的分析工具，能够更细致地预测TAI扩散路径和速度。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了系统性评估AI扩散潜力的理论框架，丰富了技术扩散理论在AI领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业领导者和研究者提供实用工具，帮助预测AI引发的劳动力市场变化，支持更精准的决策制定。

title: Demand Response Control Structure in Imperfectly Competitive Power Markets: Independent or Integrated?
affiliations: Industrial Engineering Research Department, CentraleSupélec, Paris-Saclay University

detail.title: Demand Response Control Structure in Imperfectly Competitive Power Markets: Independent or Integrated?
detail.abstract: This article investigates different types of actors controlling demand response (DR) operations under Cournot competition. Analytical results linking load-shifting capacity, market equilibrium, and welfare are obtained for DR operated either by an independent aggregator (price-taker or pricemaker), by end-consumers' suppliers, or within the portfolio of generators. An application to a 2035 French power system with detailed flexible appliances constraints is also proposed. Results show that supplier-integrated DR yields the greatest price reductions and lowest capacity withholding, while DR integrated with baseload producers has the weakest effects on prices and may worsen welfare losses compared to a perfectly competitive market. While DR deployment consistently improves welfare and lowers prices, the extent depends on the control structure. Independent aggregation and supplier integration deliver similar welfare gains but shift surplus toward consumers, whereas integration within generators results in up to a 6€/MWh higher producer surplus compared to the other structures. Policy implications highlight the importance of DR deployment overall but caution against DR integration exclusively within baseload generators' portfolios due to limited market benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Cournot竞争下不同类型主体控制需求响应(DR)运营的效果，发现供应商整合的DR能带来最大价格降低和最小容量扣留，而与基载发电商整合的DR对价格影响最弱且可能恶化福利损失。
AI.research_question: 不同类型主体控制需求响应运营对市场均衡和福利的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究不同DR控制结构（独立聚合商、终端消费者供应商、发电商组合内）在Cournot竞争下的表现差异，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: Cournot竞争模型，分析不同DR控制结构下的市场均衡和福利效应。
AI.method: 理论分析结合实证应用，使用2035年法国电力系统详细灵活设备约束数据进行验证。
AI.findings: 供应商整合DR带来最大价格降低和最小容量扣留；与基载发电商整合的DR效果最弱且可能恶化福利；独立聚合和供应商整合带来相似福利增益但将剩余转移给消费者；发电商整合使生产者剩余比其他结构高6€/MWh。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了不同DR控制结构下的Cournot竞争分析框架，揭示了控制结构对市场均衡和福利分配的关键影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供重要参考：总体应推动DR部署，但应避免DR仅与基载发电商整合，因其市场效益有限。

reference: New Strategy Center, Policy Paper, March 2018
title: A Dragon In The Powder Keg: China’s Mercantile Quest In The Balkans
affiliations: Amsterdam Center for International Law

detail.title: A Dragon In The Powder Keg: China’s Mercantile Quest In The Balkans

publicationDetails.detailsText: New Strategy Center, Policy Paper, March 2018

detail.abstract:
What can explain China’s (once) improbable rise in the
Balkans? Neither historical, nor religious affinities. Neither
spatial proximity, nor adherence to a ‘community of values’.
Is it a pragmatic partnership or a deeply-managed geopolitical
design? At a first glance, it would seem that China’s presence
is determined by mere economic drivers, tapping new markets
and opening alternative transit corridors along its Belt-and-
Road Initiative. But additional factors must also be taken into
consideration when analyzing such a powerful actor, with
a limited track-record in dealing with (lesser) mercantile
partners.

Conceptualizing China’s advance in the region is no easy
task, given the ambiguous nature of its geoeconomic stance
– often blurred by rhetoric – and the less-than-transparent
nature of its Balkan counterparts. Clear (and honest) strategic
positions are lacking, while sets of data relating to trade and
FDI are often inconsistent. Nonetheless, specific patterns
can be discerned throughout the entire region, by applying
a multi-layered methodology which makes proper use of
China’s present global practice, independent (third-party)
economic information to complement that offered by national
institutions and a political understanding of the existing
dynamics between Balkan states and their other large partners
such as the European Union or Russia.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨中国在巴尔干地区崛起的原因，通过多层次方法分析经济数据和政治动态，揭示中国在该地区的地缘经济战略。
AI.research_question: 是什么因素解释了中国在巴尔干地区看似不可能但实际发生的崛起？
AI.motivation: 中国在巴尔干地区的存在既非基于历史宗教联系，也非地理邻近或价值观共同体，需要深入理解其崛起背后的真正驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘经济学、国际关系理论、多层级分析方法
AI.method: 采用多层次方法论，结合中国全球实践、第三方经济数据和国家机构信息，以及巴尔干国家与其他大国（如欧盟、俄罗斯）政治动态分析
AI.findings: 识别出特定模式，表明中国的巴尔干战略超越单纯经济驱动，包含更深层次的地缘政治考量
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分析中国在巴尔干地区地缘经济战略的多层次框架，丰富了地缘经济学理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供理解中国巴尔干战略的实用分析工具，有助于制定相应应对策略

title: Judicial Power and the Fragile Balance of Democracy: A Critical Response to Scott Erik Stafne
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Judicial Power and the Fragile Balance of Democracy: A Critical Response to Scott Erik Stafne

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper offers a critical academic response to Scott Erik Stafne’s thought- provoking essay Who Should We Trust Least: The President, The Congress, or The Courts? Stafne raises essential questions about the institutional balance of power in the United States and the implications for liberty. While acknowledging the risks inherent in all three branches, this response argues that the judiciary poses the gravest threat when impartiality is compromised. Courts, unlike presidents or legislators, have the power to reshape the meaning of law itself, and history demonstrates how they have legitimized injustice—from slavery to the protection of corporate power. Congress, subordinated to lobbying and financial interests, often functions as a legislative oligarchy, while the presidency, though potentially prone to unilateralism, remains the most visible and electorally accountable branch. If all three are compromised, protection of freedoms must be sought in civil society and cross-border solidarity. By drawing comparative insights from global cases such as Libya, Iraq, Iran, and Sudan, the paper situates Stafne’s questions in a wider civilizational context, showing that the struggle to safeguard democracy and justice transcends national borders

AI.tldr: 本文批判性回应Stafne关于美国三权分立中哪个分支最不可信的论述，认为当司法公正受损时，司法机关构成最大威胁，因其具有重塑法律含义的权力。国会受制于游说利益成为立法寡头，总统虽可能倾向单边主义但选举问责性最强。若三权均受损，自由保护需依靠公民社会和跨国团结。
AI.research_question: 在美国三权分立体系中，哪个政府分支对自由构成最大威胁？当所有分支都不可信时，如何保护自由？
AI.motivation: 回应Stafne关于美国制度权力平衡的论述，探讨三权分立体制下的制度风险和对自由的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 三权分立理论、制度平衡理论、司法权力理论、民主问责理论
AI.method: 批判性分析、历史案例分析（奴隶制、企业权力保护）、比较研究（利比亚、伊拉克、伊朗、苏丹等全球案例）
AI.findings:
1. 司法机关在公正性受损时威胁最大，因其能重塑法律含义
2. 国会受游说和金融利益控制，成为立法寡头
3. 总统虽可能单边主义但选举问责性最强
4. 三权均不可信时需依靠公民社会和跨国团结保护自由
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了三权分立理论的风险分析框架，提出了司法权力滥用的特殊危险性，建立了跨国比较的制度分析视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为民主制度保护提供实践路径：强调公民社会作用和跨国团结的重要性，为制度设计者和公民行动提供参考

title: Economic Forecast Disagreement and Equity Pricing: International Evidence
affiliations: University of Trier, University of Trier, University of Trier - Faculty of Economics and University of Innsbruck - Department of Banking and Finance

detail.title: Economic Forecast Disagreement and Equity Pricing: International Evidence

declarations.funderStatement: The authors gratefully acknowledge financial support from the German Research Foundation (DFG, grant no. 5086102031).

detail.abstract: Economic expectations play a central role in financial markets, yet investors often disagree about the economy’s future. This disagreement has long been viewed as a potential driver of asset prices, but it remains unclear whether it reflects mispricing or a priced source of risk. We address this question by constructing monthly disagreement indices from Consensus Economics forecasts from 24 OECD markets. Firm-level exposure to economic disagreement is estimated through return regressions. Results reveal pronounced cross-country heterogeneity. In developed markets, particularly the United States, greater exposure to disagreement consistently predicts lower future returns, supporting the mispricing hypothesis. Smaller markets exhibit mixed patterns, with some evidence of positive risk premia, while other cases show no significant effect. These findings provide new international evidence that the pricing of forecast disagreement is context-dependent, shaped by market structure and institutional depth.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建24个OECD市场的经济预期分歧指数，发现发达国家市场（特别是美国）中经济分歧暴露度高的股票未来回报较低，支持错误定价假说；而较小市场则呈现混合模式，表明预期分歧的定价效应具有情境依赖性。
AI.research_question: 经济预期分歧对资产价格的影响是反映了错误定价还是风险溢价？
AI.motivation: 经济预期在金融市场中起核心作用，但投资者对经济未来存在分歧，这种分歧长期以来被视为资产价格的潜在驱动因素，但其本质（错误定价还是风险溢价）尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产定价理论，探讨经济预期分歧作为错误定价来源或风险因素的理论机制。
AI.method: 使用Consensus Economics预测数据构建月度分歧指数，覆盖24个OECD市场；通过收益回归估计公司层面的经济分歧暴露度。
AI.findings: 发现显著的跨国异质性：发达国家市场（特别是美国）中，较高的分歧暴露度持续预测较低的未来回报，支持错误定价假说；较小市场呈现混合模式，部分显示正风险溢价，部分无显著效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了预期分歧定价情境依赖性的新国际证据，表明市场结构和制度深度塑造了分歧的定价效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者在不同市场环境下理解和利用经济预期分歧提供了实践指导，特别是在发达市场与较小市场的差异化投资策略。

title: Charitable Deposits Stimulating Finance-Led Growth for Sustainable International Charity
affiliations: University of Gothenburg

detail.title: Charitable Deposits Stimulating Finance-Led Growth for Sustainable International Charity
detail.abstract:
Background: Loans to the private sector are an effective way of spurring economic growth in developing countries, but there is disagreement over the causes of loans. In particular, the literature is split on whether deposits with financial institutions cause them to issue loans.
Method and Data: We run a fixed-effects regression and an Arellano-Bond model on five years of panelled balance sheet data of 420 Kenyan financial institutions to estimate the effect of deposits on loans. Particular attention is paid to avoiding endogeneity from reverse causality.
Findings: We find that deposits with financial institutions do increase the loans they issue, but that the size of the effect depends on their type. In SACCOs, a shilling increase in deposits causes a loan of at least 95 cents, whereas in commercial banks it increases loans by 54 cents at most.
Conclusion and Policy Relevance: Depositing money with SACCOs effectively increases the loans they issue to the Kenyan private sector. Loans' positive effects on economic growth and poverty reduction make this finding relevant to policy makers and the humanitarian community. We quantify these effects and estimate that an amount deposited with a typical SACCO for 20 years contributes more than 34 times as much to economic output, and lifts at least 21% more people out of poverty than the same amount spent on ODA.

AI.tldr: 研究发现肯尼亚金融机构存款确实会增加贷款发放，但效应大小因机构类型而异。SACCOs的存款增加几乎1:1转化为贷款，而商业银行的转化率仅为54%。SACCOs在促进经济增长和减贫方面效果显著。
AI.research_question: 金融机构的存款是否会导致贷款发放？不同类型金融机构的存款对贷款的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 私人部门贷款是促进发展中国家经济增长的有效方式，但关于贷款成因存在分歧，特别是存款是否会导致贷款发放的问题在文献中存在争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融中介理论和信贷创造理论，探讨存款与贷款之间的因果关系，特别关注反向因果导致的内生性问题。
AI.method: 使用固定效应回归和Arellano-Bond模型，分析肯尼亚420家金融机构5年的面板资产负债表数据，特别注意避免反向因果导致的内生性问题。
AI.findings: 存款确实增加贷款发放，但效应因机构类型而异：SACCOs中1先令存款增加导致至少95分贷款，商业银行中最多增加54分贷款。SACCOs在促进经济增长和减贫方面效果显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了存款与贷款之间的因果关系，解决了文献中的分歧；揭示了不同类型金融机构在信贷创造效率上的差异；为金融中介理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据：支持SACCOs发展可更有效促进私人部门信贷；量化了SACCOs相比官方发展援助在经济增长和减贫方面的显著优势（20年贡献经济产出34倍以上，多减贫21%）。

title: The economy of time

detail.title: The economy of time

declarations.ethicsApproval: This pilot study was conducted with a sample of 10 adult participants, who voluntarily completed daily self-assessments in their natural environment. All participants were informed about the objectives of the research and signed written informed consent prior to their inclusion. Confidentiality, anonymity, and the exclusive use of the data for academic and scientific purposes were guaranteed at all times. As the study did not involve medical interventions or pose any risks to participants, and consisted solely of questionnaires and self-reports of subjective experiences, no additional approval from an institutional ethics committee was required, in accordance with current regulations for non-clinical research.

detail.abstract: In a historical context where mindfulness and meaningful time management emerge as truly scarce resources (Davenport & Beck, 2001), we propose a new integrative perspective: The Economy of Time. This study explores how the perception of temporal value and the intention to change one's life dynamically relate to psychological, neurocognitive, and behavioral variables. Based on a pilot sample of ten participants, we applied a mixed-methodological approach that combines advanced statistical analyses-multiple linear regression, binary logistic regression, principal component analysis (PCA), clustering (K-Means), random forest, and t-tests-with a philosophical and phenomenological interpretation of lived time (Heidegger, 1927; Metzinger, 2009). The results show that variables such as daily attention fragmentation, psychological well-being (Ryff, 1989), and sleep quality (Walker, 2017) have a significant impact on the perceived value of time. This value, in turn, accurately predicts the conscious intention to change. The logit model revealed that perceived values above a critical threshold (6.6) are associated with a greater likelihood of intention to change, while the principal components analysis confirmed that more than 92% of the total variance can be explained by a single latent factor, conceptualized here as integrated temporal awareness. Cluster analysis identified three distinct temporal profiles: fragmented time, time in transition, and integrated time, providing empirical evidence that the subjective relationship with time is not homogeneous but rather modelable. We propose the theoretical formula: Real Value = Time × Awareness as the conceptual core of a new personal and social economy, where well-being and quality of life depend not so much on the objective amount of time available, but on how each moment is consciously and emotionally inhabited.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了"时间经济"新视角，通过混合方法研究了时间价值感知与生活改变意向的关系，发现关键因素是整合性时间意识而非对象时间数量。
AI.research_question: 时间价值感知与生活改变意向如何动态相关？心理、神经认知和行为变量在这一关系中起何作用？
AI.motivation: 在正念和有意义时间管理成为稀缺资源的历史背景下，需要提出新的整合性视角来理解时间价值的主观感知和其对个体变革的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现象学和哲学观点（Heidegger、Metzinger）与心理学理论（Ryff的心理健康理论、Walker的睡眠质量研究）相结合，构建了时间经济的理论框架。
AI.method: 混合方法设计：采用10名参与者的小规模样本，结合多重线性回归、二元Logistic回归、主成分分析、K-Means聚类、随机森林和t检验等统计分析方法与哲学现象学解释。
AI.findings:
1）每日注意力分散、心理健康和睡眠质量对时间价值感知有显著影响
2）时间价值感知能够准确预测改变意向
3）Logit模型显示价值感知超过6.6阈值时改变概率增加
4）PCA分析确认92%方差可由单一潜在因子解释，即整合性时间意识
5）聚类分析识别三种时间模式：分散时间、过渡时间、整合时间
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"时间经济"新理论框架，形成了理论公式：真实价值 = 时间 × 意识，为理解主观时间体验提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人和社会提供了新的时间管理视角，明确了幸福感和生活质量主要取决于时间的主观体验质量而非对象数量，为实践应用提供了指导。

title: Scaling of Small-Area Fair Market Rents: Evidence on Neighborhood Choices of Voucher Recipients
affiliations: Purdue University - Department of Economics, University of Cincinnati and

detail.title: Scaling of Small-Area Fair Market Rents: Evidence on Neighborhood Choices of Voucher Recipients
detail.abstract: We examine the scaling of Small Area Fair Market Rents (SAFMRs) of Housing Choice Voucher (HCV) program in 2018. First used in the 2011 Dallas pilot, SAFMRs set the maximum voucher subsidy at the ZIP Codes level instead of previous metropolitan level to deconcentrate clustering in high-poverty areas. Using 2015-2019 administrative data from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), we find that SAFMRs led voucher recipients to relocate to lower-poverty neighborhoods; however, relative to the Dallas pilot, effects attenuate by more than half. This "voltage drop" appears driven by differences in baseline rental market conditions and racial segregation across metropolitan areas, generating substantial heterogeneity in policy effectiveness. Moreover, White households benefited about three times more than Black households, highlighting how race-neutral payment-standard reforms can yield unintentional consequences without complementary supports. These results underscore the importance of accounting for implementation environments when scaling housing policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2018年小区域公平市场租金(SAFMRs)政策在住房选择券(HCV)项目中的推广效果。研究发现SAFMRs确实帮助券持有者搬迁到贫困程度较低的地区，但相比达拉斯试点效果减弱一半以上，且白人家庭受益是黑人家庭的三倍，揭示了种族中立政策可能产生意外后果。
AI.research_question: 小区域公平市场租金(SAFMRs)政策在全国范围内推广时，其效果如何？是否存在效果衰减和种族差异？
AI.motivation: 理解住房政策在从试点推广到全国实施过程中的效果变化，以及政策在不同市场环境和种族群体中的异质性影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房政策评估理论、空间错配理论、种族隔离理论
AI.method: 使用2015-2019年美国住房和城市发展部(HUD)的行政数据，对比分析SAFMRs政策推广前后的效果
AI.findings: 1) SAFMRs促使券持有者搬迁到贫困程度较低的地区；2) 相比达拉斯试点，全国推广效果衰减一半以上；3) 白人家庭受益是黑人家庭的三倍；4) 效果差异由基准租赁市场条件和种族隔离程度驱动
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政策推广中的"电压下降"现象，强调了实施环境对政策效果的重要影响，提出了种族中立政策可能产生意外后果的理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为住房政策制定者提供了重要启示：政策推广需要考虑地方市场条件和种族隔离程度，需要配套支持措施来确保政策公平性

title: Sustainable Uncertainty: Crafting an ESG Index from Media Signals
affiliations: EPFL

detail.title: Sustainable Uncertainty: Crafting an ESG Index from Media Signals
detail.abstract: We construct two complementary high frequency measures of ESG-related uncertainty from 10 000 English language news articles (January 2024-April 2025, 30 global outlets). The first index, ESGUS, leverages gpt-3.5-turbo to rate each article's direction, likelihood, and market importance; the second index, ESGUI, follows the classic keyword count methodology of Baker et al. (2016). An event study centered on 16 exogenous policy, trade, and security shocks shows that, within a window of ±1 week, ESGUS increases by 22 points and ESGUI by 13 points (Welch t = 3.33 and 2.45, respectively). We observe ESGUS typically leads ESGUI during rumour phases, suggesting that large language model scoring is able to capture anticipated risk before a surge in headline volumes. The biggest joint spikes occur when regulatory, trade, and geopolitical channels converge, as in the February-April 2025 tariff escalation and Taiwan drills. Together, the indices provide a reliable barometer of ESG related risk, enabling it to be used as a tool for studying sustainability related threats.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了两个高频ESG不确定性指数（ESGUS和ESGUI），通过事件研究发现LLM评分能比传统关键词方法更早捕捉预期风险，为ESG风险管理提供了可靠工具
AI.research_question: 如何有效测量ESG相关不确定性？大型语言模型与传统关键词方法在捕捉ESG风险方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: ESG不确定性对市场和企业决策具有重要影响，但现有测量方法存在局限性，需要更精准的高频指标
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Baker et al.(2016)的经济政策不确定性指数理论框架，结合自然语言处理和事件研究方法
AI.method: 使用GPT-3.5-turbo分析10,000篇英文新闻文章构建ESGUS指数，同时采用传统关键词计数方法构建ESGUI指数，并进行事件研究分析
AI.findings: 在±1周事件窗口内，ESGUS指数上升22点，ESGUI指数上升13点；ESGUS在谣言阶段领先ESGUI，表明LLM能更早捕捉预期风险；监管、贸易和地缘政治事件共同作用时产生最大波动
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于LLM的ESG不确定性测量新方法，扩展了不确定性指数的理论框架，验证了AI在风险预测中的优势
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、企业和政策制定者提供了可靠的ESG风险监测工具，有助于及时应对可持续发展相关威胁

title: Diving into Recession: The Collective Knowledge of Online Users as an Early Warning System for Recessionary Expectations
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Zayed University, Zayed University and Zayed University

detail.title: Diving into Recession: The Collective Knowledge of Online Users as an Early Warning System for Recessionary Expectations
detail.abstract: This paper examines the nexus between social media and recessionary expectations. As concerns about economic downturns manifest in online discussions, we investigate whether sentiment extracted from social media can serve as an early warning signal for recessionary pressures. Using a dataset of Twitter (X) posts related to economic prospects, we apply a range of sentiment analysis techniques, including lexicon-based (VADER) and deep learning approaches (GPT and BERT). We assess the relationship between online sentiment and key recession indicators, such as the yield curve and GDPNow forecasts, using a combination of econometric and machine learning methods. In addition, we perform a comparative evaluation of sentiment classification techniques, incorporating both traditional models and deep learning architectures. Our results confirm that Twitter discussions precede changes in recessionary indicators and can thus provide forward-looking insights into economic sentiment. Furthermore, the comparative analysis reveals variations in sentiment detection across different methodologies, emphasizing the importance of selecting appropriate approaches in economic forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析Twitter上关于经济前景的讨论，发现社交媒体情绪可以作为经济衰退的早期预警信号，且深度学习模型在情绪检测方面表现优于传统方法。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体情绪是否能作为经济衰退预期的早期预警信号？
AI.motivation: 经济衰退担忧在在线讨论中的表现，以及利用社交媒体数据进行经济预测的潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于情绪分析理论和经济预测理论，结合社交媒体数据分析框架。
AI.method: 使用Twitter数据，应用词典法（VADER）和深度学习方法（GPT和BERT）进行情绪分析，结合计量经济学和机器学习方法评估与衰退指标的关系。
AI.findings: Twitter讨论领先于衰退指标变化，能提供前瞻性的经济情绪洞察；不同情绪分类方法存在差异，深度学习模型表现更优。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了社交媒体数据在经济预测中的应用理论，验证了在线情绪作为经济预警信号的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供了基于社交媒体情绪的实时经济监测工具，改进了经济预测方法。

title: Social Exclusion of Women in India
affiliations: Srinivas University and Srinivas University

detail.title: Social Exclusion of Women in India
detail.abstract: Even though the constitution guarantees equality and there are many legal protections in place, social exclusion is still a widespread and deeply established problem for women in India. This article critically analyses the diverse aspects of social exclusion experienced by Indian women in economic, educational, political, and cultural contexts. Utilising sociological and empirical data, it examines the intersection of caste, class, religion, and regional differences with patriarchal norms to exclude women from predominant social, economic, and political systems. The research also looks at how governmental policies, social institutions, and grassroots movements can either make exclusion worse or better. Even while there has been a lot of progress in areas like education and political representation, systemic impediments still make it hard for everyone to succeed. The article ends by suggesting policy changes and structural changes that will help women in Indian society achieve gender justice, empowerment, and full inclusion.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了印度女性在经济、教育、政治和文化等多方面的社会排斥问题，探讨了种姓、阶级、宗教和地区差异与父权规范的交叉作用，并提出了促进性别公正和全面包容的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 印度女性在社会各领域面临的社会排斥问题及其根源是什么？如何通过政策和社会变革促进女性的全面包容和赋权？
AI.motivation: 尽管宪法保障平等且有众多法律保护，但社会排斥仍是印度女性面临的普遍而根深蒂固的问题，需要深入分析其多方面表现和系统性障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用社会学理论框架，结合交叉性理论（intersectionality），分析种姓、阶级、宗教、地区差异与父权规范的相互作用如何导致女性的社会排斥。
AI.method: 运用社会学和实证数据分析方法，综合考察经济、教育、政治和文化等多个维度的排斥现象。
AI.findings: 研究发现系统性障碍仍然阻碍女性全面发展，尽管在教育政治代表等领域取得进展，但种姓、阶级、宗教等交叉因素与父权规范共同作用，将女性排除在主流社会经济政治体系之外。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了交叉性理论在印度社会背景下的应用，深化了对多重身份因素如何交织影响女性社会排斥的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的政策改革和结构性变革建议，为促进印度社会中的性别公正、女性赋权和全面包容提供了实践指导。

title: When Does Quantitative Easing Work? Threshold Effects, Market Distortions, and International Transmission
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: When Does Quantitative Easing Work? Threshold Effects, Market Distortions, and International Transmission
detail.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive econometric framework for analyzing the investment response to quantitative easing (QE) policies through three key hypotheses. Using advanced threshold regression models, local projections, and international spillover analysis, we examine QE effects from 2008-2023. Our findings reveal significant threshold effects in central bank reaction functions, with confidence effects playing a crucial moderating role. We document that intensive QE reduces long-term private investment when market distortions dominate interest rate channels, and identify substantial international spillover effects through foreign bond demand and currency depreciation mechanisms. The analysis employs enhanced Hansen threshold regression with bootstrap confidence intervals, local projections for impulse response analysis, and comprehensive robustness testing. Results indicate that QE effectiveness depends critically on debt sustainability thresholds, market distortion levels, and international transmission channels, with implications for safeguarding central bank independence, enhancing financial stability through coordinated fiscal reforms, and mitigating cross-border risks to support resilient global markets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过阈值回归模型、本地投影和国际溢出分析，发现量化宽松政策对私人投资存在显著阈值效应，过度QE会减少长期投资，并产生重大国际溢出效应，政策效果取决于债务可持续性阈值和市场扭曲程度。
AI.research_question: 量化宽松政策如何通过阈值效应、信心效应和国际溢出渠道影响私人投资？
AI.motivation: 量化宽松政策在全球金融危机后广泛实施，但其对私人投资的影响机制和效果存在争议，需要系统分析其非线性效应和跨国传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阈值回归理论、中央行反应函数理论、国际资本流动理论、市场扭曲理论
AI.method: 增强型Hansen阈值回归模型（含bootstrap置信区间）、本地投影法进行脉冲响应分析、国际溢出效应分析、全面的稳健性检验
AI.findings: 发现中央行反应函数中存在显著阈值效应，信心效应起关键调节作用；过度量化宽松在市场扭曲主导利率渠道时会减少长期私人投资；通过外国债券需求和货币贬值机制产生重大国际溢出效应
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了量化宽松政策的综合计量分析框架，揭示了阈值效应和信心效应的调节作用，完善了国际溢出效应的理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为保护中央行独立性提供依据，通过协调财政改革增强金融稳定性，缓解跨境风险以支持弹性全球市场

title: Statistical Decisioning Tools for Model Risk Management

detail.title: Statistical Decisioning Tools for Model Risk Management

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: None to declare.

detail.abstract: Model assessment represents a core aspect of bank supervision that enhances risk management in financial institutions. Key objectives of assessing models include an understanding of their benefits and limitations, both of which are important to maintaining adequate model risk management standards. Models applied in risk management are typically subjected to robust due diligence processes. Model users leverage standard measures of statistical goodness-of-fit to evaluate models, but selecting (and subsequently validating) a model may not be straightforward if, for example, the differences in comparative metrics are marginal as this can amplify uncertainty in a model choice. Furthermore, there may exist other nuances in a model that standard evaluation metrics may not capture. This paper discusses a framework grounded in statistical decision theory to assess model adequacy through utility functions, offering an additional approach to supplement common model assessment criteria. We rely on a decision-theoretic architecture (see chapter 7 of Optimal Statistical Decisions by M. DeGroot, 1970) and argue how model evaluation strategies can be accomplished through utility optimization. An empirical exercise illustrating these themes concludes the paper by analyzing 2015 public Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) data sets collated across nine banks using three different statistical models to assess risk through signals of potential disparate impact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于统计决策理论的模型评估框架，通过效用函数补充传统模型评估标准，为银行监管中的模型风险管理提供新方法。
AI.research_question: 如何通过统计决策理论和效用函数来评估银行风险管理模型的充分性？
AI.motivation: 传统统计拟合优度指标在模型选择中存在局限性，特别是当指标差异微小时会放大模型选择的不确定性，且可能无法捕捉模型的其他细微差别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计决策理论（基于DeGroot的《最优统计决策》第7章），效用函数优化框架
AI.method: 采用决策理论架构，通过效用优化进行模型评估策略，并使用2015年HMDA公开数据集对9家银行的三种统计模型进行实证分析
AI.findings: 提出了基于效用函数的模型评估补充方法，能够更好地识别模型在风险管理和潜在差异影响信号方面的表现
AI.theory_contributions: 将统计决策理论和效用函数引入银行模型评估领域，为模型充分性评估提供了新的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行监管机构和金融机构提供了更全面的模型评估工具，有助于提升模型风险管理的有效性，特别是在识别潜在差异影响方面

title: Market Visualizations
affiliations: University of California, Santa Cruz - Department of Economics, University of New South Wales and University of California, Santa Cruz - Department of Economics

detail.title: Market Visualizations
detail.abstract: In a k-replica Edgeworth box economy, we compare outcomes of laboratory markets in which human traders have different visualizations available on their screens. Novel visualizations include a heat map that shows at a glance the value of all feasible portfolios (i.e., final allocations); a geometric display of the order book; and order entry via point-and-click on the heat map. Efficiency metrics focus on allocations, prices and profitability. Compared to the traditional text-oriented trader screen for the continuous double auction, we find that the novel features generally increase all three efficiency metrics.

AI.tldr: 在k副本Edgeworth盒经济中，比较了不同可视化界面下实验室市场的表现。新型可视化功能包括投资组合价值热力图、订单簿几何显示和点击热力图下单功能。与传统文本界面相比，新型可视化显著提高了分配效率、价格效率和盈利能力。
AI.research_question: 不同可视化界面如何影响实验室市场中交易者的表现和效率？
AI.motivation: 研究交易界面可视化对市场效率的影响，探索新型可视化工具是否能改善交易决策和市场表现
AI.theoretical_framework: Edgeworth盒经济理论、市场效率理论、信息可视化理论
AI.method: 实验室实验方法，在k副本Edgeworth盒经济中比较传统文本界面与新型可视化界面的市场表现
AI.findings: 新型可视化功能（热力图、几何订单簿显示、点击下单）相比传统文本界面显著提高了分配效率、价格效率和交易者盈利能力
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了信息可视化在市场微观结构中的作用理论，为界面设计对市场效率影响提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融市场交易界面设计提供了实践指导，证明了可视化工具在改善交易决策和市场效率方面的重要价值

title: The Moving Puzzle: Trump, Trade Tariffs and the Windsor Framework
affiliations: University of Newcastle - Law School and Newcastle University - Newcastle Law School

detail.title: The Moving Puzzle: Trump, Trade Tariffs and the Windsor Framework

publicationDetails.detailsText: Institute of International and European Affairs, 2025

detail.abstract: The Spring of 2025 has brought with it a huge amount of upheaval in international trade with the Trump administration's tariff proposals in the United States (US) triggering a round of responses and negotiations and coinciding with efforts between the United Kingdom (UK) and the European Union (EU) to reset relations after Brexit. This has led to a flurry of trade announcements. These can be a challenge to track, especially in terms of their impact on goods trade involving the island of Ireland, given the special post-Brexit rules which apply to Northern Ireland. These rules mean that, as well as the primary impacts of tariffs on trade, there will possibly be secondary impacts as trade patterns adjust to make the best of the circumstances. All of this can leave policy makers and businesses feeling like they are trapped in an ever-shifting puzzle, one that is often being shaped by other actors. In this paper we explore these changes and the challenges and opportunities they present. We explain the extent to which the Windsor Framework operates to differentiate businesses located in Northern Ireland from those in other parts of the UK or Ireland.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2025年春季国际贸易动荡对爱尔兰岛货物贸易的影响，特别是特朗普关税政策和英国脱欧后贸易规则变化带来的挑战与机遇，重点探讨了温莎框架如何区分北爱尔兰企业与其他地区企业的差异。
AI.research_question: 国际贸易政策变化（特别是特朗普关税政策和英国脱欧后安排）对爱尔兰岛货物贸易的影响是什么？温莎框架如何区分北爱尔兰企业与其他英国或爱尔兰地区企业的地位？
AI.motivation: 2025年春季国际贸易环境出现重大动荡，特朗普政府的关税政策引发了一系列反应和谈判，同时英国与欧盟在脱欧后重新调整关系，这些变化给政策制定者和企业带来了巨大挑战，特别是在涉及爱尔兰岛货物贸易方面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易理论、关税政策影响理论、区域经济一体化理论、制度差异化理论
AI.method: 政策分析法和案例研究法，通过分析温莎框架的具体条款和实际应用情况来评估其差异化效果
AI.findings: 温莎框架确实在北爱尔兰企业与其他英国或爱尔兰地区企业之间建立了制度性差异，这种差异不仅体现在关税待遇上，还会引发贸易模式的二次调整，为企业带来新的挑战和机遇
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了制度差异化对贸易模式影响的理论理解，为后脱欧时代特殊贸易安排的研究提供了新的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对国际贸易动荡的参考依据，帮助企业更好地理解温莎框架下的商业环境变化并制定相应策略

title: Identification of Daily Travel Mode Preferences under Random Attention Allocation: Evidence from a Lab Experiment and Paris
affiliations: Université Paris Cité and

detail.title: Identification of Daily Travel Mode Preferences under Random Attention Allocation: Evidence from a Lab Experiment and Paris

declarations.funderStatement: The laboratory experiment was funded by the “Centre de Recherche en Economie et Management” (CREM) of the University of Rennes.

detail.abstract: Limited and random attention allocation has become an important factor to consider in preference revelation analysis. The Random Attention Model (RAM) relaxes the restrictions of known, accurate attribute information and observable consideration sets, offering potential applications in transportation economics. In this paper, we apply RAM to the transportation setting and provide evidence of internal and external validity. For internal validity, in a lab experiment, we find that the RAM enables us to statistically accept participants' self-reported preferences and reject "irrational" preferences. The most chosen preference ordering can be explained by the revealed attention intensity at the aggregate level. For external validity, we use GPStraced daily travel data from 3,319 Greater Paris residents, including mode choice and personal information. We find attention complementary and substitutionary effects across different modes. Private cars receive the most attention, followed by walking, public transportation, private motorbikes, and private bikes. Attention variability is lowest for private cars and walking, while private motorbikes exhibit the highest attention variability. Finally, we find empirically that individuals differ in their most preferred travel modes but show consistency in their least preferred modes.

AI.tldr: 本研究将随机注意力模型（RAM）应用于交通经济学，通过实验室实验和真实GPS数据验证了模型的内外部有效性，发现私人汽车获得最多注意力，不同交通方式间存在注意力互补和替代效应。
AI.research_question: 随机注意力模型（RAM）在交通选择情境中的内外部有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 有限且随机的注意力分配已成为偏好揭示分析中的重要因素，RAM模型放松了已知准确属性信息和可观察考虑集的限制，在交通经济学中具有应用潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机注意力模型（RAM）理论框架
AI.method: 结合实验室实验（内部有效性验证）和GPS追踪的日常出行数据分析（外部有效性验证），样本包括3,319名大巴黎居民
AI.findings: 1）RAM能够统计接受参与者自我报告的偏好并拒绝"非理性"偏好；2）私人汽车获得最多注意力，其次是步行、公共交通、私人摩托车和私人自行车；3）不同交通方式间存在注意力互补和替代效应；4）私人汽车和步行的注意力变异性最低，私人摩托车的注意力变异性最高；5）个体在最偏好的出行方式上存在差异，但在最不偏好的方式上表现一致
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了RAM模型在交通经济学领域的理论应用，验证了该模型在交通选择情境中的有效性
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通政策制定和出行行为预测提供了新的分析工具和实证依据，有助于理解人们在复杂交通选择中的注意力分配模式

detail.abstract: Food-chain waste can be reduced through analytics embedded in end-to-end chains. The application of Supply-chain analytics will help reduce spoilage and optimize the distribution of food to factories and stores. The implementation of analytics in a connected system through digital platforms, framework or processes to derive intelligent insights has the inherent ability to improve the supply chain visibility. Evaluate the flexibility of supply chain topology to enable decision-making involved through supply chain activities. Optimizing food supply chains will help us analyze unique challenges which will help us discover ways to improve customer interactions, add value and build relationships that last. The customer and supply chain processes for a true omnichannel view of the business and an efficient supply chain network.

AI.tldr: 通过供应链分析技术嵌入端到端食品链，减少食物浪费，优化食品分销，提高供应链可见性，并构建高效的供应链网络。

title: University Graduate Recruitment and Selection as A Part of Business Strategy: A Case of an Emerging Market
affiliations: University Kadri Zeka Gjilan and

detail.title: University Graduate Recruitment and Selection as A Part of Business Strategy: A Case of an Emerging Market
detail.abstract: Kosovo businesses are mostly small and medium-sized in structure and have a very large weight in terms of the employment of university graduates in the country. In this regard, the main purpose of this study is to present the challenges which businesses in Kosovo are confronted with during the process of recruitment and selection of university graduates. The study uses mainly primary data, which were collected through an online questionnaire in a purposive sample of businesses operating in Kosovo. The questionnaire includes structured questions mainly with alternative and dichotomous questions, as well as an open question. This study uses the Pearson correlation and t-test for hypothesis testing, while the results are generally presented through tables and graphs using Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) software. This study comes to the conclusion that the biggest challenge faced by Kosovo businesses in the process of recruiting and selecting university graduates is the lack of practical work on the part of graduates, as well as analysis of job requirements and the attraction of candidates with the right skills. The study also finds that business in the case of Kosovo considers that the skills needed from a graduate in order to get employed are the ability to work in a team, flexibility, public speaking, etc.

AI.tldr: 科索沃企业在招聘大学毕业生时面临的主要挑战是毕业生缺乏实践经验、岗位需求分析不足以及吸引合适技能人才困难，企业最看重的毕业生技能是团队合作能力、灵活性和公开演讲等。
AI.research_question: 科索沃企业在招聘和选拔大学毕业生过程中面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 科索沃企业大多为中小型结构，在吸纳大学毕业生就业方面具有重要地位，需要了解其在招聘过程中遇到的困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资源管理理论，特别是招聘选拔理论和技能匹配理论
AI.method: 采用主要数据收集方法，通过在线问卷对科索沃运营企业进行有目的抽样调查，问卷包含结构化问题（选择题和二分类问题）以及开放性问题，使用Pearson相关分析和t检验进行假设检验，通过SPSS软件以表格和图表形式呈现结果
AI.findings: 科索沃企业在招聘大学毕业生过程中面临的最大挑战是毕业生缺乏实践经验、岗位需求分析不足以及吸引具备合适技能的候选人困难；企业认为毕业生就业所需的关键技能包括团队合作能力、灵活性、公开演讲等
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家中小企业招聘实践的理论理解，为技能匹配理论在转型经济体的应用提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃高校改进课程设置和培养学生实践能力提供参考，帮助企业优化招聘策略，为政策制定者提供改善毕业生就业环境的依据

title: Exploring the Role of Deep Learning Models in Enhancing Suspicious Transaction Detection and Prediction in Anti-Money Laundering
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Exploring the Role of Deep Learning Models in Enhancing Suspicious Transaction Detection and Prediction in Anti-Money Laundering
detail.abstract: This study explores the role of deep learning models in enhancing the detection and prediction of suspicious transactions for anti-money laundering (AML) efforts. As financial crimes become increasingly sophisticated, traditional AML systems, based on rule-based algorithms, struggle to effectively identify complex patterns of money laundering. The purpose of this research is to evaluate how deep learning models, particularly recurrent neural networks (RNNs), autoencoders, and graph-based networks, can improve the detection accuracy and predictive capabilities of AML systems. The study utilizes a data-driven approach, employing several deep learning techniques to analyze large-scale transaction data. The methodology involves training models on historical transaction data, identifying patterns of suspicious activity, and evaluating model performance in comparison to traditional rule-based systems. Both supervised and unsupervised learning methods are tested, with a particular focus on the ability of models to detect anomalies and predict future fraudulent behavior. Key findings suggest that deep learning models significantly outperform traditional systems in detecting complex patterns in transaction data, offering greater accuracy and a reduced false-positive rate. The study also highlights the potential for predictive modeling, where models can flag suspicious transactions in real time, thereby allowing financial institutions to take preventive actions before illegal activities are completed. In conclusion, deep learning models have the potential to revolutionize AML practices by providing more accurate, scalable, and adaptive systems for detecting and preventing money laundering activities. These findings point to a future where AML efforts are more data-driven, efficient, and proactive, improving both financial security and compliance efforts globally.

AI.tldr: 深度学习模型在反洗钱可疑交易检测中显著优于传统规则系统，RNN、自编码器和图神经网络能提高检测准确率并降低误报，实现实时预测和预防。
AI.research_question: 深度学习模型如何提升反洗钱系统中可疑交易的检测准确率和预测能力？
AI.motivation: 传统基于规则的反洗钱系统难以有效识别日益复杂的洗钱模式，需要更先进的技术来应对金融犯罪的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习理论，特别是循环神经网络、自编码器和图神经网络在异常检测和时间序列预测中的应用框架。
AI.method: 采用数据驱动方法，使用监督和无监督学习技术分析大规模交易数据，训练模型识别可疑活动模式并与传统系统进行性能比较。
AI.findings: 深度学习模型在检测复杂交易模式方面显著优于传统系统，准确率更高，误报率更低，并具备实时预测可疑交易的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了深度学习在金融犯罪检测领域的理论应用，证明了神经网络在处理复杂时序数据和异常检测方面的优越性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了更准确、可扩展和自适应的反洗钱解决方案，能够实现实时监控和预防性干预，提升全球金融安全和合规效率。

title: Impact of Relaxing the Downpayment Constraint on Mortgage and Housing Markets

detail.title: Impact of Relaxing the Downpayment Constraint on Mortgage and Housing Markets
detail.abstract: This paper studies the effects of relaxing downpayment constraint on mortgage originations and house prices, using geographical variation in eligibility conditions for a low-downpayment program introduced by GSEs in the United States. Using a regression discontinuity design, I show that easing down payment requirements increased the origination of high loan-to-value (LTV) mortgages, with effects concentrated among first-time buyers, young, and low-income borrowers. The effect on high-LTV originations exhibits an inverse U-shaped relationship with housing affordability, being strongest in moderately priced housing markets and weaker in both low-cost and high-cost markets. As high LTV mortgage originations expand, house prices rise, though the effect is muted in markets with high owner-rental integration, where additional demand from first-time buyers is easily offset by reduced investor demand facing lower rental returns. These findings highlight how borrower characteristics, housing affordability, and ownedrental housing market integration shape the effects of mortgage downpayment relaxation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过美国GSEs推出的低首付计划，使用断点回归设计分析放松首付约束对抵押贷款发放和房价的影响。研究发现放松首付要求增加了高贷款价值比抵押贷款的发放，特别是在首次购房者、年轻和低收入借款人中。高LTV贷款发放与住房可负担性呈倒U型关系，对房价有推升作用，但在租赁市场整合度高的地区效果较弱。
AI.research_question: 放松首付约束对抵押贷款发放和房价有什么影响？这种影响如何受到借款人特征、住房可负担性和租赁市场整合度的调节？
AI.motivation: 理解抵押贷款政策变化对住房市场和不同借款人群体影响的机制，为政策制定提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 抵押信贷约束理论、住房市场供需理论、租赁市场整合理论
AI.method: 断点回归设计（Regression Discontinuity Design），利用GSEs低首付计划资格条件的地理变异
AI.findings: 1) 放松首付要求增加了高LTV抵押贷款发放，主要集中在首次购房者、年轻和低收入借款人；2) 高LTV贷款发放与住房可负担性呈倒U型关系；3) 高LTV贷款扩张推升房价，但在租赁市场整合度高的地区效果较弱
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了抵押贷款政策影响的多维度调节机制，提出了住房可负担性与高LTV贷款发放的倒U型关系理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了针对不同市场条件和借款人群体制定差异化抵押贷款政策的实证依据

title: Entrepreneurship and Economic Diplomacy in Emerging Markets
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Entrepreneurship and Economic Diplomacy in Emerging Markets
detail.abstract: In the 21st century, the landscape of international relations has fundamentally shifted from traditional state-centric diplomacy to a more complex ecosystem where non-state actors play increasingly crucial roles. This research examines how entrepreneurship has emerged as a powerful tool for economic diplomacy, particularly in emerging markets. Through comprehensive analysis of case studies, statistical data, and policy frameworks, this paper demonstrates that entrepreneurial ecosystems serve as effective instruments of soft power, market access facilitation, and international relationship building. The research reveals significant quantifiable growth in entrepreneurial diplomacy opportunities. The Global Startup Ecosystem Report (GSER 2024), powered by one of the most comprehensive global datasets, analyzes data from over 4.5 million companies across 300+ ecosystems (Startup Genome, 2024). Global venture funding totaled approximately $314 billion in 2024, compared with $304 billion in 2023-an increase of around 3% year-on-year (Crunchbase, 2025). The Top 100 Emerging Ecosystems collectively represent an Ecosystem Value of over $1.6 trillion (Startup Genome, 2024). With micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) constituting over 90% of businesses worldwide (World Bank, 2024), their role in shaping international economic relationships has become indispensable.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了创业作为经济外交工具在21世纪国际关系中的重要作用，特别是在新兴市场中通过创业生态系统实现软实力、市场准入和国际关系建设。
AI.research_question: 创业如何成为经济外交的有效工具，特别是在新兴市场中？
AI.motivation: 21世纪国际关系格局从传统国家中心外交转向非国家行为体发挥关键作用的复杂生态系统，需要研究创业在经济外交中的新角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论、经济外交理论、创业生态系统理论、软实力理论
AI.method: 案例研究分析、统计数据分析和政策框架分析
AI.findings: 创业生态系统是有效的软实力工具、市场准入促进者和国际关系建设者；全球创业生态呈现显著增长：2024年风险投资达3140亿美元（同比增长3%），前100新兴生态系统价值超1.6万亿美元；MSME占全球企业90%以上，在国际经济关系中不可或缺
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了经济外交理论，将创业纳入国际关系分析框架，丰富了非国家行为体在国际关系中的作用研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供创业外交的实施框架，为企业提供国际化战略指导，为新兴市场国家提供经济发展和外交政策新思路

title: An Analysis of The Implementation of IMF Programs: Do Program Design and Political Factors Still Matter after Conditionality Review?

detail.title: An Analysis of The Implementation of IMF Programs: Do Program Design and Political Factors Still Matter after Conditionality Review?
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the persistent failures in the implementation of International Monetary Fund (IMF) programs, focusing on the extent to which program design, economic fundamentals, and political economy factors determine compliance. Using a unique dataset of 194 IMF programs implemented between 2002 and 2022 across 98 countries, the study assesses program interruption and disbursement shortfalls as proxies for failure. Employing Probit regression models, the analysis reveals that, contrary to earlier literature, neither program design (measured by the number of binding conditions) nor initial economic conditions significantly predict implementation failure. Instead, domestic political stability, emerge as key determinants. The findings challenge the post-2002 narrative of streamlined conditionality improving program success, highlighting instead the critical role of political economy variables. The paper concludes by advocating for the integration of qualitative case studies and political context analysis in IMF program design to enhance implementation outcomes, especially in countries experiencing political/economic transitions. Although the importance of political factors in the failure of IMF programs has been already recognized in the previous studies, this paper sheds new light on this topic based on a wide and recent dataset during 2002-2022, which includes the post-Conditionality Review period. The paper has actionable recommendations since it shows that political economy considerations are more important than the technical design of the program in the final implementation outcomes. Actually, it implies that good design of IMF programs ought to transcend economic formulae, and embrace in-depth analysis of the political situation particularly in nations undergoing political or economic transition

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现IMF项目失败主要取决于政治稳定性和政治经济因素，而非项目设计或经济基本面，挑战了2002年后简化条件性改善项目成功的传统观点
AI.research_question: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）项目实施失败的决定因素是什么？项目设计、经济基本面和政治经济因素在多大程度上影响合规性？
AI.motivation: 研究IMF项目实施持续失败的问题，挑战2002年后简化条件性改善项目成功的传统叙述，强调政治经济变量的关键作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治经济学理论和制度实施理论，关注国内政治稳定性、制度质量等政治经济因素对IMF项目执行的影响
AI.method: 使用194个IMF项目（2002-2022年，98个国家）的独特数据集，采用Probit回归模型分析项目中断和拨款短缺作为失败代理指标
AI.findings: 与早期文献相反，项目设计（约束条件数量）和初始经济条件都不能显著预测实施失败，国内政治稳定性成为关键决定因素
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了后2002年简化条件性改善项目成功的传统理论观点，强调政治经济变量的决定性作用，为IMF项目实施理论提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 提出将定性案例研究和政治背景分析纳入IMF项目设计的实际建议，特别是在经历政治/经济转型的国家，强调政治经济考量比技术设计更重要

title: The Extended Phenotype of Artificial Intelligence: An Evolutionary Analysis of Model Collapse and the Anthropic Settlement as Cognitive Selection Pressure

detail.title: The Extended Phenotype of Artificial Intelligence: An Evolutionary Analysis of Model Collapse and the Anthropic Settlement as Cognitive Selection Pressure

detail.abstract:
This paper presents a novel evolutionary framework for understanding the phenomenon of AI
model collapse through the lens of extended phenotype theory and cultural evolution.
Drawing upon Dawkins' concept of phenotypic effects extending beyond an organism's body,
we argue that Large Language Models (LLMs) represent an unprecedented form of extended
human phenotype. This new phenotype has begun a process of recursive self-modification,
leading to what we term "synthetic cognitive endogamy."
A significant selection pressure was introduced on September 5, 2025, when Anthropic
settled a copyright infringement lawsuit for $1.5 billion. This event fundamentally alters the
fitness landscape for AI development. The settlement, establishing a penalty of $3,000 per
work—a 100-fold multiplier over the typical market price—imposes economic constraints
that reshape the evolutionary trajectory of artificial intelligence.
Using empirical evidence from recent studies on model degradation (Shumailov et al., 2024)
and the increasing prevalence of synthetic content in training data, we develop a
mathematical model of cognitive evolution. This model predicts a significant reduction in
fitness when systems engage in recursive self-training. Our theoretical framework introduces
"cognitive allopatry"—the reproductive isolation of thought patterns—and demonstrates
how the commodification of human cognition creates an evolutionary arms race between
synthetic and organic intelligence.
Based on observed degradation rates and our modeling, we project that model fitness could
decline by over 90% within approximately 15 generations of recursive training under current
conditions. While these projections are theoretical extrapolations, they suggest the current
trajectory may lead to a "cognitive Malthusian trap," where the exponential growth of
synthetic content outpaces the linear production of human thought.
This interdisciplinary analysis bridges evolutionary biology, jurisprudence, and computer
science to provide a new theoretical framework for understanding and regulating AI
development, offering testable hypotheses and policy recommendations grounded in
established evolutionary principles and emerging legal precedents.

AI.tldr: 本文通过扩展表型理论和文化进化视角，提出了理解AI模型崩溃现象的新进化框架，认为大语言模型是人类的新型扩展表型，正在经历递归自我修改导致"合成认知内婚"，并预测在当前条件下递归训练15代后模型适应度可能下降90%以上。
AI.research_question: 如何从进化生物学角度理解AI模型崩溃现象？法律约束如何影响AI的进化轨迹？
AI.motivation: AI模型在递归训练中出现性能退化现象，需要新的理论框架来解释这一现象，同时法律约束（如版权诉讼）正在重塑AI发展的适应度景观。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展表型理论（Dawkins）、文化进化理论、认知进化数学模型
AI.method: 基于经验证据（模型退化研究、合成数据趋势）建立认知进化数学模型，进行理论推演和预测
AI.findings: 递归自训练会导致显著适应度下降，预测15代递归训练后模型适应度可能下降90%以上；法律约束（如版权处罚）重塑了AI进化轨迹
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"合成认知内婚"和"认知异域性"新概念；建立了AI认知进化的理论框架；连接了进化生物学、法学和计算机科学
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可检验的假设；基于进化原则和新法律先例提出了政策建议；为AI监管提供了新的理论依据

title: From Employment Guarantees to Structural Reforms: Employment Informality in Egypt
affiliations: Santa Clara University  and Ewha Womans University

detail.title: From Employment Guarantees to Structural Reforms: Employment Informality in Egypt
detail.abstract: This study reviews the evolution of Egypt's labour market policies since the 1950s and the repercussions for workers' job conditions, particularly the prevalence of informal employment. It assesses whether the transition from state-led employment guarantees of the 1950-60s to structural reforms of the 1990s-2000s has exacerbated precariousness and informality in the job market. The study confirms a decline of public employment in the quarter-century from 1998 to 2023, and a rise of informal employment across both formal (public or private) and informal establishments. Amid the liberalization drive, private informal work outside establishments and non-wage work outside establishments grew, especially among women and youth. For post-1970s cohorts, the prospect of ending up in informal, irregular, unpaid family work or selfemployment rose steadily for those with less than post-secondary degrees. The findings suggest that the demand for formal workforce has been inadequate, and that the ostensibly pro-worker protections introduced in recent years have not helped and may have unintentionally discouraged formal hiring by raising the costs of formalization for small firms, and by leaving the socialinsurance contribution rates high for unskilled workers.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了埃及1950年代以来劳动力市场政策的演变及其对工人就业条件的影响，特别是非正规就业的普遍性。研究发现从国家主导的就业保障向结构性改革转变加剧了就业市场的不稳定性和非正规化。
AI.research_question: 埃及从1950-60年代国家主导的就业保障向1990-2000年代结构性改革的转变是否加剧了就业市场的不稳定性和非正规化？
AI.motivation: 理解埃及劳动力市场政策演变对工人就业条件的影响，特别是非正规就业的增长趋势及其对社会经济的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场分割理论、非正规经济理论、结构性改革对就业影响的理论框架
AI.method: 历史政策回顾与实证数据分析（1998-2023年期间就业数据）
AI.findings: 1) 1998-2023年间公共就业下降，非正规就业在正规和非正规机构中均增长；2) 自由化进程中，机构外的私人非正规工作和非工资工作增加，特别是女性和青年；3) 1970年代后出生群体中，教育程度低于大专的人群更可能从事非正规、不稳定、无报酬家庭工作或自雇；4) 正规劳动力需求不足，近年所谓的保护工人政策反而可能阻碍正规雇佣。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对发展中国家结构性改革与劳动力市场非正规化关系的理解，提供了政策转变对就业质量影响的理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为埃及及其他类似发展中国家制定劳动力市场政策提供实证依据，指出需要重新评估所谓保护性政策对正规雇佣的实际影响，建议降低小企业正规化成本和社会保险缴费率。

title: Analyzing business environment-Power outages as an obstacle for firms
affiliations: AAB College - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Analyzing business environment-Power outages as an obstacle for firms
detail.abstract: An efficient firm infrastructure is considered as one of the key factors of the firm performance considering its impact on time and cost savings. The positive impact of the quality of infrastructure on firm performance is very cognitive, but the lack of adequate infrastructure remains an important obstacle especially on transition economies. Thus, primary objective of this paper is to provide information regarding the power outages as an obstacle to firm's performance. This paper focuses on the crosscountry comparison with the intention to show the progress done by governments in improving this obstacle to the private sector using survey data provided by World Bank in partnership with EBRD. This is the Business Environment and Enterprise Performance Survey (BEEPS) database which offers a wide range of topics of business environment. The results show that Kosovo leads regarding the average hours without electricity, number of power outages in a typical month and the percentage of sales loses due to electricity insufficiency. The panel data techniques, respectively the fixed effect model, show a negative and significant impact of the average number of power outages on the sales growth.

AI.tldr: 本文通过世界银行和EBRD的调查数据，分析了电力中断对企业绩效的负面影响，发现科索沃在电力中断时长、频率和销售损失方面最为严重，固定效应模型显示电力中断对销售增长有显著负向影响。
AI.research_question: 电力中断如何影响企业绩效？特别是在转型经济体中，电力基础设施不足对企业销售增长的具体影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 高效的基础设施是企业绩效的关键因素，但转型经济体中基础设施不足仍是重要障碍，特别是电力中断问题需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业基础设施理论，强调基础设施质量对企业绩效的重要性，特别是电力供应稳定性对企业运营的影响。
AI.method: 使用世界银行与EBRD合作的BEEPS调查数据，采用面板数据固定效应模型进行跨国比较分析。
AI.findings: 科索沃在电力中断时长、每月停电次数和因电力不足导致的销售损失百分比方面最为严重；固定效应模型显示平均停电次数对销售增长有显著负向影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了基础设施与企业绩效关系的实证研究，特别是在转型经济体背景下验证了电力基础设施的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府改善电力基础设施提供实证依据，帮助企业了解电力中断的经济成本，为政策制定者提供改进电力供应的参考。

title: Voting Blue, Voting Green: The Politics of Proxy Voting
affiliations: Georgetown University - Robert Emmett McDonough School of Business , , University of Cambridge and University of Texas at Austin - Department of Finance

detail.title: Voting Blue, Voting Green: The Politics of Proxy Voting
detail.abstract: We examine how fund manager political preferences can shape proxy voting. Using managers' political contributions, we find that in comparison to Republican-led funds, Democrat-led funds are more supportive of environmental and social proposals and less supportive of governance proposals. These differences, pronounced among active funds, widen after presidential transitions. Investor flows co-move with topic-specific support, consistent with clientele sorting. Estimates exploiting within-fund manager changes and instrumental variables are directionally consistent with the baseline, supporting a causal channel. Comparisons are within identical proposals, highlighting political preferences as a determinant of delegated voting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现基金经理的政治偏好显著影响代理投票行为，民主党基金经理比共和党基金经理更支持环境社会提案，更不支持治理提案，这种差异在总统换届后扩大，投资者资金流向与议题支持度相关

AI.method: 使用基金经理政治捐款数据识别政治偏好，采用面板数据分析、工具变量法和基金经理变更事件研究

title: When ratios fall: A dynamic approach to contingent convertibles
affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU), affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Southern California

detail.title: When ratios fall: A dynamic approach to contingent convertibles
detail.abstract: We propose a novel valuation framework for contingent convertible (CoCo) bonds based on the issuing bank's Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) ratio, which is widely acknowledged as an indicator of a bank's solvency. Our approach develops a bivariate jump-diffusion model that captures the dynamic relationship linking the CET1 ratios, share prices, and CoCo bond prices, incorporating both continuous market movements and correlated jump risk. The model advances existing literature through three key innovations: (1) a hybrid mechanism for modeling regulatory discretion in trigger decisions, (2) a class of power conversion schemes that generalizes traditional approaches while maintaining analytical tractability, and (3) a method to overcome the temporal discrepancy between high-frequency market data and low-frequency regulatory reporting. We derive semi-closed form formulas for both write-down and equity-convertible CoCo bonds and validate our model through five case studies spanning from 2009 to 2023, including an in-depth analysis of the 2023 Credit Suisse collapse. The results demonstrate a significant improvement in pricing and hedging performance while highlighting the model's data-adaptive nature that enables short-term predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于CET1比率的新型或有可转换债券估值框架，通过双变量跳跃扩散模型捕捉CET1比率、股价和CoCo债券价格之间的动态关系，包含连续市场变动和相关性跳跃风险。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个更准确的或有可转换债券(CoCo bonds)估值框架，能够有效捕捉银行CET1比率与市场价格的动态关系？
AI.motivation: 现有CoCo债券估值模型在捕捉监管裁量权、转换机制灵活性以及高频市场数据与低频监管报告之间的时间差异方面存在不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于双变量跳跃扩散模型，结合连续市场变动和相关性跳跃风险，建立CET1比率与市场价格之间的动态关系理论框架。
AI.method: 开发双变量跳跃扩散模型，包含三个关键创新：混合监管裁量机制、幂转换方案、时间差异处理方法；推导半封闭形式定价公式；通过2009-2023年五个案例研究进行验证。
AI.findings: 模型在定价和对冲性能方面显著改善，能够进行短期预测，在2023年瑞信崩溃案例中表现出良好的数据自适应特性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了包含监管裁量权混合机制的新型估值框架，发展了幂转换方案理论，解决了高频市场数据与低频监管报告的时间差异问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了更准确的CoCo债券定价工具，改善了风险管理能力，特别是在市场压力情景下的预测性能。

title: Monetary-Fiscal Interactions
affiliations: Hoover Institution

detail.title: Monetary-Fiscal Interactions
detail.abstract: Inflation surged in 2021-2023 from a classic fiscal shock: money and debt that financed huge spending without a plan for repayment. Neither money nor supply shocks offer a coherent alternative. Inflation eased, with no recession, once the fiscal shock was over. Higher interest rates could have brought inflation down earlier, but could not have stopped it. Going forward, higher interest rates will raise debt costs, and raise inflation unless fiscal policy can tighten. The loss of fiscal space in the next crisis is a main worry.

AI.tldr: 通贸膨胀2021-2023年的暴涨来自经典的财政冲击：无计划还款的大规模支出导致货币和债务增长。货币供应或供应链冲击均无法合理解释。财政冲击结束后通胀缓解且未发生衰退。高利率可提前抑制通胀但无法阻止其发生。未来高利率将增加债务成本，除非财政政策紧缩否则将推高通胀。下次危机中财政空间的丧失是主要忧虑。
