title: Taming Tax Competition: The Role of Urban Amenities

detail.title: Taming Tax Competition: The Role of Urban Amenities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Number 24KJ0584.

detail.abstract: The literature in urban economics has highlighted the importance of urban amenities. This study shows that urban amenities also play a significant role in spatial tax competition. We incorporate urban amenities into a spatial tax competition model in which regions compete for spatially mobile tax bases. In the model, consumers engage in cross-border shopping by purchasing goods in regions with lower tax rates. We find that the presence of urban amenities raises equilibrium tax rates not only in the region containing the city center but also in surrounding regions. This upward effect is heterogeneous across regions. Furthermore, urban amenities can have a Pareto-improving effect. They may serve as an alternative to tax coordination or subsidies in addressing the inefficiency of low equilibrium tax rates under tax competition.

AI.tldr: 城市便利设施在空间税收竞争中发挥重要作用，不仅提高城市中心区域的均衡税率，也提升周边地区税率，且具有帕累托改进效应，可作为税收协调的替代方案
AI.research_question: 城市便利设施如何影响空间税收竞争中的均衡税率？
AI.motivation: 城市经济学文献强调了城市便利设施的重要性，但对其在空间税收竞争中的作用研究不足
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间税收竞争模型，包含跨区域购物行为和城市便利设施因素
AI.method: 理论建模分析，将城市便利设施纳入空间税收竞争框架
AI.findings: 城市便利设施提高了城市中心及周边地区的均衡税率，这种提升效应存在区域异质性，且具有帕累托改进效应
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了空间税收竞争理论，首次系统分析城市便利设施对税收竞争的影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了利用城市便利设施作为税收协调替代方案的理论依据，有助于解决税收竞争导致的低效率问题

title: Production Sharing Contracts and Rentierism: Reforming Transparency Gaps in Kurdistan’s Oil and Gas Contracts
affiliations: University of Raparin and Auckland University of Technology

detail.title: Production Sharing Contracts and Rentierism: Reforming Transparency Gaps in Kurdistan’s Oil and Gas Contracts
detail.abstract: Rentierism is a significant concern for most oil-producing countries, in particular, those in the developing world. Iraq is among those countries with a long history of rentierism. Kurdistan is the only federal region in Iraq that exports oil independently and uses Production Sharing Contracts (PSCs) without the federal government's authorisation. However, the influence of PSCs on rentierism has not been discussed in the literature, particularly in the context of the Middle East. This paper argues that while PSCs contributed significantly to increasing rentierism in the region, they are not the only factor. The paper draws on findings from interviews conducted with parliamentary members and oil experts in the region to support the arguments presented. Due to the complexity, lack of transparency and other aspects of these contracts, significant revenue accumulated in the hands of influential groups in the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG). This revenue is used for personal and political goals rather than development. The paper concludes with several findings and policy implications, including contractual and institutional reforms.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了伊拉克库尔德斯坦地区生产分成合同（PSCs）对食利主义的影响，发现PSCs虽显著加剧食利主义但非唯一因素，收入集中在KRG有影响力群体手中用于个人政治目的而非发展，提出合同和制度改革建议。
AI.research_question: 生产分成合同（PSCs）如何影响伊拉克库尔德斯坦地区的食利主义？
AI.motivation: 伊拉克库尔德斯坦作为伊拉克唯一独立出口石油的地区，未经联邦政府授权使用PSCs，但PSCs对食利主义的影响在中东背景下尚未被文献讨论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 食利主义理论，重点关注石油生产国特别是发展中国家的租金分配和经济依赖问题。
AI.method: 对库尔德斯坦地区议会成员和石油专家进行访谈的质性研究方法。
AI.findings: PSCs显著增加了该地区的食利主义；由于合同复杂性、缺乏透明度等因素，大量收入集中在KRG有影响力群体手中；这些收入被用于个人和政治目的而非地区发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了PSCs对食利主义影响的研究空白，特别是在中东地区背景下；扩展了食利主义理论在合同机制方面的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了合同和制度改革的政策建议；为其他石油生产地区提供了避免类似食利主义问题的实践参考。

title: The SOFR Premium in Nonbank Loans

detail.title: The SOFR Premium in Nonbank Loans
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how the benchmark transition from London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR) to Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) affects the borrowing costs of syndicated loans. From 2022 to June 2023, new loan originations were required to reference SOFR while outstanding loans continued to use LIBOR. Using this transition period, I find that borrowers pay higher spreads on nonbank SOFR loans relative to their outstanding LIBOR loans. The result is driven by nonbank investors sensitive to potential losses following the transition to the risk-free reference rate. The increase in loan spreads is greater for borrowers held by loan mutual funds and exposed to their outflows. Persistence of loan mutual funds' investments explains their influence on loan spreads. In the secondary loan market, SOFR loans trade at higher prices than outstanding LIBOR loans, reflecting the spreads beyond borrower credit risk.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了从LIBOR向SOFR基准利率过渡对银团贷款借款成本的影响，发现非银行SOFR贷款的利差高于LIBOR贷款，主要受贷款共同基金等非银行投资者对潜在损失的敏感性驱动。
AI.research_question: 基准利率从LIBOR向SOFR过渡如何影响银团贷款的借款成本？
AI.motivation: 了解基准利率过渡期间借款成本的变化，特别是非银行投资者在过渡过程中的行为对贷款定价的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于利率基准过渡理论、非银行投资者行为理论以及贷款定价理论，分析风险无风险参考利率转换对借贷市场的影响。
AI.method: 利用2022年至2023年6月的过渡期数据，比较新发SOFR贷款与存量LIBOR贷款的利差，通过次级贷款市场价格分析验证结果。
AI.findings: 借款人支付的非银行SOFR贷款利差高于存量LIBOR贷款；贷款共同基金的投资持续性解释了其对贷款利差的影响；次级市场中SOFR贷款交易价格更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了基准利率过渡理论，揭示了非银行投资者在利率基准转换中的关键作用，提供了贷款定价理论的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为借款人在基准利率过渡期间的成本管理提供参考，帮助投资者理解利率基准转换对投资回报的影响，为监管机构制定过渡政策提供实证依据。

title: Innovation Policy and the Press
affiliations: UC Law, San Francisco and Yeshiva University - Benjamin N. Cardozo School of Law

detail.title: Innovation Policy and the Press
detail.abstract:
Local news is in crisis. Too few subscribers are willing to pay the costs required to create sustained and high-quality local news products, and the advertisers that previously subsidized local news have fled to new sites, especially social media platforms. Press organizations and policymakers have begun experimenting with possible fixes. Media institutions have looked to new private funding models, especially nonprofit institutions supported by philanthropic foundations. And state legislators have begun testing different public financing vehicles for local media. Yet these efforts represent only a small set of possible solutions to the crisis in local news. And they have proven insufficient to save news organizations from financial devastation. 

This essay argues that the local news crisis should be understood as an innovation failure, one that calls for solutions from areas of the law that have long grappled with similar problems. In markets like pharmaceuticals and technology, policymakers often employ “innovation policy pluralism,” or combinations of intellectual property protections with non-IP tools such as prizes, grants, and tax credits. Such combinations harness both free-market forces and government regulation to foster socially valuable services in productive ways. The essay surveys these different innovation policy levers and maps them onto both existing and proposed local press interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文认为地方新闻危机本质上是创新失败问题，需要借鉴制药和技术行业的创新政策多元主义方法，结合知识产权保护与非知识产权工具（如奖励、资助和税收抵免）来拯救地方新闻业。
AI.research_question: 如何运用创新政策多元主义方法来解决地方新闻危机？
AI.motivation: 地方新闻业面临严重危机，订阅收入不足，广告商转向社交媒体平台，现有私人资助模式和公共融资措施效果有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新政策多元主义理论，结合知识产权保护与非知识产权工具（奖励、资助、税收抵免）的混合政策框架。
AI.method: 理论分析和政策映射方法，通过调查不同创新政策工具并将其应用于地方新闻干预措施。
AI.findings: 制药和技术行业的创新政策组合可以有效地映射到地方新闻领域，为拯救新闻机构提供新的政策思路。
AI.theory_contributions: 将创新政策多元主义理论扩展到媒体研究领域，为理解地方新闻危机提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的政策工具组合建议，包括知识产权保护、奖励机制、政府资助和税收优惠等实际解决方案。

title: Unemployment, Economic Growth, Inflation and FDI. Panel VAR evidence for Central and Eastern European Union countries
affiliations: Doctoral School of Economics and Business Administration, “Alexandru Ioan Cuza” University, Faculty of Economics and Business Administration, “Alexandru Ioan Cuza” University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Unemployment, Economic Growth, Inflation and FDI. Panel VAR evidence for Central and Eastern European Union countries
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the relationship between unemployment, economic growth, inflation and FDI for 11 CEE member countries of the European Union, using annual data from 2000 to 2020. We applied a panel VAR approach in order to estimate impulse response functions to describe the response of an endogenous variable over time to a shock in another variable in the model. We also applied a variance decomposition analysis in order to assess the importance of changes in one variable in explaining changes in other variables. Our results provide evidence for a negative influence of unemployment rate over a period of 2 years to GDP growth shock and a positive response of unemployment to inflation throughout the analyzed period. We also found that FDI does not have a statistically significant influence on the unemployment rate in the CEE countries.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文分析了2000-2020年欧盟11个中东欧国家的失业率、经济增长、通货膨胀和FDI之间的关系，发现失业率在2年内对GDP增长冲击呈负面响应，而通胀对失业率呈正面影响，FDI则对失业率没有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 中东欧欧盟国家的失业率、经济增长、通货膨胀和直接投资(FDI)之间存在怎样的动态关系？
AI.motivation: 研究中东欧转型经济体的工业化过程中，失业率、经济增长、通胀和FDI之间的相互作用对该地区的经济发展具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时间序列分析和面板数据经济学理论，采用面板VAR模型来探索变量间的动态关系。
AI.method: 使用2000-2020年度数据，应用面板VAR方法估计冲击响应函数，并进行方差分解分析来评估各变量的相对重要性。
AI.findings: 1、失业率在2年内对GDP增长冲击呈现负面响应 2、失业率在整个分析期间内对通货膨胀呈现正面响应 3、FDI对中东欧国家失业率没有统计上显著的影响
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了转型经济体工业化过程中巨宏经济变量动态关系的理论研究，提供了面板VAR在这一领域的应用示例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中东欧国家的就业政策和经济发展策略提供了实证支撑，指出了通货膨胀管理和经济增长制推进对降低失业率的重要性。

title: Firm Adaptation and Reallocation under Rationing: Evidence from South Africa
affiliations: , Duke University, Fuqua School of Business, University of Chicago - Department of Economics and University of Chicago

detail.title: Firm Adaptation and Reallocation under Rationing: Evidence from South Africa
detail.abstract: Rationing policies are frequently implemented due to equity concerns. We study whether equitable-exposure rationing rules deliver equal economic impacts in the context of the 2021-2023 power crisis in South Africa. We leverage shocks to outage intensity and a rotational assignment system to generate quasi-random variation in electricity outage exposure, and we combine detailed hour-level outages with geocoded transactions data from a leading payment platform in Cape Town. Although we find that aggregate daily sales do not change on outage days, there is substantial heterogeneity across the firm distribution. Revenue is reallocated through consumers substituting between firms: baseline high-performing firms able to invest in defensive technology capture the spending displaced from their competitors, gaining roughly nine percent in daily sales while the latter lose a similar share. Unequal effects are amplified when firms are able to anticipate electricity outages. The results suggest the impacts of rationing are not equal despite equitable exposure.

AI.tldr: 南非电力配给政策虽然实现了公平的停电暴露，但对企业产生了不平等经济影响。高绩效企业通过防御性技术获得约9%的日销售额增长，而竞争对手损失类似份额。
AI.research_question: 公平暴露的电力配给规则是否会产生平等的经济影响？
AI.motivation: 研究配给政策在公平性方面的实际经济效果，特别是在电力危机背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 配给经济学、企业异质性理论、防御性技术投资理论
AI.method: 利用南非2021-2023年电力危机中的停电强度冲击和轮换分配系统，结合小时级停电数据和地理编码交易数据，进行准随机实验分析。
AI.findings: 虽然总日销售额在停电日没有变化，但存在显著的企业异质性。高绩效企业通过投资防御性技术获得约9%的日销售额增长，而竞争对手损失类似份额。当企业能够预测停电时，不平等效应会放大。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了公平暴露配给规则在实际经济影响上的不平等性，挑战了传统配给政策的公平性假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于配给政策实际经济影响的实证证据，建议考虑企业异质性和防御能力差异来设计更公平的政策。

title: Economic Operator, Common Errors in Public Procurement, and How to Improve Submission in Belize, "Empowering Tomorrow's Bidders for Success"

detail.title: Economic Operator, Common Errors in Public Procurement, and How to Improve Submission in Belize, "Empowering Tomorrow's Bidders for Success"
detail.abstract: Public procurement plays a pivotal role in the economy and the development of countries. This entails the acquisition of goods, services and works. However, economic operators often face challenges that result in errors in their submission, which can lead to cost overruns, project delays and missed opportunities. The purpose of this paper is to examine the challenges encountered by economic operators in public procurement due to common errors and propose strategies for improving the quality of the submissions. Using a questionnaire of 72 contractors in Belize, the research explored three areas for common errors before the formal launch of the procedure, during the procurement and after the procedures have been awarded. The study found that the most important reason for the rejection of bids were incomplete submissions. The benefit of the study to the practice of procurement is to assist economic operators in understanding the common errors and implementing measures to mitigate or reduce those errors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了伯利兹公共采购中经济运营商因常见错误面临的挑战，通过72家承包商的问卷调查发现投标被拒的最主要原因是提交材料不完整，并提出了改进提交质量的策略。
AI.research_question: 经济运营商在公共采购中因常见错误面临哪些挑战？如何提高投标提交质量？
AI.motivation: 公共采购在经济和国家发展中具有关键作用，但经济运营商经常面临导致提交错误的挑战，造成成本超支、项目延误和机会错失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共采购理论、投标管理理论、质量管理理论
AI.method: 对伯利兹72家承包商进行问卷调查，研究采购程序正式启动前、采购过程中和程序授予后三个阶段的常见错误
AI.findings: 投标被拒绝的最重要原因是提交材料不完整
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了公共采购中投标错误管理的理论研究，提供了实证证据支持
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助经济运营商理解常见错误并实施措施来减轻或减少这些错误，提高投标成功率

title: Dynamic Competition for Sleepy Deposits *
affiliations: Harvard University - Business School (HBS), University of Chicago, Harvard University Department of Economics, Harvard University - Business School (HBS) and Georgia State University - J. Mack Robinson College of Business

detail.title: Dynamic Competition for Sleepy Deposits *

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Vincent Yao is an unpaid member of the Fiserv Small Business Index Advisory Council and a paid consultant. Mark Egan is an unpaid member of the Fiserv Small Business Index Advisory Council.

detail.abstract: We examine the implications of sleepy deposits and their impact on competition, bank value, and financial stability in the US banking sector. We first document the shopping behavior of depositors using novel data on account openings and closures. Depositors infrequently shop for deposits, with 5-15% of depositors opening a new account each year. Shopping behavior is idiosyncratic: deposit accounts are more likely to be closed due to the depositor either moving or dying than because the depositor switched to a new account offering higher rates or better services. Building on these facts, we develop an empirical model of the supply and demand for "sleepy deposits." In the model, banks face dynamic "invest-versus-harvest" incentives in competing for depositors who shop infrequently. We estimate the model and find that depositor sleepiness accounts for 58% of the average bank's deposit franchise value. Sleepiness softens competition, particularly raising markups and franchise value for banks in low-concentration areas, as well as for banks with either low-quality deposit services or high marginal costs. Sleepiness also creates stability in the banking sector. For two main money center banks in the US, the probability of default after the Federal Reserve's 2022-2023 hiking cycle would have increased to more than 20% in a counterfactual without sleepy depositors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了'沉睡存款'对美国银行业竞争、银行价值和金融稳定的影响。研究发现储户很少更换存款账户，这种'沉睡性'占银行平均存款特许价值的58%，软化了竞争并提高了银行稳定性。
AI.research_question: 沉睡存款如何影响银行业竞争、银行价值和金融稳定性？
AI.motivation: 理解储户行为特征对银行业竞争动态和金融稳定的重要影响，特别是在当前利率环境变化背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于'投资vs收获'动态竞争模型，分析银行在面对不频繁更换账户的储户时的战略选择。
AI.method: 使用新颖的账户开立和关闭数据，建立经验模型估计存款供给和需求，并进行反事实分析。
AI.findings: 储户很少更换账户(每年仅5-15%)，沉睡性占银行存款特许价值的58%，软化竞争并提高银行稳定性。在2022-2023年美联储加息周期中，没有沉睡储户的情况下主要货币中心银行违约概率将超过20%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了'沉睡存款'概念和相关的动态竞争模型，深化了对储户行为与银行竞争互动关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行监管机构和政策制定者提供了关于存款市场结构和金融稳定性的重要实证证据，有助于制定更有效的银行监管政策。

title: Optimization of the Nominal Capacity of the Energy Storage System for Ensuring Security of Electrical Energy Supply
affiliations: Institute of General Energy of NAS of Ukraine and Institute of General Energy of NAS of Ukraine

detail.title: Optimization of the Nominal Capacity of the Energy Storage System for Ensuring Security of Electrical Energy Supply
detail.abstract: This paper presents an optimization model for determining the nominal capacity of an energy storage system that transfers excess amounts of electrical energy from solar power plants as part of a group of distributed generation power plants, based on the criterion of the minimum cost of supplying electricity to end consumers. The use of the developed optimization model allows one to determine the optimal parameters of the energy storage system to achieve an economic balance between the excess amounts of electric energy of solar power plants that are transferred and the number of restrictions on inverters that are subject to payment. Based on the developed method and on the forecast level of electric energy consumption and statistical data on the level of electric energy production at wind and solar power plants for the territory of Ukraine, the installed capacity of the wind, solar, reserve power plant, and the nominal capacity of the two-hour energy storage system were determined, which will provide the minimum levelized cost of energy of supplying to consumers during the entire period of commercial operation of a group of distributed generation power plants.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个优化模型，用于确定储能系统的标称容量，以最小化终端消费者的供电成本。该模型基于太阳能发电厂过剩电能的转移，通过经济平衡优化储能参数。
AI.research_question: 如何确定储能系统的最优标称容量，以最小化分布式发电厂群向终端消费者供电的成本？
AI.motivation: 太阳能发电厂存在过剩电能，需要通过储能系统进行有效管理和转移，以降低供电成本并提高经济效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于优化理论和成本最小化原则，建立经济平衡模型来分析过剩电能转移与逆变器限制之间的权衡。
AI.method: 开发优化模型，利用乌克兰地区的电力消费预测和风能、太阳能发电统计数据，确定最优的储能系统参数。
AI.findings: 确定了风能、太阳能、备用发电厂的安装容量以及两小时储能系统的标称容量，实现了整个商业运营期间的最低平准化能源成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个基于成本最小化准则的储能系统容量优化模型，为分布式发电系统的经济性分析提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰地区的分布式发电项目提供了具体的储能系统配置方案，有助于降低供电成本并提高可再生能源的利用效率。

title: Public Participation in Agency Adjudication
affiliations: Michigan State University - College of Law and Michigan State University College of Law

detail.title: Public Participation in Agency Adjudication

declarations.funderStatement: Administrative Conference of the United States

contentFormat.other: Report to the Administrative Conference of the United States

detail.abstract: This report for the Administrative Conference of the United States (ACUS) examines the institutional structures, practices, and procedures used by federal agencies to support informed public participation in adjudicatory proceedings and suggests strategies for enhancing public participation in agency adjudication. The report provides background on the role of agency adjudication as a policymaking form, the justifications for public participation in such proceedings, the literature on public engagement with regulation, and the basic challenges of participatory agency adjudication. After describing our research methodology, the report presents a conceptual framework for public participation in agency adjudication, provides concrete examples of agencies using available tools, and suggests strategies for enhancing public participation in agency adjudication based on our research.

AI.tldr: 本报告为美国行政会议研究联邦机构在裁决程序中支持公众参与的制度结构、实践和程序，并提出增强公众参与的策略。报告分析了裁决作为政策制定形式的作用、公众参与的正当性、相关文献以及参与式裁决的基本挑战，提供了概念框架、具体案例和改进策略。
AI.research_question: 联邦机构如何通过制度结构和程序来支持公众参与裁决程序，以及如何增强公众在机构裁决中的参与度？
AI.motivation: 机构裁决作为一种重要的政策制定形式，公众参与对于提高决策的合法性和质量至关重要，但目前缺乏系统性的研究和改进策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公众参与理论、行政裁决理论、政策制定参与理论、机构治理理论
AI.method: 文献综述、案例分析、制度分析、概念框架构建
AI.findings: 识别了联邦机构支持公众参与的各种工具和实践，分析了参与式裁决面临的挑战，提出了具体的改进策略和最佳实践案例。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了公众参与机构裁决的概念框架，丰富了行政法和公共参与理论，为后续研究提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为联邦机构提供了具体的操作策略和实践建议，有助于改善公众参与机制，提高裁决过程的透明度和合法性。

title: Economic Performance of The Countries in the Western Balkans
affiliations: University Kadri Zeka Gjilan and AAB College - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Economic Performance of The Countries in the Western Balkans
detail.abstract: This paper will analyse the economic performance of six Western Balkan countries. Macroeconomic indicators have differences from country to country due to the government policies they have (Aryani et al., 2023). The economic performance of countries depends on global influences and the development model of some governments on how they use their country‘s natural resources (Chutipat et al., 2023). The aim is to measure the economic performance index (EPI) for each country in this region. The paper methodology will have secondary data for the years 2010–2020. The EPI finding is constructed using the following indicators: unemployment, inflation, budget deficit, and economic growth. To do this, graphs, descriptive statistics, and regression models were used. In conclusion, based on conventional wisdom, the results show that countries that have performed better have shown increases in average private sector monthly wages and vice versa. Contrary to expectations, a larger population appears to have a negative impact on performance, and country specifics do not appear to be statistically associated with better performance. Thus, the importance of this paper is to add to the emerging literature by arguing for the superiority of the EPI compared to more traditional indicators.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了六个西巴尔干国家的经济表现，构建经济表现指数(EPI)，发现工资增长与表现正相关，人口规模有负面影响，国家特性无统计显著性。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量西巴尔干国家的经济表现？经济表现指数(EPI)与传统指标相比有何优势？
AI.motivation: 各国宏观经济指标因政府政策而异，经济表现受全球影响和政府发展模式影响，需要更全面的衡量指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济理论和绩效评估理论，采用多指标综合评估方法。
AI.method: 使用2010-2020年二手数据，构建包含失业率、通胀率、预算赤字和经济增长的EPI指数，采用图表、描述性统计和回归模型分析。
AI.findings: 表现较好的国家平均私营部门月工资增长更高；人口规模对表现有负面影响；国家特性与更好表现无统计关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了经济表现指数(EPI)作为更全面的经济绩效衡量工具，丰富了经济绩效评估理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估经济表现的新工具，有助于西巴尔干国家制定更有效的经济政策。

title: Intellectual Property Rights and Cryptocurrency: Rising Phenomenon
affiliations: Bennett University and Bennett University

detail.title: Intellectual Property Rights and Cryptocurrency: Rising Phenomenon
detail.abstract: Law analyzes and protects Business innovation, and promotes research and development by examining it through a lens of different legal arenasintellectual property, labour law, completion law and employment laws. The business and finance sector will benefit from the advent of this technology. Distributive ledger technology is evolving, and applications based on it are mostly in the experimental stage. It might take years for its significant impact to emerge. We are unable to find any scientific evidence or data about how the competition laws and intellectual property rights will be applied to this form of technology. Here IPR laws deal with providing exclusivity of the owners' rights where the competition laws encourage healthy competition among businesses within the same industry and other, aims to increase market accessibility. A dichotomy between both laws can be observed. The need for both IPR and competition laws to coexist together and complement each other is on the rise currently. In light of the nation's development and the constitutionality of cryptocurrencies, the article attempts to investigate how IPR laws and competition laws interact. It presses on the need to have better regulation without stifling the innovative aspect of this technology. The lawmakers are having a hard time framing proper legislation regarding cryptocurrencies in the IPR regime which is specially not designed to handle them. There is considerable hype and hyperbole about this product due to the involvement of the commercial interest of many. We feel the need to examine the interplay between the blockchain, copyright law and privacy law because they all move in a vague spectrum with a heavy load of scepticism.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨区块链技术背景下知识产权法与竞争法的互动关系，分析两者在促进创新与保护竞争之间的张力，强调需要建立平衡的监管框架
AI.research_question: 在区块链技术发展背景下，知识产权法与竞争法如何相互作用？如何制定既能保护创新又不抑制竞争的监管框架？
AI.motivation: 分布式账本技术快速发展但缺乏科学证据表明竞争法和知识产权法如何应用于该技术，现有法律框架难以处理加密货币等新兴技术，需要研究两者共存互补的关系
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权法（提供权利独占性）与竞争法（促进健康竞争）的理论二分法，以及两者在技术创新背景下的协调框架
AI.method: 法律文本分析、理论框架构建、跨领域法律比较分析
AI.findings: 发现IPR法和竞争法之间存在张力但需要互补共存，现有法律框架不适用于加密货币等区块链技术，需要制定新的平衡性监管措施
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了区块链技术背景下知识产权与竞争法互动的理论框架，提出了两者协调共存的法学理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者制定加密货币相关法规提供参考，帮助企业理解法律环境，促进技术创新与市场竞争的平衡发展

title: Labor Shocks and Local Economies: The Cost of ICE Enforcement Actions
affiliations: University of Iowa - Henry B. Tippie College of Business, University of Iowa - Henry B. Tippie College of Business, University of Iowa - Henry B. Tippie College of Business, University of Illinois at Chicago and University of Iowa - Henry B. Tippie College of Business

detail.title: Labor Shocks and Local Economies: The Cost of ICE Enforcement Actions
detail.abstract: We study the economic impact of immigration enforcement based on U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) operations from 2009-2024. Enforcement actions trigger negative stock returns for firms in counties with high undocumented immigrant concentrations and reduce employment, especially in low-skill industries. These firms also reduce their labor force compared to benchmarks. Municipal bond yields rise in affected counties, indicating broader fiscal ramifications. Our results suggest that undocumented immigrants contribute positively to local economies and that enforcement-induced labor shocks impose costs on both firms and public finance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2009-2024年美国移民执法行动的经济影响，发现执法行动导致高无证移民集中地区的企业股票回报下降、就业减少，特别是在低技能行业，同时还推高了市政债券收益率，表明无证移民对地方经济有积极贡献。
AI.research_question: 移民执法行动对地方经济和企业有何影响？
AI.motivation: 了解无证移民对地方经济的实际贡献以及移民执法政策的经济后果
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场理论、企业价值理论、公共财政理论
AI.method: 基于ICE执法行动数据的实证分析，比较受影响县与基准组的差异
AI.findings: 执法行动导致高无证移民集中地区企业股票回报下降、就业减少（特别是低技能行业），市政债券收益率上升
AI.theory_contributions: 为无证移民经济贡献提供实证证据，完善劳动力冲击对企业价值和公共财政影响的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为移民政策制定提供经济影响评估，帮助企业理解劳动力市场变化的风险

title: Gender Biased Norms *
affiliations: University of British Columbia (UBC) - Vancouver School of Economics

detail.title: Gender Biased Norms *
detail.abstract: Regarding the consequences of culture, there is perhaps no aspect so profound as gender biased norms. Customs and beliefs promoting the inferiority of females relative to males have been ubiquitous throughout human history and remain pervasive today in a majority of countries. This chapter reviews the cultural economics literature which has examined the persistence and transformation of gendered beliefs and norms across the globe. While this innovative work has been expanding, in general, our understanding in economics of gender norm formation and evolution is still quite nascent and there are many exciting possibilities for future research.

AI.tldr: 本章回顾了文化经济学文献中关于性别偏见规范的持久性和全球变化的分析，指出虽然相关研究在扩展，但经济学对性别规范形成和演变的理解仍处于初级阶段，未来研究前景广阔。
AI.research_question: 性别偏见规范在全球范围内的持久性和转变机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 性别偏见规范作为文化后果中最深刻的方面之一，在人类历史上普遍存在且至今仍在多数国家广泛存在，需要系统研究其形成、维持和演变的经济学机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化经济学理论框架，重点关注性别规范的持久性、社会规范演化理论、文化传播机制以及制度与规范的相互作用。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理和评述现有文化经济学文献中关于性别偏见规范的研究成果和方法论。
AI.findings: 性别偏见规范具有显著的持久性，但在全球范围内也存在转变的可能性；现有研究提供了对性别规范形成机制的重要见解，但整体理解仍不成熟。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了文化经济学在性别规范研究领域的理论进展，识别了理论空白和研究机会，为未来理论发展提供了方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解性别规范变革的机制提供了理论基础，有助于设计更有效的促进性别平等的干预措施和政策。

title: When Floods Swamp Banks
affiliations: Univ Rennes, CNRS, CREM - UMR6211, F-35000 Rennes France and Univ Rennes, CNRS, CREM - UMR6211, F-35000 Rennes France

detail.title: When Floods Swamp Banks
detail.abstract: This article examines the impact of natural disasters, particularly floods, on systemic banking risk. The analysis is based on a quarterly panel of 61 banks located in Bangladesh, India, and Pakistan over the period 2008-2021. The results reveal a significant increase in systemic risk following floods. These results highlight the need to integrate climate risks into macroprudential frameworks, particularly in financial systems that are structurally exposed to extreme climate shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了洪水等自然灾害对系统性银行风险的影响，基于2008-2021年孟加拉国、印度和巴基斯坦61家银行的季度面板数据，发现洪水后系统性风险显著增加，强调需要将气候风险纳入宏观审慎框架。
AI.research_question: 自然灾害（特别是洪水）对系统性银行风险有何影响？
AI.motivation: 在气候变化加剧极端天气事件的背景下，需要了解自然灾害对金融系统稳定性的影响，特别是在易受气候冲击的金融体系中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险理论、气候金融风险理论、宏观审慎监管框架
AI.method: 基于2008-2021年孟加拉国、印度和巴基斯坦61家银行的季度面板数据进行实证分析
AI.findings: 洪水等自然灾害后系统性银行风险显著增加
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了气候风险与金融稳定性的理论研究，为气候相关系统性风险提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要将气候风险纳入宏观审慎监管框架，为政策制定者提供应对气候相关金融风险的建议

title: Strategic Interactions in Cyber Risk Governance: A Four-Agent Game-Theoretic and Institutional Framework
affiliations: Glasgow Caledonian University and Glasgow Caledonian University

detail.title: Strategic Interactions in Cyber Risk Governance: A Four-Agent Game-Theoretic and Institutional Framework

declarations.funderStatement: The author(s) declare that this research was conducted independently and did not receive financial support from any funding agency, commercial entity, or not-for-profit organisation.

detail.abstract: This paper develops and applies a four-agent game-theoretic framework for cyber risk governance, integrating Organisations, Hackers, the State, and People as ultimate asset owners. Moving beyond conventional dyadic attacker-defender models, the framework embeds adversarial risk analysis, principal-agent dynamics, and institutional economics to capture behavioural, economic, and political dimensions of cyber threats. Each agent is modelled with a concave utility function under uncertainty, facing sequential defence pathways of prevention, detection, and prosecution. Using synthetic parameters and beliefupdating dynamics, the model demonstrates how decentralised equilibria systematically underprovide socially optimal levels of defence, leaving systemic vulnerabilities that adversaries exploit. Sensitivity analysis highlights that detection investment yields the greatest marginal reduction in expected loss, while prosecution enhances deterrence and legitimacy only when combined with effective detection. Comparison with a planner's benchmark shows that coordinated strategies substantially lower expected losses, redistribute welfare more equitably across agents, and reduce hacker incentives. The findings underscore that complete protection is unattainable and economically inefficient; instead, resilient outcomes require layered, coordinated, and behaviourally informed governance mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个四主体（组织、黑客、国家、人民）的博弈论框架来研究网络风险治理，发现分散均衡会导致防御不足，而协调策略能显著降低预期损失并提高福利分配公平性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过多主体博弈框架分析网络风险治理中的防御不足问题，并寻找协调治理的最优策略？
AI.motivation: 传统的二元攻击者-防御者模型无法充分捕捉网络威胁的行为、经济和政治维度，需要更全面的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论、对抗性风险分析、委托-代理理论、制度经济学
AI.method: 四主体博弈模型（组织、黑客、国家、人民），使用凹效用函数和序列防御路径（预防、检测、起诉），采用合成参数和信念更新动态进行模拟分析
AI.findings: 分散均衡导致系统性防御不足；检测投资对降低预期损失的边际效果最大；起诉只有在与有效检测结合时才能增强威慑力和合法性；协调策略能显著降低预期损失并改善福利分配
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合行为、经济和政治维度的四主体网络风险治理框架，扩展了传统的二元模型
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了协调治理的策略建议，强调分层、协调和行为导向的治理机制的重要性

title: Supply-Side Economics after 30 Years
affiliations: Cato Institute

detail.title: Supply-Side Economics after 30 Years

declarations.funderStatement: Vanderbilt University

detail.abstract:
Origin of the phrase "supply-side economics" in March 1976. Demand-side Keynesian and monetarist theories could not explain or fix stagflation, but Mundell policy mix could.  U.S. time series evidence shows real output and real tax revenues grew more slowly when marginal tax rates were high.  Cross-section evidence shows that high-tax countries and states grow more slowly than those with better tax incentives.  

Demand-side critics focus on "stimulating demand" (spending) with deficits and cheap credit while supply-side analysts instead focus on incentivizing labor and capital to stimulate supply (production).  Supply must come before demand because more and better production generates the added real income and wealth needed to consume or save.

AI.tldr: 供给学派经济学起源于1976年，旨在解决凯恩斯主义和货币主义无法解释的滞胀问题。实证研究表明高边际税率会减缓实际产出和税收增长，供给激励比需求刺激更有效。
AI.research_question: 供给学派经济学如何解释和解决传统需求侧理论无法应对的滞胀问题？
AI.motivation: 凯恩斯主义和货币主义等需求侧理论无法有效解释和解决20世纪70年代的滞胀现象，需要新的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供给学派经济学理论，强调通过激励劳动力和资本供给来促进生产，认为供给先于需求，生产创造收入和财富。
AI.method: 使用美国时间序列数据和跨国/跨州横截面数据进行实证分析，比较不同税率水平下的经济增长表现。
AI.findings: 高边际税率时期实际产出和税收增长较慢；高税收国家/州的经济增长低于税收激励更好的地区。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了供给学派经济学理论框架，挑战了传统需求侧经济学的主导地位，为解释滞胀提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供了实证依据，建议通过降低税率等供给侧激励措施来促进经济增长，而非单纯依赖需求刺激。

title: Public Goods Provision in Divided Societies
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Calcutta, Oslo Metropolitan University and Indian Institute of Management, Calcutta (IIMC)

detail.title: Public Goods Provision in Divided Societies
detail.abstract: We develop a probabilistic-voting model of public goods provision in divided societies. The society is divided into multiple groups based on identity, and the government provides a generic public good and a group-specific public good for each group which is financed by taxation. Voters derive utility from public good specific to their own group and disutility from public goods provided to other groups, and the extent of disutility is a measure of intergroup identity distance. No group is inherently partisan, so political influence depends on the share of persuadable swing voters. When all groups are equally influential, electoral competition replicates the social planner's allocation. As influence varies, equilibrium provision of both generic and group-specific public goods diverges from first-best. When groups with larger tax base (richer and/or larger) are more politically influential on the average, there is an undersupply of both kinds of public goods, and when groups with lower tax base are more politically influential there is an oversupply. Stronger inter-group animosity dampens identity-good promises; greater tolerance amplifies them. Embedding groups in a social-identity network shows hat central groups secure larger identity-good shares, whereas higher overall fractionalization reduces identity-good provision for all.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个分裂社会中公共品供给的概率投票模型，分析身份认同如何影响公共品配置。研究发现政治影响力分配不均会导致公共品供给偏离最优水平，群体间敌意程度和网络中心性也会显著影响身份特定公共品的分配。
AI.research_question: 分裂社会中基于身份认同的公共品供给如何受到政治影响力、群体间距离和社会网络结构的影响？
AI.motivation: 理解在多群体分裂社会中，身份认同差异如何通过政治过程影响公共品的有效供给，为解决现实中的公共资源配置问题提供理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概率投票模型、公共经济学理论、社会身份理论、网络理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含多群体、通用公共品和群体特定公共品的概率投票模型，分析均衡条件和社会福利含义
AI.findings: 1）政治影响力均等时选举竞争复制社会计划者配置；2）影响力不均导致公共品供给偏离最优；3）群体间敌意抑制身份特定公共品承诺；4）网络中心群体获得更多身份特定公共品；5）整体碎片化减少所有群体的身份特定公共品供给
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了分裂社会中公共品供给的理论框架，将身份距离、政治影响力和网络结构纳入统一分析，丰富了公共经济学和政治经济学的理论体系
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解多群体社会中公共资源配置政治经济学的分析工具，有助于设计更公平有效的公共政策

title: When Do Investors Buy Rental Properties? Insights From A Theoretical and Empirical Investigation of Housing Market Breakeven Vacancies
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: When Do Investors Buy Rental Properties? Insights From A Theoretical and Empirical Investigation of Housing Market Breakeven Vacancies
detail.abstract: Real estate is an attractive investment asset because it provides positive cash flows from rents and prospects of valuation gains. This paper studies the housing market breakeven vacancy, the extent to which an investor needs to rent a property to equalize its costs and benefits. As a metric in rental property investment screening, investors are more likely to buy when the breakeven vacancy is high such that the transaction has a promising prospect of breakeven or better. An original asset pricing model is developed to define the housing market breakeven vacancy. The theoretical model reveals that the breakeven vacancy is not static but nonlinearly determined by housing price growth, price-to-rent ratios, interest rates, operating expenses, and rental income taxes. While higher housing price growth, lower interest rates, and smaller operating expenses lead to larger breakeven vacancies, price-to-rent ratios and rental income taxes hold theoretically ambiguous effects. Furthermore, housing market breakeven vacancies are estimated using country-level data from 12 developed nations and regional data from 30 U.S. metropolitan areas. Empirical analysis suggests that declining interest rates and rising price-to-rent ratios have fueled the ascent of breakeven vacancies until 2022, while house price collapses around crises have led to slumps in breakeven vacancies. Lastly, the housing market breakeven vacancy estimates are highly correlated with actual investment home purchases in the United States at national and regional levels, highlighting the practical relevance of this metric for income-producing property investments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了房地产市场盈亏平衡空置率，这是一个衡量投资者需要出租多少房产才能平衡成本与收益的指标。通过理论模型和实证分析，发现盈亏平衡空置率受房价增长、价格租金比、利率等因素非线性影响，并与实际投资购房行为高度相关。
AI.research_question: 房地产市场盈亏平衡空置率是什么？它如何影响房地产投资决策？
AI.motivation: 房地产作为投资资产具有吸引力，因为它能提供租金现金流和增值前景。但投资者需要了解在什么条件下投资能够盈亏平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开发了原创的资产定价模型来定义住房市场盈亏平衡空置率，该模型基于现金流折现原理。
AI.method: 使用12个发达国家的国家级数据和30个美国大都市区的区域数据进行实证分析，估计盈亏平衡空置率。
AI.findings: 盈亏平衡空置率非线性地受房价增长、价格租金比、利率、运营费用和租金所得税影响；与美国的实际投资购房行为高度相关；利率下降和价格租金比上升推动了盈亏平衡空置率上升直至2022年。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了住房市场盈亏平衡空置率的新概念和理论模型，揭示了其动态非线性特征和影响因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为收入性房地产投资提供了实用的投资筛选指标，帮助投资者评估投资前景和做出更明智的决策。

title: Chile: the Competition Law system and the country's norms
affiliations: Facultad de Derecho - Universidad de Chile and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Chile: the Competition Law system and the country's norms
detail.abstract: Assessing how competition law enforcement and governance have developed in a country such as Chile demands looking at how the competition legislation has evolved and why it has been amended. The task of evaluating the competition institutions also compels a review of the decisions and critical literature in this field of law. But this assessment also requires asking operators of the competition law system – typically, antitrust lawyers – how they assess the existing institutions and legal rules, and how well they have been working since their enactment. Therefore, this country study uses several tools in order to take a broad and in-depth look at the institutional governance of competition law bodies. In the work, we describe briefly the recent history and institutional setting for competition agencies in Chile, followed by the evidence gathered in the study and the conclusions arising from this information.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多维度方法评估智利竞争法的制度治理，包括法律演变、机构决策分析以及从业者访谈，全面考察竞争法执法和治理的发展状况。
AI.research_question: 智利竞争法执法和治理如何发展？现有制度和法律规则的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 需要全面评估智利竞争法的发展历程和制度效能，为政策制定和改进提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度治理理论、竞争法理论、法律实施效果评估框架
AI.method: 多方法综合研究：法律文本分析、机构决策回顾、文献综述、从业者访谈
AI.findings: 通过对智利竞争机构历史、制度设置和实证证据的分析，得出了关于竞争法治理现状的具体结论
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了发展中国家竞争法制度治理的评估框架，丰富了竞争法实施效果的理论研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为智利竞争法改革提供实证依据，为其他类似国家提供可借鉴的治理评估方法

title: The Effect of Economic Growth in Relation to Unemployment
affiliations: AAB College - Faculty of Economics and University of Pristina

detail.title: The Effect of Economic Growth in Relation to Unemployment
detail.abstract: The paper will include the macroeconomic analysis regarding economic growth under nominal GDP, in relation to the most important macroeconomic parameter, unemployment. The paper will also include the analysis of Gross Domestic Product, as an important measure of the economic growth, and that measures the living standard of the citizens of that country or state. Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is a more impeccable method for the analysis of all the transactions that are performed within a country, in order to display a macroeconomic analysis. The key point of this paper is the economic growth under nominal GDP, in relation to unemployment. The paper includes the analysis of the scatter plot graphs of nominal GDP in relation to unemployment, and also the analysis of descriptive statistic. The method of simple linear regression will be used when analysing the relation of nominal GDP in relation to unemployment.

AI.tldr: 本文通过简单线性回归方法分析名义GDP与失业率之间的关系，探讨经济增长与失业的宏观经济关联。
AI.research_question: 名义GDP与失业率之间存在怎样的统计关系？
AI.motivation: GDP是衡量经济增长和国民生活水平的重要指标，失业率是最重要的宏观经济参数之一，研究二者关系对宏观经济分析具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济理论中经济增长与失业率关系的理论基础，特别是奥肯定律等经典理论框架。
AI.method: 使用简单线性回归分析方法，结合散点图图形分析和描述性统计分析。
AI.findings: 通过回归分析得出名义GDP与失业率之间的具体数量关系（具体系数需等待实证结果）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为名义GDP与失业率关系提供实证证据，验证或补充现有宏观经济理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于经济增长与就业关系的定量参考，有助于制定更有效的宏观经济政策。

title: The Limits of the Offshore Oil Exploration Ban and Agricultural Sector Deal to Reduce Emissions in New Zealand
affiliations: University of Waikato, Department of Politics and Public Policy, University of Waikato, University of Raparin and Teri School of Advanced Studies

detail.title: The Limits of the Offshore Oil Exploration Ban and Agricultural Sector Deal to Reduce Emissions in New Zealand
detail.abstract:
Climate change mitigation is a common topical issue in contemporary times at global, regional and country-specific levels. It requires the formulation and implementation of national regulatory and policy regimes in different countries. At a country-specific level, this article provides a critique of New Zealand's climate policy, focusing on its frameworks for addressing
emissions from the energy and agricultural sectors. The analysis is anchored on identified issues in two key areas - the restriction of offshore petroleum production and the treatment of agricultural sector emissions. For the energy sector, we argue that the ban on new offshore oil exploration permits does not represent an optimal policy measure if onshore petroleum activities can potentially increase emissions in the country. This is, at best, a form of carbon leakage. The likelihood of shifting offshore operations to other jurisdictions with weaker regulatory regimes can also lead to carbon leakage. For agricultural sector emissions, the changes to the country's emissions trading scheme would start pricing agricultural sector emissions, which had been hitherto exempted. This addition is however weak, asthe law will likely cover only 5% of agricultural emissions, leaving 95% uncovered. This seems to undercut the ultimate objective of net-zero emissions reduction. Our analysis suggests the need to entrench a well-considered stringent regulatory regime that incentivises large-scale emissions reduction, especially in the highest emitting sectors of the New Zealand economy - agriculture and energy.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了新西兰的气候政策，重点关注能源和农业部门的排放框架。研究发现：海上石油勘探禁令可能导致碳泄漏；农业排放交易计划仅覆盖5%的排放，难以实现净零目标。建议建立更严格的监管制度来激励大规模减排。
AI.research_question: 新西兰的气候政策框架在能源和农业部门的排放管理方面存在哪些问题？如何优化这些政策以实现有效的减排目标？
AI.motivation: 气候变化减缓是全球性议题，需要各国制定和实施国家监管和政策体系。新西兰作为具体国家案例，其气候政策在关键排放部门（能源和农业）的实施效果需要批判性评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于碳泄漏理论和排放交易理论，分析政策设计的有效性和潜在缺陷。
AI.method: 批判性政策分析，重点关注能源部门的海上石油生产限制和农业部门的排放处理两个关键领域。
AI.findings: 1) 海上石油勘探禁令不是最优政策，可能导致碳泄漏；2) 农业排放交易计划仅覆盖5%的排放，力度不足；3) 现行政策难以实现净零排放目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 为碳泄漏理论提供了实证案例，揭示了政策设计中的漏洞和 unintended consequences。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新西兰政策制定者提供了具体改进建议：需要建立更严格的监管制度，激励农业和能源等高排放部门的大规模减排。

title: Education Inequalities and Returns to Schooling in Post-Liberalization Egypt
affiliations: Santa Clara University  and Ewha Womans University

detail.title: Education Inequalities and Returns to Schooling in Post-Liberalization Egypt
detail.abstract: Egypt's education system, once a pillar of social mobility through guaranteed free higher education and public sector employment, now faces significant challenges in delivering equitable outcomes, particularly for lower-income families. The neoliberal economic reforms of the 1990s gradually reduced state support for education and the public sector job guarantee, leading to diminished opportunities for quality education and stable employment. This shift has resulted in a polarized educational landscape, with high rates of both university graduates and illiteracy, alongside a severe skills mismatch that leaves many graduates-particularly those from vocational tracks-unemployed or confined to precarious, informal jobs. This study examines the persistent inequalities in education, focusing on the systemic redirection of low-wealth students toward vocational education, which has led to a decline in the quality of jobs available to graduates of this track, particularly for men. For women, the alternative often involved opting out of the labor market entirely. The study also analyzes the increasing informality and youth unemployment that followed the market reforms, distinguishing the public and private sectors, as well as formal and informal labor markets. Returns to educational attainment in terms of wage earnings as well as employment type are estimated.

AI.tldr: 埃及教育系统从社会流动支柱转变为不平等加剧的系统，新自由主义改革导致教育资源减少、职业教育质量下降，造成技能错配、青年失业率上升和就业非正规化，特别是对低收入家庭和职业教育毕业生影响严重。
AI.research_question: 埃及教育系统中的不平等如何持续存在？新自由主义经济改革如何影响教育机会和就业结果，特别是对低收入家庭和职业教育毕业生的影响？
AI.motivation: 埃及教育系统曾经通过免费高等教育和公共部门就业保障促进社会流动，但1990年代的新自由主义改革逐渐减少了国家对教育和公共部门就业的支持，导致教育机会减少、就业不稳定，形成了两极分化的教育格局。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新自由主义理论、教育不平等理论、劳动力市场分割理论、人力资本理论
AI.method: 估计教育程度对工资收入和就业类型的回报率，分析公共和私营部门以及正规和非正规劳动力市场的差异
AI.findings: 研究发现教育系统将低收入学生导向职业教育，导致该轨道毕业生就业质量下降（特别是男性），女性往往选择退出劳动力市场；市场改革后非正规就业和青年失业增加，存在严重的技能错配问题
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对新自由主义改革对教育系统和劳动力市场影响的理解，提供了教育不平等持续存在的机制分析，丰富了发展中国家教育-就业关系的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为埃及教育政策制定者提供了改革建议，帮助理解职业教育体系的问题，为改善青年就业状况提供政策依据

title: Monetary Policy, Uncertainty, and Credit Supply
affiliations: Paris School of Economics (PSE)

detail.title: Monetary Policy, Uncertainty, and Credit Supply
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how dispersion in banks' subjective inflation forecasts is a channel of the transmission of monetary policy to credit supply. We extend the Monti-Klein model of monopolistic banking by incorporating risk aversion, subjective beliefs, and ambiguity aversion. The model predicts that greater inflation uncertainty or asymmetry in beliefs raises equilibrium loan rates and amplifies credit rationing. Using AnaCredit loan-level data for France, we estimate finite-mixture density regressions that allow for latent heterogeneity in loan pricing. Empirically, we find that higher subjective uncertainty and asymmetry both increase average lending rates and skew their distribution, disproportionately affecting financially constrained firms in the right tail. Quantitatively, moving from the 25th to the 75th percentile of our indicators raises average borrowing costs by more than 10 basis points, which translates into roughly 0.5 billion euros of additional annual interest expenses for non-financial corporations. By contrast, forecast disagreement has a weaker and less systematic effect. Taken together, these results show that uncertainty and asymmetry in inflation expectations are independent and powerful drivers of credit conditions, underscoring their importance for understanding monetary policy transmission through the banking sector.

College Board Goes to Trade School The pseudo-governmental entity has entered the technical education space. Why?

title: "The Influences of Foreign Direct Investments and Remittances" the Economic Advantages Offering in Kosovo and Albanian Economy
affiliations: , University of Vlora and  SEEU University,

detail.title: "The Influences of Foreign Direct Investments and Remittances" the Economic Advantages Offering in Kosovo and Albanian Economy
detail.abstract: The aim of this study is to construct a typology which indicates strategic reaction of organizations against legal environment during the historical development of the public policies and foreign investments in Kosovo and Albania. In this study Kosovo and Albanian institutional and resource dependence perspectives are used to the prediction of strategic reactions to institutional processes. The study offers a typology of strategic reactions vary in active organizational defiance from passive deference to pro-active manipulation. The theoretical typology constructed during the study exhibits, the Albanian transition from stationary legal environment to dynamic institutional process to contribute approaches and models of strategic management. The number of immigrants and temporary workers admitted to the U.S. is the single most important factor affecting remittances. Policies that change the legal status of migrants already living in the U.S. also affect remittances by influencing how much migrants earn and how long they stay in the United States. One such policy with a particularly important effect on remittances has been temporary protected status (TPS), which allows migrants who are in the U.S. at the time of a crisis or disaster in their home country to work in the U.S. until the situation improves. Strategic changes in Kosovo and Albanian condition are basis of the study. In this paper we analyze two topics directly related to exporting and production in foreign countries to compare with foreign investments in Republic of Kosovo. The aim of this study is to analyze: (1) international trade which includes exports and imports in Republic of Kosovo, (2) foreign direct investments which international polices in Republic of Kosovo must make to establish and expand the activity components and products in Republic of Kosovo.

title: Arbitraging the US Sanction: Theory and Evidence
affiliations: Peking University - Guanghua School of Management, Department of Finance and Peking University - Guanghua School of Management

detail.title: Arbitraging the US Sanction: Theory and Evidence
detail.abstract: We document that U.S. investors exploit the 2014 sanctions on Russia by significantly increasing holdings in non-sanctioned Russian equities while Rest-of-World (ROW) investors fled, a phenomenon we term "sanction arbitrage". Building a simple two-period model with analytical solutions, we develop a theory on how U.S. investors exploit the government's need to balance geopolitical objectives against domestic welfare, leading to an asymmetric equilibrium where ROW investors exit, U.S. investors acquire assets at a discount, and ultimately redistributes wealth from ROW investors. We connect our model to three scenarios: the 2014 Russia sanctions, the 2022 Russia-Ukraine war, and the 2018 U.S.-China trade war. Our findings reveal that sanction threats can create perverse incentives, allowing domestic investors to profit from geopolitical tensions while potentially distorting foreign policy away from its intended geopolitical goals.

AI.tldr: 美国投资者利用2014年俄罗斯制裁进行"制裁套利"，在非制裁俄罗斯股票中增持，而其他国家投资者撤离。通过两期模型分析，揭示了制裁威胁可能产生扭曲激励，使国内投资者从地缘政治紧张中获利，同时可能偏离外交政策目标。

AI.method: 理论建模与实证分析相结合，通过2014年俄罗斯制裁、2022年俄乌战争和2018年中美贸易战三个案例验证模型。
AI.findings: 美国投资者在制裁期间显著增持非制裁俄罗斯股票，而其他国家投资者撤离；制裁威胁创造了扭曲的激励，允许国内投资者从地缘政治紧张中获利。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"制裁套利"理论框架，解释了制裁政策如何导致财富从外国投资者向国内投资者重新分配的不对称均衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：制裁威胁可能产生意想不到的后果，扭曲外交政策目标，需要更全面地考虑制裁措施的市场影响。

title: Household Sentiment, Intermediary Leverage, and Financial Crises
affiliations: Purdue University - Daniels School of Business

detail.title: Household Sentiment, Intermediary Leverage, and Financial Crises
detail.abstract: I document that elevated household sentiment increases households' risk exposure and is associated with lower intermediary leverage. I also show that crises are typically preceded by high sentiment and that sentiment is tightly linked to boom-bust dynamics in real activity. To explain these patterns, I develop a general-equilibrium macro-finance model with financial frictions in which households hold sentiment-driven beliefs and intermediaries face equity-capital constraints. Sentiment operates through two channels. A financing channel distorts the price of risk households require, reshaping intermediaries' funding mix and leverage. An asset-pricing channel alters consumption-saving decisions and aggregate demand for capital, moving prices and investment. The interaction of these channels delivers two paradoxical stability results: the economy becomes more stable when households are more irrational (rationality paradox) and when sentiment is more volatile (sentiment-volatility paradox).

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现家庭情绪高涨会增加家庭风险敞口并降低中介机构杠杆率，危机通常由高情绪引发且情绪与实体经济繁荣-萧条周期紧密相关。通过构建包含金融摩擦的一般均衡模型，揭示了情绪通过融资渠道和资产定价渠道影响经济，并提出了两个稳定性悖论。
AI.research_question: 家庭情绪如何通过融资渠道和资产定价渠道影响经济稳定性和金融中介杠杆？

AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含家庭情绪和金融中介约束的一般均衡模型，通过模型推导和数值模拟分析情绪对经济稳定性的影响。
AI.findings: 情绪通过融资渠道扭曲家庭风险价格要求，重塑中介融资结构和杠杆；通过资产定价渠道改变消费储蓄决策和资本总需求，影响价格和投资。两个渠道相互作用产生理性悖论和情绪波动性悖论。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了情绪影响经济的双渠道理论框架，揭示了情绪波动性与经济稳定性的非线性关系，贡献了行为宏观金融理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构识别系统性风险提供了理论依据，有助于理解情绪驱动型经济波动的机制，对金融稳定政策制定具有参考价值。

title: Empowering Private Sector in Egypt: Current Status and Way Forward

detail.title: Empowering Private Sector in Egypt: Current Status and Way Forward
detail.abstract: Egypt has made significant progress toward empowering the private sector. This progress is evident in adopting the State Ownership Policy, a framework aimed at scaling back the State’s direct involvement in non-strategic economic activities. Concurrently, Egypt is focusing on effective partnerships with the private sector. These efforts mark key strategic steps in restructuring the national economy, reflecting a clear understanding of Egypt’s current developmental needs. The Egyptian government is making determined efforts to establish a sustainable equilibrium between the roles of the State and the private sector. The reforms undertaken by the State are driven by a national vision to build an efficient and competitive economic model rather than as a response to external pressures or financing conditions. This approach is supported by positive indicators, including the increasing foreign investments and the expansion of ownership in the Egyptian stock exchange. The Egyptian State remains steadfast in pursuing private sector empowerment, primarily through sustained efforts to reinforce trust by enacting deeper institutional reforms. These reforms encompass fighting bureaucracy, streamlining tax procedures, narrowing the disparity between formal legislation and on-the-ground reality, and ensuring the equitable distribution of growth dividends across all social strata. Additionally, they include integrating small and medium-sized enterprises into the empowerment framework. The State is also accelerating the pace of digital transformation and aligning economic reforms with tangible advancements in education and innovation— measures intended to position the private sector as a principal engine of the knowledge-based economy. Building upon the foregoing, this edition of the “Policy Perspective” series, issued by the Cabinet’s Information and Decision Support Center, seeks to shed light on the current status and future outlook of private sector empowerment in Egypt. It assesses the progress in implementing the State Ownership Policy, the comprehensive reforms undertaken to enhance the business climate, and the private sector’s contribution to the national economy. Furthermore, it explores the prospective pathways for empowering the private sector in light of the Integrated National Financing Strategy, which is characterized by a flexible structure that enhances adaptability to economic shifts and fosters greater private sector engagement.

title: CONCEPTUAL THEORY OF THE DYNAMICS OF CHANGE (SWITCHING) OF PROFESSIONS AND EMPLOYMENT OF WORKERS IN THE MODERN WORLD
affiliations: Euroacademia

detail.title: CONCEPTUAL THEORY OF THE DYNAMICS OF CHANGE (SWITCHING) OF PROFESSIONS AND EMPLOYMENT OF WORKERS IN THE MODERN WORLD
detail.abstract: The subjectof the study is driven by the dynamics of the modern labor market, which is subject to the multifaceted influence of technological progress, automation, artificial intelligence (AI), and globalization. The goal of the research is professional workers whose job stability is threatened by structural economic changes. The aim of the study is to develop a new classification system based on the author's Theory of Professional Worker Relativity, which categorizes specialists according to their vulnerability to displacement. The research methods include an analysis of economic theory, structural approaches in human resource management, and practical cases of employment transformation. The results are presented as a risk assessment system for professional obsolescence and adaptation strategies, encompassing continuous learning, development of soft skills, and strengthening social protections.

title: Child Protection & UNICEF's Role in Internally Displaced Persons in Africa
affiliations: Bayero University, Kano and Benue State University, Makurdi, Nigeria

detail.title: Child Protection & UNICEF's Role in Internally Displaced Persons in Africa
detail.abstract: UNICEF has played a crucial role in addressing child protection issues among internally displaced persons (IDPs) in Africa. Despite facing challenges such as unpredictable security situations and poor communication, UNICEF has deployed various strategies to mitigate child protection risks in IDP camps. The study found a prevalence of child protection risks in IDP camps, including physical injury challenges, inadequate parental care, sexual molestation and abuse, and lack of access to basic necessities such as shelter, food, water, and clothing. UNICEF has responded by providing general care for the wellbeing of children in the camps and ensuring adequate provision of health needs, shelter, clothes, potable water, places of convenience, basic education, and other resources. The study emphasizes the need for the government to take proactive measures to prevent conflicts that lead to displacement, thereby reducing the likelihood of such events occurring in the first place. By addressing the root causes of displacement and strengthening child protection mechanisms, the government can work alongside UNICEF to ensure the safety and well-being of children in IDP camps.

title: Private Equity Valuation with Quadratic Utility: A Continuous-Time Framework
affiliations: Abu Dhabi Investment Authority and Cornell University - Operations Research & Industrial Engineering, Abu Dhabi Investment Authority

detail.title: Private Equity Valuation with Quadratic Utility: A Continuous-Time Framework
detail.abstract: This chapter presents a new approach to valuing private equity (PE) investments by developing analytical methods tailored to investors with quadratic utility preferences. It provides explicit solutions to the nonlinear partial di¤erential equations that describe the certainty (equivalent value of these investments) equations that arise from a two-dimensional Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) framework. The results take into account key features of private equity, including illiquidity, market incompleteness, and nonlinear dynamics. The chapter also includes several practical examples and calculates the optimal way to divide capital between liquid and illiquid assets.

AI.tldr: 本文为具有二次效用偏好的投资者开发了私募股权投资的估值方法，通过求解非线性偏微分方程获得确定性等价价值的显式解，考虑了流动性不足、市场不完全性和非线性动态等关键特征，并提供了资本配置的优化方案。
AI.research_question: 如何为具有二次效用偏好的投资者开发私募股权投资的估值方法？
AI.motivation: 私募股权投资具有流动性不足、市场不完全性和非线性动态等特征，传统估值方法难以准确评估其价值，需要开发专门的分析方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB)框架的二维非线性偏微分方程理论，结合二次效用函数理论。
AI.method: 开发分析性方法求解非线性偏微分方程，获得确定性等价价值的显式解，并进行数值计算和案例分析。
AI.findings: 成功获得了私募股权投资确定性等价价值的显式解，能够准确考虑流动性不足、市场不完全性和非线性动态等特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了HJB框架在私募股权投资估值中的应用，为具有特定效用偏好的投资者提供了理论分析工具。

title: Carbon Markets in China: Strategic Interactions and Corporate Adaptation
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Finance and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST)

detail.title: Carbon Markets in China: Strategic Interactions and Corporate Adaptation

declarations.funderStatement: Zhanhui Chen acknowledges the financial support from the Hong Kong Research Grants Council (GRF 16504522, GRF 16503423, and T31-603/21-N).

detail.abstract: Examining a cross section of seven regional Emission Trading System (ETS) and the national ETS in China, we explore the interplay between firms and governments. We find heterogeneous adaptation among firms. Firms in regions anticipating stringent policies reduce emissions and invest in decarbonization technology, whereas expectations of leniency lead to increased emissions. Meanwhile, governments set up more stringent carbon policies when firms decarbonize more proactively. The results are robust to allowance allocation policies, such as cap-and-trade or tradable performance standards. Our findings underscore the importance of strategic interactions between firms and governments in decarbonization.

AI.tldr: 研究分析了中国七个区域和全国碳排放交易体系，发现企业与政府之间存在战略互动：企业根据政策预期采取不同的减排行为，而政府则根据企业的减排主动性调整政策严格程度
AI.research_question: 企业与政府之间在碳排放交易体系中的战略互动关系是什么？
