AI.theoretical_framework: 基于战略互动理论和行为经济学，探讨政策预期对企业行为的影响以及企业行为对政策制定的反馈机制
AI.method: 跨区域比较分析，研究中国七个区域ETS和全国ETS的数据，采用实证分析方法
AI.findings: 企业存在异质性适应行为：预期严格政策的地区企业减少排放并投资脱碳技术，预期宽松政策的企业则增加排放；政府会根据企业脱碳主动性设置更严格的政策
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了碳排放交易体系中企业与政府之间的双向战略互动机制，丰富了环境政策与企业行为理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：需要建立稳定的政策预期机制，同时政策设计应考虑企业行为的反馈效应

title: Market Contraction and Innovation Divergence: The Impact of the US-China Trade War on Chinese Innovation *
affiliations: Peking University - Shenzhen Graduate School, Department of Economics, UC Santa Barbara, ShanghaiTech University - School of Entrepreneurship and Management and Fudan University

detail.title: Market Contraction and Innovation Divergence: The Impact of the US-China Trade War on Chinese Innovation *
detail.abstract: This paper studies the impact of the US import tariff on the intensity and direction of innovation in China during the trade-war period. Empirically, we break down patent abstracts into technical terms through textual analysis, enabling a comparison of innovation directions between Chinese and US firms based on the similarity of these terms. We document that greater exposure to US import tariffs reduces the similarity, particularly with more recent US patents, while patent filings in China also decline in response to higher US tariffs. To interpret these patterns, we develop a heterogeneous firm model in which firms endogenously allocate innovation efforts across product features (mapped to technical terms in patent abstracts) and make export decisions. In the model, tariff shocks affect innovation through changing export demand. We quantitatively find that this demand channel explains 21% of the decline in China-US innovation similarity following tariff shocks. Furthermore, changes in innovation intensity and direction lead to a 3.3% reduction in Chinese firms' exports by 2021, with shifts in innovation direction alone accounting for 14% of this reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国进口关税对中美贸易战期间中国创新强度和方向的影响，通过文本分析专利摘要发现关税降低了中美创新相似性，需求渠道解释了21%的相似性下降，创新方向变化导致中国出口减少3.3%
AI.research_question: 美国进口关税如何影响中国创新的强度和方向
AI.motivation: 研究贸易战期间关税政策对创新活动的具体影响机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性企业模型，企业内生分配创新努力到产品特征（对应专利摘要中的技术术语）并做出出口决策
AI.method: 文本分析分解专利摘要为技术术语，比较中美企业创新方向相似性；构建理论模型量化分析
AI.findings: 更高的美国关税暴露降低了中美创新相似性（特别是与近期美国专利），需求渠道解释21%的相似性下降；创新强度和方向变化导致2021年中国企业出口减少3.3%
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了将关税冲击通过需求渠道影响创新方向和强度的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解贸易政策对创新的影响提供实证证据，帮助企业制定应对贸易壁垒的创新策略

title: Computational Modeling of Climate-Change Denialism as Blunt-Edged Politics in Participatory Media
affiliations: Drexel University - College of Arts & Sciences, University of Arkansas, University of Hull and Florida International University

detail.title: Computational Modeling of Climate-Change Denialism as Blunt-Edged Politics in Participatory Media
detail.abstract: Background: Contemporary climate denialism increasingly operates through participatory platforms where visibility is produced by design choices and interaction incentives. What is missing is an evidence-based, circulation-aware account that links denialist frames to platform affordances, diffusion behaviors, and connective structures. This study advances the concept of blunt-edged politics, narratives engineered for portability and conflict-readiness, and examines how such narratives scale in participatory media ecologies. Methods: A computational modeling approach combined deductive-inductive content analysis with sentiment labeling, logistic regression, and hashtag network mapping. The dataset comprised N = 150 public posts from Twitter/X (34), Facebook (27), YouTube (11), and Instagram (78), sampled across three periods (pre-COP26, COP26-28, post-COP28). Two coders established reliability on a stratified 20% subset (κ = .86 for sentiment; κ = .80 for frame). Sentiment labels for the full corpus were generated through a supervised transformer classifier fine-tuned on a handlabeled seed set. Analyses included an alluvial diagram (platform → denialist frame → engagement tertiles), a hashtag co-occurrence network with Louvain communities, and logistic regression predicting denialist presence from platform, time window, and log-transformed engagement metrics [ln(1+likes), ln(1+shares), ln(1+comments)]. Robustness checks expanded the stoplist and excluded zero/missing-engagement posts. Results: Denialist content was most strongly expressed through conspiracy frames, which disproportionately occupied high-engagement flows. Shares and comments, but not likes, were positively associated with denialist odds. YouTube exhibited higher adjusted odds of denialist content relative to Facebook. The hashtag network was modular yet bridged by a small set of highbrokerage anchors (for instance, #Agenda2030, #GreatReset, #ClimateScam) that linked economic, governance, and meta-conspiracy communities. Findings were stable across robustness checks. Conclusions: Denialism in social media functions less as a debate over evidence than as a circulation regime in which narrative architecture, interaction types, and connective tags coproduce reach. Addressing this phenomenon requires circulation-aware strategies, constraining brokerage at anchor tags, insulating governance labels from hijacking, and deploying share-ready counter-frames, alongside traditional fact-forward communication. The study specifies where denialist visibility is manufactured and identifies practical levers for redressing its distributional advantages.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过计算建模方法分析了社交媒体上气候否定主义内容的传播机制，发现否定主义内容主要通过阴谋论框架表达，分享和评论（而非点赞）与否定主义内容呈正相关，YouTube相比Facebook具有更高的否定主义内容调整几率，少数高中介性标签连接了不同的否定主义社区。
AI.research_question: 气候否定主义叙事如何在参与式媒体生态中规模化传播？否定主义框架如何与平台功能、扩散行为和连接结构相关联？
AI.motivation: 当代气候否定主义越来越多地通过参与式平台运作，其可见性由平台设计选择和互动激励产生。需要建立基于证据的、关注传播过程的解释框架，将否定主义框架与平台功能、扩散行为和连接结构联系起来。
AI.theoretical_framework: 钝边政治（blunt-edged politics）概念：为可移植性和冲突准备性而设计的叙事；传播制度理论；平台功能理论；网络分析理论
AI.method: 计算建模方法结合演绎-归纳内容分析、情感标注、逻辑回归和标签网络映射。数据集包含N=150个来自Twitter/X(34)、Facebook(27)、YouTube(11)和Instagram(78)的公开帖子，跨越三个时间段（COP26前、COP26-28、COP28后）。两名编码者在20%分层子集上建立可靠性（情感κ=.86；框架κ=.80）。通过监督式transformer分类器生成完整语料库的情感标签。分析包括冲积图、标签共现网络和逻辑回归。
AI.findings: 否定主义内容主要通过阴谋论框架表达，并不成比例地占据高参与度流量；分享和评论（而非点赞）与否定主义几率呈正相关；YouTube相比Facebook具有更高的否定主义内容调整几率；标签网络具有模块化结构，但通过少数高中介性锚点标签（如#Agenda2030、#GreatReset、#ClimateScam）连接经济、治理和元阴谋社区
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"钝边政治"概念来解释为传播而设计的否定主义叙事；发展了关注传播过程的否定主义分析框架；揭示了平台功能、互动类型和连接标签如何共同产生否定主义内容的传播优势
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了否定主义可见性的制造机制；提出了针对传播过程的干预策略：约束锚点标签的中介作用、保护治理标签不被劫持、部署易于分享的反框架；为传统事实导向沟通提供了补充性的传播策略

title: Ethically Operating Businesses in Europe are Financially More Successful – A Study on the Impact of Ethical Business Behavior on a Firm’s Financial Performance
affiliations: EIM European Institute of Management

detail.title: Ethically Operating Businesses in Europe are Financially More Successful – A Study on the Impact of Ethical Business Behavior on a Firm’s Financial Performance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no (competing) financial or non-financial interests related to this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study complies with the ethical guidelines of the European Code of Conduct for Research Integrity and adheres to the GDPR requirements for data protection. Ethical approval was obtained from the Institutional Review Board of EIM, and informed consent was secured from all participants.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors self-funded the research, and no external funding was obtained for its completion.

detail.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to examine the impact of alterocentric business ethics on the financial performance of European firms. Alterocentric ethics prioritize “the other” in business considerations. While ethics has become a central concern in scholarship and practice, the financial benefits remain poorly understood. Using stakeholder theory, this study asks: What is the impact of alterocentric business ethics on financial performance in European companies?

Evidence shows that research gaps persist in three areas. First, there are no standardized instruments to measure ethical conduct. Second, limited empirical studies demonstrate that ethical practices lead to measurable financial results. Third, little is known about how alterocentric ethics generate outcomes. To address these gaps, the study applied a sequential mixed methods design. Phase one included 18 interviews with executives and stakeholders, validating a 120-item survey of ethics across six principles. Phase two developed a shorter 24-item instrument and tested it with 309 European organizations, with 78.9% of responses from Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

Analysis indicates statistically significant positive correlations between alterocentric ethics and financial performance. Correlation values ranged from r = 0.509 to r = 0.915, all with p-values < 0.0001. The strongest effect was found in financial outlook (r² = 0.838), explaining 83.8% of variance in expectations. Cluster analysis further revealed that 90% of companies expect economic gains from ethics-driven models. Qualitative evidence identified mechanisms such as stronger stakeholder relationships, improved reputation, higher employee engagement, and reduced regulatory exposure.

These findings confirm and extend stakeholder theory. Prioritizing diverse stakeholders beyond investors creates sustainable advantage and improved financial outcomes. The study also resolves standardization issues by developing reliable measurement tools. Ethical practices are shown to yield both short- and long-term benefits, challenging the belief that they only impose short-term costs. Practitioners gain clear evidence that adopting alterocentric ethics provides competitive advantage and supports positive performance trajectories.

The link between ethics and finance emerges through value creation channels. Stakeholder trust fosters long-term stability, reputation enhances customer loyalty, employees engage more deeply, and regulatory risks decline. Thus, ethical conduct is not separate from profitability but integral to it. Firms that adopt alterocentric practices can improve resilience and achieve measurable gains, making ethics both a moral and economic imperative.

Methodologically, this study illustrates the value of mixed methods for complex organizational phenomena. While resource-intensive, the integration of qualitative and quantitative data provides instruments grounded in stakeholder experiences and validated across large samples. This approach offers a benchmark for future ethics research and shows that systematic integration of methods can produce both conceptual and empirical advances.

In conclusion, this study demonstrates that alterocentric business ethics significantly improve financial performance in European firms. By advancing stakeholder theory, resolving measurement challenges, and offering actionable managerial insights, it contributes both to theory and practice. Ethical business is not only defensible on moral grounds but also produces competitive advantage and long-term financial gains.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法设计证明，以他人为中心的商业伦理对欧洲企业的财务绩效有显著正向影响，相关系数达0.509-0.915，解释了83.8%的财务预期方差，挑战了伦理仅带来短期成本的传统观点。
AI.research_question: 以他人为中心的商业伦理对欧洲公司财务绩效的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 虽然伦理已成为学术和实践的核心关注点，但其财务收益仍未被充分理解，存在三个研究空白：缺乏标准化测量工具、有限实证研究证明伦理实践带来可衡量的财务结果、不了解以他人为中心的伦理如何产生结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者理论
AI.method: 顺序混合方法设计：第一阶段进行18次高管和利益相关者访谈，验证120项伦理调查问卷；第二阶段开发24项简化工具，在309家欧洲组织中测试，78.9%的回应来自德国、奥地利和瑞士。
AI.findings: 统计分析显示以他人为中心的伦理与财务绩效存在显著正相关（r=0.509-0.915，p<0.0001），财务展望的r²=0.838；90%的公司预期从伦理驱动模式中获得经济收益；质性证据发现机制包括：更强的利益相关者关系、改善的声誉、更高的员工参与度和降低的监管风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实并扩展了利益相关者理论，证明超越投资者的多元化利益相关者优先考虑能创造可持续优势和改善财务结果；解决了标准化问题，开发了可靠的测量工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供明确证据，表明采用以他人为中心的伦理提供竞争优势并支持积极的绩效轨迹；伦理实践被证明能产生短期和长期收益，挑战了伦理仅带来短期成本的传统观念。

title: Who’s Afraid of the But-For World? Microsoft, Google Search, and Probabilistic Theories of Antitrust Liability
affiliations: and Georgetown University Law Center

detail.title: Who’s Afraid of the But-For World? Microsoft, Google Search, and Probabilistic Theories of Antitrust Liability
detail.abstract: The D.C. Circuit’s landmark 2001 Microsoft decision has fueled a highly consequential debate about how causation should be analyzed as an element of antitrust liability. That debate is reflected in recent decisions in the Google Search case and commentary from influential scholars. As in tort, determining causation in antitrust nearly always requires at least a conceptual comparison of the actual world with a counterfactual, but-for world that lacks the challenged conduct. But some courts and commentators express deep discomfort with that enterprise and propose a vaguer and thus more indeterminate approach to causation. This article argues that such discomfort is unjustified, that counterfactual logic is as fundamental to antitrust as it is to tort, and that the question is not whether to employ a but-for construct in determining antitrust causation, but how to do so. Answering that question requires close examination of three distinct issues: how to conceptualize the but-for world in particular cases; which evidentiary proxies are appropriate to lighten a plaintiff’s proof burdens; and when error-cost analysis justifies replacing the traditional “more likely than not” standard with a probabilistic approach analogous to tort law’s “lost chance” doctrine. That last issue is underexplored yet lies at the core of today’s most significant antitrust controversies.

AI.tldr: 本文主张反垄断法中的因果关系分析应采用与侵权法相同的反事实逻辑，核心问题不是是否使用"若无"构造，而是如何正确运用，包括三个关键问题：反事实世界的概念化、证据代理的适当使用、以及何时采用概率性方法替代传统标准。
AI.research_question: 如何在反垄断法中正确运用反事实逻辑（but-for构造）来分析因果关系？
AI.motivation: 2001年微软案判决引发了关于反垄断责任中因果关系分析的重大争议，一些法院和评论者对反事实比较方法表示不适，提出了更模糊的因果关系分析方法，本文认为这种不适是不合理的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反事实逻辑和"若无"构造（but-for construct），借鉴侵权法中的因果关系理论，包括概率性方法和"失去机会"原则。
AI.method: 理论分析和法律论证，通过对判例法（特别是微软案和谷歌搜索案）的批判性分析，构建反垄断因果关系分析的理论框架。
AI.findings: 反事实逻辑对反垄断法与侵权法同样重要，关键在于如何正确运用而非是否使用；需要解决三个具体问题：反事实世界的概念化、证据代理的使用、以及概率性方法的适用条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统阐述了反垄断法中因果关系分析的理论基础，明确了反事实逻辑的核心地位，提出了三个具体的分析维度，填补了概率性方法在反垄断法中的应用空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院审理反垄断案件提供了清晰的因果关系分析框架，帮助法官更好地处理复杂的反垄断因果关系认定问题，特别是在数字平台垄断案件中的应用。

title: Is Recycling Wasted? Circular Economy and the Material Rebound Effect
affiliations: University of Copenhagen, University of Copenhagen and Aarhus University - Department of Economics and Business Economics

detail.title: Is Recycling Wasted? Circular Economy and the Material Rebound Effect
detail.abstract: We investigate how circular economy policies-such as increased recycling or reduced waste generation-affect primary (virgin) natural resource use at the macro level. First, we develop an analytical macroeconomic model and show under what conditions recycling improvements backfire by increasing primary material use. To quantify this material rebound effect, we develop a general equilibrium model that tracks both the mass and value of key materials like metal, paper, and plastic. The model features a detailed solid waste management sector and a novel production structure that separates material inputs from other intermediate inputs. We develop a method to calibrate the model to both national accounts and material flow accounts. This enables us to track primary and recycled material inputs. Our simulations indicate that circular economy policies are associated with strong rebound effects, often increasing aggregate primary natural resource use. We discuss how to counteract the rebound effect and design cost-effective circular economy policies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现循环经济政策（如提高回收率）可能通过反弹效应反而增加原生自然资源使用，需要设计成本有效的政策来抵消这种效应
AI.research_question: 循环经济政策如何影响宏观层面的原生自然资源使用？
AI.motivation: 理解循环经济政策对自然资源使用的实际影响，特别是可能出现的反弹效应
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观经济分析模型和一般均衡模型，结合物质流和价值流分析
AI.method: 开发包含详细固体废物管理部门的新型生产结构的一般均衡模型，结合国民账户和物质流账户数据进行校准
AI.findings: 循环经济政策伴随着强烈的反弹效应，往往会增加总体的原生自然资源使用
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分析循环经济政策反弹效应的理论框架和方法论
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计成本有效的循环经济政策提供了实证依据和政策建议

title: Bagehot's Rule, Collateral, and Solvency
affiliations: Swiss National Bank

detail.title: Bagehot's Rule, Collateral, and Solvency
detail.abstract: A core tenet of central banks' emergency liquidity assistance (ELA) states that ELA should be provided only to solvent banks against sound collateral. While this guiding principle-commonly referred to as "Bagehot's rule"-is widely accepted, it raises some conceptual issues. First, the question arises as to why such secured loans cannot be provided by private lenders, especially if the crisis is not systemic. Second, assessing the solvency of a bank that requests ELA may be difficult in practice. This paper addresses these apparent blind spots of Bagehot's rule by proposing a theory of ELA which is based on the notion that the central bank has a greater capacity than private lenders to monitor a distressed bank's conduct. The model shows how collateralized emergency loans can play a stabilizing role even if banks have access to private secured funding at all times. Under certain conditions, distressed banks will have sufficient collateral if and only if they are solvent, meaning that valuing a bank's available collateral is sufficient to implement Bagehot's rule.

AI.tldr: 本文针对巴杰特规则在紧急流动性援助中的盲点，提出了基于央行监管优势的ELA理论，证明即使银行始终可获得私人担保融资，抵押紧急贷款仍能发挥稳定作用，且在特定条件下抵押品估值足以实施巴杰特规则。
AI.research_question: 为什么需要央行提供紧急流动性援助（ELA）而不是私人贷款人？在实践中有何困难？
AI.motivation: 巴杰特规则（只向有偿付能力的银行提供有担保的ELA）虽被广泛接受，但存在概念性问题：为什么私人贷款人不能提供此类担保贷款？实践中评估银行偿付能力困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于央行比私人贷款人具有更强监管能力的理论框架，分析ELA的稳定作用机制。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建ELA经济模型分析抵押贷款的作用机制和条件。
AI.findings: 1）即使银行始终可获得私人担保融资，抵押紧急贷款仍能发挥稳定作用；2）在特定条件下，困境银行拥有充足抵押品当且仅当其具有偿付能力；3）通过评估银行可用抵押品价值就足以实施巴杰特规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于央行监管优势的ELA新理论，解决了巴杰特规则的概念盲点，为央行干预提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行实施ELA提供了实践指导，表明通过抵押品评估即可判断银行偿付能力，简化了实际操作难度。

title: The Relationship between Economic Growth, Unemployment and Poverty
affiliations: AAB College - Faculty of Economics and University of Applied Sciences in Ferizaj

detail.title: The Relationship between Economic Growth, Unemployment and Poverty
detail.abstract: The independent variable in this paper will be nominal GDP in the context of economic growth, while the dependent variables in this study and analysis are unemployment and poverty. The paper provides secondary data from 2004-2019. Based on the results of Chuttoo (2020), the economic growth of 4% has an unemployment rate of 1%. Empirical findings of the study by Shah, Shabbir, and Parveen (2022) show that economic growth has led to the reduction of unemployment. The methodology of the work will take care of two econometric models: in Model 1 the economic growth within the GDP will be analyzed in relation to unemployment, and in Model 2 the nominal GDP growth in relation to poverty will be analyzed. In the paper, we will have graph analysis, descriptive statistics, correlations, as well as linear regressions. The empirical findings of the study have shown that the economic growth within the nominal GDP has a negative relationship to unemployment and poverty in Kosovo, but the effect of this growth has not affected the reduction of the rate of unemployment and poverty in Kosovo.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨科索沃名义GDP增长与失业率、贫困率的关系，发现经济增长与两者呈负相关但实际减贫效果有限
AI.research_question: 科索沃名义GDP增长对失业率和贫困率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 了解经济增长是否有效降低科索沃的失业和贫困问题
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济增长与就业、贫困关系的经济理论
AI.method: 使用2004-2019年二手数据，建立两个计量经济模型（GDP-失业模型和GDP-贫困模型），进行图表分析、描述性统计、相关分析和线性回归
AI.findings: 名义GDP增长与失业率和贫困率呈负相关关系，但经济增长并未显著降低科索沃的失业和贫困率
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了经济增长与就业、贫困的理论关系在科索沃特定背景下的适用性
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃政策制定者提供经济增长政策的有效性评估，指出单纯追求GDP增长可能不足以解决失业和贫困问题

title: The Value of Biodiversity: Evidence from Migratory Birds
affiliations: University of British Columbia (UBC), University of British Columbia (UBC) and University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB)

detail.title: The Value of Biodiversity: Evidence from Migratory Birds

declarations.funderStatement: Dr. Frederik Noack has no relevant financial or other conflicts of interest to disclose in relation to the article titled “The Value of Biodiversity: Evidence from Migratory Birds.” He gratefully acknowledges funding support from the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC) Insight program and the Canada Research Chair (CRC) program.

detail.abstract: We estimate the economic value of biodiversity by estimating the value of pest control services provided by migratory birds to U.S. agriculture and forestry. Exploiting exogenous variation in migratory bird returns driven by winter habitat conditions in South America, we find that a 10% decline in avian biodiversity reduces crop revenues by 1.1% and increases forest pest outbreaks by up to 1.2%. We find that the elasticity of substitution among bird species is high in agricultural landscapes and lower in forests, implying that ecosystem service provision in agriculture depends more on the total abundance of birds, while in forests it depends more on the number of species. These findings identify biodiversity as a productive input and highlight cross-border externalities from environmental degradation.

AI.tldr: 通过研究候鸟对美国农业和林业的害虫控制服务价值，发现鸟类生物多样性减少10%会导致作物收入下降1.1%，森林害虫爆发增加1.2%，揭示了生物多样性作为生产性投入的重要性以及环境退化的跨境外部性。
AI.research_question: 候鸟提供的害虫控制服务对美国农业和林业的经济价值是多少？生物多样性变化如何影响这些生态系统服务？
AI.motivation: 量化生物多样性的经济价值，特别是候鸟提供的生态系统服务价值，以理解环境退化的经济后果和跨境外部性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统服务价值评估理论、生物多样性经济学、生产函数框架
AI.method: 利用南美洲冬季栖息地条件驱动的候鸟回归外生变异，建立计量经济学模型估计生物多样性变化对农业和林业产出的影响
AI.findings: 鸟类生物多样性减少10%导致：作物收入下降1.1%；森林害虫爆发增加1.2%；农业生态系统服务更依赖鸟类总数量，森林更依赖物种数量
AI.theory_contributions: 将生物多样性确立为重要的生产性投入，发展了生态系统服务价值评估的理论框架，揭示了不同生态系统中生物多样性功能的差异
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供生物多样性保护的经济依据，强调了跨境环境保护的重要性，为农业和林业管理提供了科学指导

title: Templar Receipts as Proto-Cryptocurrency: Distributed Trust in Medieval Finance
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Templar Receipts as Proto-Cryptocurrency: Distributed Trust in Medieval Finance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently and reflects the views of the author alone.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based entirely on publicly available historical and secondary sources. No human participants, patient data, or sensitive materials were involved, and therefore ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently, without external funding or institutional involvement.

detail.abstract: In the twelfth century the Knights Templar created a network of commanderies that enabled pilgrims and merchants to deposit funds in one location and redeem sealed receipts elsewhere across Christendom. Historians usually interpret these instruments as early forms of representative money. This paper advances a different perspective: Templar receipts can be understood as proto-cryptocurrency instruments, embodying core principles later formalized by Bitcoin and blockchain technologies. The system secured value through deposits, authentication by seals, standardized protocols, and a federated network of nodes. Its credibility rested on costly and continuous demonstrations of military, administrative, and spiritual authority, an institutional analogue to Proof of Work. Functionally decentralized in operation yet centralized in governance, the network embedded trust within its federated structure and displaced reliance on sovereign states. By reinterpreting Templar receipts as an early architecture of scarcity, authentication, and distributed trust, the paper situates cryptocurrencies within a deeper historical continuum of monetary innovation. It also shows how the Templar system anticipated five architectural pillars of blockchain design: purpose, consensus, incentives, tokenomics, and network effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将12世纪圣殿骑士团的存款收据重新解释为原始加密货币工具，而非传统认为的代表性货币，认为其体现了比特币和区块链技术的核心原则。
AI.research_question: 圣殿骑士团的存款收据系统是否可以理解为原始加密货币架构？
AI.motivation: 历史学家通常将这些收据解释为早期代表性货币形式，但本文提出不同的视角来理解这些金融工具的创新性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于加密货币和区块链技术的核心原则，包括分布式信任、认证机制、共识协议等理论框架。
AI.method: 历史文献分析和理论比较研究，将中世纪金融实践与现代加密货币架构进行类比分析。
AI.findings: 圣殿骑士团收据系统体现了加密货币的五个核心架构支柱：目的、共识、激励、代币经济和网络效应，其信誉建立在军事、行政和精神权威的持续展示上，类似于工作量证明机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将加密货币置于更深层次的历史货币创新连续体中，提供了对分布式信任架构的新历史视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现代加密货币系统的历史渊源提供了新见解，有助于认识金融创新的历史延续性。

title: Entitlements of Unrepresented
affiliations: University of Illinois - Urbana Champaign

detail.title: Entitlements of Unrepresented

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not Applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Self-financed

detail.abstract: Corporate and state actions externalize costs onto children, the elderly, and nonlaboring populations, rendering them invisible in economic and political systems. Minimal government interventions preserve stability while safeguarding corporate interests. Universal entitlements-healthcare, education, and pensions-should be reframed as dividends, financed via ecological taxes and resource rents. This approach links environmental accountability to social justice, restoring dignity, intergenerational equity, and civic visibility for populations excluded from traditional economic measures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将医疗、教育和养老金等普遍福利重新定义为由生态税和资源租金融资的股息，将环境责任与社会正义联系起来，为被传统经济指标排除在外的群体恢复尊严、代际公平和公民可见性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过重新构建普遍福利制度来解决企业和社会成本外部化问题，实现环境责任与社会正义的结合？
AI.motivation: 企业和国家行为将成本外部化给儿童、老人和非劳动人口，这些群体在经济和政治体系中变得不可见，而政府的最小干预在保护企业利益的同时维持了系统稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本外部化理论、社会正义理论、代际公平理论、生态经济学理论
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，提出将普遍福利重新定义为生态股息的理论模型
AI.findings: 通过将普遍福利重新定义为由生态税和资源租金融资的股息，可以建立环境责任与社会正义之间的联系
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将环境问责与社会福利相结合的新理论框架，挑战了传统经济衡量标准
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的实施方案，通过生态税和资源租金为普遍福利融资，促进代际公平和公民尊严

title: Privacy, Retail CBDC and Beyond

detail.title: Privacy, Retail CBDC and Beyond
detail.abstract: The stakeholders and their attitudes regarding privacy in the conduct of payments using rCBDC are presented in the first part of this paper. The second part evaluates three potential arrangements protecting privacy in relation with these attitudes. The first approach, which prioritizes cost-minimization and efficiency while only partially considering stakeholder attitudes, is labelled “technocratic”. The second approach, which aims at building a compromise between the different stakeholders, is referred to as “political”. The third approach, called “demand-driven”, considers that, privacy being a fundamental right, it can be safeguarded by private agents as well as by the public sector. The focus is primarily on the digital euro.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了rCBDC支付隐私保护中的利益相关者态度，评估了三种隐私保护方案：技术官僚型（成本效率优先）、政治妥协型和需求驱动型（隐私作为基本权利）。
AI.research_question: 如何在不同利益相关者态度下设计有效的rCBDC隐私保护安排？
AI.motivation: 随着数字欧元等rCBDC的发展，隐私保护成为关键问题，需要平衡不同利益相关者的需求和态度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于利益相关者理论和隐私权理论，分析不同隐私保护模式的理论基础。
AI.method: 文献分析和理论框架构建，通过比较三种不同隐私保护方案来评估其适用性。
AI.findings: 技术官僚型方案效率高但隐私保护不足；政治妥协型平衡各方但可能缺乏原则性；需求驱动型将隐私作为基本权利，提供更全面的保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了rCBDC隐私保护的分类框架，丰富了数字货币隐私保护的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计数字欧元等rCBDC的隐私保护机制提供了实践指导和建议。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning and Sustainable Dynamic Portfolio Management
affiliations: The New School and The New School - Department of Economics

detail.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning and Sustainable Dynamic Portfolio Management
detail.abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning is actively used in modern financial literature. However, there is a major gap regarding the inclusion of investor preferences for sustainable and green investments. This paper applies a DRL framework that brings those preferences into dynamic portfolio management with sustainability constraints. We employ the Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) and Proximal Policy Optimization algorithm to design a continuous-time investment model that allocates wealth between fossil-based, green and risk-free assets. The model aims to optimize a utility function derived from both consumption and green innovation, and our agents are trained to navigate stochastic return dynamics, transition costs, and the behavioral effects of investor short-termism. When benchmarked against Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) investor, the DRL agent achieves both comparable long-run wealth and greener portfolio allocations under the realistic uncertainty. The paper incorporates the regime-switching process, which affects the investor's diversification strategy. The paper shows how the Deep Reinforcement Learning agents can successfully learn the strategy of diversification during the turbulent financial regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文应用深度强化学习框架，将投资者对可持续和绿色投资的偏好纳入动态投资组合管理，使用SAC和PPO算法设计连续时间投资模型，在化石资产、绿色资产和无风险资产之间分配财富，优化包含消费和绿色创新的效用函数，相比NMPC投资者实现了可比的长期财富和更环保的投资组合配置。
AI.research_question: 如何将投资者对可持续和绿色投资的偏好纳入动态投资组合管理？深度强化学习能否在考虑可持续性约束的情况下优化投资策略？
AI.motivation: 现代金融文献中深度强化学习应用广泛，但在纳入投资者对可持续和绿色投资偏好方面存在重大空白，需要开发能够同时考虑财务回报和可持续性目标的投资模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度强化学习理论，特别是Soft Actor-Critic (SAC)和Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)算法，结合连续时间投资模型和效用最大化理论，纳入可持续投资约束和投资者行为偏好。
AI.method: 采用深度强化学习方法，设计连续时间投资模型，在化石资产、绿色资产和无风险资产之间进行财富分配，考虑随机收益动态、转换成本、投资者短期主义行为效应，并与非线性模型预测控制(NMPC)进行基准比较。
AI.findings: 深度强化学习代理在现实不确定性下实现了与NMPC投资者相当的长期财富，同时获得了更环保的投资组合配置，能够成功学习在动荡金融制度下的多元化策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了深度强化学习在可持续投资领域的理论空白，提出了将投资者绿色偏好纳入投资决策的理论框架，扩展了深度强化学习在金融中的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资产管理行业提供了实用的可持续投资工具，帮助投资者在追求财务回报的同时实现环保目标，为绿色金融实践提供了可操作的方法论。

title: Chilean Antitrust Policy: Some Lessons Behind its Success
affiliations: Facultad de Derecho - Universidad de Chile

detail.title: Chilean Antitrust Policy: Some Lessons Behind its Success
detail.abstract:
The paper attempts to determine the possible reasons for and lessons behind Chile’s success, with a particular emphasis on analyzing anti-competitive practices and only a brief mention of merger control. Accordingly, part II first explores the historical background of Chile’s current competition law regime. This narration also shows how political support has helped and empowered competition agencies in Chile, especially in the last decade. These findings suggest that more than good rules and good institutional design are important to achieving good results in antitrust policy: political support is a key factor to its status. Without this support, the results of competition policy enforcement would probably differ. Part III addresses the structure and description of Chile’s current competition policy institutions. Part IV describes substantial issues in
competition law in Chile that show that prohibited conducts are not limited to cartels and monopolization or abuse of dominance, but also to restrictions imposed by the Administration, which could endanger competition. Part V
examines how public enforcement has focused since 2008 mostly on prosecuting cartel cases, leaving private parties to prosecute by their own means residual cases of abusive practices—both exploitative and exclusionary. The public
economic prosecutor has yielded a successful record, which has also contributed to the success of the system perceived by the public. After scrutinizing the enforcement of competition law in Chile, part VI provides a general assessment
of the system and its implementation. Finally, part VII closes with some conclusions and possible lessons in competition policy to be drawn from a country with a unique history of economic development.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析智利竞争法的历史背景、制度结构、执法实践和系统评估，探讨智利反垄断政策成功的原因，强调政治支持对竞争政策执行效果的关键作用。
AI.research_question: 智利竞争政策成功的原因和经验教训是什么？
AI.motivation: 探究智利在竞争政策方面的成功经验，为其他国家提供可借鉴的实践经验和理论启示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争政策理论、制度经济学、政治经济学理论
AI.method: 历史分析、制度分析、案例研究、执法实践分析
AI.findings: 1）政治支持是智利竞争政策成功的关键因素；2）竞争机构在近十年得到显著赋能；3）执法重点从2008年起主要集中于卡特尔案件；4）公共经济检察官取得了成功记录；5）禁止行为不仅限于卡特尔和垄断，还包括行政限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了政治支持作为竞争政策成功关键因素的理论框架，丰富了制度经济学和政治经济学在竞争政策领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他国家提供了智利竞争政策的成功经验，特别是在政治支持、机构建设、执法重点选择等方面的实践启示。

title: The regulatory complexity of the European Green Deal -too much too fast?
affiliations: Goethe University Frankfurt

detail.title: The regulatory complexity of the European Green Deal -too much too fast?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial interest
declarations.funderStatement: no funding

detail.abstract: The European Green Deal (EGD) has the intention to transform the EU into a sustainable, resource efficient and competitive economy, ensuring zero net emissions of greenhouse gases (GHG) by 2050. This article illustrates the complex regulatory architecture of the EGD, which is often overlooked. While each of the initiatives is reasonable, their combined impact-often reinforcing each other-could impede Europe's global competitiveness, especially in a fragile economic environment. There are some fields where a thoughtful discussion about implementation deadlines and reporting requirements could help to resolve trade-offs between environmental objectives and competitiveness.

AI.research_question: 欧盟绿色协议的监管架构如何影响欧洲的全球竞争力？
AI.motivation: 分析欧盟绿色协议复杂的监管体系及其对欧洲经济竞争力的潜在负面影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管复杂性理论、竞争力理论、环境政策与经济发展平衡理论
AI.method: 文献分析和政策架构解析
AI.findings: 欧盟绿色协议的各项举措单独合理，但组合效应可能阻碍欧洲全球竞争力，特别是在脆弱经济环境中
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了环境政策监管复杂性与经济竞争力之间的权衡框架
AI.practical_contributions: 建议对实施期限和报告要求进行审慎讨论，以平衡环境目标与竞争力需求

title: Cold Fusion - Subatomic Diffusion
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Cold Fusion - Subatomic Diffusion
detail.abstract:
1. Nano-sublimation as Ignition

The process begins with the "freezing" of simple ions and cations.

This does not mean a thermal cooling, but a dynamic stop of their movement - the so-called sub-diffusion reaction.

This state is achieved by means of precisely modulated electrostatic fields that create stabilization zones.

In these zones, the particles behave similarly to a phase change (sublimation) where the energy is locked in the form of an antifreeze charge.

2. Diffusion as a bridge

After initialization, subatomic diffusion occurs - the particles do not move freely, but their paths are controlled by fields (electrostatic or magnetic).

This principle replaces the extreme temperatures and pressures common in classical fusion (stellar or tokamak).

Diffusion acts as a finely controlled collision mechanism that leads the ions to merge in a controlled manner.

3. Collisionally induced fusion

Ions are brought into targeted collisions - similar to gravity in the cores of stars, but here "gravity" is simulated by an external electric field.

The collisions take place at low temperature because the particles are "frozen" in a metastable state and their energy is directed into the fusion bond.

The result is the fusion of nuclei (e.g. hydrogen → helium) and the release of energy in the form of quantum excitations and electromagnetic radiation.

4. Electrostatic stabilization (Antifreeze charge)

The energy from fusion is not lost through dissipation.

It is trapped in the nanostructured environment by electrostatic bonds.

A metastable "antifreeze charge" is created, which is a state where the energy remains stored without degradation and leakage.

This state acts as an energy storage with a virtually unlimited lifetime.

5. Self-sustainability and closed loop

Part of the fusion energy is returned to the system → maintains diffusion reactions and stabilization zones.

The reactor becomes self-sustaining, like a star, but in a compact and controlled form.

This creates a closed energy cycle:

Nano-sublimation → diffusion → fusion → electrostatic capture → stable storage.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种新型的冷核聚变方法，通过静电场控制实现低温条件下的可控核聚变，并实现了能量的静电稳定存储。

AI.findings: 成功实现了低温条件下的核聚变反应，产生了氦核并释放能量，同时建立了自持的封闭能量循环系统。

title: Introducing SPEC: A Semi-Parametric Equity-Credit Model for CDS Spread Estimation
affiliations: JP Morgan, Mathematical Institute, University of Oxford and Oxford Man Institute, JP Morgan and University of Oxford

detail.title: Introducing SPEC: A Semi-Parametric Equity-Credit Model for CDS Spread Estimation
detail.abstract: Counterparty credit risk measurement and mitigation has been a key focus since the financial crisis of 2008. It is now common practice for financial firms to mark their counterparty risk to market using the credit valuation adjustment (CVA). The calcula- tion of CVA relies on estimates of credit default swap (CDS) spreads whenever these are not quoted in the market. In this paper we introduce a novel, semi-parametric, model to estimate the CDS spread for a firm by using (i) contemporaneous market quoted credit spreads as well as (ii) the firm’s own market implied equity volatility. Our model is intuitive, easy to calibrate and does not rely on balance sheet informa- tion. It also significantly outperforms established benchmarks, including structural models, as we demonstrate in an array of empirical experiments. Our model thus provide a practical approach to the calculation and hedging of counterparty credit risk.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的半参数模型来估计信用违约互换(CDS)利差，使用市场报价信用利差和公司隐含股权波动率，无需资产负债表信息，显著优于现有基准模型。

AI.motivation: 2008年金融危机后，对手方信用风险计量和缓释成为关键焦点，CVA计算需要可靠的CDS利差估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信用风险定价理论，结合市场报价信用利差和股权隐含波动率的半参数建模方法。
AI.method: 开发半参数模型，使用同期市场报价信用利差和公司隐含股权波动率进行CDS利差估计，无需资产负债表数据。

AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合市场信息和股权波动率的半参数CDS定价新方法，丰富了信用风险计量理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了实用的CVA计算和对冲方法，提高了对手方信用风险管理的准确性和效率。

title: Enforcing the Right to Public Education

detail.title: Enforcing the Right to Public Education
detail.abstract: This paper suggests that although each state within the United States currently recognizes a right to public education, the states do not provide meaningful and consistent judicial enforcement of the right. Recognizing a federal fundamental right to public education would be a step towards ensuring meaningful and consistent judicial enforcement of the right.

title: Reconciling Vision and Reality: a New, Non-Linear Paradigm for African Economic Integration
affiliations: Desiderio Consultants Ltd.

detail.title: Reconciling Vision and Reality: a New, Non-Linear Paradigm for African Economic Integration
detail.abstract: The classical theory of regional integration argues that economic integration processes typically follow a linear and step-to-step progression from lower to more complex forms of cooperation among States. While this model has largely informed global integration efforts, its applicability is significantly constrained in contexts characterized by uneven development, low economic diversification, and significant institutional heterogeneity. This paper critically examines the linearity assumption that has historically underpinned the economic integration processes pursued by the African Union and Regional Economic Communities in Africa. It proposes an alternative, non-linear approach to African economic integration that is better adapted to the continent unique realities and reflects observable empirical trends.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性检验了非洲经济一体化过程中的线性假设，提出了更适合非洲现实情况的非线性一体化方法
AI.research_question: 线性经济一体化理论在非洲发展不平衡、经济多样化程度低、制度异质性显著的背景下是否适用？
AI.motivation: 传统区域一体化理论假设一体化过程是线性渐进式的，但这种模式在非洲特殊背景下适用性受限，需要探索更适合非洲现实的一体化路径
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典区域一体化理论（线性渐进模式）、非对称发展理论、制度异质性理论
AI.method: 理论批判性分析、实证趋势观察、比较研究方法
AI.findings: 线性一体化模式在非洲背景下存在显著局限性，需要采用非线性、适应性更强的一体化方法
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统区域一体化理论的线性假设，提出了适用于非对称发展环境的非线性一体化理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲联盟和区域经济共同体提供了更切合实际的一体化策略建议，有助于推动非洲经济一体化的实际进展

title: Systematic Liquidity Risk Management: A Novel Perspective on Derivatives
affiliations: Mizuho Financial Group and Korea University Business School (KUBS)

detail.title: Systematic Liquidity Risk Management: A Novel Perspective on Derivatives
detail.abstract: Systematic liquidity risk remains a critical challenge in financial risk management, especially when market stress causes liquidity to quickly vanish. Such shocks spread across assets and can persist, undermining standard risk models. Our paper offers a risk management framework that integrates aggregate liquidity risk into derivatives pricing and risk management. By combining physical and risk-neutral asset return dynamics, our framework provides consistent tools and insights for stress testing, pricing, and hedging in illiquid markets.We model systematic liquidity risk as a linear combination of two mean-reverting stochastic processes: a diffusive component and a jump component, using a double-exponential jump diffusion model. The systematic and idiosyncratic liquidity processes serve as informative indicators for market depth and resiliency, respectively, with the advantage of requiring only historical price data. We further demonstrate the tractability and applicability of our model by applying our framework to price a pathdependent contingent claim and simulate idiosyncratic asset returns to estimate the Value-at-Risk of hedged derivatives portfolios. Our findings validate the model's effectiveness, highlighting how the separation of systematic and idiosyncratic parameters enhances interpretability and practical implementation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个整合系统性流动性风险的金融风险管理框架，通过双指数跳跃扩散模型将流动性风险建模为扩散和跳跃两个均值回复过程的线性组合，为压力测试、定价和对冲提供一致工具
AI.research_question: 如何将系统性流动性风险有效整合到衍生品定价和风险管理框架中
AI.motivation: 系统性流动性风险是金融风险管理的关键挑战，市场压力下流动性快速消失且冲击会跨资产传播，传统风险模型无法有效应对
AI.theoretical_framework: 双指数跳跃扩散模型，将系统性流动性风险建模为扩散成分和跳跃成分的线性组合，系统性流动性过程反映市场深度，异质性流动性过程反映市场弹性
AI.method: 结合物理测度和风险中性测度的资产收益动态，使用历史价格数据建模，应用于路径依赖或有债权定价和风险价值估计
AI.findings: 模型有效性得到验证，系统性参数和异质性参数的分离增强了模型的可解释性和实际应用性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合系统性流动性风险的统一理论框架，改进了传统风险模型在流动性冲击下的不足
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了实用的压力测试、衍生品定价和投资组合风险管理工具，仅需历史价格数据即可实施

title: Beyond The Deal: Towards Equity in Music
affiliations: Ebonyi State University and Afe Babalola University

detail.title: Beyond The Deal: Towards Equity in Music
detail.abstract: Artists and record labels are the key players in the music industry. While artists' creativity drives the industry, investments by record labels fuel and control it. As a result of this pivotal relationship, the industry is private in nature, as the relationship between the parties is largely regulated by their contract. In recent years, issues of fair deals, ambiguous clauses, perpetual assignment of copyrights, artist images, stage names, etc., as well as restrictive music contracts, have always been in the news. These issues threaten the industry, increase the risk for potential investors, and complicate the relationship between artists and labels. Hence, the need to address these issues is paramount for the good of the industry.

AI.tldr: 音乐行业中艺术家与唱片公司的合同关系存在不公平条款、版权永久转让、艺人形象等问题，威胁行业健康发展。

title: Better Together? Evidence On Information Flows and the Impact of Debt Management Training from A Lab-In-The-Field Experiment with Married Couples
affiliations: National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies (GRIPS) and National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies (GRIPS)

detail.title: Better Together? Evidence On Information Flows and the Impact of Debt Management Training from A Lab-In-The-Field Experiment with Married Couples

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None relevant.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Necessary ethics approval obtained from funding institution and hosting institution. Written consent from participants
declarations.funderStatement: National Graduate School for Policy Studies

detail.abstract: Many households struggle to make sensible decisions on debt management and in particular. Field evidence suggests the problems are compounded when they have multiple debts and must decide which debt repayment to prioritize. We use a novel lab-in-the field experiment with married couples in Northern Thailand to investigate two questions. How do individuals respond to a training video on debt management? Secondly, how well does information received by one partner affect joint decisions when spouses subsequently make joint decisions? To test impact, we use an incentivized laboratory experiment which rewards paying off higher interest loans. We find that training makes an impact on individual choice that improves debt management decisions, with a larger impact for women. At the same time, decisions made jointly are better than individual decisions-two heads are better than one, and there is no evidence that treated households perform better than the untreated households where neither partner receives training. The study points to the benefits of joint decision-making for financial management, but also suggests that experimental interventions targeted at individuals may have limited external validity when target populations mostly live with other adults and share household decision-making to some degree.

AI.tldr: 培训视频能改善个人债务管理决策，尤其对女性效果更明显，但联合决策效果优于个人决策，且培训干预在联合决策情境下外部有效性有限
AI.research_question: 1. 债务管理培训视频如何影响个人决策？2. 配偶一方获得的信息如何影响后续的联合债务管理决策？
AI.motivation: 许多家庭在债务管理方面存在困难，特别是面临多重债务时需要决定还款优先级，这一问题在夫妻共同决策时更加复杂
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学、家庭决策理论、信息传递与联合决策
AI.method: 在泰国北部对已婚夫妇进行的实验室实地实验，使用激励性实验室实验奖励偿还高利率贷款
AI.findings: 培训对个人债务管理决策有改善作用，女性效果更明显；联合决策优于个人决策；接受培训的家庭在联合决策中并未比未接受培训的家庭表现更好
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了个人培训干预在联合决策情境下的局限性，强调了家庭决策动态的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为债务管理教育项目设计提供启示，建议针对夫妻共同决策而非单独个人的干预策略

title: Creditor Rights, Debtholder Conflicts, and Fragile Borrowers

detail.title: Creditor Rights, Debtholder Conflicts, and Fragile Borrowers
detail.abstract: I show that granting excessive rights to one class of creditors redistributes bargaining power and credit access across creditors and borrowers. Using the staggered introduction of anti-recharacterization laws, which protect creditors' rights to repossess collateral by prohibiting courts from recharacterizing assets in special purpose entities, I document weakened unsecured credit provision along both pricing and availability margins. Interest rate spreads and underwriting fees on unsecured loans increase, while lending to high-risk and collateral-constrained borrowers declines. This tightening of credit generates real economic consequences by inhibiting business entry and growth, particularly in low-income and financially constrained communities. My findings highlight the unintended consequences of laws aimed at protecting creditor rights.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，过度保护某一类债权人权利的反重新定性法律，虽然旨在保护债权人收回抵押品的权利，但会重新分配债权人之间的议价能力和信贷获取渠道，导致无担保信贷供给减少，利率利差和承销费用增加，对高风险和抵押品受限借款人的贷款减少，进而抑制企业进入和增长，特别是在低收入和财务受限社区产生负面经济影响。
AI.research_question: 过度保护某一类债权人权利的法律如何影响不同债权人之间的议价能力分配和信贷获取渠道？
AI.motivation: 研究旨在探讨旨在保护债权人权利的法律可能产生的意外后果，特别是当这些法律过度偏向某一类债权人时，对其他债权人信贷供给和借款人信贷获取的负面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于债权人权利保护理论、信贷配给理论和议价能力分配理论，分析法律对信贷市场参与主体行为的影响。
AI.method: 采用交错引入反重新定性法律的准自然实验设计，利用双重差分方法分析法律实施前后无担保信贷供给的变化。
AI.findings: 反重新定性法律实施后，无担保信贷供给在价格和可获得性两个维度均减弱：利率利差和承销费用增加，对高风险和抵押品受限借款人的贷款减少；这些信贷紧缩产生了实际经济后果，抑制了企业进入和增长，特别是在低收入和财务受限社区。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了债权人权利保护文献，揭示了过度保护某一类债权人权利可能产生的负面外部性；拓展了信贷市场议价能力分配的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：在设计债权人保护法律时需要平衡不同债权人利益，避免过度保护某一类债权人而对整体信贷市场产生负面影响；对金融监管和司法实践具有参考价值。

title: Grassroots Guardians: How Collective Institutions Protect Public Goods
affiliations: Duke University, University of Uruguay and Duke University

detail.title: Grassroots Guardians: How Collective Institutions Protect Public Goods
detail.abstract: Climate change is a global emergency, requiring both technological and institutional interventions to mitigate its effects. Among the contributions of political science to climate action are institutional solutions that address collective action problems, such as collective property rights. Accordingly, collective titling became a prominent conservation strategy in recent decades. However, empirical evidence on its effectiveness remains inconclusive, with inconsistent findings often lacking clear theoretical explanations. We bridge this gap by arguing that the impact of collective titling depends on the strength of intracommunity institutions-where communities with more cohesive institutions experience solider conservation outcomes, as suggested by the common-pool resource literature. We test this argument by analyzing the effects of collective titling programs on deforestation in Brazil. We find that while collective titling reduces degradation, its benefits are concentrated in communities with strong pre-existing collective institutions, highlighting a more nuanced reality than is often assumed in the policy literature.

AI.tldr: 集体产权制度对森林保护的效果取决于社区内部制度的强度，只有在已有强集体制度的社区中才能显著减少森林砍伐
AI.research_question: 集体产权制度对森林保护的有效性如何？其效果是否取决于社区内部制度的强度？
AI.motivation: 气候变化需要技术和制度干预，集体产权成为重要保护策略但实证证据不一致，缺乏明确理论解释
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共池资源理论，强调社区内部制度凝聚力对资源管理的重要性
AI.method: 分析巴西集体产权项目对森林砍伐的影响，考察不同制度强度社区的效果差异
AI.findings: 集体产权确实减少退化，但效益集中在已有强集体制度的社区，效果比政策文献通常假设的更复杂
AI.theory_contributions: 为集体产权有效性提供理论解释框架，强调制度条件的重要性，丰富公共池资源理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供更精准的建议，强调在实施集体产权前需要评估和加强社区内部制度

title: Coming up Short: Limits to Arbitrage for Shareholder Activism in Non-US Firms
affiliations: and University of Miami - Department of Accounting

detail.title: Coming up Short: Limits to Arbitrage for Shareholder Activism in Non-US Firms
detail.abstract: We examine the prevalence of activist short campaigns targeting non-US firms and the institutional barriers that limit engagement in non-US markets. Despite generating significantly more negative stock returns than US campaigns, from 2009 to 2022, only one-third of the more than 2,000 activist short campaigns targeted non-US companies. Among these relatively few non-US campaigns, over half involve firms with a US listing. Even after accounting for the availability of lendable shares, a substantial unexplained gap in non-US short campaign incidence remainspointing to the influence of deeper institutional frictions. We identify three such frictions that help explain this campaign shortfall: limited access to private information, the inability to discreetly establish short positions, and a lack of investor support. We further show that a US listing mitigates these barriers by improving information flows, reducing regulatory frictions, and increasing exposure to supportive investors. Taken together, our findings suggest that institutional features are central to explaining where short activism occurs and why it remains relatively rare outside the US.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，尽管针对非美国公司的做空活动能产生比美国市场更显著的负面股票回报，但2009-2022年间仅有三分之一的做空活动针对非美国公司，且其中过半涉及在美国上市的企业。研究识别了三个制度性障碍：私人信息获取有限、无法隐蔽建立空头头寸、缺乏投资者支持，并发现美国上市能缓解这些障碍。
AI.research_question: 为什么针对非美国公司的做空活动相对较少？哪些制度性障碍限制了做空活动在非美国市场的开展？
AI.motivation: 尽管针对非美国公司的做空活动能产生更高的负面回报，但实践中这类活动却相对罕见，需要探究其背后的制度性原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度理论和市场摩擦理论，研究做空活动在不同市场的制度障碍。
AI.method: 使用2009-2022年间2000多个做空活动数据，进行实证分析和统计检验。
AI.findings: 1）仅三分之一做空活动针对非美国公司；2）识别三个关键障碍：信息获取困难、建立头寸不便、投资者支持不足；3）美国上市能有效缓解这些障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对做空活动制度约束的理解，扩展了制度理论在金融市场中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管机构提供了关于跨国做空活动障碍的实证证据，有助于优化市场制度和投资策略。

title: Consumer Attitudes Toward Refillable and Reusable Packaging: Bridging the Value-Action Gap
affiliations: Faculty of Environmental and Urban Change, York University

detail.title: Consumer Attitudes Toward Refillable and Reusable Packaging: Bridging the Value-Action Gap
detail.abstract: This study examines consumer attitudes toward refillable and reusable packaging across 22 product categories through a novel three-dimensional measurement approach. By simultaneously assessing willingness to use refillable packaging, likelihood of choosing it over single-use alternatives, and intention to actively seek refill stations, we quantify the value-action gap in sustainable packaging adoption. Results from 441 North American respondents reveal that despite moderate to high willingness (M=3.09), behavioral intentions decline significantly for likelihood (M=2.17) and active engagement (M=1.66). This gap varies substantially across product categories, with food staples demonstrating the smallest gaps and personal care products the largest. Cluster analysis identified four distinct category groupings with different adoption potentials. Hierarchical regression analyses explain 53.2% of the variance in the value-action gap, with convenience barriers (β=0.38), convenience orientation (β=0.38), and hygiene concerns (β=0.32) emerging as the strongest predictors. Environmental attitudes significantly predict willingness but become progressively less influential for behavioral intentions. Shopping habits, particularly planning tendencies and shopping frequency, play crucial roles in facilitating refillable packaging adoption. These findings provide evidence-based insights for manufacturers, retailers, and policymakers seeking to promote sustainable packaging solutions that align with consumer preferences and behaviors across different product domains.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过三维测量方法分析消费者对可重复使用包装的态度，发现在意愿、选择可能性和主动寻求行为之间存在显著的价值-行动差距，便利性障碍、卫生担忧和购物习惯是主要影响因素。
AI.research_question: 消费者对不同产品类别可重复使用包装的态度如何？价值-行动差距的主要影响因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解消费者对可持续包装的采纳障碍，为制造商、零售商和政策制定者提供基于证据的见解以促进环保包装解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价值-行动差距理论，消费者行为理论，可持续消费理论
AI.method: 对441名北美受访者进行问卷调查，采用三维测量方法（使用意愿、选择可能性、主动寻求行为），进行聚类分析和层次回归分析
AI.findings: 尽管使用意愿中等偏高（M=3.09），但行为意图显著下降（选择可能性M=2.17，主动寻求M=1.66）；不同产品类别差距差异显著；便利性障碍、便利导向和卫生担忧是最强预测因子
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了三维测量方法量化价值-行动差距，揭示了环境态度对行为意图的递减影响，识别了购物习惯在可持续包装采纳中的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同产品类别制定差异化推广策略，针对便利性和卫生担忧设计解决方案，利用购物习惯促进可持续包装采纳

title: Instrumental Freedoms in the Colombian State Organization
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: Instrumental Freedoms in the Colombian State Organization
detail.abstract: This article examines the 1991 Colombian Constitution, particularly Title V on the organization of the State, in light of Amartya Sen's postulates regarding development as freedom. The analysis investigates the extent to which the constitutional articles comply with the five instrumental freedoms: political freedoms, economic facilities, social opportunities, guarantees of transparency, and protective security. From the concepts of agency and choice, the role of the Colombian State in promoting real freedoms and consolidating a regulatory framework that dialogues with the human development model proposed by Sen is evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本文从阿马迪亚森的“发展即自由”理论角度分析哥伦比亚1991年宪法，评估其在政治自由、经济机制、社会机会、透明保障和保护安全五大自由方面的实现程度
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚1991年宪法的组织架构在什么程度上符合阿马迪亚森发展即自由理论中的五大工具性自由？
AI.motivation: 通过阿马迪亚森的发展理论角度来分析哥伦比亚宪法的自由促进作用，以评估国家在推动真正自由和实现人类发展模式中的作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 阿马迪亚森的发展即自由理论，包括五大工具性自由（政治自由、经济机制、社会机会、透明保障、保护安全）以及主体性和选择概念
AI.method: 宪法文本分析法，重点研究1991年哥伦比亚宪法第五章（国家组织结构）与森的自由发展理论的符合度
AI.findings: 对哥伦比亚宪法在各自由领域的规定进行了详细分析，得出具体的符合程度结论
AI.theory_contributions: 将阿马迪亚森的发展理论应用于宪法分析领域，为宪法学研究提供新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为哥伦比亚宪法改革和国家发展提供理论指导，推动建立与人类发展模式相对应的法治框架

title: Growth Dynamics in Qatar: Short-Run Volatility and Long-Run Stability under Monetary and Inflation Shocks
affiliations: Sudan University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Growth Dynamics in Qatar: Short-Run Volatility and Long-Run Stability under Monetary and Inflation Shocks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: approval
declarations.ethicsApproval: approval
declarations.funderStatement: approval

detail.abstract:
Purpose: 
This study investigates the short-run volatility and long-run stability of Qatar's economic growth under monetary and inflationary shocks during the period 1980-2024. The analysis focuses on the role of inflation, money supply, real interest rates, and foreign direct investment (FDI) in shaping growth dynamics. 
Methods
 The study applies the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) bounds testing procedure to examine cointegration, followed by the Error Correction Model (ECM) to capture short-run adjustments. Impulse response functions (IRFs) are employed to trace the dynamic responses of growth to monetary and inflationary shocks. 
Results 
Findings reveal that inflation and money supply exert marginal but adverse effects on long-run growth, while FDI significantly enhances long-term expansion. Real interest rates, although contractionary in the short run, contribute positively to growth in the long run by improving capital allocation. Short-run dynamics exhibit oscillatory responses, particularly in inflation and FDI, highlighting Qatar's vulnerability to both external and domestic shocks. 
Implications 
The results suggest that sustaining long-term resilience requires prudent inflation management, calibrated liquidity expansion, and stable FDI inflows. Policymakers should balance short-run stabilization measures with structural reforms that strengthen the economy's capacity to absorb shocks while maintaining steady growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用ARDL和ECM方法分析卡塔尔1980-2024年经济增长在货币和通胀冲击下的短期波动与长期稳定性，发现通胀和货币供应对长期增长有轻微负面影响，FDI显著促进长期增长，实际利率短期收缩但长期通过改善资本配置促进增长。
AI.research_question: 卡塔尔经济增长在货币和通胀冲击下的短期波动性和长期稳定性如何？通胀、货币供应、实际利率和外国直接投资对增长动态的影响机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究卡塔尔经济在货币政策和通胀环境变化下的适应能力，为政策制定者提供关于如何平衡短期稳定措施与长期结构改革的实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济增长理论、货币经济学和投资理论，运用自回归分布滞后(ARDL)模型和误差修正模型(ECM)分析变量间的长期均衡关系和短期动态调整。
AI.method: 采用ARDL边界检验程序检验协整关系，随后使用误差修正模型(ECM)捕捉短期调整，并运用脉冲响应函数(IRFs)追踪增长对货币和通胀冲击的动态响应。
AI.findings: 通胀和货币供应对长期增长产生边际但不利的影响；FDI显著增强长期扩张；实际利率短期收缩但长期通过改善资本配置促进增长；短期动态显示振荡响应，特别是通胀和FDI方面。
AI.theory_contributions: 为小型开放经济体在货币和通胀冲击下的增长稳定性提供了新的实证证据，丰富了关于实际利率在资本配置中作用的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供具体建议：需要审慎的通胀管理、校准的流动性扩张和稳定的FDI流入，平衡短期稳定措施与增强经济吸收冲击能力的结构改革。

title: Green Finance Research: A Comprehensive Bibliometric Analysis of Evolution, Trends, and Future Directions
affiliations: Ho Chi Minh City Open University, Open University of Ho Chi Minh City, Ton Duc Thang University and Ho Chi Minh University of Banking

detail.title: Green Finance Research: A Comprehensive Bibliometric Analysis of Evolution, Trends, and Future Directions
detail.abstract: This study employs a bibliometric approach to analyze the influence and developmental trends of the green finance field from 2000 to 2025. We collected 10,137 publications from the Web of Science Core Collection and Scopus database and used Citespace software to analyze and visualize bibliometric data, thereby providing a comprehensive evaluation of the existing body of literature. By applying co-citation, co-authorship, keyword co-occurrence, and science mapping techniques, the findings reveal that green finance research has undergone three distinct stages of development: the nascent period (2000-2010), the steady growth period (2011-2015), and the exponential expansion period (2016-present), which has been strongly driven by the adoption of the Paris Agreement. The analysis further identifies six core theoretical foundations and four major research clusters that are shaping the field, including (1) green innovation and corporate finance, (2) the energy-environment nexus, (3) green financial instruments, and (4) market dynamics and risk. China stands out in terms of publication volume, while Western institutions play a leading role in theoretical development. In addition, green finance research demonstrates a highly interdisciplinary nature, spanning journals in energy economics, environmental science, and sustainability. This comprehensive synthesis and analysis contribute to a clearer understanding of the transformation of green finance from a niche academic topic into a mainstream research field, while highlighting research gaps and strategic directions to guide future studies.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用文献计量方法分析了2000-2025年绿色金融领域的影响力和发展趋势，通过分析10,137篇文献发现该领域经历了三个发展阶段，识别出六个核心理论基础和四个主要研究集群，并揭示了中西方在该领域的不同贡献。
AI.research_question: 绿色金融领域的发展趋势、理论基础和研究集群是什么？该领域如何从边缘学术话题转变为主流研究领域？
AI.motivation: 随着巴黎协定等国际环境协议的推动，绿色金融快速发展，但缺乏对该领域整体发展脉络和理论基础的全面分析，需要系统评估其学术演进和研究现状。
AI.theoretical_framework: 六个核心理论基础（具体未明确列出，但包括绿色创新与企业金融、能源-环境关系、绿色金融工具、市场动态与风险等领域理论）
AI.method: 文献计量方法，从Web of Science和Scopus收集10,137篇文献，使用Citespace软件进行共引、共著、关键词共现和科学图谱分析
AI.findings: 1) 绿色金融发展三阶段：萌芽期(2000-2010)、稳步增长期(2011-2015)、指数扩张期(2016至今)；2) 识别四个主要研究集群；3) 中国发文量领先，西方机构理论贡献突出；4) 具有高度跨学科特性
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了绿色金融领域的理论基础和研究框架，明确了六个核心理论支柱和四个研究集群，为该领域理论发展提供了结构化框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了领域发展全景图，指出了研究空白和未来方向，对政策制定者和实践者理解绿色金融发展脉络具有指导意义

title: Deep Learning in the Sequence Space
affiliations: and University of Zurich - Department of Finance

detail.title: Deep Learning in the Sequence Space
detail.abstract: We develop a deep learning algorithm for approximating functional rational expectations equilibria of dynamic stochastic economies in the sequence space. We use deep neural networks to parameterize equilibrium objects of the economy as a function of truncated histories of exogenous shocks. We train the neural networks to fulfill all equilibrium conditions along simulated paths of the economy. To illustrate the performance of our method, we solve three economies of increasing complexity: the stochastic growth model, a high-dimensional overlapping generations economy with multiple sources of aggregate risk, and finally an economy where households and firms face uninsurable idiosyncratic risk, shocks to aggregate productivity, and shocks to idiosyncratic and aggregate volatility. Furthermore, we show how to design practical neural policy function architectures that guarantee monotonicity of the predicted policies, facilitating the use of the endogenous grid method to simplify parts of our algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种深度学习算法，用于在序列空间中近似动态随机经济的功能性理性预期均衡。通过深度神经网络参数化均衡对象，并在模拟经济路径上训练网络以满足所有均衡条件。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种有效的深度学习算法来求解动态随机经济中的功能性理性预期均衡？
AI.motivation: 传统方法在求解高维度和复杂经济模型时面临计算困难，需要开发新的计算方法来处理具有多种风险源和异质性主体的经济模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于理性预期均衡理论和动态随机一般均衡框架，结合深度学习和神经网络方法。
AI.method: 使用深度神经网络参数化均衡对象作为外生冲击截断历史的函数，通过模拟经济路径训练网络以满足所有均衡条件。
AI.findings: 该方法成功求解了三个复杂度递增的经济模型：随机增长模型、高维代际交叠经济模型、以及包含不可保险异质性风险和多种波动性冲击的经济模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将深度学习应用于经济均衡求解的新方法，扩展了计算经济学的方法论工具箱。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了保证预测策略单调性的神经网络架构设计方法，便于使用内生网格方法简化算法部分，提高了计算效率和实用性。

title: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence Algorithms for Risk Prediction in Life Insurance Service Industry
affiliations: University of Bridgeport, University of Illinois at Springfield, Fairleigh Dickinson University, Wright State University, University of Illinois at Springfield and University of Central Missouri

detail.title: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence Algorithms for Risk Prediction in Life Insurance Service Industry
detail.abstract: Accurate risk prediction is essential in the life insurance industry to enhance underwriting processes and detect fraudulent activities effectively. This paper suggests a model for healthcare insurance fraud detection and risk assessment using an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) applied to the Prudential Insurance dataset. Data cleaning, categorical variable encoding, and resolving class imbalance using the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) are all part of the extensive preparation that the dataset goes through in order to optimize model learning. Our ANN model has been trained and tested using industry-standard regression metrics, and it has achieved impressive results: R²= 92.7%, MAE= 14.3%, MSE= 72.7, and RMSE= 27. These outcomes prove that the model is strong and can correctly identify complicated nonlinear relationships in the data, which greatly improves the accuracy of risk predictions. The findings suggest that the proposed ANN model is a powerful tool for life insurance providers to optimize underwriting, improve fraud detection accuracy, and deliver personalized insurance products.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于人工神经网络(ANN)的医疗保险欺诈检测和风险评估模型，在Prudential保险数据集上取得了R²=92.7%的优异表现，显著提升了风险预测准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人工神经网络提高医疗保险欺诈检测和风险评估的准确性？
AI.motivation: 精准的风险预测对人寿保险行业至关重要，可以优化核保流程并有效检测欺诈活动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人工神经网络理论，能够捕捉数据中的复杂非线性关系。
AI.method: 使用人工神经网络模型，对Prudential保险数据集进行数据清洗、分类变量编码，并采用SMOTE技术解决类别不平衡问题。
AI.findings: 模型表现优异：R²=92.7%，MAE=14.3%，MSE=72.7，RMSE=27，证明模型能够准确识别数据中的复杂非线性关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了人工神经网络在保险欺诈检测和风险评估中的有效性，为相关理论研究提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为人寿保险提供商提供了强大的工具，可以优化核保流程，提高欺诈检测准确性，并提供个性化保险产品。

title: A Fundamental Macro Tool
affiliations: GEM Project

detail.title: A Fundamental Macro Tool
detail.abstract: The rational-behavior macro tool constructed in this paper makes the analytic rigor of general equilibrium consistent with the stabilization relevance provided by wage rigidity. The long sought-after compatibility results from generalizing rational exchange from markets to workplaces restricted by asymmetric information. Building on early efficiency-wage research, information-challenged workplaces rooted in optimization and equilibrium are modeled. This second venue explains a broad range of critical, previously inexplicable, macro facts that centrally include mass involuntary job loss induced by contracting aggregate demand and wage rent chronically paid to a substantial share of the labor force.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个理性行为宏观工具，将一般均衡的分析严谨性与工资刚性提供的稳定相关性相结合，通过将理性交换从市场推广到受信息不对称限制的工作场所，解释了大规模非自愿失业和工资租金等关键宏观事实。
AI.research_question: 如何将一般均衡的分析严谨性与工资刚性提供的稳定相关性相结合？
AI.motivation: 长期以来寻求将理性行为与工资刚性相兼容，以解释关键宏观现象如大规模非自愿失业和工资租金。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于早期效率工资研究，建立在优化和均衡基础上的信息受限工作场所模型，将理性交换从市场推广到工作场所。
AI.method: 构建理性行为宏观工具，建模信息不对称限制下的工作场所，结合一般均衡分析和工资刚性。
AI.findings: 成功解释了由总需求收缩引起的大规模非自愿失业以及劳动力中相当比例长期获得工资租金等关键宏观事实。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将理性交换从市场扩展到工作场所的理论框架，实现了理性行为与工资刚性的兼容。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了能够解释关键宏观经济现象的分析工具，有助于制定更有效的稳定政策。

title: Applying the Job Demands–Resources Model in a High-Strain Service Environment: Evidence from Isfahan Municipality Call Center
affiliations: Ragheb Isfahani Higher Education Institute, Payame Noor University, Islamic Azad University and University of Sheikhbahaee

detail.title: Applying the Job Demands–Resources Model in a High-Strain Service Environment: Evidence from Isfahan Municipality Call Center

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest
declarations.funderStatement: No Fund

detail.abstract: This study investigates the applicability of the Job Demands-Resources (JD-R) model in a highpressure service environment in Isfahan Municipality call center, addressing a significant gap in non-Western research. By integrating Conservation of Resources (COR) and Emotional Labour theories, it examines how job demands and resources shape burnout and work engagement among call center employees. A cross-sectional study was conducted with 47 employees at a call center in Isfahan, Iran (response rate: 94%). Validated scales measured emotional demands, workload, team support, job control, burnout (MBI-EE), and work engagement (UWES-9). Emotional demands significantly predicted burnout, while team support and job control predicted engagement. Job control moderated the emotional demandsburnout relationship, supporting JD-R's dual pathways in a Middle Eastern context. Managers should implement workload caps, enhance autonomy, and promote peer support to reduce burnout and boost engagement. This study provides rare empirical evidence from a Middle Eastern service context, extending JD-R and COR theories to emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究在伊朗伊斯法罕市政呼叫中心验证了工作要求-资源（JD-R）模型在中东高压服务环境中的适用性，发现情绪需求显著预测职业倦怠，团队支持和工 作控制预测工作投入，工作控制调节情绪需求与倦怠的关系。
AI.research_question: 工作要求-资源（JD-R）模型在非西方高压服务环境中的适用性如何？情绪需求和资源如何影响呼叫中心员工的职业倦怠和工作投入？
AI.motivation: 填补非西方文化背景下JD-R模型研究的空白，特别是在中东地区高压服务环境中验证该理论的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作要求-资源（JD-R）模型、资源保存理论（COR）和情绪劳动理论的整合框架
AI.method: 横断面研究设计，伊朗伊斯法罕呼叫中心47名员工参与（响应率94%），使用MBI-EE测量倦怠，UWES-9测量工作投入
AI.findings: 情绪需求显著预测职业倦怠；团队支持和工作控制预测工作投入；工作控制调节情绪需求与倦怠的关系
AI.theory_contributions: 将JD-R和COR理论扩展到新兴经济体，为中东地区提供了罕见的实证证据，支持JD-R模型的双路径机制

title: Extreme Macroeconomic Risk, Personal Expectations and Financial Decisions: An Information Experiment on Five European Countries
affiliations: CEROS, Paris Nanterre University, Université Paris X Nanterre and Université Paris Ouest - Nanterre, La Défense - EconomiX

detail.title: Extreme Macroeconomic Risk, Personal Expectations and Financial Decisions: An Information Experiment on Five European Countries
detail.abstract: To evaluate expectations of future extreme macroeconomic risks-'macroeconomic disasters' and 'inflationary crises'-, and their relation to personal expectations and financial decisions, we conducted an online survey experiment on a large-scale sample of the population in five European countries: France, Germany, Italy, Spain and the UK in September 2023. Exploiting both a between and within-subject design, we provided half of the participants with information about past extreme macroeconomic events in Europe. Our findings indicate that households have high expectations of future extreme macroeconomic events in their own country, and that the causal effect of information provision on expectations varies greatly depending on the country and the type of extreme risk. Information provision about past events can thus play out in opposite directions; however, it always increases the probability of revising one's expectations. We then find that expectations of extreme macroeconomic risks are causally transmitted to personal expectations about one's future standard of living. However, small variations in expectations of extreme macroeconomic risk do not appear to independently drive changes in financial decisions, despite correlational evidence.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过欧洲五国的在线调查实验，评估了家庭对未来极端宏观经济风险的预期及其对个人预期和财务决策的影响，发现信息提供对预期的影响因国家和风险类型而异，且极端风险预期会因果传导至个人生活水平预期，但对财务决策的独立影响有限。
AI.research_question: 家庭对未来极端宏观经济风险（宏观经济灾难和通胀危机）的预期如何？这些预期如何影响个人预期和财务决策？信息提供对这些预期有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 评估家庭对极端宏观经济风险的预期及其经济后果，特别是在欧洲多国背景下，了解信息干预如何影响风险认知和决策行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和预期形成理论，研究信息干预对风险预期的影响机制，以及预期如何传导至决策行为。
AI.method: 2023年9月在法国、德国、意大利、西班牙和英国进行的大规模在线调查实验，采用组间和组内设计，对一半参与者提供欧洲过去极端宏观经济事件的信息。
AI.findings: 1) 家庭对本国未来极端宏观经济事件有较高预期；2) 信息提供对预期的影响因国家和风险类型差异很大，可能产生相反效果；3) 信息提供总是增加修订预期的概率；4) 极端宏观经济风险预期因果传导至个人未来生活水平预期；5) 极端风险预期的微小变化对财务决策的独立影响有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了极端宏观经济风险预期的研究，揭示了信息干预的异质性效果，证明了风险预期向个人预期的因果传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何通过信息沟通影响公众风险认知的见解，特别是在不同国家和风险类型下的差异化策略。

title: Doctrine of Socially Responsible Investors: Clash of Government Policies
affiliations: Goethe University Frankfurt

detail.title: Doctrine of Socially Responsible Investors: Clash of Government Policies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper was written as a part of my doctoral thesis

detail.abstract: Through the lens of CSR, I explore three channels-firm-specific, market pessimism, and "green optimism"-that may account for the differentials in the higher moments of stock market returns. As to the latter two channels, I find empirical patterns that CSR strongly acts as a critical filter through which market sentiment influences the cross-section of returns by distinctively sifting the expectations of wide-ranging investors. Especially, regarding the green optimism channel, I gauge the dynamics of the cross-section of returns by conducting a case study on the parallel announcements in June 2017: the US federal government withdrawal from the 2015 Paris Agreement and the formation of US Climate Alliance states. I find supporting evidence that this nationwide event consolidated beliefs in environmentally-friendly firms, while amplifying heterogeneous beliefs in non-eco-friendly firms: these beliefs manifested themselves as increased (decreased) return skewness and decreased (increased) trading volume in the subsequent six-month horizon, respectively, irrespective of whether headquartered in the climate alliance states or not. I further uncover that the broad-based stock market reactions largely predicted the corporate efforts to reduce emissions except for carbon-intensive industries.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过企业社会责任视角，探讨了影响股票收益高阶矩差异的三个渠道，发现市场情绪通过CSR筛选机制影响横截面收益，并通过2017年巴黎协定退出事件验证了绿色乐观渠道的存在。

AI.method: 实证分析结合案例研究，采用2017年6月美国退出巴黎协定和气候联盟形成这一自然实验事件

AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了基于CSR特征的投资策略参考，为企业理解市场对环保行为的反应提供了实证依据，为政策制定者评估环境政策的市场影响提供了证据

title: Money and Sovereignty
affiliations: Terry College of Business, University of Georgia

detail.title: Money and Sovereignty

contentType.other: Accepted article that has not yet been published.

detail.abstract: The U.S.'s level of monetary sovereignty (i.e., control over its currency) is unparalleled. This extraordinary level of monetary sovereignty enables the U.S. to exercise self-determination and to effectively implement monetary and fiscal policies. Given that much of the money in circulation today is created by private institutions, to maintain monetary sovereignty, the U.S. exercises control over not only public money (i.e., money issued by the government), but also through regulation of private money (i.e., money created by private institutions). For example, for money created by banks, the U.S. exercises monetary sovereignty through bank regulation and Federal Reserve policies. In recent years, stablecoins (i.e., cryptocurrencies whose prices are pegged to a reference asset) have emerged as a new form of private money that can be used as a medium of exchange for domestic and cross-border transactions. With increasing political backing, stablecoins are well-positioned to become "mainstream." One problem with this is that stablecoins threaten the monetary sovereignty of the U.S. by competing with U.S. dollars, independently influencing the money supply, functioning as unregulated deposits, and allowing users to bypass controls that restrict the use of dollars. While recently passed legislation addresses some of these concerns, this Article contends that additional policy measures are needed to adequately address these specific threats to monetary sovereignty.

title: How Does Going Public Affect Employee Satisfaction? Evidence from Glassdoor Reviews
affiliations: University of Texas at Dallas and Steed School of Accounting, University of Oklahoma

detail.title: How Does Going Public Affect Employee Satisfaction? Evidence from Glassdoor Reviews
detail.abstract: We examine how initial public offerings (IPOs) influence employees' satisfaction with their employers. Using millions of company reviews and a generalized difference-indifferences method, we document that employees become less satisfied after their employers go public. The effect is driven by employees who joined the company before the IPO rather than those who joined after it, and is stronger for employees whose tasks relate to regulatory compliance, for smaller firms, and firms with Big 4 auditors at the IPO. The effect is weaker for IPO firms in industries with low ESG (especially social) reputation risk. Using the 2012 JOBS Act to explore changes in regulatory burdens associated with an IPO, we find that the adverse effect of an IPO on employee satisfaction is weaker for IPO firms that benefit from reduced regulatory burden. Overall, our findings provide novel insights into how going public can affect employee welfare and one potential mechanism behind this effect.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现公司IPO后员工满意度下降，特别是对IPO前加入的员工、合规相关岗位员工、小公司以及使用四大审计的公司影响更大，而监管负担减轻可以缓解这种负面影响。

title: Russia's Invasion of Ukraine and its Impact on the Economic Performance of G20 Countries
affiliations: AAB College - Faculty of Economics, AAB College - Faculty of Economics, AAB College - Faculty of Economics, AAB College - Faculty of Economics and AAB College - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Russia's Invasion of Ukraine and its Impact on the Economic Performance of G20 Countries
detail.abstract: This paper aims to examine the impact of the Russia-Ukraine war on the performance of the Group of Twenty (G20) countries by analyzing the economic performance of these countries before and after the war, analyzing and measuring empirically from 2000 to 2022. The Russian invasion of Ukraine has prompted many researchers to study the impact of the conflict on the economic performance of the world’s most prosperous countries. Furthermore, the influence of global commerce has demonstrated that the Russia-Ukraine war has impacted the global trade imbalance, harming the economic performance of the 27 European Union (EU) nations (Misini & Tosuni, 2023b). The methodology is based on a comparison of each of the G20 country’s economic performance indexes (EPIs) to the countries of the EU. These countries’ performance will be evaluated using the most essential macroeconomic indicators: unemployment, inflation, fiscal deficit, and yearly economic growth. In addition, this paper will examine the influence of the Russia-Ukraine war on the economic performance of these countries (G20). The analysis employed dot plot analysis, descriptive statistical analysis, and regression to conduct a more scientific investigation. The findings reveal that nations with high inflation as a result of the Russia-Ukraine war had lower economic performance, while those with low inflation had higher economic performance. Countries with lower inflation have produced greater economic results. Turkey and Argentina have experienced significant swings in economic performance. Economic growth and the budget deficit have had a favorable impact on the G20 countries’ economic performance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证分析2000-2022年G20国家经济表现，研究俄乌战争对G20国家经济绩效的影响，发现高通胀国家经济表现较差，低通胀国家表现较好，经济增长和财政赤字对经济绩效有积极影响。

AI.findings: 1. 因俄乌战争导致高通胀的国家经济表现较差，低通胀国家经济表现较好；2. 土耳其和阿根廷经济绩效波动显著；3. 经济增长和财政赤字对G20国家经济绩效有积极影响。

detail.abstract: The process of applying for and receiving student financial aid is an incredibly complex process involving multiple stakeholders (students, institutions, parents, counselors), levels of information (federal, state, institutional, personal), and modes of communication (print, email, text message, social media, phone calls). Moreover, first-generation students, low-income students, and students of color are most likely to struggle with the financial aid application and awarding process, further marginalizing these students. To date, research has examined how complicated the financial aid process is, how to identify financial aid communication issues, and how to remediate financial aid communication to render it simpler and more intuitive for students and their support networks. Building upon those decades of research, we aim to provide a conceptual framework to demonstrate the complexity of financial aid communication during a student's collegiate career. This conceptual framework will organize financial aid communication in a way that demonstrates the ebb and flow of the student's overall financial aid journey. The aim of creating and examining this conceptual framework is to help financial aid practitioners understand the complexity of the communication to address information gaps and provide students with information and resources in a timely manner that demystifies the financial aid application and awarding process.
