title: A Spatial Price Network Equilibrium Paradox
affiliations: University of Massachusetts Amherst - Isenberg School of Management, University of Hartford - Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering and University of Massachusetts Amherst

detail.title: A Spatial Price Network Equilibrium Paradox

publicationDetails.detailsText: Accepted for publication in Optimization Letters.

detail.abstract: Spatial price equilibrium models have had wide application in commodity trade in sectors such as agriculture and mineral and energy markets. Many of such models are network-based and their relevance is now heightened due to global issues such as increasing wars and crises as well as the negative impacts of climate change. Spatial price equilibrium problems are network equilibrium problems, which include traffic network equilibrium problems. We investigate whether an analogue to the Braess Paradox can occur in spatial price network equilibrium problems, which, unlike the classical Braess Paradox problem, have elastic demands, since consumers are sensitive to price. We construct a series of examples in which a spatial price network equilibrium paradox occurs in that, after the addition of a new transportation link, the demand price for the commodity rises; the supply price for the commodity decreases, and all transportation routes are now more costly. In the case of agricultural commodities such a paradox has negative implications for food security, since consumers receive a lower volume of the commodity but at a higher price. Farmers, on the other hand, also, suffer, since the supply price of the commodity decreases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现空间价格网络均衡中可能发生类似Braess悖论的现象，即新增运输链路后商品需求价格上涨、供给价格下降、所有运输路线成本增加，这对农业商品的食物安全和农民收入产生负面影响。
AI.research_question: 空间价格网络均衡问题中是否会出现类似Braess悖论的现象？

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于网络均衡理论和空间价格均衡模型，特别关注弹性需求特性（消费者对价格敏感）。
AI.method: 构建一系列示例模型，分析新增运输链路前后空间价格网络均衡的变化。
AI.findings: 发现空间价格网络均衡悖论：新增运输链路后，商品需求价格上涨、供给价格下降、所有运输路线成本增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Braess悖论理论，证明了在具有弹性需求的空间价格网络均衡中同样存在类似悖论现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 对农业商品贸易具有重要警示意义，新增运输基础设施可能反而恶化食物安全状况，损害消费者和农民利益，为政策制定提供理论依据。

title: Navigating the Risks of the use of Digital Reporting and E-Invoicing in the Age of Advanced Fraud Detection
affiliations: Erasmus University Rotterdam

detail.title: Navigating the Risks of the use of Digital Reporting and E-Invoicing in the Age of Advanced Fraud Detection
detail.abstract: With the EU set to implement mandatory e-invoicing and digital reporting by 2030, automated fraud detection tools are expected to become standard in VAT enforcement. This article seeks to address the potential risks of automatic fraud detection tools implemented by EU Member States or at the EU level. The article examines these risks and identifies four key concerns: the risk of treating algorithmic predictions as evidence of fraud; limitations in data quality and model accuracy; the potential for bias, and function creep; and the lack of legal protection. These risks could have negative consequences for businesses. For this reason, the article argues that such risks should be addressed through well-founded decisions about the choice of analytical methods, based on the purpose of the analysis, along with measures to prevent, correct, or compensate for irregularities and discriminatory outcomes. Only sound and scientific statistical research should be used, and systems should be regularly validated and audited. Transparency in the operation of fraud detection tools is also crucial. Most importantly, fraud detection systems should support human decision-making, not replace it.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟2030年强制实施电子发票和数字报告后自动欺诈检测工具在增值税执法中的潜在风险，提出了四个关键关注点，并建议通过科学方法选择、系统验证和透明度等措施来降低风险，强调系统应支持而非取代人工决策。

AI.motivation: 随着欧盟计划在2030年实施强制性电子发票和数字报告，自动欺诈检测工具预计将成为增值税执法的标准工具，需要识别和解决这些工具可能带来的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于算法治理、数据质量和模型准确性理论、算法偏见理论、功能蔓延理论以及法律保护框架。
AI.method: 文献分析和理论分析，识别和评估自动欺诈检测工具的风险因素。
AI.findings: 识别出四个关键风险：将算法预测视为欺诈证据的风险；数据质量和模型准确性的限制；偏见和功能蔓延的潜在风险；缺乏法律保护。这些风险可能对企业产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为自动欺诈检测工具的风险评估提供了理论框架，强调了算法治理中的人类监督和法律责任问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的风险缓解措施，包括基于分析目的选择科学方法、系统定期验证和审计、操作透明度，以及确保系统支持而非取代人工决策。

title: Exploring How Risk-Weighted Capital, Credit Risk and Liquidity Risk Shape Bank Performance
affiliations: LIGS University

detail.title: Exploring How Risk-Weighted Capital, Credit Risk and Liquidity Risk Shape Bank Performance
detail.abstract: This study reinforces the pivotal role of banks in fostering financial stability and economic growth. Using a balanced panel dataset of 12 banks from 2010 to 2023, it examines the impact of risk-weighted capital, credit risk, and liquidity risk on the performance of Nigerian banks. Employing Panel-Corrected Standard Errors (PCSE) and Feasible Generalized Least Squares (FGLS) estimators, the analysis reveals a consistent negative relationship between bank performance, measured by return on assets (ROA), and each of the three risk dimensions. Specifically, higher risk-weighted capital (RWC) levels are associated with reduced profitability, implying that excessive capitalization may impede revenue-generating activities. Similarly, higher credit risk, as proxied by the Z-score, and increased liquidity risk negatively impact ROA, underscoring the need for robust credit evaluation and liquidity management frameworks. Interestingly, when modeled jointly, liquidity risk exhibits a positive effect on performance, indicating that banks with robust liquidity positions may engage in profitable risk-taking. Additionally, the study reveals that larger banks tend to experience diminishing returns, likely due to inefficiencies associated with scale. These findings highlight the complex interplay between risk factors and bank performance, underscoring the need for integrated risk management strategies. The study recommends that the Central Bank of Nigeria should strengthen real-time risk monitoring systems, enforce capital and loan quality standards, promote adequate liquidity buffers, and facilitate advanced analytics training for staff development. Moreover, the study emphasizes the necessity of enhanced transparency in risk disclosures to strengthen investor confidence. These policy measures are crucial to fostering a banking industry that is resilient, effective, and stable.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用2010-2023年尼日利亚12家银行的平衡面板数据，通过PCSE和FGLS方法分析风险加权资本、信用风险和流动性风险对银行绩效的影响，发现三者均与ROA呈负相关，但流动性风险在联合建模时呈现正向影响，建议加强实时风险监控和透明度。
AI.research_question: 风险加权资本、信用风险和流动性风险如何影响尼日利亚银行的绩效表现？
AI.motivation: 银行在促进金融稳定和经济增长中扮演关键角色，需要深入理解各类风险因素对银行绩效的影响机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行风险管理理论，探讨资本充足性、信用风险和流动性风险对银行盈利能力的理论关系
AI.method: 使用平衡面板数据集（2010-2023年，12家银行），采用面板校正标准误（PCSE）和可行广义最小二乘法（FGLS）估计方法
AI.findings: 1) 风险加权资本与ROA负相关，过度资本化可能阻碍创收活动；2) 信用风险（Z-score）与ROA负相关；3) 流动性风险单独分析时与ROA负相关，但联合建模时呈现正向影响；4) 大型银行存在规模不经济
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了风险因素与银行绩效之间的复杂互动关系，特别是流动性风险在联合建模时的正向效应，丰富了银行风险管理理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚央行提出政策建议：加强实时风险监控、执行资本和贷款质量标准、促进充足流动性缓冲、提供高级分析培训、增强风险披露透明度

title: Beauty Pays for Crime? Evidence from Criminal Sentencing *
affiliations: Nanyang Technological University (NTU) - Division of Economics, Nanyang Technological University and Nanyang Technological University (NTU) - Division of Economics

detail.title: Beauty Pays for Crime? Evidence from Criminal Sentencing *

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This study was funded by Ministry Of Education (MOE) Tier 1 AcRF seed fund (RS 15/20) and MOE Tier 1 AcRF seed fund (RS 04/20).

detail.abstract: The legal system is built on principles of fairness and equal protection, yet judicial decisions can be influenced by extraneous factors unrelated to the case, including race, gender etc. This paper exploiting quasi-randomly assigned judges to estimate how facial attractiveness can influence sentencing outcomes using a dataset of more than 22,000 felons from Miami-Dade County, Florida. Our findings show that moving from 25th to 75th percentile in facial attractiveness reduces sentencing length by around 54 to 63 days (around 2.5% to 2.9%). This bias is more pronounced for female felons, felons below the age of 45, felons at healthier weight range, and felons committing more serious crimes such as manslaughter, sexual offenses and robbery. Facially attractive felons are less likely to re-offend, suggesting that harsher punishment is driven by inferred criminality from appearance. Quasi-experimental variation from major reforms on sentencing guidelines that reduces judicial discretion attenuate this attractiveness bias, highlighting the efficacy of changes to reduce sentencing disparity driven by extraneous factors.

AI.tldr: 本文通过准随机分配的法官数据研究发现，面部吸引力对判决结果有显著影响：吸引力从25%提升到75%分位数可减少54-63天刑期（2.5%-2.9%），这种偏见在女性、年轻、健康体重和重罪罪犯中更明显。
AI.research_question: 面部吸引力如何影响刑事判决结果？
AI.motivation: 司法系统虽然建立在公平和平等保护原则基础上，但判决可能受到与案件无关的外部因素（如种族、性别等）影响，需要实证研究面部吸引力这一潜在偏见因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于司法偏见理论和外貌刻板印象理论，探讨法官在判决过程中可能受到被告外貌特征的非理性影响。
AI.method: 利用佛罗里达州迈阿密-戴德县22,000多名重罪犯的准随机法官分配数据，采用准实验设计估计面部吸引力对刑期长度的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 面部吸引力从25%提升到75%分位数减少54-63天刑期；2) 偏见在女性、45岁以下、健康体重和重罪罪犯中更明显；3) 有吸引力的罪犯再犯率更低；4) 减少法官自由裁量权的改革能减弱这种偏见。
AI.theory_contributions: 为司法偏见理论提供了面部吸引力影响判决的实证证据，揭示了外貌刻板印象在司法决策中的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了通过改革减少法官自由裁量权可以有效降低由外部因素驱动的判决差异，为司法改革提供了实证支持。

title: From Smog to Flexibility: Climate Mitigation and Corporate Labor Cost Stickiness
affiliations: Renmin University of China - School of Business, McGill University, Renmin University of China, School of Business and The Hang Seng University of Hong Kong

detail.title: From Smog to Flexibility: Climate Mitigation and Corporate Labor Cost Stickiness
detail.abstract: This study exploits the staggered rollout of China's Clean Heating Plan from 2017 to 2022 as a quasi experiment to examine the impact of climate risk mitigation policies on corporate labor cost stickiness. We find that the Plan significantly reduces air pollution in pilot cities and increases the local labor supply. This expansion of the labor pool leads to a decline in labor adjustment costs, as evidenced by the shortened recruitment time. Labor cost stickiness declines for up to three years following the Plan's implementation, primarily driven by headcount adjustments, particularly among highly skilled workers, rather than changes in average wages. The negative effect of the Plan is more pronounced for firms with greater exposures to labor adjustment costs as proxied by birth rate, net resident inflows, and recruitment time at the firms' domiciled city level, and by labor intensity, geographical concentration, and staffing flexibility at the firm level. These findings highlight the economic benefits of climate risk mitigation policies on firms' operational flexibility and labor cost efficiency.

AI.tldr: 中国清洁供暖计划通过改善空气质量增加劳动力供给，降低企业用工调整成本，从而减少劳动力成本粘性，特别是在高技能员工调整方面效果显著
AI.research_question: 气候风险缓解政策如何影响企业劳动力成本粘性
AI.motivation: 探讨气候政策在改善环境质量的同时，是否能够通过劳动力市场机制影响企业的用工成本结构
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力成本粘性理论、劳动力市场供需理论、环境政策经济学
AI.method: 利用2017-2022年中国清洁供暖计划分批实施的准自然实验，采用双重差分方法
AI.findings: 清洁供暖计划显著降低试点城市空气污染，增加当地劳动力供给，缩短招聘时间，降低劳动力成本粘性达三年之久，主要通过人员数量调整而非工资变化实现
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将气候政策与劳动力成本粘性联系起来，拓展了环境政策的经济效应研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业优化劳动力成本管理提供新视角，为政府制定气候政策提供劳动力市场影响的实证依据

title: Startup Jobs in a Polarized Era: How Dobbs v. Jackson Shifted the Geography of Remote and In-Person Applications
affiliations: Wharton School, University of Penn, Wharton School, U. Pennsylvania and University of Pennsylvania - Management Department

detail.title: Startup Jobs in a Polarized Era: How Dobbs v. Jackson Shifted the Geography of Remote and In-Person Applications

declarations.funderStatement: The Mack Institute for Innovation Management

detail.abstract: We examine how local political shifts affect startup applicant behavior, using data from a leading job search platform for technology startups. Analyzing patterns around the Supreme Court's Dobbs v. Jackson ruling, we find that applications to in-person jobs in trigger-law states (where abortion became illegal) dropped by 9% relative to states where abortion remained legal. Applications to remote jobs in these states, however, were unaffected. Following the ruling, startups in trigger-law states had to offer 9.6% higher compensation to sustain applicant interest. These findings indicate that while unexpected shifts in the local political environment may adversely impact startups' talent attraction, flexible job designs that leverage remote work and higher salary may offset this effect.

AI.tldr: 最高法院Dobbs v. Jackson裁决后，触发法律州（堕胎非法）的现场职位申请量下降9%，远程职位申请不受影响，这些州的初创企业需提供9.6%更高薪酬来维持申请者兴趣
AI.research_question: 地方政治环境变化如何影响初创企业求职者行为
AI.motivation: 研究意外政治环境变化对初创企业人才吸引的影响，特别是堕胎法律变化对求职决策的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场地理流动性理论和工作地点偏好理论，探讨政治环境变化对求职者行为的影响机制
AI.method: 利用领先科技初创企业求职平台数据，采用双重差分方法分析最高法院Dobbs v. Jackson裁决前后申请行为变化
AI.findings: 触发法律州的现场职位申请量相对下降9%，远程职位申请不受影响，这些州初创企业需提供9.6%更高薪酬补偿
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了政治环境变化对劳动力市场影响的理论框架，揭示了远程工作在缓冲政治冲击中的作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为初创企业提供应对政治环境变化的策略建议：推广远程工作模式和调整薪酬策略

title: The Effects of the War in Ukraine on the Economic Performance of Western Balkan Countries
affiliations: AAB College - Faculty of Economics and University Kadri Zeka Gjilan

detail.title: The Effects of the War in Ukraine on the Economic Performance of Western Balkan Countries
detail.abstract: This paper will analyze the economic performance of six Western Balkan countries. The intention is to utilize the index of economic performance for each country in this region. The analysis will look at the data for the past decade (2010-2022). In addition, secondary data available from publically available databases have been included in this analysis. EPI is constructed by using important macroeconomic indexes such as unemployment, inflation, budget deficit, and annual growth. Also, this paper will analyze the impact that the war in Ukraine has had in affecting the economic performance of Western Balkans countries. To do this, graphs, descriptive statistics, and regression models have been used. In line with conventional wisdom, the results show that countries with lower unemployment have performed better than the countries with higher unemployment rates. Contrary to expectations, higher growth rates have not translated to better performance, as well as increased public borrowing has not correlated to better performance.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2010-2022年西巴尔干六国的经济表现，构建了包含失业率、通胀、预算赤字和年增长的经济绩效指数，并研究了乌克兰战争的影响。发现低失业率国家表现更好，但高增长率和公共借贷增加并未带来更好的经济表现。
AI.research_question: 西巴尔干六国的经济表现如何？乌克兰战争对这些国家的经济表现产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 分析西巴尔干地区国家的经济绩效，评估宏观经济指标对经济表现的影响，并研究地缘政治事件（乌克兰战争）对该地区经济的冲击。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济绩效评估理论，使用关键经济指标构建经济绩效指数（EPI）来衡量国家经济表现。
AI.method: 使用2010-2022年的二手数据，构建经济绩效指数（包含失业率、通胀、预算赤字、年增长），采用图表分析、描述性统计和回归模型进行分析。
AI.findings: 1）低失业率国家经济表现更好；2）高增长率并未转化为更好的经济表现；3）公共借贷增加与经济表现改善无相关性；4）乌克兰战争对西巴尔干国家经济产生了负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了西巴尔干地区经济绩效的实证证据，挑战了传统认为高增长必然带来更好经济表现的观点，为经济绩效评估理论提供了新的案例研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于西巴尔干国家经济表现的实证分析，指出了失业率控制的重要性，并对该地区应对地缘政治冲击提供了政策参考。

title: Develop-Fair Use for Artificial Intelligence: A Sino-U.S. Copyright Law Comparison Based on the Ultraman, Bartz v. Anthropic, and Kadrey v. Meta Cases
affiliations: University of Macau

detail.title: Develop-Fair Use for Artificial Intelligence: A Sino-U.S. Copyright Law Comparison Based on the Ultraman, Bartz v. Anthropic, and Kadrey v. Meta Cases
detail.abstract:
The static doctrine of fair use in traditional copyright law can no longer effectively respond to the challenges posed by generative artificial intelligence (AI). Drawing on a deep comparative analysis of China's Ultraman case and the U.S. Bartz v. Anthropic and Kadrey v. Meta cases, this article proposes the theory of "Develop-Fair Use" (DFU). This theory posits that fair use for AI (AIFU) is not a fixed category of exceptions but a dynamic tool of judicial balancing, whose analytical logic should shift from examining closed scenarios to applying an evaluative rule in open-ended contexts. The judicial focus, in turn, shifts from the formal subsumption of facts to the substantive balancing of competition in relevant markets. While the judicial practices in China and the U.S. follow different paths, they both reveal this inherent logic: the Ultraman case, through its judicial creation of a "four-context analysis," carves out institutional space for the AI industry's development; meanwhile, the debate in the two U.S. cases over the fourth factor, "market impact," particularly the "market dilution theory" proposed in Kadrey, broadens the scope of judicial review from direct substitution in copyright markets to the wider dimension of industrial competition. The core of the DFU paradigm lies in recognizing and balancing the "antinomy" of competition in relevant markets: namely, the dynamic interplay between the emerging AI industry, which asserts fair use to develop its relevant markets, and the traditional publishing industry, which cultivates its relevant markets, such as the one for "training licenses," to oppose fair use. Consequently, the boundary of fair use is not the result of pure legal deduction, but a case-specific factual determination based on a judicial assessment of the evolving realities of market competition. Ultimately, this approach aims to trim the excesses of copyright scope while remedying the insufficiencies of market competition.

论人工智能的发展型合理使用
——基于“奥特曼案”“巴茨案”和“卡德雷案”的中美版权法比较
摘要：传统版权法上固定不变的合理使用规则已难以有效回应生成式人工智能的挑战。本文基于对中国“奥特曼案”与美国“巴茨案”“卡德雷案”的比较法深描，提出“发展型合理使用”理论，即合理使用并非固定的权利限制范畴，而是一种动态的司法衡平工具，其审查逻辑应从封闭的情形检验转向开放情形下的评估规则，裁判重心则从形式要件的涵摄转向对关联市场竞争的实质衡平。中美司法实践虽路径各异，却共同揭示了此内在逻辑：“奥特曼案”通过“场景四分说”的司法续造，为人工智能产业发展预留了制度空间；而美国两案围绕第四因素“市场影响”的争论，特别是“卡德雷案”所提出的“市场淡化理论”，则将司法审查的视野从直接替代的版权市场拓展至更广阔的产业竞争维度。此种发展型范式的内核在于承认并衡平关联市场竞争的“二律背反”，即人工智能新兴产业为发展关联市场而主张合理使用，与版权出版传统产业为反对合理使用而发展“训练许可市场”等关联市场之间的动态博弈。因此，合理使用的边界并非纯粹的法律演绎结果，而是在个案中对动态演进的市场竞争现实进行司法认定的事实判断，最终旨在损版权范围之有余，而补市场竞争之不足。
关键词：发展型合理使用，人工智能，中美比较，奥特曼案，巴茨案，卡德雷案

AI.tldr: 论文通过中美版权法案例深度比较，提出了“发展型合理使用”理论，主张将AI合理使用视为动态司法衡平工具，重心从形式要件转向实质性关联市场竞争衡量，以回应生成式AI对传统版权法的挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何构建能够有效回应生成式人工智能挑战的版权合理使用理论与实践案例？
AI.motivation: 传统版权法上固定不变的合理使用规则已难以有效回应生成式人工智能带来的挑战，需要重新思考合理使用的理论基础和实践逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发展型合理使用理论(DFU)，将AI合理使用视为动态的司法衡平工具，重点考察关联市场竞争的实质性衡量。
AI.method: 深度比较分析法，基于中国奥特曼案与美国巴茨案、卡德雷案的详细比较研究，探讨中美版权法实践的共同逻辑。
AI.findings: 中美司法实践虽路径各异，但都揭示了合理使用作为动态衡量工具的内在逻辑：中国案件通过“场景四分说”为AI产业发展预留空间，美国案件则将市场影响分析扩展至更广阔的产业竞争维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 创新提出发展型合理使用理论，实现了合理使用审查逻辑从闭合情形检验向开放情境下评估规则的转变，为AI时代版权法理论提供新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法官处理AI相关版权纠纷提供具体的判断标准和思路，有助于在保护版权人利益的同时促进人工智能产业健康发展，实现版权保护与技术创新的动态平衡。

title: A Peaceful, Silent, Deadly Remedy: Making Sense of the Sanctions Regime against the Russian Federation
affiliations: New Strategy Center and Amsterdam Center for International Law

detail.title: A Peaceful, Silent, Deadly Remedy: Making Sense of the Sanctions Regime against the Russian Federation

publicationDetails.detailsText: New Strategy Center, Policy Paper, January 2024

detail.abstract:
Starting from a historical and academic analysis of sanctions, as well as from the theoretical framework that supports or challenges their effectiveness, the study, completed in December 2023, details the evolution of the sanctions regime imposed by Ukraine’s partners in response to Russia’s adaptability, which enables it to find new methods of circumvention. Accordingly, the analysis focuses primarily on energy sanctions: how they have affected Russia’s profits and the ability of both Moscow and European capitals to identify new export destinations and, respectively, new sources of energy imports.

Furthermore, it examines technological sanctions and their impact in particular on the Kremlin’s war effort, trade sanctions manifested in the exodus of Western companies, sanctions against Russian oligarchs and the prospects of confiscating their assets, as well as measures adopted at the diplomatic level.

Finally, the study puts forward five guidelines for improving the sanctions regime, along with a brief analysis of the Russian mindset and ethos and the way in which these may enhance resilience against the West’s punitive measures.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了针对俄罗斯的制裁制度演变，重点关注能源制裁、技术制裁、贸易制裁和对寡头制裁的效果，并提出了改进制裁制度的五项指导方针。
AI.research_question: 如何提高对俄罗斯制裁制度的有效性？制裁如何影响俄罗斯的经济和战争能力？
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯对制裁的适应能力促使需要分析现有制裁制度的有效性并提出改进方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制裁历史学术分析和理论框架，探讨支持或质疑制裁有效性的理论基础。
AI.method: 历史分析和理论框架分析，重点研究能源制裁、技术制裁、贸易制裁和对寡头制裁的具体影响。
AI.findings: 详细分析了各类制裁对俄罗斯利润、战争努力、西方公司撤离等方面的影响，揭示了俄罗斯的适应策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了制裁有效性的理论验证，分析了俄罗斯思维方式和民族精神如何增强其抵御西方惩罚性措施的韧性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了五项改进制裁制度的指导方针，为政策制定者提供实际操作建议。

title: Social Substitution? Time Use Responses to Increased Workplace Isolation
affiliations: Washington State University and Mississippi State University

detail.title: Social Substitution? Time Use Responses to Increased Workplace Isolation

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines how people adjust their time use when they experience an increase in time spent alone, which is a growing share of adults’ lives. We utilize the dramatic rise in remote work following the onset of the pandemic, which is associated with a large decline in time spent in the physical presence of non-household members during the workday, to observe the extent to which individuals substitute toward more in-person interactions in non-work settings. We first document that on days that individuals work from home, they spend 3.5 additional hours in activities spent entirely alone and over 5 fewer hours in activities that include any non-household members. We then use a difference-in-difference strategy to ask what happens to time allocations when workers are induced toward remote work by analyzing changes over time in how workers in teleworkable occupations—who experienced the lion’s share of the post-COVID increase in remote work—spend their time relative to workers in non-teleworkable occupations. Averaging over all days of the week, we see a relative increase in time spent in activities spent entirely alone by 32 minutes and a decrease in activities that include any non-household members by 38 minutes for workers in teleworkable jobs. Normalizing by the increase in average daily remote work time (46 minutes), these estimates are of a similar magnitude to what we observe in our descriptive analysis. When individuals are induced to work from home, they exhibit almost no substitution toward spending more time with others who are not in their household to make up for the loss of time with others at work.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，远程工作的增加导致人们独处时间显著增加，但几乎没有通过非工作时间增加与他人互动来补偿工作场所社交时间的减少。
AI.research_question: 当人们经历独处时间增加时，如何调整时间使用？特别是在远程工作增加的背景下，人们是否会在非工作环境中增加面对面互动来补偿工作场所社交时间的减少？
AI.motivation: 随着远程工作的普及，成年人独处时间占比不断增加，需要了解人们如何适应这种时间使用模式的变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时间使用理论和社交行为替代理论，研究远程工作对社交时间分配的影响。
AI.method: 采用双重差分策略，比较可远程工作职业和不可远程工作职业的工人在疫情期间的时间使用变化。
AI.findings: 远程工作日独处时间增加3.5小时，与非家庭成员共处时间减少5小时以上；可远程工作职业的工人平均每天独处时间相对增加32分钟，与非家庭成员共处时间减少38分钟。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了远程工作环境下社交时间替代效应的有限性，挑战了传统时间替代理论假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供远程工作对员工社交生活影响的实证证据，有助于制定更合理的远程工作政策。

title: Measuring Territorial Political Representation
affiliations: , Sapienza University Of Rome, Department of Social Sciences and Economics and

detail.title: Measuring Territorial Political Representation
detail.abstract: Territorial representation is a cornerstone of democratic systems, ensuring that each geographic area has a voice in decision-making bodies. Although this principle is explicitly enshrined in federal governments, unitary states also incorporate territorial elements via mechanisms such as single-member district electoral systems and regional lists. However, certain democratic structures-most notably many large metropolitan governments-lack formal arrangements for territorial representation. This paper investigates whether, and to what extent, territorial disparities in political representation emerge in these contexts. To address this question, we propose several novel indices that measure the degree to which each territorial unit is represented relative to its population share. Using fine-grained precinct-level, geocoded electoral data, we calculate these indices for a sample of Italy's metropolitan areas and examine spatial and temporal variations in territorial representation. We find that areas with consistently below-average representation exhibit the lowest political engagement, the fewest university graduates, and the lowest employment rates. Our results contribute to the broader debate on the determinants and implications of territorial representation for democratic fairness and governance efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了缺乏正式地域代表制度的大都市政府中地域代表权不平等问题，通过开发新的代表权指数分析意大利大都市区数据，发现代表权不足地区存在政治参与度低、教育水平低和就业率低的现象。
AI.research_question: 在缺乏正式地域代表制度的民主结构中，是否会出现地域代表权的差异？这些差异的程度如何？
AI.motivation: 虽然联邦制政府明确规定了地域代表原则，但许多大都市政府缺乏正式的地域代表安排，这可能导致地域间代表权不平等，影响民主公平和治理效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地域代表制理论、民主公平理论、政治参与理论
AI.method: 开发新的地域代表权指数，使用精细化的选区级地理编码选举数据，分析意大利大都市区的时空变化
AI.findings: 代表权持续低于平均水平的地区表现出最低的政治参与度、最少的大学生毕业生和最低的就业率
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了测量地域代表权的新指数，丰富了地域代表制理论在非正式制度环境下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为改善大都市政府的地域代表公平性提供了实证依据，有助于提升民主治理效率

title: Bitcoin Growth Amid Climate Change: Policy and Investment Implications
affiliations: University of Calgary - Haskayne School of Business, University College London - UCL School of Management and University of Kent

detail.title: Bitcoin Growth Amid Climate Change: Policy and Investment Implications
detail.abstract: Bitcoin contributes to global carbon emissions on a scale comparable to entire countries in order to secure its decentralized network. This exposes Bitcoin to climate policies aimed at reducing emissions. This paper develops a general equilibrium framework to examine how the stringency of climate policy affects Bitcoin’s valuation and its relationship with the equity market. Our theoretical analysis delivers a key insight: a transition from a lenient to a stringent climate policy increases the conditional correlation between Bitcoin and equity returns, thereby compromising Bitcoin’s appeal as a hedge or diversifier against equity market volatility. Empirical evidence supports this theoretical prediction.

AI.tldr: 比特币的碳排放规模相当于整个国家，使其面临气候政策风险。本文通过一般均衡框架分析发现，从宽松到严格的气候政策转变会增加比特币与股票收益的条件相关性，削弱比特币作为对冲或分散股票市场波动风险工具的吸引力。实证证据支持这一理论预测。
AI.research_question: 气候政策严格度如何影响比特币的估值及其与股票市场的关系？
AI.motivation: 比特币的碳排放规模相当于整个国家水平，使其容易受到减排气候政策的影响，需要研究这些政策对比特币作为投资工具价值的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡框架，分析气候政策严格度变化对比特币估值和与股票市场相关性的影响
AI.method: 理论建模与实证分析相结合的方法
AI.findings: 从宽松到严格的气候政策转变会增加比特币与股票收益的条件相关性
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了气候政策对比特币估值和市场关系影响的理论框架，揭示了政策严格度变化对加密货币与传统资产相关性的影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了关于比特币在气候变化政策背景下作为对冲工具有效性的重要见解，帮助投资决策和风险管理

title: Cross-Platform Merger Effects
affiliations: Arizona State University (ASU), W.P. Carey School of Business, Students and Arizona State University W. P. Carey School of Business

detail.title: Cross-Platform Merger Effects
detail.abstract: Mergers and acquisitions tend to affect the prices and varieties offered by the merging firms. Most existing research, however, focuses on mergers between firms operating on the same platform, such as between two online firms or two firms in the same physical channel. In contrast, the price effects of integration across different platforms remain unexplored in empirical research but are likely of critical importance given the growth of omnichannel, or combined physical and online channels, retailing. We study this question by analyzing the acquisition of a national grocery chain by a large online retailer in the United States. Unlike same-platform mergers, this merger combines market power and efficiency motives with cross-platform network externalities that raise each channel's value as the other grows. This changes channel substitution and effective marginal costs of the merged firm and leaves the price effect ambiguous ex ante. Identifying price effects is further challenging due to the endogenous nature of merger decisions. We use a doubly-robust synthetic control method and find that prices decrease in four out of 10 treated markets, while in five markets, prices remain unchanged. Unlike in same-platform horizontal mergers, these price effects do not systematically vary with market concentration levels and challenge predictions from the Structure-Conduct-Performance literature. Therefore, in cross-platform mergers, competitive effects likely reflect forces beyond market structure, such as channel complementarities and consumer substitution.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了跨平台并购（线上零售商收购实体连锁超市）的价格效应，发现与传统同平台并购不同，跨平台并购导致价格下降或不变，且不受市场集中度影响，反映了渠道互补性和消费者替代等超越市场结构的竞争效应。
AI.research_question: 跨平台并购（线上零售商收购实体连锁超市）对价格的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注同平台并购，而随着全渠道零售的增长，跨平台并购的价格效应在实证研究中尚未探索但至关重要
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场力量与效率动机结合跨平台网络外部性理论，改变了渠道替代和有效边际成本
AI.method: 使用双重稳健合成控制方法，分析美国大型在线零售商收购全国连锁超市的案例
AI.findings: 在10个受处理市场中，4个市场价格下降，5个市场价格保持不变；价格效应不随市场集中度系统性变化
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了结构-行为-绩效文献的预测，表明跨平台并购的竞争效应反映了超越市场结构的力量
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和企业在评估跨平台并购时提供了新的实证证据和理论视角

title: Equity Risk Premium Predictability: Insights from Return Decomposition and Forecast Combination
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Antai College of Economics and Management, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Aetna School of Management, Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School and

detail.title: Equity Risk Premium Predictability: Insights from Return Decomposition and Forecast Combination

publicationDetails.detailsText: This is the second version of the original draft of the paper "Market Return Decomposition and Equity Risk Premium Predictability," uploaded in September 2025. The DOI is: https://dx.doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.5025593

detail.abstract: We propose a novel decomposition of stock market returns into a fundamental component (FC), capturing long-term growth, and an unexpected capital gain component (UC), reflecting short-term fluctuations. The FC aligns with valuation ratios, while the UC is predictable via standard regressions, further improved by shrinkage. Using 41 predictors from Goyal, Welch, and Zafirov (2024), our method finds 33 significantly predictors of the market returns, versus only 5 in their approach. Combining forecasts across predictors reaffirm equity risk premium predictability out-of-sample. Additionally, our results show that stock market predictability persists post-2008, even after accounting for potential publication bias.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将股票市场收益分解为基本面成分（FC，反映长期增长）和意外资本利得成分（UC，反映短期波动）的新方法。FC与估值比率一致，而UC可通过标准回归预测，并通过收缩方法进一步改进。使用41个预测因子，我们的方法发现了33个显著预测因子，而传统方法仅发现5个。组合预测证实了样本外股权风险溢价的可预测性，且这种可预测性在2008年后仍然存在，即使考虑了发表偏倚。
AI.research_question: 如何有效分解股票市场收益并提高市场收益的可预测性？
AI.motivation: 传统方法在预测股票市场收益方面效果有限，需要新的分解方法来更好地理解市场收益的构成并提高预测准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场收益分解理论，将总收益分解为基本面成分（反映长期增长）和意外资本利得成分（反映短期波动）。
AI.method: 提出新的收益分解方法，使用41个预测因子进行回归分析，采用收缩方法改进预测，并进行样本外预测验证。
AI.findings: 新方法发现了33个显著预测因子（传统方法仅5个），证实了股权风险溢价的样本外可预测性，且这种可预测性在2008年后仍然持续。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的市场收益分解框架，为理解市场收益结构和预测提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了更有效的市场预测方法，对投资组合管理和风险管理具有实际应用价值，特别是在后2008年金融环境下的市场预测。

title: Equity Risk Premium Prediction: Return Decomposition and Noise Shrinkage
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Antai College of Economics and Management, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Aetna School of Management, Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School and

detail.title: Equity Risk Premium Prediction: Return Decomposition and Noise Shrinkage

publicationDetails.detailsText: This is the first version of the original draft of the paper "Market Return Decomposition and Equity Risk Premium Predictability," uploaded in September 2025. The DOI is: https://dx.doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.5025593

detail.abstract: We propose a novel decomposition of stock returns into a fundamental component (FC) and an unexpected capital gain component (UC). The FC, driven by firm's valuation ratios, reflects long-term growth and exhibits high persistence, while the UC, influenced by market trading, reflects short-term fluctuations and is more random. To predict the UC, we use a predictive regression model with an L multiplier to shrink noise for mitigating estimation errors. Among the 41 monthly predictors examined by Goyal, Welch and Zafirov (2024), we find 33 of them significantly outperform the historical average forecast, compared to only 5 with their method. Aggregating information across the predictors, we reaffirm the predictability of the equity risk premium. Furthermore, our analysis shows that the stock market remains predictable post-2008, even when accounting for publication bias.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将股票收益分解为基本面成分（FC）和意外资本利得成分（UC），其中FC反映长期增长且具有高持续性，UC反映短期波动且更随机。通过使用L乘数预测回归模型来预测UC，发现41个月度预测因子中有33个显著优于历史平均预测，证实了股权风险溢价的可预测性，且这种可预测性在2008年后依然存在。
AI.research_question: 如何有效分解股票收益并预测其意外资本利得成分？股票市场风险溢价是否具有可预测性？
AI.motivation: 传统股票收益预测方法存在估计误差问题，需要更有效的方法来分解收益成分并提高预测准确性，特别是在后2008年时期验证市场可预测性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 股票收益分解理论，将收益分为基本面驱动成分和市场交易驱动的意外成分；预测回归理论；L乘数收缩噪声方法。
AI.method: 提出FC/UC分解框架；使用带L乘数的预测回归模型来减少估计误差；基于Goyal等（2024）的41个月度预测因子进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 41个预测因子中有33个显著优于历史平均预测（传统方法仅5个）；股权风险溢价具有显著可预测性；2008年后市场依然可预测，且考虑了发表偏倚。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的股票收益分解理论框架；发展了基于L乘数的预测回归方法；为市场可预测性提供了新的理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了更准确的股票收益预测工具；证实了后危机时期市场的可预测性；为投资决策提供了实证支持。

title: What Drives Refugees' Return After Conflict?
affiliations: CESifo (Center for Economic Studies and Ifo Institute), Ifo Institute, Ifo Institute, Ifo Institute, Ludwig Erhard ifo Center for Social Market Economy and Institutional Economics and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: What Drives Refugees' Return After Conflict?

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Refugees’ decisions to return after conflict carry significant political and economic implications for the origin and host countries. We examine how conflict resolution, security, economic conditions, and corruption influence return decisions. To estimate the causal effect of post-war conditions, we conducted a single-profile conjoint experiment among 2543 Ukrainian refugees across 30 European countries. Respondents were asked how likely they would be to return to Ukraine under different hypothetical scenarios. Results show that territorial integrity and security guarantees are critical, while economic prospects and combating corruption also play an important role. Refugees planning to return are more responsive to different post-war scenarios, and younger respondents are particularly influenced by income opportunities, job prospects, and potential EU accession. Our findings suggest that targeted political and economic reconstruction policies can substantially influence post-conflict return. In the most optimistic scenario, the expected return rate is 47%; in the most pessimistic scenario, only 3%.

AI.tldr: 通过联合实验分析乌克兰难民返回决策，发现领土完整和安全保障最关键，经济前景和反腐败也重要，不同人群对战后条件反应不同
AI.research_question: 冲突解决、安全、经济条件和腐败如何影响难民在战后的返回决策
AI.motivation: 难民返回决策对原籍国和东道国具有重要政治经济影响，需要了解影响返回的关键因素
AI.theoretical_framework: 难民返回决策理论，战后重建理论，安全-经济权衡理论
AI.method: 在30个欧洲国家对2543名乌克兰难民进行单剖面联合实验，评估不同假设情景下的返回意愿
AI.findings: 领土完整和安全保障最关键，经济前景和反腐败也很重要；计划返回的难民对战后情景更敏感；年轻人更受收入机会、就业前景和欧盟入盟影响；最乐观情景返回率47%，最悲观仅3%
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对难民返回决策机制的理解，识别了不同因素的重要性排序和人群异质性
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定有针对性的政治经济重建政策提供依据，可显著影响冲突后难民返回率

title: What Jobs Do Workers Want? Worker Preferences in Global Value Chains
affiliations: University of Oxford - Said Business School, University of Toronto, Centre for Industrial Relations and Human Resources and

detail.title: What Jobs Do Workers Want? Worker Preferences in Global Value Chains
detail.abstract: What do workers in global value chains (GVCs) consider a good job?  Research on work in GVCs largely studies compliance with standards set from the top-down rather than worker preferences.   Understanding worker preferences is crucial because workers are the intended beneficiaries of governance institutions; policies better aligned to their preferences could contribute to both their legitimacy and effectiveness. To explore what GVC workers want, we embedded an experiment in an original survey of 2,500 workers in 50 Moroccan apparel factories selling to foreign buyers.  Workers highly valued jobs characteristics that reduced their exposure to physical and economic risks.  They also had strong preferences for jobs with supervisors that treated workers respectfully.  By contrast, worker preferences for wage increases available in the Moroccan context were weak, especially when compared with non-wage features.  Our results suggests that when wages are compressed and extended working hours is the main way to increase earnings, preferences for non-wage attributes may dominate.  We also find more similarities than differences between men and women workers; while women place greater value on respectful supervision, safety, and childcare benefits, their overall preferences closely track those of men.  These findings provide novel evidence to inform efforts to improve jobs in GVCs.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过摩洛哥服装工厂2500名工人的调查实验发现，GVC工人最重视降低物理和经济风险的工作特征，以及受到尊重的监督管理，对工资增长的偏好相对较弱，男女工人偏好差异较小。
AI.research_question: 全球价值链（GVC）中的工人认为什么是好工作？他们的工作偏好是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有GVC工作研究主要关注自上而下的标准合规性，而非工人偏好。理解工人偏好对治理制度的合法性和有效性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球价值链治理、工人偏好理论、劳动经济学
AI.method: 在摩洛哥50家服装工厂对2500名工人进行原始调查，并嵌入实验设计
AI.findings: 工人高度重视降低物理和经济风险的工作特征；强烈偏好受到尊重的监督管理；对工资增长的偏好较弱；男女工人偏好相似度高于差异
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了GVC工人偏好的实证证据，挑战了传统以工资为中心的劳动偏好假设
AI.practical_contributions: 为改善GVC工作质量的政策制定提供依据，建议关注非工资工作特征和尊重性管理

title: Floods, Public Budgets and Fiscal Resilience: Evidence from Italian Municipalities
affiliations: University of Urbino, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Urbino, Università degli Studi di Urbino - Department of Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Floods, Public Budgets and Fiscal Resilience: Evidence from Italian Municipalities
detail.abstract: We examine the financial impact of extreme hydrogeological events on Italian municipal governments between 2016 and 2022. Leveraging the staggered timing of disaster declarations and employing a difference-in-differences framework, we estimate dynamic treatment effects on revenue and expenditure of municipal governments. Our findings indicate that local governments of affected municipalities significantly increase total and capital expenditures in the aftermath of disasters, particularly in functions related to emergency management, environmental protection and economic development. These spending increases are primarily financed through capital revenues and intergovernmental transfers, with no corresponding rise in current expenditures. To explore heterogeneity in fiscal responses, we develop a fiscal resilience index combining measures of debt servicing costs and tax autonomy. We find that municipal governments with both low debt burdens and high tax autonomy exhibit the strongest and most persistent post-disaster financial adjustments. In contrast, municipal governments with high debt service obligations and limited tax autonomy exhibit weaker responses, reflecting a constrained capacity to mobilize financial resources. These results underscore the critical importance of fiscal space, beyond formal fiscal autonomy, in shaping local governments’ ability to respond to climate-related shocks. From a policy perspective, our findings highlight the need to strengthen institutional and financial mechanisms that enhance fiscal resilience and ensure timely access to recovery resources for municipal governments with limited capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2016-2022年间极端水文地质事件对意大利市政政府的财务影响，发现受灾地方政府显著增加总支出和资本支出，主要通过资本收入和政府间转移支付融资。财政弹性高的市政府（低债务负担和高税收自主权）表现出最强和最持久的灾后财务调整能力。
AI.research_question: 极端水文地质事件对意大利市政政府的财政收入和支出有何影响？不同财政状况的市政府在应对灾害时的财政反应存在怎样的异质性？
AI.motivation: 随着气候变化导致极端天气事件频发，了解地方政府如何应对这些冲击对于制定有效的灾害应对政策至关重要。现有研究较少关注地方政府层面的财政反应机制和财政弹性在灾害应对中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财政联邦主义和公共财政理论，结合灾害经济学和财政弹性概念，构建分析地方政府灾后财政行为的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），利用灾害宣布的错时性，估计对市政政府收入和支出的动态处理效应。构建财政弹性指数，结合债务偿还成本和税收自主权指标来分析异质性。
AI.findings: 受灾市政政府显著增加总支出和资本支出，特别是在应急管理、环境保护和经济发展方面。支出增加主要通过资本收入和政府间转移支付融资，经常性支出没有相应增加。财政弹性高的市政府（低债务负担和高税收自主权）表现出最强和最持久的灾后财务调整能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了财政弹性理论在灾害应对中的应用，强调了财政空间（超越正式财政自主权）在塑造地方政府应对气候相关冲击能力中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了加强制度和金融机制的依据，以增强财政弹性，确保财政能力有限的市政政府能够及时获得恢复资源。研究结果对改善地方政府灾害应对能力和财政韧性具有重要政策启示。

title: Reducing CO2 emissions: Goodness of heart or insurance policy?
affiliations: Memorial University of Newfoundland (MUN) - Faculty of Business Administration, Memorial University of Newfoundland (MUN), Audencia Business School and Macquarie University - Department of Accounting and Corporate Governance

detail.title: Reducing CO2 emissions: Goodness of heart or insurance policy?
detail.abstract: We investigate the effect of firm-level political risk on corporate carbon emissions. We find that heightened political risk is associated with lower carbon emissions, supporting the Risk-Mitigation Hypothesis. This effect, however, is attenuated by firms that are politically connected or socially responsible. Interestingly, we find that investors are more forgiving of high-emitting firms facing elevated political risk, suggesting that valuation penalties are conditional on the political context. Finally, we uncover a governance channel: CEO compensation is negatively affected when firms maintain high emissions under political uncertainty, aligning managerial incentives with emissions reduction. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that firms treat emissions strategy as a form of operational hedging rather than altruism, with political connections, social visibility, and executive incentives shaping the extent of their response.

AI.tldr: 政治风险会使企业减少碳排放，但政治联系和社会责任会弱化这种效应。投资者对高排放企业更宽容，CEO薪酬与排放表现相关。

title: From Binary to Bands: An Edge-of-Chaos Framework for Immigration Policy
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: From Binary to Bands: An Edge-of-Chaos Framework for Immigration Policy
detail.abstract: This directional note proposes a non-binary, rule-based approach to immigration policy grounded in the edge-of-chaos intuition. We define chaos as social dysfunction (erosion of trust, recurrent unrest, institutional overload). Recent episodes in Sweden, Germany, and Los Angeles (USA) illustrate how urban concentration and high-contact sectors can breach local capacity even when national averages look "safe." The framework replaces "more vs. less" with band-setting and band-keeping: (i) where dysfunction is present or imminent, reduce immigrant shares-first by tightening temporary streams and dispersing concentrations-until indicators revert to a governable middle; (ii) where a country is far from the edge, increase shares with strict caps so creativity gains do not trigger urban overshoot. As directional starting points for different baseline contexts, we offer two tracks: A) (caution-first; highly diverse or stressed contexts) national cap ≤ 10%, regional/metro cap ≤ 30%; B) (band-first; low-to-moderate diversity) national band 5-15% with a default ~10% city cap, adjustable by local data. Stability also requires a procedural majority definition (citizenship/long-term residence plus 2-3 generations in-country) so the "non-immigrant" category updates as assimilation proceeds. We emphasize that numbers are placeholders for debate and calibration; implementation should use public dashboards, rights-respecting and non-stigmatizing guardrails, with future refinement via administrative data and AI. Note on terms. Unless stated otherwise, immigrant share refers to foreign-born. Where official statistics use immigration background or foreign population, we indicate that explicitly. City and national shares are both foreign-born unless otherwise noted.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于混沌边缘理论的非二元移民政策框架，用功能带设置和维持替代简单的'多vs少'争论，根据不同基线情境提供两种政策路径，强调通过数据仪表板和AI进行动态校准
AI.research_question: 如何基于混沌边缘理论制定有效的移民政策框架，以平衡社会功能稳定与移民带来的创造力收益？
AI.motivation: 传统移民政策的二元争论（更多vs更少）无法有效应对城市化集中和高接触行业带来的社会功能障碍风险，需要新的理论框架来指导政策制定
AI.theoretical_framework: 混沌边缘理论，将混沌定义为社会功能障碍（信任侵蚀、反复动荡、制度超载），强调在秩序与混乱之间的最优平衡点
AI.method: 基于瑞典、德国和洛杉矶等案例的实证分析，提出规则导向的政策框架，包括功能带设置、分散策略和程序性多数定义
AI.findings: 城市集中和高接触行业可能突破地方承载能力，即使国家平均水平看似安全；需要根据不同基线情境采取差异化的移民份额限制策略
AI.theory_contributions: 将混沌边缘理论应用于移民政策领域，提出非二元的规则导向框架，为移民政策研究提供新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 提供具体的政策实施路径（A路径和B路径），强调数据仪表板、权利保护护栏和AI辅助的动态校准机制，为政策制定者提供可操作的工具

affiliations: and Central University of Himachal Pradesh (CUHP)

detail.title: Evaluation of Minimum Support Price on Paddy Cultivation in the Indian State of Punjab: A Comprehensive Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced their study
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval ensures research is conducted responsibly and respects participant rights.
declarations.funderStatement: There is no funding for current research.

detail.abstract: The study evaluates the efficiency of the Minimum Support Price on paddy cultivation in Punjab. The data spanning from 1996–1997 to 2019–20 on area, production, yield, cost of production, operational cost, different cost components, and MSP of paddy in Punjab were collected from the secondary sources. For this study, data were collected from the Directorate of Economics and Statistics and the Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP) underneath the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India. The descriptive statistics and the Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) were used to analyze the collected data with appropriate analytical tools. The study exposed that the area and production of paddy has significantly increased over the year, whereas the yield has decreased. The findings of the study shows that the relative share of the different inputs, adequacy of the MSP in meeting the cost of production, and the percentage difference between the MSP and different cost components have significantly increased over the period. Therefore, the outcome of the study revealed that the MSP has significantly increased and the MSP for paddy to be found very effective in Punjab state.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了旁遮普邦水稻种植最低支持价格(MSP)的效率，发现MSP显著增加且对水稻种植非常有效，但产量有所下降。
AI.research_question: 旁遮普邦水稻种植最低支持价格(MSP)的效率如何？
AI.motivation: 评估MSP政策对水稻种植的影响，为农业政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业政策评估理论、成本收益分析理论
AI.method: 使用1996-1997至2019-20年的二手数据，采用描述性统计和复合年增长率(CAGR)分析
AI.findings: 水稻种植面积和产量显著增加但单产下降，MSP与生产成本之间的差距显著扩大，MSP政策在旁遮普邦非常有效
AI.theory_contributions: 为农业支持政策评估提供了实证证据，丰富了农业政策效率评估的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政府制定和调整MSP政策提供了具体参考，有助于提高农业政策实施效果

title: The Green Value of BigTech Credit
affiliations: Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business, , Peking University and Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance (SAIF)

detail.title: The Green Value of BigTech Credit
detail.abstract: We study an incentive-compatible mechanism-embedding financial incentives into non-financial actions-that fosters individual environmental engagement and facilitates the private sector's internalization of climate externalities. Using a novel dataset of 100,000 randomly selected users from Ant Forest, a widely used personal carbon tracking program within Alipay-China's leading BigTech platform, we demonstrate that tying eco-friendly behaviors to credit limit adjustments encourages users to engage in green actions. The platform benefits from reduced default risk even amid credit expansion, likely driven by a signaling mechanism in which costly green actions reveal environmental type. Climate-responsible individuals often exhibit conscientious and disciplined behavior across various domains, allowing lenders to infer creditworthiness from green actions. Our structural model estimates an annual green value of $413.20 million generated by linking credit access to green actions. This incentive-based approach yields larger welfare gains than traditional policy instruments such as mandates or subsidies, particularly when public green awareness is low. Our findings identify the screening role of green behaviors in household lending to align environmental values with financial value and highlight alternative data as a viable source for credit allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了将环保行为与信用额度调整挂钩的激励机制，通过蚂蚁森林10万用户数据证明这种机制能有效促进环保参与，同时降低违约风险，年产生绿色价值4.132亿美元。
AI.research_question: 如何设计激励机制来促进个人环保参与并帮助私营部门内化气候外部性？
AI.motivation: 传统政策工具如强制规定或补贴在公众环保意识低时效果有限，需要探索新的激励机制来促进环保行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号机制理论 - 成本高昂的环保行为可以揭示个人的环境类型，环保负责的个体往往在其他领域也表现出尽责和自律行为。
AI.method: 使用蚂蚁森林10万随机用户的新数据集，通过结构模型分析将环保行为与信用额度调整挂钩的效果。
AI.findings: 将环保行为与信用准入挂钩能鼓励用户参与绿色行动，平台即使在信贷扩张中也能降低违约风险，年产生绿色价值4.132亿美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了绿色行为在家庭贷款中的筛选作用，将环境价值与金融价值对齐，强调替代数据作为信贷分配的可行来源。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种比传统政策工具福利增益更大的激励方法，特别是在公众环保意识低时效果更显著，为私营部门内化气候外部性提供了可行方案。

title: Export Controls and Innovation in Sanctioned Countries
affiliations: Fudan University, Fudan University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and Harvard Business School

detail.title: Export Controls and Innovation in Sanctioned Countries
detail.abstract: This paper studies how Chinese firms responded to the 2007 U.S. "China Military Catch-All Rule," which restricted exports of dual-use products with military applications. By comparing sanctioned goods to those that were just excluded from the policy, we estimate firm-level effects on imports, R&D, and patenting. Treated firms sharply reduced imports of controlled products and increased innovation activity: R&D spending rose by 49.1%, patenting by 41.3%, and the number of active inventors by 30.4%. Patenting in related technologies increased by 65.1% and patents on other topics increased by 41.6%, indicating a broad innovation response rather than one narrowly focused on replacing restricted inputs. We also examine domestic suppliers of controlled goods and find that their innovation increased, but was concentrated in patent applications related to the restricted products, which more than quadrupled. Taken together, these results suggest that a key unintended consequence of export controls is their potential to accelerate innovation in the sanctioned economy.

AI.tldr: 美国2007年对华军事用途出口管制政策意外促进了中国企业的创新活动，被制裁企业研发支出增长49.1%，专利申请增长41.3%，发明人数量增长30.4%，显示出口管制可能加速被制裁经济体的创新
AI.research_question: 美国2007年"中国军事用途全面管制规则"对中国企业进口、研发和专利申请行为产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 研究出口管制政策对受制裁企业创新行为的实际影响，探讨此类政策的意外后果
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于出口管制、创新理论和企业应对策略的理论框架
AI.method: 采用准实验设计，比较受管制产品与仅被排除在政策外的产品，估计企业层面的进口、研发和专利申请效应
AI.findings: 受管制企业大幅减少受控产品进口，同时创新活动显著增加：研发支出增长49.1%，专利申请增长41.3%，活跃发明人数量增长30.4%；相关技术专利增长65.1%，其他主题专利增长41.6%；国内供应商创新也增加，但主要集中在受限制产品相关专利申请上（增长超过四倍）
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了出口管制政策的意外创新促进效应，丰富了关于技术制裁与创新关系的理论认识
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于出口管制实际效果的实证证据，提示此类政策可能产生与预期相反的效果，反而加速被制裁经济体的技术创新

detail.abstract: Sustainable development extends beyond environmental concerns, encompassing the integration of environmental, social, and economic progress toward a shared global goal. Rooted in both international and soft law, the concept responds to urgent challenges such as unsustainable consumption and production, population growth, climate change, biodiversity loss, and ozone depletion. It also emphasizes advancing labour rights, health services, gender equality, child protection, and community safeguards against harmful corporate practices. Addressing these interconnected issues is essential for ensuring sustainable global growth and progress.

AI.tldr: 可持续发展是一个综合环境、社会和经济发展的全球性概念，旨在应对不可持续消费、气候变化、生物多样性丧失等紧迫挑战，同时促进劳工权利、性别平等和社会保护。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整合环境、社会和经济三个维度来实现可持续发展目标？
AI.motivation: 应对当前面临的不可持续消费和生产模式、人口增长、气候变化、生物多样性丧失、臭氧层破坏等全球性挑战，同时促进社会公平和经济发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际法和软法的可持续发展理论框架，强调环境、社会和经济三个维度的协同发展。
AI.method: 理论分析和概念框架构建，基于现有国际法律和政策文件的分析。
AI.findings: 可持续发展需要综合处理环境、社会和经济问题，通过多维度整合才能实现真正的全球可持续发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了可持续发展的综合理论框架，明确了环境、社会和经济三个维度的内在联系和协同机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实施可持续发展的指导原则，强调了劳工权利保护、健康服务、性别平等、儿童保护等具体实践领域的重要性。

title: An Illustration of Semantic Fingerprinting: What's in a Word (of the Year)?
affiliations: Toulouse Business School - Barcelona Campus

detail.title: An Illustration of Semantic Fingerprinting: What's in a Word (of the Year)?
detail.abstract: Semantic fingerprinting − a product of the Semantic Folding Theory − is based on the premise that human-like (artificial) intelligence can be developed by emulating only two essential faculties: making analogies and making predictions based on previous experiences. In this way, a word gains meaning through the collection of concepts it is mostly associated with: its so-called “semantic fingerprint”. This paper illustrates the potential of semantic fingerprinting as a method for quantifying text data in ways that support interdisciplinary research, bridging linguistics with social andeconomic inquiry. As a small sample demonstration of the technique, semantic fingerprinting is used to explore the associations of emotions with the Word of the Year, chosen to reflect the “spirit of the age” according to the Dictionary.com, since 2010. Significant correlations between the emotion content of the Words of the Year and happiness indicators, suggest years with low subjective well-being are high in emotion content and raise questions about the relationship between overall happiness and economic factors.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了语义指纹技术作为一种量化文本数据的方法，通过分析年度词汇的情感关联来探索幸福感与经济因素的关系。研究发现低主观幸福感的年份情感内容较高，质疑了整体幸福感与经济因素的传统关系。
AI.research_question: 语义指纹技术如何用于量化文本数据以支持跨学科研究？年度词汇的情感内容与幸福感指标之间存在什么关系？
AI.motivation: 基于语义折叠理论，探索通过模拟人类类比和预测能力来发展人工智能的方法，并验证语义指纹在连接语言学与社会经济研究中的潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语义折叠理论 - 认为人类智能可以通过模拟类比和基于经验的预测两个基本能力来发展，词汇通过其关联概念集合获得意义（语义指纹）。
AI.method: 使用语义指纹技术分析Dictionary.com自2010年以来的年度词汇，探索这些词汇的情感关联，并与幸福感指标进行相关性分析。
AI.findings: 年度词汇的情感内容与幸福感指标存在显著相关性，低主观幸福感的年份情感内容较高，这质疑了整体幸福感与经济因素的传统关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了语义折叠理论在文本量化分析中的有效性，为人工智能发展提供了新的理论视角，推动了语言学与社会科学的跨学科融合。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种新的文本量化分析方法，可用于社会科学研究中的情感分析、舆情监测和政策评估，为跨学科研究提供了实用工具。

title: Reforms as The Pathway to Integration and Development in Africa
affiliations: Dennis Osadebay University and Department of History and International Studies,  Faculty of Humanities, Federal University Otuoke,  Bayelsa State, Nigeria

detail.title: Reforms as The Pathway to Integration and Development in Africa

declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper was published by HELSINKI JOURNAL OF SOCIAL SCIENCES AND HUMANITIES (HJSSH)A Scientific Publication of Helsinki University, Finland. Volume: 9 Issue: 4 August, 2025.
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: The essence of this paper is to interrogate reforms as a potent element in African integration drive. It x-rays Africa's integration experiences and the efforts of African states to initiate reforms for integration at the regional level. While the study employed a historical narrative approach for data collection, it utilizes primary sources mainly archival materials obtained from the Council of Europe archives and secondary sources such as books, journal articles and internet sources, as well as content data analysis. This paper argues that because of the dynamics of the global system, Africa continues to grapple with emerging trends and challenges within the context of regional conflicts, economic and political quagmire, as well as digitalization necessitates African integration process to align with the changing realities of global best practices and the acceleration of democratic culture. The expansion of trade liberalization across the globe has made it necessary that reforms be taken seriously in the process of building integrative institutions in Africa.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨改革在非洲一体化进程中的关键作用，分析非洲国家在区域层面推动一体化改革的努力，强调在全球化和数字化背景下，非洲需要通过改革来应对区域冲突、经济政治困境等挑战，建立符合全球最佳实践的整合机构。
AI.research_question: 改革如何作为非洲一体化进程中的关键要素发挥作用？非洲国家在区域层面推动一体化改革的经验和挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 由于全球体系的动态变化，非洲面临区域冲突、经济政治困境以及数字化等新兴趋势和挑战，这使得非洲一体化进程需要与全球最佳实践的变化现实和民主文化的加速相适应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域一体化理论、制度改革理论、全球化理论
AI.method: 采用历史叙事方法进行数据收集，主要利用从欧洲委员会档案馆获取的档案材料等一手资料，以及书籍、期刊文章和互联网资源等二手资料，并进行内容数据分析
AI.findings: 全球贸易自由化的扩张使得在非洲建设整合机构的过程中必须认真对待改革；非洲一体化需要与全球最佳实践和民主文化的加速相适应
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对改革在区域一体化中作用的理论理解，为非洲一体化研究提供了新的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲国家制定一体化改革政策提供实践指导，帮助非洲应对全球化挑战并建立有效的整合机构

title: The Validator Account: A New Numéraire for Assets on Blockchains
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Validator Account: A New Numéraire for Assets on Blockchains
detail.abstract: We introduce the concept of the validator account as a novel numéraire for pricing assets on blockchains with staking. We present staking as a bank-like deposit account, and formalize the validator account as an appropriate discounting numéraire. The validator account allows us to define a blockchain-specific equivalent martingale measure, termed the blockchain measure B. The validator account framework is a novel theoretical contribution, and allows us to extend arbitrage pricing theory to decentralized finance (DeFi).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了验证者账户作为区块链资产定价的新数值标床，将证明券投资模型扩展到去中心化金融领域
AI.research_question: 如何在区块链证明券投资环境下建立一种合适的资产定价框架？

AI.method: 理论建模方法，将证明券投资模拟为银行类似的存款账户，形式化验证者账户作为折现数值标床

title: COMPETITIVE ANALYSES OF LOCAL BAKERIES IN PRISHTINA/ REPUBLIC OF KOSOVO
affiliations: AAB College - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: COMPETITIVE ANALYSES OF LOCAL BAKERIES IN PRISHTINA/ REPUBLIC OF KOSOVO
detail.abstract: The main problem of today's companies is the division between marketing and sales as separate departments in company, or better saying, including the sales as division within the marketing department. Through this "regulation" of departments, enterprises will have more knowledge about market and competition and will be a step forward their competitors. The main purpose of this paper is to identify competitive analyses of local bakeries in the Capital City of Kosovo, Prishtina, and define how they act toward the competition and what strategies they use to compete in a very competitive business environment, pricing or quality based products offered to customers. While doing a research and analyzing competition and competitive strategies of bakeries, I found out that most of bakeries are based on achieving their competitive advantage in the market through lower prices than competitor and few of them based its strategy toward offering qualitative products and services to the customers and through it they have a better image and got customer loyalty. This situation is as a result of not having marketing department in any bakery or a person who is responsible for marketing. The only reason for not having established marketing was that these companies need more time to transition from sales to marketing activities. The data for research were collected through questionnaire in fifteen bakeries within the Prishtina city. Methods used for research have been descriptive, comparative, analysis, and synthesis. The research instrument was a questionnaire, the technique has been direct communication and research was conducted between months February and March 2012.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了科索沃首都普里什蒂纳当地面包店的竞争策略，发现大多数面包店通过低价竞争而非质量策略，主要原因是缺乏营销部门或专业人员，企业需要更多时间从销售导向转向营销导向。
AI.research_question: 普里什蒂纳当地面包店如何应对竞争环境，采用何种竞争策略（价格或质量基础）？
AI.motivation: 解决企业中营销与销售部门分离的问题，通过整合部门帮助企业更好地了解市场和竞争，获得竞争优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争战略理论，包括价格竞争和质量差异化战略
AI.method: 描述性、比较性、分析和综合研究方法，通过问卷调查15家面包店，采用直接沟通技术
AI.findings: 大多数面包店通过低于竞争对手的价格获得竞争优势，少数通过提供高质量产品和服务建立品牌形象和客户忠诚度；所有面包店都没有营销部门或专人负责营销
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了在中小企业中营销职能缺失对竞争策略选择的影响，提供了转型经济体中小型企业竞争行为的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为当地面包店提供从销售导向向营销导向转型的建议，强调建立营销职能对提升竞争力和客户忠诚度的重要性

title: Energy Policy and Corporate Eco-Efficiency: Evidence from US Manufacturers
affiliations: Goethe University Frankfurt

detail.title: Energy Policy and Corporate Eco-Efficiency: Evidence from US Manufacturers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper was written as a part of my doctoral thesis

detail.abstract: In the aftermath of the Energy Policy Act of 2005 (EPAct), the Energy Independence and Security Act of 2007 (EISA) introduced market-based instruments to boost efficient energy use and renewable fuel production. Following this event, my findings distinctly claim support of the "weak" form of the Porter hypothesis and an additional series of analyses using a market-based measure of firm competitiveness finds little evidence that invalidates the "strong" form of the hypothesis. In other words, EISA propelled the adoption of green innovative technologies and as a result despite the decreased near-term profitability observed in more eco-innovative firms, they correspondingly invested in R&D activities and were in parallel accompanied by positive abnormal returns over an extended period of time-thereby embedding eco-efficient aspects into their sustainable strategies and improving their shareholder values. Moreover, the 2007-2009 financial crisis hardly prevented larger firms from adopting these technologies, while small firms lagged behind in this space.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2007年能源独立与安全法案(EISA)对绿色创新技术采纳的影响，支持波特假说的弱形式，并为强形式提供证据，发现尽管短期盈利能力下降，但采用环保创新的企业通过研发投资获得了长期超额回报，提升了股东价值。
AI.research_question: EISA法案是否推动了企业绿色创新技术的采纳？这种环境规制是否支持波特假说（即环境规制能够促进企业创新和竞争力）？
AI.motivation: 2005年能源政策法案和2007年能源独立与安全法案引入了市场机制来促进能源效率和可再生能源生产，需要评估这些政策对企业创新和竞争力的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波特假说（Porter Hypothesis） - 认为适当设计的环境规制能够刺激创新，从而抵消合规成本甚至提升企业竞争力
AI.method: 事件研究法，使用市场基础的企业竞争力衡量指标，分析EISA法案实施后的企业表现
AI.findings:
1) 支持波特假说弱形式（环境规制促进创新）
2) 为波特假说强形式（提升竞争力）提供证据
3) 采用绿色创新技术的企业短期盈利能力下降但长期获得正超额回报
4) 大企业在金融危机期间仍能采纳技术，小企业落后
AI.theory_contributions: 为波特假说提供了实证支持，特别是对强形式的验证，深化了环境规制与企业竞争力关系的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计环境规制提供了依据，表明适当的环境政策能够同时促进环保创新和企业长期价值提升

title: Computational Genealogies and Political Attractors: A Network Analysis of Argentine Political Evolution (1810-2025)

detail.title: Computational Genealogies and Political Attractors: A Network Analysis of Argentine Political Evolution (1810-2025)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None. The author has no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived as influencing this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research analyzes publicly available historical documents only.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding. This research was conducted independently.

detail.abstract:
This study introduces a comprehensive computational framework for analyzing political evolution through
memetic genealogies and attractor identification in multidimensional ideological spaces. Employing novel tools
including PoliticalRootFinder, PoliticalMemespace, and bootstrap validation algorithms, we analyze 32
foundational Argentine political documents spanning 215 years. Our methodology combines TF-IDF vectorization
with cosine similarity thresholds (τ=0.3) to construct directed semantic networks, revealing 322 genealogical
chains with average path lengths of 15.33 connections—a 571% increase over smaller corpus analyses. Through
K-means clustering in 9-dimensional political space, we identify 21 stable attractors representing persistent
ideological configurations, nearly doubling the 11 attractors found in limited datasets.
The nine dimensions—economic ideology, social ideology, messianic leadership, charismatic leadership, antiestablishment
rhetoric, symbolic mysticism, populist appeal, authoritarian tendency, and media savvy—capture
political complexity invisible to traditional left-right spectrums. Temporal analysis demonstrates monotonically
increasing antagonism intensity (Historical: 0.436, Contemporary: 0.496, p<0.01), with peak polarization in the
2010s decade coinciding with global financial crisis and populist resurgence. Bootstrap validation (n=1000
iterations) confirms statistical robustness across all metrics with stability coefficients below 0.005. Network
density of 0.649 approaches theoretical predictions for fully connected political systems, while clustering
coefficient of 0.708 indicates highly modular political traditions maintaining distinct identities despite crossideological
memetic exchange. These findings fundamentally challenge traditional historiographic approaches by
revealing complex, multi-generational transmission networks invisible to qualitative analysis.
The dramatic expansion of detected patterns when moving from 13 to 32 documents demonstrates that previous
studies have systematically underestimated Argentine political complexity due to insufficient data rather than
genuine structural simplicity. Implications extend beyond methodology to democratic theory, suggesting that
political polarization follows predictable mathematical patterns amenable to early warning systems and targeted
interventions.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个计算框架，通过多维意识形态空间中的模因谱系和吸引子识别来分析政治演变。分析215年间的32份阿根廷政治文件，发现了571%增加的谱系链和几乎翻倍的稳定意识形态吸引子，挑战了传统历史分析方法。
AI.research_question: 如何通过计算方法和多维意识形态空间分析来揭示政治演变的复杂模式和结构？
AI.motivation: 传统定性分析方法无法捕捉政治演变的复杂网络结构和多代传承模式，需要开发新的计算框架来揭示这些隐藏的模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于模因理论、多维意识形态空间理论、网络分析和聚类分析理论，构建政治演变的计算分析框架。
AI.method: 使用PoliticalRootFinder、PoliticalMemespace和bootstrap验证算法，结合TF-IDF向量化和余弦相似性阈值(τ=0.3)构建有向语义网络，通过K-means聚类在9维政治空间中识别吸引子。
AI.findings: 发现了322条谱系链(平均路径长度15.33)，21个稳定吸引子，网络密度0.649，聚类系数0.708，敌对强度单调增加(历史0.436→当代0.496)，2010年代达到极化峰值。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统历史分析方法，揭示了定性分析无法发现的多代传承网络，证明了政治复杂性被系统性低估。
AI.practical_contributions: 为民主理论提供新见解，表明政治极化遵循可预测的数学模式，可用于早期预警系统和针对性干预措施。

title: Generative Innovation AI Part VI Nominal/Real Semantics Technological Linkage in GIAI-SBME Theory
affiliations: Catholic University of Buenos Aires

detail.title: Generative Innovation AI Part VI Nominal/Real Semantics Technological Linkage in GIAI-SBME Theory
detail.abstract: The GenAI research field of sense building mechanics engineering (SBME) formally exposed on Part I, with its monetization process explained in part II, analyzed in terms of concrete Models & Designs in Part III-The trilogy-, later extends & integrates the quantum dimension into the SBME theory of Generative Innovation AI (GIAI) in part IV. In Part V the real semantics environment (nominal innovative-chunk 's applicability) was properly analyzed. In this Part VI we approach the technological linkage between nominal and real semantics.

AI.tldr: 该论文是一个六部曲系列研究的第六部分，主要研究名义语义和实际语义之间的技术联系，是在生成创新AI理论框架下对语义环境的技术实现进行探讨。
