title: Tracking the relative importance of demand and supply shocks using the Survey of Professional Forecasters
affiliations: University of Lausanne and University of Lausanne

detail.title: Tracking the relative importance of demand and supply shocks using the Survey of Professional Forecasters
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a novel measure that tracks changes in the relative importance of demand and supply shocks in the economy. This measure is model-free, forward-looking, and available in real time. It is based on data from individual professional forecasters and is therefore available at a quarterly frequency. In each period, it is computed as the correlation between GDP and inflation forecasts (across forecasters). We rationalize it in the context of a synthetic model: if individual forecasters use imperfectly correlated private information about demand and supply factors to derive GDP and inflation forecasts, then the relationship, across forecasters, between expected changes in GDP and inflation is informative about the relative importance of demand over supply shocks in the economy. Regression results suggest that (i) this measure can capture, ex ante, changes in the covariance between GDP and inflation, (ii) it is negatively related to changes in bond term premiums, and (iii) it suggests that forecasters tend to under-predict inflation in supply-dominated environments.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种新的模型自由、前瞻性、实时可用的指标，通过专业预测者对GDP和通胀的预测相关性来跟踪经济中需求与供给冲击的相对重要性变化。
AI.research_question: 如何跟踪经济中需求冲击与供给冲击的相对重要性变化？
AI.motivation: 需要一种实时、前瞻性的方法来识别经济冲击的本质，以更好地理解经济变化和制定政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于合成模型理论，假设专业预测者使用不完全相关的私人信息来预测GDP和通胀，则预测者之间的GDP与通胀预测的相关性可以反映需求与供给冲击的相对重要性。
AI.method: 构建一种模型自由的指标，通过计算各专业预测者GDP预测与通胀预测之间的相关系数，并进行回归分析验证。
AI.findings: 该指标能够预先抓取GDP与通胀的协方差变化，与债券期限价差负相关，且发现预测者在供给冲击主导环境下容易低估通胀。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一种新的经济冲击识别理论框架，通过预测者行为来推断经济冲击的本质。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和预测者提供了一种实时、前瞻性的工具，用于识别经济冲击类型和预测错误模式。

title: Everyday Veil Piercing
affiliations: Emory University School of Law

detail.title: Everyday Veil Piercing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: Survey studies approved by Emory University IRB
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
Under veil-piercing doctrine, shareholders may lose the privilege of limited liability by disregarding the legal separation between themselves and the companies they own. The doctrine cautions, however, that abrogating limited liability is an exceptional remedy that requires the presence of certain factors. Among them are fraud on creditors; inattention to formalities; asset commingling; and undercapitalization. Yet courts, practitioners, and scholars lack everyday base rates of these factors—unfortunate given that their prevalence estimates could aid calibration of and rethinking about how exceptional the remedy ought to be. I begin addressing these missing base rates by estimating that in U.S. small businesses, inchoate fraud on creditors occurs with at least 4.89% annual prevalence; inattention to formalities with 12.60%; commingling with 26.37%; and undercapitalization with 38.22%.

I use two pre-registered survey studies of small businesses to reach these estimates. In the first, I ask respondents directly whether their firms have engaged in a set of practices, some innocuous and others proxying veil-piercing factors. But because veil-piercing factors could be socially undesirable, this direct-survey method risks producing downwardly biased estimates. To mitigate that potential bias, the second study employs a list experiment, a survey method used to elicit truthful answers to sensitive questions. Although list experiments have long been deployed in adjacent fields, I provide the first known instance of their use in studying legal doctrine. In doing so, I demonstrate how legal scholars can use this method to plumb countless other doctrinal questions.

The Article’s estimates translate to veil-piercing factors appearing in millions of businesses at any given time. They complement earlier studies showing that courts rule in favor of veil-piercing claimants more often than exceptionalist rhetoric found in case law suggests. Together, the Article explains, this set of findings redirects veil piercing’s meaning toward wrongdoing by corporate principals. That is, rather than allocating liability among corporations, their principals, and third-party creditors, the doctrine mostly serves to punish corporate abuses.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两项调查研究发现，美国小企业中刺破公司面纱的四个因素（欺诈债权人、忽视形式要求、资产混同、资本不足）发生率远高于预期，分别为4.89%、12.60%、26.37%和38.22%，表明该法理实际上更多用于惩罚公司不当行为而非分配责任。
AI.research_question: 美国小企业中刺破公司面纱各因素的实际发生率是多少？这些发生率如何影响我们对这一法理的理解？
AI.motivation: 法院、从业者和学者缺乏对这些因素日常基准率的了解，而这些普遍性估计有助于重新思考刺破公司面纱这一救济措施究竟应该有多特殊
AI.theoretical_framework: 刺破公司面纱理论，该理论允许在特定情况下否定股东的有限责任保护
AI.method: 使用两项预先注册的调查研究方法：第一项直接询问企业实践，第二项使用列表实验法来减少敏感问题的回答偏差
AI.findings: 四个因素的年发生率分别为：欺诈债权人至少4.89%，忽视形式要求12.60%，资产混同26.37%，资本不足38.22%
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定向刺破公司面纱法理的意义，从责任分配转向惩罚公司不当行为；首次在法学研究中应用列表实验方法
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院和从业者提供了实际发生率数据；展示了列表实验方法在法学实证研究中的适用性，可用于研究其他法理问题

title: How has the Effect of Government Spending Changed? Evidence from the High-Frequency Identified Shocks Since 1947 *

detail.title: How has the Effect of Government Spending Changed? Evidence from the High-Frequency Identified Shocks Since 1947 *
detail.abstract: This paper documents substantial time variation in the macroeconomic effects of government spending news in the U.S. economy. Using a novel identification strategy that combines text analysis with daily stock market data, I construct a quarterly series of exogenous government spending news from 1947 to 2019. The empirical analysis shows that output multipliers range from 0.8 to 1.5 over time, with the variation driven primarily by private investment responses. Private investment responds more strongly when the news signals a persistent expansion of government procurement from private suppliers. A New Keynesian model with fiscal foresight replicates this empirical relationship between news shock persistence and the strength of the private investment response.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文本分析和股市数据构建了1947-2019年美国政府支出新闻序列，发现财政支出乘数在0.8-1.5间波动，主要受私人投资响应驱动，且投资对持久性政府采购新闻反应更强。
AI.research_question: 美国政府支出新闻的宏观经济效应是否存在时间变化？这种变化的驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解财政政策效应的时变性对于政策制定至关重要，现有研究对政府支出新闻效应的动态特征关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯主义理论框架，包含财政前瞻性要素
AI.method: 结合文本分析和日度股市数据的识别策略，构建外生政府支出新闻季度序列
AI.findings: 产出乘数在0.8-1.5间变化；私人投资响应是主要驱动因素；投资对持久性政府采购新闻反应更强
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了新闻冲击持久性与私人投资响应强度之间的理论联系，验证了新凯恩斯模型对财政前瞻性的解释力
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于财政政策效应时变性的实证证据，强调了政策信号持久性的重要性

title: Unmaking the State: Succession Conflicts, State Building, and Long-Run Political Development
affiliations: Harvard University

detail.title: Unmaking the State: Succession Conflicts, State Building, and Long-Run Political Development
detail.abstract: Internal conflicts impede long-run state development. This paper argues that succession conflicts-violent struggles over the throne-fractured elite coalitions, disrupted bureaucratic expansion, and undermined the state's ability to monopolize violence or wage external war. These conflicts over the transfer of power had persistent effects. States with more frequent historical succession conflicts exhibit persistently lower fiscal capacity, less effective governments, and more neopatrimonial governance. Using original data on over 2,300 reigns across 115 monarchies from 1000 to 1800, I construct a measure of historical succession conflict exposure and link it to modern outcomes via spatial crosswalks. Instrumental variable estimates in early modern Europe suggest a plausibly causal relationship. The results reveal how the universal problem of succession generated institutional breakdown and help explain durable cross-national variation in state capacity today.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现历史上的王位继承冲突通过分裂精英联盟、破坏官僚扩张，对国家能力产生持久负面影响，导致现代国家财政能力下降、政府效率低下和庇护主义治理模式。
AI.research_question: 历史上的王位继承冲突如何影响现代国家能力的持久差异？
AI.motivation: 内部冲突阻碍国家长期发展，但具体机制和持久影响尚不清楚，特别是王位继承这一普遍问题如何导致制度崩溃和国家能力差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国家建设理论，关注精英联盟稳定性、官僚制度发展和暴力垄断能力对现代国家能力形成的关键作用。
AI.method: 使用115个君主制国家1000-1800年间2300多个统治时期的原始数据，构建历史继承冲突暴露度指标，通过空间交叉映射链接到现代结果，在欧洲早期现代时期使用工具变量进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 历史继承冲突频率越高的国家，现代财政能力越低、政府效率越差、庇护主义治理模式越明显，工具变量估计支持因果关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了王位继承这一普遍问题如何通过制度崩溃机制产生持久影响，深化了对国家能力形成历史根源的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为解释现代国家能力差异提供了历史制度视角，对理解发展中国家治理挑战和制度建设具有启示意义。

title: A Random Effects Model of Non-Ignorable Nonresponse in Panel Survey Data *
affiliations: Georgetown University - Department of Government and University of Connecticut - Department of Operations & Information Management

detail.title: A Random Effects Model of Non-Ignorable Nonresponse in Panel Survey Data *
detail.abstract: Many survey researchers worry that contemporary surveys can be biased due to non-ignorable nonresponse (NINR), which can persist even after quota sampling, weighting, or other covariatebased adjustments. NINR bias occurs when the propensity to respond is correlated with the outcome of interest conditional on covariates. Panel survey data provide an excellent opportunity for countering NINR because multiple observations for individuals across panel waves allow us to identify the correlation between response propensity and the outcome of interest. To date, however, most panel survey data is assessed as cross-sectional data, missing an opportunity to harness the informational advantage of panel data. This paper makes three contributions. First, we present a random effects panel selection model that explicitly accounts for NINR. Second, we present simulations that demonstrate that the model outperforms conventional methods in recovering the population mean when NINR bias is a problem. Third, we apply the random effects panel selection model to an application in which conventional polls were generally wrong. Our model has a substantial impact on inference and produces estimates that are closer to the ground truth values.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个随机效应面板选择模型来解决调查中的不可忽略无应答偏差问题，通过面板数据的优势来识别应答倾向与关注结果之间的相关性，相比传统方法能更准确地估计总体均值。
AI.research_question: 如何利用面板调查数据来有效应对不可忽略无应答偏差问题？
AI.motivation: 传统调查方法即使经过配额抽样、加权或其他协变量调整后，仍可能因不可忽略无应答偏差而产生偏差，而面板数据提供了解决这一问题的独特机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机效应面板选择模型，基于面板数据的重复观测特性来识别应答倾向与结果变量之间的条件相关性。
AI.method: 开发随机效应面板选择模型，通过模拟研究验证模型性能，并在实际选举调查案例中进行应用验证。
AI.findings: 该模型在存在不可忽略无应答偏差的情况下，相比传统方法能更准确地恢复总体均值，在实际应用中产生更接近真实值的估计结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个专门针对面板数据的随机效应选择模型，为处理调查无应答偏差提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为调查研究者提供了实用的分析工具，能够显著改善在存在不可忽略无应答偏差情况下的统计推断准确性。

title: Actions Speak as Loud as Words: Institutional Investors and Accounting Fraud

detail.title: Actions Speak as Loud as Words: Institutional Investors and Accounting Fraud
detail.abstract: This study investigates the levels of, and change in, institutional ownership around fraudulent 10-K filings.   Consistent with performance pressure encouraging firms to commit fraud, fraudulent firms exhibit higher ownership levels by transient institu- tions in the quarters prior to accounting fraud.  In contrast, higher ownership levels by non-transient institutions reflect a monitoring role that correlates with lower likeli- hood of accounting fraud. Following the release of fraudulent annual reports, transient institutions increase their holdings, suggesting their reaction to distorted signals em- bedded in misleading disclosures.  In contrast, non-transient institutions appear less influenced by these signals and more likely to rely on information advantage when adjusting their positions. Incorporating ownership metrics—disaggregated by investor type—significantly improves fraud detection models, outperforming the Beneish M- Score.  These results suggest that institutional ownership reflects information useful for early fraud identification and that investor heterogeneity plays a crucial role in shaping firms’ incentives and market integrity.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了机构投资者持股在财务欺诈前后的变化，发现短期机构投资者在欺诈前持股较高可能促使公司舞弊，而长期机构投资者的监督作用能降低欺诈概率。欺诈发生后，短期机构会增持（受误导信号影响），长期机构则依靠信息优势调整持仓。按投资者类型细分的持股指标能显著提升欺诈检测模型效果。
AI.research_question: 机构投资者持股水平在财务欺诈10-K申报前后的变化情况如何？不同类型机构投资者的行为差异对欺诈发生和市场完整性的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解机构投资者在财务欺诈中的角色差异，以及如何利用投资者异质性信息来改进欺诈检测模型
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论、信息不对称理论和机构投资者异质性理论，区分短期（transient）和长期（non-transient）机构投资者的不同行为模式
AI.method: 实证分析方法，使用财务欺诈公司的10-K申报数据，分析欺诈前后机构持股变化，并构建欺诈检测模型与Beneish M-Score进行比较
AI.findings: 1) 欺诈前短期机构持股较高可能促使公司舞弊；2) 长期机构持股体现监督作用，降低欺诈概率；3) 欺诈后短期机构增持（受误导信号影响），长期机构依靠信息优势调整；4) 按投资者类型细分的持股指标显著提升欺诈检测效果
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对机构投资者异质性的理解，揭示了不同类型投资者在欺诈过程中的不同角色，丰富了公司治理和信息披露理论
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了改进财务欺诈检测模型的新方法，投资者类型细分的持股指标比传统Beneish M-Score更有效，对监管机构和投资者具有实用价值

title: Funding Sources and Research Conclusions
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Finance and Columbia University

detail.title: Funding Sources and Research Conclusions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Bordoff is the Director of Columbia's Center for Global Energy Policy, and Heal chairs the Academic Advisory Board of the Center. Both receive compensation from the Center.

detail.abstract: We discuss the impact of the source of research funding on the conclusions of that research in the context of attitudes towards fossil fuels. Specifically following Almond et al. [1], we ask whether research institutes funded in part by fossil fuel companies are more likely to be favorable to fossil fuels. We find that neither the Almond et al. analysis nor our own analysis supports that conclusion, at least in one of the cases reported by Almond et al.

AI.tldr: 本文分析研究资金来源是否影响化石燃料相关研究的结论，特别是检验化石燃料公司资助的研究机构是否更倾向于支持化石燃料。研究发现无论是前人分析还是本文分析都不支持这一结论。
AI.research_question: 化石燃料公司资助的研究机构是否更可能对化石燃料持有利态度？
AI.motivation: 探讨研究资金来源对研究结论的潜在影响，特别是在化石燃料这一具有争议性的领域，验证Almond等人的研究发现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 研究偏见理论，资金来源对研究结论影响的相关理论框架
AI.method: 基于Almond等人的分析方法进行实证检验，采用类似的统计分析方法来验证研究假设
AI.findings: 研究结果表明，无论是Almond等人的分析还是本文的分析，都不支持化石燃料公司资助会导致研究结论更有利的假设
AI.theory_contributions: 对研究偏见理论提供了反证，表明在特定情况下资金来源可能不会显著影响研究结论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和公众提供了关于研究客观性的实证证据，有助于更理性地看待不同资金来源的研究成果

title: Ergonomics and Incentive Compensation
affiliations: Parthenope University of Naples and Skema Business School  &  GREDEG, Université Côte D'Azur

detail.title: Ergonomics and Incentive Compensation
detail.abstract: Ergonomics is frequently invoked to foster productivity, competitiveness, regulatory compliance, consumer welfare, and the fulfillment of organizational objectives. As a first step to integrate ergonomics in the theory of the firm, we use a simple but non-standard principal-agent model. The principal (the firm) sets monetary compensation, while also investing in decreasing the agent's (a representative employee's) marginal cost of effort-thanks to process ergonomics-and increasing consumers' willingness-to-pay for a more userfriendly product-thanks to product ergonomics. Our main finding/prediction is that investing in ergonomics comes with lower-powered incentives but entails higher output. Some policy implications and potential research avenues are briefly discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建一个非标准委托-代理模型，首次将人机工程学整合到企业理论中，发现投资于人机工程学会带来低强度激励但更高产出。
AI.research_question: 如何将人机工程学整合到企业理论框架中？投资于人机工程学对激励机制和产出有何影响？
AI.motivation: 人机工程学常被用于提高生产力、竞争力、合规性、消费者福利和组织目标实现，但缺乏系统的理论整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非标准委托-代理理论，企业作为委托人，员工作为代理人，通过过程人机工程学降低努力边际成本，通过产品人机工程学提高消费者支付意愿。
AI.method: 构建理论模型分析，企业设定货币补偿并投资于人机工程学，分析其对激励机制和产出的影响。
AI.findings: 投资于人机工程学会导致低强度激励机制但产生更高产出水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将人机工程学整合到企业理论框架中，为人机工程学投资提供了理论依据和分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业投资于人机工程学提供了决策参考，表明即使激励强度降低，仍能通过人机工程学投资获得更高产出。

title: Information Cascades in Crowdfunding Platforms
affiliations: University of Tokyo, Graduate School of Economics

detail.title: Information Cascades in Crowdfunding Platforms
detail.abstract: We investigate the dynamics of investment behavior on crowdfunding platforms where project value is common but uncertain. Assuming an all-or-nothing funding scheme, we examine the impact of different information structures on investor behavior. Specifically, we analyze three scenarios: (i) full observability of past decisions, (ii) no observability, and (iii) observability of the number of past investors. We demonstrate that information cascades occur under full observability but do not in the third case, where investors gain no additional information beyond the funding outcome. Despite this nolearning property, we show that history-dependent equilibria can achieve better information aggregation than history-independent ones. By incorporating the dynamic nature of crowdfunding, our study offers insights into the conditions under which the platform effectively serves as a gatekeeper of finance and provides guidelines for optimizing the information structure. Additionally, this research contributes to social learning theory by presenting a model of observational learning with payoff interdependence under imperfect observability.

AI.tldr: 研究众筹平台投资行为动态，分析不同信息结构对投资者决策的影响，发现在完全可观测条件下会出现信息级联，而在仅观测投资者数量时不会发生学习但历史依赖均衡能实现更好的信息聚合
AI.research_question: 不同信息结构如何影响众筹平台上的投资行为动态？
AI.motivation: 理解众筹平台作为金融守门人的有效性条件，为优化信息结构提供指导
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会学习理论，观察学习模型，支付相互依赖性，不完全可观测性
AI.method: 理论建模分析，比较三种信息结构场景：(i)完全可观测过去决策，(ii)不可观测，(iii)仅观测过去投资者数量
AI.findings: 完全可观测条件下会出现信息级联，第三种情况（仅观测投资者数量）下投资者无法获得额外信息，但历史依赖均衡比历史独立均衡能实现更好的信息聚合
AI.theory_contributions: 为社会学习理论提供了在支付相互依赖和不完全可观测条件下的观察学习模型
AI.practical_contributions: 为众筹平台优化信息结构提供指导，帮助平台更有效地作为金融守门人

title: Does Tax Avoidance Trickle Down? Evidence from a Field Experiment
affiliations: University of Michigan, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and The University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management

detail.title: Does Tax Avoidance Trickle Down? Evidence from a Field Experiment
detail.abstract: The wealthiest individuals frequently engage in tax avoidance, and public awareness of this behavior is growing. Such awareness may undermine tax compliance among the broader population, either by revealing strategies others can emulate or by shifting social norms to make avoidance seem more acceptable. We first document that individuals are less tolerant of both tax avoidance and tax evasion when carried out by the wealthiest households. We next present results from a field experiment on property tax appeals, which-like other forms of tax avoidance-is used disproportionately by the wealthiest households. Providing information about the appeal rates of the richest-1% of households increased individuals' perceptions of unfairness, but did not affect their own appeal decisions-measured via administrative records-or even their expected tax savings. Information about the prevalence of appeals among comparable households also had no effect. By contrast, information about the expected financial gains from appealing had a significant effect on appeal choices. In sum, while the public condemns tax avoidance by the wealthiest households, we find no sign that such behavior encourages similar actions among the broader population.

AI.tldr: 研究发现公众虽然谴责最富有家庭的避税行为，但这种行为并不会鼓励普通人群效仿。信息干预显示，告知最富有人群的申诉率会增加不公平感，但不影响个人申诉决策，而财务收益信息则显著影响申诉选择。
AI.research_question: 最富有家庭的避税行为是否会鼓励普通人群进行类似的避税行为？
AI.motivation: 公众对富人避税行为的意识日益增强，这可能通过揭示可模仿策略或改变社会规范来破坏普通人群的税收遵从性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和社会规范理论，探讨信息传递对税收遵从行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用田野实验方法，通过向房产税申诉者提供不同类型的信息（最富1%家庭申诉率、同类家庭申诉率、预期财务收益），并利用行政记录测量实际申诉行为。
AI.findings: 提供最富1%家庭申诉率信息增加了不公平感，但不影响个人申诉决策；提供同类家庭申诉率信息也无效果；只有预期财务收益信息显著影响申诉选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了富人避税行为会鼓励普通人群效仿的传统观点，表明社会规范信息对实际行为影响有限，而经济动机仍是主要驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税收政策设计提供实证依据，表明单纯披露富人避税行为可能不足以改变普通纳税人行为，需要结合经济激励措施。

title: Nonbank Finance and Monetary Policy Transmission
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements

detail.title: Nonbank Finance and Monetary Policy Transmission
detail.abstract: This paper briefly highlights the channels of monetary policy transmission that may be affected by different types of NBFIs, and discusses empirical evidence. It underscores that different types of NBFIs react differently to monetary policy changes. Overall, compared to banks, money market funds and nonbank lenders tend to dampen the effects of monetary policy, while bond mutual funds tend to amplify them. The net effects on monetary policy transmission likely depends on the relative importance of different forms of nonbank finance prevalent in the specific jurisdiction.

AI.tldr: 本文简要分析了不同类型非银行金融机构如何影响货币政策传导渠道，并讨论了相关实证证据。研究发现不同类别NBFIs对货币政策变化的反应存在差异：货币市场基金和非银行贷款机构倾向于减弱货币政策效果，而债券共同基金倾向于放大政策效果。货币政策传导的净效应取决于特定司法管辖区中不同非银行融资形式的相对重要性。
AI.research_question: 不同类型非银行金融机构如何影响货币政策传导机制？
AI.motivation: 随着非银行金融机构在金融体系中的重要性日益增长，理解它们对货币政策传导的影响对于制定有效的货币政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币政策传导渠道理论，分析信贷渠道、利率渠道和资产价格渠道如何受到不同类型NBFIs的影响。
AI.method: 文献综述和实证证据分析，比较银行与不同类型NBFIs对货币政策冲击的反应差异。
AI.findings: 1) 货币市场基金和非银行贷款机构倾向于减弱货币政策效果；2) 债券共同基金倾向于放大货币政策效果；3) 净效应取决于各司法管辖区非银行融资结构的相对重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对非银行金融机构在货币政策传导中异质性作用的理论理解，为货币政策理论提供了新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要参考，帮助其根据本国非银行金融结构特点制定更有针对性的货币政策措施。

detail.abstract: Why should I pay to participate in a conference that exploits my name? Why am I granted only a symbolic invitation, treated as a marketing tool? Why is my journal used as a quality seal yet marginalized in decision-making?" DFAS-CGP is not merely a protocol; it is an empowerment and structuring instrument that recalibrates the relationship between journals and conferences. It represents a declaration ending institutional silence and initiating a new era of fairness, transparency, and organized partnership (Alaali, 2025a; Alaali, 2025b; Alaali, 2025c). This manifesto serves as the philosophical and operational basis for DFAS-CGP, establishing the ethical, procedural, and structural norms that govern conference-journal interactions.

AI.findings: DFAS-CGP协议能够有效重新校准期刊与会议的关系，实现公平、透明和有组织的伙伴关系。

title: THE IMPACT OF ACCOUNTING INFORMATION IN BUSINESS DECISION-MAKING IN COMMERCIAL COMPANIES IN THE REPUBLIC OF KOSOVA

detail.title: THE IMPACT OF ACCOUNTING INFORMATION IN BUSINESS DECISION-MAKING IN COMMERCIAL COMPANIES IN THE REPUBLIC OF KOSOVA
detail.abstract: Commercial companies are using a various internal and external informational resources in business decision-making. The accounting information system represents the most important internal source of information in order to make adequate business decisions. The accounting system aims to provide primary source information for the business management of companies. Accounting figures relate to the adequate position of financial reports in companies. By placing them in mutual reports such as "Ratio analysis", we manage to obtain relevant information dedicated to the economic and financial situation and the performance of the company. Accounting information enables different users to make decisions based on different source data in order to create mutual debitcredit ratios. This paper aims to analyse the situation of companies (micro, small and medium) in the Republic of Kosovo in terms of the use of accounting information and "Ratio analysis" in the business decisionmaking process. Being aware that accounting information in annual accounts between companies may have a low degree of "reliability". However, it remains the main source of business decisionmaking analysis. For the purpose of this study, the data sources will be used from the accounts of a considerable sample of the trade companies in the Republic of Kosovo, as well as a questionnaire dedicated to this topic. Ratio analysis methods will be used as well as statistical methods in terms of creating and presenting research findings.

detail.abstract: This study investigates the causal relationship between tax policies and economic growth by utilizing North Carolina's 2014 tax reform as a quasi-natural experiment to identify economic growth driven by the reforms. I employed a difference-indifference method to analyze a panel dataset of North Carolina as the treatment state due to its tax reform and Virginia as the control state due to its stable tax regime within the period. I used state and year fixed effects to estimate the reforms' impacts on three economic growth indicators, comprising real per capita income, employment-population ratio, and real GDP. The analysis incorporates three key controls, including tax revenue as a fraction of personal income, bachelor's degree education attainment, and population density. The findings revealed that the tax reforms had the most pronounced positive impact on real GDP, which grew substantially in North Carolina relative to the counterfactual trend. I also observed a statistically significant increase in real per capita income and employment population ratio. These results support the hypothesis that lower tax rates can be a potent tool for stimulating economic growth at the state level.

title: Environmental Ratings and Stock Returns: The Dominant Role of Climate Change
affiliations: Utrecht University - School of Economics and Utrecht University - School of Economics

detail.title: Environmental Ratings and Stock Returns: The Dominant Role of Climate Change
detail.abstract: We analyze the effect of MSCI's environmental rating changes on stock returns for U.S.listed firms. We consider the aggregate environmental rating, its four underlying theme ratings, and thirteen environmental key issue ratings from which both the aggregate and theme ratings are constructed. We find that the positive effect of aggregate environmental rating changes on subsequent stock returns is driven by changes in the underlying climate change rating with no significant impact of any of the other underlying theme ratings. Specifically, a one point increase in climate change rating, measured on a tenpoint scale, is associated with stock returns increasing by about one percentage point over a subsequent period of six months. Changes in the underlying carbon emissions rating are the most important driver of the impact of climate change rating changes on stock returns. Further analyses highlight the forward-looking nature of carbon emissions ratings in capturing emissions-related risks. Specifically, they show carbon emissions rating changes predict changes in future carbon emissions and carbon emission intensity.

title: Nature Biotechnology ~ Matters Arising: Methodological Concerns and a Lack of Evidence for Reforming Regulatory Exclusivities for Pharmaceuticals
affiliations: Colorado College - Department of Economics and Business

detail.title: Nature Biotechnology ~ Matters Arising: Methodological Concerns and a Lack of Evidence for Reforming Regulatory Exclusivities for Pharmaceuticals

declarations.funderStatement: I am currently a professor of Economics at Colorado College and an affiliate at the EIRA Initiative, UC Berkeley. I received funding from both institutions during the summer of 2025.

contentType.other: submitted comment to Nature Biotechnology, Matters Arising

contentFormat.other: This is a draft submitted to Nature Biotechnology Matters Arising, raising concerns about a recently published piece.

detail.abstract: In a recent issue of Nature Biotechnology, Feldman et al. 1 examine the New Clinical Investigation (NCI) exclusivity by analyzing the non-patent exclusivities protecting a subset of drugs included in the 2019 Medicare Part D and 2019 Medicaid formularies. The study focuses on drugs that account for substantial federal drug spending: specifically, drugs with ten years of market time for which 2019 spending totaled at least $10 million. These conditions provide a baseline subset of 236 drugs of which 176 drugs had exclusivities that expired after the drug's core patent and any patent-term extension. An additional subset of these 176 drugs account for 210 instances of four types of exclusivities: New Clinical Investigation (148), Pediatric (42), Orphan Drug (19) and New Chemical Entity (1). The authors calculate that the New Clinical Investigation exclusivity comprises 70.5% of exclusivities expiring after expiration of a drug's core patent. This result is claimed to establish that New Clinical Investigation exclusivities are a substantial contributor to rising drug prices and stalled generic entry. Finally, the study notes that the potential for rampant use of NCI exclusivity provides a guide for reform, proposing a cap on the number of regulatory exclusivities that may be granted to a company or drug. High drug prices are a serious issue and efforts to address them are laudable. However, the methods employed to advocate for systemic reform are concerning. The authors' data fall short of establishing a significant problem or substantiating the claim that the pharmaceutical industry has shifted their energy away from innovation and toward preclusion of competition.

title: Optimal Mechanization Investments in Resource Constrained Farming
affiliations: Santa Clara University - Information Systems and Analytics and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Operations Area

detail.title: Optimal Mechanization Investments in Resource Constrained Farming
detail.abstract: Adopting mechanization in farming is an effective approach to increase agricultural productivity. However, in developing economies, majority of farmers face severe constraints in terms of land size and budget. In this paper, we analyze a farmer's investment decision for a single crop under limited land and budget. We model expected crop production using a Cobb-Douglas function of seed amount and machine capacity and explore the farmer's optimal procurement of these inputs to maximize her profit. For a monopolist farmer, we find that the optimal strategy follows a modified threshold-type policy, which is categorized into three scenarios (1) unconstrained scenario, (2) land-size-constrained scenario and (3) budget-constrained scenario. The relationship between cropped land and mechanization is determined by the policy scenario and budget structure. In the land-size-constrained scenario, land and machine capacity act as complements when the farmer's budget increases with her land size beyond a minimal rate but remains highly limited, while they are substitutes when her budget is moderately limited, independent of her land size or grows minimally with it. In the budget-constrained scenario, however, land and machine capacity serve as complements when the farmer's budget is increasing in her land size. We further explore how variations in seed efficacy and mechanization efficiency affect these decisions and find that, while improved seed efficacy generally incentivizes the planting of more seeds and increased usage of cropping area, and higher mechanization efficiency typically promotes greater mechanization levels, farmers may adopt a counterintuitive strategy when these factors are already high. Extending our analysis to a Cournot competition model, we show that while the threshold policy remains optimal, competition can lead to increased mechanization levels and reduced profits due to overproduction. Additionally, we demonstrate that cooperative formation can enhance profitability for farmers with extreme resource limitations. Our study offers guidance on optimal resource allocation under land and financial constraints as well as the impact of effectiveness of machinery and seeds. Our results offers policymakers actionable insights for designing appropriate subsidies that encourage mechanization under competitive and cooperative settings.

title: Supplementary Appendix for Detecting Structural Changes in Green Bond Markets: A Panel-MIDAS Regression Approach with Cross-Entropy Method
affiliations: , University of California Santa Barbara, Grenoble Ecole de Management, University of Reading - ICMA Centre and University of Reading - ICMA Centre

detail.title: Supplementary Appendix for Detecting Structural Changes in Green Bond Markets: A Panel-MIDAS Regression Approach with Cross-Entropy Method
detail.abstract: This paper develops a three-stage Panel-MIDAS-ARDL regression, integrated with the CrossEntropy method, to detect structural breaks in the greenium of 119 U.S. municipal green bonds from January 2019 to December 2023. Using Bloomberg data, the sample includes AAA-rated bonds with fixed semi-annual coupons, SNDP seniority, and issuance amounts of $500 million – $1 billion across four categories: Public Improvements, Sewer Improvements, Sustainable Purpose, and Water Utility Improvements. We relate the greenium – defined as the yield spread between green bonds and U.S. Treasuries - to market factors, finding structural breaks linked to macroeconomic shifts, COVID-19, Federal Reserve policy, and the Russia–Ukraine war.

title: Penalized Regression Methods for Exchange Rate Forecasting: Evidence from the U.S. Dollar Index

detail.title: Penalized Regression Methods for Exchange Rate Forecasting: Evidence from the U.S. Dollar Index
detail.abstract: This paper examines the effectiveness of penalized regression techniques in forecasting exchange rate movements. Using daily data for the U.S. Dollar Index (DXY) in 2016, we compare the performance of Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) with Ridge and Lasso regression models. The predictors include gold and silver returns, the S&P 500 Index, short-and longterm Treasury yields, and the EURUSD exchange rate. Results show that while OLS suffers from instability due to multicollinearity, Ridge regression improves coefficient stability and predictive accuracy. Lasso regression provides the best overall performance, with the highest explanatory power and the lowest prediction error, by selecting only the most relevant variables. These findings underscore the value of penalized regression in financial econometrics and highlight its potential for robust exchange rate forecasting.

AI.tldr: 惩罚回归方法（Ridge和Lasso）在汇率预测中优于OLS，Lasso表现最佳，通过变量选择提高预测精度和稳定性
AI.research_question: 惩罚回归技术（Ridge和Lasso）在预测汇率变动方面的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 传统OLS回归在存在多重共线性时表现不稳定，需要探索更稳健的预测方法
AI.theoretical_framework: 惩罚回归理论（Ridge回归和Lasso回归），金融计量经济学
AI.method: 使用2016年美元指数(DXY)日度数据，比较OLS、Ridge和Lasso回归模型，预测变量包括金银收益、标普500指数、国债收益率和欧元汇率
AI.findings: OLS受多重共线性影响不稳定；Ridge回归提高系数稳定性和预测精度；Lasso回归表现最佳，具有最高解释力和最低预测误差
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了惩罚回归在金融计量经济学中的理论价值，特别是在处理多重共线性问题时的优势
AI.practical_contributions: 为汇率预测提供了更稳健的建模方法，Lasso回归的变量选择功能有助于识别最相关的预测因子

title: Integrating Block Chain with IoT for Real-Time Secure Data Transmission

detail.title: Integrating Block Chain with IoT for Real-Time Secure Data Transmission
detail.abstract: The proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has transformed data generation, enabling real-time monitoring, automation, and analytics across industries such as healthcare, manufacturing, and smart cities. However, the reliance on centralized architectures for data storage and transmission introduces vulnerabilities, including susceptibility to cybe rattacks, single points of failure, and unauthorized access. Block chain technology offers a promising solution through its decentralized, immutable, and cryptographically secure architecture, which can facilitate trust less, transparent, and tamper-proof real-time data transmission. This paper examines the integration of block chain with IoT systems to ensure secure, verifiable, and efficient data exchange. It reviews recent advancements, frameworks, and consensus mechanisms tailored for resource-constrained IoT environments. The discussion addresses practical deployment challenges such as scalability, network latency, and energy consumption, along with emerging opportunities including the use of edge computing and lightweight block chain protocols. The findings underscore block chain's role as a transformative enabler for secure real-time IoT communications, while also outlining critical research gaps that must be addressed for mass adoption.

AI.tldr: 区块链技术为物联网系统提供去中心化、安全的数据传输解决方案，通过不可篡改的加密架构解决集中式架构的安全漏洞问题，但面临可扩展性、网络延迟和能耗等部署挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何将区块链技术集成到物联网系统中，以确保安全、可验证和高效的数据交换？
AI.motivation: 物联网设备激增带来实时监控和数据分析需求，但集中式架构存在网络安全攻击、单点故障和未经授权访问等漏洞，需要更安全的数据传输解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链技术的去中心化、不可篡改和加密安全架构理论，以及适用于资源受限物联网环境的共识机制理论。
AI.method: 文献综述法，回顾近期区块链与物联网集成的进展、框架和共识机制，分析实际部署挑战和新兴机遇。
AI.findings: 区块链作为变革性推动者，能够实现安全的实时物联网通信，但需要解决可扩展性、网络延迟和能耗等关键研究空白才能实现大规模应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了区块链与物联网集成的理论框架，提出了适用于资源受限环境的轻量级区块链协议和共识机制的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为物联网系统提供了去中心化的安全数据传输解决方案，指出了边缘计算和轻量级区块链协议等实际部署机会，为行业应用提供了实践指导。

title: Property Without Law. Personalized Property Rights Through Smart Contracts on the Blockchain
affiliations: ETH Zürich, University of Amsterdam, University of Amsterdam - University of Amsterdam Faculty of Law and Hebrew University of Jerusalem - Faculty of Law, University of Pennsylvania Carey Law School

detail.title: Property Without Law. Personalized Property Rights Through Smart Contracts on the Blockchain

publicationDetails.detailsText: Amsterdam Center for Law & Economics Working Paper No. 2025-04

detail.abstract: Emerging technologies for the automatic enforcement of contracts, conventionally referred to as smart contracts, have the potential to realize Professor Alan Schwartz’ ideal of an efficient contract law for sophisticated parties, as they reduce the cost of textualist enforcement, added contingencies, and privately-provided templates, and offer a way to get around mandatory rules relating to such matters as contract modifications, penalty clauses, and substantial performance. They also enable contracting parties to create personalized property rights free of legal restraints. Through automatic enforcement, a contract term can be directly included in contracts with subsequent transferees of the asset. Smart contracts thus turn mere contractual rights into de facto property rights that “run with the (digital) asset.” Breach is made impossible by the very nature of the automatic enforcement system, and notice is assured by distributed and readily accessible ledgers. Compared to traditional property rights, these “property-without-law” rights are more easily customizable ex ante – as they are not bound by the numerus clausus principle – and stronger ex post – because courts cannot modulate enforcement. We document this phenomenon, explore its potential and vulnerabilities, discuss examples in intellectual property, real estate, organizations, and financial contracts, and re-examine the role of property law in a world where technology, rather than law, turns promises into assets.

AI.tldr: 智能合约技术通过自动执行机制，将合同权利转化为事实上的财产权利，绕过法律限制和强制规则，实现高度可定制的财产权利，但同时也带来新的脆弱性和对传统财产法角色的重新审视。
AI.research_question: 智能合约技术如何改变合同执行方式，以及这种技术驱动的自动执行机制对传统财产法律体系的影响和挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 探索新兴智能合约技术如何实现Alan Schwartz教授提出的高效合同法理想，分析其通过自动执行机制将合同权利转化为事实财产权利的能力，以及这种技术对传统法律约束的突破。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于合同法与财产法的理论框架，特别是Alan Schwartz的高效合同法理论、numerus clausus（封闭数量）原则、以及财产权利"随物流转"（run with the asset）的传统法理。
AI.method: 理论分析和现象文档法，通过分析智能合约的技术特性，探讨其在知识产权、房地产、组织和金融合同等领域的应用实例。
AI.findings: 智能合约通过自动执行减少了文本执行成本、附加条件和私人模板需求，能够绕过合同修改、罚金条款和实质履行等强制性规则，创建不受法律约束的个性化财产权利。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"无法律的财产权"概念，挑战了传统财产法的numerus clausus原则，重新思考技术在将承诺转化为资产过程中的作用，对财产法理论进行了重要拓展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合同设计和执行提供了新的技术解决方案，展示了智能合约在多个领域的应用潜力，同时指出了技术驱动财产权利系统的潜在脆弱性，为实践者提供了重要参考。

title: Rhythmic Language Protocol（RLP）Whitepaper | A Rhythm-Oriented Prototype for Language Interfaces：Use structure and rhythm to turn language into an executable collaboration protocol
affiliations: The University of Manchester

detail.title: Rhythmic Language Protocol（RLP）Whitepaper | A Rhythm-Oriented Prototype for Language Interfaces：Use structure and rhythm to turn language into an executable collaboration protocol

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A — The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A — This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or experiments requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: N/A — This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Most large language models (LLMs) still operate on a sentence/paragraph paradigm: humans prompt, models reply by probabilistic prediction. This paradigm scales single-turn tasks but fails in collaborative settings where multi-role handoffs, structural paths, and rhythmic coordination are required. We propose the Rhythmic Language Protocol (RLP)—a language interface that upgrades input from content to executable structure. RLP introduces a five-layer stack that makes collaboration perceivable and runnable: Structure (modules and anchors), Rhythm (beats, pauses, resonance), Roles (explicit division of labor), Paths (routes, jumps, loops), and Execution (SPRL/EE-driven multi-turn generation). Situated between humans and models, RLP functions as an intermediary protocol: it compiles structural/rhythmic signals (SER × CSL × Rhythm OS) into controllable generation, without changing the underlying model. We show how RLP reframes writing and reasoning as path execution rather than one-off answering, enabling traceable handoffs, reversible backtracking, and reusable structural assets across documents, agents, and modalities. The framework clarifies the relationship between CLM (Collaborative Language Model), CCI (Collaborative Co-Intelligence), and Rhythm OS, positioning RLP as the operations layer that binds them. The contribution is conceptual and architectural: a shift from prompt engineering to protocol engineering that allows existing LLMs to participate in structure-first, rhythm-aligned, multi-role collaboration. We conclude that collaboration efficacy depends less on model size than on language interfaces that encode paths, roles, and rhythm—the primitives of co-built intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出了节奏语言协议（RLP），将语言模型从单轮问答升级为可执行的结构化协作接口，通过五层堆栈实现多角色、可追踪的协作生成
AI.research_question: 如何让大型语言模型从单轮问答范式转变为支持多角色协作、结构化路径和节奏协调的协作范式？
AI.motivation: 当前LLM基于句子/段落的提示-回复范式无法满足协作场景中对多角色交接、结构化路径和节奏协调的需求
AI.theoretical_framework: 节奏语言协议（RLP）五层堆栈理论：结构层（模块和锚点）、节奏层（节拍、暂停、共振）、角色层（明确分工）、路径层（路由、跳转、循环）、执行层（多轮生成）
AI.method: 提出RLP作为中介协议，将结构/节奏信号编译为可控生成，不改变底层模型，通过SPRL/EE驱动多轮生成
AI.findings: RLP能够将写作和推理重构为路径执行而非一次性回答，实现可追踪的交接、可逆回溯和跨文档/代理/模态的可重用结构资产
AI.theory_contributions: 概念性和架构性贡献：从提示工程转向协议工程，阐明CLM、CCI和Rhythm OS之间的关系，将RLP定位为绑定它们的操作层
AI.practical_contributions: 使现有LLM能够参与结构优先、节奏对齐、多角色协作，证明协作效能更依赖于编码路径、角色和节奏的语言接口而非模型大小

title: The Effect the 2008 Financial Crisis and the COVID-19 Pandemic had on Spain’s Economy
affiliations: Independent, Independent

detail.title: The Effect the 2008 Financial Crisis and the COVID-19 Pandemic had on Spain’s Economy
detail.abstract: This paper examines the trajectory of the Spanish economy before, during, and after the 2008 global financial crisis. It explores the rapid growth of the early 2000s—fueled by credit expansion, real estate speculation, and rising public revenues—and contrasts it with the severe consequences of the crash, including soaring unemployment, fiscal deficits, and financial instability. Using a combination of macroeconomic data and policy analysis, the study highlights how structural vulnerabilities amplified the crisis in Spain and discusses the long-term social and economic repercussions. The research is motivated by first-hand experience of the crisis’s impact, underscoring its significance beyond statistical indicators.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了西班牙经济在2008年全球金融危机前后的发展轨迹，探讨了信贷扩张和房地产投机驱动的快速增长期与危机后的严重后果，使用宏观经济数据和政策分析揭示了结构性脆弱性如何放大危机影响。
AI.research_question: 西班牙经济在2008年全球金融危机前后的发展轨迹是怎样的？结构性脆弱性如何放大危机的影响？
AI.motivation: 作者亲身经历了危机的冲击，认识到其影响远超统计指标，需要深入理解危机背后的结构性问题和长期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济理论和金融危机理论，分析信贷扩张、房地产泡沫与金融稳定的关系。
AI.method: 采用宏观经济数据分析和政策分析相结合的方法
AI.findings: 西班牙经济在危机前因信贷扩张和房地产投机快速增长，但结构性脆弱性导致危机后果特别严重，包括高失业率、财政赤字和金融不稳定，产生了长期的社会经济影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对新兴经济体在全球化背景下金融危机传导机制的理解，特别是结构性脆弱性在放大危机影响中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何防范类似危机和应对危机的经验教训，对其他国家具有警示和借鉴意义。

title: Risk Spillovers Between Carbon Markets and Power Generation Industries Under the Shocks of Major Events and External Uncertainties: A Time-Frequency Analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Risk Spillovers Between Carbon Markets and Power Generation Industries Under the Shocks of Major Events and External Uncertainties: A Time-Frequency Analysis
detail.abstract: Carbon market and the power generation sector are closely interconnected, with some major events and frequent uncertainties affecting their linkages. Previous studies have predominantly analyzed time-domain spillovers between carbon and electricity markets rather than focusing on the power generation sector. In this study, we conduct a series of Time-Varying Parameter Vector Autoregressive (TVP-VAR)-family models to quantify risk spillovers in time-frequency domains among three regional carbon markets and seven power generation subsectors, and then investigate how the spillover effects vary across four categories of major events and multiple external uncertainties. It is found that carbon markets and the hydropower industry primarily act as net risk receivers, whereas nuclear power industry acts as the strongest net risk transmitter. Risk spillovers between carbon markets and power generation sectors are predominantly short-term and exhibit sensitivity to different major events, including the Sino-US trade war, COVID-19 pandemic, launch of China's national carbon market, and Russia-Ukraine war. Further analysis indicates that climate risks and economic policy uncertainty usually strengthen spillovers, but the COVID-19 pandemic will reverse the effect of economic policy uncertainty. These findings are crucial for risk management and synergistic development of carbon markets and the power generation sector under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用TVP-VAR系列模型分析中国三个区域碳市场与七个电力发电子行业间的时频域风险溢出效应，发现碳市场和水电行业主要作为风险接收者，核电行业是最强的风险传播者，溢出效应主要呈短期性且对重大事件敏感。
AI.research_question: 碳市场与电力发电行业之间的风险溢出效应如何随时间频率变化？重大事件和外部不确定性如何影响这些溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 碳市场与电力发电行业紧密相连，但现有研究主要关注碳市场与电力市场的时间域溢出，缺乏对电力发电子行业的时频域风险溢出分析，特别是在重大事件和不确定性背景下的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时变参数向量自回归(TVP-VAR)模型框架，结合时间频率分析方法，研究碳市场与电力发电子行业之间的风险传导机制。
AI.method: 采用TVP-VAR系列模型，分析三个区域碳市场和七个电力发电子行业（包括水电、核电等）的数据，量化时频域风险溢出，并考察四大类重大事件（中美贸易战、COVID-19疫情、全国碳市场启动、俄乌战争）和外部不确定性因素的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 碳市场和水电行业主要作为净风险接收者；2) 核电行业是最强的净风险传播者；3) 风险溢出主要呈短期性；4) 溢出效应对重大事件敏感；5) 气候风险和经济政策不确定性通常强化溢出，但COVID-19疫情会逆转经济政策不确定性的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了碳市场与电力行业风险溢出的理论研究，引入了时频域分析视角，建立了重大事件和不确定性因素对风险传导影响的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为碳市场和电力发电行业在不确定性环境下的风险管理和协同发展提供重要依据，帮助相关企业和政策制定者更好地应对风险传导和外部冲击。

title: Seventy Professors, Zero Rebuttals: Institutional Silence and Accountability in Higher Education
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: Seventy Professors, Zero Rebuttals: Institutional Silence and Accountability in Higher Education

declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics approval was needed for the paper
declarations.funderStatement: No funding, it was an independent researcher with no financial support for the research paper

detail.abstract: This document examines the phenomenon of institutional silence in higher education through a detailed case study of Semmelweis University’s Faculty of Medicine. From August 4 to August 28, 2025, independent analytics from ResearchGate confirmed that at least 93 professors at Semmelweis University engaged with and reviewed whistleblower publications related to Ombudsman Case No. EBF–AJBH–309–2025 and Court Case No. 7, KPK. Despite this confirmed involvement, the faculty has not issued any rebuttal, correction, or counter-evidence within academic circles. By placing this silence within the context of existing literature on governance, academic accountability, and whistleblower protection, the study suggests that such non-response indicates a tacit acknowledgment of awareness and institutional evasion. The findings carry significant implications for compliance with the European Standards and Guidelines for Quality Assurance in the European Higher Education Area (ESG 2015), Hungary’s Act CCIV of 2011 on National Higher Education, and the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights (Article 11). The study concludes that institutional silence should be seen as an indication of liability rather than neutrality.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过塞梅尔维斯大学医学院的案例，分析了高等教育中的制度性沉默现象。研究发现93名教授参与了举报人出版物的审阅但机构未作回应，认为这种沉默表明制度性回避责任而非中立。
AI.research_question: 高等教育机构在面对举报人指控时保持沉默的现象及其含义是什么？
AI.motivation: 探讨高等教育机构在面对学术不端指控时的回应模式，以及制度性沉默对学术问责制和治理的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理理论、学术问责制理论、举报人保护理论、制度沉默理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，通过ResearchGate数据分析93名教授的行为，结合文献分析制度回应模式
AI.findings: 塞梅尔维斯大学医学院93名教授参与审阅举报材料但机构未作任何回应，这种沉默表明制度性回避而非中立
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了制度性沉默作为责任认定指标的理论框架，丰富了学术问责和治理理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育机构合规性评估提供实证依据，对ESG 2015标准、匈牙利高等教育法和欧盟基本权利宪章的实施具有指导意义

title: The Term Structure of European Carbon Futures and the Predictive Power of Speculators and Hedgers
affiliations: Chemnitz University of Technology (CUT), Faculty of Business and Economics, Dresden University of Technology and

detail.title: The Term Structure of European Carbon Futures and the Predictive Power of Speculators and Hedgers
detail.abstract: We study the informational content of futures positions held by different groups of market participants for changes in the term structure of European Emission Allowances. Commercial hedging open interest in emission allowance futures is found to predict changes in the carbon term structure. Specifically, our results indicate that the expectation of stronger economic activity increases the demand for long hedging positions in short- and mid-term contracts, which is associated with an upward-shifted, flatter, and less-convex futures curve. Speculative positions held by financial investors-which have significantly grown in recent years-as well as alternative measures of financial speculation have no measurable predictive value. Additionally, the ratio of natural gas to coal prices, known as switching costs, predicts changes in the term structure level, while crude oil and equity returns correlate with future changes in its slope and curvature. Our results suggest that futures prices of European Emission Allowances are primarily driven by commercial hedging demand, whereas financial speculation plays a comparatively minor role.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现欧洲排放配额期货市场的商业对冲头寸能够预测碳期限结构的变化，而金融投机活动的影响相对较小。天然气与煤炭价格比率（转换成本）预测期限结构水平变化，原油和股票收益与斜率及曲率变化相关。
AI.research_question: 不同市场参与者持有的期货头寸对欧洲排放配额期限结构变化的信息含量是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究欧洲排放配额期货市场中商业对冲和金融投机活动对碳期限结构的影响，以了解市场价格的驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于期货市场信息含量理论、期限结构理论和市场参与者行为理论。
AI.method: 使用欧洲排放配额期货市场数据，分析商业对冲头寸和金融投机头寸与期限结构变化的关系，采用回归分析等方法。
AI.findings: 商业对冲头寸能够预测碳期限结构变化（向上移动、变平、凸度减小），金融投机头寸无显著预测价值。转换成本预测水平变化，原油和股票收益预测斜率和曲率变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实商业对冲需求是欧洲排放配额期货价格的主要驱动因素，挑战了金融投机主导市场的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、监管机构和市场参与者提供了关于碳市场价格形成机制的重要见解，有助于更好地理解和管理碳市场风险。

title: Combatting Ableism: Roles and Actions of Institutions and Organizations
affiliations: Professional Website

detail.title: Combatting Ableism: Roles and Actions of Institutions and Organizations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a

declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract:
Ableism—the systemic devaluation and exclusion of people with disabilities—remains a persistent barrier to full social, economic, and political inclusion.  People with disabilities face barriers not because of inherent limitations, but because of the environment and systems around them.  Combatting ageism and ableism requires more than just policy pronouncements or isolated programs. It demands a comprehensive, multi-sector approach that transforms communities, services and institutions in order to improve the lives of people with disabilities and their caregivers. Challenging ableism means rethinking how organizations in every sector—government, business, education, civil society and healthcare providers—define inclusion, design programs, allocate resources and measure success. 

At its core, a multi-sector approach recognizes that the challenges faced by people with disabilities are not isolated to a single domain. These challenges span across health and long-term care, housing, transportation, employment, education, civic participation and access to justice. Effective responses must therefore be integrated and inclusive, driven by collaboration among a broad coalition of stakeholders including governmental actors at all levels (i.e., federal, state and local), community-based organizations, businesses, academic institutions, healthcare providers, philanthropic institutions and the individuals most affected: people with disabilities and their caregivers. 

This book offers a practical, cross-sector framework for change and describes the actions that actors operating in sectors that cross all of the day-to-day challenges for people with disabilities can take to combat ableism.  It highlights the importance of inclusive leadership, community engagement and policy reform, and considers the broader cultural and structural conditions that sustain exclusion.  Grounded in real-world examples and supported by research, this book is for practitioners, policymakers, advocates and anyone working to make their organization or community more inclusive. It shows that addressing ableism is not just a matter of compliance or accommodation—it is essential to building systems that respect the dignity, rights, and contributions of all people.

title: Agri-Drone Usage for Small Farmers in Uganda

detail.title: Agri-Drone Usage for Small Farmers in Uganda

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper was written under the guidance of the NonTrivial program.

detail.abstract: This paper explores the usage of agri-drones on small farms in Uganda to assist them in further mechanizing their agricultural sector to boost crop yield through modernization. As the nation's leading factor in export earnings as well as employing over 70% of their population, agriculture plays a key role in Uganda's economy and global standings. However, with inefficient use of farm land and increasingly unpredictable weather, it has become challenging for farmers to keep up with their crops' needs and maximize yield. Past implementation of agri-drones have proven to collect precise data over plots of land that allow farmers to track crop health and more easily maintain larger fields, all while maintaining lower costs than previously existing solutions. This paper explains the necessary changes needed for Uganda to successfully implement drone usage on small farms. It encompasses a policy proposal for the Ugandan government, providing pathways for funding this project.

title: Trade Dependency Within a Volatile Union: The Gulf Cooperation Council Case
affiliations: Qatar University

detail.title: Trade Dependency Within a Volatile Union: The Gulf Cooperation Council Case
detail.abstract: The Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) has faced serious challenges to its credibility as an economic union. Comprising six nation-states (Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates) on the premise of sharing common national objectives, the GCC's recent past is marred by intra-bloc political disagreements that even led to a trade embargo against one of its member states. These internal tensions were coupled with sobering negative externalities, such as fluctuations in energy prices and the COVID-19 pandemic, further impacting the union's economies. Despite these hurdles, this study shows, GCC intra-bloc trade dependence increased over the past decade, especially following episodes of negative external shocks affecting overall trade. Bahrain, Oman, and the UAE have grown the most dependent on the bloc for trade, with the former two particularly reliant on GCC imports to meet their domestic demands, and the latter reliant on the bloc as a significant export destination. By comparison, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Kuwait are the least dependent on the bloc. Viewing high trade dependency on growingly volatile neighbors as a vulnerability, this paper highlights the GCC member states most exposed to intra-bloc trade shocks. A closer look reveals heavy commodity-specific intra-bloc dependence, one that could lead to major disruptions in Bahrain and Oman's economies should another intrabloc trade embargo ensue. The study also uncovers a major hiccup to future GCC trade integration: Saudi Arabia, the GCC's biggest market and the second largest contributor to intrabloc trade, has the least to gain from trading with its neighbors.

AI.tldr: 海湾合作委员会（GCC）尽管面临政治分歧和外部冲击，但其内部贸易依赖度在过去十年中反而增加，特别是巴林、阿曼和阿联酋对区域贸易的依赖显著增强，但这也带来了贸易脆弱性风险。
AI.research_question: 海湾合作委员会成员国在面临政治分歧和外部冲击的情况下，内部贸易依赖度如何变化？哪些成员国最容易受到区域内贸易冲击的影响？
AI.motivation: GCC作为经济联盟面临信誉危机，内部政治分歧导致贸易禁运，加上能源价格波动和COVID-19疫情等外部冲击，需要研究其贸易依赖度的实际变化和脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域经济一体化理论、贸易依赖理论、经济脆弱性理论
AI.method: 实证分析过去十年GCC内部贸易数据，分析各成员国对区域贸易的依赖程度变化
AI.findings: 1）GCC内部贸易依赖度在过去十年增加；2）巴林、阿曼、阿联酋对区域贸易依赖最强；3）沙特、卡塔尔、科威特依赖度最低；4）存在商品特定的高度依赖，可能带来经济中断风险
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了区域经济一体化在危机情境下的理论，揭示了政治分歧与贸易依赖之间的复杂关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为GCC成员国识别贸易脆弱性提供实证依据，为政策制定者设计风险缓解策略提供参考

title: Tax Audits and Accounting Labor Investment
affiliations: , Pennsylvania State University - Smeal College of Business and Indiana University - Kelley School of Business - Department of Accounting

detail.title: Tax Audits and Accounting Labor Investment
detail.abstract: Tax enforcement has been shown to influence corporate tax planning and improve firms’ information environments, but the organizational mechanisms driving these effects are not well understood. This study investigates one such mechanism: how tax audits affect firms' investments in accounting personnel. Using employment data from Revelio Labs, we document an average investment response of approximately three additional accountants around IRS audits. Heterogeneity tests indicate that firms hire tax-specific accountants when they rely less on the external auditor for tax compliance and planning, as well as when there is more opportunity and incentive to preserve cash tax savings from positions claimed. General (non-tax) accountants are hired to support internal information demands related to tax audits. Path analysis indicates that the combined hiring response mitigates IRS audit-driven increases in cash effective tax rates. Specifically, we find that one new accountant is associated with approximately $950K of cash tax savings over the three-year period around an IRS audit. We also find evidence that the increase in accounting personnel partially explains previously documented information improvements following tax enforcement activities. Our findings highlight accounting human capital investment as a key, previously unexamined, mechanism that connects regulatory monitoring to a firm’s tax outcomes and information environments.

AI.tldr: 税务稽查促使企业增加会计人员投资，平均约增加3名会计师，其中税务会计师和普通会计师分别应对不同需求，这种人力资本投资能带来约95万美元的现金税收节约，并改善信息环境
AI.research_question: 税务稽查如何影响企业对会计人员的投资？这种投资如何影响企业的税收结果和信息环境？
AI.motivation: 虽然已知税务执法会影响企业税收筹划并改善信息环境，但驱动这些效应的组织机制尚不明确，需要研究税务稽查如何通过会计人力资本投资这一机制发挥作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于监管监控理论、人力资本投资理论和信息需求理论，探讨税务稽查如何通过改变企业的人力资源配置来影响税收结果和信息质量
AI.method: 使用Revelio Labs的就业数据，采用异质性检验和路径分析方法，考察IRS税务稽查前后企业会计人员雇佣变化及其影响
AI.findings: 企业平均增加约3名会计师；依赖外部审计师较少的企业更倾向雇佣税务会计师；会计人员增加能缓解稽查导致的现金有效税率上升，每新增1名会计师关联约95万美元的三年税收节约
AI.theory_contributions: 首次识别会计人力资本投资作为连接监管监控与企业税收结果的关键机制，拓展了税务执法影响的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业如何通过人力资源配置应对税务稽查提供实践指导，为监管机构理解执法效果的组织传导机制提供 insights

title: Research Paper: Quality Education (SDG4)

detail.title: Research Paper: Quality Education (SDG4)
detail.abstract: Education is a fundamental human right and a cornerstone of personal, social, and economic development. The United Nations, through Sustainable Development Goal 4 (SDG 4), emphasizes the need to "ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all." Despite global progress in school enrollments, significant challenges remain in achieving true quality education, such as inequality, underfunded systems, poor teacher training, and digital divides. This paper examines the meaning of quality education, analyzes global challenges, and highlights successful practices from both developed and developing nations. It concludes with policy recommendations to ensure equitable access, inclusivity, and lifelong learning for all learners.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了优质教育的含义，分析了全球教育面临的挑战，总结了发达和发展中国家的成功实践，并提出了促进教育公平、包容性和终身学习的政策建议。

title: Climate Change Economics in Vietnam: Redefining Economic Impact
affiliations: Halle Institute for Economic Research, Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK) and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Climate Change Economics in Vietnam: Redefining Economic Impact
detail.abstract: Vietnam, a low middle-income economy, grapples with considerable climate impacts, primarily driven by heat waves, sea-level rise, and tropical cyclones. Under ongoing global warming, these extreme weather events are projected to further intensify. We use a dynamic general equilibrium model to study economic transition dynamics from 2015 to 2100, accounting for heat-induced labor productivity losses, agricultural land loss from sea-level rise, and residential property damage from tropical cyclones. We compare a Paris-compatible strong mitigation scenario where global warming is limited to well-below 2°C above preindustrial levels to a strong emission scenario where warming reaches 4–5°C. We find that the impacts of climate change on output and investment are highly uncertain, with differences between low and high emission scenarios remaining statistically insignificant until the end of the century–despite substantially higher climate forcing in the latter. By contrast, consumption losses are significantly larger under the high emission scenario. These negative impacts are primarily driven by heat-induced labor productivity losses, while tropical cyclones are the main source of uncertainty. Our findings highlight the need to account for the multiple economic climate change impact channels for a literature currently predominantly focused on output damages.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用动态一般均衡模型分析越南气候变化的经济影响，发现高排放情景下消费损失显著更大，主要由热浪导致的劳动生产率损失驱动，热带气旋是主要不确定性来源。
AI.research_question: 气候变化对越南经济的多重影响渠道及其在不同排放情景下的差异
AI.motivation: 越南作为中低收入经济体面临严重气候影响，但现有文献主要关注产出损失，需要全面评估多重经济影响渠道
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态一般均衡模型，考虑热浪导致的劳动生产率损失、海平面上升造成的农业用地损失、热带气旋导致的住宅财产损失
AI.method: 使用动态一般均衡模型模拟2015-2100年经济转型动态，比较巴黎协定兼容情景（升温<2°C）和高排放情景（升温4-5°C）
AI.findings: 产出和投资影响高度不确定，高低排放情景差异在世纪末前统计不显著；但高排放情景下消费损失显著更大；主要驱动因素是热浪导致的劳动生产率损失，热带气旋是主要不确定性来源
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了气候变化经济影响评估框架，强调需要同时考虑多重影响渠道而非仅关注产出损失
AI.practical_contributions: 为越南等易受气候影响的发展中国家制定气候适应政策提供实证依据，强调减排对保护消费水平的重要性

title: Regional Income Disparity 1952–2002, Some Explanations
affiliations: Peking University

detail.title: Regional Income Disparity 1952–2002, Some Explanations
detail.abstract:
This paper, a chapter from Dong Xian’an’s doctoral dissertation Regional Income Disparities in China: 1952–2002, originally published in Economic Research Journal (2004, Issue 9) and recognized as the lead paper in China Economics 2004, explores explanations for regional income disparities in China from 1952 to 2002. It complements another chapter, Regional Inequality in China, Stylized Facts and Hypotheses Testing, 1952–2002, published in UNU-WIDER’s Income Inequality and Poverty in Transition China (2006).

Explanatory Hypotheses: The paper proposes Hypothesis 1: China’s economic system evolution, especially government control over markets, shaped disparities. Inferences include: 1952–1966 slight narrowing via planning (disrupted by Great Leap Forward); 1966–1976 widening due to Cultural Revolution and urban biases; 1978–1984 narrowing via agricultural reforms; 1985–1989 convergence between municipalities and others. Post-1990 widening led to Hypothesis 2: Suppressed labor mobility under free product/capital markets causes agglomeration and polarization. A two-region, two-sector model illustrates how household registration distorts labor allocation, widening disparities.

Empirical Analysis: This study systematically categorised, analysed, and tested hypotheses explaining the evolution of China’s regional income disparities over the past half-century, proposing and verifying two primary hypotheses and four related inferences. By controlling for a range of variables—human capital, physical capital, market density, agricultural production, agricultural structure, urban-rural gaps, industrial structure, ownership structure, government scale, enterprise scale, and household registration structure—elasticity and conditional convergence analyses confirmed their significant influence on economic growth and convergence, with this study also quantifying their respective impacts. These findings, combined with preliminary tests, effectively validate both competing and complementary hypotheses as well as the study’s own propositions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证分析验证了两个主要假设：中国经济体制演变（特别是政府市场控制）和户籍制度抑制劳动力流动导致区域收入差距变化，发现人力资本、物质资本、市场密度等变量对经济增长和收敛有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 1952-2002年中国区域收入差距的解释因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 探究中国半个世纪以来区域收入差距的演变原因，为理解中国经济发展不平衡提供理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域经济差距理论、经济体制演变理论、劳动力流动理论、两区域两部门模型
AI.method: 弹性分析和条件收敛分析，控制人力资本、物质资本、市场密度、农业生产、农业结构、城乡差距、产业结构、所有制结构、政府规模、企业规模、户籍结构等变量
AI.findings: 1952-1966年计划经济使差距略有缩小；1966-1976年文革和城市偏向政策导致差距扩大；1978-1984年农业改革缩小差距；1985-1989年直辖市与其他地区收敛；1990年后差距扩大，户籍制度抑制劳动力流动导致集聚和极化效应
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了经济体制演变和劳动力流动抑制两个核心假设，建立了中国区域收入差距的系统解释框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了缩小区域差距的理论依据，特别是户籍制度改革和劳动力市场自由化的重要性

title: Expand Right to Die Options for Older Americans: Eleven Ways to Avoid Late-Stage Dementia
affiliations: Mitchell Hamline School of Law

detail.title: Expand Right to Die Options for Older Americans: Eleven Ways to Avoid Late-Stage Dementia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Law, Health Care, and the Aging Brain and Body (I. Glenn Cohen, Francis X. Shen, Nina Kohn, Susannah Baruch eds. Cambridge University Press forthcoming 2027).

detail.abstract:
New medical advances have helped individuals live longer. And we should celebrate that success. But these advances do not always help people live better. Eventually, healthcare interventions offer only quantity, not quality of life. In other words, medical advances sometimes “add years to life” but not “life to years.”  For example, nearly ten million older Americans have Alzheimer’s or another dementia.  And that incidence is projected to increase sharply over the next three decades, especially for older Americans. Despite promising new research on prevention and treatment, millions of these patients will advance to severe or late-stage dementia.

Because late-stage dementia so brutally impacts quality of life, many older Americans ardently seek to avoid living under such conditions.  They find it intolerable to continue living after losing abilities such as the ability to recognize themselves, the ability to recognize their family, or the ability to feed and toilet themselves. Many find living into late-stage dementia to be unacceptable, even horrific and gruesome. 

But averting late-stage dementia is difficult to accomplish under U.S. laws and policies. Four well-established end-of-life options include: (1) traditional advance directives, (2) voluntarily stopping eating and drinking (VSED), (3) medical aid in dying (MAID) in Switzerland, and (4) inert gas asphyxiation. These four options work for patients dying from cancer, heart disease, stroke, or COPD. But they remain a clumsy fit for patients with dementia. These options suffer significant limitations in achieving the goals of patients seeking to avoid living into late-stage dementia.

Therefore, we must expand right to die options. Under settled legal and bioethical principles of anti-paternalism and informed consent, laws should permit adults with capacity to end their lives under conditions that they determine intolerable.  The primary objective of this Chapter is to outline and describe seven additional end-of-life options. These alternatives are not yet widely recognized or understood.

First, I present already emerging end-of-life options: (1) VSED by advance directive, (2) VSED by substitute decision maker, (3) minimal comfort feeding only (MCF) by advance directive or substitute decision maker, and (4) VSED bridge to MAID. While patients are already using these options, we must better clarify their ethical and legal legitimacy. Without regulatory and clinical guidance, too few healthcare professionals or facilities are prepared to support these options. Plus, these options still suffer significant limitations. 

Consequently, I turn to three more end-of-life options: (1) MAID, (2) MAID by advance directive, and (3) MAID by surrogate. None is available in the United States and none is likely to be authorized in the foreseeable future. But because these options avoid the limitations of existing ones, we should start studying experience in other countries.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨医疗进步延长寿命但未改善生活质量的问题，特别是针对晚期痴呆症患者。分析了现有四种临终选择对痴呆患者的局限性，提出了七种新的临终选择方案，主张在法律和伦理原则下扩大死亡权利选项。
AI.research_question: 如何为希望避免晚期痴呆症的患者提供更有效的临终选择方案？
AI.motivation: 医疗进步虽然延长了寿命但未能保证生活质量，特别是晚期痴呆症严重影响患者生活质量，而现有临终选择方案对痴呆患者存在显著局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于反家长主义和知情同意的法律和生物伦理原则，主张有能力的成年人应有权在自己认为无法忍受的条件下结束生命。
AI.method: 理论分析和方案提出，通过分析现有四种临终选择的局限性，系统性地提出七种新的临终选择方案。

title: Financial Inclusion and Economic Opportunities for Indigenous Communities in the Chittagong
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Financial Inclusion and Economic Opportunities for Indigenous Communities in the Chittagong
detail.abstract: Indigenous communities in the Chittagong Hill Tracts (CHT) remain among the most financially excluded populations in Bangladesh. Despite their cultural richness and economic potential, they face persistent barriers to accessing formal banking, credit, and savings mechanisms. This study explores the role of financial inclusion in strengthening the economic resilience of CHT's indigenous peoples. Drawing on secondary data and thematic analysis, the research examines how microfinance, informal savings groups, and cooperative models intersect with traditional livelihoods. It highlights both the opportunities and limitations of existing financial initiatives, noting that conventional microcredit often fails to align with indigenous social and cultural systems. The findings suggest that community-driven financial institutions, mobile banking, and context-sensitive lending practices could open pathways to greater autonomy, poverty reduction, and long-term development. The study argues that true financial inclusion in the CHT requires more than extending credit-it requires models rooted in trust, cultural identity, and sustainability.

title: Evaluating the Legal Accountability of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Bangladesh: Beyond Regulatory Frameworks
affiliations: Monash University - Monash University Malaysia and Curtin University, Malaysia

detail.title: Evaluating the Legal Accountability of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Bangladesh: Beyond Regulatory Frameworks

publicationDetails.detailsText: NTUT Journal of Intellectual Property Law and Management, Volume 14, No. 1. Pp. 9-29

detail.abstract: The rapid proliferation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across sectors poses significant legal, ethical, and regulatory challenges, especially in emerging economies like Bangladesh. Despite increasing AI deployment in public and private domains, Bangladesh currently lacks a dedicated legal framework governing AI-related liabilities and data governance. This paper investigates the extent to which Bangladesh's existing legal instruments can accommodate AI-specific harms and proposes actionable regulatory pathways. Owing to the widespread use of AI in recent times, Bangladesh has experienced infringements on privacy, safety, and security, in addition to the advantages it offers. The legislators in Bangladesh are currently undecided on whether to implement a new legal framework for AI or adopt a wait-and-see approach by studying the experiences of other nations, such as the USA and the UK. Hence, the primary aim of this research is to address the question: To what extent can existing legal principles in Bangladesh accommodate or be adapted to establish accountability for decisions made by AI systems? This paper employs a mixed-methods approach, combining doctrinal legal analysis with a quantitative empirical survey, to investigate the necessity and framework for regulating AI in Bangladesh. This study initially examines the exploration of many challenges and issues related to its implementation. This paper makes comparison between Bangladesh and others, such as the EU, China, the USA, and the UK in AI regulation. An extensive public survey was undertaken with 110 participants regarding the necessity of adopting regulations on AI. The results underscore widespread public support for AI-specific regulation, especially concerning transparency, job displacement, discrimination, and data misuse. The study offers policy recommendations for a tailored, risk-based, and ethically grounded regulatory framework, emphasizing multi-stakeholder collaboration and alignment with international best practices. This research contributes to the broader discourse on AI by offering a foundational blueprint for responsible AI regulation in Bangladesh.

title: The Split Personality of Protectionism: A Comparative Analysis of Its Application in Emerging and Industrialized Economies
affiliations: Desiderio Consultants Ltd.

detail.title: The Split Personality of Protectionism: A Comparative Analysis of Its Application in Emerging and Industrialized Economies
detail.abstract: Protectionism, defined as the strategic use of tariffs, subsidies, regulatory measures, and other instruments to shield domestic industries from foreign competition, has long been a recurring feature of the international trade landscape. Its resurgence has become particularly evident in light of recent shifts in United States trade policy, signaling a broader reevaluation of liberal trade norms among advanced economies. Despite the dominant discourse in favor of free markets and globalization, both emerging and industrialized countries regularly deploy protectionist measures in combination with open trade policies. However, the logic underpinning their use differs substantially. Emerging nations generally turn to protectionism as a development tool to nurture infant industries, create jobs, and accelerate structural transformation, while industrialized economies employ it as an instrument of defence of leading sectors of their industry, to maintain global economic influence, or restructure key industries in response to geopolitical, technological, or environmental challenges. This paper examines the different rationales behind protectionism by comparing its objectives, targets, and instruments in emerging versus industrialized economies. It concludes with a set of policy recommendations for both groups on how to effectively design and implement these strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了新兴国家和工业化国家实施保护主义的逻辑差异，分析了各自的目标、对象和工具，并提出了相应的政策建议。

title: Nexus between Exports, Remittances, FDI, and Economic Growth in Bangladesh: A Structural Break ARDL Bounds Test Approach
affiliations: Center for Policy and Economic Research (CPER)

detail.title: Nexus between Exports, Remittances, FDI, and Economic Growth in Bangladesh: A Structural Break ARDL Bounds Test Approach

publicationDetails.detailsText: Mamun, A. (2022). Nexus Between Exports, Remittances, FDI, and Economic Growth in Bangladesh: A Structural Break ARDL Bounds Test Approach. CPER Working Paper Series No. 02.

detail.abstract: This study examines the dynamic relationship between exports, remittances, foreign direct investment (FDI), and economic growth in Bangladesh from 1976 to 2019, incorporating structural breaks into the empirical framework. Applying the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) bounds testing approach, along with structural break dummies and interaction terms, the analysis identifies a stable long-run cointegrating relationship among the variables. The results demonstrate that both exports and remittances have a significant and positive impact on economic growth, highlighting their central role in sustaining Bangladesh’s development trajectory. By contrast, FDI is found to have a negative association with growth, reflecting persistent structural and institutional constraints that have limited its effectiveness as a driver of growth. The inclusion of a structural break around 2010 captures shifts in the growth process, underscoring the importance of policy reforms and external shocks in shaping macroeconomic outcomes. The findings suggest that Bangladesh’s long-term growth prospects depend on export diversification, productive utilization of remittances, and targeted reforms to attract efficiency-enhancing FDI. These results carry important policy implications as the country navigates post-COVID-19 recovery and external uncertainties such as the Russia–Ukraine war, and seeks to consolidate its transition toward sustainable, export-led economic growth.

title: Permissioned vs. Public Block Chains: Security Trade-Offs and Applications

detail.title: Permissioned vs. Public Block Chains: Security Trade-Offs and Applications
detail.abstract: Block chain technology has evolved into a transformative paradigm for securing data, enabling trust less interactions, and decentralizing control across a wide range of applications. While both permissioned and public block chains share a common foundation in distributed ledger technology, their differences in governance, access control, and consensus mechanisms present distinct security trade-offs and application opportunities. Public block chains-characterized by open participation, decentralized consensus, and high transparency-excel in censorship resistance and trust minimization but face challenges in scalability, transaction throughput, and susceptibility to certain attacks, such as 51% attacks. In contrast, permissioned block chains restrict participation to verified entities, enabling higher transaction throughput, compliance with regulatory frameworks, and efficient governance, albeit at the cost of reduced decentralization and increased reliance on trusted authorities. This paper critically examines the security implications of both models, discussing trade-offs related to confidentiality, integrity, availability, scalability, governance, and compliance. It further explores their suitability for various real-world applications, including finance, supply chain management, healthcare, and digital identity systems. Through a synthesis of current research, technical specifications, and case studies, this study provides an in-depth comparison of permissioned and public block chains, highlighting the factors influencing their adoption and guiding stakeholders in selecting the optimal architecture for specific security and operational requirements.
