title: Food Inflation, Food Security, and Recovery from Learning Loss: Evidence from Developing Asia
affiliations: International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD), Asian Development Bank and Independent

detail.title: Food Inflation, Food Security, and Recovery from Learning Loss: Evidence from Developing Asia

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 801
publicationDetails.journalName: ADB Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Literature links food insecurity to adverse welfare outcomes, including the educational performance of children. This paper investigates whether food insecurity, exacerbated by recent food inflation, has hindered schoolchildren’s recovery from learning loss following coronavirus disease-related school closures. We examine this relationship using household data collected in 2023 from nine countries (Afghanistan, Armenia, Georgia, Kazakhstan, the Kyrgyz Republic, Mongolia, Pakistan, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan)—severely affected by food inflation. Our data document high severity of food insecurity and limited perceived learning progress after schools reopened in many countries. Using a novel instrumental variable, the relative severity of food inflation compared to general inflation, we find a causal link between households’ food insecurity and delays in learning progress after schools reopened. This effect is particularly pronounced among schoolchildren in higher grades and those who experienced longer durations of school closure, suggesting that food insecurity hampered recovery from learning loss during the school closure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现食品不安全与新冠疫情后学童学习恢复延迟存在因果关系，特别是在高年级学生和经历较长停课时间的学生中表现更为明显
AI.research_question: 食品不安全是否阻碍了学童在新冠疫情相关学校关闭后从学习损失中恢复？
AI.motivation: 食品不安全与不良福利结果相关，包括儿童教育表现。近期食品通胀加剧了食品不安全问题，需要研究其对学童学习恢复的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于食品不安全与教育表现关系的现有文献，结合食品通胀对家庭经济状况的影响理论
AI.method: 使用2023年从9个国家收集的家庭数据，采用新颖的工具变量（食品通胀相对于总体通胀的相对严重程度）进行因果分析
AI.findings: 发现家庭食品不安全与学校重新开放后学习进展延迟之间存在因果关系，这种效应在高年级学生和经历较长学校关闭时间的学生中尤为显著
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了食品不安全对教育恢复影响的因果证据，扩展了食品不安全与教育表现关系的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对食品通胀和促进学童学习恢复的政策依据，特别是在受食品通胀严重影响的国家

title: A Time-Space-Energy (TSE) Framework: A Pull-Effect Model for Analyzing the Evolution of Technologies and Social Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Time-Space-Energy (TSE) Framework: A Pull-Effect Model for Analyzing the Evolution of Technologies and Social Systems
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a novel framework for analyzing technological and social evolution through the layered dynamics of Time, Space, and Energy. Unlike existing perspectives that treat these dimensions as static conditions, this framework conceptualizes them as sequential layers, where each stage of change is driven not by linear prediction but by a pull effect from the subsequent layer. In this model, any new technology or practice initially alters how actors perceive and use time, space, and energy. What happens next is not predetermined but emerges when economic, cultural, or institutional forces "pull" the system toward further adaptation. The value of this layered approach lies in its ability to capture the unfolding of change step by step, without relying on hindsight or rear-mirror reasoning. To illustrate its application, the paper applies the framework to the historical transition from horse-based transport to the automobile. The analysis demonstrates how the car's initial impact on time (reduced commuting), energy (expanded capacity), and space (latent effects not yet recognized) triggered subsequent layers of economic and cultural pull, leading to large-scale transformation. By grounding technological evolution in layered pull dynamics, the framework offers a generalizable tool for explaining both past transitions and anticipating future ones. This paper is conceptual in nature, offering a theoretical framework rather than an empirical study, and aims to guide future research and practical foresight applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个通过时间、空间和能量的分层动力学来分析技术和社会演化的新框架，将这三个维度视为顺序层，每个变化阶段由后续层的拉动效应驱动，而非线性预测。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够解释技术和社会演化过程的理论框架，避免后见之明偏见，捕捉变化的逐步展开？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将时间、空间和能量视为静态条件，无法充分解释技术变革的非线性、涌现性特征，需要新的理论视角来理解演化过程的动态机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层拉动动力学框架，将时间、空间和能量视为顺序演化层，每个阶段的变化由后续经济、文化或制度力量的"拉动"效应驱动。
AI.method: 概念性理论研究，通过历史案例（从马匹运输到汽车的转型）来阐释框架的应用价值。
AI.findings: 汽车最初影响时间（减少通勤）、能量（扩展容量）和空间（潜在效应），随后触发经济和文化层面的拉动，最终导致大规模转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个通用的分层拉动动力学框架，为解释历史转型和预测未来变革提供了新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来研究和实践预见应用提供指导，帮助决策者更好地理解和应对技术社会演化过程。

title: Capital Inflows, Labor Dynamics, and Growth: An ARDL Analysis of The Philippines
affiliations: Saitama University

detail.title: Capital Inflows, Labor Dynamics, and Growth: An ARDL Analysis of The Philippines

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants and relied exclusively on publicly available secondary data; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no competing interests.

detail.abstract: This study investigates whether remittances and labor act as complements or substitutes in driving economic growth in the Philippines. Using annual data from 1990 to 2023, an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model tests the competing hypotheses that remittances either enhance growth when absorbed through domestic labor or undermine it by discouraging participation. The bounds test confirms cointegration among GDP, remittances, labor, their interaction, and domestic credit. Short-run results show that remittances negatively affect GDP, consistent with their role in consumption smoothing, while labor has a strong positive effect, though lagged terms suggest adjustment costs. Domestic credit initially supports growth but displays negative effects at deeper lags. The error-correction term is negative and significant, indicating rapid adjustment toward equilibrium. In the long run, remittances, labor, their interaction, and credit are all positive and significant, with the remittance-labor interaction having the largest effect. By explicitly testing this interaction, the study contributes new Philippine evidence to the remittance-growth debate and shows that policies expanding labor participation and financial intermediation are crucial for transforming remittances into sustained growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用ARDL模型分析1990-2023年菲律宾数据，发现汇款在短期内对GDP有负面影响，但在长期与劳动力形成互补关系，共同促进经济增长，金融中介在其中发挥关键作用。
AI.research_question: 汇款和劳动力在推动菲律宾经济增长中是互补关系还是替代关系？
AI.motivation: 探讨汇款对经济增长的影响机制，特别是汇款是通过促进国内劳动力参与来增强增长，还是通过抑制劳动力参与来削弱增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于汇款与经济增长关系的竞争性假设理论，包括汇款作为消费平滑工具的短期效应和作为投资资本的长期效应。
AI.method: 使用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型，利用1990-2023年的年度数据，进行边界检验和误差修正分析。
AI.findings: 短期：汇款对GDP有负面影响，劳动力有强正面效应；长期：汇款、劳动力、两者交互项和国内信贷都具有显著正面影响，其中汇款-劳动力交互项效应最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过明确测试汇款-劳动力交互作用，为汇款-增长辩论提供了新的菲律宾证据，证实了互补关系假说。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究表明扩大劳动力参与和金融中介的政策对于将汇款转化为持续增长至关重要。

title: Human ROI: A New Paradigm for Venture Capital
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Human ROI: A New Paradigm for Venture Capital

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The author is a General Partner at a seed-stage, non-impact VC firm; this affiliation did not influence the objectivity of the research or its conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or case studies requiring ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: For half a century, return on investment has been the primary language of capital allocation in modern economies. Its simplicity and calculability have supported the rise of venture capital, guided corporate decision making, and shaped public policy. In the Anthropocene, a period in which human activity has become a dominant force on planetary and social systems, return on investment as an exclusive objective is increasingly inadequate. A portfolio that maximizes financial return can still degrade the conditions that support human life and civic prosperity. This paper proposes Human ROI, abbreviated as HROI, a reframing of the purpose and practice of investing in which the ultimate return on capital, time, and energy is measured in human flourishing. The paper advances three contributions. First, it synthesizes the literatures on impact investing, ESG disclosure, flourishing theory, resilience, and innovation finance to diagnose the limitations of existing frameworks relative to the needs of the Anthropocene. Second, it defines the HROI construct with five core dimensions, namely Resilience, Health and Well being, Equity and Inclusion, Ecological Integrity, and Agency and Creativity, and it provides a measurement and governance spine that allows HROI to complement, not replace, conventional financial ROI. Third, it offers practical implications for venture capital and policy design, including screening heuristics, portfolio construction rules, outcome dashboards, and outcome linked public incentives. The paper ends with testable propositions and a research agenda to build an empirical foundation for HROI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Human ROI（HROI）概念，将投资回报重新定义为人类繁荣，包含五个核心维度，为人类世时期的资本配置提供新框架。
AI.research_question: 在人类世时期，如何重新定义投资回报以促进人类繁荣和可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 传统投资回报率作为资本配置的唯一目标在人类世时期已不足够，需要新的框架来同时考虑财务回报和人类福祉。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合影响力投资、ESG披露、繁荣理论、韧性理论和创新金融等文献，构建HROI理论框架。
AI.method: 文献综合分析和概念框架构建，提出可测量的HROI维度和治理机制。
AI.findings: 提出了包含韧性、健康福祉、公平包容、生态完整性和能动创造力五个维度的HROI框架，并设计了相应的测量和治理体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了人类繁荣导向的投资理论，为人类世时期的资本配置提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风险投资和政策设计提供了筛选启发式、投资组合构建规则、成果仪表板和结果导向的公共激励等实用工具。

title: India’s Structural-Demographic Turn (1991–2025): Evidence of a Post-2011 Stress Convergence
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: India’s Structural-Demographic Turn (1991–2025): Evidence of a Post-2011 Stress Convergence
detail.abstract: We calibrate a structural-demographic model of India (1991-2025) linking mass pressure (youth bulge, wage compression), elite overproduction (credential growth vs. elite job slots, top-income shares), and state capacity (trust, governance proxies, fiscal strength). Using a coupled system for mass pressure P, elite competition E, and state capacity S, with parameters drawn from national datasets (Census/UN, ILO-PLFS/CMIE, RBI-NIPFP, PRS, CSDS/Gallup), we trace subsystem trajectories and identify a synchronised inflection during 2010-2013. We adapt this framework to India by integrating demographic cohorts, wage and employment data, inequality measures, and trust surveys into a tri-variable system of coupled differential equations. The simulation identifies 2011 as the critical inflection point where mass immiseration, elite overproduction, and declining state legitimacy began to converge. Robustness checks confirm this inflection across alternative datasets. Our results suggest that India has entered a structural crisis phase, not as a transient fluctuation but as a systemic convergence.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过构建结构-人口模型分析印度1991-2025年的社会政治稳定性，发现2011年是关键转折点，大众贫困化、精英过度生产和国家合法性下降开始同步恶化，表明印度已进入结构性危机阶段。
AI.research_question: 印度社会政治稳定性的结构-人口动态机制是什么？2010-2013年间是否存在系统性转折点？
AI.motivation: 理解印度社会政治不稳定的深层结构性原因，识别系统性危机的关键转折点，为政策制定提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构-人口理论，包含大众压力（青年膨胀、工资压缩）、精英过度生产（学历增长与精英职位不匹配、顶层收入份额）和国家能力（信任度、治理指标、财政实力）三个核心子系统。
AI.method: 构建三变量耦合微分方程系统，整合人口队列、工资就业数据、不平等指标和信任调查等多源国家数据集（人口普查/联合国、ILO-PLFS/CMIE、RBI-NIPFP、PRS、CSDS/Gallup），进行模拟分析和稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 识别出2010-2013年间的同步拐点，2011年为关键转折点，大众贫困化、精英过度生产和国家合法性下降开始系统性汇聚。
AI.theory_contributions: 将结构-人口理论框架适配到印度语境，建立了量化分析模型，提供了识别系统性社会政治危机转折点的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政策制定者提供了危机预警和干预的时间窗口识别，指出了结构性改革的关键领域。

title: Understanding Output-Based Pricing Systems
affiliations: Peter A. Allard School of Law, the University of British Columbia

detail.title: Understanding Output-Based Pricing Systems
detail.abstract: In recent years, Canada has used a distinctive carbon pricing regime, "output-based pricing systems" (OBPS), to incentivize emission reduction for large industrial facilities. This regime has come under heightened scrutiny as a more general carbon tax is cancelled in 2025 due to political controversy. However, OBPS regimes have received little scholarly analysis; commentators have mostly criticized the weakness of the emission trading markets within them. This Essay argues that OBPS should be viewed as primarily implementing a carbon tax with an intensity-based exemption. OBPS further introduces emissions trading into this carbon tax regime, but trading only worsens the regime's performance, by offering a distortionary production subsidy to low emitters and by weakening abatement incentives. Inefficient emissions trading markets are thus not OBPS' main problem; the combination of carbon taxation with emissions trading may be fundamentally flawed. Moreover, the Essay highlights several previously-neglected affinities between various pricing and regulatory instruments for achieving emission reductions, as well as the difficulty of identifying equivalences even among carbon pricing regimes.

AI.tldr: 加拿大输出基准定价系统(OBPS)应被视为碳税与强度基准豁免的组合，其引入的排放交易反而恶化了制度表现，提供扭曲性生产补贴并削弱减排激励。
AI.research_question: OBPS制度的主要性质是什么？其排放交易机制对制度绩效有何影响？
AI.motivation: 加拿大独特的OBPS碳定价制度在2025年因政治争议而取消一般碳税后受到更多关注，但学术界对此缺乏深入分析，评论多集中于批评其排放交易市场的薄弱。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳定价理论、排放交易理论、环境经济学中的政策工具比较分析
AI.method: 理论分析和制度比较分析
AI.findings: OBPS本质上是碳税与强度基准豁免的组合，其排放交易机制通过向低排放者提供扭曲性生产补贴和削弱减排激励而恶化制度绩效
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了碳税与排放交易组合可能存在根本性缺陷，强调了不同定价和监管工具之间的亲和性，以及识别碳定价制度间等价性的困难
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了对OBPS制度本质的新认识，指出排放交易市场效率低下并非主要问题，而是制度设计的根本性挑战

title: Motor Vehicles Taxation in the European Union – Cooperation or Competition?
affiliations: Masaryk University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Motor Vehicles Taxation in the European Union – Cooperation or Competition?
detail.abstract: This study focuses on registration taxes and regularly paid taxes in conjunction with motor vehicles. It analyses time and performance charging for the use of road infrastructure only to a certain and necessary extent. This study follows the IMRaD structure. The text demonstrates that the level of motor vehicle taxation in individual EU Member States differs not only in the number and type of taxes imposed on motor vehicles, but also in the legal construction of individual structural components. The level of harmonisation in motor vehicle taxation is currently extremely low. European cooperation regarding motor vehicle taxation is limited, and the competition between the EU Member States prevails. The EU rules concerning car taxation are adequate with regard to single market principles. However, the EU rules in this area are not acceptable in terms of economic circumstances. De lege ferenda, several motivational factors should be considered to improve the regulation. Registration taxes on motor vehicles should be abolished entirely. The tax base should be green-based, determined by the amount of CO2 emissions, to follow sustainable and polluter-pays principles. Circular taxes on motor vehicles should remain under the responsibility of each EU Member State, and the EU should refrain from taking steps to harmonise this area of taxation. Nevertheless, the principles of sustainability should be strengthened in national regulations. Taxes on motor vehicles are an ideal example of reflecting environmental elements.

AI.tldr: 欧盟成员国机动车税收水平差异显著，协调程度极低。建议废除注册税，建立以CO2排放量为税基的绿色税收体系，遵循可持续发展和污染者付费原则，同时保持循环税的国家自主权。
AI.research_question: 欧盟成员国机动车税收制度的差异程度如何？现有税收规则是否适应当前经济环境？如何改进机动车税收制度以更好地体现可持续发展原则？
AI.motivation: 欧盟各成员国机动车税收制度存在显著差异，不仅税种和数量不同，法律结构也各异。当前协调程度极低，成员国间竞争占主导地位，现有欧盟规则在经济环境方面不可接受。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可持续发展和污染者付费原则，运用税收协调理论和环境经济学理论，分析机动车税收对环境政策的影响。
AI.method: 遵循IMRaD结构，采用比较分析法研究欧盟成员国机动车税收制度的差异，包括注册税、定期税和时间绩效收费等税种的法律结构和实施情况。
AI.findings: 1) 欧盟成员国机动车税收水平存在显著差异；2) 税收协调程度极低；3) 欧盟规则符合单一市场原则但在经济环境方面不可接受；4) 机动车税收是体现环境要素的理想范例。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于CO2排放量的绿色税基理论框架，丰富了环境税收理论，为欧盟机动车税收改革提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议废除机动车注册税，建立绿色税收体系，强化国家法规中的可持续性原则，为欧盟政策制定者提供具体的税收改革方案。

title: OntoMotoOS Meta-Resonance Score (OMRS): A Novel Evaluation Framework for Measuring 'Good AI'
affiliations: Independent Researcher, South Korea

detail.title: OntoMotoOS Meta-Resonance Score (OMRS): A Novel Evaluation Framework for Measuring 'Good AI'
detail.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) systems become increasingly powerful and autonomous, measuring what constitutes “good AI” beyond raw performance has emerged as a critical challenge. Conventional benchmarks emphasize accuracy and capability, but these metrics overlook ethical alignment, safety, and socio-technical impact . In response, we propose the OntoMotoOS Meta-Resonance Score (OMRS) – a holistic evaluation framework designed to quantify an AI system’s alignment with human values, ethical principles, and trustworthy behavior. Grounded in the OntoMotoOS philosophical metaoperating system framework , OMRS integrates multiple criteria (factual accuracy, fairness, privacy, transparency, etc.) into a single meta-score that resonates with societal ideals of “good AI.” We review existing efforts in AI evaluation, from multi-metric benchmarks to ethical guidelines, highlighting their strengths and gaps. We then detail the architecture of OntoMotoOS – including its Identity–Autonomy– Mirroring–Feedback (IAMF) core, Themis ethical filter, and PhoenixLoop resilience module – and show how OMRS builds upon these components to evaluate AI behavior in a multi-layered manner. A formal definition of OMRS is provided, with a structured indicator hierarchy and an illustrative scoring formula. We conduct a conceptual simulation: a five-phase reflective test scenario (spanning epistemic humility, principle defense, strategy design, risk analysis, and self-critique) demonstrating how an AI agent’s OMRS can be assessed and adaptively improved. An experimental design is outlined to validate OMRS, including key hypotheses (reliability, construct validity, predictive validity) and a phased evaluation protocol. We discuss limitations such as the difficulty of quantifying abstract values, cultural relativity of “goodness,” data bias, and governance challenges. Looking ahead, we explore dynamic weighting of ethical factors, community governance platforms for metric oversight, bias correction algorithms informed by OMRS, and cross-domain application of the framework. OMRS aims to serve as a moral compass for AI – complementing performance metrics with a resonance of ethical accountability – thereby contributing a novel tool for AI ethics and socio-technical alignment in the global AI community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OMRS（OntoMotoOS Meta-Resonance Score）框架，这是一个综合评估AI系统与人类价值观、伦理原则和可信行为对齐程度的整体评价体系，旨在超越传统性能指标，为AI伦理和社会技术对齐提供新的评估工具。
AI.research_question: 如何超越传统的准确性指标，构建一个能够全面评估AI系统与人类价值观、伦理原则和可信行为对齐程度的综合评价框架？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统变得越来越强大和自主，仅关注准确性和能力的传统基准无法充分评估AI的伦理对齐、安全性和社会技术影响，需要开发更全面的评估方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于OntoMotoOS哲学元操作系统框架，包含IAMF（身份-自主性-镜像-反馈）核心、Themis伦理过滤器和PhoenixLoop弹性模块等理论组件。
AI.method: 提出OMRS框架的体系结构，包括结构化指标层次和评分公式，通过概念模拟（五阶段反思测试场景）和实验设计（可靠性、构念效度、预测效度验证）进行评估。
AI.findings: OMRS框架能够以多层方式评估AI行为，通过概念模拟展示了AI代理的OMRS评分可以评估和自适应改进，为AI伦理评估提供了可行的解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个将多标准（事实准确性、公平性、隐私、透明度等）整合为单一元分数的AI伦理评估框架，为AI伦理理论发展提供了新的方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI开发者和监管者提供了实用的道德指南针工具，可用于实际AI系统的伦理评估和改进，促进AI系统与社会价值观的更好对齐。

title: Strategic Responses to Disparities in Spousal Desired Fertility: Experimental Evidence from Rural Tanzania
affiliations: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Department of Agricultural and Consumer Economics and

detail.title: Strategic Responses to Disparities in Spousal Desired Fertility: Experimental Evidence from Rural Tanzania

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: In sub-Saharan Africa, the gap in fertility preferences between men and women may influence household fertility outcomes as men usually desire more children and have more intra-household bargaining power. We estimate the effect of an informational family planning program that randomizes the inclusion of husbands on fertility preferences (desired additional children) in rural Tanzania.Surprisingly, husbands who participated in joint family planning consultations increased their desired fertility, and their wives responded by also increasing their desired number of additional children, converging to his larger preferences. In contrast, women in private family planning consultations (without their husbands) reduced their fertility desires, while their husbands' preferences remained unchanged. We provide evidence that the increase in women's fertility preferences as a result of the joint consultations is related to polygamy. Women in polygamous marriages increase their demand for children substantially, likely as a strategic response to hearing their husbands' stated preferences during the joint consultations.

AI.tldr: 在坦桑尼亚农村地区，随机实验发现夫妻共同参与计划生育咨询反而增加了丈夫的生育意愿，妻子也相应提高生育偏好；而单独咨询的女性会降低生育意愿。多妻制是影响这一结果的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 夫妻共同参与的计划生育信息项目如何影响坦桑尼亚农村地区的生育偏好差异？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区男女生育偏好存在差距，男性通常希望更多孩子且拥有更多家庭内部议价能力，这会影响家庭生育结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭内部议价理论、生育决策理论、信息干预影响机制
AI.method: 随机对照实验，比较夫妻共同咨询与单独咨询对生育偏好的影响
AI.findings: 1) 共同咨询使丈夫生育意愿增加，妻子也随之提高偏好；2) 单独咨询使女性降低生育意愿而丈夫偏好不变；3) 多妻制婚姻中女性生育需求显著增加，可能是对丈夫偏好的策略性回应
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了信息干预在夫妻生育决策中的复杂作用机制，特别是多妻制情境下的策略性行为
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计更有效的计划生育项目提供实证依据，需要考虑夫妻互动模式和文化背景（如多妻制）的影响

title: Mortgage Loan Rates and the Defaults of Variable Rate Mortgages
affiliations: Central Bank of Ireland, Ifo Institute and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Mortgage Loan Rates and the Defaults of Variable Rate Mortgages

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Using a granular database of variable rate euro area loans and analysing their defaults between 2014 and 2019, we show that the effect of interest rate changes on mortgage defaults is highly non-linear. First, we find that the risk associated with higher contemporaneous interest rates is concentrated among borrowers who got the loan at ultra-low interest rates, their default probability being 2.6 times higher than our sample average. Second, we show that the effect of interest rate changes on the default probability is asymmetric: interest rate cuts have rather small effects, whereas increases significantly raise default probabilities. Finally, we show that the magnitude of the effect of an interest rate increase depends on the history of net interest rate changes, with a consecutive interest rate increase having a 3 times stronger impact on the default probability than an increase following an interest rate decrease.

AI.tldr: 本文通过欧元区可变利率贷款数据研究发现，利率变化对抵押贷款违约的影响具有高度非线性特征：超低利率时期借款人的违约风险最高；利率上升的影响远大于利率下降；连续加息对违约概率的影响是加息后降息情况的三倍
AI.research_question: 利率变化如何影响欧元区可变利率抵押贷款的违约概率？这种影响是否具有非线性和不对称性？
AI.motivation: 理解利率政策变化对金融稳定的影响，特别是对抵押贷款违约风险的传导机制，对于央行制定货币政策和金融机构风险管理至关重要
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信贷风险理论、利率传导机制理论和行为金融学，研究利率变化对借款人还款能力的影响
AI.method: 使用2014-2019年欧元区可变利率贷款的细粒度数据库，分析贷款违约情况，采用计量经济学方法检验利率变化的非线性效应
AI.findings: 1)超低利率时期借款人的违约概率是样本平均的2.6倍；2)利率上升对违约概率的影响显著大于利率下降；3)连续加息的影响是加息后降息情况的三倍
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了利率变化对违约风险的非线性、不对称和路径依赖特征，丰富了利率传导机制理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行货币政策制定和金融机构风险管理提供了实证依据，有助于更好地评估利率政策变化的金融稳定影响

title: Central Bank Money as a Catalyst for Fungibility: The Case of Stablecoins
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB) and University of Newcastle (Australia)

detail.title: Central Bank Money as a Catalyst for Fungibility: The Case of Stablecoins

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: To ensure that means of payments are readily interchangeable at face value – i.e. fungible – for retail payments, three elements are required: (1) settlement finality; (2) interoperability; and (3) seamless convertibility of the means of payment into the “ultimate” or quasi-ultimate means of payment. This paper argues that stablecoins issued by different issuers on different blockchains can be fungible to the same extent as commercial bank deposits from different banks provided that (i) payment and settlement technologies are interoperable, (ii) payments are transacted on ledgers that offer settlement finality, and (iii) that central bank money acts as the anchor to the monetary system (assuming that the central bank money is itself underscored by a homogenous unit of account). On this basis, this paper asserts that tokenised funds and off-chain collateralised stablecoins are fungible means of payments under some conditions, and that on-chain collateralised stablecoins can be prima facie classified as fungible means of payments, so long as the identical preconditions associated with accomplishing means of payment fungibility for tokenised funds/off-chain collateralised stablecoins can be fulfilled, and on the premise that the on-chain collateral can be readily converted into higher level money. Finally, it is determined that algorithmic stablecoins are not fungible means of payments.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了稳定币作为支付手段的可互换性条件，分析了不同类型稳定币（代币化资金、链下抵押稳定币、链上抵押稳定币和算法稳定币）在满足结算最终性、互操作性和无缝兑换性三个要素时的可互换性程度。
AI.research_question: 不同发行人和不同区块链上发行的稳定币在什么条件下能够实现与商业银行存款相同的可互换性？
AI.motivation: 随着数字货币和稳定币的快速发展，需要明确稳定币作为支付手段的可互换性条件，以促进支付系统的有效运作和金融稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于支付手段可互换性的三个核心要素理论：结算最终性、互操作性和无缝兑换性。
AI.method: 理论分析和逻辑推理，通过对不同类型稳定币的结构特征进行分析，评估其满足可互换性条件的可能性。
AI.findings: 1) 代币化资金和链下抵押稳定币在特定条件下是可互换支付手段；2) 链上抵押稳定币在满足相同前提条件时可初步归类为可互换支付手段；3) 算法稳定币不是可互换支付手段。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了稳定币可互换性的分析框架，明确了不同类型稳定币实现支付手段可互换性的具体条件和要求。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构制定稳定币监管政策提供了理论依据，为支付系统设计者和稳定币发行者提供了实现可互换性的具体指导原则。

title: On the Road to Better Life? Rural Road and Economic Development in Albania
affiliations: University of Notre Dame,  and San Jose State University

detail.title: On the Road to Better Life? Rural Road and Economic Development in Albania

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study evaluates the impact of investment in rural roads on household welfare in Albania. Using a difference-in-differences method, we find that treated households experienced a 35-percentage point increase in the quality of roads relative to control households and reduced travel times to the nearest motorable roads. The study also demonstrates that the price and value of residential and farmland increased in the treated communities. Household heads in treated communities were less likely to be unemployed, and there was a higher incidence of self-employment in treated households, which seems to suggest a pattern of households shifting away from paid employment to self-employment in response to improved economic opportunities due to improved connectivity. The study does not find a significant effect on household income, but finds an increase in consumption expenditure. In general, these findings indicate that investments in rural roads have had positive impacts on the welfare of the family in Albania.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了阿尔巴尼亚农村道路投资对家庭福利的影响，发现道路质量提升35%，出行时间减少，房地产价值上升，就业结构从受雇转向自雇，消费支出增加但收入无显著变化。
AI.research_question: 农村道路投资对阿尔巴尼亚家庭福利的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 评估基础设施投资对农村地区家庭福利的实际效果，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于发展经济学和基础设施投资理论，探讨交通基础设施改善对农村经济发展的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（difference-in-differences）比较处理组和对照组家庭的变化。
AI.findings: 道路质量提升35%，出行时间减少；住宅和农地价值上升；失业率下降，自雇比例增加；消费支出增加但收入无显著变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了基础设施投资通过改善连通性创造经济机会的理论机制，揭示了就业结构转变的新发现。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿尔巴尼亚及其他发展中国家农村道路投资政策提供了实证支持，表明此类投资能有效提升农村家庭福利。

title: Political Views and College Choices in a Polarized America
affiliations: Miami University, Tulane University and Louisiana State University

detail.title: Political Views and College Choices in a Polarized America

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the role of students’ political views in shaping college enrollment decisions in the United States. We hypothesize that students derive utility from attending institutions aligned with their political identities, which could reinforce demographic and regional disparities in educational attainment and reduce ideological diversity on campuses. Using four decades of survey data on college freshmen, we document increasing political polarization in colleges’ student bodies, which is not fully explained by sorting along demographic, socioeconomic, or academic lines. To further explore these patterns, we conduct a series of survey-based choice experiments that quantify the value students place on political alignment relative to factors such as cost and proximity. We find that both liberal and conservative students prefer institutions with more like-minded peers and, especially, with fewer students from the opposite side of the political spectrum. The median student is willing to pay up to $2,617 (12.5%) more to attend a college where the share of students with opposing political views is 10 percentage points lower, suggesting that political identity plays a meaningful role in the college choice process.

AI.tldr: 美国大学生在择校时考虑政治立场匹配，自由派和保守派学生都偏好政治观点相似的院校，愿意为减少10%对立政治观点学生支付额外2617美元费用，导致校园政治极化加剧。
AI.research_question: 学生的政治观点如何影响美国大学入学决策？政治身份认同是否在择校过程中发挥重要作用？
AI.motivation: 研究政治身份认同对高等教育选择的影响，探讨政治极化是否通过择校行为加剧校园意识形态单一化，并可能强化教育机会的地域和人口差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于身份效用理论，学生从就读政治立场相符的院校中获得效用满足，政治身份成为高等教育选择的重要考量因素。
AI.method: 使用40年新生调查数据分析校园政治极化趋势，并通过调查选择实验量化学生对政治匹配的支付意愿，比较其与成本、距离等因素的相对重要性。
AI.findings: 校园政治极化日益严重，无法完全用人口、社会经济或学术因素解释；学生普遍偏好政治观点相似的同伴，特别回避对立政治观点学生；中位数学生愿为减少10%对立观点学生支付12.5%的额外费用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政治身份认同纳入高等教育选择理论框架，证实政治效用是择校决策中的重要非货币因素，拓展了身份经济学在教育领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高校招生政策提供实证依据，警示政治极化可能加剧教育不平等，帮助院校制定促进意识形态多样性的策略。

title: Investing in Human Capital During Wartime: Experimental Evidence from Ukraine
affiliations: World Bank, World Bank, London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE), University of Arkansas, Fayetteville and Harvard University

detail.title: Investing in Human Capital During Wartime: Experimental Evidence from Ukraine

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper provides insights into human capital investments during wartime by presenting evidence from 3 experiments of an online tutoring program for Ukrainian students amid Russias invasion. Conducted between 2023 and 2024, the experiments reached 10,000 students across Ukraine. The program offered 3 hours per week of small-group tutoring in math and Ukrainian language over 6 weeks, and used academic and psychosocial tools to address student challenges at different intensities of disruption. Results show that the program led to substantial improvements in learning0.49 standard deviations in math and 0.40 standard deviations in Ukrainian languageand consistent reductions in stress0.12 standard deviations. High take-up and engagement rates were observed, and 4 mechanisms were identified as drivers of impact: structured peer interactions, improved attitudes toward learning, enhanced socio-emotional skills, and increased student investments. A complementary experiment using information nudges highlights challenges in promoting parental investments in a conflict setting. The program was cost-effective, with benefit-to-cost ratios ranging from 31-56, and scalable given its reliance on existing infrastructure and capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过乌克兰在线辅导项目的三个实验，揭示了战争时期人力资本投资的有效性，证明结构化辅导能显著提升学习效果（数学0.49标准差，乌克兰语0.40标准差）并降低压力（0.12标准差），成本效益比达31-56。
AI.research_question: 战争环境下，在线辅导项目如何影响学生的学习成果和心理状态？
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰导致教育系统严重中断，需要证据支持在冲突环境中有效的人力资本投资策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本投资理论、教育干预理论、心理社会支持理论
AI.method: 三个随机对照实验，覆盖10,000名乌克兰学生，提供6周的小组在线辅导（数学和乌克兰语，每周3小时），使用学术和心理社会工具。
AI.findings: 项目显著提升学习效果（数学0.49σ，乌克兰语0.40σ）和降低压力（0.12σ）；识别出四个影响机制：结构化同伴互动、改善学习态度、增强社会情感技能、增加学生投入。
AI.theory_contributions: 为冲突环境中的人力资本投资理论提供实证证据，揭示教育干预在危机情境中的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可扩展、成本效益高的教育干预模式（效益成本比31-56），为冲突地区的教育政策制定提供实践指导。

title: The Perverse Effect of Flexible Work Arrangements on Informality
affiliations: CSEF - University of Naples Federico II - Centre for Studies in Economics and Finance (CSEF), University of Turin - Faculty of Economics, University of Turin - Collegio Carlo Alberto and University of Roma

detail.title: The Perverse Effect of Flexible Work Arrangements on Informality

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Flexible work arrangements (FWAs) are often promoted as a means to regularise informal labour. Utilising unique Italian administrative data that links employer-employee records, daily voucher usage by firms, and randomly timed labour inspections (2014-2017), we demonstrate that FWAs can also hinder enforcement and increase undeclared work. We document that, upon inspection, some firms validate undeclared work with FWAs on the spot, raising the probability of FWA usage by 0.88 percentage points (18%) on average, with the largest increases occurring on the day of and the day after the inspection. A simple partial-equilibrium labour-demand model with heterogeneous tax morale rationalises these “on-the-spot” validations as an enforcement-avoidance margin. The post-inspection increase vanishes when firms are required to pre-notify the tax authority of their use of FWAs. Moreover, when FWAs are completely abolished, presumptive misusers substitute FWAs with temporary contracts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过意大利行政数据发现，灵活工作安排（FWAs）可能阻碍劳动执法并增加未申报工作。企业在劳动检查时会当场用FWAs来验证未申报工作，检查后FWAs使用率平均增加0.88个百分点（18%）。要求预先通知税务部门可消除这种效应，完全废除FWAs后企业会改用临时合同。
AI.research_question: 灵活工作安排（FWAs）是否真的能够规范非正规劳动，还是会阻碍执法并增加未申报工作？
AI.motivation: 虽然FWAs常被推广作为规范非正规劳动的手段，但缺乏实证证据表明其实际效果，特别是在执法环境下的表现
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于异质性税收道德的局部均衡劳动需求模型，将"当场验证"行为解释为执法规避边际
AI.method: 利用意大利独特的行政数据（2014-2017），链接雇主-雇员记录、企业每日代金券使用情况和随机时间劳动检查数据
AI.findings: 劳动检查时企业会当场用FWAs验证未申报工作，检查后FWAs使用率平均增加0.88个百分点（18%），最大增幅出现在检查当天和次日
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了FWAs作为执法规避机制的理论解释，扩展了对非正规劳动和执法互动的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 发现预先通知要求可有效消除检查后的FWAs滥用，为政策设计提供了实证依据

title: Political Salience and Regime Resilience
affiliations: HU Berlin, Wissenschaftszentrum Berlin für Sozialforschung (WZB) and WZB Berlin Social Science Center

detail.title: Political Salience and Regime Resilience

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We introduce political salience into a canonical model of attacks against political regimes, as scaling agents’ expressive payoffs from taking sides. Equilibrium balances heterogeneous expressive concerns with material bandwagoning incentives. We examine comparative statics in salience that fully characterize the stability of equilibria. A main insight is that when regime sanctions are weak, increases from low to middling salience can pose the greatest threat to regimes – even very small shocks can suffice to drastically escalate attacks. Our results speak to the charged debates about democracy, by identifying conditions under which heightened interest in political decision-making can pose a threat to democracy in and of itself.

title: Early Effects of Cognitive-Impairment Friendly Community on Health Care Utilization in China: Evidence from Administrative Data
affiliations: Fudan University - School of Economics, Yale School of Public Health - Department of Health Policy and Management, Fudan University - School of Economics and

detail.title: Early Effects of Cognitive-Impairment Friendly Community on Health Care Utilization in China: Evidence from Administrative Data

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: The study examines the early effects of cognitive-impairment (CI) friendly communities on health care utilization among older adults in Shanghai, China. By exploiting the rollout of CI-friendly communities and employing a difference-in-differences approach, we evaluate the impact of CI-friendly communities. We find that CI-friendly communities significantly increase the probability and frequency of visiting cognition-disease-related departments (CRD) by 0.7 (13.73%) percentage points and 0.02 (17.24%) times, respectively. In particular, the effect is more pronounced for individuals not previously received CRD care. The dominant mechanisms may include information and early screening effects. Additionally, CI-friendly communities affect health care utilization in other positive ways, such as reducing emergency room (ER) visits and promoting primary care use.

title: Evolving Strategic Partnership: Analyzing EU-India Bilateral Defense Cooperation and Institutional Mechanisms for Enhanced Security Collaboration
affiliations: ESPIRIDI LLP

detail.title: Evolving Strategic Partnership: Analyzing EU-India Bilateral Defense Cooperation and Institutional Mechanisms for Enhanced Security Collaboration
detail.abstract: This research critically examines the evolving defence cooperation between the European Union (EU) and India, with particular emphasis on prominent institutional mechanisms, namely the European Defence Fund (EDF), Permanent Structured Cooperation (PESCO), and the Organisation for Joint Armament Cooperation (OCCAR). Employing Neoliberal Institutionalism as the guiding theoretical framework, the research elucidates how these multilateral instruments underpin joint capability development, technological collaboration, and operational interoperability. The analysis juxtaposes the institutionalised efficiency of EU defence frameworks against the systemic procurement challenges confronting India, such as bureaucratic delays and limited indigenous manufacturing capacity. By identifying key impediments to bilateral cooperation, including regulatory and procedural disparities, the study offers strategic foresight aimed at reinforcing institutional integration and promoting sustainable defence partnerships. The findings underscore the significance of institutional reforms and regulatory alignment in strengthening strategic autonomy and enhancing mutual security interests within a multipolar Indo-Pacific context.

title: Financial Inclusion Through Digital Financial Services (DFS). A Case of Liberia
affiliations: Wilmington University

detail.title: Financial Inclusion Through Digital Financial Services (DFS). A Case of Liberia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: The world of finance has long been shrouded in complexity, creating an impediment for the economically vulnerable and less powerful populations in developing and emerging economies who lack the resources or knowledge to access it. However, with the evolving digital landscape coupled with digital financial innovation, these barriers are beginning to crumble. From digital banking apps to mobile money platforms, digitization is revolutionizing access to financial services like never before. Digital financial services (DFS) have emerged as a critical enabler of financial inclusion, bridging the longstanding gaps in access, usage, and affordability of financial services that previously existed in traditional brick-and-mortar financial systems. In Liberia, where access to financial services is limited or unavailable for the population residing in rural and semi-urban areas of the country, digital financial services provide a vital lifeline for financial inclusion. Through a descriptive correlation quantitative research design, this study examines the impact of digital financial services adoption on financial inclusion in Liberia from 2011 to 2024. Using secondary cross-sectional data collected from the central bank of Liberia's annual reports (2016-2024) and the World Bank's Findex global database (2011-2024), the study results show a direct positive correlation between digital financial services and financial inclusion in Liberia, characterized by a shift towards digital financial services and an increase in banked individuals. The research findings also highlight that the adoption rate of digital financial services has increased considerably, thereby expanding financial inclusion in Liberia from 18.18% in 2011 to 52.21% in 2024. Notwithstanding, despite the DFS's potential to enhance financial inclusion in Liberia, the study identified several challenges and limitations hindering the widespread adoption of digital financial services in Liberia. These include inadequate digital public infrastructure (DPI), limited financial and digital literacy, security and privacy concerns, and regulatory and policy issues. Thus, the paper recommends that the Government of Liberia should augment Liberia's digital public infrastructure (DPI), strengthen the digital regulatory framework, enhance financial and digital literacy programs, and promote stakeholders' collaboration for more comprehensive financial inclusion through digital financial services in Liberia.

title: From Vulnerability to Resilience: The Impact of Global Shocks on Recovery Pathways in Tourism-Dependent Economies
affiliations: KPMG, India, IPAS India and Schrödinger, India

detail.title: From Vulnerability to Resilience: The Impact of Global Shocks on Recovery Pathways in Tourism-Dependent Economies
detail.abstract: Tourism-dependent economies are among the most exposed to global shocks, facing acute disruptions from crises such as pandemics, financial downturns, and climate-related disasters. This article examines how vulnerability is manifested and how resilience is constructed in the recovery pathways of states whose prosperity relies heavily on international tourism. Drawing on empirical evidence from small island developing states and selected emerging destinations, the analysis highlights three interrelated dimensions: structural dependence on external markets, the adaptability of tourism infrastructure, and the flexibility of labor markets. The findings demonstrate that while shocks generate severe short-term losses in arrivals, revenues, and employment, they also create opportunities for institutional innovation, diversification, and sustainabilityoriented reforms. Recovery trajectories vary across cases, shaped by governance capacity, regional cooperation, and access to international finance. The study underscores the dual nature of tourism dependency-as a source of fragility and as a platform for resilience-building. It concludes that policies integrating crisis preparedness, investment in adaptive infrastructure, and inclusive labor strategies are critical to transforming vulnerability into resilience in tourism-dependent economies.

detail.abstract: This investigation started by considering the materials and discussions on the subject of R & D & I contained in the most relevant international taxation legal sources available in Europe. In essence, the analysis of R & D & I seems to be very fashionable, especially at the end of 20th century (1990s) and the beginning of the 21st century (2000s). The concepts comprise intricate legal, economic, financial and account problems, which need to be confronted from various angles. Hence, given that few technical investigations exist with an emphasis on international taxation, this work aims to envisage the main principles, characteristics and problems of application of Research, Development and Innovation Fiscal Incentive Provisions having as background the aforementioned multidisciplinary analysis perspective.

detail.title: The Political Economy of Gender Equality *
detail.abstract: Political institutions have long been dominated by men, and the majority still are. These institutions, in turn, have placed restrictions on the rights and freedoms of women and girls. Progress has been made in the battle for equality, but inequities persist. The first part of this chapter discusses the motivations for male leadership to grant women liberties. The second part flips the perspective and considers women's own participation in the political processes that design and uphold their rights. Innovative research in political economy from both of these perspectives continues to grow, and there remain many exciting possibilities for future research.

title: Democratizing Education? Schooling as an Elite Strategy in Times of Reform
affiliations: Northwestern University

detail.title: Democratizing Education? Schooling as an Elite Strategy in Times of Reform
detail.abstract: Does democratization induce investment in schooling? I study the British Second Reform Act of 1867, which enfranchised poorer urban males. Exploiting its differential impact across locations, time, and cohorts, I show that the Reform elevated schooling quantity and quality, enhancing affected individuals' literacy by 5.6 percentage points. Because schools were mostly mixed-gender, these gains extended to the still disenfranchised women. I find no evidence suggesting that the expansion of education was driven by the demand of the newly enfranchised. Rather, the findings indicate that elites strategically expanded education to shape the new voters' worldviews and secure their allegiance to the establishment. The efforts to cultivate loyalty among the masses seem to have been successful, as treated individuals increasingly joined the British police and military forces.

AI.method: 利用1867年改革法案在不同地区、时间和群体间的差异化影响进行实证分析，采用准实验设计。
AI.findings: 改革法案使受影响个体的识字率提高5.6个百分点，教育数量和质量均得到提升；由于学校多为男女混合，女性也从中受益；教育扩张由精英策略性推动而非新选民需求驱动；处理组个体更倾向于加入警察和军队，表明忠诚培养策略成功。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了民主化进程中教育扩张的精英驱动机制，挑战了传统需求驱动理论，丰富了政治经济学对民主化与教育投资关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现代民主国家教育政策制定提供了历史借鉴，对当前教育政策设计具有启示意义，特别是在处理新获得权利群体时的策略选择。

title: Power Up Consumption: Impact of Electric Vehicle Infrastructure on Household Finance
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Sustainable & Green Finance Institute (SGFIN), National University of Singapore (NUS) - Sustainable & Green Finance Institute (SGFIN) and National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Real Estate

detail.title: Power Up Consumption: Impact of Electric Vehicle Infrastructure on Household Finance
detail.abstract: To achieve carbon neutrality, electrifying vehicles within a cleaner electricity grid is a major pathway among global cities. While much attention has been paid to the environmental benefits of electric vehicle (EV), the financial impacts of EV networks remain underexplored. Using a smart city-state of Singapore as a social laboratory, we combine high-resolution data on the geographic distribution of EV chargers with nearly one million individual-level monthly expenditure records from a major commercial bank and around 65,000 housing transaction records, spanning January 2019 to March 2021. Our results indicate that, during this initial phase of EV infrastructure rollout, being close to charging stations significantly increases household consumption by 1-3%. This effect is primarily driven by public housing residents, who tend to be more financially constrained, than their private housing counterparts. We identify three channels underlying this consumption increase: appreciation in housing wealth, improved accessibility and discretionary spending around EV infrastructure, and a reallocation of household budgets from fuel expenses to other consumption categories. Notably, hybrid car owners exhibit the most pronounced trade-offs, reducing fuel spending while increasing expenditure on entertainment or luxury goods expenditure among public and private housing residents, respectively. Our findings highlight how green infrastructure can influence economic behavior and enhance consumer welfare in global cities, extending its impact beyond environmental goals.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过新加坡的实证分析发现，电动汽车充电站邻近性使家庭消费增加1-3%，主要通过住房财富增值、可达性改善和预算重新分配三个渠道实现，揭示了绿色基础设施对经济行为的积极影响
AI.research_question: 电动汽车充电基础设施的邻近性如何影响家庭消费行为？
AI.motivation: 虽然电动汽车的环境效益受到广泛关注，但其对EV网络财务影响的研究仍然不足，特别是在绿色基础设施如何影响经济行为方面
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费行为理论、可达性理论和家庭预算分配理论，探讨绿色基础设施通过财富效应、便利性效应和替代效应对消费的影响
AI.method: 利用新加坡高分辨率数据，包括EV充电站地理分布、近百万条个人月度消费记录和6.5万条住房交易记录，采用实证分析方法（2019年1月至2021年3月）
AI.findings: 充电站邻近性使家庭消费增加1-3%；效应主要由公共住房居民驱动；通过三个渠道实现：住房财富增值、可达性改善和预算重新分配；混合动力车主表现出最明显的消费结构调整
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了绿色基础设施对经济行为影响的理论框架，揭示了EV基础设施通过多重渠道影响消费的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者和政策制定者提供了实证依据，表明EV基础设施不仅具有环境效益，还能促进消费和提升消费者福利

title: Are SIPs Really 'Sahi' ? A Continuous-Time Analysis of Systematic Investment Plans in Indian Equity Markets
affiliations: Invespar Pte Ltd

detail.title: Are SIPs Really 'Sahi' ? A Continuous-Time Analysis of Systematic Investment Plans in Indian Equity Markets
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates whether Systematic Investment Plans (SIPs) are "sahi" (correct/ appropriate/safe) through a four-lens analytical framework that examines normative optimality, contextual appropriateness, outcome precision, and risk management. Using continuous-time stochastic modelling under geometric Brownian motion, we derive analytical expressions for terminal wealth across three strategies: lump-sum investment (LSI), SIP-Deployment (SIP D), and SIP-Accumulation (SIP A). Theoretical analysis establishes the universal ranking LSI > SIP D > SIP A , with SIP A retaining 56-87% of LSI expected returns and SIP D retaining 66-92%. SIP D achieves superior risk-adjusted positioning through lower coefficient of variation ratios. SIP A can exhibit higher shortfall probabilities than LSI despite a lower absolute variance. Bootstrap validation using 20 years of Indian market data confirms strategic rankings but reveals substantial deviations from theory. Terminal wealth estimates exceed theoretical predictions by 4-28%, reflecting momentum clustering and volatility persistence that continuous-time models abstract away. The four-lens evaluation reveals conditional appropriateness. SIPs suit systematic savers with extended horizons requiring behavioural commitment mechanisms, but impose opportunity costs on capital-rich disciplined investors. Current marketing creates expectation gaps, with significant terminal wealth sacrifices exceeding typical investor expectations. Behavioural analysis explains SIP effectiveness through automation benefits and elimination of timing errors. AMFI data shows that 23% of the advised SIPs remain active beyond five years versus 12.4% self-directed, indicating commitment device value. SIPs are neither universally superior nor inferior, but sophisticated instruments that require careful matching with investor circumstances and objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文通过四维度分析框架评估系统性投资计划(SIP)的适当性，理论分析显示一次性投资最优，SIP次之，实证验证理论排序但发现显著偏差，SIP适合需要行为承诺机制的系统性储蓄者但不适合资本充足的纪律投资者。
AI.research_question: 系统性投资计划(SIP)是否是正确的投资策略？
AI.motivation: 评估SIP投资策略的适当性和有效性，解决当前营销宣传与实际情况之间的期望差距
AI.theoretical_framework: 四维度分析框架：规范性最优性、情境适当性、结果精确性、风险管理；几何布朗运动下的连续时间随机模型
AI.method: 理论推导三种策略（一次性投资、SIP部署、SIP积累）的终端财富解析表达式；使用20年印度市场数据进行Bootstrap验证
AI.findings: 理论排序：LSI > SIP D > SIP A；SIP A保留LSI预期回报的56-87%，SIP D保留66-92%；实证显示终端财富比理论预测高4-28%；23%的建议SIP能持续5年以上
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了SIP投资策略的理论分析框架，推导了三种策略的终端财富解析表达式，提供了SIP风险调整表现的量化评估
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了SIP策略选择的实用指导，揭示了SIP作为行为承诺机制的价值，帮助理财顾问更好地匹配投资者需求与策略

title: Money Is Not the State: A Natural-Moral Theory of Exchange, Credit, and Money
affiliations: Afrindependent Institute

detail.title: Money Is Not the State: A Natural-Moral Theory of Exchange, Credit, and Money
detail.abstract: This paper presents the Africonomics Theory of Exchange, Credit, and Money, offering a principled alternative to utilitarian, mechanistic, and state-centric models dominant in contemporary monetary theory. Contrary to statist claims—such as those advanced by chartalism and its offshoots—which frame money as a state creation, Africonomics demonstrates that money is not a state invention but an organic social institution that originates in human enterprise, voluntary exchange, and the natural-moral law of justice. Money emerges as society’s economic yardstick, an instrument of account that transforms subjective preferences into objective, quantifiable information essential for calculation, coordination, and prosperity. Credit is an intertemporal extension of exchange rooted in trust, collateral, and accountability—not in the inflationary fraud of fiat and fractional-reserve systems. Money becomes corrupted when monopolized and manipulated by states, transforming a tool of cooperation into an instrument of coercion, dispossession, and systemic instability. Grounded in a principled and human-centered approach, Africonomics reframes exchange, credit, and money as natural-moral institutions essential to civilized socioeconomic order.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了非洲经济学交换、信贷和货币理论，提供了一个基于原则的替代方案，挑战了当代货币理论中占主导地位的功利主义、机械论和国家中心主义模型。该理论认为货币不是国家发明，而是源于人类企业、自愿交换和自然道德正义法则的有机社会制度。
AI.research_question: 货币的本质是什么？它是国家创造的还是自然产生的社会制度？
AI.motivation: 挑战当代货币理论中的功利主义、机械论和国家中心主义模型，特别是国家主义主张（如图表主义及其分支）将货币视为国家创造的观点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非洲经济学理论（Africonomics Theory），基于自然道德法则、人类企业、自愿交换和正义原则。
AI.method: 理论分析和方法论批判，通过哲学和经济学原理分析货币的本质和起源。
AI.findings: 货币不是国家发明，而是源于人类企业、自愿交换和自然道德正义法则的有机社会制度；货币作为社会经济尺度，将主观偏好转化为客观可量化信息；信贷是基于信任、抵押和责任的跨期交换延伸；国家垄断和操纵货币会使其腐败。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个基于原则和以人为本的替代货币理论框架，重新定义交换、信贷和货币作为自然道德制度的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解货币本质提供了新的视角，批判了国家垄断货币体系的弊端，为构建更加公正稳定的货币体系提供了理论基础。

title: PEOPLE BEFORE INSTITUTIONS: REFRAMING DEVELOPMENT THROUGH BEHAVIOURAL EVOLUTION
affiliations: Nigerian Economic Summit Group

detail.title: PEOPLE BEFORE INSTITUTIONS: REFRAMING DEVELOPMENT THROUGH BEHAVIOURAL EVOLUTION

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No affiliation
declarations.funderStatement: No funder

keywords: Societal Transformation Models JEL Classification: O43

detail.abstract: Why do similarly designed institutions and reform programmes yield starkly different developmental outcomes across countries? This research argues that the missing variable lies not in policy design or resource endowments, but in the behavioural architecture of a society's people. It introduces the Quality of People for Societal Transformation (QPST) framework, which posits that development is fundamentally contingent upon the ethical, cognitive, civic, and aspirational evolution of people. These four dimensions-ethical integrity, cognitive sophistication, civic disposition, and transformational drive-form the behavioural bedrock upon which effective institutions, inclusive policies, and sustainable development are built. Contrary to prevailing approaches that treat institutions as exogenous or self-sustaining, QPST reconceptualises institutions as artefacts of behavioural evolution, constructed and maintained by the collective quality of people within a society. The framework also advances a theory of functionally convergent ethics, proposing that while moral codes differ across cultures, only those that consistently yield public-regarding outcomes, such as trust, accountability, and rule of law, can support long-term development. Through a five-stage model of societal transformation, QPST captures how societies evolve from foundational survival ethics to advanced stages of civic maturity and innovation. This paradigm offers a new lens for interpreting developmental divergence, explaining why some societies are able to absorb reforms, maintain state legitimacy, and sustain growth, while others stagnate despite similar policy interventions. In doing so, the research calls for a shift in development theory and practice, from institution-first to people-first, placing behavioural evolution at the heart of global development strategy.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了"社会转型人口质量(QPST)"框架，认为发展差异的根本原因在于人口的行为架构而非制度设计，强调伦理、认知、公民意识和变革动力四个维度的行为进化是可持续发展的基础。
AI.research_question: 为什么相似设计的制度和改革项目在不同国家会产生截然不同的发展结果？
AI.motivation: 现有发展理论过度关注制度设计和资源禀赋，忽视了人口行为质量对发展结果的关键影响，需要新的理论框架来解释发展差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: QPST框架（社会转型人口质量框架），包含四个核心维度：伦理诚信、认知成熟度、公民倾向和变革驱动力，将制度重新概念化为行为进化的产物。
AI.method: 理论框架构建和概念分析，提出了五阶段社会转型模型和功能趋同伦理理论。
AI.findings: 发展根本上取决于人口的伦理、认知、公民和抱负进化，只有产生公共导向结果（如信任、问责、法治）的道德规范才能支持长期发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了以人口行为质量为核心的新发展理论框架；2) 重新概念化制度为行为进化的产物；3) 发展了功能趋同伦理理论；4) 建立了五阶段社会转型模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展实践提供了从"制度优先"向"人口优先"的转型思路，将行为进化置于全球发展策略的核心位置，为解释发展差异和制定有效干预措施提供了新视角。

title: Recent Tax Treaty Developments: Chile

detail.title: Recent Tax Treaty Developments: Chile
detail.abstract: The first income tax treaty negotiated and concluded by Chile with Argentina was enforced on March 7, 1986, according to its publication in the Official Gazette. This tax treaty was negotiated using the Andean Pact Model, despite the fact that Chile was not a member of the Andean Pact. As from 1998 Chilean authorities started an aggressive tax treaty campaign with negotiations that have included different nations around the world. These tax treaty negotiations have followed the OECD Model, with some deviations that reinforce the right of taxation at source following particular UN Model clauses. At present, the most important official source of deviations from the OECD Model can be obtained from the Chilean positions included in the 2008 OECD Update to the OECD Model Tax Convention, hereinafter 2008 OECD Model Update.

AI.tldr: 智利首个所得税条约于1986年生效，使用安第斯模型，虽然智利非成员国。从1998年起智利启动税政条约攻势，转向使用OECD模型但保留了源地税收权的特定偏移，这些偏移在2008年OECD模型更新中得到了官方认可。
AI.research_question: 智利所得税条约政策的发展演变及其对国际税收模型的选择与修订策略是什么？
AI.motivation: 分析智利在国际税收条约网络建设中从安第斯模型向OECD模型转变的过程，以及在接纳国际标准的同时保持源地税收权的特定立场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际税收条约模型理论（安第斯模型、OECD模型、联合国模型），源地税权与居住地税权的分配原则，双边税收协定策略理论。
AI.method: 历史文档分析法，对智利税收条约发展历程进行时间序列分析，重点考察模型选择和条款修订的演变过程。
AI.findings: 智利初期使用非成员国模型（安第斯），后期转向OECD模型但保留重要偏移，特别是在源地税收权方面接近联合国模型条款，这些偏移在2008年得到OECD官方认可。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家在国际税收条约网络建设中的模型选择理论，提供了非OECD成员国实践OECD模型但保持国家税收利益的实证研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智利及其税收条约伙伴国提供了条约解释和执行的实践指南，为其他发展中国家制定税收条约政策提供了参考案例。

title: Wiring Equality: The Impact of Internet on Wage Dispersion in Costa Rica
affiliations: Utrecht University, Utrecht University - School of Economics and Utrecht University

detail.title: Wiring Equality: The Impact of Internet on Wage Dispersion in Costa Rica
detail.abstract: This paper shows that investment in internet infrastructure compresses lower-tail wage inequality. We present a monopsony model with heterogeneous firms in which better job search by workers, due to increased internet access, forcing wages to converge to the competitive wage. This results in larger wage increases for low-wage workers and a reallocation of workers from low-wage to high-wage firms, such that lower-tail wage inequality decreases. We then leverage the liberalization of the telecommunications market in Costa Rica as a natural experiment in a continuous treatment DiD design to show evidence in support of our model. We also show that lower-tail inequality in non-wage job characteristics decreases, and that minimum wages and collective bargaining are unlikely to be alternative explanations for our empirical results.

AI.tldr: 互联网基础设施投资通过改善工人求职搜索能力，压缩了工资分布的低尾不平等。在哥斯达黎加电信市场自由化的自然实验中发现，互联网接入增加使低工资工人获得更大涨幅，工人从低薪企业向高薪企业重新配置，从而降低工资不平等。
AI.research_question: 互联网基础设施投资如何影响工资不平等，特别是低尾工资不平等？
AI.motivation: 理解数字技术发展对劳动力市场不平等的影响，特别是互联网接入如何改变工人的议价能力和企业间的工资差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于异质性企业的买方垄断模型，其中互联网改善的求职搜索迫使工资向竞争性工资收敛。
AI.method: 利用哥斯达黎加电信市场自由化作为自然实验，采用连续处理的双重差分设计（continuous treatment DiD）。
AI.findings: 互联网接入增加导致低工资工人获得更大工资涨幅，工人从低薪企业向高薪企业重新配置，降低低尾工资不平等；非工资工作特征的不平等也减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了互联网技术通过改善求职搜索影响工资不平等的理论机制，解释了数字技术对劳动力市场结构的重塑作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了通过数字基础设施建设减少收入不平等的实证依据，表明互联网普及可以成为改善低收入群体经济状况的有效工具。

title: Inspections in Private Premises Under Slovak Competition Law: Did the Implementation of the ECN+ Directive Miss the Point?
affiliations: Comenius University in Bratislava, Faculty of Law and Faculty of Law

detail.title: Inspections in Private Premises Under Slovak Competition Law: Did the Implementation of the ECN+ Directive Miss the Point?

declarations.funderStatement: This article was prepared within the activities of the Jean Monnet Centre of Excellence “Rule of Law in the European Union” supported by the European Union (grant No 620758-EPP- 1-2020-1-SK-EPPJMO-CoE)

keywords: Antimonopoly Office of the Slovak Republic

detail.abstract:
We face the era when tech giants are getting ever more powerful, when there are
subtle ways of collusion via algorithms, and when home offices are the new normal.
One would expect competition authorities to have suitable tools to investigate any
infringement of competition law even under these difficult conditions. Inspections are arguably the most powerful investigatory tool within the realm of the powers
of competition authorities. Although inspections are very often conducted in
business premises, there might be a need to search private premises too. Regulation
1/2003 has recognised this need for almost two decades. The ECN+ Directive
expects national competition law to provide their competition authorities with the
power to inspect non-business premises. How was this provision transposed into
the Slovak legal order? What obstacles would the Slovak Antimonopoly Office
(Slovak NCA) face if it wanted to conduct an inspection on private premises?
These are the questions asked in this article. The article finds that, although the
legislation itself seems in compliance with the ECN+ Directive, any attempt to
conduct an inspection on private premises would be difficult. Particularly, we look
into shortcomings related to the institution of the guardian who should be present
during an inspection; and we present solutions de lege ferenda.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了斯洛伐克竞争法在实施ECN+指令中关于检查非经营场所的规定时面临的挑战，特别是监护人在场制度的缺陷，并提出了立法改进建议。
AI.research_question: 斯洛伐克法律体系如何转化ECN+指令中关于检查非经营场所的规定？斯洛伐克反垄断办公室在检查私人场所时会面临哪些障碍？
AI.motivation: 科技巨头日益强大、算法合谋等新型竞争违法行为出现，以及居家办公新常态下，竞争执法机构需要有效的调查工具，包括对非经营场所的检查权。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欧盟竞争法框架，特别是ECN+指令和欧盟第1/2003号条例，分析竞争执法机构的调查权力和程序保障机制。
AI.method: 法律文本分析和比较法研究，分析斯洛伐克国内法对欧盟指令的转化实施情况。
AI.findings: 虽然斯洛伐克立法表面上符合ECN+指令要求，但在实际操作中检查私人场所存在困难，特别是监护人在场制度存在缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对竞争执法机构调查权力边界和程序保障的理论认识，特别是在数字时代和新工作模式下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了斯洛伐克竞争法实施中的具体障碍，提出了改进立法的具体建议，为其他欧盟成员国提供借鉴。

title: Evaluating the Impact of Model Interpretability and Transparency in Machine Learning-Based Anti-Money Laundering Solutions for Financial Institutions
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Evaluating the Impact of Model Interpretability and Transparency in Machine Learning-Based Anti-Money Laundering Solutions for Financial Institutions

keywords: Evaluating the Impact of Model Interpretability
Anti-Money Laundering Solutions for Financial Institutions

detail.abstract: This study evaluates the impact of model interpretability and transparency in machine learning (ML)-based Anti-Money Laundering (AML) solutions deployed within financial institutions. With the increasing reliance on ML to detect and prevent money laundering activities, the research focuses on understanding how transparent models influence regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and trust within financial organizations. Purpose of the Study: The primary purpose of this study is to assess the role of interpretability and transparency in improving the effectiveness and compliance of ML-driven AML systems. The research aims to identify the benefits and challenges that transparent ML models bring to financial institutions, especially in terms of reducing false positives, ensuring fairness, and complying with regulatory standards. Methodology: The study uses a mixed-methods approach, combining qualitative interviews with financial compliance officers and AML experts to understand the practical challenges of implementing ML models. Additionally, quantitative analysis of model performance (e.g., false positive rates, detection accuracy) is conducted across a range of interpretable and non-interpretable ML models. This analysis is supplemented by case studies from financial institutions using both black-box and transparent ML solutions for AML detection.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估机器学习反洗钱解决方案中模型可解释性和透明度的影响，通过混合方法分析透明模型如何提升监管合规性、操作效率和机构信任度
AI.research_question: 模型可解释性和透明度如何影响基于机器学习的反洗钱系统的有效性和合规性？
AI.motivation: 随着金融机构日益依赖机器学习检测和预防洗钱活动，需要理解透明模型对监管合规、操作效率和机构内部信任的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习可解释性理论、反洗钱监管框架、组织信任理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法：定性访谈金融合规官和AML专家，定量分析模型性能指标（误报率、检测准确率），以及金融机构案例研究
AI.findings: 透明ML模型能够降低误报率、确保公平性、符合监管标准，但实施过程中面临挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了机器学习可解释性在金融合规领域的理论应用，建立了透明模型与监管合规的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构选择AML解决方案提供实践指导，帮助提升合规效率和降低操作风险

title: Banking Concentration, Outside Options and Market Power
affiliations: Adolfo Ibanez University, Universidad de los Andes and Nottingham University Business School

detail.title: Banking Concentration, Outside Options and Market Power
detail.abstract: We consider the dual nature of the banking industry and estimate a structural model that examines market power both in the loan market and the deposit market in Argentina. We nd that a substantial concentration of the industry led to reduced competition and higher bank protability, which based on signicant reductions in marginal costs despite lower loan rates. We also nd that the usual assumption of exogenous deposit interest rates provides a downward assessment of the extent of market power in the loan market, and that banks price deposits above their standalone marginal benet to take advantage of imperfect competition in the loan market.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建结构模型分析阿根廷银行业的双重性质，发现业务集中度导致竞争减弱和银行盈利能力提升，并揭示了存款利率外生假设对贷款市场权力估计的低估偏差
AI.research_question: 阿根廷银行业在贷款市场和存款市场中的市场权力分布如何？业务集中度如何影响银行业竞争和盈利能力？
AI.motivation: 传统银行业研究假设存款利率外生，影响了对贷款市场权力的准确估计，需要考虑银行业的双重市场性质
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行业结构模型理论，市场权力测度理论，双重市场竞争分析框架
AI.method: 结构模型估计方法，对阿根廷银行业贷款市场和存款市场进行同时分析
AI.findings: 业务集中度导致竞争减弱和银行盈利能力提升；存款利率外生假设会低估贷款市场权力；银行会将存款定价高于独立边际收益以利用贷款市场的不完全竞争
AI.theory_contributions: 提出考虑银行业双重市场性质的分析框架，批判了存款利率外生假设的限制，丰富了银行业结构模型理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿根廷银行业监管提供政策建议，帮助理解业务集中度对竞争和效率的影响，为其他发展中国家的银行业政策提供参考

title: Are "100% Renewable" Electricity Claims Misleading? Evidence on Consumer Awareness and Preferences for Temporal Matching *
affiliations: Technical University Munich and Technische Universität München (TUM) - TUM School of Management

detail.title: Are "100% Renewable" Electricity Claims Misleading? Evidence on Consumer Awareness and Preferences for Temporal Matching *

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This work has received funding from Stadtwerke München GmbH which was used to conduct the online experiment.

detail.abstract: Green electricity tariffs marketed as "100% renewable" often rely on Energy Attribute Certificates (EACs), which allow a temporal decoupling between consumption and generation. This decoupling has raised concerns about the actual environmental impact of green electricity tariffs and the potential to mislead consumers. This paper examines German households' awareness and preferences regarding temporal matching. Based on a stated-choice experiment with randomized information treatments and over 1,000 participants, we find: (1) 85% of consumers are unaware of the mismatch; (2) informing them reduces willingness to pay (WTP) modestly but statistically significant by 4.1-11.4 percentage points; and (3) an explicit guarantee of temporal matching does not significantly increase WTP. We interpret these findings as an information failure in current green electricity markets, where a non-negligible share of consumers likely base their purchase decisions on incorrect or incomplete information. Various measures could help mitigate it, including clearer definitions and greater transparency mandates, alongside voluntary industry standards and third-party verification.

AI.tldr: 德国消费者对绿色电力证书的时间错配问题缺乏认知，信息透明化能适度降低支付意愿，但时间匹配保证并未显著提升支付意愿，表明当前市场存在信息失灵问题。
AI.research_question: 德国家庭对绿色电力时间匹配的认知程度和偏好如何？信息透明化如何影响消费者的支付意愿？
AI.motivation: 绿色电力证书（EACs）导致消费与发电时间脱节，引发了对绿色电力实际环境影响和可能误导消费者的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论和消费者行为理论，研究绿色电力市场中的信息失灵问题。
AI.method: 采用陈述选择实验，包含随机化信息处理，样本量超过1000名参与者。
AI.findings: 1) 85%消费者不了解时间错配问题；2) 信息透明化使支付意愿显著降低4.1-11.4个百分点；3) 时间匹配保证未显著提高支付意愿。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了绿色电力市场中的信息失灵现象，为信息不对称理论在环境产品领域的应用提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了改善市场透明度的政策建议，包括更清晰的定义、强制性透明度要求、行业自愿标准和第三方验证机制。

title: Is Globalization Ending?
affiliations: United Nations - Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD)

detail.title: Is Globalization Ending?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare herewith that neither person nor organization have influence their study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
As the world experiences serious economic, political, and technological upheavals, globalization - once regarded as a key driver of growth and prosperity - is facing unprecedented challenges. The processes of industrialization and globalization
have brought significant achievements over the past two centuries, particularly through specialization, free trade, and technological advancement. However, financial crises, global pandemics, wars, and strategic competition among major
powers have exposed vulnerabilities in the traditional model of globalization.
This article aims to analyze the achievements and limitations of globalization, thereby shedding light on trends such as the restructuring of global supply chains, policy shifts by national governments, and especially the adoption of de-risking strategies. Through practical case studies of the EU, the United States, China, and developing countries, the article argues that globalization is not ending but is being reshaped  moving toward stronger regionalization, geopolitical polarization, and digitalization.

AI.tldr: 全球化正在经历重塑而非终结，从传统模式转向更强的区域化、地缘政治极化和数字化趋势。
AI.research_question: 全球化面临哪些挑战？其成就与局限性是什么？全球化将如何重塑？
AI.motivation: 世界经济、政治和技术剧变暴露了传统全球化模式的脆弱性，需要重新审视全球化的未来走向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球化理论、国际政治经济学、地缘政治理论
AI.method: 案例研究法（欧盟、美国、中国和发展中国家的实践案例分析）
AI.findings: 全球化正在向区域化、地缘政治极化和数字化方向重塑，而非终结；全球供应链重组、国家政策转变和去风险策略成为主要趋势
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了全球化重塑的理论框架，识别了区域化、极化和数字化三个关键维度
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对全球化转型的实践指导，特别是去风险策略和供应链重组的实施建议

title: Cannabis and Acquisitions
affiliations: Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen and

detail.title: Cannabis and Acquisitions
detail.abstract: We examine whether cannabis legalization in the U.S. enhances or diminishes firm value in the context of corporate acquisitions. Following the legalization of recreational cannabis, acquirers of targets in those states earn surprisingly higher abnormal announcement returns, while no such effect is observed for medical cannabis. The value gain is driven by improved target selection. Acquirers become more selective in making acquisition decisions, reducing value-destroying deals while increasing the success rate of value-enhancing ones. These transactions also lead to improved long-run operational efficiency and stronger stock performance.

AI.tldr: 美国娱乐大麻合法化提升了伦理公司的收购价值，通过改善目标选择和减少价值破坏交易来实现
AI.research_question: 大麻合法化是否以及如何影响美国企业收购交易的价值创造
AI.motivation: 探索大麻合法化改策对企业财务决策和价值创造的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 以合法化政策作为外生冲击，分析其对企业投资决策和价值创造的作用机制
AI.method: 实证分析法，通过比较娱乐大麻合法化和医疗大麻合法化状态下的收购市场反应和交易结果
AI.findings: 娱乐大麻合法化后，收购方获得更高的异常回报率，主要来自于收购决策更加精准，减少价值破坏交易的同时提高价值增值交易成功率
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了合法化政策对企业投资决策影响的理论，揭示了政策环境变化通过改善决策质量来提升价值创造的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在大麻合法化环境下进行投资决策提供实证支撑，以及为政策制定者评估合法化政策的广泛经济影响提供参考

title: Catastrophe Bonds and Insurer Solvency: Evidence on Capital Structure Optimisation and Cost of Capital
affiliations: Glasgow Caledonian University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Catastrophe Bonds and Insurer Solvency: Evidence on Capital Structure Optimisation and Cost of Capital

declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This study examines how catastrophe (Cat) bonds, as a form of insurance-linked securities (ILS), influence insurers' solvency, capital reserves, and cost of capital when underwriting catastrophe risk. Using panel data from 39 global insurers and reinsurers between 1997 and 2015, we apply Generalised Method of Moments (GMM) estimations and stress-testing techniques to evaluate the role of Cat bonds in capital optimisation. The results show that Cat bond issuance significantly improves debt-to-equity and solvency ratios, enhances contingent reserves, and reduces weighted average cost of capital (WACC). Stress-testing further indicates that Cat bonds strengthen insurers' resilience under extreme loss scenarios, despite their associated coupon costs. Overall, the findings provide empirical evidence that Cat bonds are an effective instrument for optimising capital structure and managing catastrophe risk in a cost-efficient and forward-looking manner.

AI.tldr: 巨灾债券发行显著改善保险公司资本结构，提升偿付能力，降低资本成本，增强极端损失情景下的韧性
AI.research_question: 巨灾债券如何影响保险公司的偿付能力、资本储备和资本成本
AI.motivation: 研究巨灾债券作为保险连接证券在优化保险公司资本结构和应对巨灾风险方面的作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 保险连接证券理论、资本结构理论、风险管理理论
AI.method: 使用1997-2015年39家全球保险公司和再保险公司的面板数据，采用广义矩估计(GMM)和压力测试技术
