title: A Study on Expected Risk-Return of Selected Stock with Respect to Growth Industries
affiliations: Associate Professor, Surana College, P G Departments, Bangalore, India, Surana College and Associate Professor, Surana College, P G Departments, Bangalore, India

detail.title: A Study on Expected Risk-Return of Selected Stock with Respect to Growth Industries
detail.abstract: Investors' investment activity usually revolves around high-growth industries in order to take advantage of growth in respective industry. Expected Return, Expected Risk, Coefficient of Variation (CV) and Beta of stock have been calculated and sector-wise comparative analysis of all the above parameters have been made to analyze and present the performance of stocks of 35 companies across seven sectors. This would help investors to identify the expected return and risk associated with the stock in relation to the stock market and support investors to make appropriate investment decision. From the analysis it is found that a risk averse investor can consider investing in Godrej Properties and HDFC Bank because both these stocks have higher expected return, lower expected risk and low CV and Beta value of less than 1. Next category of the stock that investor can consider investing in will be the stocks of TCS and PVR because both these stocks have higher expected return, lower CV and Beta value of less than 1. But in terms of expected risk, both of these stocks have higher expected risk.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过计算预期收益、预期风险、变异系数和Beta值，对七个行业35家公司的股票进行行业比较分析，为投资者提供投资决策支持。研究发现Godrej Properties和HDFC Bank适合风险避免型投资者，TCS和PVR适合寻求高收益的投资者。
AI.research_question: 不同行业股票的预期收益、风险水平和市场相关性如何？投资者如何根据这些指标做出合理的投资决策？
AI.motivation: 投资者通常投资高增长行业以获取增长收益，需要系统性的股票性能分析来评估预期收益和风险水平，以支持投资决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现代投资组合理论(MPT)、资产定价模型(CAPM)、风险-收益交换理论，通过预期收益、预期风险、变异系数(CV)和Beta值等指标来评估股票性能。
AI.method: 采用定量分析方法，计算35家公司在7个不同行业的股票的预期收益、预期风险、变异系数和Beta值，并进行行业比较分析。
AI.findings: Godrej Properties和HDFC Bank股票具有较高预期收益、较低预期风险、低变异系数和小于1的Beta值，适合风险避免型投资者。TCS和PVR股票具有高预期收益、低变异系数和小于1的Beta值，但预期风险较高，适合寻求高收益的投资者。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证验证了风险-收益交换理论在不同行业股票中的应用，为投资者提供了基于定量指标的股票选择理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了具体的股票投资建议，帮助投资者根据自身风险偏好选择合适的股票，提高投资决策的科学性和有效性。

title: Knowledge Management and Performance of Deposit Money Banks in Enugu State, Nigeria
affiliations: University of Nigeria Enugu Campus

detail.title: Knowledge Management and Performance of Deposit Money Banks in Enugu State, Nigeria
detail.abstract: This study examined the effect of knowledge management on the performance of deposit money banks in Enugu state, Nigeria. The aim of the study was to ascertain the effect of knowledge identification on employee productivity, to determine the effect of knowledge sharing on customer satisfaction, to assess the nature relationship between knowledge application and customer acquisition and retention. The study adopted survey research design in conducting the research, and data was collected from 89 employees across three prominent banks through structured questionnaires (on a five-point Likert Scale) and insightful interviews. A test-retest method was used and tested with the Spearman Ranking Order Correlation Coefficient which gave a reliability coefficient of 0.88, indicating high frequency. Face validation was conducted by five management research experts from both industry and academia. Frequency distribution table and simple percentage techniques respectively, were utilized for the data presentation and analysis of the study. Data analysis involved Simple Linear Regression and Pearson Product Moment Correlation, with a significant level of 0.05. Results revealed that knowledge identification positively influences employee productivity (R= 0.752, β= 0.672, t= 6.254, p= 0.001 < 0.05), knowledge sharing significantly affects customer satisfaction (R= 0.678, β= 0.523, t= 4.510, p= 0.001 < 0.05), and knowledge application correlates positively with customer acquisition and retention (R= 0.712, β= 0.615, t= 4.347, p= 0.001 < 0.05). The study concluded that enhancing Deposit Money Banks’ performance in Enugu State, Nigeria, relies on knowledge identification, knowledge sharing, and knowledge application. It recommended that management should design an effective and efficient knowledge management system, recognizing its role in fostering employee productivity, customer satisfaction, and ultimately, customer acquisition and retention.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了知识管理对尼日利亚埃努古州存款货币银行绩效的影响，发现知识识别、知识共享和知识应用分别对员工生产力、客户满意度及客户获取与保留有显著正向影响。
AI.research_question: 知识管理如何影响尼日利亚埃努古州存款货币银行的绩效？
AI.motivation: 了解知识管理在银行业中的具体作用机制，为银行提升绩效提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识管理理论，包括知识识别、知识共享和知识应用三个维度。
AI.method: 采用调查研究设计，通过结构化问卷（五点李克特量表）和深度访谈收集89名银行员工数据，使用重测信度检验（Spearman相关系数0.88），数据分析采用简单线性回归和Pearson相关分析。
AI.findings: 知识识别对员工生产力有显著正向影响（R=0.752, β=0.672, p<0.05）；知识共享显著影响客户满意度（R=0.678, β=0.523, p<0.05）；知识应用与客户获取保留正相关（R=0.712, β=0.615, p<0.05）。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了知识管理理论在银行业的具体应用效果，为知识管理理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理层设计有效的知识管理系统提供了实践指导，有助于提升员工生产力、客户满意度和客户忠诚度。

title: Draws, Productive and Destructive Activities in Contests
affiliations: Miyazaki Sangyo-keiei University and Konan University

detail.title: Draws, Productive and Destructive Activities in Contests
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the incentive effects of introducing the possibility of a draw in a two-stage contest that involves both destructive and productive activities. In the first stage, players may engage in destructive activities (sabotage) to raise their opponent's cost of exerting productive activity in the second stage. Although prior studies have shown that allowing for draws generally reduces total activity in contests with only productive inputs, we demonstrate that the presence of a draw can improve incentive structures in settings where sabotage is possible. Specifically, we show that the equilibrium level of sabotage decreases, while the equilibrium level of productive activity increases with the probability of a draw. These findings highlight a previously underappreciated role of draws: by discouraging destructive behavior, they can indirectly promote productive activity and improve contest efficiency from the designer's perspective.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在包含破坏性和生产性活动的两阶段竞赛中引入平局可能性的激励效应。研究发现平局概率增加会降低破坏活动水平，同时提高生产性活动水平，从而改善竞赛效率。
AI.research_question: 在包含破坏性活动（破坏）和生产性活动的两阶段竞赛中，引入平局可能性对参与者的激励结构会产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 先前研究显示在只有生产性投入的竞赛中允许平局通常会降低总活动水平，但本文关注的是在破坏活动可能存在的环境中平局是否能改善激励结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两阶段竞赛理论，包含破坏性活动（第一阶段）和生产性活动（第二阶段）的博弈框架，分析平局概率对均衡行为的影响。
AI.method: 理论建模和博弈论分析，构建包含平局概率的两阶段竞赛模型，求解纳什均衡并比较静态分析。
AI.findings: 平局概率增加会降低均衡破坏活动水平，同时提高均衡生产性活动水平。平局通过抑制破坏行为间接促进生产性活动，改善竞赛效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了平局在竞赛理论中的一个被低估的作用：通过抑制破坏性行为间接促进生产性活动，为竞赛设计提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞赛设计者提供了改善激励结构的实用建议：通过适当设置平局概率，可以有效减少破坏行为，促进生产性努力，提高整体竞赛效率。

title: Political Settlement: A Review Over the Concept and Its Latest Meaning
affiliations: Sharif University of Technology

detail.title: Political Settlement: A Review Over the Concept and Its Latest Meaning
detail.abstract: Development studies have developed different frameworks to explain how nations reach prosperity, among which Political settlement is one of the latest attempts to readjust the new institutional economics framework to come up with better explanations. In this note, we present the latest meaning of political settlement, explain the discrepancies in their viewpoints and typologies that scholars have created so far. Finally, we discuss the implications of political settlement framework to make more efficient policies.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了政治解决框架的最新发展，分析了学者们在该领域的观点分歧和类型学差异，并讨论了该框架对制定更有效政策的启示

AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了政治解决框架的理论发展，厘清了学术分歧，推动了发展研究理论体系的完善

title: Federal Reserve Chairs and Monetary Regimes
affiliations: Birkbeck University of London, University of Exeter and University of London - Economics, Mathematics and Statistics

detail.title: Federal Reserve Chairs and Monetary Regimes

declarations.funderStatement: Morita acknowledges financial support from the Economic and Social Research Council (ESRC: Grant Reference ES/J500021/1)

detail.abstract: This paper extends prior research by introducing a novel econometric framework-Regime-Dependent Granger Causality-to analyse the systematic elements of United States (US) monetary policy. Using vector autoregressive models allowing for temporary Granger causality, we examine the association between monetary policy regimes-Taylor rules and Monetary Feedback rules-and the tenures of Federal Reserve Chairs. The analysis identifies the Global Financial Crisis period as a critical juncture. Taylor rule regimes predominated between 1965 and 2004, whereas Monetary Feedback regimes became more prominent from 1984 to 2019, with notable deviations during the Burns-Miller tenure and post-2004 under Bernanke. Monte Carlo simulations affirm the robustness of these findings. The study underscores the increasing relevance of Monetary Feedback rules in understanding the evolving nature of systematic US monetary policy, particularly in the aftermath of the crisis.

AI.tldr: 本文引入了一种新的计量经济学框架——体制依赖格兰杰因果关系，来分析美国货币政策的系统性要素。研究发现全球金融危机是一个关键转折点，泰勒规则在1965-2004年占主导，而货币反馈规则在1984-2019年更加突出，特别是在伯南克时期。
AI.research_question: 美国货币政策体制（泰勒规则与货币反馈规则）与美联储主席任期之间是否存在关联？
AI.motivation: 扩展先前研究，通过新的计量经济学框架来深入分析美国货币政策的系统性要素及其演变规律。
AI.theoretical_framework: 体制依赖格兰杰因果关系理论、向量自回归模型、泰勒规则理论、货币反馈规则理论
AI.method: 使用允许临时格兰杰因果关系的向量自回归模型，结合蒙特卡洛模拟进行稳健性检验
AI.findings: 全球金融危机是关键转折点；泰勒规则在1965-2004年占主导地位；货币反馈规则在1984-2019年更加突出；伯恩斯-米勒任期和伯南克任期后出现显著偏离
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了体制依赖格兰杰因果关系这一新的计量经济学框架，为分析货币政策体制转变提供了理论工具
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了货币政策规则的历史演变规律，为理解美联储政策制定和未来货币政策走向提供了实践指导，特别是在后危机时代货币反馈规则的重要性日益凸显

title: A Baseline Study on the State of Local Climate Change Expenditure Tagging (CCET) in the Philippines
affiliations: and University of the Philippines, Diliman

detail.title: A Baseline Study on the State of Local Climate Change Expenditure Tagging (CCET) in the Philippines

keywords: Organisation for Economic Co-Operation and Development

publicationDetails.detailsText: Philippine Journal of Public Administration, Vol. 68 (2024)

detail.abstract: Local government units (LGUs) in the Philippines are situated at the forefront of climate change action. As they translate local plans into investment programs, LGUs are required to implement climate change expenditure tagging (CCET) to track budgeted items related to climate adaptation and mitigation. However, numerous LGUs in the Philippines have faced challenges in achieving sufficient compliance with CCET. This study, therefore, aims to contribute to this area by assessing the state of local CCET and subsequently identifying institutional and policy recommendations to improve its implementation. Using the evaluation criteria developed by the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), this study employs a qualitative descriptive design involving document analysis, literature review and key informant interviews (KII). In general, the findings highlight the need for supporting legislation to ensure sustainability and propose an expansion of the tagging mechanics. This expansion may involve indicating financing sources, integrating adaptation and mitigation objectives within programs, projects, and activities (PPA), applying degrees of relevance through corresponding weights, accounting for negative expenditures, and tracking PPAs' alignment with the five comprehensive development plan (CDP) sectors. To improve implementation effectiveness and efficiency, integrating CCET across LGUs' planning, budgeting, and legislative functions is recommended, alongside institutionalizing administrative reforms for sufficient institutional capacities for CCET implementation.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估菲律宾地方政府气候变化支出标签（CCET）实施状况，发现需要支持性立法确保可持续性，并建议扩展标签机制，整合规划预算功能，制度化行政改革以提高实施能力。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾地方政府气候变化支出标签（CCET）的实施状况如何？如何通过制度和政策建议改进其实施效果？
AI.motivation: 菲律宾许多地方政府在实现CCET充分合规方面面临挑战，需要评估现状并提出改进建议以推动气候变化行动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用经济合作与发展组织（OECD）开发的评估标准作为理论框架。
AI.method: 定性描述性研究设计，包括文件分析、文献综述和关键信息人访谈（KII）。
AI.findings: 研究发现需要支持性立法确保可持续性，建议扩展标签机制（包括标明资金来源、整合适应和减缓目标、应用相关性权重、核算负面支出、跟踪与综合发展计划部门的对齐）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家地方政府气候变化预算追踪机制提供了实证研究和理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体的制度和政策建议：整合CCET到地方政府的规划、预算和立法职能中，制度化行政改革以提升CCET实施能力。

title: Exact Simulation of Stochastic Volatility Models Based on Conditional Fourier-cosine Method
affiliations: and Carl von Ossietzky University Oldenburg

detail.title: Exact Simulation of Stochastic Volatility Models Based on Conditional Fourier-cosine Method
detail.abstract: The traditional methodology used for the exact simulation of stochastic volatility models based on the Gil-Pelaez formula presents implementation problems that are observed by many researchers and practitioners. In particular, although conventionally considered exact, such a method presents a difficult control of the error. The bias of the Monte Carlo simulation estimator can only be computed numerically and is controlled by two parameters, typically determined by running timeconsuming simulations under different tuning parameter configurations until an optimal setup is found. In this paper, we propose a new exact simulation scheme based on the Fourier-cosine method, which approximates a probability density given the characteristic function as follows: the density is truncated on a finite interval, and approximated by a classical Fourier-cosine series. The method allows full error control via an effective automatic identification of the tuning parameters given a user-supplied error tolerance. The new approach offers the following advantages: improved control of the error, simplified implementation, and reduction in computing time. The error is controlled by only one parameter instead of two. This parameter has a clear interpretation: it is the maximum tolerable bias. This facilitates the implementation, since the maximum bias becomes an input of the simulation algorithm, instead of an output, and can be set a priori, before running simulations. Our analysis shows that the proposed exact simulation scheme is computationally faster than the traditional one, and presents an improved speed-accuracy profile with respect to alternative stateof-the-art fast approximated sampling schemes.

AI.tldr: 提出基于傅里叶余弦方法的新精确模拟方案，相比传统Gil-Pelaez方法具有更好的误差控制、简化实现和计算时间减少的优势
AI.research_question: 如何改进随机波动率模型的精确模拟方法，解决传统方法误差控制困难的问题
AI.motivation: 传统基于Gil-Pelaez公式的随机波动率模型精确模拟方法存在误差控制困难、实现复杂、计算耗时等问题
AI.theoretical_framework: 傅里叶余弦方法理论框架，通过特征函数近似概率密度函数
AI.method: 基于傅里叶余弦方法的精确模拟方案，在有限区间上截断密度函数并用傅里叶余弦级数近似
AI.findings: 新方法只需一个参数控制误差，计算速度更快，具有改进的速度-精度特性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于傅里叶余弦方法的精确模拟理论框架，实现了更好的误差控制机制
AI.practical_contributions: 简化了实现过程，减少了计算时间，提供了有效的自动参数识别方法

title: INITIATIVE IN 3 × 3 STRICTLY ORDINAL GAMES
affiliations: Helmut-Schmidt-Universitaet

detail.title: INITIATIVE IN 3 × 3 STRICTLY ORDINAL GAMES
detail.abstract: This paper takes up the age-old talk about "seizing the initiative" and submits it to rigopurous game theory analysis. In so doing, we achieve two things: (a) We extend the taxonomy of 2 × 2 strictly ordinal games to include consideration of the initiative. (b) We employ a Monte Carlo framework to capture the 3 × 3 case and also explore the computational frontiers involved for ordinary researchers and practitioners. It turns out that the 2 × 2 case is fraught with a number of strategic peculiarities that do not survive an extension to larger normal form games. We find that among the two main guises that that initiative may take, commitment and pre-emption, the latter is by far the stronger one. This theoretical result has so far not been recognised in military theory. Additionally, we have a first indication that the value of the initiative, ceteris paribus, may decrease in the number of COAs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过博弈论分析扩展了2×2严格序数博弈的分类，引入先手权考量，并使用蒙特卡洛方法研究3×3情况。研究发现先手权在承诺和先发制人两种形式中，后者更具优势，且先手价值可能随行动方案数量增加而降低。
AI.research_question: 先手权在博弈论中的战略价值是什么？不同博弈规模下先手权的效果有何差异？
AI.motivation: 对传统军事理论中'掌握主动权'概念进行严谨的博弈论分析，填补理论空白
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论、2×2严格序数博弈理论、蒙特卡洛模拟框架
AI.method: 扩展2×2严格序数博弈分类学，采用蒙特卡洛框架分析3×3博弈情况
AI.findings: 1) 2×2博弈存在特殊战略特性，但在更大规模标准形式博弈中不成立；2) 先手权的两种主要形式中，先发制人比承诺更具优势；3) 先手价值可能随行动方案数量增加而降低
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了博弈论分类体系，首次在军事理论中识别先发制人的战略优势
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者和实践者提供了计算边界参考，对军事战略决策具有指导意义

title: E-commerce Reshapes Tax Competition: U-shaped Tax Rates with Respect to Populations

detail.title: E-commerce Reshapes Tax Competition: U-shaped Tax Rates with Respect to Populations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Number 24KJ0584.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a model of commodity tax competition with e-commerce and shows that local tax rates can have a non-monotonic relationship with regional populations. Previous studies on tax competition present a monotonic relationship in which regions with larger populations impose higher tax rates. In reality, however, this monotonic relationship between tax rates and populations sometimes fails to apply. We formulate tax competition with a cross-border shopping model among three regions. In the absence of e-commerce, the monotonic and positive relationship between tax rates and populations is observed as in prior research. In contrast, when online shopping via e-commerce is available, local tax rates can be non-monotonic with respect to populations. To be more precise, the relationship between tax rates and population sizes follows a U-shaped curve. The region with the moderate population has the lowest tax rate, while areas with small or large populations set higher tax rates. This result holds no matter how advanced and widespread e-commerce is. The U-shaped relationship is caused by two effects of e-commerce: changing tax bases and intensifying tax competition. The presence and availability of e-commerce reshape tax competition.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了包含电子商务的商品税竞争模型，发现地方税率与区域人口规模呈U型关系，而非传统研究中的单调正相关关系。中等人口规模地区税率最低，小规模和大规模人口地区税率较高。
AI.research_question: 电子商务如何影响地区间商品税竞争？地方税率与人口规模的关系在电子商务环境下是否发生变化？
AI.motivation: 传统税收竞争理论认为人口规模与税率呈单调正相关，但现实中这种关系有时不成立。电子商务的兴起可能改变了税收竞争格局，需要新的理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于跨境购物模型的税收竞争理论，结合电子商务对消费者购物行为的影响。
AI.method: 构建三地区跨境购物税收竞争模型，分别分析无电子商务和有电子商务两种情况下的税率设定策略。
AI.findings: 无电子商务时，税率与人口规模呈单调正相关；有电子商务时，税率与人口规模呈U型关系，中等人口地区税率最低。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了电子商务环境下税收竞争的新理论框架，解释了税率与人口规模的U型关系，丰富了税收竞争理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了电子商务时代税收政策制定的理论依据，有助于理解不同规模地区的最优税率设定策略。

title: Robo-Advisors Beyond Automation: Principles and Roadmap for AI-Driven Financial Planning
affiliations: Tsinghua University, Gordon S Lang School of Business and Economics, University of Guelph, Guelph, Canada - Department of Economics and Finance and Guizhou University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Robo-Advisors Beyond Automation: Principles and Roadmap for AI-Driven Financial Planning
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming financial planning by expanding access, lowering costs, and enabling dynamic, data-driven advice. Yet without clear safeguards, digital platforms risk reproducing longstanding market inefficiencies such as information asymmetry, misaligned incentives, and systemic fragility. This paper develops a framework for responsible AI in financial planning, anchored in five principles: fiduciary duty, adaptive personalization, technical robustness, ethical and fairness constraints, and auditability. We illustrate these risks and opportunities through case studies, and extend the framework into a five-level roadmap of AI financial intermediaries. By linking technological design to economic theory, we show how AI can either amplify vulnerabilities or create more resilient, trustworthy forms of financial intermediation.

AI.tldr: AI在财务规划中既带来机遇也带来风险，本文提出了负责任AI的五原则框架和五级路线图，通过案例研究展示了AI如何放大脆弱性或创造更稳健的金融中介形式。
AI.research_question: 如何构建负责任的AI框架来确保金融规划中的人工智能既能发挥优势又能避免市场低效问题？
AI.motivation: AI正在改变财务规划，但缺乏明确保障措施的数字平台可能重现信息不对称、激励错配和系统脆弱性等长期存在的市场低效问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合技术设计与经济理论，分析AI如何放大脆弱性或创造更稳健的金融中介形式，重点关注市场效率理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，通过具体案例展示AI在金融规划中的风险和机遇。
AI.findings: 提出了基于五大原则（受托责任、自适应个性化、技术稳健性、伦理公平约束、可审计性）的负责任AI框架，并延伸为五级AI金融中介路线图。
AI.theory_contributions: 将技术设计与经济理论联系起来，为AI在金融中介领域的应用提供了理论框架和分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技公司和监管机构提供了具体的实施路线图和操作原则，帮助构建更可信赖的AI金融中介系统。

detail.abstract: This article examines Title IV of Colombia's 1991 Political Constitution, dedicated to democratic participation and political parties, based on Amartya Sen's theoretical framework on instrumental freedoms. It analyzes the extent to which constitutional articles guarantee political freedoms, economic facilities, social opportunities, transparency, and protective security. From the notions of agency and choice, it reflects on the real scope of democratic participation in promoting development and equity in the country.

AI.findings: 分析宪法条款在保障各种工具性自由方面的具体表现和程度

title: cNGN Stablecoin, Nigeria's Macroeconomic Challenges and Monetary Sovereignty
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: cNGN Stablecoin, Nigeria's Macroeconomic Challenges and Monetary Sovereignty
detail.abstract: Nigeria's stablecoin experiment began with the official launch of cNGN in February 2025. As a stablecoin pegged to the Naira, Nigeria's official currency, cNGN was designed to serve two purposes: a payment tool for domestic and cross-border remittance, and a financial instrument for yield on decentralized platforms like Xend Finance. This dual purpose stablecoin model prompts two macroeconomic questions: one, should stablecoins be pegged to highly volatile local currencies if their purpose is to hedge against volatile cryptocurrencies priced in USD? And two, should stablecoins be financialized to produce yield or interest incentivizing adoption at the expense of local commercial banks? This paper explores the connection between cNGN and Nigeria's macroeconomic challenges. It highlights the sovereignty gaps in its design and questions its ongoing financialization.

AI.tldr: 尼日利亚cNGN稳定币实验存在主权设计缺陷和过度金融化问题，其与高波动本币挂钩的模式可能无法有效对冲加密货币风险，且可能损害商业银行体系。
AI.research_question: 稳定币是否应该与高波动性的本币挂钩？稳定币是否应该被金融化以产生收益，从而以牺牲本地商业银行为代价来激励采用？
AI.motivation: 分析尼日利亚cNGN稳定币实验与宏观经济挑战的联系，揭示其设计中的主权缺口并质疑其持续的金融化趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稳定币经济学、货币政策理论、金融主权理论、数字货币监管框架
AI.method: 案例分析法，通过对尼日利亚cNGN稳定币实验的实证分析，结合宏观经济指标和金融监管政策进行综合评估。
AI.findings: cNGN与高波动性奈拉挂钩的设计存在根本性矛盾，无法有效对冲加密货币风险；金融化设计可能削弱商业银行体系，产生系统性风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了稳定币设计中的"主权缺口"概念，丰富了数字货币与宏观经济稳定性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场国家设计央行数字货币和稳定币提供了重要警示，强调了金融主权保护和商业银行体系稳定的重要性。

title: Automatic IT governance in cloud computing its risk and compliance
affiliations: Universitat de Balearic Island

detail.title: Automatic IT governance in cloud computing its risk and compliance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declare that there is no conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Satisfied with ethical resources
declarations.funderStatement: No

detail.abstract:
Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) automation is critical for organizations adopting cloud computing due to increasing regulatory requirements and cybersecurity threats. Manual GRC processes are inefficient, error-prone, and difficult to adapt to dynamic cloud environments. Compliance monitoring, this study explores the integration of ServiceNow's GRC platform with the NIST Cyber Framework (CSF) to automate risk assessment and policy enforcement. It presents a case study that shows how this integration improves audit readiness, reduces compliance violations, and increases real-time risk visibility. Key findings indicate a 40% reduction in manual effort and a 30% faster incident response through automation. The paper concludes with recommendations for future improvements, including AI-driven predictive risk analysis.

The adoption of cloud computing has created complexities in managing governance, risk and compliance (GRC) due to shared responsibility models and evolving regulations (e.g. GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2). Traditional manual GRC processes are slow, inconsistent, fail to provide real-time insights, and increase organizational risk.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了ServiceNow GRC平台与NIST网络安全框架的集成，通过自动化风险评估和政策执行，实现了40%的人工工作量减少和30%的事件响应速度提升。
AI.research_question: 如何通过ServiceNow GRC平台与NIST网络安全框架的集成来自动化云环境中的治理、风险和合规管理？
AI.motivation: 云计算采用带来了GRC管理的复杂性，传统手动流程效率低下、容易出错，无法适应动态云环境，且难以满足日益增长的监管要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于NIST网络安全框架(CSF)的理论基础，结合ServiceNow GRC平台的自动化能力。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，分析ServiceNow GRC平台与NIST CSF框架的集成实施效果。
AI.findings: 集成实施后实现了40%人工工作量减少、30%事件响应速度提升，改善了审计准备度，减少了合规违规，提高了实时风险可见性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于NIST CSF框架的GRC自动化理论模型，为云环境下的合规管理提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了可操作的GRC自动化实施方案，通过ServiceNow平台集成显著提升了合规效率和风险管理能力。

title: The True Puzzle of Finance: Unpredictability
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The True Puzzle of Finance: Unpredictability
detail.abstract: We have been wrong from the start. The question is not whether markets are predictable, but why they are not. Contrary to a common misconception, theoretical finance does not ban predictability: rationality and efficiency are intimidating notions, not impenetrable ones. Standard models even accommodate limited "crystal balls. " In theory, a range of psychological, cultural, institutional, and even existential factors should generate partial predictability. Yet the empirical record repeatedly fails to validate this intuition. This article clarifies two forms of predictability admitted by theory-one durable because it compensates risk, one fleeting because it is anomalous-then details why, despite multiple reasons to expect foresight, markets remain stubbornly unpredictable in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了市场可预测性的传统观点，指出理论金融并不完全禁止可预测性，但实证证据却显示市场在实践中保持顽固的不可预测性。
AI.research_question: 为什么金融市场在实践中保持不可预测性，尽管理论模型允许有限的可预测性？
AI.motivation: 纠正关于市场可预测性的常见误解，澄清理论金融实际上允许一定程度的可预测性，但实证记录却无法验证这种直觉。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性与效率理论、风险补偿理论、异常收益理论，以及心理、文化、制度和存在主义因素对市场可预测性的影响。
AI.method: 理论分析与文献综述，区分理论允许的两种可预测性形式：基于风险补偿的持久可预测性和基于异常的短暂可预测性。
AI.findings: 尽管理论模型承认多种因素可能导致部分可预测性，但实证证据一致显示市场在实践中保持不可预测性。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了理论金融对可预测性的真实立场，区分了两种不同类型的可预测性，并解释了理论与实证之间的差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和从业者提供了对市场可预测性局限性的更准确理解，有助于制定更现实的投资策略。

title: Agricultural Insurance Systems in Developed and Emerging Economies: Lessons from the USA, the EU, and India
affiliations: Glasgow Caledonian University and Glasgow Caledonian University

detail.title: Agricultural Insurance Systems in Developed and Emerging Economies: Lessons from the USA, the EU, and India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: As climate change intensifies agricultural risks worldwide, crop insurance has become a central mechanism for safeguarding farmer livelihoods and strengthening food security. Developed economies such as the United States and the European Union have established distinct but mature systems: the U.S. Federal Crop Insurance Program (FCIP), a subsidydriven public-private partnership, and the EU's Common Agricultural Policy (CAP), which embeds risk management within a broader framework of income support and environmental sustainability. Using India as a case study, this paper examines how emerging economies have sought to adapt these models through hybrid approaches such as the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY). The analysis finds that while subsidies, public-private partnerships, and technological innovations are common features, challenges of fiscal sustainability, administrative efficiency, and equitable coverage remain unresolved. The study cautions against direct replication of developed-country models, arguing instead for adaptive frameworks that balance affordability, inclusivity, and longterm resilience. It concludes with recommendations for hybrid, context-sensitive approaches-combining targeted subsidies, parametric instruments, and community-based schemes-that better align agricultural insurance design with the fiscal realities and institutional capacities of emerging nations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过印度PMFBY案例研究，分析了新兴经济体如何借鉴美欧成熟农业保险模式，发现虽然补贴、公私合作和技术创新是共同特征，但财政可持续性、行政效率和公平覆盖等挑战仍未解决。研究建议采用结合定向补贴、参数化工具和社区计划的混合适应性框架。
AI.research_question: 新兴经济体如何适应和借鉴发达国家的农业保险模式，以应对气候变化带来的农业风险？
AI.motivation: 气候变化加剧全球农业风险，农业保险成为保障农民生计和粮食安全的核心机制，需要研究新兴经济体如何有效借鉴发达国家成熟经验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于比较制度分析和适应性治理理论，分析不同农业保险模式（美国FCIP的补贴驱动公私合作模式 vs 欧盟CAP的收入支持和环境可持续性框架）的制度特征。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以印度Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)项目为研究对象，进行模式比较和适应性分析。
AI.findings: 虽然补贴、公私合作和技术创新是共同特征，但财政可持续性、行政效率和公平覆盖等挑战在新兴经济体中仍未解决，直接复制发达国家模式不可行。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了适应性框架理论，强调农业保险设计需要平衡可负担性、包容性和长期韧性，为新兴经济体的制度适配提供理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出混合式、情境敏感的方法建议，包括定向补贴、参数化工具和社区计划相结合，更好地匹配新兴国家的财政现实和制度能力。

title: AIPPI-SQ293-Compulsory Licensing for Patents – State of Play from a German Perspective
affiliations: Bundesgerichtshof (Federal Court of Justice), George Washington University, Noerr PartG mbB, Quinn Emanuel Urquhart & Sullivan LLP, Leibniz Universität Hannover and Kather Augenstein

detail.title: AIPPI-SQ293-Compulsory Licensing for Patents – State of Play from a German Perspective
detail.abstract:
The authors present key responses of the German group to the AIPPI to study question 293. The main conclusions can be summarized as follows:

- Historically, compulsory licence law played a decisive role in the development of patent law.

- The grounds for compulsory licensing should be divided into those based on the innovation economy and those based on other interests. In principle, the innovation economy relies on licences being freely negotiated and the patentee determining how their invention is practiced. The right to exclude others from practicing the patented invention sits at the very core of the inventor’s intellectual property right. Besides antitrust reasons, a compulsory licence may only be granted to foster the innovation economy, that is a refusal to licence would result in the patented technology or the technology of another patent – the latter under the provisions of art. 31(l) TRIPS – not being used.

- Other grounds of public interest must, in terms of quality or quantity, be of such weight that they justify a restriction of the inventor's intellectual property. They are not limited as to their nature and may have various causes, such as national emergencies, health crises, and other severe events. 

- Compulsory licences are generally not necessary for patent applications to the extent they do not confer any exclusionary rights. This could only be different in very exceptional cases in which investments into the use of a technology are so significant and the lead time until the use so long that the mere prospect of the grant of the application deters such investments and effectively renders a compulsory licence to the granted patent meaningless.

- Harmonisation of the law on compulsory licences is desirable, in particular to enable such licences to be granted for manufacture in one country for export to another country where the reason for the compulsory licence exists.

- The compulsory licence under sec. 24(6) GPA must be limited in scope and duration so far as justified by the overriding public interest. Such limitations may relate to time, purpose, quantity, territory, or products. Termination is possible once the overriding interest has ceased and is unlikely to recur, in cases of serious breaches by the licensee, or upon revocation or lapse of the patent.

- Compulsory licences are generally not sublicensable to maintain the patentee’s control over their invention to the extent possible. In exceptional cases in which the invention needs to be practiced by multiple parties (very complex products or methods requiring complex supply chains, for example), the availability of sublicences if preferable over each of these parties having to obtain their own compulsory licence, however. In case of dependent inventions, there is no reason to restrict the owner of the dependent patent from monetizing that patent differently than normal, i.e. not allowing them to grant sublicensable licences.

- The licence seeker is not barred from challenging the validity of the patent through nullity or opposition proceedings. This corresponds to the situation in FRAND cases, where implementers may also contest validity while at the same time negotiating a licence. Given the comparable interests in both settings, such a parallel approach is justified. The decisive difference, however, is that the antitrust obligations established in SEP case law do not apply to compulsory licences.

- Reasonable remuneration can generally be determined based on a licence analogy taking into consideration that the nature of a compulsory licence regularly warrants an increase of the royalty rates compared to a freely negotiated licence. Particularly in the case of a patentee who has taken high investment risks in developing his invention and plans to market the patented product alone, it is also necessary to compensate for the loss of monopoly profits in the event of a compulsory licence.

- Even though compulsory licences are rarely actually granted, compulsory licence law is economically significant. It defines which licences would have to be granted ultima ratio if they were not agreed voluntarily, and thus serves as an important, invisible guideline for such transactions. At the same time, it acknowledges the patent system’s importance in society and broader legal system by equating it with other societal and legal interests. This serves the constructive, peaceful and prosperous coexistence of different legal instruments and public and private interests.

AI.tldr: 德国专家组对AIPPI研究问题293的关键回应，系统阐述了强制许可制度的理论基础、适用条件、限制因素和经济效益，强调强制许可作为最后手段在专利法体系中的重要性。
AI.research_question: 专利强制许可制度的理论基础、适用条件和实践意义是什么？
AI.motivation: 回应AIPPI研究问题293，系统分析强制许可制度在专利法体系中的地位和作用，为国际专利制度的协调提供理论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识产权理论、创新经济学和公共利益平衡理论，构建强制许可制度的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论分析和法律解释方法，结合TRIPS协议和德国专利法的相关规定进行系统性分析。
AI.findings: 强制许可应分为基于创新经济和其他公共利益两类；适用范围应严格限制；许可条件需要合理设定；制度具有重要的经济指导意义。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了强制许可制度的系统理论框架，明确了其在不同利益平衡中的定位和作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国专利立法和实践提供了具体的操作指南，促进了国际专利制度的协调统一。

title: Environmental Stewardship: Community Relations in Addressing Oil Spills Across Africa's Oil-Producing Nations - Spotlight on Nigeria
affiliations: Bayero University, Kano and Benue State University, Makurdi, Nigeria

detail.title: Environmental Stewardship: Community Relations in Addressing Oil Spills Across Africa's Oil-Producing Nations - Spotlight on Nigeria
detail.abstract: Environmental stewardship plays a crucial role in addressing oil spills and conflicts in Africa's oil-producing nations, particularly in Nigeria. This study aimed to examine conflict occurrences in selected Niger Delta communities related to oil exploration by Agip, assess the causes and consequences of these conflicts on the communities and oil companies, identify community relations strategies used for conflict resolution, and evaluate the effectiveness of these approaches in addressing oil spillages. The study employed Conflict Theory, Social Atavistic Conflict Theory, and Stakeholder Theory, and utilized a survey method to gather data from five selected communities. The findings revealed varying perceptions of conflict occurrences, with Shell, Agip, and Chevron identified as key players. The causes of conflicts were attributed to factors such as government representation by oil companies, infrastructure deficiencies, and political influences. The study highlighted serious implications for both communities and oil companies, including neglect, security concerns, and low productivity. Oil companies employed various community relations strategies, with Shell and Chevron utilizing dialogues, government partnerships, and community initiatives. However, the communities preferred transparency, consultation, and provision of amenities from oil companies. Based on the findings, the study recommends actions to address conflict triggers, enhance community awareness, improve community relations strategies, reduce military presence, provide skill training, and foster government cooperation for holistic development in the Niger Delta. Overall, fostering transparent communication, mutual respect, and sustainable partnerships between oil companies, communities, and governments are pivotal for environmental stewardship and community wellbeing in oil-producing regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨尼日利亚尼日尔三角洲地区石油勘探冲突，分析冲突原因后果，评估社区关系策略有效性，提出改善环境管理和社区福祉的建议。
AI.research_question: 尼日尔三角洲社区与Agip石油勘探相关的冲突发生情况、原因后果、社区关系策略及其在解决石油泄漏问题中的有效性
AI.motivation: 环境管理在处理非洲产油国特别是尼日利亚的石油泄漏和冲突中至关重要，需要研究冲突解决策略的有效性
AI.theoretical_framework: 冲突理论、社会返祖冲突理论、利益相关者理论
AI.method: 调查方法，从五个选定社区收集数据
AI.findings: 冲突发生认知存在差异，Shell、Agip和Chevron是关键参与者；冲突原因包括政府代表、基础设施不足和政治影响；对社区和石油公司都有严重影响；石油公司采用对话、政府合作等策略，但社区更希望透明度和咨询
AI.theory_contributions: 将冲突理论、社会返祖冲突理论和利益相关者理论应用于石油冲突分析，为环境管理和社区关系研究提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出解决冲突触发因素、增强社区意识、改善社区关系策略、减少军事存在、提供技能培训等具体建议，促进石油公司、社区和政府之间的透明沟通和可持续合作

title: Good Carry Trades and Market Dynamics
affiliations: Tamagawa University and Hokkaido University

detail.title: Good Carry Trades and Market Dynamics
detail.abstract: This study investigates the return sources of good carry trades. We find that the profitability of most good carry trades is linked to investors' overconfidence in the currency market. Good carry trades depend on both public and private signals. When the direction of the past market conditions aligns with that of subsequent market conditions, the effects of investors' private signals are amplified. In contrast, the profitability of standard carry trades is not explained by the overconfidence model, suggesting that the drivers of good carry trade profitability differ from those of standard carry trades. We also demonstrate that overconfidence also affects the cross-sectional currency momentum portfolio, while good carry portfolios provide unique information separate from the momentum portfolio. The alphas of good carry portfolios remain statistically significant even after controlling for the momentum, standard carry, value, and dollar carry factors.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨优质套利交易的收益来源，发现其盈利能力与投资者在外汇市场的过度自信相关，而标准套利交易的盈利无法用过度自信模型解释。优质套利组合在控制动量、标准套利、价值和美元套利因子后仍保持显著阿尔法收益。
AI.research_question: 优质套利交易的收益来源是什么？其盈利能力是否与投资者的过度自信行为相关？
AI.motivation: 传统套利交易研究主要关注标准套利策略，但对优质套利交易的特殊收益来源缺乏深入理解，需要探究行为金融因素在其中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资者过度自信理论，认为投资者对私有信息的过度自信会影响外汇市场的定价效率，从而产生套利机会。
AI.method: 采用实证分析方法，构建优质套利组合和标准套利组合，检验过度自信模型对两者盈利能力的解释力，并进行多因子回归分析。
AI.findings: 优质套利交易的盈利能力与投资者过度自信显著相关，私有信号在市场条件一致时效应放大；标准套利交易盈利不受过度自信影响；优质套利组合提供独立于动量组合的独特信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将过度自信理论应用于优质套利交易研究，揭示了行为金融因素在外汇套利中的重要作用，丰富了套利交易的理论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了识别真正优质套利机会的行为金融视角，帮助区分基于过度自信的暂时性收益和可持续的结构性套利机会，提升投资决策效果。

title: Multi-Dimensional Matching with Verifiable Information
affiliations: Institute of Economics, Academia Sinica

detail.title: Multi-Dimensional Matching with Verifiable Information
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes matching markets where agents have multi-dimensional private characteristics they can strategically disclose through verifiable evidence. I establish a general necessary and sufficient condition for any matching to be implementable and ex post stable, showing that a strong form of complementarity, conditioned on the sorting pattern, is indispensable. In linear-quadratic settings, the condition reduces to a simple matrix definiteness test, providing a tractable criterion for implementation. I then apply these results to show that while classic unraveling fails in multi-dimensional settings, the socially optimal matching in a Gaussian model is always implementable, and I identify conditions under which multi-dimensional positive assortative matching is implementable.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了多维特征匹配市场，建立了可实施性和事后稳定性的充要条件，发现在线性二次和高斯模型中社会最优匹配总是可实施的。
AI.research_question: 在多维特征匹配市场中，哪些匹配是可实施且事后稳定的？
AI.motivation: 传统匹配理论主要关注单维特征，而现实世界中代理人往往具有多维可验证特征，需要研究多维特征下的匹配机制设计问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于匹配市场理论和机制设计理论，特别关注多维特征下的可验证信息披露和稳定性条件。
AI.method: 建立一般性的理论框架，推导充要条件；在线性二次设定中简化为矩阵正定性检验；在高斯模型中进行具体应用分析。
AI.findings: 1) 建立了多维匹配可实施性的充要条件，需要基于排序模式的强互补性；2) 在线性二次设定中条件简化为矩阵正定性检验；3) 社会最优匹配在高斯模型中总是可实施；4) 识别了多维正分类匹配可实施的条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了匹配理论到多维特征场景，提供了多维匹配可实施性的系统分析框架，揭示了传统单维结果在多维环境中的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际匹配市场设计提供了理论指导，特别是在需要多维特征验证的场景（如教育匹配、就业市场等）中具有应用价值。

title: Underreporting of AI Use: The Role of Social Desirability Bias
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics, University of Chicago - Department of Computer Science and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Underreporting of AI Use: The Role of Social Desirability Bias
detail.abstract: Rapid integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into work and educational settings challenges organizations to gauge and respond to adoption rates. However, most measures of AI adoption come from self-reported surveys, producing estimates of AI use that disagree by up to 40 percentage points within the same setting. We investigate whether social desirability bias-the tendency to answer surveys in ways that would be viewed favorably by an outside party-can explain this discrepancy. Surveying 338 university students, we assess potential social desirability bias using a method from psychology, indirect questioning: students report both their own AI use and that of their peers. We find a significant gap, with approximately 60% of students reporting that they use AI compared to 90% of their peers. Through qualitative analysis of student explanations for this gap, we conclude that social desirability bias is a key driver of mis-measurement, causing underestimates of AI adoption in educational settings.

AI.tldr: 研究发现社会期望偏差导致AI采用率测量误差：学生自报AI使用率约60%，但认为同龄人使用率达90%，表明自报数据低估了教育环境中AI的实际采用率
AI.research_question: 社会期望偏差是否能解释AI采用率测量中的差异？
AI.motivation: AI在工作教育环境中快速集成，但自报调查得出的AI使用率估计在同一环境中差异高达40个百分点，需要探究测量不一致的原因
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会期望偏差理论 - 受访者倾向于以外部认可的方式回答调查问题
AI.method: 对338名大学生进行调查，采用心理学间接提问法：学生报告自己和他人的AI使用情况，并进行定性分析
AI.findings: 发现显著差距：约60%学生自报使用AI，但认为90%的同龄人使用AI；定性分析确认社会期望偏差是测量误差的关键驱动因素
AI.theory_contributions: 证实社会期望偏差在技术采用测量中的重要作用，为AI采用研究提供理论解释框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供更准确的AI采用率测量方法建议，帮助制定更有效的AI集成策略

title: LLM-Based Instance-Driven Heuristic Bias In the Context of a Biased Random Key Genetic Algorithm
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence Research Institute (IIIA-CSIC), University of Concepción, Universidad de Concepción and IIIA-CSIC

detail.title: LLM-Based Instance-Driven Heuristic Bias In the Context of a Biased Random Key Genetic Algorithm
detail.abstract: Integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) within metaheuristics opens a novel path for solving complex combinatorial optimization problems. While most existing approaches leverage LLMs for code generation to create or refine specific heuristics, they often overlook the structural properties of individual problem instances. In this work, we introduce a novel framework that integrates LLMs with a Biased Random-Key Genetic Algorithm (BRKGA) to solve the NP-hard Longest Run Subsequence problem. Our approach extends the instance-driven heuristic bias paradigm by introducing a human-LLM collaborative process to co-design and implement a set of computationally efficient metrics. The LLM analyzes these instance-specific metrics to generate a tailored heuristic bias, which steers the BRKGA toward promising areas of the search space. We conduct a comprehensive experimental evaluation, including rigorous statistical tests, convergence and behavioral analyses, and targeted ablation studies, comparing our method against a standard BRKGA baseline across 1,050 generated instances of varying complexity. Results show that our top-performing hybrid, BRKGA+Llama-4-Maverick, achieves statistically significant improvements over the baseline, particularly on the most complex instances. Our findings confirm that leveraging an LLM to produce an a priori, instance-driven heuristic bias is a valuable approach for enhancing metaheuristics in complex optimization domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个将大语言模型与BRKGA算法结合的框架，通过人机协作设计实例特定指标，让LLM生成定制化启发式偏置来指导算法搜索，在最长运行子序列问题上取得了显著改进
AI.research_question: 如何有效整合大语言模型与元启发式算法来解决复杂组合优化问题，特别是如何利用LLM分析问题实例的结构特性来生成定制化的启发式偏置
AI.motivation: 现有方法大多利用LLM进行代码生成来创建或改进特定启发式，但往往忽略了单个问题实例的结构特性，需要一种能够针对具体实例生成定制化启发式偏置的方法
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于实例驱动的启发式偏置范式，结合大语言模型的分析能力和BRKGA算法的搜索能力，构建人机协作的启发式设计框架
AI.method: 提出人机协作过程共同设计和实现计算高效指标，LLM分析这些实例特定指标生成定制化启发式偏置，指导BRKGA算法向有希望的搜索空间区域探索
AI.findings: 在1,050个不同复杂度的生成实例上，最佳混合方法BRKGA+Llama-4-Maverick相比标准BRKGA基线取得了统计显著的改进，特别是在最复杂的实例上表现尤为突出
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了实例驱动的启发式偏置范式，提出了人机协作的启发式设计理论框架，为大语言模型在组合优化中的应用提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个实用的框架，能够有效整合LLM与元启发式算法，在复杂优化领域中显著提升算法性能，为解决NP难问题提供了新的技术路径

title: Family, Neighborhood, and the Architecture of Opportunity: A Game-Theoretic and Category-Theoretic Rejoinder to Heckman and Eshaghnia

detail.title: Family, Neighborhood, and the Architecture of Opportunity: A Game-Theoretic and Category-Theoretic Rejoinder to Heckman and Eshaghnia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: The debate over whether family or neighborhood constitutes the primary determinant of intergenerational mobility has long animated both social science research and public policy. James J. Heckman and Sadegh Eshaghnia's recent essay in the Wall Street Journal (2025), "ZIP Code Is Destiny? Turns Out That's Bunk," reasserts the primacy of family, arguing that widely circulated claims of neighborhood causality-particularly those advanced by Raj Chetty and Nathaniel Hendren-rest on flawed assumptions and misidentified causal structures. While Heckman and Eshaghnia rightly underscore the importance of family dynamics, their near dismissal of neighborhood effects suffers from econometric reductionism and an inadequate account of systemic interdependence. This paper offers a rejoinder. Drawing on the technical apparatus of game theory and category theory, I show that families and neighborhoods cannot be treated as separable determinants of mobility. From a game-theoretic perspective, neighborhood sorting is not an exogenous reflection of family quality but the endogenous outcome of equilibrium dynamics under incomplete information and strategic interaction. From a category-theoretic perspective, the causal morphisms linking family states, neighborhood structures, and child outcomes compose not as independent arrows but as enriched functors with nontrivial interdependencies. Empirically, these frameworks suggest that neighborhood effects are not mere artifacts of self-selection but emergent properties of stratified equilibria. The rejoinder recalibrates the policy implications: interventions must operate at the joint interface of family and neighborhood, shifting equilibrium dynamics and addressing braided causal morphisms, rather than privileging one domain to the exclusion of the other.

AI.tldr: 本文反驳Heckman和Eshaghnia关于家庭因素主导代际流动性的观点，运用博弈论和范畴论证明家庭与社区是不可分割的因果关系系统，主张政策干预需要同时关注家庭和社区两个层面的相互作用。
AI.research_question: 家庭和社区在代际流动性中各自扮演什么角色？它们之间是否存在不可分割的因果关系？
AI.motivation: 回应Heckman和Eshaghnia在华尔街日报文章中过度强调家庭因素而几乎否定社区影响的立场，指出其计量经济学简化主义的局限性
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论（不完全信息和策略互动的均衡动态）和范畴论（因果关系形态的非平凡相互依赖）
AI.method: 理论框架构建和概念分析，运用博弈论和范畴论工具重新概念化家庭与社区的因果关系
AI.findings: 社区效应不是自我选择的伪象，而是分层均衡的涌现属性；家庭和社区不能作为分离的决定因素处理
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了整合博弈论和范畴论的分析框架，揭示了家庭与社区因果关系的系统性相互依赖本质
AI.practical_contributions: 重新校准政策含义：干预措施需要在家庭和社区的联合界面上运作，改变均衡动态，而不是偏重某一个领域

title: Rethinking Measures of Sentiment: A New Approach

detail.title: Rethinking Measures of Sentiment: A New Approach
detail.abstract: I argue that valid measures of investor sentiment must satisfy additional conditions beyond conventional return predictability tests to imply sentiment-induced misvaluation. Specifically, both positive and negative sentiments should explain returns and volatility contemporaneously, and forecast returns. I show that several well-known sentiment indexes fail to fully meet these necessary conditions and introduce three new empirical indexes that perform better. These proposed measures demonstrate superior predictive power for returns both in-sample and out-of-sample, particularly over longer horizons; and survive the inclusion of non-sentiment variables known to predict returns. Further evidence shows that their robust forecasting ability extends to broader financial outcomes, including changes in flows to actively-managed equity mutual funds, the VIX, and credit spreads.

AI.tldr: 本文提出有效的投资者情绪测量指标需要满足超越传统收益预测测试的额外条件，包括正负情绪都应能同时解释收益和波动性，并能预测未来收益。研究发现多个知名情绪指数未能完全满足这些必要条件，并提出了三个新的实证指数，这些新指标在样本内和样本外都表现出更优越的预测能力，特别是在较长的时间范围内。
AI.research_question: 什么是有效的投资者情绪测量指标的必要条件？现有情绪指数是否满足这些条件？如何构建更好的情绪测量指标？
AI.motivation: 传统投资者情绪测量方法主要依赖收益预测测试，但这种方法可能不足以识别真正的情绪驱动错误定价，需要更严格的条件来验证情绪指标的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为金融学理论，特别是投资者情绪导致资产错误定价的理论框架，强调情绪指标应该能够同时解释正负情绪对市场的影响。
AI.method: 实证分析方法，通过检验现有情绪指数的表现，提出新的情绪测量指标构建方法，并进行样本内和样本外的预测能力测试。
AI.findings: 多个知名情绪指数未能完全满足有效情绪测量的必要条件，而提出的三个新情绪指数在收益预测方面表现更优，特别是在长期预测中，并且能够预测更广泛的金融结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了有效投资者情绪测量指标的必要条件理论框架，为情绪指标的构建和验证提供了更严格的理论标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了三个新的实证情绪指数，这些指数具有更好的预测能力，可用于投资决策、风险管理和市场监控等实际应用。

title: The Extended Phenotype of Populism: A Memetic Analysis of Policy Persistence in Latin America

detail.title: The Extended Phenotype of Populism: A Memetic Analysis of Policy Persistence in Latin America

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently without institutional affiliation or external influence.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study analyzes publicly available electoral data and historical policy records. No human participants were involved in this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted as independent scholarly work.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a novel theoretical framework applying Dawkins's extended phenotype concept and memetic theory to explain the differential reproductive success of populist versus liberal policy "memes" in Latin America. We argue that populist policies function as extended phenotypes-environmental modifications that persist beyond their creators-while exhibiting superior memetic fitness through cognitive simplicity, immediate gratification, and cultural compatibility. Through theoretical modeling, we derive a memetic fitness function predicting a 216:1 reproductive advantage for populist over liberal memes in the Argentine ecosystem. The analysis reveals that populism operates as an Evolutionarily Stable Strategy (ESS) resistant to liberal "invasion," while liberalism remains vulnerable to populist resurgence. We identify five mechanisms of populist persistence: (1) institutional niche construction, (2) dependency architecture, (3) cognitive optimization, (4) emotional engagement systems, and (5) immunological narrative defenses. Historical analysis of Argentina (1946-2025) demonstrates that no liberal government has completed a full reproductive cycle (8-10 years), while populist structures exhibit multi-generational persistence. Early empirical validation from the September 2025 Buenos Aires provincial elections confirms theoretical predictions about hybrid strategy instability and the reassertion of populist dominance when liberal memes lose fitness advantages. The paper introduces RootFinder, an open-source computational methodology for tracking policy genealogies and institutional evolution. This framework contributes to understanding why certain political systems exhibit remarkable stability despite poor economic outcomes, bridging evolutionary biology, memetics, and political economy. Replication materials available at: https://github.com/adrianlerer/RootFinder-Production

AI.tldr: 本文应用道金斯的延伸表型概念和模因理论，建立了分析拉美民粹主义政策模因比自由主义政策模因更具繁殖优势的理论框架，预测民粹主义模因在阿根廷生态中具有216:1的繁殖优势，并识别了五种民粹主义持久机制。
AI.research_question: 为什么民粹主义政策模因在拉丁美洲比自由主义政策模因具有更强的繁殖成功和持久性？
AI.motivation: 解释某些政治体系在经济表现不佳的情况下仍能保持显著稳定性的现象，特别是拉美地区民粹主义政策的持久存在与自由主义政策的脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道金斯的延伸表型概念、模因理论、进化稳定策略(ESS)理论
AI.method: 理论建模构建模因适应度函数，阿根廷历史分析(1946-2025)，布宜诺斯艾利斯省选举的实证验证，开发RootFinder计算方法
AI.findings: 民粹主义模因在阿根廷生态中具有216:1的繁殖优势，民粹主义是进化稳定策略，自由主义政府从未完成完整繁殖周期(8-10年)，民粹结构表现出多代持久性
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了连接进化生物学、模因理论和政治经济学的理论框架，提出了政策模因适应度函数，识别了民粹主义持久性的五种机制
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了RootFinder开源计算方法用于追踪政策谱系和制度演变，为理解政治稳定性提供新工具，对政策制定者有实践启示

title: Prefix-Based Collection Auction: A Mechanism against Market Power and Collusion
affiliations: Independent Scholar and Independent Researcher

detail.title: Prefix-Based Collection Auction: A Mechanism against Market Power and Collusion
detail.abstract: We introduce a new auction mechanism for selling multiple identical items to a single winner-the Prefix-Based Collection Auction. In this format, the winner is restricted to a contiguous prefix of their bids, and the payment rule follows a strategyproof (DSIC) second-price design. The prefix structure provides strong protection against both market power and bidder collusion, while preserving intuitive and fair bidding behavior. The mechanism is robust, simple to implement, and has potential applications in art-collection markets, digital advertising, and other settings where the value of ownership depends on controlling an entire collection.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的拍卖机制——基于前缀的收藏拍卖，用于向单一赢家销售多个相同物品。该机制限制赢家只能获得其出价的前缀部分，采用策略证明的第二价格支付规则，具有抗市场操纵和投标人合谋的强保护特性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种既能防止市场操纵和投标人合谋，又能保持直观公平投标行为的多个相同物品拍卖机制？
AI.motivation: 传统多物品拍卖机制容易受到市场力量和投标人合谋的影响，需要一种更稳健的机制来保护拍卖的公平性和效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于拍卖理论、机制设计和策略证明（DSIC）原理，结合前缀约束和二级价格支付规则构建理论框架。
AI.method: 设计前缀约束的拍卖机制，赢家只能获得连续前缀的物品，采用策略证明的第二价格支付设计。
AI.findings: 该机制提供了对市场力量和投标人合谋的强保护，同时保持了直观公平的投标行为，具有鲁棒性和易于实施的特点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了前缀约束拍卖的新理论框架，扩展了多物品拍卖机制的设计空间，为抗操纵拍卖机制提供了新的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 该机制简单易实施，可应用于艺术品收藏市场、数字广告等领域，特别适用于需要控制整个收藏来体现所有权价值的场景。

title: Knowledge Transfer Mechanisms and Decentralization of Decision Rights in Interfirm Networks: The Case of Franchising
affiliations: University of Vienna, Frederick University and University of Vienna

detail.title: Knowledge Transfer Mechanisms and Decentralization of Decision Rights in Interfirm Networks: The Case of Franchising

keywords: Relationship Between Knowledge Transfer Mechanism and Decentralization of Decision Rights

detail.abstract:
Decentralization of decision-making in interfirm networks (such as franchise networks, strategic alliances, or joint ventures) requires successfully transferring knowledge from headquarters to local network partners using appropriate knowledge transfer mechanisms. This study examines the relationship between the franchisor’s choice of knowledge transfer
mechanisms and the decentralization of decision rights in franchise networks. Specifically, we test the facilitating effect of three types of knowledge transfer mechanisms—high, medium, and low information-rich media—on decentralization of decision rights by using data from 168 franchise networks in four European countries. Our findings show that the use of high information-rich media increases the decentralization of decision rights by facilitating the transfer of tacit system knowledge, and the use of medium information-rich knowledge transfer mechanisms increases decentralization by facilitating the transfer of system knowledge with both explicit and tacit components. Thus, the design of knowledge transfer mechanisms plays a critical role in transferring tacit and explicit knowledge from headquarters to local franchisees and
is a prerequisite for the decentralization of decision-making in franchise networks. Overall, we contribute to the literature on franchise and interfirm networks by highlighting that network governance based on the allocation of decision rights is closely intertwined with the choice of knowledge transfer mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了特许经营网络中知识转移机制与决策权分散化的关系，发现高信息丰富度媒体通过促进隐性系统知识转移来增加决策权分散，中等信息丰富度机制通过促进显性和隐性混合知识转移来增加分散化。
AI.research_question: 特许经营网络中知识转移机制的选择如何影响决策权的分散化？
AI.motivation: 企业间网络（如特许经营网络）的决策分散化需要总部通过适当的知识转移机制向地方合作伙伴成功转移知识，但目前缺乏对知识转移机制与决策权分散化关系的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识转移理论和组织设计理论，重点关注隐性知识与显性知识的区别，以及不同信息丰富度媒体在知识转移中的作用。
AI.method: 使用来自欧洲四个国家168个特许经营网络的数据，测试三种信息丰富度水平（高、中、低）的知识转移机制对决策权分散化的促进作用。
AI.findings: 高信息丰富度媒体通过促进隐性系统知识转移增加决策权分散；中等信息丰富度机制通过促进显性和隐性混合知识转移增加分散化；知识转移机制设计对总部向地方特许经营者转移隐性和显性知识至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 为特许经营和企业间网络文献做出贡献，强调基于决策权分配的网络治理与知识转移机制选择密切相关。
AI.practical_contributions: 为特许经营网络管理者提供了实践指导，表明适当的知识转移机制设计是实现决策分散化的前提条件，有助于提高网络治理效率。

title: Blockchain and Machine Learning for Anti-Money Laundering: A Synergistic Approach
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Blockchain and Machine Learning for Anti-Money Laundering: A Synergistic Approach
detail.abstract: Blockchain and Machine Learning for Anti-Money Laundering: A Synergistic Approach This study investigates the integration of Blockchain and Machine Learning (ML) as a synergistic approach to Anti-Money Laundering (AML). With increasing concerns over the sophistication of money laundering schemes, traditional methods are proving insufficient. Blockchain's transparent and immutable ledger combined with ML's advanced pattern recognition presents a promising solution to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of AML efforts. Purpose of the Study: The primary aim of this study is to explore how the synergy between blockchain technology and machine learning can improve the detection, prevention, and reporting of money laundering activities. By leveraging blockchain's immutable records and ML's predictive capabilities, the research seeks to demonstrate how these technologies can work together to create a more effective AML framework. Methodology: The study employs a qualitative analysis of current literature and industry case studies, alongside a conceptual framework that integrates blockchain technology and machine learning models. The methodology includes: 1. Blockchain Transaction Analysis: Examining the features of blockchain's transparent ledger for detecting suspicious activities. 2. Machine Learning Algorithms: Reviewing ML techniques, such as anomaly detection and classification models, for predicting and identifying money laundering patterns. 3. Case Study Review: Analyzing real-world implementations and pilot programs by financial institutions using both technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了区块链与机器学习在反洗钱领域的协同应用，通过区块链的透明账本和机器学习的模式识别技术，提高反洗钱的效率和准确性。
AI.research_question: 区块链技术与机器学习如何协同作用来改善反洗钱的检测、防范和报告能力？
AI.motivation: 传统反洗钱方法在应对趋于复杂化的洗钱手段时显得力不从心，需要更有效的技术解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链技术的不可篦改性和透明性理论，结合机器学习的模式识别与预测理论。
AI.method: 采用定性分析方法，包括对现有文献和行业案例的研究，以及区块链与机器学习集成的概念框架。具体包括：1）区块链交易分析；2）机器学习算法评估；3）实际案例研究。
AI.findings: 区块链与机器学习的结合能够有效提高反洗钱的检测精准度和效率，通过区块链的透明账本提供可靠数据源，机器学习则能识别疑似模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 为区块链与机器学习在金融监管领域的协同应用提供理论支撑，丰富了数字化反洗钱的研究基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了可行的技术集成方案，帮助提升反洗钱实践的效果和可靠性。

title: Behavior, Automation, and the Energy Transition
affiliations: University of Melbourne and University of Melbourne - Department of Economics

detail.title: Behavior, Automation, and the Energy Transition
detail.abstract: The past twenty years have seen significant technological change in energy markets with the global rollout of smart electricity meters, solar panels, and electric vehicles. Yet, in many contexts, electricity pricing remains unchanged from the pre-digital era, with households facing flat-rate prices that fail to reflect fluctuations in electricity costs within and across days. This disconnect between pricing and costs creates various inefficiencies in energy markets that the rise of renewables in energy production will exacerbate. Evidence from emerging field trials highlights a pathway to mitigating these inefficiencies: combining dynamic electricity pricing with automation technologies -smart homes and electric vehicles - that give energy users the incentive and ability to flexibly increase their usage when energy is abundant and reduce their usage when it is scarce. However, various open questions remain over how to evolve policy settings to scale such demand flexibility in energy markets. This overview paper provides background on the rising importance of demand flexibility in electrified energy markets, synthesizes the current evidence base on how pairing dynamic pricing contracts with automation technologies can enhance it, and discusses policy challenges and open research questions on how to scale to grid-scale flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在智能电表、太阳能和电动汽车等技术变革背景下，电力定价与成本脱节导致的效率低下问题，提出通过动态定价与自动化技术结合来提升需求灵活性，并讨论了相关政策挑战和研究问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过动态电价与自动化技术的结合来提升能源市场的需求灵活性，以应对可再生能源增长带来的挑战？
AI.motivation: 过去20年能源市场技术显著变革，但电力定价仍沿用传统固定费率，无法反映日内和日间成本波动，这种定价与成本脱节导致效率低下，且可再生能源的兴起将加剧这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能源市场效率理论、动态定价理论和需求响应理论，探讨定价机制与技术创新的协同作用。
AI.method: 文献综述和现有实地试验证据的综合分析，概述当前研究现状和政策挑战。
AI.findings: 现有证据表明，动态电价与智能家居、电动汽车等自动化技术结合，能够激励用户在能源充足时增加使用、稀缺时减少使用，从而提升需求灵活性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了动态定价与自动化技术协同提升需求灵活性的理论框架，为能源市场定价机制创新提供理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了通过动态定价和自动化技术规模化提升电网需求灵活性的实践路径，并指出了需要解决的政策挑战和研究方向。

title: Freedom as Development: Economics of the Belarusian Brain Drain and Remittances
affiliations: Florida Atlantic University - Wilkes Honors College

detail.title: Freedom as Development: Economics of the Belarusian Brain Drain and Remittances
detail.abstract: Brain drain refers to the emigration of skilled workers, often from less developed to more developed countries with higher-paying jobs. Immigration of the workforce occurs due to a lack of economic opportunities rooted in historical, political, and cultural factors that hinder domestic political, economic, and social reforms. Remittances directly aid the household; they provide the monetary means without the burden of consumption. Such contributions stimulate the domestic economy by lifting people out of poverty. In the long run, the persistence of remittances and migration drives feelings of despair among the youth population, initiating the belief that there are no employment opportunities and that they must migrate. However, remittances contribute to increasing technological advancement, diversifying knowledge exchange, and spurring production efficiency, leading to more exports and higher GDP growth. Yet, through this research, it can be deduced that remittances only treat the symptoms of economic inadequacy. This paper aims to explore the case of Belarus, wherein the governmental influence of Russia often drives economic decisions because dependency and lack of freedom within Belarus cause a discouragement of development in Belarus.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨白俄罗斯的脑力流失现象，分析汇款对经济的短期缓解作用与长期依赖问题，指出政治依赖俄罗斯导致经济发展受阻。
AI.research_question: 白俄罗斯的脑力流失现象如何影响其经济发展？汇款是否能真正解决经济不足的根本问题？
AI.motivation: 研究白俄罗斯在俄罗斯政治影响下的经济决策依赖性，探讨脑力流失和汇款对经济发展的双重影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于发展经济学和移民经济学理论，分析人才流失、汇款经济效应和政治依赖性对经济发展的综合影响。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以白俄罗斯为具体案例，分析其政治经济环境和移民汇款数据。
AI.findings: 汇款短期内缓解贫困但长期导致青年绝望感；政治依赖性阻碍根本性经济改革；汇款仅治标不治本。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家脑力流失与经济发展的理论框架，强调了政治因素在移民经济分析中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为白俄罗斯等类似国家制定人才政策和经济发展战略提供参考，警示过度依赖汇款的长期风险。

title: The Global Minimum Tax and The Future of International Taxation
affiliations: University of Oxford - Faculty of Law

detail.title: The Global Minimum Tax and The Future of International Taxation
detail.abstract: Over 140 countries have now agreed to the introduction of a Global Minimum Tax, widely regarded as the most significant reform of the international business tax system in a century. While acknowledging that the agreement constitutes a remarkable political and technical achievement, this article questions whether the hype over the reform is justified and reflects on its likely impact on the future of international business taxation. The article makes three principal contributions. First, it argues that the Global Minimum Tax's impact on the existing system is, at best, mixed. Critically, the system continues to perform poorly overall. Second, it argues that this mixed impact is caused by the policy, not its implementation. Propping up the existing origin-based system with a Global Minimum Tax is a poor policy choice because the destabilising forces generated by the system’s incentive incompatibility persist. These forces undermine the reform and continue to undermine the system overall. Third, it argues that by doubling down on the existing origin-based system, the Global Minimum Tax makes it more difficult to pursue promising reform options that depart fundamentally from this system. This is troubling given the article’s conclusion that the system continues to perform poorly overall, even in the wake of the Global Minimum Tax.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑全球最低税改革的实际效果，认为其对现有国际税收体系的影响好坏参半，政策本身而非实施问题是根本原因，且该改革阻碍了更有前景的根本性改革路径。
AI.research_question: 全球最低税改革是否真的如宣传那样具有重要意义？其对国际商业税收体系的未来影响如何？
AI.motivation: 尽管140多个国家同意引入全球最低税，这被广泛认为是世纪性税收改革，但需要客观评估其实际效果和合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际税收体系激励不相容理论，分析全球最低税对现有原产地基础体系的支撑作用及其不稳定性。
AI.method: 理论分析和政策评估，通过对全球最低税政策设计的批判性分析，评估其对现有税收体系的影响。
AI.findings: 1)全球最低税对现有体系影响好坏参半；2)问题根源在于政策设计而非实施；3)改革阻碍了更有前景的根本性改革选项。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了全球最低税政策设计的根本缺陷理论，揭示了激励不相容问题在改革后仍然存在并继续破坏体系稳定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了对全球最低税改革效果的客观评估，指出了需要重新考虑根本性改革路径的必要性。
