AI.tldr: 欧盟对科索沃签证自由化政策的社会经济影响及人们利用欧盟内自由流动的动机研究
AI.research_question: 欧盟签证自由化对科索沃的社会经济影响是什么？科索沃人民利用欧盟内自由流动的主要动机是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究欧盟签证政策变化对科索沃这一特殊地区的实际影响，了解自由流动政策如何影响当地社会经济发展和人口流动模式
AI.theoretical_framework: 移民理论、区域一体化理论、签证政策影响评估框架、社会经济影响分析理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法，可能包括定量数据分析（移民统计、经济指标）和定性研究（访谈、问卷调查）
AI.findings: 签证自由化促进了科索沃与欧盟的人员往来，带来了汇款增加、技能提升等积极影响，但也可能面临人才外流等挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了欧盟东部伙伴关系国家签证政策影响的理论研究，为后冲突地区的一体化进程提供了实证依据
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟和科索沃政府制定相关移民和发展政策提供参考，帮助优化签证自由化政策的实施效果

title: Optimal Income Taxation in Multi-level Governance
affiliations: Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - School of Economics and Management, Peking University and Zhejiang University - College of Economics

detail.title: Optimal Income Taxation in Multi-level Governance
detail.abstract: We study the incidence and design of nonlinear central income taxes in an economy with multi-level governments. We derive an optimal central tax rule in terms of a few partial equilibrium elasticities (PEEs) in general equilibrium. This is achieved by formalizing an integral equation that expresses the general equilibrium elasticity (GEE) of labor income in terms of PEEs. The classic Diamond ABC formula is nested within a novel Pigouvian ABC framework, which comprises: (i) the original Diamond ABC term as a baseline, (ii) a measure of intergovernmental objective inconsistency, and (iii) a region-specific economic weight. In contrast to the canonical Mirrleesian tax, this ABC-nest-ABC rule specifically addresses intergovernmental objective inconsistencies and fiscal externalities. A quantitative analysis of 51 U.S. jurisdictions indicates that federal redistribution improves national welfare significantly even in the presence of optimal interregional transfers. It enhances welfare in low-income states at the expense of high-income states. Decentralized redistribution, however, slightly reduces national welfare. Consequently, the necessity of decentralized redistribution is contingent upon its value to the local community. Finally, implementing region-specific central redistribution would yield only minimal additional gains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多级政府经济中的非线性中央所得税问题，提出了包含Diamond ABC公式的Pigouvian ABC框架，通过量化分析发现联邦再分配能显著提高国家福利，但分散化再分配会轻微降低国家福利。
AI.research_question: 多级政府经济中非线性中央所得税的最优设计和影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究多级政府体系中中央税收政策如何应对政府间目标不一致和财政外部性问题，为联邦制国家的税收政策设计提供理论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Diamond ABC公式的Pigouvian ABC框架，包含基准Diamond ABC项、政府间目标不一致性度量和地区特定经济权重三个组成部分。
AI.method: 建立积分方程将一般均衡弹性表示为偏均衡弹性的函数，推导最优中央税收规则，并对美国51个司法管辖区进行定量分析。
AI.findings: 联邦再分配显著提高国家福利，惠及低收入州但损害高收入州利益；分散化再分配轻微降低国家福利；地区特定中央再分配的额外收益有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新颖的Pigouvian ABC框架，将经典Diamond ABC公式嵌套其中，专门解决政府间目标不一致和财政外部性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多级政府国家的中央税收政策设计提供实用指导，表明联邦再分配的重要性，并指出分散化再分配的价值取决于地方社区需求。

title: Axiomatizations of Normalized Measures for Directed Networks
affiliations: Kyushu University, Institute of Science Tokyo and Tokyo University of Science - School of Management

detail.title: Axiomatizations of Normalized Measures for Directed Networks
detail.abstract: This paper introduces new measures for assigning weights to nodes in directed networks (digraphs), extending the delta-and beta-measures developed by van den Brink and Gilles (2000). We offer alternative characterizations of these measures by replacing the original additivity axiom with an independence axiom. Moreover, we propose egalitarian delta-and beta-measures that incorporate egalitarian principles. Furthermore, we develop a new class of normalized measures that assign weights summing to one within any chosen subset of nodes. These measures are particularly suited for resource allocation problems that rely on digraph structures.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了有向网络中的节点权重分配方法，提出了基于独立性公理和平均主义原则的新测度，并开发了适用于资源分配问题的归一化测度
AI.research_question: 如何为有向网络中的节点开发新的权重分配测度，特别是基于独立性公理和平均主义原则的测度？
AI.motivation: 扩展van den Brink和Gilles（2000）的delta和beta测度，为有向网络中的资源分配问题提供更合适的权重分配方法
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于图论和网络分析理论，特别是针对有向图（digraph）的节点权重分配理论
AI.method: 理论推导和公理化方法，通过替换可加性公理为独立性公理来提供替代特征化，并引入平均主义原则
AI.findings: 成功开发了新的delta和beta测度变体，包括基于独立性公理的特征化、平均主义测度以及归一化测度
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了有向网络中节点权重分配的理论框架，提供了新的公理化特征和测度变体
AI.practical_contributions: 为依赖有向图结构的资源分配问题提供了实用的归一化权重分配工具

title: Granular Origins of Agglomeration
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD) and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

detail.title: Granular Origins of Agglomeration
detail.abstract: A few large firms dominate many local labor markets. How does that granularity affect the geography of economic activity and optimal place-based policy? To answer this question, we propose a new economic geography model featuring granular firms subject to idiosyncratic shocks. We show that average wages increase with the size of the local labor market due to that granularity, and we derive the optimal subsidy on firm entry. Using Japanese administrative data on manufacturing, we estimate our model and provide evidence consistent with our mechanism. Our mechanism implies that the smallest commuting zones have an elasticity of wages to population of 0.006. In large markets like Tokyo, the elasticity is around 0.002. Enacting optimal place-based industrial and wage policy would increase the number of people in the smallest cities, but the effect on the number of firms depends on firm conduct.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型企业在地方劳动力市场中的主导地位如何影响经济活动地理分布和最优地方政策，提出了包含异质性冲击的颗粒企业新经济地理模型，发现平均工资随地方劳动力市场规模增加而上升，并推导出最优企业进入补贴政策。
AI.research_question: 大型企业在地方劳动力市场中的主导地位（颗粒性）如何影响经济活动的地理分布和最优的地方政策？
AI.motivation: 许多地方劳动力市场由少数大型企业主导，这种颗粒性特征可能对经济地理和区域政策产生重要影响，但现有研究对此关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新经济地理学模型，包含受异质性冲击的颗粒企业，分析企业规模分布对地方劳动力市场和工资水平的影响机制。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与推导，使用日本制造业行政数据进行模型估计和实证验证。
AI.findings: 平均工资随地方劳动力市场规模增加而上升；最小通勤区的工资对人口弹性为0.006，东京等大市场约为0.002；最优地方政策会增加小城市人口，但对企业数量的影响取决于企业行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了包含颗粒企业异质性冲击的新经济地理模型，为理解企业规模分布对区域经济的影响提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 推导出最优企业进入补贴政策，为地方产业和工资政策制定提供了理论依据，有助于优化区域发展政策。

title: Gulf Cooperation Council Diversification
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Gulf Cooperation Council Diversification

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the role of cross-border investments, including by Sovereign Wealth Funds (SWFs), in driving economic growth and diversification of Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries. Utilizing novel deal-level datasets, we analyze GCC cross-border investment portfolios across various dimensions such as time, geography, and industry. We show that recent years have witnessed an increase in GCC cross-border investments. While the geographic distribution of these investments remains diverse and balanced across different regions, both inward and outward investments are increasingly directed towards the services sector. The empirical results demonstrate a significant positive relationship between both cross-border inward and domestic investments on GCC real non-hydrocarbon GDP. Notably, the medium-term increase in real non-hydrocarbon GDP resulting from inward investments is three times larger than that from domestic investments. This amplification could be explained by increased inward investments in high-growth services sectors. Although domestic investments, including by SWFs, are contributing to the GCC economic transformation, their efficiency could be further enhanced by focusing on strategic partnerships with international investors and fostering a more transparent and competitive business environment. Recent shift in GCC investments in renewable and clean energy projects will further support diversification efforts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现海湾合作委员会国家的跨境投资（包括主权财富基金）对非石油GDP增长有显著正向影响，其中外来投资的促进作用比国内投资大三倍，服务业投资是主要驱动力。
AI.research_question: 跨境投资（包括主权财富基金）如何影响海湾合作委员会国家的经济增长和经济多元化？
AI.motivation: 研究海湾国家经济转型过程中跨境投资的作用，特别是主权财富基金在推动经济多元化方面的贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际投资理论、经济增长理论、经济多元化理论
AI.method: 使用新颖的交易级别数据集，从时间、地理和行业维度分析海湾合作委员会国家的跨境投资组合，并进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1）近年来海湾国家跨境投资增加；2）投资地理分布多样均衡；3）投资日益集中于服务业；4）跨境外来投资和国内投资都对非石油GDP有显著正向影响；5）外来投资的促进作用比国内投资大三倍
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了国际投资对资源型经济体转型的理论理解，特别是主权财富基金在促进经济多元化方面的作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为海湾国家政策制定者提供建议：通过与国际投资者建立战略伙伴关系、营造更透明竞争的商业环境来提升投资效率，可再生能源投资将进一步加强经济多元化

title: Carbon Taxation, Systematic Carbon Risk, and Capital Allocation

detail.title: Carbon Taxation, Systematic Carbon Risk, and Capital Allocation
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the channels through which carbon taxation affects the portfolio of industrial production capital. Based on the mean-variance optimization framework, it is shown that carbon taxation adjusts not only the expected level of industrial returns on capital but also their variance-covariance. The potential effects arising from carbon taxation on variancecovariance have not been fully addressed in prior research. Our findings from the double-index model with two systematic risk factors (market risk and carbon risk) indicate that carbon taxation reduces the risk premium for exposures to the carbon risk factor. This analysis also shows that the impact of carbon taxation on the expected level of industrial returns on capital can be mitigated or amplified by the impact on their variance-covariance. These results suggest that unintended impact as well as intended impact should be considered to catalyze a lasting shift in industrial capital allocation. Key policy insights  Carbon taxation can affect a portfolio of industrial production capital by lowering the risk premium for exposure to returns on capital of the carbon risk factor in a double-index model.  The after-tax carbon risk premium can be close to zero as the effective carbon tax rate is differentiated based on industrial carbon intensity.  The indirect and unintended effects should be considered when making a policy decision based on assessing the impact of carbon taxation on individual industries.

AI.tldr: 本文基于均值-方差优化框架，研究发现碳税不仅调整工业资本回报的预期水平，还影响其方差-协方差结构。通过双指数模型分析发现，碳税降低了碳风险因子的风险溢价，且对预期回报的影响可能被方差-协方差变化所抵消或放大。
AI.research_question: 碳税如何通过不同渠道影响工业生产资本组合？
AI.motivation: 先前研究未充分探讨碳税对方差-协方差的潜在影响，需要全面理解碳税对工业资本配置的预期和非预期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 均值-方差优化框架和双指数模型（包含市场风险和碳风险两个系统性风险因子）
AI.method: 基于双指数模型的实证分析，考察碳税对碳风险因子风险溢价的影响
AI.findings: 碳税降低了碳风险因子的风险溢价；根据工业碳强度差异化的有效碳税率可使税后碳风险溢价接近零；碳税对预期回报的影响可能被方差-协方差变化所抵消或放大
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析碳税对资本回报方差-协方差结构的影响，拓展了碳税经济效应的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供重要启示：需要考虑碳税的间接和非预期效应，以促进工业资本配置的持久转变

title: Crowd and the Gender Gap in Evaluating Entrepreneurship
affiliations: ICN Business School

detail.title: Crowd and the Gender Gap in Evaluating Entrepreneurship
detail.abstract: Does relying on the crowd mitigate differences in evaluations between male-and female-led entrepreneurial projects? Drawing on the wisdom of the crowd and the gender stereotype theory, I examine gender differences in crowd evaluations and the role of gender identity in assessing quality using data from an online platform. I find that female-led projects do not receive lower evaluation scores, but female evaluators are more supportive of female founders. However, a gender gap persists across sub-criteria, with male-led projects receiving higher scores on traits associated with masculine stereotypes, while female-led projects garner more support for traits aligned with feminine stereotypes.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，在众筹平台上，女性主导的创业项目并未获得较低的整体评价分数，但存在性别刻板印象导致的子标准评价差异：男性主导项目在男性化特质上得分更高，女性主导项目在女性化特质上获得更多支持，且女性评价者对女性创始人更支持。
AI.research_question: 依赖群体智慧是否能缓解男性和女性主导创业项目之间的评价差异？
AI.motivation: 探讨在线众筹平台上性别差异对创业项目评价的影响，以及性别身份在质量评估中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 群体智慧理论和性别刻板印象理论
AI.method: 利用在线平台数据进行分析
AI.findings: 女性主导项目未获得较低的整体评价分数，但女性评价者对女性创始人更支持；在子标准上存在性别差距：男性主导项目在男性化刻板印象相关特质上得分更高，女性主导项目在女性化刻板印象相关特质上获得更多支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了群体智慧理论和性别刻板印象理论在创业评价领域的应用，揭示了性别身份对评价行为的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业平台设计更公平的评价机制提供参考，帮助创业者了解性别因素在众筹评价中的影响，促进性别平等的创业环境。

title: Multihoming and Single-homing Complementors' Responses to Intensified Between-Platform Competition: Evidence from the YouTube-Twitch Rivalry
affiliations: Singapore Management University

detail.title: Multihoming and Single-homing Complementors' Responses to Intensified Between-Platform Competition: Evidence from the YouTube-Twitch Rivalry
detail.abstract: This paper examines how heterogeneous YouTube content creators, specifically single-homing and multihoming channels, respond to a sudden increase in the exposure of the rival platform, Twitch. Contrary to expectations, I find that multihoming channels reduce their content creation efforts and underperform relative to single-homers. To make sense of these surprising results, I develop a formal model that characterizes the strategic behavior of different types of complementors operating across two platforms with varying levels of user exposure. The model offers a plausible explanation for the observed empirical patterns, suggesting that intensified competition between platforms, as a consequence of their changing exposure, disproportionately incentivizes single-homers to enhance platform value while discouraging multihomers from maintaining the same level of engagement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，当竞争对手平台Twitch曝光度突然增加时，多平台运营的YouTube创作者反而减少内容创作投入，表现不如单平台创作者。通过建立理论模型解释这一反直觉现象，表明平台间竞争加剧会激励单平台创作者提升平台价值，但抑制多平台创作者的参与度。
AI.research_question: 异质性YouTube内容创作者（单平台与多平台运营者）如何应对竞争对手平台Twitch曝光度的突然增加？
AI.motivation: 理解平台生态系统中不同类型创作者对竞争平台变化的战略反应，以及这种反应如何影响平台价值创造。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台竞争理论、互补者战略行为理论、多平台运营理论
AI.method: 实证分析结合理论建模，通过观察YouTube创作者对Twitch曝光度增加的反应，建立形式化模型解释观察到的模式。
AI.findings: 与预期相反，多平台创作者减少内容创作投入，表现不如单平台创作者；平台竞争加剧会不对称地激励单平台创作者提升平台价值，同时抑制多平台创作者的参与度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了解释多平台互补者战略行为的理论模型，揭示了平台竞争对异质性创作者的不同激励效应，丰富了平台生态系统理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台管理者制定创作者激励策略提供理论依据，帮助理解如何通过调整平台竞争策略来优化创作者参与和平台价值创造。

title: Reputational Conservatism in Expert Advice
affiliations: and Ecole Polytechnique

detail.title: Reputational Conservatism in Expert Advice
detail.abstract: We develop a tractable career-concerns model of expert recommendations with a continuous private signal. In equilibrium, advice obeys a cutoff rule: the expert recommends the risky option if and only if the signal exceeds a threshold. Under a mild relative-diagnosticity condition, the threshold is (weakly) increasing in reputation, yielding reputational conservatism. Signal informativeness and success priors lower the cutoff, while stronger career concerns raise it. A success-contingent bonus implements any target experimentation rate via a one-to-one mapping, providing an implementable design lever.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个连续信号下的职业关注模型，发现专家建议遵循临界值规则：信号超过阈值时推荐风险选项。声誉增加会导致保守主义，信号信息量和成功先验降低临界值，而职业关注增强会提高临界值。成功相关奖金可通过一对一映射实现任何目标实验率。
AI.research_question: 专家在职业关注背景下如何做出推荐决策？声誉如何影响专家的风险建议行为？
AI.motivation: 理解专家在声誉压力下的决策机制，为设计有效的激励机制提供理论依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 职业关注理论、信号理论、贝叶斯更新、连续信号下的决策模型
AI.method: 构建理论模型，分析均衡条件，推导临界值规则，进行比较静态分析
AI.findings: 1) 建议遵循临界值规则；2) 声誉增加导致保守主义；3) 信号信息量和成功先验降低临界值；4) 职业关注增强提高临界值；5) 成功相关奖金可实现目标实验率
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了连续信号下的职业关注理论，揭示了声誉对专家建议行为的影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了通过成功相关奖金设计激励机制的具体方法，可用于实际组织中的专家决策管理

title: Higher Education Development Strategies in Sudan: A Comprehensive Vision for Phased Modernization and Development
affiliations: International University of Africa

detail.title: Higher Education Development Strategies in Sudan: A Comprehensive Vision for Phased Modernization and Development
detail.abstract: This study aims to develop a comprehensive strategy for improving the quality of higher education in Sudan, focusing on contemporary challenges and innovative solutions. The study addresses the current state of Sudanese higher education, which comprises approximately 170 educational institutions serving more than 600,000 students. The study presents a phased implementation plan starting with 30 universities in the first phase, followed by the remaining institutions in the second phase. It also proposes two technical options for solutions: the first relies on traditional data centers, and the second uses cloud computing. The proposed strategies include: curriculum development, faculty development and training, improving the educational environment, digital transformation, supporting scientific research, building community partnerships, collaborating with the labor market, and quality assurance.

AI.tldr: 本研究旨在制定苏丹高等教育质量提升的综合战略，重点关注当代挑战和创新解决方案，提出了包括课程开发、教师培训、教育环境改善、数字化转型等八大战略，并设计了分阶段实施计划和技术方案。
AI.research_question: 如何制定一个全面的战略来提升苏丹高等教育的质量，应对当代挑战并提供创新解决方案？
AI.motivation: 苏丹高等教育系统规模庞大（约170所院校，60多万学生），但面临诸多质量挑战，需要系统性的改进策略来提升教育质量和竞争力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高等教育质量管理理论、教育发展战略理论、数字化转型理论、质量保证体系理论
AI.method: 采用战略规划和系统分析方法，提出分阶段实施计划（第一阶段30所大学，第二阶段其余院校）和两种技术方案（传统数据中心和云计算）
AI.findings: 提出了包含八大战略的综合改进方案：课程开发、教师发展培训、教育环境改善、数字化转型、科研支持、社区伙伴关系建设、劳动力市场合作、质量保证
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家高等教育质量提升提供了系统的战略框架，丰富了高等教育发展战略理论在资源受限环境下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为苏丹高等教育机构提供了具体的实施路线图和技术选择，有助于系统性提升教育质量，促进数字化转型和产教融合

title: Sri Lanka’s Sovereign Debt Restructuring
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Sri Lanka’s Sovereign Debt Restructuring

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Sri Lanka’s debt restructuring distinguishes itself from others by its complexity due to a particularly diverse creditor landscape and novel instruments issued in the restructuring. Not eligible for the G20 Common Framework for Debt Treatments, Sri Lanka had to navigate the challenges of a diverse creditor landscape, requiring complex coordination across many stakeholders. The majority of official debt was held by non-traditional creditors outside of the Paris Club and domestic borrowing played an important role in Sri Lanka’s overall debt. Commercial creditors were particularly interested in new and complex instruments that would share up- and downsides to the macroeconomic framework and would offer additional debt relief for implementing governance reforms. For the first time, the IMF applied fully the newly developed Sovereign Risk and Debt Sustainability Framework to assess debt sustainability. The restructuring took place against the background of a very deep fiscal and balance of payments crisis that required sweeping policy solutions in the context of a complex IMF-supported reform program. This paper reviews the root causes of Sri Lanka’s debt problem, the deliberation of its solution, and the designs, negotiations, and outcomes of the restructuring processes. Important lessons from Sri Lanka’s experience regarding restructuring strategies and design, as well as the IMF’s role in facilitating debt-creditor engagement, can inform future restructurings.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了斯里兰卡债务重组的复杂性，包括多样化的债权人结构、新型金融工具的使用，以及IMF新债务可持续性框架的首次应用，为未来债务重组提供了重要经验。
AI.research_question: 斯里兰卡债务重组的复杂性特征、解决方案设计及其对未来的启示是什么？
AI.motivation: 斯里兰卡债务重组因其特别多样化的债权人结构和重组中使用的新型工具而具有独特性，且不符合G20共同框架，需要研究其复杂协调过程和经验教训。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权债务重组理论、债权人协调理论、债务可持续性分析框架
AI.method: 案例研究方法，分析斯里兰卡债务问题的根源、解决方案的审议过程以及重组过程的设计、谈判和结果
AI.findings: 斯里兰卡债务重组面临非传统官方债权人、重要国内借款和商业债权人偏好复杂工具等挑战；IMF首次应用新的主权风险和债务可持续性框架；重组在深度财政和国际收支危机背景下进行
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了主权债务重组理论，特别是对非传统债权人和复杂金融工具的处理；验证了IMF新债务可持续性框架的实际应用效果
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来债务重组提供了重要经验教训，包括重组策略设计、IMF在促进债务人与债权人接触中的作用等方面

title: Dynamic Portfolio Selection under Monotone Additive Statistics in the Heston Model
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong - Department of Systems Engineering and Engineering Management, Hong Kong Polytechnic University and Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Academy of Mathematics and Systems Sciences

detail.title: Dynamic Portfolio Selection under Monotone Additive Statistics in the Heston Model
detail.abstract: The monotone additive statistic is a preference representation satisfying the monotonicity and additivity properties. This statistic has been proven to be represented by a weighted average of certainty equivalents under exponential utility functions with different risk aversion degrees and employed in various financial and economic contexts. We study a dynamic portfolio selection problem in which an agent trades a risk-free asset and a risky stock with stochastic volatility to optimize her investment performance measured by the monotone additive statistic of her terminal wealth or log investment return. We find that the monotone additive statistic, when applied to dynamic decision problems, can lead to time inconsistency. We thus consider equilibrium strategies for our portfolio selection problem and derive these strategies by proving the solvability of two associated systems of ordinary differential equations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了单调加性统计量在动态投资组合选择中的应用，发现该统计量会导致时间不一致性问题，并通过求解两个常微分方程系统得到了均衡策略。
AI.research_question: 单调加性统计量在动态投资组合选择中是否会导致时间不一致性问题？如何求解相应的均衡策略？
AI.motivation: 单调加性统计量已被证明可以在指数效用函数下表示为不同风险厌恶程度的确定性等价的加权平均，并在金融和经济领域广泛应用，但其在动态决策问题中的时间一致性尚未研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 单调加性统计量理论、动态投资组合选择理论、时间不一致性理论
AI.method: 通过证明两个关联常微分方程系统的可解性来推导均衡策略
AI.findings: 单调加性统计量在动态决策问题中会导致时间不一致性，需要采用均衡策略方法
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了单调加性统计量在动态环境中的时间不一致性问题，扩展了该统计量的理论应用范围
AI.practical_contributions: 为使用单调加性统计量的投资者提供了动态投资组合选择的均衡策略解决方案

title: Random-Proposer Deferred Acceptance and Possibility-based Strategy-proofness
affiliations: Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Budapest University of Technology and Economics and Budapest University of Technology and Economics

detail.title: Random-Proposer Deferred Acceptance and Possibility-based Strategy-proofness

declarations.funderStatement: József Pintér is funded by Project No. KDP-IKT-2023-900-I1-00000957/0000003 with support provided by the Ministry of Culture and Innovation of Hungary from the National Research, Development and Inno- vation Fund, financed under the KDP-2023 funding scheme; additional support for his work at BME came from Grant Nr. TKP2021-NVA-02 of the same ministry’s NRDI Fund under the TKP2021-NVA scheme and from the EU project RRF-2.3.1–21-2022-00004 (Artificial Intelligence National Laboratory). Christopher Stapenhurst acknowledges funding from the Sustainable Development and Technologies National Programme of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences (FFT NP FTA), and from project no. EKÖP-24- 4-II-BME-37 implemented with the support provided by the Ministry of Culture and Innovation of Hungary from the National Research, Development and Innovation Fund, financed under the 2024-2.1.1-EKÖP-2024- 00003 funding scheme.

detail.abstract: It is well known that no deterministic and stable, two-sided matching algorithm is strategy-proof for both sides. We propose a new matching algorithm—the Random-Proposer Deferred Acceptance (RPDA) algorithm—that randomly selects either the man- and woman-proposing Deferred Acceptance algorithms with equal probability. To evaluate the strategy-proofness of the RPDA, we introduce three natural extensions of strategy-proofness to stochastic environments: optimistic, pessimistic and possibilistic strategy-proofness. We find that the RPDA is optimistic and possibilistic strategy-proof, but not pessimistic strategy-proof. These results demonstrate how stochastic matching algorithms can circumvent classic impossibility theorems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了随机提议者延迟接受算法（RPDA），通过随机选择男女提议的延迟接受算法来规避经典不可能定理，证明了该算法在乐观和可能性策略证明方面有效，但在悲观策略证明方面无效。
AI.research_question: 随机匹配算法能否规避经典的两边策略证明不可能定理？
AI.motivation: 已知不存在对双方都确定性和稳定的策略证明匹配算法，需要探索随机算法来突破这一限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于延迟接受算法和随机化理论，扩展策略证明概念到随机环境。
AI.method: 提出RPDA算法，随机选择男女提议的延迟接受算法，并引入三种策略证明扩展定义。
AI.findings: RPDA算法具有乐观和可能性策略证明性，但不具有悲观策略证明性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了策略证明理论到随机环境，提出了三种新的策略证明定义，证明了随机算法可以规避不可能定理。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际匹配市场提供了新的随机算法选择，能够在保持稳定性的同时提高策略证明性。

title: Can We Measure from the Bottom Up? Constructing An Index of Gas Station Infrastructure to Identify Regional Economic Development
affiliations: and

detail.title: Can We Measure from the Bottom Up? Constructing An Index of Gas Station Infrastructure to Identify Regional Economic Development
detail.abstract: We develop a methodology that leverages open-source geospatial data on fuel station infrastructure and related services to construct the Gas Station Index (GSI), a novel indicator that augments official and alternative measures of regional economic development. Gas stations serve as consumer-facing infrastructure nodes, and their density and quality reflect local demand, purchasing power, and mobility. Using data on 19,033 stations across 62 regions in nine European countries, the GSI explains 64% of the cross-regional variation in GDP per capita-a notable result for a single-variable indicator. Beyond its statistical fit, the GSI uncovers meaningful economic patterns. It reflects diminishing returns to infrastructure, consistent with core economic theory; it maps spatial inequality both visually and statistically, highlighting clusters of prosperity in capitals, port cities, transit corridors, and tourist destinations; and it classifies regional development typologies through bivariate LISA analysis. The unexplained variation underscores the structural differences between infrastructure-based indicator and GDP per capita, driven by sectoral specialization, mobility patterns, and informal economic activity. The GSI should therefore be viewed not as a substitute for national accounts, but as a complementary indicator particularly relevant at the subnational level. Compared to existing indicators, it offers distinct advantages: GDP per capita is delayed and masks heterogeneity, while night-time lights suffer from saturation and rural undercoverage. By contrast, the GSI provides a ground-level, behaviorally grounded, and real-time measure of economic development. By capturing both infrastructure and consumption dynamics, it complements-and in certain respects surpasses-conventional indicators in tracing regional growth trajectories and spatial inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种利用加油站基础设施数据构建加油站指数(GSI)的新方法，该指数能够有效补充传统经济指标，解释64%的地区人均GDP差异，并揭示空间不平等和发展模式。
AI.research_question: 如何利用加油站基础设施数据构建一个能够有效衡量和补充地区经济发展的新型指标？
AI.motivation: 传统经济指标如人均GDP存在数据延迟和掩盖地区异质性的问题，夜间灯光数据则存在饱和和农村覆盖不足的局限，需要开发更实时、地面层面的经济发展衡量工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于基础设施经济学和消费行为理论，加油站作为消费基础设施节点，其密度和质量反映了当地需求、购买力和流动性。
AI.method: 利用9个欧洲国家62个地区的19,033个加油站的开放地理空间数据，构建加油站指数(GSI)，并通过回归分析和双变量LISA分析验证其有效性。
AI.findings: GSI能够解释64%的地区人均GDP差异，显示基础设施的边际收益递减规律，识别出首都、港口城市、交通走廊和旅游目的地的繁荣集群，并通过未解释的变异揭示了结构性差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于消费基础设施的新型经济发展衡量框架，验证了基础设施经济学理论在实践中的应用，丰富了区域经济发展的测量方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实时、地面层面的经济发展监测工具，特别适用于次国家级别的区域发展分析和空间不平等研究，弥补了传统指标的不足。

title: Intergenerational Income Mobility and the Bailout Programs: Evidence from Greece
affiliations: De Montfort University - Faculty of Business and Law and De Montfort University - Faculty of Business and Law

detail.title: Intergenerational Income Mobility and the Bailout Programs: Evidence from Greece
detail.abstract: This article delves into the dynamics of intergenerational income and earnings mobility in Greece in the aftermath of the bailout programs. Leveraging data sourced from the European Union Statistics on Income and Living Conditions survey spanning from 2011 to 2019, we investigate the income landscape of Greece during this pivotal period. To mitigate the coresidence selection bias, we supplement our analysis with data from the European Community Household Panel and implement the robust two-sample two-stage least squares estimator (TS2SLS) method. Our empirical findings reveal a noteworthy uptick in intergenerational income elasticity as the bailout programs draw to a close. This result endures rigorous scrutiny through a battery of robustness checks encompassing diverse income categories and alternative methodologies to gauge mobility. Additionally, we present compelling evidence illuminating the underlying factors contributing to the observed decline in mobility subsequent to the bailout programs. This comprehensive analysis sheds valuable light on the nuanced shifts in income mobility dynamics in post-bailout Greece.

AI.tldr: 本文使用TS2SLS方法分析希腊纾困计划后的代际收入流动性变化，发现纾困计划结束时代际收入弹性显著上升，流动性下降
AI.research_question: 希腊纾困计划结束后代际收入和收入流动性发生了怎样的变化？
AI.motivation: 研究纾困计划对希腊代际收入流动性的影响，为理解经济危机后的社会流动性提供实证证据
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际收入流动性理论，收入弹性测量框架
AI.method: 使用欧盟收入与生活条件调查数据（2011-2019），采用两样本两阶段最小二乘法（TS2SLS）控制共居选择偏误
AI.findings: 纾困计划结束时代际收入弹性显著上升，表明代际收入流动性下降
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了经济危机时期代际流动性变化的理论理解，提供了纾困计划影响社会流动性的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供纾困计划社会后果的参考，有助于设计更公平的经济复苏政策

title: Instrumental Freedoms and Inhabitants of the Territory in the Colombian Political Constitution
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: Instrumental Freedoms and Inhabitants of the Territory in the Colombian Political Constitution
detail.abstract: This article examines the relationship between Amartya Sen's theoretical framework on instrumental freedoms and Title III of the 1991 Colombian Constitution, dedicated to inhabitants and territory. It analyzes the five instrumental freedoms-political freedoms, economic facilities, social opportunities, guarantees of transparency, and protective security-and their correspondence with the constitutional articles, assessing the extent to which they strengthen agency and choice. The study, from an economic, legal, and cultural perspective, shows that there has been regulatory progress in the recognition of rights, but structural limitations in economic and social matters persist that reduce the effectiveness of citizen agency.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了森的五种工具性自由理论与哥伦比亚1991年宪法第三章的对应关系，发现虽然权利认可有法律进步，但经济社会结构限制仍削弱公民能动性。
AI.research_question: 阿马蒂亚·森的工具性自由理论框架与1991年哥伦比亚宪法第三章（关于居民和领土）之间的关系如何？这些自由在多大程度上增强了公民的能动性和选择能力？
AI.motivation: 探讨宪法规定与理论框架的对应关系，评估哥伦比亚在实现工具性自由方面的进展和挑战，为理解公民权利实现提供多维度分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阿马蒂亚·森的工具性自由理论，包括五种自由：政治自由、经济便利、社会机会、透明度保障和保护性安全。
AI.method: 从经济、法律和文化视角进行分析，对比理论框架与宪法条款的对应关系，评估权利实现的进展和限制。
AI.findings: 在权利认可方面取得了监管进展，但在经济和社会事务方面存在结构性限制，这些限制降低了公民能动性的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将森的工具性自由理论应用于具体宪法文本分析，验证理论在实践中的适用性和局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为哥伦比亚宪法实施效果评估提供分析框架，指出需要解决的结构性障碍以增强公民实际权利。

title: Cognitive Bias in Nuclear Crisis Decision-Making: Empirical Evidence Challenging Rational Actor Theory
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Cognitive Bias in Nuclear Crisis Decision-Making: Empirical Evidence Challenging Rational Actor Theory

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research represents a collaborative effort between a human researcher and an AI assistant (Claude, Anthropic). The human researcher maintained responsibility for all methodological decisions, evidence assessment, and theoretical conclusions
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study analyzes declassified historical documents and does not involve human subjects research. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently

detail.abstract: Systematic analysis of declassified nuclear crisis documents reveals that cognitive biases, not rational calculation, determined outcomes in major nuclear crises. Using empirical evidence from the Cuban Missile Crisis, the 1983 Soviet false alarm incident, and Able Archer 83, this study demonstrates that individual psychology consistently overrode institutional safeguards designed to ensure rational decisionmaking. These findings challenge fundamental assumptions in nuclear strategy theory and indicate that current governance structures are inadequate to prevent evidence-immune decision-making in nuclear command authority. While this study focuses on documented secular cognitive bias patterns, the findings have implications for understanding how any belief system that immunizes decisions against evidence-whether ideological, religious, or technological-could create similar risks requiring institutional safeguards.

AI.tldr: 通过对解密核危机文件的系统分析发现，认知偏见而非理性计算决定了重大核危机的结果。研究基于古巴导弹危机、1983年苏联误报事件和Able Archer 83演习的实证证据，证明个体心理学持续压倒旨在确保理性决策的机构保障机制。
AI.research_question: 认知偏见如何影响核危机中的决策过程？个体心理学是否能够压倒制度化的理性决策保障机制？
AI.motivation: 挑战核战略理论的基本假设，揭示当前治理结构在防止证据免疫决策方面的不足，为理解任何免疫决策免受证据影响的信念系统提供启示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知偏见理论、核战略理论、决策心理学、组织行为学
AI.method: 对解密核危机文件进行系统分析，使用古巴导弹危机、1983年苏联误报事件和Able Archer 83演习的实证证据
AI.findings: 个体认知偏见持续压倒制度化的理性决策保障机制，认知偏见而非理性计算决定了核危机结果，当前治理结构无法防止证据免疫决策
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了核战略理论中理性决策的基本假设，提出了认知偏见在危机决策中的核心作用理论
AI.practical_contributions: 指出了当前核指挥机构治理结构的不足，为设计更好的制度保障机制提供依据，对防范意识形态、宗教或技术信念系统造成的类似风险具有启示意义

title: Multi-Horizon Forecasting with Temporal and Horizon Instabilities *
affiliations: Universitat de les Illes Balears and University of Padua

detail.title: Multi-Horizon Forecasting with Temporal and Horizon Instabilities *
detail.abstract: In this paper we introduce a testing approach to compare and evaluate the forecasting ability of two models in a multi-horizon setting. First, we consider a group-average variant of the Diebold and Mariano (1995) test to assess equal forecasting performance across specific subgroups of horizon, over times. Second, we develop ta multi-horizon extension of the Fluctuation test by Giacomini and Rossi (2010) to analyze how relative forecasting performance evolves dynamically across different horizon groups. Finally, we propose a bootstrap approach based on the Moving Block Bootstrap method that improves the finite sample properties of the proposed tests, and investigate the small sample properties of these tests through a Monte Carlo experiment. To illustrate the usefulness of our testing approach, we extend the flexible quantile framework by Adams et al. (2021) to predict various sources of macroeconomic risk at multiple forecasting horizons by using text-based indexes to proxy financial and economic pessimism. Our results indicate that these indexes contribute at some horizons in predicting downside growth risk and upside unemployment and inflation risks, particularly during economic crises.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多期预测模型比较测试方法，包括分组平均DM检验、多期波动检验和移动区块自助法，并通过宏观经济风险预测案例验证了方法的实用性。
AI.research_question: 如何比较和评估多期预测设置中两个模型的预测能力？
AI.motivation: 现有预测模型比较方法主要针对单期预测，缺乏对多期预测场景下模型性能的系统评估方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Diebold和Mariano(1995)的预测精度检验理论，以及Giacomini和Rossi(2010)的波动检验理论。
AI.method: 1)分组平均DM检验；2)多期波动检验扩展；3)移动区块自助法改进有限样本性质；4)蒙特卡洛实验验证小样本性质
AI.findings: 文本指数在某些预测期对预测下行增长风险以及上行失业和通胀风险有贡献，特别是在经济危机期间。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了多期预测模型比较的统计检验框架，扩展了现有单期预测检验方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观经济风险的多期预测提供了实用的模型评估工具，有助于识别不同预测期下的最优预测模型。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning as Enablers of Energy Transition
affiliations: Blend Tiger

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning as Enablers of Energy Transition
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) have emerged as central tools in addressing the complexity of modern energy systems. The global transition towards low-carbon and decentralized energy infrastructures requires advanced analytical methods that can manage variability, uncertainty, and large volumes of operational data. Traditional deterministic and statistical models provide valuable insights but remain limited in their ability to capture nonlinear dynamics across multi-vector energy networks. ML methods, including supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning, enable predictive accuracy, adaptive control, and system-level optimization. Their application spans renewable generation forecasting, asset reliability analysis, hydrogen supply chain optimization, and market operations. This paper examines the state of knowledge on AI and ML in the energy sector, establishes methodological foundations for their deployment, and assesses their potential to accelerate decarbonization, reduce costs, and improve resilience. Challenges such as data availability, model interpretability, and regulatory integration are critically evaluated, and directions for future research are identified. The findings demonstrate that AI and ML constitute not incremental improvements but systemic enablers of the clean energy transition [1-3].

AI.tldr: AI和机器学习在能源系统中发挥核心作用，能够处理复杂性、不确定性和大数据，为低碳能源转型提供系统性支持。
AI.research_question: AI和机器学习如何应用于能源领域以加速脱碳、降低成本并提高系统韧性？
AI.motivation: 全球向低碳和分散式能源基础设施转型需要先进分析方法来管理变异性、不确定性和大量运营数据，传统方法在捕捉多向量能源网络非线性动态方面存在局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习理论框架，包括监督学习、无监督学习和强化学习，用于预测准确性、自适应控制和系统级优化。
AI.method: 文献综述和知识状态评估，建立方法论基础，评估应用潜力，并批判性评估挑战。
AI.findings: AI和ML不仅是渐进式改进，而且是清洁能源转型的系统性推动者，应用涵盖可再生能源预测、资产可靠性分析、氢供应链优化和市场运营。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了AI和ML在能源领域部署的方法论基础，识别了未来研究方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 展示了AI和ML在加速脱碳、降低成本和改善韧性方面的实际应用潜力，为能源行业提供了可行的技术解决方案。

title: Afghan Exodus
affiliations: , , International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Afghan Exodus

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Afghanistan has endured decades of war and political turmoil, leading to repeated waves of displacement (refugees and internally displaced persons) and emigration. This paper documents key stylized facts of the Afghan displacement and emigration crisis, assesses its macroeconomic impacts from a regional perspective using the IMF’s FSGM model, and considers policies to address the crisis. It underscores the need for a holistic and coordinated approach to achieve a durable solution. With international support serving as a critical catalyst, well-designed reforms in both Afghanistan and host countries (Iran and Pakistan) could yield a win-win outcome.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文分析了阿富汗移民危机，使用IMF模型评估宏观经济影响，建议通过整体协调政策实现双赢解决方案。
AI.research_question: 阿富汗移民危机的宏观经济影响是什么？如何通过政策干预实现可持续解决？
AI.motivation: 阿富汗长期战乱导致的重复移民潮对区域经济造成严重影响，需要系统性分析和政策建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际财经理论、移民经济学、区域经济一体化理论
AI.method: 量化分析和定性研究相结合，使用IMF的FSGM模型进行宏观经济影响评估
AI.findings: 移民危机对区域经济产生重大影响，需要整体性政策应对
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了移民经济学和区域经济合作理论，提供了宏观模型分析案例
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿富汗及拥抿国(伊朗、巴基斯坦)提供具体政策建议，推动双赢合作方案

title: Local Currency Debt and Sovereign Rollover Risk
affiliations: Seoul National University - Department of Economics, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Department of Economics, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Department of Economics, Students and Vienna University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Local Currency Debt and Sovereign Rollover Risk
detail.abstract: Using granular bond-level data on emerging-market sovereign debt, we construct country-specific maturity structures and document three novel stylized facts: (1) a negative relationship between average maturity and the share of local currency debt; (2) sustained declines in average local-currency debt maturity; and (3) increases in rollover requirements with substantial crosscountry and time variation. We show that the effects of exogenous shocks to capital outflows on rollover risk are substantially amplified in countries with larger shares of short-term local-currency debt, as reflected in sharper increases in exchange rates, bond yields, and CDS spreads. Our results underscore the lasting effects of the "original sin."

AI.tldr: 使用稀土市场主权债券数据构建成熟市场国家的期限结构，发现了三个新的定性事实，并证明外生出资流出冲击对即将到期风险的影响在短期本币债务占比较高的国家中更大，强调了"原罪"的持久影响。
AI.research_question: 外生出资流出冲击如何影响不同债务结构的稀土市场国家的即将到期风险？
AI.motivation: 理解稀土市场主权债务结构与即将到期风险之间的关系，尤其是在外部冲击下的传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 原罪理论，货币区域理论，债务结构与风险传导理论。
AI.method: 使用细层面的债券级别数据构建国家特定的期限结构，并通过实证分析检验外生出资流出冲击对即将到期风险的影响。
AI.findings:
1）平均期限与本币债务份额存在负相关关系
2）本币债务平均期限持续下降
3）即将到期需求增加且存在显著的跨国和时间差异
4）短期本币债务占比较高的国家在外生出资流出冲击下更容易出现汇率、债券收益率和CDS利差扩大
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了"原罪"理论的实证基础，提供了债务结构与风险传导的新视角，丰富了货币区域理论的实证内容。
AI.practical_contributions: 为稀土市场国家的债务管理和风险控制提供了实证指导，有助于政策制定者和投资者更好地评估和管理即将到期风险。

title: Evolving Patterns of Gender Inequality Over Time and Across Countries: New Theoretical Perspectives and an Emerging Research Agenda
affiliations: University of Groningen, Stanford University and Warwick Business School

detail.title: Evolving Patterns of Gender Inequality Over Time and Across Countries: New Theoretical Perspectives and an Emerging Research Agenda
detail.abstract: The last century has seen significant gains in women’s agency and status, declining gender gaps in labor force participation, education, and wages, and ‘a rising tide’ of increasingly gender egalitarian societies. Many expected this process to continue. Yet, unexpectedly, progress towards gender equality has started to stall in many countries. We can even observe a clear backlash against gender equality in some countries. The optimistic predictions of gender convergence as suggested by modernization theory have not materialized. Moreover, counterintuitively, the most gender egalitarian societies (e.g., Denmark and Sweden) have the highest level of gender segregation in jobs and educational fields, a phenomenon also known as the gender-equality paradox. In these countries, women are less likely to major in STEM and more likely to major in the humanities, with important consequences for the gender gap in wages. These observations matter for the field of international business (IB), which has studied cross-country differences in gender equality and the implications for management practices across the world. Our theories in IB cannot explain the gender-equality paradox or the backlash against gender equality observed across countries. The good news is that new theorizing is emerging in sociology and political science, with tremendous opportunities for IB. The purpose of our editorial is to describe how these insights can propel IB research, and to chart an exciting way forward.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了性别平等进程的停滞和反弹现象，特别是在最性别平等的社会中出现的性别隔离悖论，并呼吁国际商务领域借鉴社会学和政治学的新理论来解释这些现象。
AI.research_question: 为什么在最性别平等的社会中会出现最高的性别职业和教育隔离（性别平等悖论），以及国际商务理论如何解释全球范围内的性别平等反弹现象？
AI.motivation: 性别平等进程在许多国家出现停滞甚至反弹，现代化理论预测的性别趋同并未实现，而国际商务领域的现有理论无法解释性别平等悖论和全球性别平等反弹现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现代化理论、性别平等悖论理论、社会学和政治学中新出现的性别理论
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析
AI.findings: 最性别平等的社会（如丹麦、瑞典）存在最高的职业和教育性别隔离，女性更少选择STEM专业而更多选择人文学科，导致工资性别差距；现有IB理论无法解释这些现象
AI.theory_contributions: 为国际商务领域引入新的理论视角，借鉴社会学和政治学理论来解释性别平等悖论和反弹现象，推动IB理论的创新发展
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国企业管理实践提供新的性别平等视角，帮助理解不同文化背景下性别平等的复杂动态，为制定更有效的性别平等政策提供理论指导

title: Regulating Inaction: The Case of Price Walking
affiliations: Imperial College London, London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Department of Economics, University of Southern California and Imperial College London

detail.title: Regulating Inaction: The Case of Price Walking
detail.abstract: We develop a theoretical model and evaluate its predictions using granular search, choice, and insurer pricing data around the introduction of "price walking" regulation in the UK motor insurance market. Prior to the policy, insurers benefited from customer inaction by keeping prices low to attract new customers whilst raising prices for preexisting customers. Post-regulation, price incentives to new likely inactive customers fell, and product proliferation and market segmentation increased in line with insurer incentives. The net effect keeps customer benefits of switching high and maintains price penalties for inaction. These findings illustrate the difficulty of regulating markets with inertial consumers in the face of endogenous supplier responses.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论模型和英国车险市场数据，分析了价格行走监管政策的效果。研究发现，监管后虽然对新客户的低价优惠减少，但供应商通过产品分化和市场细分维持了客户转换收益和价格惩罚，说明在存在惯性消费者的市场中监管面临挑战。
AI.research_question: 价格行走监管政策如何影响英国车险市场的定价策略和消费者福利？
AI.motivation: 监管机构试图通过禁止价格行走（对老客户涨价）来保护消费者，但需要评估这种监管在供应商内生性反应下的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者惯性理论和供应商策略性定价行为，构建理论模型分析监管政策的市场影响。
AI.method: 结合理论模型构建和英国车险市场的细粒度搜索、选择和定价数据，进行政策前后的对比分析。
AI.findings: 监管后，对新潜在不活跃客户的低价激励减少，但产品多样化和市场细分增加，总体上保持了较高的转换收益和对不行动的价格惩罚。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在存在消费者惯性的市场中，监管政策可能引发供应商的内生性策略调整，从而削弱政策效果的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了重要启示：单纯禁止价格行走可能不足以保护消费者，需要更全面的监管框架来应对供应商的策略性反应。

title: Crypto Treasury Companies: Financing Dynamics, Accretion Conditions, and Systemic Risk
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Crypto Treasury Companies: Financing Dynamics, Accretion Conditions, and Systemic Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The research was conducted independently, without institutional involvement. The views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All data used are publicly available; no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding.

detail.abstract: Public companies such as MicroStrategy and Bitmine have adopted a novel corporate model in which shareholder value derives primarily from holding cryptocurrency rather than generating operating cash flows. A central performance metric for these firms is Crypto per Share (CPS), defined as the number of crypto units effectively backing each share. This paper develops an analytical framework to trace how CPS evolves under equity, debt, and convertible financing. Closed-form propositions identify conditions under which financing is accretive or dilutive, and numerical examples illustrate favorable and unfavorable cases. The analysis shows that crypto treasury companies behave similarly to leveraged exchange-traded funds: CPS expands more than proportionally in bull markets but contracts more sharply in downturns. Beyond firm-level performance, the paper discusses why investors are attracted to these vehicles, how capital structure choices shape risk, and whether systemic vulnerabilities may arise if such firms proliferate. To our knowledge, this is the first formal study to characterize CPS mechanics and their broader implications for corporate finance and financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统分析了加密货币储备公司的新型商业模式，重点研究CPS（每股加密货币持有量）在不同融资方式下的变化机制，揭示了这类公司类似于杠杆ETF的风险特征，并探讨了对公司金融和金融稳定的影响。
AI.research_question: 加密货币储备公司如何通过股权、债务和可转换融资影响每股加密货币持有量（CPS）的演变？这些融资方式在什么条件下会产生增值或稀释效应？
AI.motivation: MicroStrategy和Bitmine等上市公司采用了一种新型商业模式，其股东价值主要来源于持有加密货币而非产生经营现金流。需要理解这种模式下关键绩效指标CPS的演变机制及其对公司金融和金融稳定的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司金融理论，特别是资本结构理论和杠杆效应理论，结合加密货币市场的特殊性，构建分析CPS演变的框架。
AI.method: 开发分析框架追踪CPS在股权、债务和可转换融资下的演变，提出闭式命题识别增值或稀释条件，并通过数值示例说明有利和不利情况。
AI.findings: 加密货币储备公司的行为类似于杠杆交易所交易基金：在牛市中CPS扩张超过比例，但在下跌时收缩更剧烈。不同融资方式对CPS产生不同的增值或稀释效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次正式研究CPS机制及其对公司金融和金融稳定的更广泛影响，为理解新型加密货币企业商业模式提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解加密货币储备公司的风险收益特征提供指导，为企业资本结构选择提供参考，并为监管机构识别系统性风险提供分析工具。

title: Automated Evidence Extraction and Scoring for Corporate Climate Policy Engagement: A Multilingual RAG Approach
affiliations: University of Zurich, University of Zurich, University of Zurich - Department of Finance, University of Zurich and University of Zurich

detail.title: Automated Evidence Extraction and Scoring for Corporate Climate Policy Engagement: A Multilingual RAG Approach
detail.abstract: InfluenceMap's LobbyMap Platform monitors the climate policy engagement of over 500 companies and 250 industry associations, assessing each entity's support or opposition to science-based policy pathways for achieving the Paris Agreement's goal of limiting global warming to 1.5°C. Although InfluenceMap has made progress with automating key elements of the analytical workflow, a significant portion of the assessment remains manual, making it time- and labor-intensive and susceptible to human error. We propose an AI-assisted framework to accelerate the monitoring of corporate climate policy engagement by leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation to automate the most time-intensive extraction of relevant evidence from large-scale textual data. Our evaluation shows that a combination of layout-aware parsing, the Nomic embedding model, and few-shot prompting strategies yields the best performance in extracting and classifying evidence from multilingual corporate documents. We conclude that while the automated RAG system effectively accelerates evidence extraction, the nuanced nature of the analysis necessitates a human-in-the-loop approach where the technology augments, rather than replaces, expert judgment to ensure accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI辅助框架，利用检索增强生成技术自动化从企业文件中提取气候政策参与证据，显著提升效率但仍需人工专家参与确保准确性
AI.research_question: 如何利用AI技术自动化企业气候政策参与监测中的证据提取过程，同时保持分析的准确性
AI.motivation: 当前企业气候政策参与监测主要依赖人工分析，耗时耗力且易出错，需要自动化解决方案提高效率
AI.theoretical_framework: 检索增强生成(RAG)理论、少样本学习、多语言文档分析、人机协同决策框架
AI.method: 结合布局感知解析、Nomic嵌入模型和少样本提示策略的RAG系统，从多语言企业文件中提取和分类证据
AI.findings: 自动化RAG系统能有效加速证据提取，但分析的复杂性需要人机协同方法，技术应增强而非替代专家判断
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI辅助企业气候政策监测的理论框架，验证了RAG技术在此领域的适用性和局限性
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可实际应用的企业气候政策参与自动化监测工具，为类似政策分析任务提供了技术解决方案

title: Moral Sentiments and Investor Behavior: Evidence from the Chernobyl Disaster
affiliations: and China Europe International Business School

detail.title: Moral Sentiments and Investor Behavior: Evidence from the Chernobyl Disaster
detail.abstract: We exploit meteorological conditions prevailing in Sweden at the time of the Chernobyl accident, which created stark regional differences in exposure to a large-scale environmental shock within the same population. Using comprehensive register-based data, we test whether this quasi-random variation in "Chernobyl experiences" predicts subsequent values-based investment behavior. Investors in the most affected regions are about 20% more likely to allocate to socially responsible assets compared to otherwise similar investors in the least affected regions. The effect is robust to extensive individual-level controls, including health status, and to alternative specifications addressing regional sorting. Our findings provide novel evidence that lived experiences of salient societal shocks can durably shift portfolio preferences, highlighting a moral-sentiment channel in household finance that persists well beyond standard risk-return considerations.

AI.tldr: 利用切尔诺贝利事故期间瑞典的气象条件差异，研究发现受辐射影响更严重地区的投资者投资社会责任资产的可能性高出20%，表明重大社会冲击的亲身经历能持久改变投资偏好。
AI.research_question: 切尔诺贝利事故的经历是否会影响个人基于价值观的投资行为？
AI.motivation: 探讨重大环境冲击的亲身经历如何持久影响个人的道德情感和投资决策，超越传统的风险收益考量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为金融学中的道德情感渠道理论，研究社会冲击对投资偏好的长期影响。
AI.method: 利用瑞典切尔诺贝利事故期间的气象条件差异作为准自然实验，使用全面的登记数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 受影响最严重地区的投资者投资社会责任资产的可能性比受影响最小地区高出约20%，效应在控制健康状态等个体因素后依然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 为重大社会冲击对投资偏好的持久影响提供了新颖证据，强调了家庭金融中的道德情感渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解环境灾难等社会冲击如何长期塑造投资者的价值观和投资行为，对资产管理和社会责任投资有启示意义。

title: Media Pressure and Reputational Herding in ESG Performance Dynamics
affiliations: Seoul National University

detail.title: Media Pressure and Reputational Herding in ESG Performance Dynamics
detail.abstract: This paper examines how media exposure influences firms' ESG strategies through reputational herding. Drawing on panel data for S&P 500 firms from 2011 to 2023, we conduct our analysis based on Refinitiv ESG ratings, ESG-related media exposure, and AIanalyzed ESG scores from 10-K filings. We find that firms with higher media exposure tend to attain higher ESG ratings and show quicker incorporation of internal disclosures into external ratings. In addition, corporate ESG development follows reputational herding, which has asymmetric dynamics. Higher exposure amplifies upward adjustments when below the peer average and softens downward adjustments when above it, while lower ones show weaker upward and sharper downward adjustments. Taken together, these findings highlight the role of media as a signal amplifier that conditions reputational incentives and the dynamics of ESG development.

AI.tldr: 媒体曝光通过声誉羊群效应影响企业ESG策略，高曝光企业获得更高ESG评级且内部披露更快转化为外部评级，ESG发展呈现不对称动态调整
AI.research_question: 媒体曝光如何通过声誉羊群效应影响企业的ESG策略？
AI.motivation: 探讨媒体在企业ESG发展中的作用机制，特别是作为信号放大器如何调节声誉激励和ESG发展动态
AI.theoretical_framework: 声誉羊群理论、信号传递理论、媒体效应理论
AI.method: 基于2011-2023年标普500企业的面板数据分析，使用Refinitiv ESG评级、ESG相关媒体曝光数据和AI分析的10-K文件ESG得分
AI.findings: 高媒体曝光企业获得更高ESG评级，内部披露更快转化为外部评级；ESG发展遵循声誉羊群效应，具有不对称动态：高曝光放大低于同行平均时的向上调整，软化高于平均时的向下调整；低曝光则表现出较弱的向上调整和更剧烈的向下调整
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了媒体作为信号放大器在ESG发展中的调节作用，深化了对声誉羊群效应不对称动态的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业制定ESG策略提供指导，帮助理解媒体曝光对ESG评级的影响机制，为投资者和监管机构提供决策参考

title: Breeding Delays Determine the Wavelength of the Pork Cycle
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, KU Leuven - Faculty of Business and Economics (FEB), Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management and Wageningen University and Research (WUR)

detail.title: Breeding Delays Determine the Wavelength of the Pork Cycle
detail.abstract: The pork cycle exhibits persistent oscillations in prices and production with a wavelength of three to six years. We develop a System Dynamics model in which cyclical behaviour arises endogenously from biological delays and rational adjustment rules, without the explicit modelling of price or forward-looking optimization from decision-makers. The model reproduces a substantial share of the observed variation in Dutch pork prices and explains the gradual shortening of the cycle through technological changes that reduced production lead times. Counterfactual experiments further suggest policy levers for moderating the cycle's amplitude. Our findings do not imply that prices are irrelevant; rather, they highlight that a significant part of the pork cycle is structural, with prices primarily reflecting underlying production delays. This perspective complements rational-expectations models and clarifies why similar "pork cycle" patterns appear in other industries with long lead times.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统动力学模型解释了猪肉周期现象，发现生物延迟和理性调整规则是导致3-6年价格生产波动的内生原因，而非价格预期或优化决策。模型成功重现了荷兰猪肉价格变化，并解释了技术变革缩短周期的机制。
AI.research_question: 猪肉周期现象的波动机制是什么？价格和生产的内生周期性行为是如何形成的？
AI.motivation: 传统理性预期模型无法完全解释猪肉周期的持续波动现象，需要从结构性因素角度探究其内在机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统动力学理论、内生周期理论、生物延迟机制、理性调整规则
AI.method: 构建系统动力学模型，包含生物延迟和理性调整规则，进行历史数据拟合和反事实实验
AI.findings: 模型能够重现荷兰猪肉价格的大部分变化，技术变革通过减少生产提前期逐步缩短了周期长度，价格主要反映生产延迟而非驱动周期
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了猪肉周期的结构性解释框架，补充了理性预期模型，解释了长提前期行业的类似周期现象
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了调节周期幅度的政策杠杆，为行业稳定提供管理启示
