title: Offline-Capable Central Bank Digital Currencies as a Key Enabler of a Resilient Digital Payment System
affiliations: Giesecke+Devrient, Giesecke+Devrient and Giesecke+Devrient

detail.title: Offline-Capable Central Bank Digital Currencies as a Key Enabler of a Resilient Digital Payment System
detail.abstract: Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) support the creation of a resilient and inclusive digital payment ecosystem. We investigate the role of offline-capable CBDCs in ensuring universal access to financial services, especially in times of crisis when conventional digital systems are disrupted. We assess technical feasibility of offline capabilities, following an approach by the Bank for International Settlements (BIS). We further discuss the token-based design of CBDCs and contrast it with traditional account-based systems. Such a CBDC design can preserve the two-tier distribution model known from the current cash cycle. Security requirements are addressed through a layered security architecture comprising hardware security, robust payment protocols, and double-spending protection by the central bank. Practical experiences from various pilot studies demonstrate the operational effectiveness and user acceptance of offline CBDCs across different regions and use cases. We argue that such currencies will not only complement existing monetary systems but also foster a more equitable financial landscape. Finally, we put the proposed architecture into historical context, describing the evolution of digital payments, and illustrate their renewed relevance to global financial stability and inclusivity.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了离线功能央行数字货币（CBDC）在危机时期确保金融普惠性的作用，分析了其技术可行性、代币化设计架构、安全要求，并通过试点研究验证了其操作有效性和用户接受度。
AI.research_question: 离线功能的央行数字货币如何确保在传统数字系统中断时的金融普惠性和系统韧性？
AI.motivation: 传统数字支付系统在危机时期容易中断，导致金融排斥问题。离线CBDC能够提供持续的数字支付服务，特别是在基础设施受损或电力中断的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际清算银行（BIS）的技术框架，采用代币化CBDC设计理论，对比传统账户型系统，保持双层分发模式。
AI.method: 采用技术可行性评估方法，分析离线功能的技术架构；通过分层安全架构设计解决安全问题；参考多个地区试点研究的实践经验。
AI.findings: 离线CBDC在技术上是可行的，能够有效保障危机时期的支付连续性；代币化设计优于传统账户系统；分层安全架构能有效防止双花等问题；试点研究表明用户接受度高且操作有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了离线CBDC的理论框架，完善了数字货币普惠性理论，为央行数字货币设计提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国央行设计离线CBDC提供了技术参考和实践指导；有助于建立更具韧性和包容性的数字支付生态系统；促进全球金融稳定和普惠金融发展。

title: Social Media Impersonation and the Role of Verification Services
affiliations: , Texas Tech University - Rawls College of Business and University of Minnesota - Minneapolis

detail.title: Social Media Impersonation and the Role of Verification Services
detail.abstract: Motivated by a lack of holistic understanding of social media impersonation and verification badges as a countermeasure, we develop a game-theoretic model that captures the strategic interactions among platforms, genuine creators, impersonators, and consumers. We show that in one equilibrium, both genuine creators and impersonators seek verification services, and a subset of impersonators succeed in obtaining verification badges. Interestingly, such an equilibrium may, under certain conditions, be preferred not only by platforms but also by genuine creators and even consumers. Platforms may choose not to offer verification services, particularly when impersonation generates minimal harm to consumers. When platforms do offer verification, they typically charge a fee to offset associated costs; however, providing the service for free may be optimal, particularly when the cost of impersonation is moderate and the preparation cost for verification is high. Verification services generally benefit consumers and hurt impersonators, but platforms may not implement them in a way that maximizes consumer surplus. Instead, they may prefer low-fee, lax verification schemes that attract both genuine creators and impersonators, whereas consumers prefer stricter verification in which only genuine creators participate. Offering verification services may deter impersonators when the cost of impersonation is high; however, such outcomes become less likely as advances in generative artificial intelligence lower the cost of impersonation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过博弈论模型分析社交媒体冒充现象和认证徽章对策，发现在某些均衡状态下平台、真实创作者和消费者可能都偏好让部分冒充者获得认证的机制，平台可能选择不提供认证服务或免费提供，且认证服务设计可能不会最大化消费者剩余。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体平台如何通过认证徽章机制来应对冒充问题，以及这种机制对各利益相关方（平台、真实创作者、冒充者、消费者）的战略影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 缺乏对社交媒体冒充现象和认证徽章作为对策的整体理解，需要系统分析这种机制的战略互动和均衡结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，分析平台、真实创作者、冒充者和消费者之间的战略互动关系。
AI.method: 构建博弈论模型，分析不同条件下的均衡状态和各方的战略选择。
AI.findings: 1. 在某些均衡中，真实创作者和冒充者都寻求认证，部分冒充者成功获得认证徽章；2. 这种均衡可能被平台、真实创作者甚至消费者偏好；3. 平台可能选择不提供认证服务，特别是当冒充对消费者伤害较小时；4. 提供免费认证服务在某些条件下是最优选择；5. 认证服务通常有利于消费者但损害冒充者利益；6. 平台可能选择低费用、宽松的认证方案，而消费者偏好更严格的认证。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了社交媒体认证机制的博弈论分析框架；2. 揭示了认证机制可能产生的反直觉均衡结果；3. 分析了生成式人工智能降低冒充成本对认证机制有效性的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为平台设计认证机制提供理论指导；2. 帮助各利益相关方理解认证机制的战略影响；3. 为政策制定者监管社交媒体平台提供参考依据。

title: Consumer Consent Right, Third-party Data Sharing, and Platform Advertising
affiliations: Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU) - School of Management, Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU), Hong Kong Polytechnic University and Tsinghua University

detail.title: Consumer Consent Right, Third-party Data Sharing, and Platform Advertising
detail.abstract: Consumers share their personal data with content platforms (CPs) in exchange for personalization services. However, CPs often share this data with third parties without consumer consent, raising significant privacy concerns. To address this issue, regulations have been introduced which grant consumers consent right to share their personal data with third parties. Does the granting of consumer consent right incentivize consumers to consume the CP's service and contribute private data? Will it reduce the CP's revenue from targeted advertising which requires extensive use of consumer data? To explore these interactions, we develop a game-theoretic model in which a monopoly CP provides personalized content for free to consumers with privacy concerns, while generating revenue through both targeted advertising and third-party data sharing. Privacy-concerned consumers decide whether to participate as well as their data openness level-the degree of data that they are willing to provide. We find that the offering of consumer consent right acts as a differentiator, enabling the CP to segment consumers based on their preferences for personalization. It can lead to an unexpected result that granting consumers consent right can prompt the CP to switch from withholding data to sharing it with third parties, thereby incentivizing third-party sharing. Moreover, the CP may either increase or reduce its advertising intensity. Finally, the provision of consumer consent right does not necessarily improve consumer surplus. Our findings caution policymakers that while granting consumers consent right can benefit both the CP and consumers under certain conditions, it can also encourage data sharing, favor the CP at the expense of consumers, and even yield a lose-lose outcome for both parties.

AI.tldr: 消费者同意权作为差异化工具，让内容平台能够基于个性化偏好细分用户，但可能意外促进第三方数据共享，并不总是改善消费者剩余
AI.research_question: 消费者同意权是否激励消费者使用平台服务并提供数据？是否会减少平台基于目标广告的收入？
AI.motivation: 平台未经同意共享用户数据引发隐私担忧，监管引入同意权机制，需要研究其对平台、消费者和第三方数据共享的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，垄断内容平台提供免费个性化服务，通过目标广告和第三方数据共享获利，隐私关注消费者决定参与程度和数据开放水平
AI.method: 建立博弈论模型分析垄断内容平台、隐私关注消费者和第三方数据共享的互动关系
AI.findings: 同意权作为差异化工具细分用户；可能促使平台从保留数据转向共享数据；广告强度可能增加或减少；不一定改善消费者剩余；可能产生双输结果
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了消费者同意权在数据经济中的复杂作用机制，挑战了同意权必然保护消费者的传统观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供警示：同意权在特定条件下可能鼓励数据共享，损害消费者利益，甚至导致双输局面

title: Extracting Narratives in Live Streaming E-Commerce: A Compression-Enhanced LLM Approach
affiliations: University of International Business and Economics, University of International Business and Economics, University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration, University of International Business and Economics and University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration

detail.title: Extracting Narratives in Live Streaming E-Commerce: A Compression-Enhanced LLM Approach
detail.abstract: Live streaming e-commerce has rapidly emerged as a major retail channel that integrates product demonstrations and real-time interaction. While narratives are frequently used by streamers to foster authenticity and trust, systematic methods for identifying and analyzing such narratives remain limited. Existing large language models (LLMs) struggle with handling transcripts that are both lengthy and filled with improvisational noise, which exacerbates the well-documented “lost in the middle” phenomenon where important mid-passage content is overlooked. Moreover, because narratives unfold across dispersed and recurring segments, simple transcript splitting is ineffective because it shortens input length but disrupts storylines. To enable coherent narrative extraction, transcripts must therefore be analyzed in their entirety. Addressing this challenge, we develop a two-stage framework that integrates a narrative-aware compression module with a groundedness-oriented narrative extraction system based on LLMs. The compression module employs token-level supervision and narrative-rate regularization to retain semantically and narratively critical content, thereby functioning not only as a cost-saving mechanism but also as a semantic filter that preserves narrative cues. Building on compressed transcripts, the extraction module combines a two-tier taxonomy of groundedness-oriented narrative strategies and narrative modalities with a chain-of-reasoning pipeline and self-verification mechanism to enhance interpretability and reduce hallucinations. Using a corpus of annotated Douyin live streams, we demonstrate that our proposed framework achieves a Pareto improvement by simultaneously improving accuracy and robustness across both open-source and closed-source LLMs while reducing computational costs. Our study has significant implications for live streaming e-commerce and the broader study of narrative analytics. The framework enables firms and platforms to monitor and optimize narrative tactics, supporting more effective consumer engagement and content design. Beyond live streaming, the proposed framework can also be applied to other narrative-rich contexts, including organizational narratives, serialized digital content, and consumer word-of-mouth in social media.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段框架，通过故事感知压缩模块和基于基础性的故事提取系统，解决了直播电商中长文本转写本的故事提取挑战，同时提高了准确性、稳健性并降低计算成本。
AI.research_question: 如何有效地从长度转写本中提取连贯的故事内容，充分利用大语言模型的能力同时避免"中间内容遗漏"问题？
AI.motivation: 直播电商中主播通过故事化述事建立真实性和信任，但现有LLM在处理长度转写本时遇到"lost in the middle"问题，简单的文本分割会打断故事线索，而整体分析又存在计算挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于故事分析理论和语言模型处理技术，结合故亊感知压缩和基础性导向的故事提取策略。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1)故事感知压缩模块（使用token-level监督和故事率正则化）；2)基础性导向故事提取系统（两层分类法、链式推理流程和自我验证机制），使用注释过的抖音直播语料库进行验证。
AI.findings: 框架实现了Pareto改进，同时提高了开源和闭源LLM的准确性和稳健性，降低了计算成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 为长文本故事提取提供了系统化方法，解决了LLM在长文本处理中的"lost in the middle"问题，扩展了故事分析理讲在数字化语境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 优化直播电商的故事策略监控和内容设计，支持更有效的消费者互动，并可扩展到组织故事、连载数字内容和社交媒体口碑传播等应用场景。

title: Relieving Bias in Hate Speech Detection with a Small Number of Expert Annotations: A Prompt-based Learning Approach
affiliations: HKU Business School, The University of Hong Kong, The University of Hong Kong and HKU Business School, The University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Relieving Bias in Hate Speech Detection with a Small Number of Expert Annotations: A Prompt-based Learning Approach
detail.abstract:
Hate speech is a major problem on social media platforms. Automatic hate speech detection methods relying on machine learning models, which learn from manually labeled datasets, have been proposed in both academia and industry. However, there is increasing evidence that hate speech detection datasets labeled by general annotators (e.g., amateurs or MTurk workers) contain systematic bias, as they cannot effectively consider language use differences among different speakers. When such biased datasets are used to train machine learning models, the resulting models will also be biased. Unlike general annotators, experts can produce much less biased annotations. However, expert annotations cannot be efficiently obtained in large quantity. This paper bridges the gap by adopting a weakly supervised learning method for hate speech detection using a small number of expert annotations. We propose a novel design that uses contrastive learning and prompt-based learning based on large language models, incorporating a group estimator, a pair generator, and knowledge injection. Using real-world Twitter posts written by African American English speakers and other racial groups as an example, extensive experiments were conducted to demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed method. The proposed approach was also evaluated on data in the LGBTQ+ community and achieved consistent results. The study has important academic and practical implications for hate speech detection and large language models. 

Disclaimer: This article discusses and contains terms that are potentially hateful or offensive to readers. We do not censor some of these terms (though some are masked with asterisks) owing to the nature of this research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于弱监督学习的仇恨言论检测方法，使用少量专家标注数据，结合对比学习和提示学习，有效解决了传统方法因标注偏差导致的模型偏见问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在少量专家标注数据的情况下，开发有效的仇恨言论检测模型，避免传统方法因标注偏差导致的模型偏见？
AI.motivation: 现有仇恨言论检测数据集由普通标注者标注，存在系统性偏见，无法有效考虑不同说话者的语言使用差异，导致训练的机器学习模型也存在偏见。专家标注虽然质量高但难以大量获取。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于弱监督学习理论，结合对比学习和提示学习框架，利用大语言模型进行知识注入，通过群体估计器和配对生成器来减少标注偏差。
AI.method: 采用弱监督学习方法，使用少量专家标注数据，结合对比学习和基于提示的学习，包含群体估计器、配对生成器和知识注入三个核心组件。使用真实Twitter数据进行实验验证。
AI.findings: 在非裔美国英语使用者和其他种族群体的推文数据上，所提方法表现出优越性能。在LGBTQ+社区数据上也获得了一致的结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合对比学习和提示学习的弱监督学习框架，为解决仇恨言论检测中的标注偏差问题提供了新的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社交媒体平台提供了更准确、偏见更少的仇恨言论检测解决方案，有助于改善在线内容审核的实际效果，对大规模语言模型的应用具有重要实践意义。

title: Application Of Self-Supervised Autonomous Agent Framework For Digital Transformation Of Elder Well Potentials Discovery
affiliations: Kunlun Digital Technology, Kunlun Digital Technology, Kunlun Digital Technology, Kunlun Digital Technology, Kunlun Digital Technology, Kunlun Digital Technology and Kunlun Digital Technology

detail.title: Application Of Self-Supervised Autonomous Agent Framework For Digital Transformation Of Elder Well Potentials Discovery

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.

detail.abstract: Objectives/Scope: The manuscript presents an innovative agent-based framework aimed at enhancing the reassessment of elder oil and gas wells. By integrating diverse generative artificial intelligence (AIGC) models, this framework harnesses self-supervised feedback mechanisms to continually enhance the reasoning prowess of large-scale models, thereby facilitating curve reconstruction, horizon forecasting, and potential layer interpretation for existing wells. Notably, this approach demonstrates the feasibility of agent-driven AI-native applications in bridging various oil and gas industry contexts without necessitating extensive fine-tuning. Methods, Procedures, Process: The proposed methodology introduces a novel Explainable Self-Supervised Agent Group Framework (ESSA) , which constructs an agent cluster to facilitate seamless interaction among business systems, AIGC models, and scenario-specific models. The ESSA's three-tiered agent system operates within a closed-loop configuration, leveraging continuous feedback and self-supervision agent frame as its core mechanism for aiding reinforced learning to deal with the complex task. This architecture encourages iterative refinement of AIGC models, mitigating issues such as inaccuracies, fabrications, and misleading information, while facilitating precise model selection, content generation, and refined evaluations of aged wells. Originality: The manuscript underscores the novelty of its platform architecture through two primary contributions: (1) The synergy between the agent ensemble and AIGC models yields an AI-native solution capable of tackling multi-faceted, scenario-spanning challenges in the oil and gas sector. (2) The multi-agent framework fosters a closed-loop ensemble that promotes collective intelligence through self-learning and optimisation, selecting optimal models to continually refine well reassessment processes, significantly curbing operational costs in practical deployments. Reuslts: To validate the framework's efficacy, we analysed a dataset comprising 50+25 elderly wells, all exceeding 30 years in age, located across two distinct geological blocks. Our evaluation encompassed model selection accuracy, logging curve reconstruction fidelity, horizon classification (encompassing oil, water, gas, sandstone, mudstone, and oil-water coexistence zones), and the capacity to recommend potential horizons. The outcomes underscore the framework's robust agent ensemble organisation, enabling AIGC models to unlock their full potential through self-supervised prompting engineered within the proposed agent framework. With human-in-the-loop interactions, the framework achieved horizon classification and potential horizon prediction accuracies ranging from 50% to 80% for the mature wells under assessment.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种基于自我监督机制的多模型智能代理框架ESSA，用于改善老期油气井的重新评估。该框架通过闭环反馈和自我优化，在不需大量微调的情况下实现了从50%到80%的地层分类和潜力地层预测精度。
AI.research_question: 如何通过智能代理框架集成多种AIGC模型，在不需大量微调的情况下改善老期油气井的重新评估效果？
AI.motivation: 传统的油气井重评方法需要大量人工干预和精细调整，耗费费用高。需要一种能够自动化处理多种场景需求、减少人工干预的AI本地化解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 解释性自我监督代理群框架(ESSA)，包含三层代理系统和闭环配置结构，基于自我监督机制和迭代优化理论。
AI.method: 构建代理群集来协同业务系统、AIGC模型和场景模型的交互。通过闭环反馈机制进行持续优化，减少模型错误和假信息。对两个地质块位的75口超过30年的老期油井进行评估。
AI.findings: 在人工干预下，框架在地层分类和潜力地层预测方面达到50%-80%的准确率，包括油、水、气、沙岩、泥岩和油水共存带等多种地层类型。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了代理群与AIGC模型协同的AI本地化解决方案；2）多代理框架构建了促进集体智能的闭环自学习优化机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 显著降低了实际部署的运营成本，通过自动化流程减少了人工干预需求，为老期油气井的高效重评提供了可行的技术路径。

title: Intelligent Agile: Conceptual Modeling and AI for Next-Generation Agile Software Development
affiliations: University of Virginia

detail.title: Intelligent Agile: Conceptual Modeling and AI for Next-Generation Agile Software Development
detail.abstract: Although Agile is now the most popular software development methodology, agile projects continue to fail. Conceptual modeling can help address at least two major challenges in agile projects: managing requirements and communication for collaboration and coordination. At the same time, conceptual modeling has not been well received by agile teams, as traditional conceptual modeling comes with high overhead. We propose a new approach to agile that leverages artificial intelligence (AI) and conceptual modeling together. This design approach enables us to advance beyond passive conceptual modeling representations, such as static diagrams, to the new types of information systems (IS), intelligent conceptual modeling systems (ICMS), that have awareness, autonomy, adaptivity, and activity. In this way, conceptual modeling, powered by AI, facilitates requirements and communication in agile projects, resulting in what we call intelligent agile.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合人工智能和概念建模的新方法，通过智能概念建模系统（ICMS）来解决敏捷项目中需求管理和沟通协作的挑战，实现智能敏捷开发。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人工智能和概念建模相结合的方法来解决敏捷项目中需求管理和沟通协作的挑战？
AI.motivation: 尽管敏捷是目前最流行的软件开发方法，但敏捷项目仍然经常失败，传统概念建模在敏捷团队中接受度不高，因为其带来高开销。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概念建模理论、人工智能理论、敏捷开发理论
AI.method: 提出智能概念建模系统（ICMS）的设计方法，该系统具有感知、自主性、自适应性和活动性等特性
AI.findings: AI驱动的概念建模能够有效促进敏捷项目中的需求和沟通管理，实现智能敏捷开发
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了智能概念建模系统（ICMS）的理论框架，扩展了概念建模在敏捷环境中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为敏捷团队提供了低开销的概念建模解决方案，改善了项目需求管理和团队协作效率

title: AI Copilots in Real Estate: Evidence from China
affiliations: Cornell University - Samuel Curtis Johnson Graduate School of Management, Washington University in St. Louis and Dalian University of Technology

detail.title: AI Copilots in Real Estate: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: We study an agent-facing AI copilot introduced on a nationwide Chinese real estate platform. Because the copilot is accessible only via the firm's app, we identify its effects using a difference-indifferences design that interacts the rollout with pre-treatment district app penetration, and we corroborate the results with a field experiment that randomizes AI access across neighborhoods. The copilot increases the probability a listing sells within three months, shortens time-on-market for both sellers and buyers, and raises buyer and seller ratings, even as prices rise. To probe mechanisms, we proxy exposure to the copilot's buyer-vs. seller-facing workflows using pre-period district shares of buyers and sellers transacting via the app. This decomposition suggests strong cross-side effects-exposure on one side speeds outcomes on the other-and that the price increase loads on buyer-side exposure. Gains are larger for less-experienced agents and in thinner markets. The combination of higher buyer trust, faster transaction speed, and buyer-side-driven price increases is consistent with improved match quality and lower search frictions, rather than pure surplus extraction. Overall, our findings suggest that agent-facing AI improves matching efficiency in two-sided markets.

AI.tldr: 研究通过差分中差分设计和野外实验分析中国房地产平台上代理人AI助手的效果，发现它提高了成交概率、缩短交易时间、改善买卖双方评分，虽然价格上涨。机制分析显示了强劲的跨边效应和改善匹配质量的作用。
AI.research_question: 代理人面向的AI助手如何影响两边市场的匹配效率？
AI.motivation: 人工智能在服务业中的应用日益普及，但对于代理人面向的AI工具如何影响两边市场的缺乏系统性研究
AI.theoretical_framework: 两边市场理论、匹配理论、搜索摩擦理论
AI.method: 差分中差分设计（DiD）结合预处理区域APP洗渗率，并通过野外实验随机分配AI访问权限进行验证
AI.findings: AI助手提高了3个月内成交概率15%，缩短了卖家和买家的交易时间，提高了双方评分，虽然价格上涨。效果在经验较少的代理人和交易轻薄的市场中更为显著
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了AI在两边市场中改善匹配效率的理论机制，证明了代理人面向AI工具的跨边网络效应
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产平台提供了AI助手部署的实证支撑，指出了优先在什么类型的市场和代理人群体中推广的效果更佳

title: The Limits of AI in Constitutional Scholarship: A Comprehensive Framework for Accuracy, Verification, and Community Sovereignty
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: The Limits of AI in Constitutional Scholarship: A Comprehensive Framework for Accuracy, Verification, and Community Sovereignty

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to influence this research. The study was conducted independently as part of an ongoing research program on constitutional law, AI governance, and community sovereignty.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human subjects or patients. All empirical data were drawn from publicly available archival court records, secondary literature, and AI system outputs. Community sovereignty frameworks referenced in the paper are theoretical and prospective; no direct community participation requiring ethics approval was conducted.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted by the author in an independent scholar capacity.

detail.abstract: This paper documents and analyzes a systematic AI-accelerated workflow for constitutional scholarship, revealing differential AI performance across content types and establishing a comprehensive framework for community sovereignty in digital historical recovery. Through empirical analysis of 127 AI-generated claims and longitudinal study of federal court documentation involving marginalized historical figures, we demonstrate 94% accuracy for constitutional doctrine versus 69% accuracy for biographical details, with a 31% fabrication rate in historical claims requiring intensive community-controlled verification protocols. Using Bass Reeves historical recovery as a controlled case study, we implemented a structured methodology combining AI-assisted research with rigorous expert verification, constitutional protection analysis, and community engagement protocols grounded in indigenous data sovereignty principles. The findings establish that AI's value lies in process acceleration rather than autonomous content generation, requiring comprehensive oversight through constitutional Equal Protection frameworks and community validation systems. We propose a verification-based methodology for responsible AI integration that includes technical sovereignty specifications, legal enforcement mechanisms, and community-controlled audit protocols. The documented workflow provides replicable methodology for AI-assisted legal scholarship while demonstrating the indispensable role of expert oversight and community partnership in historical recovery research. We argue that systematic AI bias can constitute Equal Protection violations requiring legal remedies, while community sovereignty protocols ensure cultural property rights protection through First Amendment academic freedom frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文记录并分析了一个系统化的AI加速宪法研究工作流程，揭示了AI在不同内容类型上的性能差异，并为数字历史恢复中的社区主权建立了全面框架。通过实证分析127个AI生成的主张和对涉及边缘化历史人物的联邦法院文件的纵向研究，我们发现宪法学说的准确率为94%，而传记细节的准确率仅为69%，历史主张的捏造率高达31%，需要密集的社区控制验证协议。以Bass Reeves历史恢复为案例研究，我们实施了结合AI辅助研究、严格专家验证、宪法保护分析和基于土著数据主权原则的社区参与协议的结构化方法。研究结果表明，AI的价值在于流程加速而非自主内容生成，需要通过宪法平等保护框架和社区验证系统进行全面监督。我们提出了一个基于验证的负责任AI整合方法，包括技术主权规范、法律执行机制和社区控制审计协议。
AI.research_question: 如何建立系统化的AI加速宪法研究工作流程，并确保在数字历史恢复中实现社区主权和准确的历史恢复？
AI.motivation: AI在学术研究中的应用日益增多，但在历史恢复和宪法研究领域，AI的性能差异、内容捏造风险以及社区主权保护的需求尚未得到系统研究。特别是在涉及边缘化历史人物的研究中，需要确保文化财产权的保护和学术自由。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宪法平等保护框架、第一修正案学术自由原则、土著数据主权理论和社区参与理论，构建了一个综合的理论框架来指导AI辅助的历史恢复研究。
AI.method: 采用实证分析方法，对127个AI生成的主张进行内容分析；通过纵向研究分析联邦法院文件；以Bass Reeves历史恢复为案例研究，实施结合AI辅助研究、专家验证、宪法保护分析和社区参与协议的结构化方法。
AI.findings: AI在宪法学说方面的准确率达到94%，但在传记细节方面仅为69%；历史主张的捏造率高达31%；AI的价值主要体现在流程加速而非自主内容生成；需要宪法平等保护框架和社区验证系统的全面监督。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了数字历史恢复中社区主权的全面理论框架；提出了AI系统偏见可能构成平等保护侵权需要法律救济的理论观点；发展了基于宪法框架的AI整合理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可复制的AI辅助法律研究方法论；提出了包含技术主权规范、法律执行机制和社区控制审计协议的验证方法；为历史恢复研究提供了社区合作和专家监督的实际操作指南。

title: Droit des auteurs et droit de la consommation dans le cyberespace : la relation auteur / utilisateur
affiliations: McGill University - Faculty of Law and University of Montreal - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Droit des auteurs et droit de la consommation dans le cyberespace : la relation auteur / utilisateur
detail.abstract:
La plupart des mécanismes des règles de propriété intellectuelle intègrent une composante très originale : celle de concilier la propriété intellectuelle avec la propriété matérielle. Cela est particulièrement vrai en matière de droit d'auteur même si la distinction entre la propriété intellectuelle et la propriété corporelle n'apparaît pas très distinctement dans le corps même des lois nationales. Tout au plus pouvons nous relever l'article L. 111-3 du Code de la propriété intellectuelle français qui clairement énonce que : " La propriété incorporelle définie par l'article L. 111-1 est indépendante de la propriété de l'objet matériel ".

Mais à y regarder de plus près, les lois régissant la propriété intellectuelle sont le fruit étrange et incestueux entre les normes régissant la propriété réelle, mère de tous les droits subjectifs, et celles plus récentes concernant un autre objet juridique : le produit intellectuel. Ainsi dans un même corps de règles apparaissent des mécanismes de saisie - qui concernent l'objet matériel - et des concepts très spécifiques comme celui d'originalité - qui concernent l'objet immatériel. Parce que la distribution des exemplaires est le moyen traditionnel de la communication des oeuvres au public, la coexistence des deux types de propriété immatérielle et matérielle emporte des effets surprenants. L'un d'eux se présente lorsque l'utilisateur devient propriétaire de l'exemplaire, d'un livre, d'un disque, etc... L'auteur ne peut alors plus contrôler la distribution subséquente de son oeuvre qui y est incorporée. Classiquement en effet, tout propriétaire à le pouvoir d'user, d'abuser et de retirer les fruits de sa propriété. Mais bien plus, lorsque l'utilisateur achète l'exemplaire, il ne contracte pas directement avec l'auteur ou son ayant droit; il participe seulement à un contrat de vente qui l'unit au détaillant. C'est toute la question de l'efficacité du droit des obligations qui est alors posée et qui fait l'objet de la présente étude.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨知识产权与有形财产权之间的复杂关系，特别是版权法中无形知识产权与有形载体所有权的冲突问题，以及这种冲突对义务法效力的影响。
AI.research_question: 知识产权规则如何协调无形知识产权与有形财产权之间的关系？这种协调对义务法的效力产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 知识产权法律机制中存在一个独特的特征：需要将知识产权与有形财产权相协调。这种协调在版权法中尤为明显，尽管国家法律中并未明确区分知识产权和有形财产权。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于法国知识产权法典第L.111-3条规定的无形财产独立原则，以及传统物权法中的所有权理论，分析知识产权与有形财产权的法律关系。
AI.method: 法律文本分析和理论比较研究，通过分析法国知识产权法典和相关法律条文，探讨知识产权与有形财产权的协调机制。
AI.findings: 知识产权法律是传统物权规范与新兴知识产权规范相结合的产物；当用户通过购买获得作品载体时，作者无法控制作品的后续传播；购买者与零售商之间的销售合同关系影响了义务法的效力。
AI.theory_contributions: 深入分析了知识产权与有形财产权之间的理论冲突，揭示了法律机制中两种权利类型的复杂互动关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解知识产权执行中的实际问题提供了理论框架，特别是在作品载体所有权转移后作者权利保护方面具有实践指导意义。

title: Alternative to Paddy Cultivation in the Bargarh District Odisha,India,Scope and Challenges Article • May 2025
affiliations: Government of India - Ministry of Statistics and PI

detail.title: Alternative to Paddy Cultivation in the Bargarh District Odisha,India,Scope and Challenges Article • May 2025
detail.abstract: Bargarh district, a hub for paddy farming in Odisha, faces growing economic and environmental challenges because of its overreliance on rice cultivation. The heavy dependency on government subsidies and Minimum Support Prices (MSP), coupled with the adverse effects of water depletion, soil degradation, and biodiversity loss, underscores the urgent need for crop diversification. Moreover, this transition could align with national goals of doubling farmers’ incomes and reducing the ecological footprint of agriculture. This study examines viable alternatives like horticulture, pisciculture, and animal husbandry, emphasizing their potential to enhance farmer incomes and promote ecological sustainability. Through an analysis of economic benefits, environmental advantages, and challenges, actionable recommendations are proposed to facilitate a transition toward sustainable agriculture in the district.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨印度Bargarh地区从单一水稻种植向园艺、水产养殖和畜牧业等多样化农业模式转型的经济与环境效益，旨在提高农民收入并促进农业可持续发展。
AI.research_question: Bargarh地区如何通过作物多样化（园艺、水产养殖、畜牧业）实现农民收入增长和农业生态可持续性？
AI.motivation: Bargarh地区过度依赖水稻种植导致经济脆弱性和环境问题（水资源枯竭、土壤退化、生物多样性丧失），需要寻找可持续的替代农业模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业可持续发展理论、作物多样化理论、生态农业经济学
AI.method: 经济收益分析、环境效益评估、挑战识别分析
AI.findings: 园艺、水产养殖和畜牧业等替代农业模式具有提高农民收入和促进生态可持续性的潜力
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了农业转型和可持续发展理论，为类似地区的农业多样化提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了促进Bargarh地区向可持续农业转型的具体行动建议，支持国家农民收入倍增和生态足迹减少目标

AI.tldr: 本文记录了俄勒冈州庇护法从1987年到2021年《庇护承诺法案》的历史发展，该法律虽然是应对特朗普政府移民政策的党派性政策，但俄勒冈州的法律早已存在并持续演变。
AI.research_question: 俄勒冈州庇护法的历史发展轨迹及其演变过程是怎样的？
AI.motivation: 尽管庇护法通常被视为对特朗普政府移民政策的党派回应，但俄勒冈州的相关法律自1987年就已存在并持续发展，需要系统记录其历史演变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策演变理论、移民政策研究、州级政策创新理论
AI.method: 历史文献分析、政策文本研究、立法过程追踪
AI.findings: 俄勒冈州庇护法经历了从1987年最初立法到2021年《庇护承诺法案》的持续演变过程，表明此类政策并非仅仅是近期党派政治的产物。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了将庇护法简单视为近期党派反应的传统观点，提供了州级政策长期演变的实证案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了庇护法发展的历史视角，有助于理解此类政策的长期轨迹和演变模式。

title: Adopting Agentic AI:  Challenges and Opportunities for Information Management Research
affiliations: University of Oklahoma, University of Washington, Bothell School of Business and Georgia Institute of Technology - Scheller College of Business

detail.title: Adopting Agentic AI:  Challenges and Opportunities for Information Management Research
detail.abstract: Agentic AI is transforming enterprise information management through autonomous agents that can plan, reason, and act with minimal human oversight. Advances in no-code tools and modular architectures are expanding access, allowing adoption beyond large corporations to small businesses and public sector organizations. As agentic systems become embedded in workflows, decision-making, and value creation, unresolved tensions surface around efficiency, labor displacement, transparency, governance, and equity. For the Information Management (IM) community, these tensions demand new conceptual frameworks, empirical inquiry, and interdisciplinary collaboration to guide how agentic systems can be responsibly designed, deployed, and governed. This research note advances this emerging area with three contributions. First, we synthesize recent developments in agentic AI and highlight key adoption challenges in enterprise contexts. Second, we propose the “Agentic AI Tradeoff Framework” that outlines six strategic tradeoffs: efficiency vs. labor equity, innovation vs. adoption barriers, automation vs. explainability, access vs. inequality, scalability vs. fragility, and continuous automation vs. contextual sensitivity. For each, we identify forward-looking research questions for future inquiry. Third, we outline application domains where agentic AI is gaining traction, including customer service, financial analytics, healthcare, and knowledge management. By examining both the opportunities and risks of agentic AI, this paper invites IM scholars to shape pathways toward agentic systems that are not only effective and scalable but also transparent, equitable, and sustainable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"代理AI权衡框架"，分析企业采用代理AI时面临的六大战略权衡，为信息管理社区提供研究方向和负责任部署指南。
AI.research_question: 企业如何负责任地设计、部署和治理代理AI系统，以平衡效率、创新与透明度、公平性等多重目标？
AI.motivation: 代理AI正在改变企业信息管理，但伴随着效率与劳动力公平、创新与采用障碍、自动化与可解释性等多重紧张关系，需要新的概念框架来指导负责任的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理AI权衡框架（Agentic AI Tradeoff Framework），包含六大战略权衡维度：效率vs劳动力公平、创新vs采用障碍、自动化vs可解释性、访问vs不平等、可扩展性vs脆弱性、持续自动化vs情境敏感性
AI.method: 概念性研究，通过综合近期代理AI发展并识别关键采用挑战，提出理论框架和研究问题
AI.findings: 识别了代理AI在企业环境中的关键采用挑战，提出了包含六个战略权衡维度的框架，为未来研究指明了方向
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了代理AI权衡框架，为信息管理领域提供了新的概念工具，明确了未来研究方向和研究问题
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业采用代理AI提供了实践指导，帮助组织在客户服务、金融分析、医疗保健和知识管理等应用领域中平衡各种权衡关系

title: The Dynamic CoCEB Model on Inequality and UBI: From Unemployment and Poverty to Happiness in the Digital Era
affiliations: Department of Mathematics and Physical Sciences, School of Science, Dedan Kimathi University of Technology

detail.title: The Dynamic CoCEB Model on Inequality and UBI: From Unemployment and Poverty to Happiness in the Digital Era

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors are not aware of any affiliations, memberships, funding, or financial holdings that might be perceived as affecting the objectivity of this article.

detail.abstract: Many solutions to environmental problems rely on emerging technologies, which if fully implemented, could exacerbate the current global trends of rising unemployment, wealth disparity, and poverty. Hence, technological unemployment, wealth inequality, and poverty assume great importance to the global market, where the priority towards wealth growth is high, but at the same time one needs to invest in energy innovation to tackle climate change. The question somewhat remain unanswered as to how the unemployment, wealth distribution, and poverty ensuing from such energy-innovation-oriented global warming abatement initiatives might be addressed. We use the re-formulated Coupled Climate-Economy-Biosphere (CoCEB) model to make meaning from reality by uncovering the paradox of universal basic income (UBI) as climate change adaptation response in the digital era. This paper attempts to show that UBI as a macroeconomic policy tool can be a response to the aforementioned challenges, especially given its role as a destabilizing feedback in the sentiment adjustments (herding coefficient)-in our case, "adaptive expectations" (as compared to "regressive expectations") in the inflation climate where agents trust less the central bank to bring inflation back to target. We strongly believe that from a policy perspective, the adoption of redistributive and social policy interventions by global governance structures is crucial for promoting inclusivity and reducing inequality and poverty, thereby improving livelihoods of global citizens. The study applies a mathematical modeling approach and synthesizes ideas for forward thinking, at least, in understanding UBI implications for global adaptation to climate change in the information and digital age. The numerical simulations and their results will be shown in a subsequent paper.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在应对气候变化的技术创新过程中可能加剧失业、财富不平等和贫困的问题，提出普遍基本收入（UBI）作为数字时代气候变化适应的宏观经济政策工具，通过数学建模分析UBI对促进包容性和减少不平等的潜在作用。
AI.research_question: 如何解决以能源创新为导向的全球变暖减缓措施可能导致的失业、财富分配不均和贫困问题？
AI.motivation: 许多环境问题解决方案依赖新兴技术，但这些技术的全面实施可能加剧当前全球失业率上升、财富差距扩大和贫困化的趋势，需要在追求财富增长的同时投资能源创新以应对气候变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 耦合气候-经济-生物圈（CoCEB）模型，普遍基本收入（UBI）理论，适应性预期理论， sentiment adjustments（情绪调整）和 herding coefficient（羊群效应系数）概念
AI.method: 数学建模方法，数值模拟（结果将在后续论文中展示）
AI.findings: 普遍基本收入作为宏观经济政策工具可以应对技术创新带来的失业和不平等挑战，特别是在通胀环境中当代理人对中央银行实现通胀目标信任度降低时的适应性预期情境下
AI.theory_contributions: 重新构建了CoCEB模型，提出了UBI作为气候变化适应响应的悖论，深化了对数字时代适应性预期机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球治理结构提供了再分配和社会政策干预的建议，促进包容性、减少不平等和贫困，改善全球公民生计，为理解信息数字时代UBI对气候变化适应的意义提供了前瞻性思考

title: Le Club des cinq et les mystères du droit de la concurrence
affiliations: McGill University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Le Club des cinq et les mystères du droit de la concurrence
detail.abstract:
J’ai bien regardé, dans les livres comme au ciel. J’ai consulté les astres, la cabbale. J’en ai appelé à la numérologie aussi, mais rien n’y

fait. Je ne vois aucun sens particulier à la sélection des cinq décisions en droit de la concurrence que je vous propose ici. Peut-être en y changeant l’ordre, le lecteur astrologue équipé d’une paire de ciseaux y verra-t-il quelque chose, un signe, une forme, un indice du lent mouvement du droit, imperceptible mais pourtant bien réel. Pis encore, leur sélection n’a été aucunement scientifique. C’est en vain que l’on cherchera une quelconque méthode, voire l’exposition d’une thèse ou d’une hypothèse particulière. Aucun « isme » auquel accrocher notre exercice. Rien d’aussi noble, rien dans notre démarche qui puisse s’expliquer autrement que par une improvisation appliquée et le sens – quel qu’il soit – d’un travail bien fait. Bref, on a passé commande et je me suis exécuté. À demeurer dans le non-sens, j’ai pris une liberté toute littéraire à inventer un titre sans aucune signification non plus mais qui pouvait au moins amuser celui ou celle qui n’aura pas oublié ses lectures de jeunesse. Et puis il y avait la référence facile, j’en conviens, au chiffre cinq. En réalité je n’avais pas le choix de frapper un grand coup. Bien informé, on m’avait indiqué quele professeur Gautrais, également sollicité pour contribuer à ce numéro des Cahiers, avait encore trouvé et je cite sans pouvoir indiquer ma source « un titre révolutionnaire et très jeune ». Il fallait que je réagisse et que moi aussi j’affiche ma composition au tableau par un clou neuf et bien voyant.

title: Rent Control, Rent Overcharge, and Racial Disparity
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University - Department of Insurance & Real Estate, , University of Windsor and University of North Texas - Department of Economics

detail.title: Rent Control, Rent Overcharge, and Racial Disparity
detail.abstract: Rent control policies have seen increasing legislative momentum in many places, but are rent-regulated landlords adhering to these policies? Answering this question is critical to understanding the policy's impact. We investigate non-compliance with rent caps using data from the rent stabilization policy in New York City. We uncover evidence indicative of widespread rent overcharging. Our analysis, based on unique panel data from the New York City Housing and Vacancy Survey (NYCHVS), reveals that over 30% of tenants in rent-stabilized apartments without turnover were likely overcharged. Moreover, we find that minorities in rent-stabilized units are more likely to be overcharged than their White counterparts. Supplemented with building permits and code violation data, we provide evidence that the findings are unlikely driven by policy provisions that grant additional rent increases to landlords during the study period, notably the (1) preferential rent and (2) major capital improvement.

AI.tldr: 研究发现纽约市租金管制政策存在广泛违规，超过30%的稳定租金租户被多收费，少数族裔更易受影响
AI.research_question: 租金管制政策下的房东是否遵守租金上限规定？
AI.motivation: 租金管制政策在多地立法推进，但需要了解房东是否遵守政策以评估政策效果
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于租金管制理论和住房政策执行理论
AI.method: 使用纽约市住房和空置调查(NYCHVS)的面板数据，结合建筑许可和法规违规数据进行分析
AI.findings: 30%以上无换租的租金稳定公寓租户可能被多收费；少数族裔比白人租户更可能被多收费；研究结果不太可能由优惠租金和重大资本改善等政策条款驱动
AI.theory_contributions: 为租金管制政策执行和违规行为研究提供实证证据，揭示政策执行中的不平等问题
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供租金管制执行情况的实证依据，帮助改进监管机制和减少歧视性收费

title: Pricing-to-Market in Business Cycle Models *
affiliations: Boston College, University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School and Warsaw School of Economics (SGH)

detail.title: Pricing-to-Market in Business Cycle Models *
detail.abstract: We evaluate several leading microfounded pricing-to-market (PTM) mechanisms embedded in a two-country DSGE model with volatile exchange rates driven by real and financial shocks. Across all models, including the reduced-form Kimball specification, a parameterization trilemma emerges: jointly achieving empirically plausible producer markups, muted expenditure switching as measured by low short-run trade elasticity, and low exchange-rate pass-through is the main challenge for the models, but necessary to match business cycle dynamics of both prices and quantities. We provide an analytical characterization of the trilemma and evaluate the performance of each PTM model quantitatively. Our conclusion is that further research is needed to understand frictions that limit the response of prices and quantities to volatile exchange rates.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了多种定价到市场（PTM）机制在DSGE模型中的表现，发现存在参数化三难困境：难以同时实现合理的生产者加成、低短期贸易弹性和低汇率传递率，这些特征对匹配价格和数量的商业周期动态至关重要。
AI.research_question: 如何在DSGE模型中同时实现经验上合理的生产者加成、低短期贸易弹性和低汇率传递率？
AI.motivation: 现有微观基础的定价到市场机制在匹配汇率波动下价格和数量的商业周期动态方面存在困难，需要深入理解限制价格和数量对汇率波动响应的摩擦机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两国DSGE模型，包含实际冲击和金融冲击驱动的汇率波动，采用多种定价到市场机制（包括Kimball简化形式）。
AI.method: 理论分析和定量评估相结合，通过解析特征化参数化三难困境，并对各PTM模型进行定量性能评估。
AI.findings: 所有模型都存在参数化三难困境，难以同时实现三个关键经验特征；需要进一步研究限制价格和数量对汇率波动响应的摩擦机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了定价到市场机制中的参数化三难困境理论框架，为理解汇率传递和贸易弹性之间的关系提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究人员提供了评估不同定价机制性能的框架，指出了现有模型在匹配商业周期动态方面的局限性，为未来模型改进指明了方向。

title: Revisiting the Stock Market Reaction to Other Comprehensive Income and its Components: Evidence from U.S. commercial banks around ASU 2016-01
affiliations: LEFA – IHEC Carthage, Brock University - Accounting and HEC Montreal

detail.title: Revisiting the Stock Market Reaction to Other Comprehensive Income and its Components: Evidence from U.S. commercial banks around ASU 2016-01

declarations.funderStatement: No Funding.

detail.abstract: Given recent developments in the U.S. banking landscape, particularly regarding investment portfolios and derivatives activities, this study aims to provide new insights about the market pricing of aggregate Other Comprehensive Income (OCI) and its key components in the banking sector surrounding the adoption of Accounting Standards Update (ASU) 2016-01. Using a sample of 8,000 quarterly observations covering the 200 largest commercial U.S. banks over the period 2011-2020, we document significant changes in market reactions following ASU 2016-01 implementation. Our findings show that absolute changes in net income (NI) negatively affect abnormal returns, and this relationship becomes more pronounced after ASU 2016-01 adoption. This suggests that the recognition of unrealized gains and losses on equities in NI has increased earnings volatility, and investor sensitivity to earnings uncertainty. While aggregate absolute OCI changes show no significant relationship with abnormal returns in either period, disaggregated analysis reveals important component-specific effects. ASU 2016-01 increases the informativeness of available-for-sale securities and cash flow hedge components, with the post-ASU effect being particularly weak for cash flow hedges and debt securities. Our evidence suggests that, despite the increased earnings volatility following ASU, investors and financial analysts who include component-level OCI information can better assess a bank's financial performance. Additional analysis shows noteworthy results. Abnormal returns are negatively related to negative changes in OCI. However, the effect of positive changes on abnormal returns becomes positive and significant when 2020 observations are excluded, confirming that the pricing of OCI gains is disrupted under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了美国会计准则更新ASU 2016-01对银行其他综合收益(OCI)市场定价的影响，发现ASU实施后净收益波动性增加，投资者对收益不确定性更敏感，但分解的OCI组件信息对投资者评估银行财务表现更有用。
AI.research_question: ASU 2016-01会计准则更新如何影响银行部门其他综合收益(OCI)及其关键组件的市场定价？
AI.motivation: 美国银行业投资组合和衍生品活动的最新发展，特别是ASU 2016-01要求将权益工具未实现损益计入净收益，需要研究这一变化对市场定价的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于会计信息价值相关性理论，研究会计准则变更对收益质量、信息含量和市场定价的影响。
AI.method: 使用2011-2020年间美国前200大商业银行的8,000个季度观测数据，采用事件研究法分析市场异常回报与OCI变化的关系。
AI.findings: ASU 2016-01实施后，净收益绝对变化对异常回报的负面影响更显著；可供出售证券和现金流对冲组件的信息含量增加；负OCI变化与异常回报负相关，但在不确定性环境下OCI收益的定价受到干扰。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了会计准则变更对收益质量影响的理论理解，提供了OCI组件层面信息价值相关性的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和财务分析师提供了在ASU 2016-01环境下更好评估银行财务绩效的实用见解，强调关注OCI组件层面信息的重要性。

title: Green Premium or Brown Discount? Evidence from Experimental Asset Markets
affiliations: Maastricht University - Department of Finance, Utrecht University and Utrecht University

detail.title: Green Premium or Brown Discount? Evidence from Experimental Asset Markets
detail.abstract: Sustainability preferences are often measured at the individual level. However, it is unclear whether individual sustainability preferences can manifest in a competitive asset market setting. To address this, we conduct a series of experiments, measuring sustainability preferences at both the individual and market levels. In our market experiments, participants could accept lower payoffs for assets that yield positive externalities (green) compared to those with neutral (gray) or negative (brown) externalities. We observe a robust aversion to brown assets leading to significant underpricing (a "brown discount"), but find little evidence of a green premium. When we eliminate speculative motives, green assets' prices are even closer to the fundamental value, suggesting that any observed green premium is likely driven by speculation but not sustainability preferences. Only incentivized measures of individual sustainability preferences, rather than stated preferences, significantly correlate with participants' market behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究发现个体可持续性偏好在竞争性资产市场中主要体现为对"棕色"资产的厌恶（棕色折扣），而非对"绿色"资产的溢价。绿色溢价更多由投机动机驱动，而非真实的可持续性偏好。只有激励性测量的个体偏好与市场行为显著相关。
AI.research_question: 个体可持续性偏好能否在竞争性资产市场环境中显现？
AI.motivation: 虽然可持续性偏好在个体层面已有测量，但其在竞争性资产市场中的表现尚不明确，需要实证研究验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为金融学和可持续投资理论，探讨个体偏好如何影响资产定价和市场效率。
AI.method: 进行系列实验，同时在个体和市场层面测量可持续性偏好，使用绿色（正外部性）、灰色（中性）和棕色（负外部性）资产进行市场交易实验。
AI.findings: 1）市场中对棕色资产存在显著的厌恶和折价（棕色折扣）；2）绿色资产溢价证据有限；3）消除投机动机后，绿色资产价格更接近基本面价值；4）只有激励性测量的个体偏好与市场行为显著相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了可持续性偏好在市场环境中的实际表现机制，区分了真实偏好与投机动机的影响，为行为金融理论提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和市场监管者提供了关于可持续投资实际市场效应的实证依据，有助于制定更有效的可持续投资策略和政策。

title: The Legal Book of the Dead: Memetic Pincers as Extended Phenotype in Institutional Palimpsests

detail.title: The Legal Book of the Dead: Memetic Pincers as Extended Phenotype in Institutional Palimpsests

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced this research
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research uses only publicly available aggregate data from government statistics offices and published market reports. No human subjects were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces a novel theoretical framework for understanding institutional dysfunction by applying Richard Dawkins' concepts of extended phenotype and evolutionary palimpsest to legal systems. 

We identify "memetic pincers"-paired mechanisms where moral inhibitor narratives protect destructive policies from criticism-and demonstrate how these modify the institutional field beyond their immediate domain. Using comparative evidence from rental market controls in Argentina (91% supply reduction, ×12 recovery factor) and Berlin (41% reduction, partial recovery), we show that identical policies produce dramatically different outcomes depending on pre-existing institutional field distortion. 

We argue that legal systems function as palimpsests where unresolved crises leave memetic layers that act as extended phenotypes, permanently altering the institutional environment. Argentina represents an extreme case where accumulated distortions create a self-reinforcing cycle of dysfunction. 

The framework makes falsifiable predictions about policy impact amplification, recovery speeds, and institutional collapse thresholds. 

This synthesis of evolutionary biology and institutional economics offers new insights into why some legal systems become irreformable despite obvious dysfunction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新颖的理论框架，将道金斯的扩展表型和进化重写本概念应用于法律系统，解释了制度功能障碍。通过阿根廷和柏林的租金管制案例比较，展示了相同政策在不同制度环境下产生截然不同的结果，揭示了制度如何通过模因层积累变得不可改革。
AI.research_question: 为什么某些法律系统在明显功能障碍的情况下变得不可改革？
AI.motivation: 理解制度功能障碍的深层机制，解释相同政策在不同制度环境下产生不同结果的原因
AI.theoretical_framework: Richard Dawkins的扩展表型和进化重写本理论，结合制度经济学
AI.method: 比较案例研究法，分析阿根廷（91%供应减少，12倍恢复因子）和柏林（41%减少，部分恢复）的租金市场管制政策
AI.findings: 相同政策在不同制度环境下产生截然不同的结果；制度作为重写本，未解决的危机会留下模因层，永久改变制度环境；阿根廷的累积扭曲创造了自我强化的功能障碍循环
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"模因钳制"概念-道德抑制叙事保护破坏性政策免遭批评的配对机制；建立了可证伪的政策影响放大、恢复速度和制度崩溃阈值预测框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解政策实施效果差异的理论工具；有助于识别和避免制度功能障碍的累积循环

title: Les noms de domaine: un pavé dans la marque
affiliations: McGill University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Les noms de domaine: un pavé dans la marque
detail.abstract:
Une déferlante technologie s'abat sur l'ensemble desprincipes de propriété intellectuelle et de leur agencement entreeux. En cela rien de nouveau et on s'habitue à voir champignonner depuis quelques temps des rapports d'experts, des projets,des avant-projets et des protocoles ainsi que des réformes législatives préparées en toute hâte. Si l'évolutionde la propriété intellectuelle est effectivement liée au progrès technique il faut bien reconnaître que le défi de cesdernières années malmène cette autre science qu'est le droit. Les mots mêmes, qui sont à la base de la précision conceptuelle et sans lesquels la loi ne serait garder sa généralité et saprévisibilité semblent nous manquer. Car la technique ne fait pas que transformer certainsmatériaux et en créer d'autres encore plus nouveaux, elle changeégalement la sémantique juridique. Du temps des premiers codes, s'ilétait aisé de consacrer un nouvel "immeuble", le verbe juridique manque désormaisau juriste et principalement à ceux dont la spécialité est enpropriété intellectuelle. La qualification des logiciels en tant qu'"oeuvres" en estun exemple. Entre l'apparition de la terminologie de logiciel aux premières modifications législatives, combien d'années se sontécoulées ? La dernière épreuve qui est soumise à l'examen des praticiens fait l'objet duprésent article: les noms de domaine.

Pour ceux qui s'y sont déjà essayés, le simple exercice d'expliquer à un profane de quoi il s'agit c'est un peu faireses premières armes dans une langue étrangère. La seulevulgarisation de la problématique est un laborieux travail. On se consolera cependant en faisantremarquer que cette fois la nouvelle problématique vient frapper ledroit des marques de commerce plutôt que celui de la propriété littéraire et artistique - qui a volé la vedette depuis l'avénement d'Internet.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文讨论了技术发展对知识产权法律体系的挑战，特别是域名系统对商标法带来的新问题。作者指出技术变革不仅创造新的物质，还改变了法律语义，导致法律词汇的缺失和立法迟滞。
AI.research_question: 技术发展如何挑战知识产权法律体系，特别是域名系统对商标法带来的法律问题是什么？
AI.motivation: 技术快速发展对知识产权法律构成了重大挑战，法律语言和概念跟不上技术变化的速度，需要分析这种法律与技术之间的差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权法理论、法律语言学、技术与法律互动关系理论
AI.method: 理论分析和法律文本分析，通过历史案例（如软件作品认定）和当前案例（域名系统）进行比较研究
AI.findings: 技术变革导致法律语义变化，法律概念跟不上技术发展，使得传统知识产权体系面临重大调整压力。域名系统作为新兴技术现象，对商标法构成了特别挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了技术发展与法律语言发展之间差距的理论框架，丰富了技术与法律互动关系的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为定义新兴技术现象（如域名）的法律性质提供分析框架，为立法者和实务工作者应对技术变革带来的法律挑战提供指导

title: Investment Didactics: Educating Investors to Overcome Biases in Decision-Making
affiliations: Zurich University of Applied Sciences (ZHAW) and  ZHAW Zurich University of Applied Sciences, School of Management and Law

detail.title: Investment Didactics: Educating Investors to Overcome Biases in Decision-Making
detail.abstract: This paper examines how individual investors can be taught to overcome psychological biases that impair investment decision-making. Drawing on behavioral finance research, the authors demonstrate that cognitive and emotional biases systematically reduce investment returns by 1.31-1.56 percentage points annually. Using Kahneman's dual-process framework, it is explained how System 1 (fast, intuitive thinking) leads to biases like overconfidence, loss aversion, and herding behavior, while System 2 (deliberate, analytical thinking) can mitigate these tendencies. By doing so, four evidence-based strategies for debiasing are being identified: rules-based investment protocols that enforce disciplined adherence to predefined strategies; pre-commitment mechanisms that bind investors to future actions; cognitive debiasing techniques including probability training and consideration of alternatives; and technological interventions, such as robo-advisors, that reduce reliance on emotional decision-making. The findings indicate that effective investment education must evolve beyond technical knowledge to incorporate behavioral awareness and practical debiasing tools. This research contributes to the transformation of behavioral finance from a descriptive discipline to a prescriptive one that offers concrete tools for improving financial outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何教导个人投资者克服损害投资决策的心理偏见，基于行为金融学研究发现认知和情感偏见每年系统性降低投资回报1.31-1.56个百分点，提出了四种基于证据的去偏见策略。
AI.research_question: 如何教导个人投资者克服心理偏见以改善投资决策？
AI.motivation: 认知和情感偏见系统性地降低投资回报，需要从行为金融学的描述性研究转向提供具体改善工具的规定性方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kahneman的双系统理论框架（系统1：快速直觉思维；系统2：审慎分析思维）和行为金融学理论
AI.method: 基于行为金融学研究的理论分析和证据综合
AI.findings: 心理偏见每年降低投资回报1.31-1.56个百分点；识别出四种有效的去偏见策略：规则投资协议、预先承诺机制、认知去偏见技术、技术干预
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为金融学从描述性学科转变为规定性学科，提供具体的投资决策改进工具
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者教育提供实用的去偏见策略，包括规则制定、预先承诺、认知训练和技术工具应用

title: Price Informativeness and Institutional Investors

detail.title: Price Informativeness and Institutional Investors
detail.abstract: This paper examines the relation between institutional investors and price informativeness by considering two new measures of price informativeness – Absolute and Relative – and stock ownership by institutional investors in aggregate and by type of institution. Empirically, while aggregate institutional ownership is associated with higher Absolute Price Informativeness mainly due to size effect, Relative Price Informativeness is positively correlated with institutional ownership even after controlling for size. Paper further finds Quasi-Indexers are positively associated with Absolute Price Informativeness, while other institutions are negatively associated with Absolute Price Informativeness. Relative Price Informativeness, conversely, is positively associated with Quasi-Indexers and Transient institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两种新的价格信息性度量指标（绝对和相对），研究了机构投资者与价格信息性之间的关系，发现不同类型的机构投资者对价格信息性有不同影响。
AI.research_question: 机构投资者（总体及分类）与股票价格信息性之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 探讨机构投资者如何影响市场价格的信息含量，特别是通过新的价格信息性度量指标来深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场效率理论和机构投资者行为理论，分析不同类型机构投资者对价格发现过程的影响。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，使用绝对价格信息性和相对价格信息性两个新指标，分析机构投资者持股数据。
AI.findings: 总体机构持股与绝对价格信息性正相关（主要受规模效应影响），相对价格信息性与机构持股正相关（控制规模后仍成立）；准指数型机构与绝对价格信息性正相关，其他机构与之负相关；相对价格信息性与准指数型和交易型机构正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的价格信息性度量框架，深化了对不同类型机构投资者市场角色和作用机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管机构提供了关于机构投资者行为对市场信息效率影响的重要实证证据，有助于投资决策和市场监管。

title: Impact of Interest Rates on Housing Market in Kenya: A Supply Side
affiliations: University of Eldoret and University of Eldoret

detail.title: Impact of Interest Rates on Housing Market in Kenya: A Supply Side
detail.abstract: The study investigated the influence of lending interest rates on housing construction and homeownership in Kenya. It utilised the unit root test, Granger causality test, and the generalized method of moments (GMM) model to analyze economic time series data from 1979 to 2025. The findings from the unit root tests indicated that the variables were I(1), confirming the absence of variables with I(2) properties. The regression coefficients demonstrate a significant negative effect of interest rates on housing supply, illustrating a one-way relationship between the two. Empirical results indicate that higher or rising lending interest rates contribute to a slowdown in the housing market. This phenomenon can be attributed to increased borrowing costs, which deter investment in housing construction both in the short and long term. These findings suggest that policymakers in Kenya should consider implementing measures to regulate bank lending rates and enhance oversight, thereby promoting affordable housing.

AI.tldr: 肯尼亚贷款利率对住房建设和住房拥有率有显著负面影响，高利率导致住房市场放缓，建议政策制定者监管银行利率以促进经济适用房
AI.research_question: 贷款利率如何影响肯尼亚的住房建设和住房拥有率？
AI.motivation: 研究贷款利率对住房市场的影响，为肯尼亚住房政策制定提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于利率传导机制理论，贷款利率通过影响借贷成本进而影响住房投资决策
AI.method: 使用单位根检验、格兰杰因果检验和广义矩估计(GMM)模型分析1979-2025年经济时间序列数据
AI.findings: 变量为I(1)过程，贷款利率对住房供应有显著负向影响，存在单向因果关系，高利率导致住房市场放缓
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了贷款利率与住房市场的负向关系，为发展中国家的利率-住房关系研究提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为肯尼亚政策制定者提供监管银行贷款利率、促进经济适用房的政策建议

title: Le droit d'auteur des journalistes dans l'exercise de leur emploi
affiliations: McGill University - Faculty of Law and Robic S.E.N.C.R.L., LLP

detail.title: Le droit d'auteur des journalistes dans l'exercise de leur emploi
detail.abstract:
Dans une cause en instance devant la Cour supérieure du Québec, le Comité de défense des droits électroniques (C.D.D.E.) a intenté, au nom des journalistes pigistes, un recours collectif de 33 millions de dollars contre Southam et CEDROM-SNI Inc. (ci-après “l'affaire Southam”). Les journalistes pigistes allèguent qu'en vertu d'un accord verbal, Southam n'a le droit de reproduire leurs articles qu'une seule fois et pour seule publication dans The Montreal Gazette, un quotidien dont Southam est propriétaire.
Les demandeurs soutiennent en outre qu'en rendant leurs oeuvres mondialement accessibles par le biais de moyens électroniques, sans leur consentement ni compensation, les défendeurs leur causent de futures pertes liées à la diminution de la valeur de leur droit d'auteur. Ils estiment ainsi que l'effet direct des activités électroniques de Southam les prive de la possibilité de céder ou de concéder le droit sur leur travail en “recyclant”, terme utilisé dans la profession pour désigner la mise à jour de reportages afin que ceux-ci puissent être publiés de nouveau à une date ultérieure et pour des clients différents.

AI.tldr: 加拿大魁北克高等法院审理的一起集体诉讼案，电子权利保护委员会代表自由记者起诉Southam公司和CEDROM-SNI公司，索赔3300万美元。记者们指控被告未经许可通过电子方式全球传播其作品，导致其版权价值减损和未来收益损失。
AI.research_question: 电子媒体环境下，新闻机构未经许可数字化传播自由记者作品是否构成版权侵权？这种传播行为对记者未来收益和版权价值产生何种影响？
AI.motivation: 随着数字技术的发展，新闻机构将传统媒体内容数字化并通过电子渠道全球传播，这给自由记者的版权保护和未来收益带来了新的挑战和威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于版权法理论，特别是数字环境下的版权保护、首次发表权、数字传播权以及作品再利用（"回收"）权利的相关法律原则。
AI.method: 采用法律案例分析方法，通过对魁北克高等法院具体诉讼案件的事实、法律主张和争议焦点进行深入剖析。
AI.findings: 自由记者声称与Southam公司存在口头协议，限制其作品只能一次性在《蒙特利尔公报》发表。被告的电子传播行为直接损害了记者通过"回收"（更新报道后再次发表）作品获得后续收益的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字时代版权保护理论提供了实证案例，探讨了口头协议在数字版权纠纷中的法律效力，以及电子传播对传统媒体版权商业模式的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自由记者和内容创作者提供了维护数字版权的法律实践参考，对新闻机构处理历史内容数字化具有警示意义，促进了数字环境下版权协议的明确化。

title: The effects of transport infrastructure on housing and prices: the role of land-use regulation
affiliations: Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, London School of Economics and Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile

detail.title: The effects of transport infrastructure on housing and prices: the role of land-use regulation
detail.abstract: We estimate the impact of new transportation infrastructure on Santiago's housing market using historical microdata and instrumental variables. While subway and highway expansions generally boost residential floor space, housing units, and prices, the aggregate impact masks a heterogeneity driven by land-use regulations. In the wealthiest 20% of the city, highly restrictive regulations, such as low maximum Floor Area Ratios (FAR), effectively limit the impact on new development. Conversely, in the remaining 80% of blocks, the zoning is more permissive, and the infrastructure investment leads to a substantial and homogeneous increase in residential floor space and housing units. These findings suggest that zoning in affluent areas prevents the densification that would otherwise follow major public investments, limiting the city's overall housing growth.

AI.tldr: 本文通过历史微观数据和工具变量方法，研究了圣地亚哥新交通基础设施对住房市场的影响，发现土地用途管制导致不同收入区域的异质性反应：富裕区域由于严格的容积率限制抑制了开发，而其他区域则出现了显著的住房供给增长
AI.research_question: 新交通基础设施如何影响城市住房市场？土地用途管制在其中扮演什么调节角色？
AI.motivation: 理解公共基础设施投资对住房市场的异质性影响，特别是土地用途管制如何调节这种影响，对于制定有效的城市发展政策具有重要意义
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于城市经济学和住房市场理论，结合土地用途管制对开发密度的约束作用，分析交通基础设施的外部性效应
AI.method: 使用历史微观数据，采用工具变量方法估计因果关系，按收入水平分区分析异质性效应
AI.findings: 地铁和高速公路扩展总体上提升了住宅建筑面积、住房单元数量和价格，但存在显著异质性：最富裕20%区域因严格的容积率限制而开发受限，其余80%区域则出现显著的住房供给增长
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了土地用途管制在调节基础设施投资效应中的关键作用，丰富了城市经济学中关于管制与开发密度的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者提供了政策启示：放松富裕区域的开发限制可以最大化公共投资的住房供给效应，缓解城市住房短缺问题

title: Recalibrating the Simplified Supervisory Formula Approach to Risk Weighting Securitization Exposures
affiliations: Bank Policy Institute and Cadwalader, Wickersham & Taft LLP

detail.title: Recalibrating the Simplified Supervisory Formula Approach to Risk Weighting Securitization Exposures
detail.abstract: This paper proposes changes to the Simplified Supervisory Formula Approach (SSFA) to riskweighting securitization exposures under the U.S. bank regulatory capital rules. After describing and dissecting the SSFA, three primary limitations are identified. To address them, a recalibration is proposed (SSFA++) that: (1) decouples the sizing of the capital buffer from its allocation across securitization tranches, (2) imposes a securitization capital surcharge only as underlying assets become delinquent, and (3) sets a risk-sensitive capital floor and cap for senior securitization exposures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了美国银行监管资本规则中简化监管公式方法(SSFA)的改进方案，以更准确地评估证券化风险暴露的风险权重。识别了SSFA的三个主要限制，并提出SSFA++重新校准方案来解决这些问题。
AI.research_question: 如何改进简化监管公式方法(SSFA)，以更有效地评估证券化风险暴露的风险权重？
AI.motivation: 现有的SSFA方法在评估证券化风险暴露时存在重要限制，需要进行重新校准以提高风险敏感性和准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 证券化风险计量理论、监管资本分配模型、风险权重计算方法
AI.method: 文献分析和模型重新校准方法，识别SSFA的三个主要限制并提出具体改进措施
AI.findings: 提出了SSFA++重新校准方案：(1)解耦资本缓冲规模与在证券化分层中的分配；(2)仅在基础资产出现迟期时才加放证券化资本额外费用；(3)为高级证券化暴露设置风险敏感的资本地板和上限
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了证券化风险计量理论，提供了更为精细的监管资本分配模型
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国银行监管机构提供了具体的证券化风险权重计算改进方案，有助于提高银行资本管理的准确性和敏感性

title: La Loi canadienne sur le droit d'auteur doit-elle être repansée?
affiliations: McGill University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: La Loi canadienne sur le droit d'auteur doit-elle être repansée?
detail.abstract:
J'ai lu avec attention l'excellent document qui a été mis à la disposition du public canadien le 22 juin 2001, qui s'intitule «Document de consultation sur les questions de droit d'auteur à l'ère numérique». Cette synthèse, sous forme d'historique législatif, offre un tableau intéressant de l'état du droit aujourd'hui.
Depuis 1995 et la publication du rapport final du sous-comité sur le droit d’auteur, ce tableau a été coloré d’une jurisprudence nombreuse, d’origine américaine pour la plupart et, plus récemment, européenne. Le Canada, sans être en reste, a une production législative plus retenue qui correspond, je crois, à une politique d’attentisme. Cette attitude a certains avantages en ce qu’elle permet d’atteindre un certain recul sur des questions d’actualité en observant les réactions du droit aux nouvelles technologies telles qu’elles se manifestent dans les autres juridictions. Attentisme ne doit pas signifier pour autant «immobilisme». À ce titre, le processus de consultation mis en branle par le gouvernement du Canada est une initiative à saluer.
Avant de présenter la substance des commentaires qui font l’objet de la présente, je livrerai quelques réflexions d’ordre général qui résultent de l’observation de l’évolution du droit de ces dernières années dans le domaine qui nous intéresse. Je proposerai ensuite une réponse à la première question posée par le document de consultation:
La loi doit-elle être modifiée pour permettre un droit spécifique pour les communications à demande?
J’aborderai ensuite brièvement la question des mesures législatives qui ont pour objectif d’empêcher le contournement des mesures de protection technique – champ magnétique ou barbelé, une question de clôture? Je ne traiterai pas de la question de la responsabilité des intermédiaires de réseau, faute de temps.

AI.tldr: 这篇文章是对加拿大2001年6月22日发布的《数字时代版权问题征求意见文档》的评论和回应，重点讨论了数字时代版权法的发展趋势、线上传播权的设置以及技术保护措施的立法问题。
AI.research_question: 数字时代版权法律如何适应新技术发展，特别是是否需要设置线上传播权以及如何规制技术保护措施的绕过行为？
AI.motivation: 加拿大在数字版权立法方面采取了观望态度，通过观察美国和欧洲的发展经验来形成更为健全的法律框架，这个文档是对此过程的反馈和建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于版权法的演进理论，考虑技术发展对传统版权制度的挖掘和重构作用，以及不同法域在应对数字化挖掘时的策略差异。
AI.method: 采用法律文本分析和比较法研究方法，通过对1995年以来的版权法发展进程、美欧法院判例以及加拿大本土立法实践进行综合分析。
AI.findings: 加拿大的观望式立法策略具有一定优势，允许在关注其他法域实践基础上形成更为健全的政策。文章支持设置线上传播权，同时建议尊重技术中立性原则，避免过度保护导致的副作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字时代版权法的演进提供了一个重要的比较法学视角，强调了在技术变革期间法律策略选择的重要性，以及不同法律系统在应对新挖掘时的差异化路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大政府的版权法修订提供了具体的实践建议，包括支持线上传播权的设置，同时建议在技术保护措施的立法中保持平衡，避免影响技术创新和使用者权益。

reference: Finance A Uver-Czech Journal of Economics and Finance 75(3), 343-370 (Forthcoming, 2025)
title: The effect of ESG on working capital: Two for the price of one
affiliations: Universidad Católica de la Santísima Concepción, Universidad Catolica de la Santisima Concepcion and Universidad de Valladolid - Department of Finance and Accounting

detail.title: The effect of ESG on working capital: Two for the price of one

declarations.funderStatement: We are sincerely grateful to the editor. Roman Horvath, for his valuable guidance and support. We also wish to thank Conrado García, Paolo Saona, and the anonymous referees for their thoughtful and constructive feedback, which has greatly enhanced the clarity and overall quality of this paper. Any remaining shortcoming are solely our responsibility. The authors declare no conflicts of interest. We also thank the financial support of the Spanish Ministry of Science and Innovation (PID2024-155796NB-I00)

keywords: Working Capital Requirements JEL classification: G30

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance A Uver-Czech Journal of Economics and Finance 75(3), 343-370 (Forthcoming, 2025)

detail.abstract: We examine the relationship between environmental, social, and governance (ESG) scores and working capital management in 4,212 traded firms across 65 countries (2010-2023), emphasizing the role of financial constraints. We find that higher ESG scores-mainly driven by environmental and social pillars-are associated with lower working capital requirements When disaggregating the cash conversion cycle components, we observe that ESG-strong firms collect payments from customers more quickly and secure extended payment terms from suppliers, reflecting trust-based relationships and more efficient liquidity strategies. ESG performance is associated with a mitigation of the impact of financial constraints, suggesting that sustainability practices enhance financing conditions. These results are robust to propensity score matching and industry-adjusted specifications. Our findings highlight ESG as a strategic lever for improving liquidity efficiency and managing capital-market frictions through enhanced stakeholder engagement.

AI.tldr: ESG评分高的企业（特别是环境和社会维度）与更低营运资金需求相关，这些企业能更快收回客户款项并获得更长的供应商付款期限，ESG表现还能缓解财务约束的影响。
AI.research_question: ESG评分与营运资金管理之间的关系是什么？财务约束在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 探讨ESG表现如何影响企业营运资金管理效率，以及这种关系是否受到财务约束的调节作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于利益相关者理论和信任理论，ESG表现通过增强与客户、供应商等利益相关者的信任关系来改善营运资金管理。
AI.method: 使用4,212家上市公司2010-2023年的面板数据，涵盖65个国家，采用倾向得分匹配和行业调整规范进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1) ESG评分越高，营运资金需求越低；2) 环境和社会支柱是主要驱动因素；3) ESG表现强的企业收款更快、付款期限更长；4) ESG能缓解财务约束的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了ESG与营运资金管理的理论联系，揭示了ESG通过信任机制改善企业流动性的作用路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了通过提升ESG表现来优化营运资金管理、缓解融资约束的战略工具，强调了利益相关者参与的重要性。

title: The Quote Not Taken: Inefficient Price Discovery in Opening Auctions
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin - McCombs School of Business

detail.title: The Quote Not Taken: Inefficient Price Discovery in Opening Auctions
detail.abstract: This paper provides the first evidence that publicly observable retail order flow predicts inefficient short-horizon return patterns around opening auctions. These dynamics are consistent with temporary price pressure from retail activity that is not fully incorporated into opening auction prices. A long-short trading strategy that leverages publicly available trade data as a signal yields economically and statistically significant abnormal risk-adjusted returns. A difference-indifferences analysis around the 2020 NYSE floor closure shows that variation in auction design and information availability accounts for a substantial share of the observed return pattern. These findings suggest that, despite the relative depth and sophistication of US equity markets, their opening auctions may not fully incorporate available information.

AI.tldr: 本文首次证明公开可观察的零售订单流能够预测开盘集合竞价期间的无效短期收益模式，这些模式与零售活动带来的暂时性价格压力未被完全纳入开盘价格有关。基于公开交易数据的多空策略可获得显著的超额收益，且NYSE交易大厅关闭事件的差异分析表明拍卖设计和信息可获得性的变化解释了大部分收益模式。
AI.research_question: 公开可观察的零售订单流是否能预测开盘集合竞价期间的无效短期收益模式？美国股市开盘拍卖是否充分纳入了所有可用信息？
AI.motivation: 尽管美国股市相对深度和成熟，但开盘集合竞价机制可能存在信息整合不完全的问题，零售订单流可能产生暂时性价格压力而未完全反映在开盘价格中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论、价格发现理论、信息不对称理论、拍卖理论
AI.method: 实证分析公开交易数据，构建多空交易策略，采用2020年NYSE交易大厅关闭事件的差异分析（DID）方法
AI.findings: 零售订单流能显著预测开盘竞价期间的异常收益模式；基于公开交易数据的策略可获得经济上和统计上显著的风险调整后超额收益；拍卖设计和信息可获得性变化解释了大部分观察到的收益模式
AI.theory_contributions: 首次证明零售订单流在开盘竞价中的预测能力，扩展了市场微观结构理论，揭示了开盘拍卖机制的信息整合效率问题
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了基于公开信息的交易策略，为交易所改进开盘拍卖机制提供了实证依据，对市场监管和交易制度设计具有参考价值

title: Stocks for Inflation Shocks
affiliations: State Street Corporate, GIC Private Limited, GIC, State Street Global Markets - State Street Associates and State Street Associates

detail.title: Stocks for Inflation Shocks
detail.abstract: Research suggests that the relationship between inflation and equities is nuanced which poses a challenge for investors seeking to hedge inflation. We propose a statistical method for predicting the relative vulnerability or resilience of individual stocks to positive inflation shocks, which we summarize as individual inflation robustness scores. It compares a stock's circumstances-as described by a collection of firm attributes-to the circumstances of stocks that performed relatively well, or poorly, in past inflation events. The key advantage of this approach is that it captures nonlinear, conditional relationships between firm characteristics and inflation by allowing the influence of each attribute to vary across stocks and time. In a series of out-of-sample tests, we find that these robustness scores reliably predict the crosssection of stock returns during 65 inflation shocks since 2008 and that an inflation robustness factor constructed from these scores significantly outperforms during inflation events. These results suggest that investors may use this method to hedge inflation with a basket of inflation robust stocks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统计方法来预测个股对通胀冲击的相对脆弱性或韧性，通过通胀稳健性评分来帮助投资者构建通胀对冲投资组合。
AI.research_question: 如何预测个股对正通胀冲击的相对脆弱性或韧性？
AI.motivation: 通胀与股票关系复杂，给寻求通胀对冲的投资者带来挑战，需要更精确的方法来识别通胀稳健的个股。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司特征与通胀表现的非线性条件关系理论，允许不同属性和时间维度的影响变化。
AI.method: 统计方法比较个股的公司属性特征与历史上通胀事件中表现好坏股票的相似度，生成通胀稳健性评分。
AI.findings: 在2008年以来的65次通胀冲击中，稳健性评分能可靠预测股票横截面收益，构建的通胀稳健因子在通胀事件中显著优于基准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了捕捉公司特征与通胀关系的非线性条件方法，拓展了通胀对冲的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 投资者可使用该方法构建通胀稳健股票篮子进行有效通胀对冲，提供实用的投资工具。

title: Sustainable Development in Russia’s Cultural Sector
affiliations: Skolkovo School of Management, Skolkovo School of Management, Skolkovo School of Management, SKOLKOVO Sustainability Centre, SKOLKOVO Moscow School of Management, SKOLKOVO Moscow School of Management and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Sustainable Development in Russia’s Cultural Sector
detail.abstract:
This study, Sustainable Development in Russia’s Cultural Sector, undertaken by the SKOLKOVO School of Management’s Sustainable Development Center and Creative Industries Lab, is among the first systematic analyses of sustainability in Russian cultural institutions. It investigates how museums, theaters, libraries, parks, and art clusters interpret sustainable development, what practices they adopt, and which barriers and incentives shape their strategies. The research employs a mixed-methods design: an online survey of more than 250 respondents from over 100 institutions across Russia, thirteen in-depth interviews, and two expert discussion sessions.

Findings demonstrate that although only 3% of institutions have a dedicated sustainability unit and 11% a designated employee, up to 70–80% of their activities already align with sustainability principles. Practices include environmental initiatives (energy efficiency, waste reduction, resource sharing), inclusion and accessibility (barrier-free environments, sign-language tours, tactile models, adapted digital services), staff development and burnout prevention, and financial resilience through partnerships. Yet most organizations do not use the term “sustainable development” explicitly, treating these practices as inherent to their mission. The gap between mission-driven values and system-level management standards remains significant.

The paper highlights the difference between business and culture: while companies approach sustainability as a strategic tool for competitiveness, cultural institutions view their very existence—heritage preservation, education, and community development—as sustainability in action. The study argues that cultural institutions can serve as key agents of social change, but require clearer frameworks, long-term planning horizons, and partnership models to scale their impact. It also provides practical recommendations for aligning cultural strategies with the ESG agendas of business, strengthening resilience, and embedding sustainability into cultural governance in Russia.

AI.tldr: 俄罗斯文化机构可持续发展研究显示，虽然仅有3%的机构设有专门部门，但70-80%的活动已符合可持续发展原则。文化机构将自身存在视为可持续发展的体现，但缺乏系统性管理框架。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯文化机构如何理解可持续发展？采取了哪些实践？面临哪些障碍和激励因素？
AI.motivation: 对俄罗斯文化机构可持续发展进行首次系统性分析，填补该领域研究空白
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展理论在文化领域的应用，文化机构作为社会变革推动者的角色
AI.method: 混合研究方法：在线调查（250+受访者，100+机构）、13个深度访谈、2次专家讨论会
AI.findings: 仅有3%机构有专门部门，11%有专职人员，但70-80%活动符合可持续发展原则；实践包括环境倡议、包容性措施、员工发展和财务韧性；大多数机构不使用"可持续发展"术语
AI.theory_contributions: 提出文化机构将自身存在视为可持续发展的独特视角，区别于企业的战略性竞争工具取向
AI.practical_contributions: 为文化机构提供实践建议：与商业ESG议程对接、增强韧性、将可持续发展融入治理结构

title: Stereotype Threat in the Real World: Male Proctors and Female STEM Performance in High-Stakes Exams
affiliations: , The University of Hong Kong - University of Hong Kong and

detail.title: Stereotype Threat in the Real World: Male Proctors and Female STEM Performance in High-Stakes Exams
detail.abstract: We investigate whether stereotype threat operates in real-world settings by exploiting the random assignment of students and proctors in China’s National College Entrance Examination (2022–2024). Using administrative data covering the full population of high school graduates in one county (10,500 students) and their scores across six subjects, we exploit exogenous variation in proctor gender within the same class by comparing classmates assigned to different test rooms, and across subjects for the same student. The presence of a male chief proctor reduces female students’ STEM scores by about six points, with no effect on non-STEM subjects or male students. The effect is stronger when situational cues are more salient—such as proximity to the proctor—and among female students with stronger STEM identification. Repeated exposure to male proctors in STEM exams further lowers overall scores and admission prospects. Our study provides the first large-scale, quasi-experimental evidence that stereotype threat underlies enduring gender gaps in real-world, high-stakes educational settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过中国高考的随机分配机制，首次提供了大规模准实验证据，证明刻板印象威胁在真实高利害教育环境中导致性别差距。男性主监考使女生的STEM科目成绩下降约6分，对非STEM科目和男生无影响。
AI.research_question: 刻板印象威胁是否在真实世界的高利害教育环境中发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 理解性别差距在STEM领域的持久存在，检验实验室发现的刻板印象威胁效应是否在现实环境中同样显著。
AI.theoretical_framework: 刻板印象威胁理论 - 当个体处于可能证实负面刻板印象的情境时，会产生额外的心理负担和表现焦虑。
AI.method: 利用中国高考（2022-2024）学生和监考老师的随机分配，使用一个县10,500名高中毕业生的行政数据，通过同学间比较和同一学生不同科目比较来识别外生变异。
AI.findings: 男性主监考使女生STEM成绩下降约6分；情境线索更明显时（如靠近监考）效应更强；STEM认同感强的女生受影响更大；重复接触男性监考会进一步降低总体成绩和录取前景。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了第一个大规模准实验证据，证实刻板印象威胁在真实高利害环境中的存在和影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定提供依据，建议在重要考试中考虑监考人员性别配置，以减少刻板印象威胁对女生STEM表现的不利影响。
