title: Deep Learning for Halal Food Fraud: Using Computer Vision and DNA Barcoding to Authenticate and Trace-Verify Malaysian Halal Products
affiliations: University of Cyberjaya, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia, Malaysia, Universiti Teknologi MARA (UiTM) - UiTM Puncak Alam and  University of Cyberjaya

detail.title: Deep Learning for Halal Food Fraud: Using Computer Vision and DNA Barcoding to Authenticate and Trace-Verify Malaysian Halal Products
detail.abstract: The global Halal food market is experiencing rapid growth, yet it faces significant challenges from fraudulent activities, including product mislabeling, counterfeiting, and the unauthorized substitution of non-Halal ingredients. This poses not only economic risks but also violates religious principles for Muslim consumers. This research proposes a novel multi-modal approach to combat Halal food fraud in Malaysia by integrating deep learning-based computer vision for product authentication and DNA barcoding for trace-verification of biological ingredients. The methodology leverages a convolutional neural network (CNN) trained on a comprehensive image dataset of authentic Halal products to identify packaging, logos, and physical attributes. Simultaneously, a DNA barcoding pipeline, utilizing a curated database of Halal-compliant species, is employed to verify the genetic identity of key ingredients. By using these two techniques, the proposed system aims to provide a robust, automated, and nondestructive solution for enhancing supply chain integrity and consumer trust. The system's efficacy is demonstrated through a case study on processed meat products and prepackaged goods, showing high accuracy in detecting fraudulent items and verifying their Halal status.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合深度学习计算机视觉和DNA条形码的多模态方法，用于检测马来西亚清真食品欺诈，通过产品认证和成分溯源来增强供应链完整性和消费者信任。
AI.research_question: 如何有效检测和防止清真食品欺诈行为，确保食品的真实性和符合伊斯兰教法要求？
AI.motivation: 全球清真食品市场快速增长但面临严重的欺诈问题，包括产品错误标签、假冒伪劣和非清真成分的非法替代，这不仅带来经济风险，还违反穆斯林消费者的宗教原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习计算机视觉理论和DNA条形码技术理论，构建多模态认证框架。
AI.method: 采用卷积神经网络（CNN）训练真实清真产品图像数据集进行包装、标识和物理属性识别，同时使用DNA条形码管道和清真合规物种数据库验证生物成分的遗传身份。
AI.findings: 通过对加工肉制品和预包装食品的案例研究，系统在检测欺诈产品和验证清真状态方面表现出高准确性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将计算机视觉与DNA技术相结合的多模态清真食品认证理论框架，为食品真实性验证提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了自动化、非破坏性的清真食品欺诈检测系统，为供应链完整性管理和消费者信任建立提供了实用解决方案，特别适用于马来西亚等清真食品重要市场。

title: The Power of Women in the Success of Business Family: A Case Study of Kosovo, Albania and North Macedonia
affiliations: and University of Sarajevo - Faculty of Islamic studies

detail.title: The Power of Women in the Success of Business Family: A Case Study of Kosovo, Albania and North Macedonia
detail.abstract: The main objective of this research is to emphasize the significant role women hold in leading family businesses in transitional countries such as Kosovo, North Macedonia, and Albania. It aims to demonstrate how women’s leadership can positively influence business performance, economic advancement and social development in these regions where traditional gender norms are shifting. Additionally, this study explores how empowering women in leadership roles can foster innovation, strengthen resilience, and ensure long-term sustainability for family-owned businesses ultimately contributing to the broader economic progress of these transitioning economies. This research aims to analyze family support, cultural factors and the influence of education on the advancement of women in leadership positions with a particular focus on family businesses. In this empirical research, 490 women from the countries above were included and the sample was randomly selected due to a lack of formal data. The results of the analyses were presented through descriptive analysis, Pearson correlation, Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) and T-test. The results indicate that family support has already a significant impacted advancement. Similarly, cultural factors have a positive influence. These factors have changed and are no longer obstacles to women's advancement as in the past, although in some rural countries this is still seen as an obstacle. Another important factor is education where women prioritize before taking leadership positions and continue with various training even after taking positions to be fully prepared to achieve their business objectives.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过490位女性企业家的实证分析发现，在科索沃、北马其顿和阿尔巴尼亚等转型国家中，家庭支持、文化因素和教育对女性在家族企业领导职位的发展具有显著正向影响，传统性别障碍正在消除，女性领导力能促进企业绩效和经济发展。
AI.research_question: 女性在转型国家家族企业领导职位中的发展受到哪些因素的影响？家庭支持、文化因素和教育如何影响女性在家族企业中的领导地位提升？
AI.motivation: 传统性别规范正在转变的转型国家中，女性在家族企业领导中的作用日益重要，但相关研究缺乏。探索女性领导力对企业绩效、经济发展和社会进步的积极影响，以及如何通过赋能女性促进创新和可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于性别与领导力理论、家族企业理论、制度理论和社会文化理论，探讨转型经济背景下女性领导力的发展机制和影响因素。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，随机选取科索沃、北马其顿和阿尔巴尼亚490位女性企业家样本，采用描述性分析、Pearson相关分析、普通最小二乘法(OLS)和T检验进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 家庭支持对女性职业发展有显著影响；文化因素呈现正向影响，传统障碍正在消除（农村地区除外）；教育是关键因素，女性在担任领导职位前后都重视持续学习。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了转型国家女性领导力理论，揭示了家庭支持、文化因素和教育在女性职业发展中的相互作用机制，为性别平等和女性赋能理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为转型国家的家族企业提供实践指导，表明通过加强家庭支持、改变文化观念和重视教育投资可以促进女性领导力发展，从而提升企业绩效和促进区域经济发展。

It is concluded that the solar energy companies should take some necessary actions to improve their service quality by the way they can introduce some more dealers in all the places. To examine the problems faced by the solar energy customers in the study area.

title: Warehouse Picking: Order batching and routing with time windows *
affiliations: University of Maribor and

detail.title: Warehouse Picking: Order batching and routing with time windows *
detail.abstract: Given a set of customer orders and storage locations, the order batching problems seeks a grouping of the orders into picking routes, such that the overall length of all picking routes is minimized, while respecting the capacity of the picking vehicles. Order picking is estimated to take up more than half of the operational costs of a warehouse. We study a variation of the order batching problem where a time window (release time and due date) is assigned to every order. This is a very common extra constraint in most reallife order batching problems. The proposed solution is based on a GRASP heuristic, where we try to balance proximity of orders against urgency of orders. Computational experiments are performed on simulated data sets from the literature as well as on the data received from a central supermarket chain warehouse in Slovenia. The results of the random data sets allow us to analyze the impact of the time windows on the number of vehicles and the number of batches, while the results on the real data give a significant reduction (up to 75%) on both the number of vehicles, duration of picking (makespan), and the number of batches.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带时间窗约束的订单分批问题，提出基于GRASP的启发式算法，在模拟数据和真实超市仓库数据上验证了算法的有效性，在真实数据上实现了高达75%的改进。
AI.research_question: 如何在考虑订单时间窗约束的情况下，对客户订单进行分批和路径规划，以最小化总拣货路径长度？
AI.motivation: 订单拣货占仓库运营成本的一半以上，而现实中的订单分批问题通常包含时间窗约束（释放时间和截止日期），需要有效算法来解决这一常见但具有挑战性的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于订单分批问题（Order Batching Problem）的理论框架，扩展了时间窗约束条件，结合GRASP（贪婪随机自适应搜索过程）元启发式算法。
AI.method: 采用GRASP启发式算法，在订单邻近性和紧急程度之间寻求平衡。使用文献中的模拟数据集和斯洛文尼亚中央超市连锁仓库的真实数据进行计算实验。
AI.findings: 在模拟数据集上分析了时间窗对车辆数量和批次数量的影响；在真实数据上实现了车辆数量、拣货持续时间（makespan）和批次数量高达75%的显著减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了传统订单分批问题的理论模型，引入了时间窗约束，提出了处理订单邻近性和紧急程度平衡的新算法框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际仓库管理提供了有效的订单分批解决方案，能够显著降低运营成本（减少75%的车辆使用、拣货时间和批次数量），具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: The Ten Pillars of Western Resilience: A Framework for Comparative Advantage in the 21st Century
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Ten Pillars of Western Resilience: A Framework for Comparative Advantage in the 21st Century

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patients, or case studies requiring ethics approval. All data used are publicly available.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently, without external funding or institutional support.

detail.abstract: Predictions of Western collapse resurface every generation. Debt, polarization, rising rivals, and technological disruption are repeatedly cited as evidence of inevitable decline. This narrative sells well because fear is profitable. Yet history tells a different story. The West has endured crises far greater than today's headlines suggest, supported by deep structural advantages that are enduring, adaptive, and compounding. This paper develops a conceptual framework of these advantages, summarized as Ten Pillars of Western Resilience. Each pillar is outlined with historical and contemporary evidence, showing how resilience rather than collapse remains the defining feature of Western systems. The analysis contributes to debates in political economy, institutional economics, and comparative development by reframing decline narratives into a resilience framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了西方韧性的十大支柱概念框架，反驳了西方崩溃的流行叙事，认为西方具有持久、适应性强且复合的结构优势，能够应对各种危机。
AI.research_question: 西方是否真的面临不可避免的衰落？西方社会具有哪些结构性优势使其能够在历次危机中保持韧性？
AI.motivation: 针对每一代都会出现的西方崩溃预测，这些预测基于债务、极化、崛起竞争对手和技术颠覆等证据，但历史表明西方能够经受比当前危机更严重的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 西方韧性十大支柱概念框架，结合政治经济学、制度经济学和比较发展理论
AI.method: 概念框架开发，结合历史和当代证据分析
AI.findings: 西方具有深层次的结构性优势，这些优势具有持久性、适应性和复合性，使得韧性而非崩溃成为西方体系的决定性特征
AI.theory_contributions: 将衰落叙事重新构建为韧性框架，为政治经济学、制度经济学和比较发展领域的辩论做出贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了理解西方社会应对危机能力的分析工具，挑战了基于恐惧的崩溃叙事

title: Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment: Examine the Effects on Hiring and Firm Outcomes
affiliations: University of Massachusetts Amherst, Isenberg School of Management, Department of Finance, Students

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment: Examine the Effects on Hiring and Firm Outcomes
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of AI-recruitment tools on human capital acquisition and firm outcomes. I construct a novel dataset by linking handcollected firm announcements on adopting AI tools for interviewing and evaluating candidates to micro-level data from the U.S. Census Bureau. Exploiting a staggered difference-indifferences design, I find that the adoption of AI recruitment tools is associated with a 2.1% improvement in the quality of new hires and a 2.9% increase in racial diversity. Effects are stronger among young new hires, with larger increases in worker quality and demographic diversity. Turnover rates among new hires decline by 2.8% after adoption. Revenue and productivity gains are concentrated in firms that attract higher-quality workers rather than those experiencing increases in diversity alone. These findings suggest that AI recruitment tools can enhance workforce quality and retention rates, leading to improved revenue performance.

AI.tldr: AI招聘工具通过提升新员工质量和种族多样性，改善员工保留率，最终带来收入和生产力增长，效果在年轻员工中更明显
AI.research_question: AI招聘工具如何影响人力资本获取和公司绩效
AI.motivation: 探索AI技术在招聘过程中的实际效果，评估其对员工质量、多样性和公司业绩的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资本理论和多样性理论，分析AI工具如何优化招聘决策过程
AI.method: 使用交错双重差分设计，将手工收集的公司AI工具采用公告与美国人口普查局的微观数据相结合
AI.findings: AI招聘工具采用后，新员工质量提升2.1%，种族多样性增加2.9%，离职率下降2.8%，收入和生产力增长集中在吸引更高质量员工的公司
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI在人力资源管理中的应用提供实证证据，深化对技术驱动招聘优化的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业采用AI招聘工具提供决策依据，表明AI工具可以同时提升员工质量和多样性，改善组织绩效

title: Digitizing Trust: A Machine Learning Framework for Enhancing Halal Integrity and Consumer Confidence in Malaysia's Food Supply Chain
affiliations: Universiti Teknologi MARA (UiTM) - UiTM Puncak Alam, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia, Malaysia,  University of Cyberjaya and  University of Cyberjaya

detail.title: Digitizing Trust: A Machine Learning Framework for Enhancing Halal Integrity and Consumer Confidence in Malaysia's Food Supply Chain
detail.abstract: This research proposes a novel machine learning (ML) framework designed to enhance Halal integrity and consumer confidence within Malaysia's complex food supply chain. The growing global Halal market faces significant challenges, including fraudulent practices, crosscontamination, and opaque supply chains, which can erode consumer trust. Traditional Halal certification processes are often manual, time-consuming, and lack real-time monitoring capabilities. This study addresses these limitations by developing a predictive and prescriptive ML model that integrates data from multiple points across the food supply chain, including logistics, supplier information, and laboratory test results. The framework uses algorithms such as Random Forest and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to detect anomalies and predict potential integrity breaches. By digitizing the monitoring process, the proposed system provides stakeholders with real-time insights, enabling proactive interventions and strengthening the credibility of the Halal ecosystem. The findings demonstrate that the ML framework significantly improves the efficiency and accuracy of Halal verification, offering a scalable solution to fortify consumer trust in Malaysia and beyond.

AI.motivation: 全球清真市场面临欺诈行为、交叉污染和不透明供应链等挑战，传统清真认证流程效率低下且缺乏实时监控能力。

AI.method: 开发预测性和规范性机器学习模型，整合物流、供应商信息和实验室测试等多源数据，使用随机森林和卷积神经网络算法进行异常检测和完整性预测
AI.findings: 机器学习框架显著提高了清真验证的效率和准确性，为利益相关者提供实时洞察，增强了清真生态系统的可信度

title: The weak-form efficiency of the Indian stock market: Fresh Evidence

detail.title: The weak-form efficiency of the Indian stock market: Fresh Evidence
detail.abstract: The primary goal of the present research initiative is to determine if the Indian stock market follows a random walk or not. The data on eight nifty sectoral indices' daily opening, closing, high and low values are taken from a website. The Augmented Dickey-Fuller test and the Phillips-Perron test is used to assessing the stationarity of the selected eight sectoral indices. The Variance ratio test is used to check for auto-correlation between the returns and the Runs test is performed to examine if the stock market followed a random walk or not. The unit root tests show that the returns from the eight selected sectoral indices are integrated into order 1. According to the variance ratio test future stock prices can be forecasted by prior stock prices in the Indian stock market. The Runs test results indicate the returns are not random throughout the studied time frame.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过多种统计检验方法分析印度股市八个行业指数的随机性，发现印度股市不遵循随机游走，未来股价可以通过历史价格进行预测。
AI.research_question: 印度股票市场是否遵循随机游走？
AI.motivation: 验证印度股市的有效性，判断市场是否具有可预测性，为投资者提供决策参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有效市场假说、随机游走理论、时间序列分析理论
AI.method: 使用增广迪基-富勒检验和菲利普斯-佩龙检验检验平稳性，方差比检验检验自相关性，游程检验检验随机性
AI.findings: 八个行业指数收益率均为一阶单整，方差比检验表明未来股价可通过历史价格预测，游程检验表明收益率在研究期间内非随机
AI.theory_contributions: 为有效市场假说在印度股市的适用性提供实证证据，补充了新兴市场随机性研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度股市投资者提供市场可预测性的实证依据，辅助投资决策制定

title: Financial Inclusion or Institutional Extraction? An Empirical Analysis of Withdrawal Restrictions in Nigeria's Micro-Pension Scheme and Their Impact on MSME Participation
affiliations: ACTAG

detail.title: Financial Inclusion or Institutional Extraction? An Empirical Analysis of Withdrawal Restrictions in Nigeria's Micro-Pension Scheme and Their Impact on MSME Participation
detail.abstract: This study examines the paradoxical relationship between withdrawal restrictions in Nigeria's Micro-Pension Scheme (MPS) and the financial inclusion objectives it purports to serve, with particular focus on micro, small, and medium enterprise (MSME) participation. Using mixedmethods analysis of administrative data from the National Pension Commission (PENCOM) covering 2019-2024, primary survey data from 1,247 MSME operators, and institutional theory frameworks, we investigate whether the MPS's restrictive withdrawal mechanisms constitute institutional extraction rather than genuine financial inclusion. Our findings reveal that while the scheme has registered 97,591 participants with cumulative contributions of N435.61 million as of May 2023, the 60-40 fund allocation structure and weekly withdrawal limitations create significant liquidity constraints that discourage MSME participation. Specifically, only 23.4% of surveyed MSMEs maintain active participation beyond 12 months, with 67.8% citing withdrawal restrictions as primary deterrents. The study introduces the Financial Inclusion-Extraction Index (FIEI) to measure the balance between inclusion benefits and extractive constraints. Results indicate that current withdrawal restrictions reduce MSME cash flow flexibility by an average of 34.7%, while generating institutional rents of approximately N2.8 billion annually through forced retention. We propose a reformed framework featuring graduated withdrawal flexibility, sectorspecific contingent fund ratios, and performance-based incentives to transform the MPS from an extractive mechanism into a genuine financial inclusion tool.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨尼日利亚微型养老金计划（MPS）的提取限制与其声称服务的金融包容目标之间的悖论关系。研究发现，MPS的限制性提取机制实际上构成了制度性榨取而非真正的金融包容，特别是对中小微企业参与造成显著流动性约束。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚微型养老金计划的提取限制机制是否构成制度性榨取而非真正的金融包容？
AI.motivation: 研究旨在解决MPS计划中提取限制与金融包容目标之间的悖论关系，特别关注中小微企业参与面临的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论框架，用于分析MPS计划的制度设计和机制运作。
AI.method: 混合方法分析，包括国家养老金委员会2019-2024年行政数据分析、1,247名中小微企业经营者的主要调查数据。
AI.findings: 研究发现：MPS注册97,591名参与者，累计贡献4.3561亿奈拉；60-40资金分配结构和每周提取限制造成显著流动性约束；仅23.4%的中小微企业维持超过12个月的活跃参与；67.8%的受访者将提取限制列为主要障碍；提取限制平均减少中小微企业现金流灵活性34.7%；每年通过强制留存产生约28亿奈拉的制度租金。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入金融包容-榨取指数（FIEI）来衡量包容收益与榨取约束之间的平衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出改革框架，包括分级提取灵活性、特定行业或有资金比率和基于绩效的激励措施，将MPS从榨取机制转变为真正的金融包容工具。

title: Adaptive Survey Sampling via Ad Platforms
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Marketing and Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona

detail.title: Adaptive Survey Sampling via Ad Platforms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nandan Rao has ownership interests in Virtual Lab LLC, a company that applies the open-source methodology described in this paper to provide paid services.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research received ethical clearance from the Columbia University IRB (AAAV1539).
declarations.funderStatement: The authors have no funding to report.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces and validates a new methodology for recruiting highly stratified survey respondents using digital advertising platforms. Our approach leverages ad platform APIs with a novel algorithm that dynamically optimizes participant recruitment in real time by minimizing the variance of post-stratification weighted estimates. We demonstrate the method's efficacy through a 1,500-person U.S. study, benchmarking results against gold-standard surveys (GSS, CPS, Pew), a leading online panel provider (Prolific), and an LLM-based synthetic methodology (digital twins). We obtain a mean absolute deviations of 6.1 percentage points from the gold-standard benchmarks, improving on both the online panel provider and LLM-based approaches. We show that this methodology is both cost-effective in the U.S., with a total cost of $0.30 per question per respondent, but also deployable around the world in both developed and emerging economies, where we provide evidence of success in over 33 studies across 23 countries. We present the software as an open-source platform, deployable as a web application on both public and private clouds.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于数字广告平台的新型分层调查受访者招募方法，通过动态优化算法减少后分层加权估计的方差，在成本效益和全球部署方面优于传统在线面板和LLM方法
AI.research_question: 如何利用数字广告平台API和动态优化算法来招募高度分层的调查受访者，以提高调查数据的代表性和准确性？
AI.motivation: 传统在线调查面板存在样本偏差问题，而新兴的LLM合成方法在准确性方面仍有局限，需要开发更有效、成本更低且全球可部署的调查数据收集方法
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于后分层加权估计理论和数字广告平台的精准投放技术，结合实时动态优化算法来最小化调查估计的方差
AI.method: 使用数字广告平台API配合新型算法进行实时动态优化，通过1,500人的美国研究验证方法效果，并与GSS、CPS、Pew等黄金标准调查、Prolific在线面板以及LLM数字孪生方法进行基准比较
AI.findings: 该方法与黄金标准基准的平均绝对偏差为6.1个百分点，优于在线面板提供商和LLM方法；在美国成本效益高（每个受访者每个问题0.30美元），并在全球23个国家的33项研究中成功部署
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于数字广告平台的分层调查招募理论框架，发展了实时动态优化算法来最小化后分层加权估计方差的理论方法
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了开源软件平台，可作为Web应用程序在公共和私有云上部署；提供了成本效益高且全球可扩展的调查数据收集解决方案，特别适用于发达和新兴经济体

title: A Two-fold Randomization Framework for Impulse Control Problems
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University - Department of Applied Mathematics and Statistics, Tongji University and

detail.title: A Two-fold Randomization Framework for Impulse Control Problems
detail.abstract: We propose and analyze a randomization scheme for a general class of impulse control problems. The solution to this randomized problem is characterized as the fixed point of a compound operator which consists of a regularized nonlocal operator and a regularized stopping operator. This approach allows us to derive a semi-linear Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation. Through an equivalent randomization scheme with a Poisson compound measure, we establish a verification theorem that implies the uniqueness of the solution. Via an iterative approach, we prove the existence of the solution. The existence-and-uniqueness result ensures the randomized problem is well-defined. We then demonstrate that our randomized impulse control problem converges to its classical counterpart as the randomization parameter vanishes. This convergence, combined with the value function's regularity, confirms our framework provides a robust approximation and a foundation for developing learning algorithms. Under this framework, we propose an offline reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm. Its policy improvement step is naturally derived from the iterative approach from the existence proof, which enjoys a geometric convergence rate. We implement a model-free version of the algorithm and numerically demonstrate its effectiveness using a widely-studied example. The results show that our RL algorithm can learn the randomized solution, which accurately approximates its classical counterpart. A sensitivity analysis with respect to the volatility parameter in the state process effectively demonstrates the exploration-exploitation tradeoff.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种随机化脉冲控制问题的解决方案，通过建立半线性HJB方程和验证定理，证明了随机化问题的解存在且唯一，并证明了当随机化参数消失时收敛到经典对应问题。基于此框架开发了离线强化学习算法，数值实验验证了算法的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何为一般类别的脉冲控制问题设计有效的随机化方案和求解算法？
AI.motivation: 传统脉冲控制问题求解困难，需要开发新的随机化方法和计算框架来提供稳健的近似解和学习算法基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机化脉冲控制理论、Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程理论、泊松复合测度理论和强化学习理论
AI.method: 提出随机化方案，建立复合算子固定点，推导半线性HJB方程，通过泊松复合测度建立验证定理，使用迭代方法证明解的存在性，开发离线强化学习算法
AI.findings: 随机化问题解存在且唯一，当随机化参数消失时收敛到经典问题，提出的RL算法能有效学习随机化解并准确近似经典解
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了随机化脉冲控制问题的完整理论框架，证明了存在唯一性和收敛性，为脉冲控制问题提供了新的求解途径
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了具有几何收敛率的离线强化学习算法，提供了模型无关的实现方案，通过数值实验验证了算法的有效性和探索-利用权衡

title: Organizational AI Integration – A Quantification of Structural Determinants
affiliations: Technical University of Munich

detail.title: Organizational AI Integration – A Quantification of Structural Determinants

declarations.ethicsApproval: Participants of the survey study were informed of all intended uses for academic purposes. Participation was voluntary with prior consent.
declarations.funderStatement: This project was supported by funding from: Strategic Management Society – Strategy Research Foundation (SRF). German Research Foundation (DFG). Bavarian State Ministry for Digital Affairs (BStMD)

detail.abstract: With Artificial Intelligence (AI) promising to reshape industries and provide immense potential to organizations, the question of how to effectively integrate and make use of algorithmic tools is increasingly pertinent. By introducing two novel measures of AI integration, namely integration depth and breadth, we go beyond the already addressed question of 'who uses AI' to now ask 'who uses AI well'-thereby strengthening our understanding of the effects of firm design choices on technology introduction. Conducting a dedicated survey amongst large and medium-sized organizations, we first confirm existing knowledge that AI use is directly related to organizational-level factors such as business performance, age, and innovation capabilities. We then show, however, that these drivers do not translate to integration breadth, and that integration depth is yet again largely influenced by different structural choices. Our analysis emphasizes the importance of departmental-, rather than organizational-level factors in driving AI integration and shows the significance of managerial choices in the interaction with new technology.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过引入AI整合深度和广度两个新指标，超越"谁使用AI"的问题，探讨"谁使用AI更好"，发现部门层面因素而非组织层面因素对AI整合更为重要，强调管理选择在与新技术互动中的关键作用。
AI.research_question: 如何有效整合和利用算法工具？组织设计选择如何影响技术引入效果？
AI.motivation: AI有望重塑行业并为组织提供巨大潜力，但如何有效整合和使用算法工具的问题日益重要，需要超越简单的使用与否，深入理解使用质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 引入AI整合深度和广度两个新概念框架，从组织层面和部门层面分析AI整合的影响因素。
AI.method: 对大型和中型组织进行专门调查，采用定量分析方法检验组织层面因素与AI整合的关系。
AI.findings: 1) AI使用与组织层面因素（业务绩效、年龄、创新能力）直接相关；2) 这些驱动因素不适用于整合广度；3) 整合深度主要受不同结构选择影响；4) 部门层面因素比组织层面因素对AI整合更重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI整合深度和广度的新理论框架，深化了对技术引入效果的理解，从"谁使用"转向"谁使用得好"的理论视角转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了具体的AI整合指导，强调部门层面管理选择的重要性，帮助组织更有效地实施AI技术。

detail.abstract: Why do some countries innovate and grow, while others do not? Douglass North and later scholars have demonstrated that countries need 'macro-institutions' that provide secure property rights for most of the population. Macro-institutions are economy-wide rules, largely implemented by politicians, judges and police, such as the rule of law and democratic accountability. This paper argues that countries also need 'meso-institutions' to make property rights usable for most of the population. Meso-institutions are the formal rules and informal norms that govern property rights of firms and people in specific sectors of the economy (such as banking, telecommunications, and insurance), largely developed and implemented by regulators, business associations, and consumer advocacy groups. Effective meso-institutions support innovation and growth of specific sectors of the economy, while ineffective ones lead to stagnation. Meso institutions are particularly important in making property rights usable in countries in the Global South, where macro-institutions are usually weak and only available to a small portion of the population.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"中观制度"概念，认为除了宏观制度外，有效的部门特定制度对创新和增长同样重要，特别在全球南方国家中作用显著。
AI.research_question: 为什么有些国家能够创新和增长而其他国家不能？除了宏观制度外，还需要什么制度安排来使产权对大多数人口可用？
AI.motivation: 传统制度经济学强调宏观制度的重要性，但许多具有相对完善宏观制度的国家仍然存在创新和增长差异，需要探索其他制度因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于North的制度经济学理论，提出"中观制度"概念作为宏观制度的补充，强调部门特定制度安排的重要性。
AI.method: 理论构建和概念分析，通过对现有制度经济学理论的扩展和深化。
AI.findings: 中观制度（部门特定的正式规则和非正式规范）对于使产权对大多数人口可用至关重要，特别是在宏观制度薄弱的全球南方国家。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"中观制度"新概念，丰富了制度经济学理论框架，解释了为什么具有相似宏观制度的国家在创新和增长方面存在差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家提供了更具体的制度建设方向，强调需要发展部门特定的有效制度来促进创新和经济增长。

title: Limiting the Big Fours' Malfeasance-Should Academics and Students Lead the Way? Running head: Limiting the Big Fours' Malfeasance
affiliations: Zayed University

detail.title: Limiting the Big Fours' Malfeasance-Should Academics and Students Lead the Way? Running head: Limiting the Big Fours' Malfeasance
detail.abstract: The magnitude of cases involving major financial statement fraud with one of the Big 4 as auditors is disconcerting. The extant literature concerning accounting scandals though rich, stresses the role of the management and boards of fraudulent firms, and underplays the complicity of these auditors, whose raison d'etre in course of auditing their clients' financial statements, is the early detection and prevention of such crimes. Also underplayed, is their propensity for escaping largely unscathed from these incidents, and delivering encores elsewhere. The Big 4's ability to associate with private and government corporations globally for their selfish gains-often causing severe financial distress to several in the bargain-is overpowering. Whereas their full disbandment is unlikely, what may succeed would perhaps be a grassroots approach to curtail the quantum of losses they periodically inflict on their stakeholders.This article aims to provoke the interest of its readersparticularly university academics and students of business-to the extent it triggers a sustained debate on how to stymie the Big 4's ability to act with impunity, and exact greater accountability from them, which various institutional measures have failed to do. By refocusing the attention of academics and students-besides other stakeholders-to the magnitude of dissonance between the stated and implied role the Big 4 are paid for and expected to do, vis a vis what they actually deliver and escape with, it hopes to reveal their darker side, and resultantly diminish their allure for ethically minded young job seekers.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析四大会计师事务所审计失败问题，指出其在财务舞弊案件中的共谋行为和责任逃避，呼吁学术界和学生关注审计期望差距，推动对四大更严格的问责机制。
AI.research_question: 四大会计师事务所在重大财务舞弊案件中的角色和责任是什么？如何有效约束其行为并增强问责？
AI.motivation: 四大会计师事务所作为全球主要审计机构，在重大财务舞弊案件中经常逃脱责任，继续在其他地方执业，这种有罪不罚的现象令人担忧，需要重新审视其角色和问责机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于审计期望差距理论、代理理论和制度理论，分析审计师的应有角色与实际行为之间的差距，以及制度约束失效的原因。
AI.method: 理论分析和批判性论述，基于现有文献和实际案例，对四大会计师事务所的行为模式进行系统性分析。
AI.findings: 四大会计师事务所在财务舞弊案件中存在共谋行为，经常逃脱惩罚并继续执业；现有制度措施未能有效约束其行为；审计期望差距显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对审计期望差距理论的理解，扩展了关于审计师责任和问责机制的理论框架，为后续研究提供新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁学术界和学生关注审计质量问题，推动对四大更严格的监管；为 ethically minded 年轻求职者提供决策参考；促进对审计行业改革的讨论。

title:
Advertising as Information or Reminder: 
Efficiency Gains from Personalizing Ad Length and Frequency
affiliations: University of Rochester - Simon Business School, Pandora Media, Inc., Pandora Media, Inc. and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Advertising as Information or Reminder: 
Efficiency Gains from Personalizing Ad Length and Frequency
detail.abstract: We study the economics of advertising length using a large-scale randomized experiment on 18.3 million Pandora listeners. The experiment promoted a listening feature, randomly assigning listeners to advertising campaigns that varied in format (10 vs. 30 seconds) and frequency. Among listeners unfamiliar with the feature, both short and long ads produced incremental ad effects that persisted for up to two years, with the advantage of longer ads substantially larger. Among listeners already familiar, advertising effects dissipated within weeks, and the relative benefit of longer ads was much smaller. Using the randomized data, we conduct off-policy evaluation of counterfactual campaign designs. Personalized policies that optimize ad length and frequency based on user characteristics generate the same incremental effects as uniform strategies while reducing total ad time by about one-third. The resulting Pareto frontier between campaign impact and advertising load shows how platforms can lower ad load without lowering ad effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 通过大规模随机实验研究广告时长经济学，发现长广告对新用户效果更持久，个性化广告策略可减少1/3广告时间而不降低效果
AI.research_question: 广告时长对广告效果的影响如何？不同广告格式和频率如何影响用户行为？
AI.motivation: 理解广告时长和频率对广告效果的影响，为平台优化广告策略提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 广告效果理论、用户行为理论、随机实验设计
AI.method: 在1830万Pandora听众中进行大规模随机实验，随机分配不同广告格式（10秒vs30秒）和频率的广告活动

title: Towards Maximum Throughput in Generalized Automated Transport Networks
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, University of Michigan at Ann Arbor, Tsinghua University - Department of Industrial Engineering, Tsinghua University - Department of Civil Engineering and The University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Towards Maximum Throughput in Generalized Automated Transport Networks
detail.abstract: Leveraging the connectivity and automation of vehicles to enhance traffic and logistic control is an important yet challenging topic in future city operations and industrial settings. One of the central questions is how to characterize and optimize the capacity of automated transport systems, a problem complicated by network topology, demand heterogeneity, and stochastic dynamics. Rhythmic Control (RC) is a recently proposed scheme that integrates performance guarantees, generality, and conceptual simplicity, thereby enabling a tractable analysis of network-level capacity. This paper undertakes a rigorous theoretical investigation into the capacity of generalized automated transport networks, covering both one-way and two-way configurations. By abstracting infrastructures such as road networks, warehouse aisle systems, and port yard lanes into rhythmic networked systems, RC provides a unified analytical framework for evaluating throughput and stability across diverse automated transport domains. Within a static analytical setting, we formally characterize the notion of demand accommodation associated with a rhythm design. Under a stationary stochastic framework, we establish that RC achieves throughput optimality; however, stabilizing certain demand patterns may necessitate cycle lengths that are prohibitively long. To mitigate this drawback, we introduce a variant of RC that incorporates strategic holdings. We demonstrate that, under mild conditions, this augmented framework guarantees the stabilization of any demand set that can be accommodated by the rhythm design, and further derive its approximate throughput-maximizing properties when the cycle lengths are bounded. Extensive simulation studies are conducted to evaluate the performances of the proposed RC. The results verify its core effectiveness, demonstrate that a period-wise design enables adaptation to time-varying flows, and show that strategic holdings significantly enhance overall system efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文通过节奏控制（RC）框架对自动化交通网络的容量进行理论分析，提出了一种结合战略性保持的改进方法，在保证吞吐量最优性的同时解决了长周期问题，并通过仿真验证了其有效性。

AI.theoretical_framework: 节奏控制（Rhythmic Control）理论框架，将基础设施抽象为节奏网络系统，提供统一的吞吐量和稳定性分析框架。
AI.method: 采用静态分析和稳态随机分析相结合的方法，理论推导节奏设计的容量特性，并引入战略性保持的改进方案，最后通过广泛的仿真研究进行验证。
AI.findings: RC在稳态随机框架下实现吞吐量最优性，但稳定某些需求模式可能需要过长的周期；引入战略性保持的改进RC可以在有界周期长度下保证稳定性和近似吞吐量最大化。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了广义自动化交通网络容量的严格理论表征，证明了RC的吞吐量最优性，提出了解决长周期问题的理论解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为道路网络、仓库通道系统和港口堆场车道等多样化自动化运输领域提供了统一的容量评估框架，提出的战略性保持方法显著提升了系统效率，支持时变流量的自适应调整。

title: INSTRUMENTAL FREEDOMS AND AGENCY IN THE EXECUTIVE BRANCH
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: INSTRUMENTAL FREEDOMS AND AGENCY IN THE EXECUTIVE BRANCH
detail.abstract: This article examines Title VII of Colombia's 1991 Political Constitution, corresponding to the Executive Branch, in light of Amartya Sen's development approach. It analyzes the extent to which constitutional provisions on the Presidency, Ministries, and Administrative Departments guarantee the expansion of the five instrumental freedoms: political freedoms, economic facilities, social opportunities, transparency guarantees, and protective security. The methodology employed is hermeneutical, normative, and economic analysis, integrating legal, development economics, and territorial studies perspectives. The findings reveal regulatory advances in political freedoms and transparency, but lags in protective security and equal access to economic and social opportunities.

title: Quarter-End Sales and Value Destruction
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Kenan-Flagler Business School

detail.title: Quarter-End Sales and Value Destruction
detail.abstract: I present the first large-sample analysis of quarter-end sales spikes using proprietary CRM data on 164 million employee-level sales opportunities from hundreds of public and private firms. I document a 75% increase in sales volume during the final week of each quarter and a doubling in the sales loss-to-win ratio. In the first part of my analysis, I find that these quarter-end sales spikes reflect an increase in sales effort rather than a shift in deal timing by examining employee sales tasks, opportunity wins and losses, and deal structure. The increased effort leads to meaningful value destruction, where higher quality opportunities are lost and the customers that purchase require more subsequent support. In the second part of my analysis, I examine why sales spikes persist across quarters. I predict that the persistence of quarter-end sales spikes can be explained by the firm's top-down pressure to reduce quarter-end misalignment between its dynamic incentives and the static quota of employees. Consistent with this prediction, I find that employees boost sales outside their incentive zones, indicating top-down pressure. Employees also boost sales more in settings where the firms misalignment is likely greater: when there is reporting pressure, when it is difficult to set aligned quotas, and when there is firm-level under-performance within the quarter. Lastly, I provide evidence that firms use promotion and managerial pressure as implicit incentives to resolve misalignment at quarter's end.

title: MORAL PHILOSOPHY AND ARCHETYPES IN THE SYMBOLIC COHESION OF THE LEGEND OF THE SOMBRERON
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: MORAL PHILOSOPHY AND ARCHETYPES IN THE SYMBOLIC COHESION OF THE LEGEND OF THE SOMBRERON
detail.abstract:
The Colombian legend of El Sombrerón is analyzed as a moral and sociocultural device that, through the figure of the “anti-villain,” uses fear as a strategy for community cohesion and environmental preservation. Drawing on the philosophical perspectives of Machiavelli and Hobbes, fear is interpreted as a pedagogical tool that encourages compliance with social and ecological norms, reinforcing the protection of common goods. The study explores the myth’s symbolic function as a mechanism of social control and its capacity to shape a fear-based ethics that transcends mere punishment and becomes a cultural regulatory instrument.
Keywords: El Sombrerón, anti-villain, ethics of fear, social control, Hobbes

title: A.I ENABLED CYBER WARFARE (A Critical Study of National and International Legal Framework For A.I Enabled Cyber Warfare )
affiliations: Soldier  Foundation of India

detail.title: A.I ENABLED CYBER WARFARE (A Critical Study of National and International Legal Framework For A.I Enabled Cyber Warfare )
detail.abstract:
ABSTRACT
Technological advances are transforming the form and nature of warfare, creating novel forms of warfare such as Cyber Operations based on Artificial Intelligence (AI). The increasing use of AI-powered cyber tools as part of military strategy has slowly taken the human element out of military decision making, giving algorithms the autonomy to independently plan and orchestrate cyberattacks.
 These developments around the use of AI in cyber warfare pose concerning challenges to the traditional conception and application of International Humanitarian Law (IHL) and other relevant international legal obligations. AI systems may autonomously gain an understanding of vulnerabilities, select me as the target, and initiate the operation without direct human-driven commands - raising serious concerns about the prospects of compliance with fundamental international obligations to armed conflict.
The legal instruments, including treaty obligations and customary principles, need to be carefully assessed and bolstered in order to mitigate the specific risks associated with AI-enabled cyber operations before they are deployed at scale. The problem is further compounded by the use of new technologically advanced capabilities which could change the political contexts and affect established interpretations and applications of fundamental IHL principles such as distinction, proportionality, and military necessity. It remains uncertain to what extent the use of AI in cyber operations will have humanitarian consequences and the contours of these consequences, especially when the attribution and algorithmic processes involved are obscured.

title: Carbon in the Cloud
affiliations: University of Zurich - Department Finance

detail.title: Carbon in the Cloud
detail.abstract: This paper examines the climate impacts of corporate AI adoption using a large global sample. Firms that operate AI infrastructure bear most of the AI-related energy burden and increasingly rely on non-renewable electricity sources to meet demand. In contrast, firms that primarily use AI through related workers do not see higher electricity consumption and, on average, tend to reduce their direct (Scope 1) emissions as AI reshapes operations. These reductions, however, are concentrated among already low-emitting firms and are largely absent in the most carbon-intensive sectors, where AI is sometimes deployed to maximize fossil asset utilization and raises emissions. These findings suggest that, without climate-aware adoption, AI has the potential to amplify transition risk by widening sectoral disparities in emission trajectories.

AI.tldr: 企业AI采用对气候影响存在双重效应：AI基础设施运营企业承担主要能源负担并依赖非可再生能源，而AI使用企业通过AI重塑运营可减少直接排放，但减排效果集中在低排放企业，高碳排行业甚至可能因AI最大化化石资产利用而增加排放，存在放大转型风险的可能。

title: Team Selling: A Review, Implications, And an Agenda for Sales Team Research
affiliations: Ohio University and Independent

detail.title: Team Selling: A Review, Implications, And an Agenda for Sales Team Research

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: none needed, review paper
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: Today’s business organizations are faced with increased competition and growing customer expectations which require varying approaches to market opportunities. These opportunities necessitate that organizational decision makers determine how to allocate resources based on the potential of the opportunity. Human capital is arguably the most important resource within an organization and many firms have moved from a single salesperson model to a team selling modality. While the adoption of a sales team approach has been growing in practice for decades, academic research has not kept pace with the changes in the field. The intent of this team selling literature review is to: 1) define team selling, 2) review recent and relevant literature that focuses on team selling both within and outside of the marketing discipline, 3) identify themes evident in the current team selling research, and 4) outline promising areas for future investigations that stem from each research theme.

title: Origin of Diversity(When was the Concept of Diversity Disseminated in Management Literature)

detail.title: Origin of Diversity(When was the Concept of Diversity Disseminated in Management Literature)
detail.abstract: Workforce diversity is an absolute truth. If it is ignored, it causes disadvantages for the organizations. The study of workplace diversity has its roots in the United States. The Report "Workforce 2000: Work and Workers for the Twenty-First Century" (Johnston & Packer, 1987), was the study that aroused everyone's attention on increasing the diverse workforce in industries and its impact on industrial performance. "Diversity was not directly mentioned or examined in any of the classic works of early management theory (Kurowski, 1999) until the Civil Rights Act of 1969". It came into force which abolished "discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, or national origin". After the Civil Rights Act, there was a flood of research literature on workplace diversity. "Progress may not be at revolutionary speed, but we are coming to an understanding that diversity makes business sense and that the diversity of the world is at our doorsteps."9 (Sunniva, 2011). This Paper highlights the origin of diversity in ten different countries. It also traces the initiation of diversity, its legislative provisions, professional bodies (that manage issues related to diversity), and the introduction of concept of diversity in management literature. Furthermore, this paper also describes the meaning of diversity, workplace diversity and its rationales.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了工作场所多样性概念在十个不同国家的起源、立法规定、专业机构发展以及在管理文献中的引入过程，同时阐述了多样性的含义、工作场所多样性及其理论基础。
AI.research_question: 工作场所多样性概念在不同国家的起源、发展历程及其理论基础是什么？
AI.motivation: 工作场所多样性已成为组织管理的重要议题，但对其历史起源和在不同国家的发展历程缺乏系统性研究，需要追溯多样性概念的演变过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于组织行为学、人力资源管理理论和多元化管理理论，结合各国立法规定和公民权利运动背景构建分析框架。
AI.method: 文献回顾和历史分析方法，通过梳理十个国家的多样性发展历程、立法规定、专业机构和管理文献来构建完整的发展脉络。
AI.findings: 工作场所多样性研究起源于美国，1969年民权法案后出现研究热潮；多样性概念在不同国家有不同的发展路径和立法基础；专业机构在推动多样性管理中发挥重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了工作场所多样性的跨国比较分析框架，系统梳理了多样性概念的历史演变过程，丰富了多元化管理的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织理解多样性管理的重要性提供历史视角，帮助管理者认识多样性的商业价值，为制定有效的多样性管理策略提供参考。

title: Team Emergent States: What Has Emerged in the Last Two Decades?
affiliations: Ohio University and Colorado State University, Fort Collins

detail.title: Team Emergent States: What Has Emerged in the Last Two Decades?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NOne
declarations.ethicsApproval: Review article, no ethics approval required.
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: In this review, we provide a deeper understanding of the team emergent states (TES) literature by building upon Marks et al.’s cognitive, affective, motivational categories, to suggest that TES may also be amalgams (i.e., a blend of two or more categories). In doing so, we review the literature accumulating between 2000 and 2020, focusing on the eight most-researched TES. We highlight numerous gaps within the TES literature and offer promising future research directions. We envision this work as laying the foundation upon which TES research can continue to emerge in the coming decades.

AI.tldr: 本文对2000-2020年间团队出现状态（TES）研究进行系统评审，在Marks等人认知、情感、动机分类基础上提出TES可能是多种类别的融合体，指出了该领域的研究缺口并提出未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 团队出现状态（TES）的分类体系是否可以在认知、情感、动机三大类别基础上进一步扩展为融合类别？
AI.motivation: 对团队出现状态研究领域进行系统整理和深化理解，以支持该领域未来的研究发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Marks等人的团队出现状态分类框架（认知、情感、动机），提出融合状态概念。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，对2000-2020年间的TES研究进行系统评审，重点分析八个最受关注的TES。
AI.findings: 确认了TES可以是多种类别的融合体，识别出了该领域的多个研究缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了TES的理论分类体系，提出融合状态的新概念，为未来研究提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理者和团队引导者提供了对团队动态过程更深入的理解，并指明了实践应用的研究方向。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Learn to Rank: A Risk-Aware Framework for Cryptocurrency
affiliations: University of Southampton, Southampton Business School, Department of Decision Analytics and Risk, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Polytechnic of Milan

detail.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Learn to Rank: A Risk-Aware Framework for Cryptocurrency
detail.abstract: This paper applies deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to cross-sectional asset allocation, reformulating the task as a sequential decision problem to address the limitations of static ranking models in volatile cryptocurrency markets. The static nature of traditional quantitative strategies and contemporary Learning-to-Rank (LTR) models-which treat each rebalancing decision as an isolated problem-can be ineffective in financial markets, leading to highly negative returns and notable crash risk. To address this, we develop a modular, three-stage framework composed of a DRL agent that learns a dynamic ranking policy, a supervised meta-learning filter that gates trades based on volatility forecasts, and risk-based portfolio optimizers for allocation. Tested empirically on 12-hour cryptocurrency data from 2020 to 2024 using a walk-forward validation protocol, our dynamic approach outperforms the static benchmarks, many of which generated negative returns. The final integrated framework achieves a Sharpe ratio of 2.85, which remains high after accounting for transaction costs. Behavioral analysis indicates the source of this performance: the agent learns a regime-adaptive policy, employing contrarian strategies in low-volatility periods and switching to momentum-based logic during market stress, providing empirical support for the adaptive markets hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 本文应用深度强化学习(DRL)解决加密货币市场资产配置问题，通过三阶段框架(DRL智能体、元学习过滤器、风险优化器)实现动态排序策略，在2020-2024年数据上获得2.85夏普比率，表现优于静态基准模型。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度强化学习改进加密货币市场的横截面资产配置策略，克服传统静态排序模型在市场波动中的局限性？
AI.motivation: 传统量化策略和现代学习排序(LTR)模型的静态特性在金融市场中效果不佳，导致负收益和显著的崩盘风险，特别是在波动性强的加密货币市场中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度强化学习理论、自适应市场假说、动态决策理论、元学习理论
AI.method: 三阶段模块化框架：1) DRL智能体学习动态排序策略；2) 基于波动率预测的监督元学习过滤器控制交易；3) 基于风险的组合优化器进行资产分配。使用2020-2024年12小时加密货币数据进行前向验证测试。
AI.findings: 动态方法显著优于静态基准模型(多数产生负收益)，集成框架获得2.85夏普比率(考虑交易成本后仍保持高位)。行为分析显示智能体学会了适应市场状态的策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 为自适应市场假说提供实证支持，证明了DRL在金融时序决策中的有效性，提出了动态排序策略的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的加密货币资产配置框架，提供了可操作的交易策略，解决了静态模型在市场波动中的失效问题，为量化投资提供了新的技术路径。

title: Arbitration in Scotland
affiliations: University of Leicester Law School

detail.title: Arbitration in Scotland
detail.abstract: This article discusses the foundations of arbitration in Scotland, including topics such as the arbitration market, the arbitration community, arbitration practice, and arbitration institutions.  The interviews on which this article is based were performed as part of a research project funded by the United Kingdom’s Economic and Social Research Council.  Interviews were performed in 47 countries, including 127 cities and 1,086 interviewees.  Further information on the project is available on the project website (https://commercialarbitrationineurope.wordpress.com).  9 interviews were performed in Scotland, involving 18 participants, with 2 interviews performed in Glasgow on 22 September 2022, 2 interviews performed in Aberdeen on 3 October 2022, and 5 interviews performed in Edinburgh on 5-6 October 2022.  All interviews were performed by the author.  Interviews were recorded and then professionally transcribed.

AI.tldr: 本文基于对苏格兰仲裁实践的实地访谈研究，探讨了苏格兰仲裁的基础设施，包括仲裁市场、仲裁社群、仲裁实践和仲裁机构等方面。

AI.findings: 基于实地访谈数据，揭示了苏格兰仲裁市场的实际运作模式、仲裁社群构成、实践特点以及仲裁机构的功能

AI.practical_contributions: 为苏格兰仲裁实践者提供参考，为仲裁制度改革和政策制定提供实证支持

title: DIGITAL DYNAMIC MARKETING CAPABILITY FOR GREEN HOSPITALITY TRANSFORMATION IN EMERGING COUNTRIES : A SYSTEMATIC LITERATURE REVIEW AND EMPIRICAL TREND ANALISYS
affiliations: Universitas Pelita Harapan and Pelita Harapan University

detail.title: DIGITAL DYNAMIC MARKETING CAPABILITY FOR GREEN HOSPITALITY TRANSFORMATION IN EMERGING COUNTRIES : A SYSTEMATIC LITERATURE REVIEW AND EMPIRICAL TREND ANALISYS
detail.abstract: This study explores the role of Digital Dynamic Marketing Capability (DDMC) in advancing green hospitality in emerging countries by integrating theoretical and empirical insights. A Systematic Literature Review (SLR) following the PRISMA protocol analyzed 30 peer-reviewed articles from 2020 to 2024, sourced from Scopus and Web of Science, and supplemented by empirical data from WTTC, UNWTO, and Statista to validate trends. The findings highlight four key themes: technological adaptability, sustainability-driven digital communication, organizational agility, and customer eco-engagement. DDMC strengthens branding, fosters eco-innovation, and enhances service personalization, though its adoption, particularly of advanced technologies like AI and blockchain, varies across regions due to infrastructural and resource disparities. The study’s reliance on secondary data limits its ability to establish direct causal relationships, suggesting a need for further empirical research. Practically, it offers strategic insights for hospitality leaders and policymakers to develop adaptive, sustainable marketing practices that align with eco-hospitality goals. By extending dynamic capabilities theory to green digital marketing, this paper contributes an original conceptual framework tailored to the unique challenges and opportunities of emerging markets, providing a roadmap for sustainable transformation in the hospitality sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了数字动态营销能力（DDMC）在推动新兴国家绿色酒店业发展中的作用，通过整合理论和实证见解，提出了一个针对新兴市场独特挑战和机遇的原创概念框架。
AI.research_question: 数字动态营销能力（DDMC）如何促进新兴国家绿色酒店业的发展？
AI.motivation: 探索数字动态营销能力在推动绿色酒店业可持续发展中的作用，特别是在新兴市场面临基础设施和资源差异的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论，扩展到绿色数字营销领域
AI.method: 采用PRISMA协议的系统文献综述（SLR），分析了2020-2024年间的30篇同行评审文章，并辅以WTTC、UNWTO和Statista的实证数据进行趋势验证
AI.findings: 识别出四个关键主题：技术适应性、可持续性驱动的数字沟通、组织敏捷性和客户生态参与。DDMC能够加强品牌建设、促进生态创新和提升服务个性化，但AI和区块链等先进技术的采用因地区和基础设施差异而不同
AI.theory_contributions: 将动态能力理论扩展到绿色数字营销领域，提出了一个针对新兴市场独特挑战和机遇的原创概念框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为酒店业领导者和政策制定者提供战略见解，帮助制定符合生态酒店目标的适应性、可持续营销实践，为酒店业的可持续转型提供路线图

title: A STUDY ON IMPLEMENTATION OF KNOWLEDGE MANAGEMENT IN ORGANIZATIONS-TOWARDS THE FOCUS OF DEVELOPING CSR
affiliations: Rajah Serfoji Govt. College

detail.title: A STUDY ON IMPLEMENTATION OF KNOWLEDGE MANAGEMENT IN ORGANIZATIONS-TOWARDS THE FOCUS OF DEVELOPING CSR
detail.abstract: Effective use of knowledge has been crucial to the organization's survival and success in competitive global markets and has a strong potential to problems solving, decision making, organizational performance enhancements and innovation. Hence this paper focused into the implementation of the knowledge management from the CSR perspective and also investigates the positive impact on KM developing CSR in organizations.CSR is much broader than charitable activities, philanthropy and community involvement. It embraces business practices, including environmental management systems, human resource policy and strategic investment for a sustainable future. The objective of the paper are to find out the knowledge management strategies developing CSR and how it intends to create new innovative plans for organization development. The primary data is used for the research study collected from various private and public sectors. The result of the research study shows that KM helps the organizations to build sustainable competitive advantage and strengthens the organizations towards their commitment in CSR

title: Capacity Reservation for High-Priority Customers with Spillover Effects on Strategic Low-Priority Customers
affiliations: VU Amsterdam and University of Calgary - Haskayne School of Business

detail.title: Capacity Reservation for High-Priority Customers with Spillover Effects on Strategic Low-Priority Customers
detail.abstract: Service systems commonly experience capacity imbalances and prolonged wait times when managing customers across multiple priority levels. These challenges are particularly profound for low-priority customers, who often experience significant delays. To mitigate these issues, the adoption of a fast-track has become a widespread practice. Our work studies the problem of capacity reservation for high-priority customers and explores its spillover effects on the service delay and throughput of strategical low-priority customers served on the fast-track system. We develop a stylized queueing-game model to study the capacity allocation between two separate service tracks: a fast track and a dedicated track. High-priority customers are either assigned to the dedicated track, where they are served according to a first-come, first-served (FCFS) discipline, or routed to the fast track, where they receive non-preemptive priority over low-priority customers. While low-priority customers are delay sensitive, they decide whether to join the fast track or leave the system based on their anticipated waiting time. This study explores how capacity reservation with routing affects the system throughput and the expected waiting time of low-priority customers. We find that increasing the capacity of the fast track does not always benefit the throughput of low-priority customers and their expected waiting time when spillover effects of high-priority customers are taken into consideration. The total system capacity, as well as the service times of high-priority customers across both tracks, are critical determinants for the strategic behavior of low-priority customers and, ultimately, of the overall system performance. Our study shows that when the fast track does not accelerate service for high-priority customers, separating the service by priority consistently improves the overall system throughput. In contrast, when the fast track operates significantly faster than the dedicated track, allocating additional capacity to it effectively diverts resources to low-priority customers, thereby enhancing their throughput. However, the effect of such capacity allocation decision on the expected waiting times depends on both the service times of high-priority customers across the two tracks and the overall system capacity.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了多优先级服务系统中快速通道容量预留对低优先级客户的溢出效应，发现增加快速通道容量并不总能改善低优先级客户的吞吐量和等待时间，系统总容量和高优先级客户服务时间是关键决定因素。
AI.research_question: 快速通道容量预留如何影响低优先级客户的服务延迟和吞吐量？
AI.motivation: 服务系统在处理多优先级客户时经常出现容量不平衡和长时间等待问题，低优先级客户尤其面临显著延迟，快速通道的采用成为普遍做法但需要研究其溢出效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 排队博弈理论，包含两个独立服务轨道（快速轨道和专用轨道）的容量分配模型，高优先级客户获得非抢占式优先权。
AI.method: 建立风格化的排队博弈模型，分析高优先级客户在专用轨道（FCFS）和快速轨道（非抢占式优先）之间的路由分配，低优先级客户基于预期等待时间做出加入或离开决策。
AI.findings: 1) 增加快速通道容量不一定改善低优先级客户吞吐量和等待时间；2) 系统总容量和高优先级客户服务时间是关键因素；3) 当快速通道不加速服务时，按优先级分离服务能提高整体吞吐量；4) 当快速通道显著更快时，增加其容量能提升低优先级客户吞吐量。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了考虑容量预留和路由溢出的多优先级排队博弈理论框架，揭示了系统容量和服务时间对客户战略行为的交互影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为服务系统管理者提供了容量分配决策指导：需要综合考虑系统总容量、服务时间差异和优先级路由策略，避免简单增加快速通道容量可能带来的负面溢出效应。

title: Designing a Neuroleadership Training Module: A Mixed-Method Study on Leadership Competency Development
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Designing a Neuroleadership Training Module: A Mixed-Method Study on Leadership Competency Development
detail.abstract: The study examines the design and effectiveness of a neuroleadership training module for middle-level managers in India, which focuses on stress-related decision-making, emotional intelligence (EI), and Empathy. Using mixed-method approaches, data, healthcare, and 150 samples were collected from 150 managers in the education sector. Conducted interviews and leadership qualification surveys, identified major merit intervals. A five-day neuroleadership training program with general soft skills leadership training was implemented and compared. The results of the pre-and post-training assessment demonstrated significant improvement in sympathy for decision-making, EI, and neuroleadership training. Conclusions suggest that integrating neurological principles in leadership development enhances the effectiveness of learning and provides analogous strategies for different regions.
