title: AI as Flesh, OM as Bone: Semiparametric Regression with Deep Neural Networks
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, Georgia Institute of Technology and Hong Kong Polytechnic University - Department of Applied Mathematics

detail.title: AI as Flesh, OM as Bone: Semiparametric Regression with Deep Neural Networks
detail.abstract: We argue that the future of data-driven operations management lies in coupling the structural foundations of operations management (OM) with the adaptive intelligence of machine learning (ML). OM provides the “bone” of decision-making through well-established models. These models capture system dynamics, tradeoffs, and performance objectives, offering a principled structure that does not need to be relearned from data. ML then acts as the “flesh,” enhancing these foundations by modeling complex patterns, capturing contextual variation, and adapting to dynamic environments. We illustrate this integration through a semiparametric regression framework with deep neural networks, where OM structures encode the parametric backbone while ML supplies nonparametric flexibility. Technically speaking, we model the operations metric of interest in a semiparametric form, where prior knowledge is incorporated through a specified link function and the unknown components are inferred from data. We establish theoretical convergence guarantees for both the basic semiparametric model and the partially linear model. In particular, we prove upper bounds for the excess risk that decrease with the sample size and depend on the scale of the neural network, and we show that the excess risk converges in probability to zero as both grow. By carefully setting the scale of the network according to the sample size, we further obtain the optimal convergence rate of excess risk. Finally, we empirically demonstrate the framework through applications in three foundational OM domains: inventory control, pricing and revenue management, and service operations. Together, these results demonstrate how the marriage of structure and learning yields decision systems that are not only interpretable and principled but also adaptive and provably robust to the complexities of modern operations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将运营管理的结构化模型与机器学习的自适应能力相结合，通过半参数回归框架和深度神经网络，在保持理论原则性的同时增强对复杂模式的适应性，并在库存控制、定价和服务运营等三个领域进行了实证验证。
AI.research_question: 如何将运营管理的结构化决策模型与机器学习的自适应智能有效结合，以构建既具有理论原则性又具备实际适应性的决策系统？
AI.motivation: 传统运营管理模型虽然理论基础扎实但缺乏对复杂现实环境的适应性，而纯机器学习方法虽然灵活但缺乏理论解释性和原则性，需要将两者优势结合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半参数回归理论框架，结合参数化模型（OM结构）和非参数化组件（ML灵活性），使用深度神经网络进行建模。
AI.method: 提出半参数回归框架，其中先验知识通过指定链接函数编码，未知组件从数据中推断；建立理论收敛保证，证明超额风险随样本量增加而收敛到零。
AI.findings: 理论证明超额风险上界随样本量增加而减小，通过适当设置网络规模可获得最优收敛速率；在库存控制、定价和服务运营三个领域的实证应用验证了框架的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了OM与ML结合的理论框架，提供了半参数模型的理论收敛保证，证明了超额风险的收敛性质，为结构化学习提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可实际应用的决策系统框架，在三个核心运营管理领域展示了实际应用价值，为数据驱动的运营管理提供了既解释性强又适应性好的解决方案。

title: A Bibliometric Examination of Sustainable Development Research in Business : Insights from the Web of Science
affiliations: George College of Management and Science, George College of Management and Science and George College of Management and Science

detail.title: A Bibliometric Examination of Sustainable Development Research in Business : Insights from the Web of Science
detail.abstract: Purpose : This paper aimed to analyze studies on sustainable development goals (SDGs), specifically within the domains of economics, management, and business. The primary objective of the study was to explain how scholars could effectively identify essential contributions, prominent countries, significant organizations, and potential avenues for future research in these fields. Methodology : The bibliometric analysis was performed using the esteemed Web of Science database, and the necessary information was saved as a tab-delimited text file. Advanced tools such as the JAVA-based VOSviewer software were used to analyze co-authorships, co-occurrences, bibliographic coupling, citation, and co-citation analysis. Findings : The topic of sustainable development goals garnered significant attention, as evidenced by the rise in research publications overthe past five years. The highest number of publications was recorded in 2023. Practical Implications : Several network studies revealed promising avenues for additional research in the business sector conceming the SDGs. The study enabled interested researchers to make significant contributions in this field. Originality : This study provided a novel perspective for doing a more exact and accurate analysis within the domains of business, management, and economics in relation to the SDGs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献计量分析方法，系统分析了经济学、管理学和商业领域关于可持续发展目标（SDGs）的研究状况，提供了重要贡献、驱动国家、关键机构和未来研究方向的视角。
AI.research_question: 如何在经济学、管理学和商业领域中，有效识别关于可持续发展目标（SDGs）的核心贡献、驱动国家、重要机构和未来研究方向？
AI.motivation: 可持续发展目标在过去五年中引起了广泛关注，研究成果丰厚，需要系统性的分析来理解该领域的研究状况、发展趋势和研究机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量分析理论，包括合作网络分析、关键词共现分析、引文耦合分析、引用分析和共引分析等方法。
AI.method: 采用Web of Science数据库进行文献计量分析，使用JAVA基础的VOSviewer软件进行合作者分析、关键词共现分析、引文耦合分析、引用分析和共引分析。
AI.findings: 可持续发展目标在过去五年间研究文献数量显著增长，2023年达到最高峰，体现了该领域的高度关注度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一种新题的视角来进行更准确和精确的分析，为理论研究提供了系统性的文献计量分析方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 网络分析揭示了商业领域关于SDGs的充满前景的研究方向，为研究者在该领域做出重要贡献提供了指导。

title: Bias in Unanimous Awards: A Response to Sahu's take on the Vento II Arbitral Award

detail.title: Bias in Unanimous Awards: A Response to Sahu's take on the Vento II Arbitral Award
detail.abstract: This article presents a critical response to R. Sahu's analysis of the Vento II annulment decision, in which a Canadian court set aside an arbitral award due to the appearance of bias in one arbitrator, despite the tribunal's unanimity. It challenges the assumption that one arbitrator's bias necessarily taints the entire panel, drawing on comparative insights from recent cases such as Aiteo v Shell and Eiser v Spain. The article advances a two-pronged critique-first, addressing the methodological presumption that bias is automatically contagious within a tribunal; and second, analyzing the procedural and institutional consequences of annulled awards, especially where governing rules are silent or fragmented. By examining tribunal dynamics, the burdens of proof, and the feasibility of retrying arbitrations, the article highlights the legal uncertainty that arises when an award is set aside and calls for more nuanced approaches to safeguard both procedural integrity and arbitral finality.

AI.tldr: 本文对Vento II撤销裁决案提出批判性回应，质疑仲裁员偏见必然污染整个仲裁庭的假设，主张需要更细致的方法来平衡程序公正与仲裁终局性。
AI.research_question: 单个仲裁员的偏见是否必然导致整个仲裁庭的裁决无效？在仲裁裁决被撤销的情况下，如何平衡程序公正与仲裁终局性？
AI.motivation: 回应R. Sahu对Vento II撤销裁决案的分析，批判性地审视加拿大法院以单个仲裁员存在偏见为由撤销全体一致裁决的做法，探讨这种做法的理论基础和实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 仲裁庭偏见传染性理论、程序公正理论、仲裁终局性原则、比较法分析框架
AI.method: 比较案例分析（Aiteo v Shell、Eiser v Spain等近期案例）、法律文本分析、程序性后果评估
AI.findings: 单个仲裁员的偏见不一定污染整个仲裁庭；撤销裁决会产生严重的程序性和制度性后果；现行仲裁规则在此问题上存在沉默或碎片化问题
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了偏见自动传染的理论假设；提出了更细致的仲裁庭偏见分析框架；丰富了仲裁程序公正与终局性平衡的理论讨论
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院处理类似案件提供分析工具；为仲裁机构完善规则提供参考；帮助当事人更好地理解偏见指控的法律后果

title: Harnessing the Power of Diversity: Strategies for Effective Workplace Management

detail.title: Harnessing the Power of Diversity: Strategies for Effective Workplace Management

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not Applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Not Applicable

detail.abstract:
Diversity includes everyone; it is not something that is defined by race or gender. It extends to age, personal and corporate background, education, function, and personality. It includes lifestyle, sexual preference, geographic origin, tenure with organization and management or non-management" (Thomas Jr, 1996).

Management of workplace diversity is not a new-fangled concept now. Researchers and academicians are exploring it for better achievements. It has its roots in western countries, especially in the USA. It is a progression of the Equal Employment Opportunity Law and Affirmative action. If it is ignored, it causes disadvantages for the organizations. In this paper, the author explains the concept of management diversity and the advantages of managing it effectively. Furthermore, the paper highlights key strategies for the effective management of workplace diversity in organizations, as discussed by various authors in the literature.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了工作场所多样性管理的概念、优势及有效管理策略，强调多样性不仅限于种族和性别，还包括年龄、背景、教育、职能等多维度，并指出忽视多样性管理会给组织带来不利影响。
AI.research_question: 如何有效管理工作场所多样性以及多样性管理对组织的优势是什么？
AI.motivation: 工作场所多样性管理已成为重要议题，源于西方国家的平等就业机会法律和肯定行动，忽视多样性管理会给组织带来不利后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Thomas Jr (1996)的多样性定义，涵盖种族、性别、年龄、背景、教育、职能、个性等多维度多样性理论框架。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，综合分析了多位作者关于工作场所多样性管理的理论和策略。
AI.findings: 有效管理多样性能为组织带来优势，论文识别了关键的有效管理策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了多样性管理的理论理解，提供了综合性的概念框架和管理方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了实用的多样性管理策略，帮助组织更好地利用多样性优势，避免管理不善带来的问题。

reference: The Engineering Economist, Volume 70, No. 3, Pp. 122-151
title: The Two Sides of the Reinvestment Assumption Fallacy in IRR And NPV
affiliations: Università degli studi di Modena e Reggio Emilia (UNIMORE) - School of Doctorate E4E (Engineering for Economics-Economics for Engineering) and Baylor University - Department of Finance, Insurance & Real Estate

detail.title: The Two Sides of the Reinvestment Assumption Fallacy in IRR And NPV

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Engineering Economist, Volume 70, No. 3, Pp. 122-151

detail.abstract: This methodological article addresses a persistent and consequential fallacy in capital budgeting and financial investments: the belief that Net Present Value (NPV) and Internal Rate of Return (IRR) implicitly assume reinvestment of interim cash flows. Despite decades of scholarly clarification, most notably by Keane (1979), this misconception continues to affect academic discourse and practical decision-making. The paper offers multiple proofs that neither NPV nor IRR requires any reinvestment assumption, and it explains how the fallacy can distort investment evaluations and lead to flawed financial reasoning. The origins of the confusion are traced to early efforts to resolve ranking conflicts between IRR and NPV and to address the problem of multiple IRRs. A central source of this misunderstanding is the misinterpretation of a sufficient condition for IRR-NPV compatibility (which involves reinvestment) as an implicit reinvestment assumption. A key contribution is the distinction between exogenous reinvestment assumptions (artificially imposed post-modeling, after cash flows have been projected) and endogenous reinvestment (used during cash flow modeling to determine distributions to capital providers). This distinction is formalized using Magni's (2020, 2023) accounting-and-finance engineering framework, which explicitly models how payout and retention policies shape the cash flow stream. By integrating reinvestment dynamics directly into the modeling phase, the framework ensures conceptual clarity, removes artificial assumptions, and supports more accurate investment analysis and decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文纠正了资本预算和金融投资中长期存在的谬误：认为NPV和IRR隐含了期中现金流再投资假设。通过多重证明表明这两种方法都不需要任何再投资假设，并解释了这种误解如何扭曲投资评估。
AI.research_question: NPV和IRR方法是否隐含了期中现金流的再投资假设？这种误解如何影响投资决策？
AI.motivation: 尽管Keane（1979）等学者已澄清数十年，但这种误解仍在学术讨论和实际决策中持续存在，导致错误的财务推理和投资评估失真。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Magni（2020, 2023）的会计与金融工程框架，区分外生再投资假设（建模后人为强加）和内生再投资（现金流建模期间用于确定资本提供者分配）。
AI.method: 提供多重数学证明和理论分析，追溯误解的起源，并运用会计与金融工程框架进行形式化区分。
AI.findings: NPV和IRR都不需要任何再投资假设；误解源于将IRR-NPV兼容性的充分条件错误解释为隐含假设；早期解决IRR与NPV排名冲突和多IRR问题的努力导致了这种混淆。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了资本预算理论中的根本误解，形式化了再投资假设的区分，提供了概念清晰的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 消除人为假设，支持更准确的投资分析和决策制定，帮助从业者避免因误解导致的投资评估失真。

title: System-Critical: Revisiting Methodology of Islamic Economics and Finance to Solve the 21 st Century Complex Problems

detail.title: System-Critical: Revisiting Methodology of Islamic Economics and Finance to Solve the 21 st Century Complex Problems
detail.abstract: Contemporary Islamic Economics and Finance (IEF) approaches to complex, 'wicked' problems such as climate change, inequality, and technological disruption are hampered by persistent disciplinary fragmentation. This paper argues that this fragmentation manifests as a critical dichotomy: Neoclassical Economic analysis, employed by many Islamic financial economists, and the related Fiqh excel in analytical and critical rigor but often ignore systemic interdependencies. Conversely, the Maqasid al-Shariah (Objectives of Islamic Law) based systems approach captures holistic complexity but may lack the analytical validation and prescriptive pathways needed for practical implementation. To resolve this tension, in this paper we propose a novel conceptual framework informed by the principles of Dynamic Prescriptive Economics (DPE). We construct a two-dimensional cognitive map where the horizontal axis (D₁) represents Systems Thinking (ST) and the vertical axis (D₂) represents Critical Thinking (CT). This creates a four-quadrant decision space that categorizes thought processes. Preliminary analysis positions traditional neoclassical economics in QII (high CT, low ST) and Maqasid-based systems approaches in QIV (high ST, low CT), both representing suboptimal, imbalanced states. The paper concludes that the future efficacy of IEF lies in its ability to cultivate and operationalize an integrated, System-aware Critical Thinking approach located in the synergistic Quadrant I (Q1). This is achieved by applying DPE's core tools-Normalized Balanced Coordinates (NBCs) for measurement and Substitutions, Transformations, and Offsets (STOs) for transition-to transform this cognitive framework from a diagnostic tool into a prescriptive roadmap for solving 21st-century complex problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于动态规范经济学（DPE）的新概念框架，通过系统思维和批判性思维的双维认知图谱来解决伊斯兰经济学和金融领域的分裂问题，旨在实现系统感知的批判性思维方法。
AI.research_question: 如何解决伊斯兰经济学和金融领域在应对复杂问题时存在的学科分裂问题？
AI.motivation: 当代伊斯兰经济学和金融在应对气候变化、不平等和技术颠覆等复杂"棘手"问题时，受到持续学科分裂的阻碍，需要新的整合框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态规范经济学（DPE）、系统思维（ST）、批判性思维（CT）、Maqasid al-Shariah（伊斯兰法目标）
AI.method: 构建二维认知图谱（水平轴为系统思维，垂直轴为批判性思维），形成四象限决策空间，分析不同经济学方法在其中的位置。
AI.findings: 传统新古典经济学位于QII象限（高批判性思维、低系统思维），基于Maqasid的系统方法位于QIV象限（高系统思维、低批判性思维），两者都代表次优的不平衡状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合系统思维和批判性思维的新概念框架，为伊斯兰经济学和金融提供了解决复杂问题的新理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了从诊断工具转变为规范性路线图的具体方法，包括标准化平衡坐标（NBCs）和替代、转换与抵消（STOs）等核心工具，可用于实际解决21世纪复杂问题。

title: The Interplay Between Customer Feedback Solicitation and Innovation: A Dynamic Solution
affiliations: University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business, University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business and New York University (NYU) - NYU Tandon School of Engineering

detail.title: The Interplay Between Customer Feedback Solicitation and Innovation: A Dynamic Solution
detail.abstract: Agile product development relies on rapid iteration and customer feedback to guide product improvement, yet firms face challenges in coordinating when to solicit feedback and when to invest in quality improvement. While each action adds value on its own, coordinating the two introduces an additional layer of complexity beyond optimizing either decision in isolation. We model this problem as a semi-Markov decision process, with product quality and accumulated customer feedback as state variables. To build intuition, we first analyze two single-action settings: one where the firm continuously invests in quality improvement while optimizing feedback solicitation, and another where it always solicits feedback while optimizing quality investment. In both cases, the optimal policy exhibits a clean monotone-threshold structure. We then study the full joint optimization problem, where the firm must simultaneously decide when to solicit feedback and when to invest in quality. These two interdependent actions create significant analytical complexity. Despite this, we uncover a key structural insight: under mild regularity conditions, the optimal joint policy preserves the threshold-based properties of the single-action settings. Feedback solicitation follows an optimal stopping rule, while quality investment is selectively applied based on the evolving product state. This structure partitions the state space into four regions, each guiding a distinct course of action. We also conduct sensitivity analysis to show how the thresholds shift in response to changes in model parameters. Our analysis reveals that effective agile product development benefits from selective agility—instead of defaulting to nonstop iteration, firms may benefit from pausing quality investment to await more feedback, or focusing solely on quality improvement once sufficient customer input has been collected. The resulting threshold-based policy offers clear, actionable guidance for balancing learning and execution under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了敏捷产品开发中质量投资和客户反馈征集的最优协调问题，通过半马尔可夫决策过程建模，发现最优策略具有阈值结构，提出了"选择性敏捷"的概念，为企业在不确定环境下平衡学习和执行提供了清晰的操作指导。
AI.research_question: 在敏捷产品开发过程中，企业如何最优地协调质量投资和客户反馈征集这两个相互依赖的决策？
AI.motivation: 敏捷开发依赖快速迭代和客户反馈，但企业在协调何时征集反馈和何时投资质量改进方面面临挑战，这两个行动虽然各自都能创造价值，但协调它们比单独优化任一决策都更加复杂。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半马尔可夫决策过程，以产品质量和累积客户反馈作为状态变量
AI.method: 建模分析：首先分析两个单行动情境（持续质量投资优化反馈征集，以及持续反馈征集优化质量投资），然后研究完整的联合优化问题，并进行敏感性分析
AI.findings: 最优联合策略保持了单行动情境的阈值特性：反馈征集遵循最优停止规则，质量投资根据产品状态选择性应用；状态空间被划分为四个区域，每个区域指导不同的行动方案
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在敏捷产品开发中协调质量投资和反馈征集的最优策略结构，提出了"选择性敏捷"的理论概念，扩展了半马尔可夫决策过程在运营管理中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了基于阈值的清晰操作指南，帮助管理者在不确定环境下更好地平衡学习（收集反馈）和执行（质量改进），避免盲目迭代，实现更有效的敏捷开发

title: Misplaced Political Responsibilities? Big Tech and Housing Affordability

detail.title: Misplaced Political Responsibilities? Big Tech and Housing Affordability
detail.abstract: Over a 27-month span, the five largest United States technology companies (Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Facebook, and Microsoft) and two philanthropic organizations connected with their founders (Jeff Bezos' The Day One Families Fund, and Mark Zuckerberg's Chan-Zuckerberg Initiative) committed nearly $9 billion to address housing affordability, predominantly in cities where they have corporate offices. In this study, I provide an overview of each organizations' commitments, illustrate that Big Tech is commonly perceived to be both causally responsible for and held morally responsible to resolve this crisis, and I make a normative argument about the proper role of private businesses to engaging in 'state-like' activities in strong institutional settings. Neither of the dominant theoretic frameworks in corporate political activity (CPA) and political corporate social responsibility (political CSR) research inadequate address this situation which leaves a gap in normative examinations into corporate involvement on political issues. First, I argue that Big Tech should not be perceived as blameworthy for causing the housing crisis. The commonly justification that paying above average wages is overly simplistic. Second, Big Tech should not be held morally required to directly address the crisis. Even if an organization caused a political problem, it does not inherently follow that they have a responsibility to participate directly in the resolution of it. Organizations must have the appropriate characteristics and capabilities, and corporations are not capable of serving as the type of political actors who ought to be seen as legitimately capable of holding others responsible on political issues. This is due primarily to the fact that they are unlikely to have the appropriate motivation to resolve public goods issue in the best interest of the public since they are primarily self-interested actors. Furthermore, in strong institutional settings, with legitimate and capable political entities (e.g., states and non-profit organizations) who are unwilling but are capable of assuming the role of governing entity in resolving public goods issues, the onus should not fall on private actors.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国五大科技公司为解决住房可负担性危机投入近90亿美元的现象，认为现有企业政治活动和政治企业社会责任理论框架无法充分解释这一现象，并提出了规范性论点：科技公司不应被视为危机的责任方，也不应被要求直接参与解决，因为在强制度环境下应由合法政治实体承担这一角色。
AI.research_question: 大型科技公司在强制度环境下参与'类国家'活动（如解决住房危机）的适当角色是什么？
AI.motivation: 五大科技公司和相关慈善组织在27个月内承诺近90亿美元解决住房可负担性问题，这一现象需要理论解释和规范性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业政治活动（CPA）和政治企业社会责任（political CSR）理论框架
AI.method: 规范性理论分析和案例研究
AI.findings: 1）科技公司不应被视为住房危机的责任方；2）即使企业造成政治问题，也不必然有责任直接参与解决；3）在强制度环境下，应由合法政治实体而非私人企业承担公共物品问题的解决责任
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了企业参与政治议题的规范性研究空白，挑战了现有CPA和政治CSR理论的局限性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供了关于私人企业在公共事务中适当角色的指导原则

title: Moral Philosophy and Archetypes in the Symbolic Cohesion of the Tale of the Poor Old Woman
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS and Independent

detail.title: Moral Philosophy and Archetypes in the Symbolic Cohesion of the Tale of the Poor Old Woman
detail.abstract: The analysis of Rafael Pombo’s tale “La pobre viejecita” highlights how Colombian children’s literature operates as a moralizing device linking the pedagogy of fear with the construction of social order. Drawing on the perspectives of Machiavelli and Hobbes, the study explores the figure of the “antivillain,” understood as an ambivalent character who, although feared, seeks the common good. This approach shows that fear, rather than being destructive, emerges as a mechanism of discipline and collective cohesion, bridging political ethics with cultural transmission.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析Rafael Pombo的童话《可怜的老太太》，揭示哥伦比亚儿童文学如何作为道德教化工具，将恐惧教育与构建社会秩序联系起来。通过马基雅维利和霍布斯的视角，探讨了'反反派'这一矛盾角色，说明恐惧可以成为纪律和集体凝聚的机制，连接政治伦理与文化传承。
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚儿童文学如何通过恐惧教育来构建社会秩序？
AI.motivation: 探讨儿童文学作为道德教化工具的作用机制，特别是恐惧在塑造社会秩序中的功能
AI.theoretical_framework: 马基雅维利的政治哲学和霍布斯的社会契约理论，特别是关于恐惧作为社会控制机制的观点
AI.method: 文本分析方法，对Rafael Pombo的童话《可怜的老太太》进行深入分析
AI.findings: 儿童文学中的'反反派'角色虽然令人恐惧，但实际追求共同利益；恐惧不是破坏性力量，而是纪律和集体凝聚的有效机制
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了'反反派'概念，拓展了文学角色分析的理论框架；连接了政治哲学与文学研究的交叉领域
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育工作者提供理解儿童文学教化功能的新视角；有助于设计更有效的道德教育材料

title: A STUDY ON TALENT MANAGEMENT STRATEGIES FOR ATTRACTING AND RETAINING THE BEST AND BRIGHTEST EMPLOYEES WITH SPECIAL REFERENCE TO BUSINESS PROCESS OUTSOURCING (BPO) COMPANIES IN HYDERABAD
affiliations: Rajah Serfoji Govt. College

detail.title: A STUDY ON TALENT MANAGEMENT STRATEGIES FOR ATTRACTING AND RETAINING THE BEST AND BRIGHTEST EMPLOYEES WITH SPECIAL REFERENCE TO BUSINESS PROCESS OUTSOURCING (BPO) COMPANIES IN HYDERABAD
detail.abstract:
The Talent management process is a subset of HR process that bridges its components. It plays a vital role among all other key areas of HR to retain the employees. A strong talent management practice increases the performance of the employees, motivate, engage and retain them for better productivity of the organization. When the talent management is formulated right, then the companies can build a sustainable competitive advantage and outperform their competition they face. The skills of the employees and the job description varies from industry to industry and from company to company in the same industry. Therefore, the scope of research study on the talent management strategies to attract and retain the best talents suitable for the industry as well as to the company is explored. Business Services industry is the fastest growing industry in India. It is the fastest growing segment of the ITES (Information Technology Enabled Services) industry. Economies of scale, business risk mitigation, cost advantage; utilization improvement and superior competency are some of the factors that have all lead to the growth of the Indian Business Services industry. The Business Services boom in India is credited to India's huge talent pool of skilled and cheap labor costs.

 

The issue of global talent management (GTM) has become an important area for research because of several key reasons such as the competition between employers, which has become more generic and has shifted from the country level to the regional and global levels. Talent management has been investigated under several heads, including succession, human resource development, and organizational learning. Regardless of the terms used, it is important to see Talent management as competitive weapon and see how it can serve as a source of competitive advantage. Managers today do understand the potential value added by talent to organizations; they often struggle to deploy their key talents effectively (Farndale and Paauwe, 2005). To quantify this fact, this study attempts to identify the suitable talent management strategies to attract and retain the best skilled employees for the outsourcing organizations.

Talent management focuses on understanding the critical talent ability and capability required to achieve organizational purpose. Designing and developing strategies to recruit, retain and develop the talent ensure the organization to fulfill the needs of industry for today and in the future. It is impossible for organizations to generate profits without the efforts, ideas, skills, and talent of knowledge workers; therefore, they must bet on people and not on technologies. The study thus explores the fact that Talent management practices adopted in the BPO organization is the key to success and sustainable growth as it allows the organizations to retain high potential and top talent employees thereby increasing productivity.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了人才管理策略在印度业务流程外包(BPO)行业中的作用，重点分析了如何通过有效的人才管理吸引和保留优秀员工，从而为企业创造可持续竞争优势。
AI.research_question: 如何为外包组织制定合适的人才管理策略来吸引和保留最佳技能员工？
AI.motivation: 人才管理作为人力资源的重要组成部分，在员工保留方面起着关键作用。印度商业服务行业快速发展，拥有大量技能人才和低成本优势，但企业在有效部署关键人才方面面临挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球人才管理(GTM)理论、竞争武器视角下的人才管理、人力资源发展与组织学习理论
AI.method: 本研究采用定性研究方法，通过文献综述和理论分析探讨人才管理策略
AI.findings: 有效的人才管理实践能够提高员工绩效、激励员工、增强参与度并保留人才，从而提升组织生产力。BPO组织中采用的人才管理实践是成功和可持续增长的关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了全球人才管理理论，特别是在外包行业的应用；深化了人才管理作为竞争武器的理论认识
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度BPO行业提供了具体的人才管理策略建议；帮助企业建立可持续竞争优势；指导企业如何有效部署关键人才

title: AI-Enabled Terrorism: A Strategic Analysis of Emerging Threats AI-Enabled Terrorism: A Strategic Analysis of Emerging Threats and Countermeasures in Global Security and Countermeasures in Global Security
affiliations: Stern Academic College

detail.title: AI-Enabled Terrorism: A Strategic Analysis of Emerging Threats AI-Enabled Terrorism: A Strategic Analysis of Emerging Threats and Countermeasures in Global Security and Countermeasures in Global Security
detail.abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming terrorist methods and counter-terrorism strategies, with far-reaching effects on global security. This paper examines how terrorists use AI for new attack tactics, propaganda, and coordination, while also evaluating the ethical, legal, and strategic challenges AI introduces into counterterrorism. Through a systematic literature review and qualitative analysis, the study identifies key trends in AI's impact on security dynamics, highlighting its role in blurring the lines between peace and conflict. An analytical framework is proposed to navigate the complex landscape of AI-driven asymmetric warfare, providing practical insights for policymakers and researchers. The study advocates for interdisciplinary approaches that integrate technological, legal, and ethical perspectives to proactively address the emerging risks of AI-enabled terrorism.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI如何被恐怖分子用于新型攻击战术、宣传和协调，同时评估AI在反恐中带来的伦理、法律和战略挑战，提出了应对AI驱动不对称战争的框架。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何改变恐怖主义方法和反恐策略，以及由此产生的伦理、法律和战略挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: AI技术的快速发展正在深刻影响全球安全格局，恐怖分子利用AI开发新的攻击手段，而反恐机构也面临AI带来的新挑战，需要系统性研究来应对这一新兴威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不对称战争理论、安全研究框架、技术伦理理论
AI.method: 系统性文献综述和定性分析
AI.findings: 识别了AI对安全动态影响的关键趋势，揭示了AI在模糊和平与冲突界限方面的作用，提出了应对AI驱动不对称战争的分析框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了整合技术、法律和伦理视角的跨学科分析框架，为理解AI在恐怖主义和反恐中的双重作用提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究人员提供了应对AI赋能恐怖主义新兴风险的实用见解，倡导采取前瞻性措施来应对安全挑战。

title: Transfer Learning Approaches for Emotion Recognition in Low-Resource Regional Language Music
affiliations: Ladoke Akintola University of Technology

detail.title: Transfer Learning Approaches for Emotion Recognition in Low-Resource Regional Language Music
detail.abstract: This study investigates the application of transfer learning techniques for emotion recognition in music from low-resource regional languages, where limited annotated datasets often hinder model development. The purpose of the research is to assess whether pre-trained deep learning models, fine-tuned on small, domain-specific datasets, can achieve competitive performance in recognizing musical emotions across culturally diverse, resource-constrained environments. The methodology involved collecting and curating a regional music corpus, applying audio feature extraction using Mel-spectrograms, and leveraging convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and pre-trained architectures such as VGGish and YAMNet for transfer learning. Experiments were conducted to compare baseline models trained from scratch with fine-tuned transfer learning models. Key findings indicate that transfer learning significantly improves classification accuracy, reduces training time, and enhances generalization, even with limited data. The results suggest that transfer learning is a promising strategy for advancing emotion recognition in low-resource regional language music, enabling more inclusive and culturally adaptive music information retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在低资源区域语言音乐情感识别中应用迁移学习技术，通过预训练模型在小规模数据集上微调，显著提升了分类准确率和泛化能力。
AI.research_question: 预训练的深度学习模型经过小规模领域特定数据集微调后，是否能在资源受限的文化多样化环境中实现竞争性的音乐情感识别性能？
AI.motivation: 低资源区域语言中有限的标注数据集阻碍了模型开发，需要寻找有效方法来提升音乐情感识别的性能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 迁移学习理论，利用预训练模型的知识迁移到目标领域
AI.method: 收集和整理区域音乐语料库，使用梅尔频谱图进行音频特征提取，利用CNN和预训练架构（VGGish、YAMNet）进行迁移学习，比较从头训练的基线模型与微调的迁移学习模型
AI.findings: 迁移学习显著提高了分类准确率，减少了训练时间，增强了泛化能力，即使在数据有限的情况下也能取得良好效果
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了迁移学习在低资源音乐情感识别中的有效性，为跨文化音乐信息检索提供了理论支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为低资源区域语言音乐情感识别提供了实用的技术方案，促进了更具包容性和文化适应性的音乐信息检索系统发展

title: Dynamic Factor Models with Forward-Looking Views
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Institute of Operations Research and Analytics and National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Decision Sciences

detail.title: Dynamic Factor Models with Forward-Looking Views

declarations.funderStatement: Andrew Lim is supported by the Ministry of Education, Singapore under its 2024 Academic Research Fund Tier 2 grant call (Award ref: MOE-T2EP20224-0018).

detail.abstract: Prediction models calibrated using historical data may forecast poorly if the dynamics of the present and future differ from observations in the past. For this reason, predictions can be improved if information like forward looking views about the state of the system are used to refine the forecast. We develop an approach for combining a dynamic factor model for risky asset prices calibrated on historical data, and noisy expert views of future values of the factors/covariates in the model, and study the implications for dynamic portfolio choice. By exploiting the graphical structure linking factors, asset prices, and  views, we derive closed-form expressions for the dynamics of the factor and price processes after conditioning on the views. For linear factor models, the price process becomes a time-inhomogeneous affine process with a new covariate formed from the views. We establish a novel theoretical connection between the conditional factor process and a process we call a Mean-Reverting Bridge (MrB), an extension of the classical Brownian bridge. We derive the investor's optimal portfolio strategy and show that views influence both the myopic mean-variance term and the intertemporal hedge. The optimal dynamic portfolio when the long-run mean of the expected return is uncertain and learned online from data is also derived. More generally, our framework offers a generalizable approach for embedding forward-looking information about covariates in a dynamic factor model.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种结合历史数据校准的动态因子模型和专家前瞻性观点的方法，用于改进风险资产价格预测和动态投资组合选择。通过图模型结构，推导出条件因子过程的闭式解，建立了与均值回归桥的理论联系，并得出了考虑观点影响的最优动态投资组合策略。
AI.research_question: 如何将专家前瞻性观点与历史数据校准的动态因子模型相结合，以改进风险资产价格预测和优化动态投资组合选择？
AI.motivation: 基于历史数据校准的预测模型在当前和未来动态与过去观测不同时可能预测效果不佳，需要利用前瞻性信息来改进预测精度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态因子模型、图模型理论、均值回归桥(MrB)理论、随机最优控制理论
AI.method: 利用图模型结构连接因子、资产价格和观点，推导条件因子过程的闭式表达式，建立线性因子模型下价格过程的时间非齐次仿射过程表示
AI.findings: 观点同时影响近视均值-方差项和跨期对冲项；在长期均值不确定且需要在线学习的情况下也得出了最优动态投资组合；条件因子过程与均值回归桥存在理论联系
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了条件因子过程与均值回归桥的新理论联系；提出了将前瞻性信息嵌入动态因子模型的通用框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了考虑专家观点的动态投资组合优化方法；改进了风险资产价格预测的准确性

title: Labor Automation Ethics: Balancing efficiency gains with employment impacts
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Labor Automation Ethics: Balancing efficiency gains with employment impacts
detail.abstract: The rapid advancement of labor automation technologies presents significant opportunities for enhancing operational efficiency and productivity across various industries. However, these benefits often come at the cost of employment stability and job displacement for workers. This research explores the ethical implications of labor automation, emphasizing the need to balance efficiency gains with the societal impacts on employment. By analyzing case studies and existing literature, the study highlights the ethical dilemmas faced by organizations and policymakers in implementing automation technologies. It argues for a multi-stakeholder approach that includes considerations of social justice, worker retraining, and equitable economic growth. Ultimately, this research aims to contribute to the ongoing discourse on how to ethically navigate the complex landscape of labor automation, ensuring that technological progress does not undermine the livelihoods of individuals and communities.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨劳动自动化的伦理影响，强调在效率提升与就业稳定之间寻求平衡，主张通过多利益相关方方法实现社会公正和公平经济增长。
AI.research_question: 如何在劳动自动化过程中平衡效率提升与就业稳定的伦理困境？
AI.motivation: 劳动自动化技术快速发展在提高效率的同时带来了就业不稳定和工作替代问题，需要研究其伦理影响和社会责任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术伦理理论、社会正义理论和利益相关者理论，构建劳动自动化的伦理分析框架。
AI.method: 采用案例分析和文献综述方法，分析现有研究和实践案例中的伦理困境和解决方案。
AI.findings: 组织和管理者在实施自动化技术时面临重大伦理困境，需要综合考虑效率、就业和社会影响等多方面因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了技术伦理和社会正义理论在劳动自动化领域的应用，提出了多利益相关方伦理决策框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织和管理者提供了伦理决策指导，建议通过工人再培训、公平经济增长等措施实现技术进步的伦理平衡。

title: Comparative Analysis of Traditional vs. XAI-Driven Models in Supply Chain Price Forecasting Accuracy and Transparency
affiliations: University of Leeds and University of Bergen

detail.title: Comparative Analysis of Traditional vs. XAI-Driven Models in Supply Chain Price Forecasting Accuracy and Transparency
detail.abstract: In today's rapidly evolving supply chain landscape, accurate price forecasting is essential for strategic decision-making and operational efficiency. This study conducts a comparative analysis of traditional forecasting models against Explainable AI (XAI)-driven approaches to evaluate their effectiveness in price forecasting accuracy and transparency. We utilize a dataset from diverse industries to assess the performance of classical statistical methods, such as ARIMA and exponential smoothing, alongside advanced machine learning techniques enhanced by XAI frameworks. The analysis focuses on key metrics including forecasting accuracy, interpretability, and user trust. Preliminary findings indicate that while traditional models provide reasonable accuracy, XAI-driven models significantly improve interpretability, enabling stakeholders to understand underlying predictions better. This research highlights the potential of XAI to not only enhance forecasting precision but also foster transparency and trust among supply chain partners, ultimately contributing to more resilient and responsive supply chain operations. The implications of these findings are discussed in the context of future advancements in supply chain analytics.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较传统预测模型与可解释AI(XAI)方法在供应链价格预测中的表现，发现XAI模型在保持准确性的同时显著提升了解释性和用户信任度
AI.research_question: 可解释AI驱动的预测模型相比传统预测模型在供应链价格预测的准确性和透明度方面有何优势？
AI.motivation: 在快速演变的供应链环境中，准确的价格预测对战略决策和运营效率至关重要，需要平衡预测准确性和解释性
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于预测理论、机器学习理论和可解释AI理论，结合供应链管理理论构建分析框架
AI.method: 使用多行业数据集，比较ARIMA、指数平滑等传统统计方法与XAI增强的机器学习技术的性能
AI.findings: 传统模型提供合理准确性，但XAI驱动模型显著提高了解释性，使利益相关者能更好理解预测依据，增强透明度和信任
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了可解释AI在供应链预测领域的理论应用，为预测准确性与解释性的平衡提供了理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 为供应链管理者提供了更透明可信的预测工具，有助于提升供应链韧性和响应能力，促进合作伙伴间的信任建立

title: From Reviews to Responses: Bridging Pre-and Post-Purchase Consumers through AI-Enhanced QA with RAG
affiliations: , University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Marketing and University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Marketing

detail.title: From Reviews to Responses: Bridging Pre-and Post-Purchase Consumers through AI-Enhanced QA with RAG
detail.abstract: Question Answering (QA) on customer-facing platforms (e-commerce, travel, education, and brand websites) often suffers from delayed, low-quality responses and limited user participation. While customer reviews are abundant, their unstructured nature limits direct use to answer specific questions, and Large Language Models (LLMs) alone lack product-specific details and subjective insights. To address these challenges, we propose and evaluate a novel QA framework that integrates LLMs with reviews through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Our framework incorporates three components: (1) RAG for dynamically retrieving relevant reviews at inference time; (2) a question-review type matching module that enhances topical alignment; (3) an answerability classifier that determines whether a reliable answer can be generated. Using a data set of 500 Amazon questions, 2000+ human responses, and 14,000 review sentences, we systematically evaluate different model variants for both lexical similarity metrics (ROUGE-L) and human judgments. Our full model improves lexical similarity scores by 50% from baseline LLM answers, matches or exceeds 72% of human responses, and approaches the best human answers in clarity, relevance, and informativeness. In particular, human evaluations show that our full model performs particularly well on subjective questions and lexical similarity metrics fail to capture this performance gain. Overall, our findings show how LLMs and reviews can be combined to build scalable QA systems, while also revealing the limits of lexical similarity metrics and highlighting the importance of human-centered evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的QA框架，通过结合LLM和评论的RAG技术，有效解决客户平台上问答质量低、响应延迟的问题，在主观性问题上表现特别优异。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结合大语言模型和用户评论来构建可扩展的问题答复系统，提高客户平台问答的质量和效率？
AI.motivation: 客户面向平台（电子商务、旅游、教育等）的问题答复存在响应延迟、质量低和用户参与度低等问题。虽然用户评论丰富，但其非结构化性限制了直接用于回答具体问题，而LLM单独使用缺乏产品特定细节和主观见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于检索增强生成（RAG）理论，结合大语言模型的通用知识和用户评论的专业内容，构建了一个多组件集成框架。
AI.method: 提出了一个包含三个组件的QA框架：(1) RAG组件用于推理时动态检索相关评论；(2) 问题-评论类型匹配模块以增强主题对齐；(3) 可回答性分类器用于判断是否能生成可靠答案。使用Amazon的500个问题、2000+人工回答和14000条评论进行系统评估。
AI.findings: 完整模型将词法相似性指标（ROUGE-L）提高了50%，匹配或超过72%的人工回答，在清晰度、相关性和信息量方面接近最佳人工答案。在主观性问题上表现特别优异，词法相似性指标无法抓取这种性能提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一种结合LLM和用户生成内容的新的QA框架理论，证明了RAG技术在客户服务领域的有效性，并揭示了词法相似性指标的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台提供了可扩展的高质量QA系统构建方案，能够利用现有的评论资源，特别是在主观性问题上提供更佳的用户体验，同时强调了人本中心评估的重要性。

title: Understanding the Impacts of Generative AI Use on Children: WP2 School based Engagements
affiliations: The Alan Turing Institute, The Alan Turing Institute and The Alan Turing Institute

detail.title: Understanding the Impacts of Generative AI Use on Children: WP2 School based Engagements

declarations.ethicsApproval: Written consent was received for all participants.
declarations.funderStatement: The LEGO Group

detail.abstract:
Generative AI is being rapidly deployed across a wide range of sectors and for diverse purposes. While children are the group that may be most impacted by the widespread deployment of generative AI, they are simultaneously the group least represented in decision-making processes relating to the design, development, deployment or governance of AI.

The research was undertaken through workshops run in collaboration with Children’s Parliament in two state-funded schools in Scotland. 40 children aged between 9 and 11 took part in three days of workshops exploring generative AI through creative, rights-based activities and discussing their hopes and concerns about the ways that generative AI is developed and used. This work package report provides insights into children’s experiences with generative AI, and importantly children's own views on the ways that generative AI should be developed and used.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过创意工作坊探讨儿童对生成式AI的看法，发现儿童作为受AI影响最大的群体却在AI决策过程中代表性不足，研究揭示了儿童对AI发展的希望和担忧。
AI.research_question: 儿童对生成式AI的开发和使用有哪些看法和观点？
AI.motivation: 儿童是受生成式AI广泛部署影响最大的群体，但他们在AI设计、开发、部署和治理的决策过程中代表性最低。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于儿童权利的研究框架，通过创意活动探索儿童对AI的观点。
AI.method: 与苏格兰儿童议会合作，在两所公立学校开展为期三天的创意工作坊，40名9-11岁儿童参与基于权利的创意活动和讨论。
AI.findings: 研究提供了儿童与生成式AI互动的经验洞察，以及儿童自身对生成式AI应如何开发和使用的观点。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了儿童视角在AI研究中的空白，建立了基于儿童权利的AI研究框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI开发者和政策制定者提供了儿童对AI发展的真实看法，有助于设计更符合儿童需求的AI系统。

title: Retention Costs or Human Capital Investments: A Dual Perspective on Employer-Sponsored Health Benefits
affiliations: Columbia University and Ivey Business School, Western University

detail.title: Retention Costs or Human Capital Investments: A Dual Perspective on Employer-Sponsored Health Benefits
detail.abstract: Abstract: Employer-sponsored health insurance is the predominant coverage source for the U.S. workforce, yet the rationale behind firms' provision of these benefits remains debated. We examine two primary motivations: as a retention mechanism reducing employee turnover, and as a human capital investment enhancing workforce productivity. To disentangle these perspectives, we exploit policy-induced shocks to labor mobility and track firms’ benefit adjustments. We employ a stacked difference-in-differences approach using novel datasets on health plan details, individual healthcare utilization, and state-level variations in non-compete agreement (NCA) enforceability from 2013 to 2020. Our results show that increased NCA enforceability leads firms to lower premiums primarily by shifting to High-Deductible Health Plans (HDHPs). This shift, in turn, boosts HDHP enrollment rates and significantly reshapes healthcare utilization among affected employees, leading to fewer preventive care visits but a greater incidence of severe, high-cost medical procedures. Overall, our findings support the retention cost perspective while also highlighting the unintended long-term consequences of cost-saving strategies.

AI.tldr: 研究发现非竞争协议执行力增强导致企业通过转向高免赔额健康计划来降低保费，这支持了健康保险作为留才机制的观点，但带来了减少预防性护理和增加高成本医疗程序等 unintended consequences。
AI.research_question: 企业提供健康保险的主要动机是什么？是作为员工留任机制还是人力资本投资？
AI.motivation: 雇主赞助的健康保险是美国劳动力的主要覆盖来源，但企业提供这些福利的根本原因仍存在争议，需要区分留任机制和人力资本投资两种动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于组织经济学和人力资源管理理论，探讨健康保险作为员工留任机制（降低流动成本）和人力资本投资（提高生产力）的双重作用。
AI.method: 采用堆叠双重差分法，利用2013-2020年健康计划细节、个人医疗利用数据以及州级非竞争协议执行力变化，分析政策冲击对企业福利调整的影响。
AI.findings: 非竞争协议执行力增强导致企业降低保费（主要通过转向高免赔额健康计划），提高了HDHP参保率，显著改变了医疗利用模式：预防性护理减少但高成本医疗程序增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 为健康保险的企业提供动机理论提供了实证证据，支持留任成本视角，同时揭示了成本节约策略的长期 unintended consequences。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业健康福利设计提供参考，警示政策制定者注意非竞争协议对医疗福利和员工健康结果的影响，有助于更全面地评估健康保险政策的效果。

title: VERY HAPPY WORKERS. Learning from them for the benefit of workers and organizations
affiliations: Erasmus Happiness Economics Research Organization

detail.title: VERY HAPPY WORKERS. Learning from them for the benefit of workers and organizations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Approval from an ethics board was not asked.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding.

detail.abstract: Diener and Seligman (2002) carried out a very influential study on very happy people. In our study, we focus on very happy workers and more precisely on very happy at work workers.  Our main purpose was to learn from very happy at work workers to help organizations and workers to heighten the degree of happiness at work of workers. This purpose led us to ask four questions: What is the impact of personal characteristics on very happy at work workers? What is the impact of current work experiences on very happy at work workers? What is the impact of past work experiences on very happy at work workers? What is the impact of very happy at work workers on the effectiveness of an organization they are working for? Finally, we asked a subsidiary question: Are very happy at work workers very happy in life workers? Three groups of workers were compared: the 10% happiest at work, the 10% unhappiest at work and the 20% median happy at work. This comparison was realized using a cross-sectional study of 1,761 workers working in the same field, teaching, for a same organization. Our results showed that the very happy at work workers are very happy in life. They considered that they experience better work conditions, although they were unsatisfied with some of their conditions. They could be assets to their organization as they had a higher degree of occupational self-efficacy, showed more organizational citizenship behaviours, less counterproductive behaviours, and wanted to stay working for the organization.

AI.tldr: 本研究聚焦于工作中非常快乐的员工，通过与最不快乐和中等快乐员工的对比，发现非常快乐的员工在生活中也很幸福，对工作条件评价更高，具有更高的职业自我效能感，表现出更多组织公民行为，更少反生产行为，且更愿意留在组织。
AI.research_question: 1. 个人特征对工作中非常快乐的员工有何影响？2. 当前工作经历对工作中非常快乐的员工有何影响？3. 过去工作经历对工作中非常快乐的员工有何影响？4. 工作中非常快乐的员工对其所在组织的效能有何影响？
AI.motivation: 借鉴Diener和Seligman(2002)关于非常快乐人群的研究，关注工作中非常快乐的员工，旨在帮助组织和员工提升工作幸福感。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于积极心理学和工作幸福感理论，借鉴Diener和Seligman的研究框架，关注工作场所中的极端快乐群体。
AI.method: 横断面研究设计，对1,761名在同一领域（教育）和同一组织工作的教师进行比较分析，分为三组：10%最快乐、10%最不快乐、20%中等快乐。
AI.findings: 工作中非常快乐的员工在生活中也很幸福；他们认为工作条件更好（尽管对某些条件不满意）；具有更高的职业自我效能感；表现出更多组织公民行为；更少反生产行为；更愿意留在组织工作。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Diener和Seligman关于极端快乐人群的研究到工作领域，提供了工作中非常快乐员工的实证特征描述。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了识别和培养快乐员工的具体指标，帮助组织通过提升员工幸福感来改善组织效能和员工保留率。

title: Responsible Sourcing Through Online "Supplier Intelligence" Platforms
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) - School of Management, Singapore Management University - Lee Kong Chian School of Business, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Anderson School of Management and Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE) - School of Business Administration

detail.title: Responsible Sourcing Through Online "Supplier Intelligence" Platforms
detail.abstract: To ease buyers' burden in seeking responsible suppliers, some online "supplier intelligence" platforms now offer supplier audit services. Given this alternative, should buyers rely on these platforms to facilitate responsible sourcing? To address this question, we develop a game-theoretical model involving a buyer and two potential suppliers whose social-responsibility compliance is not completely known to either parties. The buyer would incur a penalty when sourcing from a low-compliance supplier. We compare two sourcing scenarios: direct sourcing, where the buyer searches and audits the suppliers directly, and platform sourcing, where the buyer sources through a platform that acts as a marketplace and conducts supplier audits. By examining and comparing these two sourcing models, where the principal (buyer or platform) specifies the efficacy level of imperfect audits, our equilibrium outcomes generate the following results. First, the buyer increases its audit efficacy when the social-responsibility penalty increases under direct sourcing, whereas interestingly, the penalty has a non-monotonic impact on the platform's audit efficacy. Second, platform sourcing generally intensifies suppliers' price competition. However, when the platform sets a higher audit efficacy or when the penalty is higher, supplier competition is softened, thereby raising wholesale prices. Third, platform sourcing is not always superior to direct sourcing: it promotes responsible sourcing effectively only when the penalty is low or when the pool of compliant suppliers is limited. Furthermore, when the penalty is moderate, platform sourcing can create a win-win outcome for both the buyer and suppliers, achieving a Pareto improvement over direct sourcing.

AI.tldr: 本文通过博弈论模型比较了直接采购和平台采购两种模式，发现平台采购并不总是优于直接采购，只有在处罚较低或合规供应商有限时才更有效促进负责任采购，中等处罚时能实现帕累托改进。
AI.research_question: 买家是否应该依赖供应商情报平台来促进负责任采购？
AI.motivation: 为减轻买家寻找负责任供应商的负担，在线供应商情报平台提供审计服务，需要评估这种替代方案的优劣。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，涉及买家和两个潜在供应商，供应商的社会责任合规性不完全可知。
AI.method: 开发博弈理论模型，比较直接采购（买家直接审计）和平台采购（平台作为市场并审计）两种情景。
AI.findings: 1. 处罚增加时买家提高审计效能，但对平台审计效能有非单调影响；2. 平台采购加剧供应商价格竞争，但高审计效能或高处罚时竞争缓和；3. 平台采购并非总是更优，只在低处罚或合规供应商有限时更有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了供应商审计的博弈理论框架，揭示了平台采购与直接采购在不同条件下的相对优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为买家选择采购模式提供决策依据，帮助平台设计更有效的审计策略，促进供应链社会责任实践。

title: “Too Much” Self-Efficacy? Understanding the Curvilinear Consequences of Between-Person Self-Efficacy Through a Moderated-Mediation Model of Perceived Proximity and Employee Effort
affiliations: Ohio University, University of Alabama - Culverhouse College of Commerce & Business Administration and Independent

detail.title: “Too Much” Self-Efficacy? Understanding the Curvilinear Consequences of Between-Person Self-Efficacy Through a Moderated-Mediation Model of Perceived Proximity and Employee Effort

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: IRB approved all study materials and methodologies
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: Building from a paradox frame, we argue that at the between-person level the relationship between self-efficacy and effort may be nonlinear. We bound our conceptual model with a focus on perceived proximity, reflecting employees’ perceptions of how close they feel to their organization and colleagues. We test our model in a lagged, multi-source field study, with matching employee survey data from 1502 employees, and archival effort, and performance, metrics collected several months later. The results from our analyses reveal a curvilinear association between self-efficacy and effort, which is moderated by perceived proximity. We also find that the relationship between self-efficacy and performance is mediated by effort for individuals with low self-efficacy (Low SEs), but not for individuals with moderate (Moderate SEs) or high self-efficacy (High SEs). Implications for theory and practice are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于悖论框架，发现自我效能感与努力之间存在非线性关系，且这种关系受到感知亲近度的调节。自我效能感与绩效的关系通过努力中介，但仅适用于低自我效能感个体。
AI.research_question: 自我效能感与努力之间的关系是否呈现非线性特征？感知亲近度如何调节这种关系？自我效能感如何通过努力影响绩效？
AI.motivation: 传统研究认为自我效能感与努力呈线性正相关，但悖论框架提示可能存在非线性关系，需要更深入探讨这种复杂关系及其边界条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 悖论框架、自我效能理论、社会交换理论
AI.method: 滞后多源实地研究，收集1502名员工的调查数据，数月后匹配档案中的努力和绩效指标数据
AI.findings: 1. 自我效能感与努力之间存在曲线关系；2. 感知亲近度调节这种曲线关系；3. 自我效能感通过努力影响绩效的关系仅适用于低自我效能感个体
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了自我效能感与努力的线性关系假设，引入悖论框架解释非线性关系，识别感知亲近度作为重要边界条件
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理提供指导，帮助识别不同自我效能感水平的员工，通过调节感知亲近度来优化努力投入和绩效表现

title: Automated accounting and auditing in the platform of blockchain technology
affiliations: Science and Research Branch of Islamic Azad University

detail.title: Automated accounting and auditing in the platform of blockchain technology
detail.abstract:
Purpose

The purpose of this research is to enhance the body of knowledge and forecast the future of accounting and auditing. In this regard, it is essential to comprehend the nature, structure and efficacious capabilities of blockchain technology in accounting and auditing to achieve this goal. Furthermore, it is imperative to ascertain the efficacious and affected relationships and factors of this technology to gain insight into and accurately analyses the current situation, and to identify effective strategic factors in the development, improvement of performance and future changes of accounting and auditing.

Design/methodology/approach

In accordance with contemporary methodologies employed in the analysis of future-oriented technology (FTA), this research has undertaken a comprehensive examination of the extant literature on the subject, delineating the principles of automatic accounting and auditing in the context of blockchain technology. The descriptive-exploratory approach within the event approach has been employed to elucidate the pertinent issues. To achieve this objective, the researchers adopted a systemic and philosophical approach with a mixed methodology. This involved conducting an environmental scan and content analysis of the collected resources to elucidate the structures, paradigms and prospective transformations. The results of this review were presented in the form of a semi-structured internet questionnaire and the opinions of 35 international experts on the topics covered in 2023 were sought. The experts were selected using purposive and snowball sampling methods. The survey data were subjected to analysis using the Fuzzy Delphi method. To substantiate or refute the hypothesis of automated accounting and auditing in the blockchain technology platform, the precision of the research outcomes was evaluated through the lens of the linear regression method, the Automatic Linear Modeling (ALM) method, the Support Vector Machine (SVMs) method and the Structural Equation Model (SEM). The software used was ATLAS.ti, Excel, SPSS, Python and SmartPLS.

Findings

The findings of this multi-faceted study, with an accuracy of over 91%, demonstrate that accounting and auditing will be automated on the blockchain platform. The occurrence of this phenomenon will be influenced to a significant degree by technical factors, as well as the perceived usefulness and ease of this automated system.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过多方法分析预测区块链技术将实现会计审计自动化，准确率超过91%，技术因素和系统易用性是关键影响因素
AI.research_question: 区块链技术如何影响会计和审计的未来发展？会计和审计是否会在区块链平台上实现自动化？
AI.motivation: 增强会计审计知识体系并预测其未来发展，需要深入理解区块链技术的本质、结构和有效能力，以及识别影响该技术发展的关键战略因素
AI.theoretical_framework: 未来导向技术分析(FTA)框架，结合系统性和哲学性方法，运用模糊德尔菲法和多种统计建模方法
AI.method: 采用混合方法：文献综述、环境扫描、内容分析、半结构化网络问卷（35位国际专家）、模糊德尔菲法、线性回归、自动线性建模(ALM)、支持向量机(SVMs)、结构方程模型(SEM)，使用ATLAS.ti、Excel、SPSS、Python和SmartPLS软件
AI.findings: 研究结果显示会计和审计将在区块链平台上实现自动化，准确率超过91%。技术因素以及自动化系统的感知有用性和易用性对此现象的发生有显著影响
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了区块链技术在会计审计领域应用的预测模型，为未来技术发展提供了理论框架和验证方法
AI.practical_contributions: 为会计审计行业提供了区块链技术应用的实践指导，识别了影响自动化实现的关键因素，有助于相关机构制定发展战略

title: Artificial Intelligence and Value-Based Strategy: A Literature Review and Future Research Directions
affiliations: , University of Prishtina - Faculty of Economy, Saints Cyril and Methodius University of Skopje and University of Gjilan (UGJ) - Faculty of Economy, Managment and Informatic

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Value-Based Strategy: A Literature Review and Future Research Directions
detail.abstract: Recent technological advancements, data growth, and increased computational capacity have intensified the need for organizations to adopt artificial intelligence (AI) as a driver for value creation. Despite the topic’s importance, the literature on AI and value-based strategy has not been comprehensively evaluated in light of its strategic use for value creation. Thus, this paper, through a systematic literature review, aims to investigate how firms can leverage AI to create a value-based strategy that enhances customer delight, employee satisfaction, and supplier satisfaction/surplus. Specifically, we demonstrate how AI technologies enable firms to create value by proposing a tripartite value-creation model comprising three key dimensions: (1) customer value, by increasing their willingness-to-pay (WTP); (2) employee value, by reducing their willingness-to-sell (WTS); and (3) supplier value, by reducing their WTS. We clarify how established value-based strategy concepts intersect with AI-enabled capabilities, offering a unified conceptual framework that organizes prior insights. Drawing on 70 peer-reviewed articles indexed in Web of Science and Scopus, we identify key gaps, offer guidance for integrating AI into value-based strategy, and propose future research directions to advance theory and practice.

title: Impact of HR Practices on Retention of the Employees -A study in Visakha Dairy
affiliations: and GITAM (Deemed to be University)

detail.title: Impact of HR Practices on Retention of the Employees -A study in Visakha Dairy
detail.abstract: Human resource management is very much essential in any manpower based unit like dairy industry because of mass, money and utility. HR management is aimed at the efficient use of human resources and therefore increased human productivity. Moreover, organizations develop HR practices to motivate and retain their most important assets like employees, evaluating the effectiveness of HR practices on employee retention in Dairy Industry becomes the need of the day. Thus, this part of research paper focuses on study the impact of HR practices on employee retention in Dairy Industry. For this purpose data collected from employees of Visakha Cooperative Dairy units (societies) in Visakhapatnam district with a questionnaire and data was analysed with the help of SPSS software. In this process regression test has been applied to find out the impact of HR Practices on the employee retention, where HR practices were considered independent variables and wmployee retention considered as dependent variable. Thus, recruitment and selection process, performance appraisal, training and development, welfare measures and rewards and recognition included in HR practices. The results from this study indicate that dairy units have the potential of achieving competitive advantage through the HR practices. Management of dairy units can effectively utilize HR practices to develop a skilled and motivated workforce that can be a potential source of competitive advantage for their industry. Moreover, employee retention is determined by performance appraisal, training and development, welfare measures and rewards and recognition in Dairy Industry, the retention attitude among the employees with stable human resources of skilled and quality for a long time and work for same organization development.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨人力资源实践对乳制品行业员工保留的影响，通过回归分析发现绩效评估、培训发展、福利措施和奖励认可是员工保留的关键因素，乳制品企业可通过有效HR实践获得竞争优势。
AI.research_question: 人力资源实践对乳制品行业员工保留的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 乳制品行业作为人力密集型产业，人力资源管理的有效性对提高生产力和保留重要员工资产至关重要，需要评估HR实践对员工保留的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资源管理理论，重点关注招聘选拔、绩效评估、培训发展、福利措施、奖励认可等HR实践与员工保留的关系。
AI.method: 采用问卷调查法收集Visakha合作乳制品单位员工数据，使用SPSS软件进行回归分析，以HR实践为自变量，员工保留为因变量。
AI.findings: 研究发现绩效评估、培训发展、福利措施和奖励认可是决定乳制品行业员工保留的关键因素，这些HR实践有助于建立稳定的高素质员工队伍。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了人力资源管理理论在乳制品行业的应用，明确了特定HR实践对员工保留的具体影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乳制品企业管理提供了实践指导，表明通过优化HR实践可以培养技能型、积极性高的员工队伍，从而获得竞争优势和长期组织发展。

title: The Right to Academic Freedom: Why Scholarly Articles Should Not Require Citations and the Critique of the Academic Gaming System
affiliations: Shenyang Normal University

detail.title: The Right to Academic Freedom: Why Scholarly Articles Should Not Require Citations and the Critique of the Academic Gaming System
detail.abstract: This paper argues that academic articles should have the fundamental right to exist without citing any external sources, challenging the current academic publishing paradigm that demands extensive citations as a prerequisite for publication. Through analysis of editorial requirements from Surface Engineering journal and broader academic publishing practices, we demonstrate how citation mandates have transformed scientific inquiry into an elaborate gaming system designed primarily to inflate SCI impact factors rather than advance knowledge. The paper examines how interdisciplinary researchers face systematic barriers when submitting to unfamiliar fields due to citation requirements, despite potentially valuable innovations. We analyze the problematic distinction between self-citation and external citation, showing that self-citation often demonstrates author conviction and intimate knowledge of their work, while external citations may reflect superficial engagement or coercive editorial practices. Drawing on historical examples like Qian Weichang's famous declaration "this paper need not reference any literature," we argue that truly innovative theoretical work often transcends existing literature boundaries. The current system creates artificial constraints that prioritize bibliographic compliance over intellectual substance, forcing researchers to engage in citation padding, authority worship, and database quota fulfillment rather than focusing on genuine scientific contribution. This academic gaming destroys the integrity of scholarly discourse and impedes genuine innovation by transforming citation from a tool for attribution and context into a mechanism for journal marketing and author networking.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了学术出版中强制引用的范式，认为学术论文应有不引用外部文献的基本权利，指出当前引用要求已异化为提升期刊影响因子的游戏机制，阻碍了真正的学术创新。
AI.research_question: 学术论文是否应该拥有不引用任何外部文献的基本权利？当前强制引用要求如何影响学术创新和学术诚信？
AI.motivation: 当前学术出版体系过度强调引用数量，将科学探究变成了提升期刊影响因子的游戏，对跨学科研究者和理论创新者造成系统性障碍，破坏了学术讨论的完整性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于学术自由和科学创新理论，批判现有引用规范如何从归属工具异化为期刊营销机制，借鉴钱伟长"本文不必参考任何文献"的历史案例。
AI.method: 通过分析《表面工程》期刊编辑要求和更广泛的学术出版实践，考察引用要求对跨学科研究的影响，分析自引用与外部引用的区别问题。
AI.findings: 强制引用要求将学术探究变成了影响因子游戏；跨学科研究者因引用要求面临系统性障碍；自引用常体现作者信念，外部引用可能反映表面参与；真正创新的理论工作往往超越现有文献边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了学术论文不引用外部文献的基本权利理论，挑战了现有引用范式，为学术自由和创新理论提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术期刊改革引用政策提供依据，帮助跨学科研究者克服发表障碍，促进真正以学术贡献而非引用数量为导向的评价体系。

title: Role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) based Customer Relationship Management (CRM) in Customer Retention: An Empirical Investigation for Fintech Organisations
affiliations: MMS Department Rajeev Gandhi College of Management Studies, , University of Rajasthan,  and The School of Management Sciences (SMS) Lucknow

detail.title: Role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) based Customer Relationship Management (CRM) in Customer Retention: An Empirical Investigation for Fintech Organisations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not Applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Not Applicable

detail.abstract: The present research work aims to recognise the use of Artificial Intelligence in Customer Relationship Management towards customer retention in the Fintech industry. Through this paper, we are going to understand the way the Fintech organizations interact with its customers to build a strong relationship. However, it also examines how Artificial Intelligence-based CRM helps enhance the customer experience in the Fintech industry. Fintech companies provide personal financial services by installing AI tools and automation to support the customers and to follow the rules as well. Using AI-based CRM helps an organisation study all data in real-time, predict customer needs, and connect with them as early as possible. Thereby, leading to enhanced customer satisfaction and loyalty. The study also showed that AI-based security systems improve customer satisfaction and their engagement in Fintech companies. This proves that these tools help build satisfaction, engagement, and loyalty among customers. The paper also concludes by sharing views about the challenges in using AI in CRM, and the future changes that may shape this growing area. A sample of 208 respondents from the CRM department was surveyed to determine the factors that show different roles of AI-based CRM in customer retention, and also to know the impact of AI-based CRM on customer retention. The results indicate that there is a significant impact of AI-based CRM on customer retention.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了人工智能在金融科技行业客户关系管理中的应用，特别是对客户保留的影响。研究发现AI驱动的CRM系统能实时分析数据、预测客户需求，显著提升客户满意度和忠诚度。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在金融科技行业客户关系管理中如何影响客户保留？
AI.motivation: 金融科技公司通过AI工具提供个性化金融服务，需要了解AI-based CRM如何增强客户体验和促进客户保留。
AI.theoretical_framework: 客户关系管理理论、人工智能应用理论、客户保留理论
AI.method: 对208名CRM部门受访者进行问卷调查，分析AI-based CRM在客户保留中的不同角色和影响
AI.findings: AI-based CRM对客户保留有显著影响，能实时研究数据、预测客户需求、提高客户满意度和忠诚度，AI安全系统也能提升客户满意度
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了AI在CRM领域的应用理论，为金融科技行业的客户保留机制提供了理论支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技公司提供了实施AI-based CRM的具体指导，帮助提升客户体验和保留率

title: Cultural Heritage Tourism and Destination Loyalty in Tourism Villages: Mediating Effects of Existential Authenticity, Place Attachment and Emotional Solidarity
affiliations: Universitas Pembangunan Panca Budi and Universitas Pembangunan Panca Budi

detail.title: Cultural Heritage Tourism and Destination Loyalty in Tourism Villages: Mediating Effects of Existential Authenticity, Place Attachment and Emotional Solidarity

declarations.funderStatement: We gratefully acknowledge the many individuals and communities who supported this study. Our sincere thanks go to the leaders and residents of the tourism villages in Samosir Regency who participated in the survey and shared their time, stories, and local knowledge. We also thank the field enumerators and colleagues who assisted with instrument pre-testing and data collection. This research was funded by Universitas Pembangunan Panca Budi through the Faculty of Social Sciences Research and Community Service Grant Program (2023). The funder had no role in the study design, data collection and analysis, decision to publish, or preparation of the manuscript.

detail.abstract: Objective: To test a mediated model explaining destination loyalty in tourism villages in Toba Samosir (Toba) Regency, Indonesia, by examining whether cultural heritage tourism (CHT) and emotional solidarity (ES) mediate the effects of iconic tourist attractions (ITA), existential authenticity (EA), and place attachment (PA). Method: A descriptive, cross-sectional survey of 155 repeat visitors was conducted using nonprobability purposive sampling; hypotheses were evaluated with PLS-SEM. Results: CHT had a positive direct effect on destination loyalty. ITA and PA exhibited small positive effects on CHT, while the effect of EA on CHT was positive but not statistically significant. PA substantially increased ES; EA related positively to ES but not significantly. Both CHT and ES acted as mediators that enhanced destination loyalty, indicating that heritage-led experiences and affective bonds translate attraction qualities into repeat-visit intentions and advocacy. Implications: In heritage-rich, community-based destinations, strengthening place attachment and curating iconic experiences can build solidarity with residents and, through CHT, foster loyalty. The study offers actionable insights for local governments and tourism operators in Indonesia and comparable African rural/heritage destinations seeking to leverage village tourism for inclusive development. Value: Provides empirical evidence from an under-studied setting on dual mediation (CHT and ES) in a loyalty model, extending heritage tourism and solidarity theory to tourism villages.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过文化传承旅游和情感团结的双重中介机制，解释了旅游目的地忠诚度的形成路径，为印尼托巴萨莫西尔县的乡村旅游发展提供了实证依据。
AI.research_question: 文化传承旅游和情感团结是否在标志性旅游景点、存在真实性和地方依恋对目的地忠诚度的影响中起到中介作用？
AI.motivation: 探索遗产丰富的社区型旅游目的地中，如何通过文化传承体验和情感联系来培养游客忠诚度，为类似乡村旅游目的地的包容性发展提供实践指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于遗产旅游理论、情感团结理论和地方依恋理论，构建了包含标志性景点、存在真实性、地方依恋、文化传承旅游、情感团结和目的地忠诚度的理论模型。
AI.method: 采用描述性横断面调查设计，对155名重复游客进行非概率目的性抽样，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型检验假设。
AI.findings: 文化传承旅游对目的地忠诚度有直接正向影响；标志性景点和地方依恋对文化传承旅游有较小正向影响；地方依恋显著提升情感团结；文化传承旅游和情感团结在模型中起到中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将遗产旅游和团结理论扩展到旅游村庄情境，提供了双重中介机制在忠诚度模型中的实证证据，丰富了乡村旅游理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼和类似非洲乡村/遗产目的地的当地政府和旅游经营者提供了可操作的见解，强调通过加强地方依恋和策划标志性体验来建立与居民的情感团结，从而培养游客忠诚度。

title: Two-Birds-One-Stone for Green E-commerce: Business and Environmental Impacts of Delivery Fee Charge in Instant Online Retail
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong - The University of Hong Kong Faculty of Business and Economics, Students, The University of Hong Kong  and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Marketing

detail.title: Two-Birds-One-Stone for Green E-commerce: Business and Environmental Impacts of Delivery Fee Charge in Instant Online Retail
detail.abstract: Despite the rapid growth of instant home delivery, most retailers struggle with profitability due to high operational costs and consumer resistance to delivery fees. At the same time, the surge in small, highly responsive orders not only increases operational cost but also generates substantial carbon emissions and plastic package waste. This paper examines how the delivery fee charge affects business and environmental outcomes in instant online retail. Leveraging data from a large-scale quasi-experiment by a leading instant grocery platform in China, this paper analyzes the impact of introducing fees for orders below a spending threshold using a regression discontinuity design. The authors find the policy reduced total order volume by 10.1%, but left quantity sales and overall revenue unchanged. Orders above the threshold increased by 11.3%, driving a 13.9% revenue increase in non-perishable goods, offsetting a 5.2% decline in perishable revenue. Critically, the policy reduced delivery costs by 16.1%, transportation emissions by 11.0%, and plastic bag usage by 10.4%. Results indicate that delivery pricing can simultaneously improve sustainability and maintain financial performance. These findings offer actionable insights for managers seeking to align profitability with environmental goals in instant online retail.

AI.tldr: 即时配送收费政策虽然减少了10.1%的总订单量，但通过提高订单金额（11.3%）和调整商品结构，保持了整体收入和销量不变，同时显著降低了16.1%的配送成本、11.0%的运输排放和10.4%的塑料袋使用，实现了商业效益与环境可持续性的双赢。
AI.research_question: 配送收费政策如何影响即时在线零售的商业表现和环境结果？
AI.motivation: 即时配送面临盈利困境（高运营成本、消费者抵制配送费），同时小订单激增导致运营成本上升、碳排放和塑料包装浪费问题严重
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于定价策略、消费者行为理论和环境可持续性理论
AI.method: 利用中国领先即时杂货平台的大规模准实验数据，采用断点回归设计分析订单金额阈值下的配送收费政策影响
AI.findings: 政策使总订单量下降10.1%，但销量和总收入保持不变；阈值以上订单增加11.3%，非易腐品收入增长13.9%（抵消易腐品5.2%下降）；配送成本降低16.1%，运输排放减少11.0%，塑料袋使用减少10.4%
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了配送定价在协调商业绩效与环境可持续性方面的作用机制，拓展了定价策略与环境管理交叉领域的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了可操作的见解，帮助在即时在线零售中实现盈利能力与环境目标的统一，提供了具体的配送收费政策实施方案

title: Monopolizing The Harvest: Corporate Influence and Regulatory Gaps in Global Seed Governance
affiliations: University of New England (Australia) - School of Law

detail.title: Monopolizing The Harvest: Corporate Influence and Regulatory Gaps in Global Seed Governance

contentType.other: Forthcoming in the VANDERBILT JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL LAW

detail.abstract: This Article critically examines the growing dominance of multinational corporations in the global seed and agrochemical sectors and its far-reaching implications for food security, agricultural biodiversity, and environmental sustainability. Through a detailed analysis of market consolidation, intellectual property regimes, and technological dependencies, the study reveals how a handful of corporations have come to control the majority of commercial seed and agrochemical markets, fundamentally reshaping global food governance. The Article interrogates claims of corporate stewardship, exposing tensions between profit motives and genuine biodiversity conservation, as well as issues of epistemic injustice and democratic deficits in seed governance. It further assesses the environmental sustainability practices of leading industry players-Bayer, Corteva, Syngenta, and BASF-highlighting significant discrepancies between their sustainability rhetoric and operational realities. The analysis extends to the fragmented global regulatory landscape, encompassing international treaties, regional frameworks, and the rise of private governance, which collectively prioritise corporate interests over public and ecological welfare. It argues that only by reclaiming seeds as common heritage, strengthening public governance, and empowering social movements can we address the intertwined challenges of hunger, biodiversity loss, and climate change, and move towards a more just and sustainable global food system. Ultimately, the Article calls for transformative reforms grounded in food sovereignty, democratic participation, and agroecological principles.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析跨国公司在全球种子和农化领域的垄断地位及其对粮食安全、农业生物多样性和环境可持续性的深远影响，揭示企业利益与公共利益之间的冲突，呼吁基于粮食主权和生态农业原则的转型改革。
AI.research_question: 跨国公司如何通过市场整合、知识产权制度和技术依赖控制全球种子和农化市场，以及这种控制对粮食安全、生物多样性和环境可持续性产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 随着少数跨国公司控制全球种子和农化市场，这种垄断格局对全球粮食治理、生物多样性保护和环境可持续性构成了严重威胁，需要深入分析其影响机制并提出解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全球食品治理理论、企业社会责任理论、知识产权理论和环境正义理论，分析企业垄断对公共利益的侵蚀。
AI.method: 采用批判性分析方法，通过市场整合数据、知识产权制度分析和企业可持续性实践评估，揭示企业言论与实际操作之间的差距。
AI.findings: 四大跨国公司（拜耳、科迪华、先正达、巴斯夫）控制大部分商业种子和农化市场；企业可持续性言论与实际操作存在显著差异；全球监管体系碎片化且偏向企业利益。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了企业治理与公共治理之间的张力，提出了基于粮食主权和生态农业的替代治理框架，丰富了全球食品治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了改革监管体系的依据，为社会运动提供了行动策略，为企业指出了真正的可持续经营方向。

title: A General Critique of Post-1990 American Strategists from the Perspective of Relative Universalism
affiliations: Istanbul Topkapi University and Association of Digital Ecosystem Governance and Development Research

detail.title: A General Critique of Post-1990 American Strategists from the Perspective of Relative Universalism
detail.abstract:
The end of the Cold War and the dissolution of the Soviet Union in the early 1990s generated a wave of American strategic thinking that claimed prophetic authority over the future of world politics. Figures such as Zbigniew Brzezinski, Francis Fukuyama, Samuel Huntington, Edward Luttwak, Joseph Nye, Henry Kissinger, Thomas Friedman, Paul Wolfowitz, Robert Kaplan, and others projected frameworks that ranged from the “unipolar moment” and the “end of history” to the “clash of civilizations” and the “rise of geo-economics.” These theses shaped policy debates in Washington and influenced international relations scholarship worldwide. Yet, three decades later, many of these claims have proven fragile, exaggerated, or deeply flawed when tested against empirical realities such as 9/11, the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan, the resurgence of Russia, the rapid rise of China, global financial crises, and the ongoing transformation of globalization.

This article develops a systematic critique of post-1990 American strategists from the perspective of Relative Universalism, a theoretical framework that emphasizes pluralism, contextual truth, and the coexistence of multiple trajectories of modernization and governance. Relative Universalism challenges the absolutist tendencies of U.S. strategic thought by rejecting the assumption that liberal democracy, market capitalism, or American hegemony constitute final or universal stages of history. Through a critical literature review and comparative analysis, the article situates American strategic predictions within a broader field of scholarly critique, including both Western and non-Western voices.

The findings suggest that while certain insights—such as Kissinger’s realism, Nye’s notion of soft power, and Luttwak’s geo-economic emphasis—retain partial relevance, the overarching narratives of unipolar permanence, historical closure, and civilizational determinism collapse under the weight of multipolar realities. The article concludes that Relative Universalism provides a more resilient analytical lens to interpret global politics, one that accommodates diversity, cultural relativity, and the open-ended character of historical development. In doing so, it contributes both to critical strategic studies and to pluralist theories of international order, offering lessons for future scholarship and policy in an increasingly multipolar world.

AI.tldr: 本文对1990年后美国战略家的预测进行了系统性批判，提出了相对普遍主义理论框架，认为多元化和多极化现实否定了美国战略思想中的绝对主义倾向。
AI.research_question: 后冷战时期美国战略家的预测框架在多大程度上经得起实证检验？相对普遍主义如何提供更有效的分析视角来理解全球政治？
AI.motivation: 冷战结束30年后，许多美国战略家的预言（如单极时刻、历史终结、文明冲突等）被证明是脆弱、夸大或有严重缺陷的，需要新的理论框架来解释多极化现实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相对普遍主义（Relative Universalism），强调多元化、情境真理、现代化和治理模式的多元共存，挑战自由民主、市场资本主义和美国霸权的绝对普世性假设。
AI.method: 批判性文献综述和比较分析，将美国战略预测置于更广泛的学术批判领域（包括西方和非西方观点）中进行评估。
AI.findings: 基辛格的现实主义、奈的软实力概念和卢特瓦克的地缘经济学观点仍具有部分相关性，但单极永久性、历史终结和文明决定论等总体叙事在多极化现实面前崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 为批判性战略研究和国际秩序多元理论做出贡献，提供更具韧性的分析视角来解读全球政治，容纳多样性、文化相对性和历史发展的开放性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来学术研究和政策制定提供启示，特别是在日益多极化的世界中，强调需要更加包容和多元的理论框架来指导国际关系实践。

title: Effect of Sovereign Risk and Debt-Side Governance on Cross-Border Infrastructure Risk Premium in a Developing Nation: The Case of Kenya
affiliations: Strathmore Business School, The British University in Dubai and Mercer University - Eugene W. Stetson School of Business and Economics

detail.title: Effect of Sovereign Risk and Debt-Side Governance on Cross-Border Infrastructure Risk Premium in a Developing Nation: The Case of Kenya

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Motivation: Developing countries' reliance on foreign capital for large-scale infrastructure projects makes sovereign risk premium and debt-side governance practices key determinants of cross-border infrastructure risk premiums. Purpose: This study estimates the effect of international sovereign bond spreads (systematic risk) and debtside governance (unsystematic risk) on cross-border infrastructure risk premiums in Kenya's major infrastructure projects from 2011 to 2020. Approach and methods: We use pooled and random-effects panel data analysis of secondary data. Findings: The findings show that rising international sovereign bond spreads (ranging from 9.6% to 32.39%), corruption levels, external debt-to-import ratios, loan utilization rates, disbursement delays, and climate risk disclosure significantly contributed to increasing cross- border infrastructure risk premiums. The interaction between bond spreads and corruption had a compounding effect in increasing cross- border infrastructure risk premiums. On the other hand, longer loan maturities, higher internal rates of return, substantial government involvement, and a rising external debt to total investment ratio reduce project risk premiums. Policy implications: These findings underscore the need for Kenya's modern Public Debt Management Office and infrastructure execution institutions to reduce external borrowing costs through governance reforms that improve transparency, project oversight, and environmental standards. By strengthening debtside governance, Kenya can reduce its external borrowing costs and improve the sustainability of infrastructure-led debt. As such, the study offers actionable insights for low- and middle-income countries, emphasizing the role of modern sovereign debt management tools that target sustainability and strategic governance reforms at the project level in attracting more favourable borrowing rates for infrastructure financing.

AI.tldr: 本研究估计了国际主权债券利差（系统性风险）和债务侧治理（非系统性风险）对肯尼亚2011-2020年主要基础设施项目跨境风险溢价的影响。研究发现主权债券利差上升、腐败水平、外债与进口比率等因素显著增加了风险溢价，而较长的贷款期限、较高内部收益率等因素降低了风险溢价。

title: The Impact of Animated Advertisements on Consumer Engagement in the Digital Age
affiliations: Jai Narain Vyas University (JNV), Pune Institute of Business Management, Pune Institute of Business Management, Department of Management Studies, Jai Narain Vyas University, Jodhpur, MIT World Peace University, Pune Institute of Business Management and University of Rajasthan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not Applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable
