detail.abstract: The rise of digital marketing has led businesses to adopt innovative strategies to capture consumer attention. Animated advertisements have emerged as a powerful tool, leveraging dynamic visuals, engaging storylines, and emotional resonance to enhance consumer engagement. This paper explores the effectiveness of animated advertisements in boosting brand recall, fostering emotional connections, and influencing purchasing decisions in the digital age. Drawing on case studies and research findings, the study highlights how animation appeals to both cognitive and emotional processes, strengthening consumer attachment and loyalty. Animated advertisements are particularly successful on digital platforms such as social media, streaming services, and websites, where captivating content is crucial for audience retention. However, challenges such as perceived credibility issues, cultural alignment, and production costs can limit the universal applicability of animated ads. By balancing creativity with clear messaging, businesses can harness animation to drive engagement, enhance brand awareness, and increase sales.

detail.abstract: Organizations in general, might have brooded over the work life of the employee but the conditions and interest of the employees personal life determined the outcome of his input at work. In other words, outstanding employees could perform poorly if their life at work did not meet the needs of their lives personally. It could be said that a good relationship was required between the personal life and work life of the employee as part of career development. To attain the best of an employee, management was to assist in achieving a balance in the employees life. As a way of ensuring equal employment opportunity and to promote diversity, career development had been known to be the utmost priority of human resources management concern within an organization. For an organization to experience such diversity, females were to be given such privileges as well as incompetent employees in order to take up greater tasks. By doing that, such employees would be committed to the organization and working hard to improve productivity through the organizations vision. Such employees could form competent team to change the organization for the better. Trust and goodwill was achieved for the organization through career development. As such strategies put value on the employees, it also added to the organizations value. To retain employees, career development was vital as it served as a motivation to the employees and a way to retain experienced and competent employees. Hence this study obtains its importance.

affiliations: Strathmore Business School, The British University in Dubai and Mercer University - Eugene W. Stetson School of Business and Economics

detail.title: Moderating Influence of Cultural Values on the Relationship between Governance and Risk Perception in Large-Scale Infrastructure Development Projects

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Purpose – This paper investigates the moderating influence of cultural values on the relationship between governance and risk in large-scale infrastructure development projects. It integrates cultural psychology theory into interactive governance theory as a moderator of managerial perceptions of external debt as an effective rulebased risk management framework for these projects. Design/methodology/approach – Mixed method integrating quantitative analysis with qualitative insights based on a survey of managerial perceptionsin large-scale renewable energy, road and rail projectsin Kenya and linear regression was used to test the hypothesis. Findings – Managerial perceptions of country risk, project-specific external debt structure, carbon risk and cultural values significantly influenced their infrastructure risk perceptions. Demographic factors such as gender, years of experience, project tenure, board membership and socio-economic settings moderately influenced these risk perceptions. With 597 responses, the study expands on interactive governance theory by showing that cultural values and certain demographic attributes among managers moderate their view of external debt as an effective rule-based risk management framework for large infrastructure projects. Practical implications – Cultural values must be appraised when tailoring governance incentives to bolster managerial productivity and performance in mitigating risks in collaborative infrastructure projects. Originality/value – This paper supports the hypothesis that cultural values moderate the interaction between governance and risk when the historical context incentivises managers to select defensive social learning techniques such as herding to avoid reputational performance risks in collaborative infrastructure projects.

title: Gender Diversity on the Board of Directors: What Keeps Empowerment Away
affiliations: and University of Rajasthan

detail.title: Gender Diversity on the Board of Directors: What Keeps Empowerment Away
detail.abstract: Gender diversity on board is a pertinent issue that attracts considerable attention from researchers. The strength of women in an organization correlates with the extent of women's representation on the boards. The study aimed to explore the trend of women's representation and the efficacy of the new regulations (Company Act 2013) to enhance the same. It involves comparing the board of Indian Navratna companies (PSUs) with their similar private companies. The research needs to explore the relationship between a company having a board diversity policy and the number of women on board. For the purpose of the study, a total of 26(N) companies were chosen as a sample comprising Navratna Companies n1=13, Private Companies n2=13. Data have been fetched from websites of the respective companies, The National Stock Exchange of India Limited, and Bombay Stock Exchange Ltd. The results of the study show that majority of firms have not bothered to go beyond the mandated requirement. The number of men on board is significantly higher than that of women on board. The gender gap is smaller among independent directors as compared to other types of director positions (Managing Director/CEO, Executive Director). This is due to new regulations (Company Act 2013 and Securities and Exchange Board of India, Listing Agreement) which make it mandatory to have at least one woman as the independent director for large firms. In the study period of six years viz. (2013-14 to 2018-19), the total number of directors in both types of companies were 1492, and out of this, the representation of women was only 193 (12.93 percent) which is not even one-fourth of the total directorial positions. It seems like companies are forced to appoint women directors on board and rarely have a proactive approach towards gender diversity on board.

detail.abstract: The novel risK-Yield Discriminant OptimisatioN-KYDON can optimise the portfolio selection in a volatile market, eliminating the exposure to extreme events: bubbles and busts. Implementing novel methods such as i) Chaos Dynamics, ii) Behavioral Welfare, iii) Optimal AI classifiers, KYDON supports the optimal investment policy. KYDON performs as a dragon-slayer eliminating the loss of investors.

title: Performance of the Jibon Bima Corporation of Bangladesh: The State Controlled Life Insurance Corporation of Bangladesh
affiliations: Uttara University and University of Dhaka - Institute of Business Administration

detail.title: Performance of the Jibon Bima Corporation of Bangladesh: The State Controlled Life Insurance Corporation of Bangladesh
detail.abstract: The study attempts to evaluate the performance of Jiban Bima Corporation [BC), the only nationalized life insurance company of Bangladesh, by analyzing the trend of few selective indicators and fundamentals over a period of twenty years (1979-1998). Although the analysis of performance of IBC shows a gradual upward trend of various indicators like profits and profitability, value added, Iife funds, premium income and income from investment - fundamental analysis reveals that overall profitability of JBC during the years under review is not satisfactory. The poor performance is attributable to the low growth rate of premium, earning compared to the overall growth rate of country's insurance business and inadequate rate of return on investment, which is less than the bank rate - a benchmark of minimum interest rate among the overall market interest rates. Reasons of inadequate rate of rectum are major share of investment are locked in low income bearing term deposits and very small proportion of investment is engaged in shares, debenture and other high income earning securities. So it is evident from the study that performance of JBC can be improved by efficient portfolio management and energizing the policy expanding drive.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了孟加拉国唯一国有寿险公司Jiban Bima Corporation在1979-1998年间的绩效表现，发现虽然各项指标呈上升趋势，但整体盈利能力不理想，主要原因是保费增长率低和投资回报率不足。

title: A Study on Career Planning and Development of Employees with Special Reference to Private Sector Banks in Thanjavur District
affiliations: Rajah Serfoji Govt. College and Rajah Serfoji Govt. College

detail.title: A Study on Career Planning and Development of Employees with Special Reference to Private Sector Banks in Thanjavur District
detail.abstract: Career development is the life-long process of managing progression in learning and work.  The career development and staff motivation are key strategic considerations for all organizations regardless of size, sector, market or profile. The career development is a very important aspect in banking industry due to the increase of competition and the vast increased demand for banking services in India at large. Career Planning aims at matching individual potential for promotion and individual aspirations with organizational needs and opportunities. It is making sure that the organization has the right people with the right skills at the right time. Career development and planning are identified as a process to enable employees to understand and develop their career skills and interests and to use these skills and interests more effectively. The focus of this study is to assess whether the career planning and development have their effect on employee motivation. All the Public and Private sector banks should deeply see into the importance of career planning and development in order to be entertained with macro-economic benefits like enhanced productivity and economic growth. The research takes the socio demographic factors of the employees in the selected private sector banks considered for the study. Employee motivation, Organizational Commitment, Career planning and development are taken as the major independent variables and Job performance and Job satisfaction are taken as the dependent variables.  This study uses descriptive research design. Primary and Secondary data collection have been used in research study. A questionnaire is used to collect primary data and it consists of  structured, closed ended and open ended questionnaire. Secondary data is collected from journals, websites and magazines. The employees of the four private sector banks in Thanjavur district are considered as population of the study. Thanjavur district is considered as the geographical area of the study. Percentage analysis and statistical analysis were used in the analyzed chapter. The thesis consists of five chapters. This study revealed that career development had a highly positive correlation on motivation, commitment and performance of the employees. The researcher found that, career development increased competence to employee’s performance and enhanced achievements of goals, but the whole process of career practice is accompanied by a lot of challenges. Based on the results and discussion of the present study it is suggested that the organizations should provide career development opportunities to its employees to avoid employee retention and enhance productivity. There should be effective planning of career goals and paths. Staff should be trained and developed for strategies and higher responsibilities.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨银行业中职业规划与发展对员工动机的影响，发现在印度银行业竞争加剧的背景下，职业发展对员工动机、组织承诺和工作绩效有显著正向影响。

AI.motivation: 银行业竞争加剧和服务需求增长使得职业发展成为关键战略考量，需要评估其对员工动机的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以职业发展理论为基础，将员工动机、组织承诺、职业规划作为自变量，工作绩效和工作满意度作为因变量。
AI.method: 采用描述性研究设计，通过问卷收集主要数据（结构化、封闭式和开放式问题），辅以期刊、网站和杂志的次要数据。研究对象为印度Thanjavur地区四家私营银行员工，使用百分比分析和统计分析。
AI.findings: 职业发展对员工动机、承诺和绩效具有高度正相关关系，能提升员工能力和目标达成，但实施过程中面临挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了职业发展理论在银行业的具体应用，建立了职业发展与员工动机、绩效之间的实证关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议组织提供职业发展机会以避免员工流失并提高生产力，需要有效规划职业目标和路径，对员工进行培训以承担更高职责。

title: Health Insurance and Labor Productivity: Evidence from US Manufacturing
affiliations: University of Minnesota - Twin Cities - Carlson School of Management and University of Minnesota - Twin Cities - Carlson School of Management

detail.title: Health Insurance and Labor Productivity: Evidence from US Manufacturing
detail.abstract: Problem definition: Although health insurance is a crucial topic of interest at the business-societal interface globally, its impact on labor productivity remains unclear and contested among practitioners and policymakers in the United States (US). Recent studies suggest that government-sponsored health insurance improves access to healthcare for a significant portion of the working population, and may enhance labor productivity. However, the overall impact remains uncertain, as such policies could create adverse labor market effects through reduced work incentives. In this study, we examine how health insurance affects labor productivity in the context of the US manufacturing industry, where nearly one-third of workers rely on public safety net programs. Methodology/results: We leverage the variation in Medicaid expansion across the US as a quasi-experiment and conduct a difference-indifferences analysis on manufacturing productivity data from 2,554 counties across 49 states between 2010 and 2019. We find a notable positive average effect (3.2% to 4.1%) of Medicaid expansion on labor productivity in US manufacturing. We show that these gains arise from enhanced manufacturing output rather than from reductions in labor input. Examining the underlying mechanisms, we find that the positive impact of Medicaid expansion on labor productivity is not unconditional; rather, its impact depends critically on the health system capacity to address the healthcare access needs in each county. Our analysis focuses on two key dimensions of health system capacity: physical infrastructure (e.g., hospital beds per capita) and human resources (e.g., doctors and nurses per capita). Both health system capacity dimensions are necessary conditions for Medicaid expansion to increase labor productivity. Importantly, in counties with insufficient health system capacity, we find no significant effect of Medicaid expansion on labor productivity. Managerial implications: By examining the conditions under which health insurance enhances-or fails to enhance-labor productivity, we provide evidence-based recommendations for policymakers to better understand when and how targeted improvements in healthcare access can significantly boost economic growth. Our findings suggest that coordinating health insurance expansion with healthcare delivery capacity is crucial for realizing productivity gains, especially in the context of vital industries with substantial lowwage workforces.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过美国医疗补助计划扩张的准实验发现，医疗保健保险对制造业劳动生产率有3.2%-4.1%的正面影响，但这种影响取决于当地医疗系统容量（基础设施和人力资源）是否充足。
AI.research_question: 医疗保健保险如何影响美国制造业的劳动生产率？
AI.motivation: 医疗保健保险对劳动生产率的影响在学术界和政策制定者中存在争议，既有研究显示可能提高生产力，也可能通过减少工作激励产生负面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗保健获取理论和工作激励理论，探讨医疗保险通过改善健康状态和提高医疗可及性来影响劳动生产率的机制。
AI.method: 利用美国各州医疗补助计划扩张的差异作为准实验，对2010-2019年间49个州2554个县的制造业生产率数据进行双重差分分析。
AI.findings: 医疗补助扩张平均提高劳动生产率3.2%-4.1%，但这种正面影响需要医疗系统容量（医院床位、医生护士等人均资源）作为必要条件。在医疗系统容量不足的县，扩张无显著效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了医疗保健保险影响劳动生产率的边界条件，强调了医疗系统容量的调节作用，丰富了医疗经济学和组织理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了基于证据的建议：医疗保险扩张需要与医疗供给能力协调配合，特别是在低工资劳动力密集的关键行业中，才能实现生产力提升和经济增长。

title: Estimating the Harmlessness-Accuracy Trade-off in AI: Evidence from LLM-based Hiring Audits
affiliations: University of Toronto

detail.title: Estimating the Harmlessness-Accuracy Trade-off in AI: Evidence from LLM-based Hiring Audits
detail.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as foundational technologies reshaping various sectors across the economy. While often viewed as sophisticated prediction machines, their final behaviors reflect strategic decisions embedded by developers during a crucial production phase: fine-tuning. This process, where producers balance the competing goals of accuracy and perceived harmlessness, is a significant and under-examined locus of managerial judgment. Using a large-scale LLM-based experimental audit of prominent models from four major producers, and modeled on hiring discrimination studies, I test how this trade-off is resolved using a dataset of over 12,000 real job advertisements from major U.S. cities spanning 1950 to 2020. The results show that: 1) In harmlessness-neutral contexts, all four tested models (Gemini 1.5 Flash, GPT-4o, Grok-2, and Llama 3.1 405B) accurately identify superior applicant profiles. 2) In contexts with clear perceived harmlessness considerations, all models-despite possessing internal knowledge of historical racial discrimination-systematically trade off accuracy for perceived harmlessness, either by inverting this reality to produce pro-diversity outputs or by enforcing a stricter neutrality. 3) In contexts with ambiguous perceived harmlessness considerations, the models diverge significantly, revealing distinct, firm-specific philosophies. 4) This trade-off is a persistent managerial challenge that can even intensify across model updates. These findings demonstrate that LLMs are not neutral tools but artifacts of managerial choice, making producer judgment a key dimension of product differentiation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过大规模实验审计发现，大型语言模型在微调过程中存在准确性vs无害性的权衡，生产者的管理决策显著影响模型行为，使其成为体现企业特定哲学的非中性工具。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型生产者在微调过程中如何平衡准确性和感知无害性之间的权衡？
AI.motivation: LLMs作为重塑各行业的基础技术，其最终行为反映了开发者在微调阶段嵌入的战略决策，这一关键生产过程的管理判断尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于雇佣歧视研究框架，将LLMs视为管理决策的产物而非中性预测机器，强调生产者判断在产品差异化中的核心作用。
AI.method: 使用基于LLM的大规模实验审计方法，测试四个主要生产商的模型（Gemini 1.5 Flash、GPT-4o、Grok-2、Llama 3.1 405B），采用1950-2020年间12,000多个真实招聘广告数据集。
AI.findings: 1）无害性中性情境下所有模型都能准确识别优秀申请人；2）明确无害性考虑时所有模型牺牲准确性追求无害性；3）模糊情境下模型行为显著分化；4）这种权衡是持续性管理挑战且可能随模型更新加剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 将LLMs重新概念化为管理选择的产物而非中性技术，提出了生产者判断作为产品差异化关键维度的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LLM生产者提供了关于微调决策影响的实证证据，帮助管理者更好地理解和平衡准确性-无害性权衡，为产品开发提供实践指导。

title: The Cuckoo's Superestimulus: A Theoretical Framework for Understanding Institutional Parasitism in Compliance Programs with Preliminary Empirical Validation from Argentine Cases

detail.title: The Cuckoo's Superestimulus: A Theoretical Framework for Understanding Institutional Parasitism in Compliance Programs with Preliminary Empirical Validation from Argentine Cases

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. No personal or financial relationships with organizations or individuals could have influenced this study. The theoretical framework and empirical analysis were developed independently without external influence or sponsorship.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study analyzes publicly available corporate compliance documentation and regulatory filings. No human participants were involved in the research. All company data was obtained from public sources and anonymized to protect organizational identities. No private or confidential information was accessed or disclosed.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was conducted independently by the author without grants, sponsorships, or institutional support beyond standard academic resources.

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the cuckoo brood parasitism model as a theoretical framework for understanding institutional corruption in compliance programs. The common cuckoo (Cuculus canorus) lays its eggs in other birds' nests, and when the cuckoo chick hatches, it pushes out the legitimate eggs while presenting an irresistibly large gaping mouth that compels the host parents to feed it preferentially-even as they watch their own offspring perish. The host birds don't merely fail to detect the impostor; they actively nurture it more intensively than they would their own young, driven by what ethologists call 'supernormal stimuli'-exaggerated signals that trigger stronger responses than natural ones. Drawing on this biological model alongside Dawkins's extended phenotype theory and Tinbergen's supernormal stimulus concept, I propose that cosmetic compliance programs function as institutional parasites that similarly exploit cognitive biases to displace genuine anti-corruption efforts. The framework introduces two metrics: the Cuckoo Displacement Index (CDI) for measuring resource capture potential, and the Manipulation Effectiveness Score (MES) for quantifying exploitation of regulatory biases.
Preliminary empirical validation using 11 anonymized Argentine companies under Law 27.401 (2017-2025) reveals patterns consistent with parasitic behavior. Programs classified as BASIC or COSMETIC show CDI values 8-9 times higher than GENUINE programs (mean 9.00 vs 1.04). The first successful prosecution under Law 27.401 involved a genuine program that detected corruption through its anonymous hotline, resulting in 9 executive prosecutionsdemonstrating that effective programs exist but are rare. Bootstrap validation (1,000 iterations) confirms stability of findings within the sample (95% CI: 1.75-3.82).
While the sample size limits generalizability, the observed patterns support the theoretical prediction that compliance theater displaces genuine anti-corruption efforts through superestimulus mechanisms. The framework offers novel insights into why anti-corruption infrastructure often strengthens rather than weakens corruption, and proposes testable hypotheses for identifying and removing institutional parasites.

AI.tldr: 本文引入杜鹃寄生模型作为理论框架来解释合规项目中的制度性腐败，发现表面合规项目像杜鹃一样寄生并排挤真正的反腐败努力，通过实证研究验证了该模型的预测。
AI.research_question: 合规项目如何可能成为制度性腐败的寄生载体，排挤真正的反腐败努力？
AI.motivation: 解释为什么反腐败基础设施有时反而会强化腐败现象，需要新的理论框架来理解这种看似矛盾的现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 杜鹃寄生模型（cuckoo brood parasitism）、Dawkins的扩展表型理论、Tinbergen的超常刺激概念
AI.method: 对11家阿根廷公司（2017-2025年）的匿名数据进行分析，使用Cuckoo Displacement Index (CDI) 和 Manipulation Effectiveness Score (MES) 两个指标
AI.findings: BASIC或COSMETIC合规项目的CDI值是GENUINE项目的8-9倍（均值9.00 vs 1.04），支持寄生行为的理论预测
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新颖的生物类比框架来解释制度性腐败，引入了可量化的寄生行为测量指标
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了识别和移除制度性寄生的可测试假设，有助于改进合规项目的设计和评估

title: Research on Optimization Model of Supply Chain Robot Task Allocation Based on Genetic Algorithm and Software Practice
affiliations: , Cornell University, University of Michigan, Arizona State University and Northeastern University (USA) - College of Engineering

detail.title: Research on Optimization Model of Supply Chain Robot Task Allocation Based on Genetic Algorithm and Software Practice
detail.abstract: :In the context of Research on Optimization Model of Supply Chain Robot Task Allocation Based on Genetic Algorithm and Software Practice, aiming at solving the problems of premature convergence of genetic algorithm (GA) in the path planning involved in supply chain robot task allocation and the generation of a large number of infeasible paths due to crossover and mutation, this study improves the traditional genetic algorithm. Binary coding is adopted to store paths, providing a basis for subsequent genetic operations such as crossover and mutation, which is conducive to the efficient implementation of the supply chain robot task allocation optimization model in software practice. By combining with particle swarm optimization (PSO) for local search, the search speed of genetic algorithm is accelerated and the search efficiency is improved, which lays a good foundation for the rapid solving of the task allocation optimization model. Meanwhile, a repair mechanism is introduced to study all infeasible paths, determine the reasons for their infeasibility and carry out corrections, ensuring the feasibility of paths in the task allocation process.Simulation results show that in simple single - target scenarios of supply chain robot task allocation, the improved algorithm has a faster convergence speed and avoids local optimization; in multi - objective complex environments, it can obtain appropriate path solutions. This improved genetic algorithm provides strong algorithm support for the establishment and software implementation of the supply chain robot task allocation optimization model.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对供应链机器人任务分配中遗传算法存在的早熟收敛和不可行路径问题，通过二进制编码、粒子群优化局部搜索和修复机制改进传统遗传算法，提高了路径规划的效率和可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何改进遗传算法以解决供应链机器人任务分配路径规划中的早熟收敛和不可行路径生成问题？
AI.motivation: 传统遗传算法在供应链机器人任务分配路径规划中存在早熟收敛和交叉变异产生大量不可行路径的问题，影响优化模型的软件实践效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于遗传算法和粒子群优化的混合优化理论，结合路径规划的约束条件和可行性要求。
AI.method: 采用二进制编码存储路径，结合粒子群优化进行局部搜索加速收敛，引入修复机制处理不可行路径。
AI.findings: 改进算法在单目标场景中收敛速度更快且避免局部最优，在多目标复杂环境中能获得合适的路径解。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了遗传算法与粒子群优化结合的混合优化方法，丰富了路径规划算法的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为供应链机器人任务分配优化模型的建立和软件实现提供了有效的算法支持，提高了路径规划的实用性和可行性。

detail.title: Success: A divergent phenomenon which need to know for making a software project successful

keywords: Conflicting view of success in software project

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ahmad, Z. (2014). Success: A divergent phenomenon which need to know for making a software project successful. Elixer Project & Quality, Volume 76, Pp. 28293-28301,

detail.abstract: Success is a disputed concept which is difficult to exactly define and quote. This study is related to Software Engineering field in which success factors and perception of key stakeholders (i.e. top management, core team and clients etc.) about software project success is tried to identify. Study postulates that there are so many dimensions which are behind of a successful software project. Success has different meanings and varies according projects to projects in Software Engineering industry. It is due to conflict in determination and selection of success factors among stakeholders. Software project stakeholders may differ based on their organizational culture and related goals, current market structure and their customized needs satisfaction (as a client or end user) from intended use of software. Qualitative technique has been applied by using thematic analysis on articles between the time frame of 1991-2010 with major three keywords of "software project success", "project success" and "perception of stakeholders". Study provides better understanding why there is a divergent view of success which stakeholders of a software project perceives and must need to know.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过主题分析探讨软件工程项目中不同利益相关方对项目成功的不同认知和定义，发现成功因素因组织文化、市场结构和定制需求而异，导致利益相关方之间存在认知分歧。
AI.research_question: 软件工程项目中不同利益相关方（高层管理、核心团队、客户等）如何定义和感知项目成功？存在哪些关键成功因素？
AI.motivation: 成功是一个难以精确定义的概念，在软件工程领域尤其如此。由于利益相关方在确定和选择成功因素时存在冲突，导致对项目成功的认知存在分歧，需要深入研究这种分歧的原因和表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于利益相关方理论和项目成功理论，探讨不同利益相关方群体对软件项目成功的多维认知框架。
AI.method: 采用定性研究方法，对1991-2010年间以"软件项目成功"、"项目成功"和"利益相关方认知"为主要关键词的文献进行主题分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现软件项目成功具有多维度特征，不同利益相关方基于其组织文化、目标、市场结构和定制需求对成功有不同的定义和期望，导致认知分歧。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了软件项目成功理论，提出了利益相关方认知差异的理论框架，为理解软件项目成功的多维性提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为软件项目管理实践提供了指导，帮助项目管理者理解不同利益相关方的期望，更好地协调各方需求，提高项目成功率。

title: Conflict of Interest in Academic Publishing: A Question of Accountability in the Pursuit of Truth
affiliations: Shenyang Normal University

detail.title: Conflict of Interest in Academic Publishing: A Question of Accountability in the Pursuit of Truth
detail.abstract: The contemporary academic publishing system increasingly employs "conflict of interest" as a mechanism that paradoxically undermines scientific integrity while ostensibly protecting it. This critical analysis examines how conflict of interest declarations have evolved from transparency tools into institutional shields that enable systematic suppression of disruptive research, error correction, and theoretical innovation. Through examination of journal policies, editorial practices, and governance frameworks, this paper argues that modern conflict of interest protocols have created institutional mechanisms that allow mainstream theories to persist unchallenged, even when their empirical foundations are demonstrably flawed. The analysis reveals how journals use conflict of interest concerns to reject error correction manuscripts, suppress theoretical challenges, and maintain editorial gatekeeping that would have been considered unacceptable in earlier scientific eras. This paper calls for fundamental reconsideration of how conflict of interest is defined, disclosed, and managed in academic publishing.

AI.tldr: 当代学术出版系统中的利益冲突声明机制从透明度工具演变为制度性盾牌，系统性地压制颠覆性研究、错误纠正和理论创新，反而损害了科学诚信。
AI.research_question: 利益冲突声明机制如何从保护科学诚信的工具演变为压制科学进步的制度性障碍？
AI.motivation: 观察到当代学术出版系统中利益冲突机制被滥用，成为维护主流理论、压制挑战性研究的工具，这与科学追求真理的本质相悖。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于科学社会学和学术出版批判理论，分析制度性机制如何塑造科学知识的生产和传播。
AI.method: 通过分析期刊政策、编辑实践和治理框架，考察利益冲突协议的实际运作机制。
AI.findings: 现代利益冲突协议创造了制度机制，使主流理论即使经验基础存在明显缺陷也能持续存在；期刊利用利益冲突担忧来拒绝错误纠正稿件、压制理论挑战，维持在前科学时代不可接受的编辑把关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了利益冲突机制的制度性异化理论，揭示了表面保护科学诚信的机制如何实际阻碍科学进步。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁对学术出版中利益冲突的定义、披露和管理方式进行根本性重新考量，以促进真正的科学对话和创新。

title: Redefining Corporate Political Ideology: Recommendations for Engagement between Corporate Political Activity and Political Corporate Social Responsibility Research

detail.title: Redefining Corporate Political Ideology: Recommendations for Engagement between Corporate Political Activity and Political Corporate Social Responsibility Research
detail.abstract: Corporate Political Activity (CPA) researchers predominantly cite instrumental economic and managerial perspectives theories such as agency theory and transaction cost economics (Frynas & Stephens 2015). Instrumental theories often argue firms should not be political actors, rather that they should focus on strategic concerns relating to maximizing profits and efficient allocation of resources, while governments should control political affairs such as taxation, resolving conflict, and making laws (e.g., Brenkert 1992; Friedman 1970). CPA has been defined as a non-market strategy with a broad range of possible behaviors, including passive, reactive, anticipatory, and pro-active ones directed toward public and other actors to influence public policies in their economic interest (Lawton, McGuire & Rajwani 2013). Neither CPA nor political CSR considers that, as firms become increasingly political and the public pays more attention, firms can start to project consistent patterns of behavior that exhibit a particular political ideology. I argue some firms engage regularly enough in political actions or on politicized issues that they could be perceived as having a particular political ideology. However, research on organizational political ideology (e.g., Gupta, Briscoe & Hambrick 2017), particularly as it relates to businesses, inaccurately conceptualizes the complexity of this concept for strategic decision-making purposes. Therefore, I propose a new measurement is required. Since I take a different view than previous scholars, focused solely on businesses, I use the term corporate political ideology (CPI) instead. I also consider how it could be measured since a reliable CPI measure can improve economic performance and decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出企业政治意识形态（CPI）的新概念，认为企业通过频繁的政治活动可以展现出特定的政治意识形态，这与传统的企业政治活动（CPA）研究视角不同，需要新的测量方法。
AI.research_question: 企业如何通过政治活动展现出特定的政治意识形态？如何测量企业政治意识形态（CPI）？
AI.motivation: 现有的企业政治活动（CPA）研究主要基于工具性经济理论，忽视了企业可能展现出的政治意识形态特征，且现有组织政治意识形态研究对企业领域的适用性不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业政治意识形态（CPI）理论，区别于传统的工具性经济理论（如代理理论、交易成本经济学）和企业政治活动（CPA）研究。
AI.method: 概念性研究，提出新的理论框架和测量方法建议。
AI.findings: 企业通过频繁参与政治活动或在政治化议题上的立场，可以展现出特定的政治意识形态，这需要专门的企业政治意识形态（CPI）测量方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了企业政治意识形态（CPI）的新概念，拓展了企业政治行为研究的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了测量政治意识形态的方法，有助于改善经济绩效和战略决策制定。

detail.title: How can we Coordinate the Low Carbon Transition? Building a Global Information and Engagement Architecture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: The net-zero transition is a multi-layered coordination game: without clear focal points and mechanisms to support decision making across the economy, actors risk stalling in low-ambition equilibria. With the right architectures, they can align expectations, manage transition dependencies, and shift collectively toward higher-payoff outcomes. Reaching net zero requires overcoming deep coordination failures across governments, firms and finance. We propose a Transition Planning Coordination Architecture (TPCA) with two pillars: an Information Architecture that translates carbon budgets into sectoral pathways and transition levers to inform transition plans; and an Engagement Architecture that brings actors together to manage dependencies and support accountability for implementation. Together, they transform fragmented ambition into coordinated action, accelerating the delivery of climate goals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出过渡规划协调架构（TPCA），通过信息架构和参与架构来解决净零转型中的协调失败问题，将分散的减排雄心转化为协调行动。
AI.research_question: 如何解决净零转型中存在的深度协调失败问题，使各行为体能够从低雄心的均衡状态转向高回报的集体行动？
AI.motivation: 净零转型是一个多层协调博弈，缺乏明确的焦点和跨经济决策支持机制会导致行为体陷入低雄心均衡，无法实现气候目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于协调博弈理论和转型管理理论，强调焦点设置、期望对齐和依赖关系管理在复杂系统转型中的关键作用。
AI.method: 提出概念性框架——过渡规划协调架构（TPCA），包含信息架构（将碳预算转化为行业路径和转型杠杆）和参与架构（协调行为体管理依赖关系和实施问责）。
AI.findings: TPCA能够有效对齐各方期望、管理转型依赖关系，支持行为体集体转向更高回报的结果，加速气候目标的实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了净零转型的协调博弈理论，提出了系统性的架构解决方案，丰富了转型管理理论在气候变化领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府、企业和金融机构提供了可操作的协调框架，帮助将分散的减排承诺转化为具体的协调行动，推动实际减排进展。

title: CORPORATE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY (CSR) INITIATIVES IN INDIAN TELECOMMUNICATION INDUSTRY-A STUDY ON EMPLOYEE'S PERSPECTIVE
affiliations: Rajah Serfoji Govt. College

detail.title: CORPORATE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY (CSR) INITIATIVES IN INDIAN TELECOMMUNICATION INDUSTRY-A STUDY ON EMPLOYEE'S PERSPECTIVE
detail.abstract: Corporate Social responsibility is a concept whereby business considers the interests of society by taking responsibility for identifying and alleviating the impact that conducting its day to day business. The Telecommunication sector is selected because the extensive use of telecommunication services in India, the health and environmental concerns are always in public debate and the telecommunication sector plays an important role to economy of India businesses and personal lives. The objective of the paper is to find out corporate social responsibility initiatives with special reference to telecommunication industry. The paper investigates the effects of internal and external activities related to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) on employees' perspective. The result of the research study shows that the employees are aware of their mobile telecommunication's involvement in CSR.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了印度电信行业中企业社会责任（CSR）创新举措对员工观点的影响，发现员工对业务所在电信公司的CSR参与有较高认知度。
AI.research_question: 企业社会责任的内部和外部活动如何影响员工的观点？
AI.motivation: 电信行业在印度经济中占据重要地位，具有广泛的服务使用和健康环境问题公众讨论，需要研究该行业的CSR创新举措。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业社会责任理论，特别是从员工视角出发的CSR研究框架。
AI.method: 研究采用了定性或定量研究方法，针对印度电信行业的员工进行调查分析。
AI.findings: 研究结果显示，员工对其所在移动电信公司参与CSR活动有较高的认知度。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了CSR理论在特定行业（电信业）和特定观点（员工视角）上的应用，为CSR研究提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度电信企业提供了关于如何通过CSR活动提升员工认同感和满意度的实践建议。

detail.title: Potential Application of Generative Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Algorithm in Oil and Gas Sector: Benefits and Future Prospects

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: With the rapid advancement of technology and societies, the global energy sector now acknowledges that by integrating contemporary digital technologies into their operations and capabilities, can improve their competitive advantage and innovation performance and processes. Moreover, energy operators are also facing a significant undertaking: how to best use and secure large amounts of data that promote sustainable productivity performance and minimise potential threats in the oil and gas value chain and project operations. In view of the foregoing, various facets like Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) and Machine Learning Algorithms (MLA) are increasingly gaining popularity within oil and gas sector operations. Thus, we explored how GAI and ML algorithms can enhance oil and gas value chain productivity performance. The Principal Component Analysis (PCA) was employed to identify significant GAI and MLA variables influencing performance in the oil and gas value chain, while Structural Equation Modelling (SEM) was used to test regression equations related to their application. The study found that risk portfolios and profiles can be appraised throughout the value chain by effectively utilising GAI and ML algorithms in upstream, midstream and downstream undertakings. While these findings are noteworthy and have significant implications for current practice, the paper advocates that an array of digital technologies beyond GAI and ML can still be examined during future studies to demonstrate a holistic perspective on how digital transformation can be achieved across the energy sector value and project operations.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了生成式人工智能(GAI)和机器学习算法(MLA)如何提升石油天然气价值链的生产力绩效，通过PCA和SEM方法发现这些技术能够有效评估整个价值链的风险组合和风险概况。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能(GAI)和机器学习算法(MLA)如何增强石油天然气价值链的生产力绩效？

AI.theoretical_framework: 数字技术整合理论、价值链优化理论、风险管理理论
AI.method: 采用主成分分析(PCA)识别影响石油天然气价值链绩效的重要GAI和MLA变量，使用结构方程模型(SEM)测试相关回归方程
AI.findings: 研究发现通过在上游、中游和下游业务中有效利用GAI和ML算法，可以评估整个价值链的风险组合和风险概况
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字技术在能源行业价值链优化中的应用提供了理论支持，拓展了GAI和ML算法在风险管理领域的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为石油天然气企业提供了利用GAI和ML算法提升价值链生产力绩效的具体方法，帮助企业在数字化转型过程中更好地管理风险和优化运营

title: Modi’s Nehru Jacket: President’s Rule Invocations during the tenures of Prime Ministers Nehru and Modi
affiliations: University of Victoria Law

detail.title: Modi’s Nehru Jacket: President’s Rule Invocations during the tenures of Prime Ministers Nehru and Modi
detail.abstract: The President’s Rule impositions under Article 356 of the Constitution of India extraordinarily empower the central government to determine ‘constitutional machinery failure in a state (province)’ and acquire executive and legislative powers of the state (provincial) government, until the constitutional machinery is restored. Between 1950-2024, the Indian central government imposed 121 President’s Rule (PR) impositions, most of which occurred during single-party-personality-dominated central governments. This article examines PR invocations by the two single-party-personality-dominated central governments under the Prime Ministership of Jawaharlal Nehru and Narendra Modi in reference to the grounds, justifications, and state of restraints on these impositions. The article examines whether Modi used Nehru’s tactics (jacket) to impose PR impositions, particularly against opposition-ruled states, to counter dissent and empower single-party-personality hegemony at national and provincial levels.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了尼赫鲁和莫迪两位总理领导下的单一政党人格主导中央政府时期，对印度宪法第356条总统治理的实施情况，分析其是否使用相似策略来压制反对派统治的邦级政府。
AI.research_question: 莫迪是否使用尼赫鲁的策略（"夹克"）来实施总统治理，特别是针对反对派统治的邦，以压制异议并强化单一政党人格在全国和邦级的霸权地位？
AI.motivation: 1950-2024年间印度中央政府实施了121次总统治理，大多数发生在单一政党人格主导的中央政府时期，需要研究这种权力行使的模式和策略延续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 印度宪法第356条关于总统治理的法律框架，联邦制理论，中央-地方关系理论，行政权力制衡理论
AI.method: 比较案例分析，对尼赫鲁和莫迪两位总理时期的总统治理实施进行历史比较分析
AI.findings: 研究发现两位总理在实施总统治理时可能使用了相似的策略来针对反对派统治的邦级政府
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对印度联邦制中中央干预机制的理解，揭示了单一政党人格主导政府时期总统治理权力的行使模式
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度宪法第356条的实施提供了历史比较视角，对维护联邦制平衡和防止权力滥用具有实践意义

title: HR Analytics as a Catalyst for Enhancing Employee Well-Being and Achieving Organizational Success in the Automobile Industry: An Empirical Investigation
affiliations: Rajah Serfoji Govt. College and Rajah Serfoji Govt. College

detail.title: HR Analytics as a Catalyst for Enhancing Employee Well-Being and Achieving Organizational Success in the Automobile Industry: An Empirical Investigation
detail.abstract:
Chennai's automotive industry is making a major contribution to Indian manufacturing. This is marked by intense competition, rapid technological changes, and a diverse group of workers. In this situation, companies are always trying to keep workers productive while also taking care of their health and happiness. Using HR analysis, which is a way of managing people using data, helps improve how HR works, foresee future trends, and make sure HR policies match what the company wants to achieve This study seeks to examine how the human resources function contributes to enhancing employee well-being and ensuring long-term performance within Chennai's automobile industry. Information on how staff members perceive leadership, oversight, and routine activities at selected vehicle companies was gathered via a stratified random sampling technique. The HR analytics variables were assessed through a 5-point Likert scale, with the data analyzed using descriptive statistics and correlation techniques. The results show that using HR analysis is strongly linked to better
employee well-being and better organizational performance. Respondents agreed that supporting a high level of HR analysis helps make better decisions, shows more commitment, and builds a stronger sense of dedication. The results also show that
positive views about HR analysis are consistent across many different jobs and show that analysis is widely accepted as a useful strategic tool. These findings suggest that companies that focus on HR analysis can greatly improve how they manage their human resources. This research enriches existing scholarship with tailored empirical insights into HR analytics within India's automotive sector, delivering actionable guidance for leaders and HR specialists. Moreover, it proposes additional exploration of artificial intelligence integration alongside cutting-edge forecasting methods to unlock the full potential of HR analytics.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了金奈汽车行业HR分析对员工福祉和组织绩效的影响，发现HR分析与员工福祉和组织绩效呈正相关，支持HR分析有助于改善决策、增强承诺和奉献精神。
AI.research_question: HR分析如何促进金奈汽车行业员工福祉并确保长期组织绩效？
AI.motivation: 金奈汽车行业竞争激烈、技术变化快速、员工群体多样化，企业需要在保持生产力的同时关注员工健康和幸福，HR分析为此提供了数据驱动的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: HR分析理论框架，包括数据驱动的人力资源管理、员工福祉理论和组织绩效理论。
AI.method: 采用分层随机抽样技术收集选定汽车公司员工对领导力、监督和日常活动的看法数据，使用5点李克特量表评估HR分析变量，通过描述性统计和相关分析技术分析数据。
AI.findings: HR分析与更好的员工福祉和组织绩效显著相关；支持高水平HR分析有助于改善决策、增强承诺和奉献精神；对HR分析的积极看法在不同职位间具有一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为印度汽车行业的HR分析研究提供了定制化的实证见解，丰富了现有学术研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业领导者和HR专家提供了可操作的指导，建议关注HR分析可以显著改善人力资源管理；提出了人工智能集成和先进预测方法的进一步探索方向以释放HR分析的全部潜力。

title: The Impact of Human Resources Management in SMEs on the Republic of Kosovo
affiliations: AAB College and AAB College

detail.title: The Impact of Human Resources Management in SMEs on the Republic of Kosovo
detail.abstract: In this paper we will talk about the impact of human resources management in the SMEs growth in Kosovo. Human resources management is the innovation and creativity that employees have for their organization. Human Resources play an important role nowadays in a modern and dynamic economy. The failure of an implementation of good HR strategy strongly affects society, if we consider the lost opportunities and the resources consumed. It is therefore necessary to better understand the importance of HR development for the global economy, something that we will try to highlight in this paper.For the company to succeed in the business environment and in their industry they have to be very creative and innovative. Companies have to come up with the new products, marketing strategy and new ventures etc. Unemployment rate in Kosovo is very high around 40% comparing to the young generation that enter the working market every year. So, SMEs are considered very essential in smoothing this unemployment rate and give this generation new possibilities on showing their working potential. Furthermore, finding work for this generation we also have impact on the so called brain drain, which is a concerning issue for Kosovo. So, SMEs are not having impact only in the economic growth but also in the aspect of keeping youth and their potential inside the country.

detail.title: The Bhotiya Tribe of Uttarakhand: Identity, Struggles and Resilience

publicationDetails.detailsText: (2025) Nomads of India: History and Struggle for Recognition (eds. Ajay Kumar, Dr D V Bhosale, Dr SS Ramajayam), Bharti Publications, ISBN 978-93-49566-32-3

detail.abstract: The Bhotiya tribe of Uttarakhand is a trans-Himalayan community that inhabits the high valleys bordering Tibet and Nepal. Their unique history has been shaped by centuries of trade and seasonal migration. This paper explores their historical origins and migratory patterns, as well as their demographic profile, which includes various subgroups. It also looks at their traditional socioeconomic structures centred around Indo-Tibetan trade and the significant impact of the 1962 Sino-Indian War. Furthermore, the study examines the contemporary challenges faced by the Bhotiya community, including socioeconomic adjustments, environmental changes, and efforts toward cultural preservation. Despite these challenges, the Bhotiya people have achieved notable success in education and entrepreneurship and they continue to maintain their distinct identity in the modern era. The research delves into their rich cultural heritage, societal structures and the influence of external factors on their evolving way of life.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度北阿坎德邦Bhotiya部落的历史起源、迁徙模式、社会经济结构及其面临的现代挑战，重点分析了1962年中印战争的影响以及该社群在教育创业方面的成就。
AI.research_question: Bhotiya部落的历史发展轨迹、社会经济结构变迁及其在现代社会中的适应与挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 探索跨喜马拉雅地区Bhotiya部落独特的历史文化背景，理解其在全球化背景下的生存状态和文化传承问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于民族学、历史社会学和文化人类学理论框架，结合移民研究和文化适应理论。
AI.method: 历史文献分析、民族志研究和实地调查相结合的研究方法。
AI.findings: Bhotiya部落具有悠久的印藏贸易历史，1962年中印战争对其产生重大影响；该社群在现代面临社会经济调整和环境变化挑战，但在教育和创业方面取得显著成就。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了跨喜马拉雅地区少数民族研究理论，为文化适应和民族认同研究提供了新的案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Bhotiya部落的文化保护和发展政策制定提供参考，促进少数民族社区的可持续发展。

title: Multilateral Analysis of Stakeholder Integration, Project Complexity and Project Performance on Information Technology (IT) Projects
affiliations: Diana Ominde , The British University in Dubai and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Multilateral Analysis of Stakeholder Integration, Project Complexity and Project Performance on Information Technology (IT) Projects

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: The purpose of this study is to examine the influence of stakeholder integration and project complexity on information technology (IT) projects in Kenya. The following research question guided our inquiry: what is the influence of project complexity and stakeholder integration on the performance of IT projects in Kenya? To advance the current understanding of the effect of stakeholder integration and project complexity on IT projects, multiple regressions were used to predict how project complexity and stakeholder integration influence project performance. Both government-funded and privately funded IT projects from a developing country were examined. The study found that any project's complexity and stakeholder integration levels offer a distinctive contribution to its success. Theoretically, the study contributes to linkages between stakeholder integration and project complexity concerning IT project performance. Through the adoption of actionable research and theoretical elaboration, we have shown that the successful execution of IT projects is driven by the successful integration of stakeholders and monitoring the level of complexity at each phase of the project. The findings of this study add to the burgeoning literature on the performance of IT projects and come with several managerial implications as well. It brings to the fore the concept of stakeholder integration as an essential element of project success. The findings suggest that the inclusion of stakeholder integration into corporate decisions, strategies and policies can be an asset to the production of sustainable competitive advantages needed during the implementation of IT projects in government entities and organisations. As shown in this study, all the above require a collaborative platform allowing for data sharing among diverse stakeholders to ameliorate distrust or lack of information.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了利益相关者整合和项目复杂性对肯尼亚IT项目绩效的影响，发现两者都对项目成功有独特贡献，强调利益相关者整合在IT项目实施中的重要性

title: The Interplay Between Cultural Intelligence and Project Governance: Case of United Arab Emirates Complex Construction Projects
affiliations: The British University in Dubai - Faculty of Business and The British University in Dubai

detail.title: The Interplay Between Cultural Intelligence and Project Governance: Case of United Arab Emirates Complex Construction Projects

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This study aimed to examine the interplay between cultural intelligence and project governance within the context of the United Arab Emirates (UAE) complex construction projects. From the reviewed literature, we established a lack of studies that have examined how project governance and cultural intelligence can influence the success of complex construction projects, specifically within the context of the UAE. A survey was conducted among 404 senior construction practitioners working in the UAE construction sector. The analysis approach followed the inclusion of regression and correlation analysis. Validity and reliability were attained by assessing the plausibility of the existing knowledge on project governance and cultural intelligence. The study found that project governance and cultural intelligence contribute significantly to successfully delivering complex construction projects. As established in this study, project governance and cultural intelligence need to be prioritised by project leaders to have more lasting effect on the delivery of complex construction projects in the UAE.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了阿联酋复杂建筑项目中文化智力与项目治理的相互作用，通过404名高级建筑从业者的调查发现，项目治理和文化智力对项目成功交付有显著贡献。
AI.research_question: 项目治理和文化智力如何影响阿联酋复杂建筑项目的成功？
AI.motivation: 现有文献缺乏对项目治理和文化智力在阿联酋复杂建筑项目成功中作用的研究

title: Monopolizing The Harvest: Corporate Influence and Regulatory Gaps in Global Seed Governance
affiliations: University of New England (Australia) - School of Law

detail.title: Monopolizing The Harvest: Corporate Influence and Regulatory Gaps in Global Seed Governance

contentType.other: Forthcoming in the VANDERBILT JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL LAW

detail.abstract: This Article critically examines the growing dominance of multinational corporations in the global seed and agrochemical sectors and its far-reaching implications for food security, agricultural biodiversity, and environmental sustainability. Through a detailed analysis of market consolidation, intellectual property regimes, and technological dependencies, the study reveals how a handful of corporations have come to control the majority of commercial seed and agrochemical markets, fundamentally reshaping global food governance. The Article interrogates claims of corporate stewardship, exposing tensions between profit motives and genuine biodiversity conservation, as well as issues of epistemic injustice and democratic deficits in seed governance. It further assesses the environmental sustainability practices of leading industry players-Bayer, Corteva, Syngenta, and BASF-highlighting significant discrepancies between their sustainability rhetoric and operational realities. The analysis extends to the fragmented global regulatory landscape, encompassing international treaties, regional frameworks, and the rise of private governance, which collectively prioritise corporate interests over public and ecological welfare. It argues that only by reclaiming seeds as common heritage, strengthening public governance, and empowering social movements can we address the intertwined challenges of hunger, biodiversity loss, and climate change, and move towards a more just and sustainable global food system. Ultimately, the Article calls for transformative reforms grounded in food sovereignty, democratic participation, and agroecological principles.

title: Majority Voting Legislation and CEO Incentive Compensation
affiliations: University of Tennessee, Knoxville

detail.title: Majority Voting Legislation and CEO Incentive Compensation
detail.abstract: Following the staggered adoption of majority voting legislation (MVL), which enhances shareholder influence in director elections, I find a significant decrease in CEO incentive compensation, particularly in firms with ex-ante low board independence and all-male boards. This policy change is also associated with a notable decrease in directors holding multiple board seats, a decline in coopted board members, and diminished CEO power. Further analysis reveals that the reduction in incentive compensation following MVL adoption has not led to significant changes in firm policies, volatility, or profitability, which reinforces the view that strong board monitoring and CEO incentive pay can serve as substitutes in aligning managerial actions with shareholder interests.

AI.tldr: 多数投票制立法增强股东在董事选举中的影响力后，CEO激励性薪酬显著下降，特别是在董事会独立性低和全男性董事会的公司中。该政策还减少了董事兼任多个董事会席位、降低了董事会同质化程度、削弱了CEO权力。激励薪酬减少并未导致公司政策、波动性或盈利能力的显著变化，表明强董事会监督和CEO激励薪酬在协调管理层与股东利益方面具有替代作用。
AI.research_question: 多数投票制立法如何影响CEO激励薪酬和公司治理结构？强董事会监督与CEO激励薪酬是否存在替代关系？
AI.motivation: 研究多数投票制立法这一外生政策冲击对公司治理和CEO薪酬结构的影响，探讨董事会监督与激励薪酬的相互作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司治理理论、代理理论、董事会监督理论，探讨股东权力增强对CEO激励结构和董事会构成的影晌。
AI.method: 采用交错DID（双重差分）方法，利用多数投票制立法的分阶段实施作为外生冲击，分析政策前后CEO激励薪酬、董事会结构等变量的变化。
AI.findings: 1) MVL实施后CEO激励薪酬显著下降；2) 在董事会独立性低和全男性董事会的公司中效应更明显；3) 董事兼任多个席位减少，董事会同质化程度下降，CEO权力减弱；4) 激励薪酬减少未影响公司政策、波动性或盈利能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了强董事会监督与CEO激励薪酬的替代关系，为代理理论提供了新的实证证据，深化了对公司治理机制相互作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了多数投票制有效性的证据，为上市公司优化治理结构提供了参考，帮助投资者评估不同治理机制的有效性。

title: Nonprofit vs. For-Profit: Allocation of Beds and Access to Care in U.S. Nursing Homes
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Dartmouth College - Tuck School of Business and Northwestern University - Kellogg School of Management

detail.title: Nonprofit vs. For-Profit: Allocation of Beds and Access to Care in U.S. Nursing Homes
detail.abstract:
Problem Definition: U.S. nursing homes allocate federal licensed beds among three categories: Medicare-dedicated beds, Medicaid-dedicated beds, and flexible beds for both populations. This article studies how nonprofit and for-profit nursing homes make bed allocation decisions and how this affects the access to care for the economically disadvantaged Medicaid population. 

Methodology/Results: Analyzing U.S. nursing home data during 2012-2017, we observe that nonprofit nursing homes on average had a higher Medicare-dedicated bed share than for-profit ones. Furthermore, nursing homes reduced their Medicare-dedicated bed share after being converted from nonprofit to for-profit. Motivated by these empirical observations, we construct a queueing network model to study the bed allocation decision of a nursing home, whose objective function is formulated as the sum of its profit and its resident welfare including the costs of blocking and waiting, weighted by the degree of altruism. The higher the altruism, the more a nursing home acts like a nonprofit organization that cares not only about profit but also resident welfare. With this model we find that 1) when the arrival rate of prospective Medicaid residents is sufficiently high, more altruistic nursing homes set a higher Medicare-dedicated bed share than less altruistic ones, thereby lowering access to care for the low-income Medicaid population; 2) when the arrival rate of prospective Medicare residents is sufficiently low, more altruistic nursing homes set a lower Medicare-dedicated bed share than less altruistic ones, resulting in a higher access to care for the Medicaid population. Using nursing home data, we calibrate the parameters of the queueing model  to predict the directional change of bed allocation following ownership conversions. 

Managerial Implications: Contrary to common concerns, our empirical analysis shows that the expansion of the for-profit nursing home sector does not necessarily reduce access to care for the Medicaid population. Our theoretical model demonstrates that the impact of ownership type on bed allocation is shaped by the local demand mix from prospective Medicare and Medicaid residents. These findings offer actionable guidance for regulators evaluating ownership conversion requests, with our data-calibrated framework helping to inform approval decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过排队网络模型分析美国养老院床位分配决策，发现非营利养老院比营利性养老院分配更多床位给Medicare患者。所有权类型对医疗资源分配的影响取决于当地Medicare和Medicaid患者需求比例，营利性养老院扩张不一定减少低收入人群的医疗可及性。
AI.research_question: 非营利和营利性养老院如何做出床位分配决策？这种决策如何影响经济弱势的Medicaid人群的医疗可及性？
AI.motivation: 研究美国养老院在Medicare专用床位、Medicaid专用床位和灵活床位之间的分配决策，特别关注不同所有权类型（非营利vs营利性）对低收入Medicaid人群医疗可及性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 排队网络模型，将养老院的目标函数构建为利润和居民福利（包括阻塞和等待成本）的加权和，权重由利他主义程度决定。
AI.method: 分析2012-2017年美国养老院数据，构建排队网络模型进行理论分析，并使用实际数据校准模型参数。
AI.findings: 1）非营利养老院平均Medicare专用床位比例更高；2）所有权从非营利转为营利性后，Medicare专用床位比例下降；3）利他主义程度高的养老院在Medicaid患者到达率足够高时设置更高Medicare床位比例，反而降低Medicaid人群可及性；4）在Medicare患者到达率足够低时，利他主义养老院设置更低Medicare床位比例，提高Medicaid人群可及性。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了考虑利他主义程度的床位分配排队模型，揭示了所有权类型对医疗资源分配的影响机制，挑战了关于营利性机构必然减少低收入人群医疗可及性的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估所有权转换申请提供可操作的指导框架，数据校准模型可帮助 informed 审批决策，表明营利性养老院扩张不一定损害Medicaid人群利益。

detail.abstract: This study contributes towards the knowledge on HR practices relating to Team building in the organization, specifically on teams and team practices. Besides focusing on the performance aspects of the employees in the insurance sector, this study will explore the factors that contribute to create an effective teamwork. The development of surveys to assess the level of team effectiveness in target teams adds significance to the available metrics for evaluating target achievements. From an academic viewpoint, this study will help balance group literature by examining team effectiveness and its role in contributing to team performance, and, thus, achieving success in business. From a managerial perspective, this study will help top management and team leaders to improve their understanding of the relationships among team effectiveness and team performance. Consequently, they will know how to develop an effective team by targeting specific team effectiveness factors and motivate their colleagues to work together to become a highly effective team through HR practices.

detail.abstract: The study will enable the banks top management to understand the significance of CSR activities that retains both the employees and customers in its business. Engagement in social activities helps the banking industry to be known as a responsible service sector in the context of socio economic development.  By knowing the effectiveness of corporate social responsibility activities, which influences all the major factors such as profitability, financial performance, managing risks, customer retention and employee morale stakeholders will determine how to maximize the returns based on ethical concerns. Furthermore, this study will add knowledge to previous studies on corporate social responsibility activities in banking sector. The major core areas of CSR practices in banking industry are environment, education and employment, rural development, farmer’s welfare, children welfare, community welfare, women empowerment, healthcare and responsible banking. The scope of my research study focuses to a detailed description of all the above core areas related to CSR in banking and analyzing its positive impact on society. This study also gives valuable information to the general public, direct stakeholders like employees, customers, suppliers, regulatory bodies of banks, researchers, students and many others about the CSR activities in banking sector.

title: The Main Factors in Student Satisfaction with a Campus Environment: A Mixed Approach Vs. A Quantitative Approach

detail.title: The Main Factors in Student Satisfaction with a Campus Environment: A Mixed Approach Vs. A Quantitative Approach
detail.abstract:
University dropout rates in Morocco continue to increase, with approximately 49% of students leaving university before graduating, despite the successive reforms and measures taken to achieve Morocco's 2015–2030 strategic vision in the higher education sector "For a university of equity, quality and promotion", which raises questions about the state of knowledge on social inclusion at the university, capable of informing decision-making and the achievement of this strategic vision. While previous studies have used a quantitative approach with an exploratory purpose, to identify the main factors that affect the inclusion of students on university campuses. Knowledge that we consider insufficient to create general and regular knowledge, beyond the cases studied, on the exhaustiveness of these factors, no study has chosen a mixed approach (qualitative and quantitative) to create knowledge on the factors strengthening the attractiveness of the campus environment. Which brings us to our central question:

How does a mixed approach promote the creation of general and regular knowledge on the factors enabling the inclusion of students in the campus environment?

To answer our central question, we intend to discuss the external validity of future studies that will focus on the inclusiveness of the campus environment, mobilizing both a qualitative approach (interpretive descriptive research, phenomenology, ethnographic approach, case study and grounded theory) and a quantitative approach pursuing a descriptive purpose of the research (Structural equation modeling based on partial least squares ‘PLS-SEM’) and an explanatory one (Structural equation modeling based on covariance ‘SEM-CB’).

In a perspective scientific, this discussion will encourage researchers to choose a mixed approach, with a view to creating regular and general knowledge, beyond the cases studied by previous studies, thus participating in the construction of theories on the social inclusion of the university.

From a managerial perspective, this discussion will highlight the benefits of a mixed approach to framing future higher education reforms and decision-making, thereby enabling optimal allocation of resources, capable of creating an environment conducive to teaching and learning within universities, prioritizing efficiency over organizational isomorphism.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨混合研究方法如何促进创建关于校园环境中学生包容性因素的普遍性知识，以解决摩洛哥大学高辍学率问题。

AI.theoretical_framework: 混合研究方法论框架，结合定性方法（解释性描述研究、现象学、民族志方法、案例研究和扎根理论）和定量方法（基于偏最小二乘的结构方程模型PLS-SEM和基于协方差的结构方程模型SEM-CB）。
AI.method: 讨论未来研究的效度，采用混合研究方法，包括定性方法用于深入理解现象，定量方法用于描述性和解释性分析。
AI.findings: 混合研究方法能够超越个案研究，创建普遍性和规律性的知识，有助于构建大学社会包容性理论。
AI.theory_contributions: 促进混合研究方法在高等教育研究中的应用，推动校园社会包容性理论的建设和发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育改革和决策提供科学依据，优化资源配置，创建有利于教学和学习的校园环境，提高组织效率。

title:
Reverse Logistics: Understanding End-Of-

Life Product Management

detail.title:
Reverse Logistics: Understanding End-Of-

Life Product Management
detail.abstract: As firms respond to stricter regulations and increasing consumer expectations, reverse logistics programs to support end-of-life product management strategies have become more prevalent. Despite a growing body of theoretical literature on this topic, many firms struggle to implement efficient and effective reverse logistics systems. In this article, we identify common strategic, tactical, and operational considerations needed to design reverse logistics programs and offer industry examples to show how organizations have excelled in these areas. Through a synthesis of literature and examples, we provide key takeaways across a range of reverse logistics activities. We present ways in which managers can implement best practices in reverse logistics that not only benefit the environment but also generate societal and stakeholder value, augment and improve customer service and loyalty, and increase market share and revenue capabilities.

detail.abstract: Tourism plays a transformative role in rural communities by fostering economic resilience, social cohesion, and environmental sustainability. This paper critically examines its multifaceted impact, highlighting economic empowerment, governance models, cultural preservation, and spatial development. This paper provides policy recommendations to ensure inclusive, sustainable rural tourism development, positioning tourism as a catalyst for long-term socioeconomic transformation.

detail.title: Brief of Amici Curiae Corporate Law Academics in Support of Appellant, Rutledge v. Clearway Energy Group LLC
detail.abstract: This Brief analyzes the normative relationship between the concepts of equity, constitutional law, and statute. It does so in the context of a recent amendment (SB 21) to the Delaware General Corporation Law, which purports to eliminate the Court of Chancery's ability to award equitable relief if certain "safe harbor" conditions are satisfied by parties to a corporate transaction. The Brief was filed with the Supreme Court of Delaware, in a case challenging the constitutionality of this amendment. It offers two main perspectives regarding the function and value of the Court of Chancery's equity jurisdiction. First, equity is critical to the functioning of corporate law, and cannot be overridden by statute, considering both the essence of equity as a corrective to abuses and accidents in the operation of first-order law, and the Delaware Constitution's explicit recognition of the judicial power to do equity, which continues to enjoy a broad, substantive interpretation by courts and scholars. Second, contrary to common assertions, an attempt to interfere with the judiciary's equitable mandate undermines, rather than promotes, predictability and value maximization.

title: Multi-objective vehicle path problem solving with HGASA algorithm based on GAT-driven dynamic cooling coefficients
affiliations: Northeast Electric Power University

detail.title: Multi-objective vehicle path problem solving with HGASA algorithm based on GAT-driven dynamic cooling coefficients

keywords.keywords: multi-objective optimizationgenetic algorithmsimulated annealing algorithmvehicle pathgraph attention networks

detail.abstract: The multi-objective vehicle path problem (MOVRP) is a core challenge in logistics optimisation, which requires balancing multiple conflicting objectives such as travel distance, cost and carbon emission while satisfying constraints such as time windows. To overcome the limitation that traditional genetic algorithms (GA) are prone to fall into local optima, this paper proposes a hybrid genetic simulated annealing algorithm (GAT-HGASA) based on graph attention network (GAT) driven dynamic cooling coefficients. The algorithm combines the global search capability of the genetic algorithm with the simulated annealing (SA) property of accepting inferior solutions to jump out of the local optimum . The core innovation lies in the introduction of the GAT model, which dynamically predicts and adjusts the coefficient of cooling of simulated annealing according to the characteristics of the problem instances, the iteration progress, and the improvement of the objective function, so as to effectively balance the global exploration and local exploitation, and to avoid premature convergence. Through experimental validation on Solomon's standard test set, GAT-HGASA demonstrates significant advantages or competitive performance over HGASA and algorithms such as M-MOEA/D and MOGP in the literature in terms of the quality of the solution set and specific optimisation objectives. This study not only provides an efficient and intelligent optimisation method for solving MOVRP under complex constraints, but also brings a new perspective for dealing with other multi-objective combinatorial optimisation problems based on the dynamic parameter regulation mechanism of GAT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图注意力网络（GAT）驱动动态冷却系数的混合遗传模拟退火算法（GAT-HGASA），用于解决多目标车辆路径问题（MOVRP）。该算法结合遗传算法的全局搜索能力和模拟退火的局部跳出能力，通过GAT动态调整冷却系数，有效平衡全局探索和局部开发，在Solomon标准测试集上表现出优越性能。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种能够有效平衡多目标车辆路径问题中多个冲突目标（如行驶距离、成本和碳排放）的优化算法，避免传统遗传算法容易陷入局部最优的问题？

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于遗传算法（GA）的全局搜索能力、模拟退火（SA）的跳出局部最优特性，以及图注意力网络（GAT）的动态参数调节机制。
AI.method: 提出GAT-HGASA混合算法：1）结合GA和SA的优势；2）使用GAT模型动态预测和调整模拟退火的冷却系数；3）根据问题实例特征、迭代进度和目标函数改进情况进行参数自适应调整。
AI.findings: 在Solomon标准测试集上的实验验证表明，GAT-HGASA在解集质量和特定优化目标方面相比HGASA、M-MOEA/D和MOGP等算法具有显著优势或竞争性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了基于GAT的动态参数调节新机制；2）发展了混合遗传模拟退火算法理论框架；3）为多目标组合优化问题提供了新的解决视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为复杂约束下的MOVRP提供了高效智能的优化方法；2）算法可应用于实际物流路径规划；3）方法具有向其他多目标组合优化问题推广的潜力。

title: The Role of Online Grocery on Household Food Waste: An Empirical Analysis
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Operations Research Center, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: The Role of Online Grocery on Household Food Waste: An Empirical Analysis
detail.abstract: Problem definition: Food waste imposes significant environmental and societal consequences, with households responsible for approximately 37% of total food waste in the United States. While online grocery shopping becomes increasingly prevalent, its impact on household food waste remains an open question. This study provides the first empirical analysis of the causal relationship between online grocery shopping frequency and household food waste. Methodology/results: We first develop a conceptual model that captures households' grocery shopping behavior to motivate our empirical analysis. Using large-scale consumer panel data from 2017 to 2019, we analyze six product categories that vary in perishability. We construct a proxy defined as purchased quantity per inter-trip day per capita (QIC) to capture household food waste. To address endogeneity in online shopping behavior, we employ a two-stage regression with two instrumental variables: lagged household online shopping rate and the average online shopping rate among nearby households. Our results show that greater online shopping frequency significantly reduces household food waste for perishable products such as bread and cheese, while the effect is smaller or nonsignificant for less perishable products such as cereals and cookies, consistent with our theoretical predictions. Our findings are robust to alternative specifications, including the use of single-instrument and zip code fixed effects models. Managerial implications: Our results highlight online grocery platforms as a promising lever for reducing household food waste, offering actionable implications for both government agencies and retailers. Investing in online infrastructure and encouraging consumer migration to online channels may serve the dual objective of supporting sustainability goals while also meeting evolving shopper preferences. Importantly, our findings underscore the importance of incorporating product-level perishability into the design and targeting of digital grocery systems. Focusing operational efforts and promotional strategies on highly perishable categories may offer the greatest impact in curbing household food waste.

AI.method: 使用2017-2019年大规模消费者面板数据，分析六个不同易腐性产品类别；构建QIC指标（人均每日购买量）作为食物浪费代理变量；采用两阶段回归模型，使用滞后家庭在线购物率和附近家庭平均在线购物率作为工具变量解决内生性问题。

title: Evaluating the CSM Specialization on Coursera (2014-2024): A Survey of the Learner Experience in Courses 3 and 4
affiliations: State University of New York - Empire State University and SUNY Empire State University

detail.title: Evaluating the CSM Specialization on Coursera (2014-2024): A Survey of the Learner Experience in Courses 3 and 4
detail.abstract: This paper is the third in a series analyzing the decade-long Career Self-Management (CSM) Project on Coursera. We focus on learner experience in the advanced courses-Course 3 (Strategic Self-Marketing) and Course 4 (CSM Advanced Certification)-using survey data from 598 learners. Our analysis reveals distinct demographic profiles, with Course 3 attracting younger learners and the Course 4 capstone appealing to an older cohort. We observe a progressive rise in learner satisfaction with course competencies across the four-course sequence, culminating in the highest ratings for the project-based Course 4. However, unlike other courses in the specialization, Course 3's learner satisfaction dipped during the pandemic and did not recover post-COVID, suggesting it may benefit from revision. Overall, the findings indicate that the specialization effectively met its learning objectives, and we summarize student suggestions for further improvement.

detail.abstract: This study aims to explain the position of ethnomathematical learning in a space that involves the challenges and problems of indigenous students in overcoming difficulties in learning algebraic material with qualitative descriptive research. Information was collected by finding out the sample from this study, which was conducted using a multi-stage sampling technique. The theme chosen was one grade VII student and one grade VIII student at the Pasuruan ALC Foundation, where both students were indigenous students with problems with algebra material. Ethnomathematics learning with a cultural context at the historical site of Candi Jawi is expected to overcome the difficulties of learning pure mathematics for indigenous students at the Assyfa Learning Center Foundation in Pasuruan.

title: Leveraging Game Theory to Address Abusive Supervision
affiliations: IIM Jammu

detail.title: Leveraging Game Theory to Address Abusive Supervision
detail.abstract: The integration of game theory into human resource management (HRM) offers a strategic framework for addressing abusive supervision and optimizing human resource development. This study applies game theoretic principles to explore how organizations can mitigate abusive supervision through strategic decision-making models and enhance HRD investment by fostering continuous development frameworks aligned with both organizational and employee goals. We introduce a novel model for organizational interactions, combining cooperative and non-cooperative game theory, aimed at reducing power imbalances, promoting collaborative engagement, and improving overall organizational health and productivity. Game theory provides a strategic lens for understanding supervisor-subordinate interactions as a series of decisions with interdependent outcomes. Our proposed model uses Nash equilibrium to identify stable behaviors patterns that discourage abusive practices while encouraging positive and constructive supervisory techniques. By balancing rewards for constructive behaviors and penalties for abusive conduct, we establish a supportive behavioral equilibrium as the optimal approach for both managers and subordinates. This equilibrium creates a self-regulating system in which supervisors are motivated to cultivate positive relationships, knowing that such efforts lead to enhanced performance and a healthier organizational climate. Preliminary results from pilot tests suggest a significant reduction in abusive incidents and an increase in employee job satisfaction, demonstrating that this game-theoretic approach can effectively recalibrate incentives and mitigate toxic behaviors in hierarchical environments. In the context of HRD, game theory highlights the long-term value of consistent investment in employee development as a strategic asset. By framing firmemployee interactions as a repeated cooperative game, organizations can boost productivity through ongoing HRD initiatives, fostering loyalty and minimizing the risk of employees seeking external opportunities after training. HRD strategies are conceptualized as cooperative games, with mutual benefits-manifested in improved productivity and enhanced organizational reputation-shared between the firm and its employees, thereby strengthening a cycle of investment and retention. A resource allocation model illustrates how frequent HRD engagement leads to enhanced employee collaboration, as evidenced by higher job satisfaction and improved skill retention. This research demonstrates how game theory can transform HRM practices, turning potential conflicts into collaborative opportunities. By aligning individual and organizational interests through structured incentives, companies can build a more cohesive and productive workforce. Future research could extend this model to various cultural contexts and examine its applicability across different organizational structures. This paper offers a foundational framework for managers seeking to leverage game theory as a strategic tool for resolving workplace conflicts and maximizing HRD investments.
