title: Exploring spatiotemporal heterogeneity and nonlinear effects in electric vehicle crash risk prediction: A hybrid modeling approach
affiliations: Beijing Jiaotong University, Beijing Jiaotong University, Beijing Jiaotong University, Heriot-Watt University and Beijing Jiaotong University

detail.title: Exploring spatiotemporal heterogeneity and nonlinear effects in electric vehicle crash risk prediction: A hybrid modeling approach
detail.abstract: Electric vehicle (EV)-related risk and uncertainty pose critical challenges for urban traffic management. Fine-grained crash risk prediction at 1km × 1km and hour-of-day resolution remains difficult due to rapidly evolving, strongly spatiotemporally heterogeneous crash patterns. Crash risk research spans risk measurement, prediction modeling, and factor selection, with a move toward interpretable nonlinear hybrid methods, yet temporal dynamics and local heterogeneity remain insufficiently modeled. This study addresses these limitations by first constructing a Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Network Kernel Density Estimation (ST-ANKDE) method that combines network-constrained proximity, cyclic time weighting, severity weighting, and adaptive bandwidths, and then developing a Multiscale Geographically and Temporally Weighted Regression–Extreme Gradient Boosting (MGTWR-XGBoost) method to learn local heterogeneity and nonlinear effects. To capture the influence of preceding periods and adjacent grids, we introduce temporal and spatial weighted crash risk variables (T-AccRisk and S-AccRisk). These are analyzed alongside road-network density, built-environment variables, socioeconomic variables, and EV-specific infrastructure variables. An empirical case study on 14,818 EV crashes shows that ST-ANKDE effectively captures crash risk dynamics, with a mean value of 6.57, and reveals pronounced spatiotemporal heterogeneity. The results show that MGTWR-XGBoost, enhanced by S-AccRisk and T-AccRisk to capture spatiotemporal dependence, achieves MAE = 1.54 and RMSE = 2.06 and outperforms standalone machine learning and other hybrid methods; road-network density, built-environment features, population density, and EV infrastructure coefficients exhibit significant spatiotemporal heterogeneity. Moreover, SHAP further analyzes nonlinear effects. These findings enable grid-level early warning, priority targeting of high-risk periods/locations, and data-driven deployment of enforcement and infrastructure for EV safety management.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了ST-ANKDE和MGTWR-XGBoost混合方法，用于预测电动汽车粒度空间时间冲突风险，通过实验验证显示方法在冲突风险动态捕捉和预测精度方面显著优于现有方法。
AI.research_question: 如何有效预测电动汽车在1km×1km粒度和小时分辨率下的空间时间异质性冲突风险？
AI.motivation: 电动汽车相关风险和不确定性给城市交通管理带来严峻挑战，而现有方法在时间动态和局部异质性建模方面仍有不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间时间统计学、地理加权回归、机器学习和风险预测理论，结合网络约束、周期时间权重、严重程度权重和适应带宽等技术。
AI.method: 首先构建ST-ANKDE方法进行冲突风险估计，然后发展MGTWR-XGBoost混合方法，引入时空权重冲突风险变量(T-AccRisk和S-AccRisk)，结合路网密度、建筑环境、社会经济和EV专用基础设施变量进行分析。
AI.findings: 在14,818起EV冲突数据上，ST-ANKDE有效捕捉冲突风险动态(平均值6.57)，MGTWR-XGBoost达到MAE=1.54和RMSE=2.06，显著优于单独机器学习和其他混合方法，各因素系数呈现显著空间时间异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了ST-ANKDE和MGTWR-XGBoost新方法，完善了空间时间异质性建模理论，为粒度风险预测提供了新的理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果可支持网格级早期预警、高风险时空优先目标定位以及数据驱动的执法和基础设施部署，为电动汽车安全管理提供实践指导。

title: AI & ESG
affiliations: , Pace University - School of Law and Independent

detail.title: AI & ESG
detail.abstract: The field of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) has undergone rapid expansion, followed by political backlash, yet continues to see steady utilization in recent years. Businesses are disclosing social and environmental information, prompting regulatory agencies to propose and set regulations and guidelines. Moreover, ESG is evolving as a tool for investment analysis, a risk management tool, and an approach to corporate social responsibility. Simultaneously, artificial intelligence (AI) is emerging as a possible tool for companies to collect and analyze ESG metrics, including environmental impacts and workplace safety. This Article proposes an approach that companies and their users can employ to leverage AI benefits and adequately minimize risks. This Article addresses (1) the environmental impacts of AI, (2) the numerous ways AI is being used in the ESG space, (3) the legal hurdles companies and their users may face when integrating AI in the ESG space, and (4) best practices to mitigate the risks and leverage the potential of AI in the ESG space. This Article concludes by revealing best practices for companies, which include utilizing blockchain to mitigate risks, implementing adequate procedures and policies, and ensuring adequate oversight over AI use.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能在ESG领域的应用潜力、法律障碍和最佳实践，提出了利用区块链、完善政策程序和加强监管来降低风险的建议。

title: Gradient-Accelerated Search for the Unique Intersection of Monotone Sequences
affiliations: Thalesians

detail.title: Gradient-Accelerated Search for the Unique Intersection of Monotone Sequences
detail.abstract: We study the problem of finding the unique common element of two strictly monotone sequences: a strictly decreasing list A of length m and a strictly increasing list B of length n. Classical solutions in the comparison model include two-pointer saddleback search in O(m + n) time and the optimal Hwang-Lin algorithm in O(m log(n/m)) time. We propose a new method-gradient-accelerated intersection search-that assumes access to local gradients (finite differences) of both sequences. This additional arithmetic information permits Newton-style jumps that typically converge in O(log R) steps, where R is the initial value gap between A[0] and B[n-1]. We prove correctness with a safe linear-time fallback and relate the method to interpolation search and discrete Newton iteration.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于梯度加速的交集搜索方法，利用序列的局部梯度信息实现牛顿式跳跃，在O(log R)步骤内找到两个单调序列的唯一公共元素，相比经典算法有显著加速。
AI.research_question: 如何利用序列的局部梯度信息来加速寻找两个严格单调序列的唯一公共元素？
AI.motivation: 经典算法如双指针鞍背搜索和Hwang-Lin算法在比较模型下存在效率限制，而序列的梯度信息可能提供额外的算术信息来加速搜索过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于牛顿迭代法和插值搜索的理论框架，利用有限差分作为局部梯度信息来指导搜索过程。
AI.method: 梯度加速交集搜索方法，通过访问两个序列的局部梯度（有限差分）信息，实现牛顿风格的跳跃式搜索，并包含线性时间的安全回退机制。
AI.findings: 该方法通常能在O(log R)步骤内收敛，其中R是初始值间隙，相比经典算法有显著的时间复杂度改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了利用梯度信息加速序列交集搜索的理论基础，将牛顿迭代思想应用于离散序列搜索问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种在实际应用中可能更高效的算法，特别适用于具有梯度信息的数值序列搜索场景。

title: Embodied AI as Coach: Integrating Facial Expression and Heart-Rate Biometrics into Adaptive Coaching Systems

detail.title: Embodied AI as Coach: Integrating Facial Expression and Heart-Rate Biometrics into Adaptive Coaching Systems

declarations.ethicsApproval: Applied for Ethics clearance through witsethics.co.za

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly used in human-centered domains such as coaching, education, and healthcare. However, most remain disembodied, relying solely on text or speech while neglecting the non-verbal cues essential to human communication. This paper advances the vision of embodied AI by proposing a multimodal framework that integrates facial expression analysis with biometric signals, heart rate, heart rate variability, and electrodermal activity, for real-time affect recognition. Grounded in embodied cognition, polyvagal theory, emotional intelligence frameworks, and affective computing, the study investigates how such integration can close the empathy gap in AI-mediated coaching. Specifically, it examines fusion strategies (early, late, and hybrid) for synchronizing heterogeneous signals and enabling adaptive coaching systems that dynamically adjust responses to users' affective states. The expected contributions are both scientific, developing robust multimodal affective recognition, and applied, advancing empathetic, trustworthy, and personalized AI-driven coaching interventions.

title: Military Intelligence and Digital Ecosystem Governance
affiliations: Association of Digital Ecosystem Governance and Development Research

detail.title: Military Intelligence and Digital Ecosystem Governance
detail.abstract: Military intelligence has entered an era defined by data abundance rather than scarcity. In this environment, the challenge is no longer solely about collecting information but about filtering intelligence-distinguishing signal from noise, authentic data from disinformation, and strategic insight from overwhelming digital clutter. The integration of artificial intelligence, big data analytics, blockchain, digital twins, and cloud architectures has revolutionized intelligence practices, yet it has also created vulnerabilities that adversaries exploit through cyberattacks and hybrid warfare. Digital ecosystem governance, understood as the systemic management and regulation of interconnected digital infrastructures, offers a framework for addressing these vulnerabilities. By embedding principles of resilience, accountability, and adaptive oversight, ecosystem governance enhances the filtering, validation, and secure dissemination of intelligence. This article examines the convergence of military intelligence and digital ecosystem governance, focusing on the need for intelligence filtering as a strategic and operational imperative. Through case studies from Estonia, the United States, China, and Türkiye, the study demonstrates how ecosystemic governance principles can ensure that intelligence is not only collected but also curated, protected, and made actionable in an era of information overload.

title: From Scarcity to Stewardship: A Phenomenological Investigation of Financial Flourishing and Peace among Support-Based Ministers in Cameroon
affiliations: University of Buea

detail.title: From Scarcity to Stewardship: A Phenomenological Investigation of Financial Flourishing and Peace among Support-Based Ministers in Cameroon

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This author has no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All participants in this study provided a written consent.
declarations.funderStatement: Campus Crusade for Christ funded this research in part.

contentType.other: Ph.D. dissertation, final copy after defense

detail.abstract:
Financial flourishing is a vital yet underexplored aspect of sustaining and enhancing the effectiveness of Christian ministry. This transcendental phenomenological study examines the lived experiences of senior staff of Campus Crusade for Christ (CCC) in Cameroon, with a focus on the significance of financial flourishing and its impact on ministry and leadership. Financial flourishing is defined in this study as being financially sustainable, practicing generosity, stewarding resources ethically, and using financial resources to promote peace. CCC staff members rely on donor support for their salaries and ministry expenses, making financial flourishing a critical factor in building a healthy and impactful organization.                                                          

Using a qualitative phenomenological approach, the study collected data through eight individual interviews, a focus group discussion, and observations. The data were analyzed using Moustakas’ phenomenological method, resulting in textured and structured descriptions that led to the identification of common themes, from which a composite description was derived. The findings demonstrate that financial flourishing extends beyond mere financial stability to encompass fostering peace, strong relationships, leadership effectiveness, and generosity. Without financial flourishing, Christian ministry is hindered, limiting both personal well-being and organizational impact.

Key factors contributing to financial flourishing, as identified in the study, include faith and dependence on God, financial discipline, engagement in income-generating projects, and mindset shifts. Generosity emerged as a core marker of financial flourishing, shaped by spiritual motivations, personal fulfillment, and a sense of reciprocity. The study also highlights the role of financial flourishing in promoting stewardship and integrity, equipping leaders to manage resources wisely, resist financial misconduct, and serve as ethical role models within their organizations.

A significant insight from the research is that financial flourishing requires a shift in mindset from one of scarcity to one of stewardship. The shared experiences of participants revealed a process of mindset change that can serve as a foundation for fundraising training and curriculum development. This study contributes to existing research on financial well-being in faith-based organizations, offering practical insights for theological education, leadership development, and financial sustainability strategies. By fostering financial flourishing, CCC Cameroon can create an environment of shalom (often translated as wholistic peace), ensuring that staff thrive and the organization remains effective and impactful.
